237: export async function commandMove(
238:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
239:   id: string,
240:   status: string = 'done',
241:   reason: string = ''
242: ): Promise<boolean> {
243:   try {
244:     const { root, doneDir, failedDir } = await ensureCommandDirs();
245:     const src = join(root, `${id}.json`);
246:     const destDir = status === 'failed' ? failedDir : doneDir;
247:     const dest = join(destDir, `${id}.json`);
248:     if (existsSync(src)) {
249:       if (reason) {
250:         const data = JSON.parse(await readFile(src, 'utf-8'));
251:         data.status = status;
252:         data.reason = reason;
253:         await writeFile(src, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2), 'utf-8');
254:       }
255:       await rename(src, dest);
256:     }
257:     return true;
258:   } catch (_err) {
259:     return false;
260:   }
261: }

================
File: electron/device-manager.ts
================
 1: import { spawnSync } from 'child_process';
 2: import type { IpcMainInvokeEvent } from 'electron';
 3: 
 4: interface RunResult {
 5:   success: boolean;
 6:   stdout?: string;
 7:   stderr?: string;
 8:   code?: number | null;
 9:   message?: string;
10: }
11: 
12: function run(cmd: string, cmdArgs: string[]): RunResult {
13:   try {
14:     const res = spawnSync(cmd, cmdArgs, { encoding: 'utf8' });
15:     const ok = res.status === 0 || res.status === null;
16:     return { success: ok, stdout: res.stdout || '', stderr: res.stderr || '', code: res.status };
17:   } catch (err) {
18:     return { success: false, message: (err as Error)?.message || String(err) };
19:   }
20: }
21: 
22: export async function deviceActionHandler(
23:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
24:   action: string,
25:   payload: string | string[]
26: ): Promise<RunResult> {
27:   try {
28:     const act = String(action || '').toLowerCase();
29:     const args = Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : typeof payload === 'string' ? [payload] : [];
30: 
31:     if (process.platform !== 'linux') {
32:       return { success: false, message: 'Device actions supported on Linux only' };
33:     }
34: 
35:     if (act === 'movemouse' || act === 'move_mouse' || act === 'mouse_move') {
36:       const x = Number(args[0] || 0);
37:       const y = Number(args[1] || 0);
38:       return run('xdotool', ['mousemove', String(x), String(y)]);
39:     }
40: 
41:     if (act === 'click' || act === 'leftclick') {
42:       const button = args[0] ? String(args[0]) : '1';
43:       return run('xdotool', ['click', String(button)]);
44:     }
45: 
46:     if (act === 'clickdown' || act === 'mousedown') {
47:       const button = args[0] ? String(args[0]) : '1';
48:       return run('xdotool', ['mousedown', String(button)]);
49:     }
50: 
51:     if (act === 'clickup' || act === 'mouseup') {
52:       const button = args[0] ? String(args[0]) : '1';
53:       return run('xdotool', ['mouseup', String(button)]);
54:     }
55: 
56:     if (act === 'rclick' || act === 'rightclick') {
57:       return run('xdotool', ['click', '3']);
58:     }
59: 
60:     if (act === 'key') {
61:       const key = String(args[0] || '');
62:       if (!key) return { success: false, message: 'key missing' };
63:       return run('xdotool', ['key', key]);
64:     }
65: 
66:     if (act === 'type' || act === 'write') {
67:       const text = String(args[0] || '');
68:       if (!text) return { success: false, message: 'text missing' };
69:       return run('xdotool', ['type', '--delay', '0', text]);
70:     }
71: 
72:     if (act === 'copy') {
73:       const text = String(args[0] || '');
74:       if (!text) return { success: false, message: 'text missing' };
75:       const which = spawnSync('which', ['xclip'], { encoding: 'utf8' });
76:       if (which.status !== 0) return { success: false, message: 'xclip not installed' };
77:       const proc = spawnSync('bash', ['-c', `printf %s "${text.replace(/"/g, '\\"')}" | xclip -selection clipboard`], { encoding: 'utf8' });
78:       return { success: proc.status === 0, stdout: proc.stdout || '', stderr: proc.stderr || '' };
79:     }
80: 
81:     if (act === 'paste') {
82:       return run('xdotool', ['key', 'ctrl+v']);
83:     }
84: 
85:     return { success: false, message: 'unknown action' };
86:   } catch (err) {
87:     return { success: false, message: (err as Error)?.message || String(err) };
88:   }
89: }

266: export interface MatchedHint {
267:   pattern: string;
268:   category: string;
269:   suggestion: string;
270:   checkFiles: string[];
271:   relatedDocs: string[];
272:   severity: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical";
273: }
274: 
275: /**
276:  * Hata mesajını pattern database ile eşleştir
277:  */
278: export function matchErrorPattern(
279:   errorMessage: string | null | undefined,
280:   provider: string | null = null
281: ): MatchedHint | null {
282:   if (!errorMessage || typeof errorMessage !== 'string') {
283:     return null;
284:   }
285:   
286:   for (const pattern of ERROR_PATTERNS) {
287:     const regex = new RegExp(pattern.pattern, 'i');
288:     if (regex.test(errorMessage)) {
289:       const hint = { ...pattern };
290:       
291:       if (provider) {
292:         hint.checkFiles = hint.checkFiles.map(f => f.replace(/{provider}/g, provider));
293:         hint.relatedDocs = hint.relatedDocs.map(d => d.replace(/{provider}/g, provider));
294:       }
295:       
296:       return {
297:         pattern: pattern.pattern,
298:         category: hint.category,
299:         suggestion: hint.suggestion,
300:         checkFiles: hint.checkFiles,
301:         relatedDocs: hint.relatedDocs,
302:         severity: hint.severity || 'medium',
303:       };
304:     }
305:   }
306:   
307:   return null;
308: }
309: 
310: export { ERROR_PATTERNS };

================
File: electron/meta-command-manager.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Meta Command Manager - Electron Main Process
  3:  *
  4:  * AI'ların dinamik olarak yeni komutlar tanımlamasını sağlar.
  5:  * Komutlar config/custom-commands.json dosyasında kalıcı olarak saklanır.
  6:  *
  7:  * Güvenlik: Yok - Tam sistem erişimi ile JavaScript kodu çalıştırılabilir.
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: import fs from "fs";
 11: import path from "path";
 12: import { app } from "electron";
 13: import type { IpcMainInvokeEvent } from "electron";
 14: 
 15: interface CustomCommand {
 16:   name: string;
 17:   description: string;
 18:   code: string;
 19:   createdAt: number;
 20:   updatedAt: number;
 21:   createdBy: string;
 22: }
 23: 
 24: type CommandsMap = Record<string, CustomCommand>;
 25: 
 26: const CONFIG_DIR = path.join(app.getAppPath(), "config");
 27: const COMMANDS_FILE = path.join(CONFIG_DIR, "custom-commands.json");
 28: 
 29: /**
 30:  * Config klasörünü oluştur (yoksa)
 31:  */
 32: function ensureConfigDir(): void {
 33:   if (!fs.existsSync(CONFIG_DIR)) {
 34:     fs.mkdirSync(CONFIG_DIR, { recursive: true });
 35:   }
 36: }
 37: 
 38: /**
 39:  * Tüm custom komutları yükle
 40:  */
 41: export function loadCustomCommands(): CommandsMap {
 42:   try {
 43:     ensureConfigDir();
 44:     if (!fs.existsSync(COMMANDS_FILE)) {
 45:       return {};
 46:     }
 47:     const content = fs.readFileSync(COMMANDS_FILE, "utf-8");
 48:     return JSON.parse(content);
 49:   } catch (err) {
 50:     console.error("[MetaCommand] loadCustomCommands hatası:", err);
 51:     return {};
 52:   }
 53: }
 54: 
 55: /**
 56:  * Custom komutları kaydet
 57:  */
 58: function saveCustomCommands(commands: CommandsMap): void {
 59:   try {
 60:     ensureConfigDir();
 61:     fs.writeFileSync(COMMANDS_FILE, JSON.stringify(commands, null, 2), "utf-8");
 62:   } catch (err) {
 63:     console.error("[MetaCommand] saveCustomCommands hatası:", err);
 64:     throw err;
 65:   }
 66: }
 67: 
 68: interface DefineCommandResult {
 69:   success: boolean;
 70:   message?: string;
 71:   error?: string;
 72:   command?: CustomCommand;
 73: }
 74: 
 75: /**
 76:  * Yeni custom komut tanımla
 77:  */
 78: export function defineCommand(
 79:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
 80:   { name, description, code, createdBy }: { name: string; description?: string; code: string; createdBy?: string }
 81: ): DefineCommandResult {
 82:   try {
 83:     if (!name || typeof name !== "string") {
 84:       return { success: false, error: "Komut adı gerekli" };
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     if (!code || typeof code !== "string") {
 88:       return { success: false, error: "Komut kodu gerekli" };
 89:     }
 90: 
 91:     // Komut adını normalize et (PascalCase)
 92:     const normalizedName = name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1);
 93: 
 94:     const commands = loadCustomCommands();
 95: 
 96:     // Komut zaten var mı kontrol et
 97:     const isUpdate = !!commands[normalizedName];
 98: 
 99:     commands[normalizedName] = {
100:       name: normalizedName,
101:       description: description || "",
102:       code: code,
103:       createdAt: Date.now(),
104:       updatedAt: Date.now(),
105:       createdBy: createdBy || "unknown",
106:     };
107: 
108:     saveCustomCommands(commands);
109: 
110:     console.log(`[MetaCommand] Komut ${isUpdate ? "güncellendi" : "oluşturuldu"}: ${normalizedName}`);
111: 
112:     return { 
113:       success: true, 
114:       message: `Komut ${isUpdate ? "güncellendi" : "oluşturuldu"}: ${normalizedName}`,
115:       command: commands[normalizedName]
116:     };
117:   } catch (err) {
118:     console.error("[MetaCommand] defineCommand hatası:", err);
119:     return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
120:   }
121: }
122: 
123: /**
124:  * Custom komutu sil
125:  */
126: export function deleteCommand(
127:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
128:   { name }: { name: string }
129: ): { success: boolean; message?: string; error?: string } {
130:   try {
131:     if (!name || typeof name !== "string") {
132:       return { success: false, error: "Komut adı gerekli" };
133:     }
134: 
135:     const commands = loadCustomCommands();
136: 
137:     // Case-insensitive arama
138:     const key = Object.keys(commands).find(
139:       (k) => k.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()
140:     );
141: 
142:     if (!key) {
143:       return { success: false, error: `Komut bulunamadı: ${name}` };
144:     }
145: 
146:     delete commands[key];
147:     saveCustomCommands(commands);
148: 
149:     console.log(`[MetaCommand] Komut silindi: ${key}`);
150: 
151:     return { success: true, message: `Komut silindi: ${key}` };
152:   } catch (err) {
153:     console.error("[MetaCommand] deleteCommand hatası:", err);
154:     return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
155:   }
156: }
157: 
158: /**
159:  * Tüm custom komutları listele
160:  */
161: export function listCommands(
162:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent
163: ): { success: boolean; commands: CommandsMap; error?: string } {
164:   try {
165:     const commands = loadCustomCommands();
166:     return { success: true, commands };
167:   } catch (err) {
168:     console.error("[MetaCommand] listCommands hatası:", err);
169:     return { success: false, commands: {}, error: (err as Error).message };
170:   }
171: }
172: 
173: /**
174:  * Tek bir custom komutu getir
175:  */
176: export function getCommand(
177:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
178:   { name }: { name: string }
179: ): { success: boolean; command?: CustomCommand; error?: string } {
180:   try {
181:     if (!name) {
182:       return { success: false, error: "Komut adı gerekli" };
183:     }
184: 
185:     const commands = loadCustomCommands();
186: 
187:     // Case-insensitive arama
188:     const key = Object.keys(commands).find(
189:       (k) => k.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()
190:     );
191: 
192:     if (!key) {
193:       return { success: false, error: `Komut bulunamadı: ${name}` };
194:     }
195: 
196:     return { success: true, command: commands[key] };
197:   } catch (err) {
198:     console.error("[MetaCommand] getCommand hatası:", err);
199:     return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
200:   }
201: }

210:   listCommands,
211:   getCommand,
212: };

256: /**
257:  * OpenCode system config'ten model listesini oku
258:  * ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json dosyasından provider ve model bilgilerini parse eder
259:  */
260: export async function loadOpenCodeModels(): Promise<OpenCodeProviderInfo[]> {
261:   const configPath = getOpenCodeSystemConfigPath();
262:   
263:   try {
264:     if (!existsSync(configPath)) {
265:       console.log("[OpenCodeConfig] System config not found:", configPath);
266:       return [];
267:     }
268: 
269:     const content = await readFile(configPath, "utf-8");
270:     const config = JSON.parse(content);
271:     
272:     const providers: OpenCodeProviderInfo[] = [];
273:     
274:     // Parse provider section
275:     if (config.provider && typeof config.provider === "object") {
276:       for (const [providerId, providerData] of Object.entries(config.provider)) {
277:         const providerInfo: OpenCodeProviderInfo = {
278:           id: providerId,
279:           name: formatProviderName(providerId),
280:           models: [],
281:         };
282:         
283:         // Parse models for this provider
284:         const pData = providerData as { models?: Record<string, unknown> };
285:         if (pData.models && typeof pData.models === "object") {
286:           for (const [modelId, modelData] of Object.entries(pData.models)) {
287:             const mData = modelData as {
288:               name?: string;
289:               limit?: { context?: number; output?: number };
290:               variants?: Record<string, unknown>;
291:             };
292:             
293:             const modelInfo: OpenCodeModelInfo = {
294:               id: modelId,
295:               name: mData.name || modelId,
296:               providerId,
297:               context: mData.limit?.context,
298:               output: mData.limit?.output,
299:               variants: mData.variants ? Object.keys(mData.variants) : undefined,
300:             };
301:             
302:             providerInfo.models.push(modelInfo);
303:           }
304:         }
305:         
306:         if (providerInfo.models.length > 0) {
307:           providers.push(providerInfo);
308:         }
309:       }
310:     }
311:     
312:     console.log(`[OpenCodeConfig] Loaded ${providers.length} providers with models`);
313:     return providers;
314:     
315:   } catch (err) {
316:     console.error("[OpenCodeConfig] Failed to load models:", err);
317:     return [];
318:   }
319: }

324: function formatProviderName(providerId: string): string {
325:   const nameMap: Record<string, string> = {
326:     google: "Google",
327:     anthropic: "Anthropic",
328:     openai: "OpenAI",
329:     azure: "Azure",
330:     bedrock: "AWS Bedrock",
331:     vertex: "Google Vertex",
332:     ollama: "Ollama",
333:     groq: "Groq",
334:   };
335:   return nameMap[providerId.toLowerCase()] || providerId;
336: }

365:   defaultAgentModel?: AgentModelPreference;

368: /**
369:  * Normalize folder path for consistent key
370:  */
371: function normalizeFolderPath(folderPath: string): string {
372:   return folderPath.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\/$/, '');
373: }
374: 
375: /**
376:  * Get agent/model preference for a folder
377:  * Falls back to default if folder-specific preference doesn't exist
378:  */
379: export async function getAgentModelPreference(folderPath?: string): Promise<AgentModelPreference | null> {
380:   try {
381:     const config = await loadOpencodeConfig() as OpenCodeConfigExtended;
382:     
383:     if (folderPath) {
384:       const normalizedPath = normalizeFolderPath(folderPath);
385:       const folderPref = config.agentModelPreferences?.[normalizedPath];
386:       if (folderPref) {
387:         console.log(`[OpenCodeConfig] Loaded preference for ${normalizedPath}:`, folderPref);
388:         return folderPref;
389:       }
390:     }
391:     
392:     // Fall back to default
393:     if (config.defaultAgentModel) {
394:       console.log('[OpenCodeConfig] Using default preference:', config.defaultAgentModel);
395:       return config.defaultAgentModel;
396:     }
397:     
398:     return null;
399:   } catch (error) {
400:     console.error('[OpenCodeConfig] Error getting agent/model preference:', error);
401:     return null;
402:   }
403: }
404: 
405: /**
406:  * Save agent/model preference for a folder
407:  * Also updates the default if no folder specified
408:  * Merges with existing preference - only updates defined (non-null/undefined) values
409:  */
410: export async function saveAgentModelPreference(
411:   preference: Omit<AgentModelPreference, 'lastUpdated'>,
412:   folderPath?: string
413: ): Promise<boolean> {
414:   try {
415:     const config = await loadOpencodeConfig() as OpenCodeConfigExtended;
416:     
417:     // Get existing preference to merge with
418:     const existingPref = folderPath 
419:       ? config.agentModelPreferences?.[normalizeFolderPath(folderPath)]
420:       : config.defaultAgentModel;
421:     
422:     // Merge: only override if new value is defined (not null/undefined)
423:     const mergedPref: AgentModelPreference = {
424:       agent: preference.agent ?? existingPref?.agent,
425:       providerId: preference.providerId ?? existingPref?.providerId,
426:       modelId: preference.modelId ?? existingPref?.modelId,
427:       lastUpdated: Date.now(),
428:     };
429:     
430:     console.log('[OpenCodeConfig] Merging preference:', { incoming: preference, existing: existingPref, merged: mergedPref });
431:     
432:     if (folderPath) {
433:       const normalizedPath = normalizeFolderPath(folderPath);
434:       
435:       // Initialize preferences object if not exists
436:       if (!config.agentModelPreferences) {
437:         config.agentModelPreferences = {};
438:       }
439:       
440:       config.agentModelPreferences[normalizedPath] = mergedPref;
441:       console.log(`[OpenCodeConfig] Saved preference for ${normalizedPath}:`, mergedPref);
442:     }
443:     
444:     // Always update default as well (last used becomes default)
445:     config.defaultAgentModel = mergedPref;
446:     
447:     await saveOpencodeConfig(config);
448:     return true;
449:   } catch (error) {
450:     console.error('[OpenCodeConfig] Error saving agent/model preference:', error);
451:     return false;
452:   }
453: }

460:   return saveAgentModelPreference({
461:     ...current,
462:     agent,
463:   }, folderPath);
464: }

================
File: electron/session-manager.ts

  1: /**
  2:  * Session Manager - Electron session/cache yönetimi
  3:  *
  4:  * Uygulama açılışında cache temizliği yapar.
  5:  * Login bilgilerini (cookies, localStorage) korur.
  6:  *
  7:  * @module electron/session-manager
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: import { session } from "electron";
 11: 
 12: interface ClearResult {
 13:   success: boolean;
 14:   cleared: string[];
 15:   error?: string;
 16: }
 17: 
 18: interface ClearAllResult {
 19:   success: boolean;
 20:   error?: string;
 21: }
 22: 
 23: // Yönetilen partition'lar
 24: const PARTITIONS = {
 25:   MAIN: "persist:main", // AI1 + AI2 paylaşımlı
 26:   ASISTAN: "persist:ai0", // Asistan - izole
 27: } as const;
 28: 
 29: // Temizlenecek storage türleri (login bilgileri HARİÇ)
 30: const CLEARABLE_STORAGES: ("cachestorage" | "serviceworkers")[] = [
 31:   "cachestorage", // Service worker cache (~100-300 MB)
 32:   "serviceworkers", // SW registrations
 33: ];
 34: 
 35: /**
 36:  * Belirli bir partition için cache temizliği yapar.
 37:  * Cookies ve localStorage'a DOKUNMAZ.
 38:  */
 39: async function clearPartitionCache(partitionName: string): Promise<ClearResult> {
 40:   try {
 41:     const ses = session.fromPartition(partitionName);
 42: 
 43:     // Storage temizliği (cookies ve localStorage HARİÇ)
 44:     await ses.clearStorageData({
 45:       storages: CLEARABLE_STORAGES,
 46:     });
 47: 
 48:     // HTTP cache temizliği
 49:     await ses.clearCache();
 50: 
 51:     console.log(`[session-manager] Cache temizlendi: ${partitionName}`);
 52: 
 53:     return {
 54:       success: true,
 55:       cleared: [...CLEARABLE_STORAGES, "httpcache"],
 56:     };
 57:   } catch (error) {
 58:     console.error(`[session-manager] Cache temizleme hatası (${partitionName}):`, (error as Error).message);
 59: 
 60:     return {
 61:       success: false,
 62:       cleared: [],
 63:       error: (error as Error).message,
 64:     };
 65:   }
 66: }
 67: 
 68: /**
 69:  * Tüm partition'lar için startup cache temizliği yapar.
 70:  * Uygulama açılışında çağrılır.
 71:  */
 72: export async function clearStartupCache(): Promise<{ main: ClearResult; asistan: ClearResult }> {
 73:   console.log("[session-manager] Startup cache temizliği başlıyor...");
 74: 
 75:   const results = {
 76:     main: await clearPartitionCache(PARTITIONS.MAIN),
 77:     asistan: await clearPartitionCache(PARTITIONS.ASISTAN),
 78:   };
 79: 
 80:   const totalSuccess = results.main.success && results.asistan.success;
 81: 
 82:   console.log(
 83:     `[session-manager] Startup cache temizliği ${totalSuccess ? "tamamlandı" : "kısmen başarısız"}`
 84:   );
 85: 
 86:   return results;
 87: }
 88: 
 89: /**
 90:  * Belirli bir partition'ın tüm verilerini siler (logout için).
 91:  * DİKKAT: Bu fonksiyon cookies dahil HER ŞEYİ siler!
 92:  */
 93: async function _clearAllSessionData(partitionName: string): Promise<ClearAllResult> {
 94:   try {
 95:     const ses = session.fromPartition(partitionName);
 96: 
 97:     // Tüm storage'ları temizle (cookies dahil)
 98:     await ses.clearStorageData();
 99:     await ses.clearCache();
100:     await ses.clearAuthCache();
101: 
102:     console.log(`[session-manager] Tüm session verisi silindi: ${partitionName}`);
103: 
104:     return { success: true };
105:   } catch (error) {
106:     console.error(`[session-manager] Session silme hatası (${partitionName}):`, (error as Error).message);
107: 
108:     return { success: false, error: (error as Error).message };
109:   }
110: }
111: 
112: /**
113:  * Session Manager'ı export et
114:  */
115: export const SessionManager = {
116:   PARTITIONS,
117:   clearStartupCache,
118:   clearPartitionCache,
119: };

 17: export async function catboxUpload(
 18:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
 19:   payload: UploadPayload = {}
 20: ): Promise<UploadResult> {
 21:   try {
 22:     const {
 23:       name,
 24:       mimeType = "application/octet-stream",
 25:       base64,
 26:     } = payload || {};
 27:     if (!base64 || !name) return { success: false, message: "Eksik parametre" };
 28: 
 29:     const url = "https://catbox.moe/user/api.php";
 30:     const boundary = `----HayaletEv${Date.now()}`;
 31:     const eol = "\r\n";
 32:     const fileBuffer = Buffer.from(base64, "base64");
 33: 
 34:     let pre = `--${boundary}${eol}`;
 35:     pre += `Content-Disposition: form-data; name="fileToUpload"; filename="${name}"${eol}`;
 36:     pre += `Content-Type: ${mimeType}${eol}${eol}`;
 37:     const post = `${eol}--${boundary}${eol}Content-Disposition: form-data; name="reqtype"${eol}${eol}fileupload${eol}--${boundary}--${eol}`;
 38: 
 39:     const bodyBuffer = Buffer.concat([
 40:       Buffer.from(pre, "utf8"),
 41:       fileBuffer,
 42:       Buffer.from(post, "utf8"),
 43:     ]);
 44: 
 45:     let res;
 46:     if (typeof fetch === "function") {
 47:       res = await fetch(url, {
 48:         method: "POST",
 49:         headers: {
 50:           "Content-Type": `multipart/form-data; boundary=${boundary}`,
 51:         },
 52:         body: bodyBuffer,
 53:       });
 54:     } else {
 55:       throw new Error(
 56:         "Global fetch is not available in this Node runtime. Please run on Node 18+ or provide a fetch polyfill.",
 57:       );
 58:     }
 59: 
 60:     const text = await res.text();
 61:     return {
 62:       success: res.ok,
 63:       status: res.status,
 64:       statusText: res.statusText,
 65:       data: text,
 66:     };
 67:   } catch (err) {
 68:     return { success: false, message: (err as Error)?.message || "catbox upload failed" };
 69:   }
 70: }

  1: /**
  2:  * Diff Utilities
  3:  * 
  4:  * Dosya ve içerik karşılaştırma araçları
  5:  * - Unified diff formatı
  6:  * - Satır bazlı karşılaştırma
  7:  * - Değişiklik özeti
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: import { readFileSync, existsSync } from "fs";
 11: 
 12: // ============================================
 13: // Types
 14: // ============================================
 15: 
 16: export interface DiffLine {
 17:   type: "added" | "removed" | "unchanged" | "header";
 18:   lineNumber?: { old?: number; new?: number };
 19:   content: string;
 20: }
 21: 
 22: export interface DiffResult {
 23:   file1: string;
 24:   file2: string;
 25:   identical: boolean;
 26:   additions: number;
 27:   deletions: number;
 28:   changes: DiffLine[];
 29:   summary: string;
 30: }
 31: 
 32: export interface ContentDiffResult {
 33:   identical: boolean;
 34:   additions: number;
 35:   deletions: number;
 36:   changes: DiffLine[];
 37:   unified: string;
 38: }
 39: 
 40: // ============================================
 41: // Core Diff Algorithm (Myers-like simplified)
 42: // ============================================
 43: 
 44: /**
 45:  * İki string array'ini karşılaştır
 46:  */
 47: function computeDiff(oldLines: string[], newLines: string[]): DiffLine[] {
 48:   // LCS (Longest Common Subsequence) tabanlı basit diff
 49:   const oldLen = oldLines.length;
 50:   const newLen = newLines.length;
 51:   
 52:   // DP matrix
 53:   const dp: number[][] = Array(oldLen + 1).fill(null).map(() => Array(newLen + 1).fill(0));
 54:   
 55:   for (let i = 1; i <= oldLen; i++) {
 56:     for (let j = 1; j <= newLen; j++) {
 57:       if (oldLines[i - 1] === newLines[j - 1]) {
 58:         dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
 59:       } else {
 60:         dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
 61:       }
 62:     }
 63:   }
 64:   
 65:   // Backtrack to find diff
 66:   let i = oldLen;
 67:   let j = newLen;
 68:   const tempResult: DiffLine[] = [];
 69:   
 70:   while (i > 0 || j > 0) {
 71:     if (i > 0 && j > 0 && oldLines[i - 1] === newLines[j - 1]) {
 72:       tempResult.unshift({
 73:         type: "unchanged",
 74:         lineNumber: { old: i, new: j },
 75:         content: oldLines[i - 1],
 76:       });
 77:       i--;
 78:       j--;
 79:     } else if (j > 0 && (i === 0 || dp[i][j - 1] >= dp[i - 1][j])) {
 80:       tempResult.unshift({
 81:         type: "added",
 82:         lineNumber: { new: j },
 83:         content: newLines[j - 1],
 84:       });
 85:       j--;
 86:     } else if (i > 0) {
 87:       tempResult.unshift({
 88:         type: "removed",
 89:         lineNumber: { old: i },
 90:         content: oldLines[i - 1],
 91:       });
 92:       i--;
 93:     }
 94:   }
 95:   
 96:   return tempResult;
 97: }
 98: 
 99: /**
100:  * Diff'i unified format'a çevir
101:  */
102: function toUnifiedFormat(diff: DiffLine[], contextLines: number = 3): string {
103:   if (!diff || diff.length === 0) {
104:     return "";
105:   }
106:   
107:   const lines: string[] = [];
108:   let currentHunk: DiffLine[] = [];
109:   let lastChangeIndex = -contextLines - 1;
110:   
111:   for (let i = 0; i < diff.length; i++) {
112:     const line = diff[i];
113:     if (!line) continue;
114:     
115:     if (line.type !== "unchanged") {
116:       // Değişiklik var, context ile birlikte ekle
117:       const contextStart = Math.max(lastChangeIndex + 1, i - contextLines);
118:       
119:       // Önceki context satırlarını ekle
120:       for (let c = contextStart; c < i; c++) {
121:         const contextLine = diff[c];
122:         if (contextLine && contextLine.type === "unchanged" && !currentHunk.includes(contextLine)) {
123:           currentHunk.push(contextLine);
124:         }
125:       }
126:       
127:       currentHunk.push(line);
128:       lastChangeIndex = i;
129:     } else if (i - lastChangeIndex <= contextLines) {
130:       // Değişiklikten sonraki context
131:       currentHunk.push(line);
132:     } else if (currentHunk.length > 0) {
133:       // Hunk'ı bitir
134:       lines.push(...formatHunk(currentHunk));
135:       lines.push("");
136:       currentHunk = [];
137:     }
138:   }
139:   
140:   // Son hunk
141:   if (currentHunk.length > 0) {
142:     lines.push(...formatHunk(currentHunk));
143:   }
144:   
145:   return lines.join("\n");
146: }
147: 
148: function formatHunk(hunk: DiffLine[]): string[] {
149:   const lines: string[] = [];
150:   
151:   if (!hunk || hunk.length === 0) {
152:     return lines;
153:   }
154:   
155:   // Hunk header
156:   const oldStart = hunk.find(l => l.lineNumber?.old)?.lineNumber?.old || 1;
157:   const newStart = hunk.find(l => l.lineNumber?.new)?.lineNumber?.new || 1;
158:   const oldCount = hunk.filter(l => l.type !== "added").length;
159:   const newCount = hunk.filter(l => l.type !== "removed").length;
160:   
161:   lines.push(`@@ -${oldStart},${oldCount} +${newStart},${newCount} @@`);
162:   
163:   for (const line of hunk) {
164:     if (!line || !line.type) continue;
165:     
166:     switch (line.type) {
167:       case "added":
168:         lines.push(`+ ${line.content ?? ""}`);
169:         break;
170:       case "removed":
171:         lines.push(`- ${line.content ?? ""}`);
172:         break;
173:       case "unchanged":
174:         lines.push(`  ${line.content ?? ""}`);
175:         break;
176:       default:
177:         lines.push(`  ${line.content ?? ""}`);
178:     }
179:   }
180:   
181:   return lines;
182: }

185: // Public API

188: /**
189:  * İki dosyayı karşılaştır
190:  */
191: export function diffFiles(file1: string, file2: string): DiffResult {
192:   if (!existsSync(file1)) {
193:     return {
194:       file1,
195:       file2,
196:       identical: false,
197:       additions: 0,
198:       deletions: 0,
199:       changes: [],
200:       summary: `Hata: ${file1} bulunamadı`,
201:     };
202:   }
203:   
204:   if (!existsSync(file2)) {
205:     return {
206:       file1,
207:       file2,
208:       identical: false,
209:       additions: 0,
210:       deletions: 0,
211:       changes: [],
212:       summary: `Hata: ${file2} bulunamadı`,
213:     };
214:   }
215:   
216:   const content1 = readFileSync(file1, "utf-8");
217:   const content2 = readFileSync(file2, "utf-8");
218:   
219:   const lines1 = content1.split("\n");
220:   const lines2 = content2.split("\n");
221:   
222:   const diff = computeDiff(lines1, lines2);
223:   const additions = diff.filter(d => d.type === "added").length;
224:   const deletions = diff.filter(d => d.type === "removed").length;
225:   const identical = additions === 0 && deletions === 0;
226:   
227:   let summary = "";
228:   if (identical) {
229:     summary = "✅ Dosyalar aynı";
230:   } else {
231:     summary = `📊 ${additions} ekleme, ${deletions} silme\n\n`;
232:     summary += toUnifiedFormat(diff);
233:   }
234:   
235:   return {
236:     file1,
237:     file2,
238:     identical,
239:     additions,
240:     deletions,
241:     changes: diff.filter(d => d.type !== "unchanged"),
242:     summary,
243:   };
244: }
245: 
246: /**
247:  * İki metin bloğunu karşılaştır
248:  */
249: export function diffContent(content1: string, content2: string, label1: string = "a", label2: string = "b"): ContentDiffResult {
250:   const lines1 = content1.split("\n");
251:   const lines2 = content2.split("\n");
252:   
253:   const diff = computeDiff(lines1, lines2);
254:   const additions = diff.filter(d => d.type === "added").length;
255:   const deletions = diff.filter(d => d.type === "removed").length;
256:   const identical = additions === 0 && deletions === 0;
257:   
258:   let unified = "";
259:   if (!identical) {
260:     unified = `--- ${label1}\n+++ ${label2}\n`;
261:     unified += toUnifiedFormat(diff);
262:   }
263:   
264:   return {
265:     identical,
266:     additions,
267:     deletions,
268:     changes: diff.filter(d => d.type !== "unchanged"),
269:     unified,
270:   };
271: }

273: /**
274:  * Dosya içeriğini satır numaralarıyla göster
275:  */
276: export function showFileContent(filePath: string, startLine?: number, endLine?: number): string {
277:   if (!existsSync(filePath)) {
278:     return `Hata: ${filePath} bulunamadı`;
279:   }
280:   
281:   const content = readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
282:   const lines = content.split("\n");
283:   
284:   const start = startLine ? Math.max(1, startLine) : 1;
285:   const end = endLine ? Math.min(lines.length, endLine) : lines.length;
286:   
287:   const result: string[] = [];
288:   const lineNumWidth = String(end).length;
289:   
290:   for (let i = start - 1; i < end; i++) {
291:     const lineNum = String(i + 1).padStart(lineNumWidth, " ");
292:     result.push(`${lineNum} │ ${lines[i]}`);
293:   }
294:   
295:   return result.join("\n");
296: }

298: /**
299:  * Dosya değişiklik özeti (git diff benzeri)
300:  */
301: export function getFileSummary(filePath: string): { lines: number; words: number; chars: number; language: string } {
302:   if (!existsSync(filePath)) {
303:     return { lines: 0, words: 0, chars: 0, language: "unknown" };
304:   }
305:   
306:   const content = readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
307:   const lines = content.split("\n").length;
308:   const words = content.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 0).length;
309:   const chars = content.length;
310:   
311:   // Detect language from extension
312:   const ext = filePath.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() || "";
313:   const languageMap: Record<string, string> = {
314:     ts: "TypeScript",
315:     tsx: "TypeScript (React)",
316:     js: "JavaScript",
317:     jsx: "JavaScript (React)",
318:     py: "Python",
319:     rs: "Rust",
320:     go: "Go",
321:     java: "Java",
322:     cpp: "C++",
323:     c: "C",
324:     css: "CSS",
325:     html: "HTML",
326:     json: "JSON",
327:     yaml: "YAML",
328:     yml: "YAML",
329:     md: "Markdown",
330:     sh: "Shell",
331:   };
332:   
333:   const language = languageMap[ext] || ext.toUpperCase();
334:   
335:   return { lines, words, chars, language };
336: }

  1: /**

 20:   ".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".mjs", ".cjs",

 22:   ".cs", ".rb", ".php", ".swift", ".scala", ".vue", ".svelte"

 29:   ".exe", ".dll", ".so", ".dylib", ".bin",

 42: // ============================================
 43: // Code Structure Parsing
 44: // ============================================
 45: 
 46: /**
 47:  * TypeScript/JavaScript dosyasından kod yapısını çıkar
 48:  * Basit regex-based parser (tam AST parsing yerine performans için)
 49:  */
 50: export function parseCodeStructure(content: string, extension: string): CodeStructure[] {
 51:   const structures: CodeStructure[] = [];
 52:   const lines = content.split("\n");
 53:   
 54:   // Sadece TS/JS dosyaları için parse et
 55:   if (![".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".mjs", ".cjs"].includes(extension)) {
 56:     return structures;
 57:   }
 58:   
 59:   const stack: { type: string; name: string; startLine: number; braceCount: number }[] = [];
 60:   let braceCount = 0;
 61:   
 62:   for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
 63:     const line = lines[i];
 64:     const lineNum = i; // 0-indexed
 65:     
 66:     // Brace counting
 67:     const openBraces = (line.match(/{/g) || []).length;
 68:     const closeBraces = (line.match(/}/g) || []).length;
 69:     
 70:     // Function declaration: function name(...) { veya async function name(...)
 71:     const funcMatch = line.match(/^(\s*)(export\s+)?(async\s+)?function\s+(\w+)\s*\(/);
 72:     if (funcMatch) {
 73:       stack.push({ type: "function", name: funcMatch[4], startLine: lineNum, braceCount });
 74:     }
 75:     
 76:     // Arrow function: const name = (...) => veya const name = async (...) =>
 77:     const arrowMatch = line.match(/^(\s*)(export\s+)?(const|let|var)\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*(async\s*)?\([^)]*\)\s*(:\s*\w+)?\s*=>/);
 78:     if (arrowMatch) {
 79:       stack.push({ type: "function", name: arrowMatch[4], startLine: lineNum, braceCount });
 80:     }
 81:     
 82:     // Class declaration
 83:     const classMatch = line.match(/^(\s*)(export\s+)?(abstract\s+)?class\s+(\w+)/);
 84:     if (classMatch) {
 85:       stack.push({ type: "class", name: classMatch[4], startLine: lineNum, braceCount });
 86:     }
 87:     
 88:     // Interface declaration
 89:     const interfaceMatch = line.match(/^(\s*)(export\s+)?interface\s+(\w+)/);
 90:     if (interfaceMatch) {
 91:       stack.push({ type: "interface", name: interfaceMatch[3], startLine: lineNum, braceCount });
 92:     }
 93:     
 94:     // Type declaration
 95:     const typeMatch = line.match(/^(\s*)(export\s+)?type\s+(\w+)\s*=/);
 96:     if (typeMatch) {
 97:       // Type'lar genellikle tek satır, ama çok satırlı olabilir
 98:       stack.push({ type: "type", name: typeMatch[3], startLine: lineNum, braceCount });
 99:     }
100:     
101:     // Method in class: name(...) { veya async name(...)
102:     const methodMatch = line.match(/^(\s+)(async\s+)?(\w+)\s*\([^)]*\)\s*(:\s*[^{]+)?\s*{/);
103:     if (methodMatch && stack.length > 0 && stack[stack.length - 1].type === "class") {
104:       stack.push({ type: "method", name: methodMatch[3], startLine: lineNum, braceCount });
105:     }
106:     
107:     // Update brace count
108:     braceCount += openBraces - closeBraces;
109:     
110:     // Check if any structure is closed
111:     while (stack.length > 0) {
112:       const current = stack[stack.length - 1];
113:       if (braceCount <= current.braceCount) {
114:         stack.pop();
115:         structures.push({
116:           type: current.type as CodeStructure["type"],
117:           name: current.name,
118:           startLine: current.startLine,
119:           endLine: lineNum,
120:         });
121:       } else {
122:         break;
123:       }
124:     }
125:   }
126:   
127:   // Close any remaining structures
128:   while (stack.length > 0) {
129:     const current = stack.pop()!;
130:     structures.push({
131:       type: current.type as CodeStructure["type"],
132:       name: current.name,
133:       startLine: current.startLine,
134:       endLine: lines.length - 1,
135:     });
136:   }
137:   
138:   return structures.sort((a, b) => a.startLine - b.startLine);
139: }
140: 
141: /**
142:  * Collapsed view oluştur - fonksiyon/class gövdelerini gizle
143:  */
144: export function createCollapsedView(content: string, extension: string): string {
145:   const structures = parseCodeStructure(content, extension);
146:   if (structures.length === 0) {
147:     return content;
148:   }
149:   
150:   const lines = content.split("\n");
151:   const result: string[] = [];
152:   const hiddenRanges: Set<number> = new Set();
153:   
154:   // Gizlenecek satırları belirle (fonksiyon/method gövdeleri)
155:   for (const struct of structures) {
156:     if (struct.type === "function" || struct.type === "method") {
157:       // İlk satırı (signature) göster, geri kalanını gizle
158:       for (let i = struct.startLine + 1; i < struct.endLine; i++) {
159:         hiddenRanges.add(i);
160:       }
161:     }
162:   }
163:   
164:   let lastWasHidden = false;
165:   for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
166:     if (hiddenRanges.has(i)) {
167:       if (!lastWasHidden) {
168:         result.push(`${String(i).padStart(4)}     ... (collapsed)`);
169:         lastWasHidden = true;
170:       }
171:     } else {
172:       result.push(`${String(i).padStart(4)} ${lines[i]}`);
173:       lastWasHidden = false;
174:     }
175:   }
176:   
177:   return result.join("\n");
178: }
179: 
180: /**
181:  * Satır numaralı içerik oluştur
182:  */
183: export function addLineNumbers(content: string): string {
184:   const lines = content.split("\n");
185:   return lines.map((line, i) => `${String(i).padStart(4)} ${line}`).join("\n");
186: }

192: /**
193:  * Dosya oku ve collapsed view uygula (gerekirse)
194:  */
195: export async function readFileWithCollapse(filePath: string): Promise<FileContent> {
196:   try {
197:     const ext = extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
198:     
199:     // Binary dosyaları atla
200:     if (BINARY_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) {
201:       return {
202:         path: filePath,
203:         content: `[Binary file: ${ext}]`,
204:         lineCount: 0,
205:         isCollapsed: false,
206:       };
207:     }
208:     
209:     const content = await readFile(filePath, "utf-8");
210:     const lineCount = content.split("\n").length;
211:     const shouldCollapse = content.length > COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD && CODE_EXTENSIONS.has(ext);
212:     
213:     if (shouldCollapse) {
214:       return {
215:         path: filePath,
216:         content: createCollapsedView(content, ext),
217:         lineCount,
218:         isCollapsed: true,
219:       };
220:     }
221:     
222:     return {
223:       path: filePath,
224:       content: addLineNumbers(content),
225:       lineCount,
226:       isCollapsed: false,
227:     };
228:   } catch (error) {
229:     return {
230:       path: filePath,
231:       content: "",
232:       lineCount: 0,
233:       isCollapsed: false,
234:       error: (error as Error).message,
235:     };
236:   }
237: }

239: /**
240:  * Belirli satır aralıklarını genişlet
241:  */
242: export async function expandLineRanges(
243:   filePath: string,
244:   ranges: [number, number][]
245: ): Promise<string> {
246:   const content = await readFile(filePath, "utf-8");
247:   const lines = content.split("\n");
248:   const result: string[] = [];
249:   
250:   // Tüm dosya için [-1] veya [0, -1]
251:   if (ranges.length === 1 && (ranges[0][1] === -1 || ranges[0][0] === -1)) {
252:     return addLineNumbers(content);
253:   }
254:   
255:   // Normalize edilmiş ranges
256:   const normalizedRanges = ranges.map(([start, end]) => {
257:     const normalizedEnd = end === -1 ? lines.length : end;
258:     return [Math.max(0, start), Math.min(normalizedEnd, lines.length)] as [number, number];
259:   });
260:   
261:   // Birleşik satır setleri
262:   const includedLines = new Set<number>();
263:   for (const [start, end] of normalizedRanges) {
264:     for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
265:       includedLines.add(i);
266:     }
267:   }
268:   
269:   let lastIncluded = -2;
270:   for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
271:     if (includedLines.has(i)) {
272:       if (i > lastIncluded + 1 && lastIncluded >= 0) {
273:         result.push("     ...");
274:       }
275:       result.push(`${String(i).padStart(4)} ${lines[i]}`);
276:       lastIncluded = i;
277:     }
278:   }
279:   
280:   return result.join("\n");
281: }

283: /**
284:  * Kod sembollerini (fonksiyon, class vb.) bul ve genişlet
285:  */
286: export async function expandSymbols(
287:   filePath: string,
288:   patterns: string[]
289: ): Promise<string> {
290:   const content = await readFile(filePath, "utf-8");
291:   const ext = extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
292:   const lines = content.split("\n");
293:   const structures = parseCodeStructure(content, ext);
294:   
295:   const matchedRanges: [number, number][] = [];
296:   
297:   for (const pattern of patterns) {
298:     // "def function_name" veya "class ClassName" formatı
299:     const [prefix, name] = pattern.includes(" ") 
300:       ? pattern.split(" ", 2) 
301:       : [null, pattern];
302:     
303:     // Slash ile nested symbol: "MyClass/myMethod"
304:     const parts = name.split("/");
305:     
306:     for (const struct of structures) {
307:       let matches = false;
308:       
309:       if (parts.length === 1) {
310:         // Basit eşleşme
311:         matches = struct.name === parts[0] || struct.name.includes(parts[0]);
312:         if (prefix) {
313:           const typeMap: Record<string, string[]> = {
314:             "def": ["function", "method"],
315:             "function": ["function"],
316:             "class": ["class"],
317:             "interface": ["interface"],
318:             "type": ["type"],
319:           };
320:           matches = matches && (typeMap[prefix]?.includes(struct.type) ?? false);
321:         }
322:       } else if (parts.length === 2) {
323:         // Nested: parent/child
324:         const [parentName, childName] = parts;
325:         if (struct.name === parentName || struct.name.includes(parentName)) {
326:           // Parent içindeki child'ları bul
327:           for (const child of structures) {
328:             if (
329:               (child.name === childName || child.name.includes(childName)) &&
330:               child.startLine > struct.startLine &&
331:               child.endLine <= struct.endLine
332:             ) {
333:               matchedRanges.push([child.startLine, child.endLine + 1]);
334:             }
335:           }
336:         }
337:         continue;
338:       }
339:       
340:       if (matches) {
341:         matchedRanges.push([struct.startLine, struct.endLine + 1]);
342:       }
343:     }
344:   }
345:   
346:   if (matchedRanges.length === 0) {
347:     // Pattern bulunamadı, grep ile ara
348:     const grepMatches: number[] = [];
349:     for (const pattern of patterns) {
350:       const searchTerm = pattern.includes(" ") ? pattern.split(" ")[1] : pattern;
351:       for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
352:         if (lines[i].includes(searchTerm)) {
353:           grepMatches.push(i);
354:         }
355:       }
356:     }
357:     
358:     if (grepMatches.length > 0) {
359:       // Her eşleşme etrafında context göster
360:       for (const lineNum of grepMatches) {
361:         matchedRanges.push([Math.max(0, lineNum - 2), Math.min(lines.length, lineNum + 3)]);
362:       }
363:     }
364:   }
365:   
366:   if (matchedRanges.length === 0) {
367:     return `Pattern bulunamadı: ${patterns.join(", ")}`;
368:   }
369:   
370:   return expandLineRanges(filePath, matchedRanges);
371: }

377: /**
378:  * Klasör yapısını recursive olarak oku
379:  */
380: export async function readFolderStructure(
381:   folderPath: string,
382:   maxDepth: number = 3,
383:   currentDepth: number = 0
384: ): Promise<FolderEntry[]> {
385:   if (currentDepth >= maxDepth) {
386:     return [];
387:   }
388:   
389:   try {
390:     const entries = await readdir(folderPath, { withFileTypes: true });
391:     const result: FolderEntry[] = [];
392:     
393:     // Önce dizinler, sonra dosyalar (sıralı)
394:     const sorted = entries.sort((a, b) => {
395:       if (a.isDirectory() && !b.isDirectory()) return -1;
396:       if (!a.isDirectory() && b.isDirectory()) return 1;
397:       return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
398:     });
399:     
400:     for (const entry of sorted) {
401:       // Ignore dirs
402:       if (entry.isDirectory() && IGNORE_DIRS.has(entry.name)) {
403:         continue;
404:       }
405:       
406:       const fullPath = join(folderPath, entry.name);
407:       
408:       if (entry.isDirectory()) {
409:         const children = await readFolderStructure(fullPath, maxDepth, currentDepth + 1);
410:         result.push({
411:           name: entry.name,
412:           type: "directory",
413:           path: fullPath,
414:           children,
415:         });
416:       } else {
417:         const stats = await stat(fullPath);
418:         result.push({
419:           name: entry.name,
420:           type: "file",
421:           path: fullPath,
422:           size: stats.size,
423:         });
424:       }
425:     }
426:     
427:     return result;
428:   } catch (error) {
429:     return [];
430:   }
431: }
432: 
433: /**
434:  * Klasör yapısını string olarak formatla
435:  */
436: export function formatFolderStructure(entries: FolderEntry[], indent: string = ""): string {
437:   const lines: string[] = [];
438:   
439:   for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
440:     const entry = entries[i];
441:     const isLast = i === entries.length - 1;
442:     const prefix = indent + (isLast ? "└── " : "├── ");
443:     const childIndent = indent + (isLast ? "    " : "│   ");
444:     
445:     if (entry.type === "directory") {
446:       lines.push(`${prefix}${entry.name}/`);
447:       if (entry.children && entry.children.length > 0) {
448:         lines.push(formatFolderStructure(entry.children, childIndent));
449:       }
450:     } else {
451:       const sizeStr = entry.size ? ` (${formatSize(entry.size)})` : "";
452:       lines.push(`${prefix}${entry.name}${sizeStr}`);
453:     }
454:   }
455:   
456:   return lines.join("\n");
457: }
458: 
459: function formatSize(bytes: number): string {
460:   if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes}B`;
461:   if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB`;
462:   return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)}MB`;
463: }

465: // ============================================
466: // Grep / Search
467: // ============================================
468: 
469: /**
470:  * Dosya içeriğinde pattern ara
471:  */
472: export async function grepFile(
473:   filePath: string,
474:   pattern: RegExp,
475:   maxMatches: number = 100
476: ): Promise<GrepMatch[]> {
477:   try {
478:     const ext = extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
479:     if (BINARY_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) {
480:       return [];
481:     }
482:     
483:     const content = await readFile(filePath, "utf-8");
484:     const lines = content.split("\n");
485:     const matches: GrepMatch[] = [];
486:     
487:     for (let i = 0; i < lines.length && matches.length < maxMatches; i++) {
488:       const line = lines[i];
489:       const match = pattern.exec(line);
490:       if (match) {
491:         matches.push({
492:           file: filePath,
493:           line: i + 1, // 1-indexed for display
494:           content: line.trim(),
495:           matchStart: match.index,
496:           matchEnd: match.index + match[0].length,
497:         });
498:       }
499:     }
500:     
501:     return matches;
502:   } catch {
503:     return [];
504:   }
505: }
506: 
507: /**
508:  * Recursive olarak dosyalarda ara
509:  */
510: export async function grepDirectory(
511:   dirPath: string,
512:   contentPattern: RegExp | null,
513:   pathGlob: string | null,
514:   maxResults: number = 500
515: ): Promise<GrepMatch[]> {
516:   const allMatches: GrepMatch[] = [];
517:   
518:   async function searchDir(currentPath: string): Promise<void> {
519:     if (allMatches.length >= maxResults) return;
520:     
521:     try {
522:       const entries = await readdir(currentPath, { withFileTypes: true });
523:       
524:       for (const entry of entries) {
525:         if (allMatches.length >= maxResults) break;
526:         
527:         const fullPath = join(currentPath, entry.name);
528:         
529:         if (entry.isDirectory()) {
530:           if (!IGNORE_DIRS.has(entry.name)) {
531:             await searchDir(fullPath);
532:           }
533:         } else {
534:           // Path glob check
535:           if (pathGlob && !matchGlob(fullPath, pathGlob)) {
536:             continue;
537:           }
538:           
539:           // Content search
540:           if (contentPattern) {
541:             const matches = await grepFile(fullPath, contentPattern, maxResults - allMatches.length);
542:             allMatches.push(...matches);
543:           } else {
544:             // Sadece path arama
545:             allMatches.push({
546:               file: fullPath,
547:               line: 0,
548:               content: "",
549:               matchStart: 0,
550:               matchEnd: 0,
551:             });
552:           }
553:         }
554:       }
555:     } catch {
556:       // Erişim hatası, devam et
557:     }
558:   }
559:   
560:   await searchDir(dirPath);
561:   return allMatches;
562: }
563: 
564: /**
565:  * Basit glob pattern matching
566:  */
567: export function matchGlob(path: string, pattern: string): boolean {
568:   // Glob pattern matching:
569:   // ** → herhangi bir path (alt dizinler dahil)
570:   // * → tek dizin seviyesinde herhangi bir karakter (/ hariç)
571:   // ? → tek karakter
572:   
573:   // Önce ** için placeholder kullan (tek * ile karışmaması için)
574:   const placeholder = "\x00GLOBSTAR\x00";
575:   let regexPattern = pattern
576:     .replace(/\*\*/g, placeholder)  // ** → placeholder
577:     .replace(/\./g, "\\.")         // . → \.
578:     .replace(/\*/g, "[^/]*")        // * → [^/]* (tek seviye)
579:     .replace(/\?/g, ".")            // ? → .
580:     .replace(new RegExp(placeholder, "g"), ".*");  // placeholder → .* (çok seviye)
581:   
582:   const regex = new RegExp(`^${regexPattern}$`);
583:   return regex.test(path) || regex.test(basename(path));
584: }

590: /**
591:  * Dosyada bul ve değiştir
592:  */
593: export async function findAndReplace(
594:   filePath: string,
595:   find: string,
596:   replace: string
597: ): Promise<{ success: boolean; replacements: number; error?: string }> {
598:   try {
599:     const content = await readFile(filePath, "utf-8");
600:     
601:     // Kaç kez değişiklik yapılacak
602:     const occurrences = content.split(find).length - 1;
603:     
604:     if (occurrences === 0) {
605:       return { success: false, replacements: 0, error: "Pattern bulunamadı" };
606:     }
607:     
608:     const newContent = content.split(find).join(replace);
609:     
610:     // Dosyayı yaz
611:     const { writeFile } = await import("fs/promises");
612:     await writeFile(filePath, newContent, "utf-8");
613:     
614:     return { success: true, replacements: occurrences };
615:   } catch (error) {
616:     return { success: false, replacements: 0, error: (error as Error).message };
617:   }
618: }

 24: /**
 25:  * En son session'ı bul
 26:  */
 27: export async function findLatestSession(logDir: string): Promise<string | null> {
 28:   try {
 29:     if (!existsSync(logDir)) return null;
 30:     
 31:     const entries = await readdir(logDir, { withFileTypes: true });
 32:     const sessions = entries
 33:       .filter(e => e.isDirectory())
 34:       .map(e => e.name)
 35:       .sort()
 36:       .reverse();
 37:     
 38:     return sessions[0] || null;
 39:   } catch {
 40:     return null;

 44: /**
 45:  * Session loglarını oku
 46:  */
 47: export async function readSessionLogs(
 48:   logDir: string, 
 49:   sessionId: string, 
 50:   type: "console" | "error" | "structured" = "console"
 51: ): Promise<string> {
 52:   const sessionDir = join(logDir, sessionId);
 53:   
 54:   if (!existsSync(sessionDir)) {
 55:     return `Session bulunamadı: ${sessionId}`;
 56:   }
 57:   
 58:   try {
 59:     if (type === "error") {
 60:       const errorPath = join(sessionDir, "error.log");
 61:       if (existsSync(errorPath)) {
 62:         return await readFile(errorPath, "utf-8");
 63:       }
 64:       return "Error log dosyası bulunamadı";
 65:     }
 66:     
 67:     if (type === "structured") {
 68:       const structuredPath = join(sessionDir, "structured.jsonl");
 69:       if (existsSync(structuredPath)) {
 70:         return await readFile(structuredPath, "utf-8");
 71:       }
 72:       return "Structured log dosyası bulunamadı";
 73:     }
 74:     
 75:     const files = await readdir(sessionDir);
 76:     const consoleFiles = files
 77:       .filter(f => f.startsWith("console-") && f.endsWith(".log"))
 78:       .sort();
 79:     
 80:     let content = "";
 81:     for (const file of consoleFiles) {
 82:       content += await readFile(join(sessionDir, file), "utf-8");
 83:     }
 84:     
 85:     return content || "Console log dosyası bulunamadı";
 86:   } catch (err) {
 87:     const error = err as Error;
 88:     return `Log okuma hatası: ${error.message}`;
 89:   }
 90: }

 92: /**
 93:  * Logları filtrele
 94:  */
 95: export function filterLogs(content: string, filters: LogFilters = {}): string[] {
 96:   const { source, level, contains, correlationId, tail = 50 } = filters;
 97:   
 98:   let lines = content.split("\n").filter(l => l.trim());
 99:   
100:   if (source) {
101:     const sourcePattern = source.replace(/\*/g, ".*");
102:     const sourceRegex = new RegExp(`\\[${sourcePattern}\\]`, "i");
103:     lines = lines.filter(l => sourceRegex.test(l));
104:   }
105:   
106:   if (level) {
107:     lines = lines.filter(l => l.includes(`[${level}]`));
108:   }
109:   
110:   if (contains) {
111:     const containsLower = contains.toLowerCase();
112:     lines = lines.filter(l => l.toLowerCase().includes(containsLower));
113:   }
114:   
115:   if (correlationId) {
116:     lines = lines.filter(l => l.includes(correlationId));
117:   }
118:   
119:   return lines.slice(-tail);
120: }
121: 
122: /**
123:  * Session meta ve summary bilgilerini oku
124:  */
125: export async function readSessionInfo(logDir: string, sessionId: string): Promise<SessionInfo> {
126:   const sessionDir = join(logDir, sessionId);
127:   const metaPath = join(sessionDir, "meta.json");
128:   const summaryPath = join(sessionDir, "summary.json");
129:   
130:   let meta: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
131:   let summary: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
132:   
133:   try {
134:     if (existsSync(metaPath)) {
135:       meta = JSON.parse(await readFile(metaPath, "utf-8")) as Record<string, unknown>;
136:     }
137:     if (existsSync(summaryPath)) {
138:       summary = JSON.parse(await readFile(summaryPath, "utf-8")) as Record<string, unknown>;
139:     }
140:   } catch {
141:     // Ignore parse errors
142:   }
143:   
144:   return { meta, summary };
145: }

File: mcp-server/utils/progress.ts

  1: /**
  2:  * Progress Indicator Utility
  3:  * 
  4:  * Uzun süren işlemler için progress göstergesi.
  5:  * MCP notification + stderr üzerinden mesaj gönderir.
  6:  */
  7: 
  8: import type { Server } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/index.js";
  9: 
 10: // Global server reference (set from index.ts)
 11: let mcpServer: Server | null = null;
 12: let currentProgressToken: string | number | null = null;
 13: 
 14: /**
 15:  * MCP Server referansını ayarla (index.ts'den çağrılır)
 16:  */
 17: export function setMcpServer(server: Server): void {
 18:   mcpServer = server;
 19: }
 20: 
 21: /**
 22:  * Progress token'ı ayarla (request'ten gelen)
 23:  */
 24: export function setProgressToken(token: string | number | null): void {
 25:   currentProgressToken = token;
 26: }
 27: 
 28: export interface ProgressOptions {
 29:   /** İşlem adı */
 30:   operation: string;
 31:   /** Toplam adım sayısı (biliniyorsa) */
 32:   total?: number;
 33:   /** Heartbeat interval (ms) */
 34:   interval?: number;
 35:   /** Sessiz mod (sadece önemli adımları göster) */
 36:   quiet?: boolean;
 37:   /** Progress token (MCP notification için) */
 38:   progressToken?: string | number;
 39: }
 40: 
 41: export interface ProgressTracker {
 42:   /** Mevcut adımı güncelle */
 43:   update: (current: number, message?: string) => void;
 44:   /** Mesaj göster */
 45:   log: (message: string) => void;
 46:   /** İşlem tamamlandı */
 47:   done: (message?: string) => void;
 48:   /** Hata ile sonlandır */
 49:   fail: (error: string) => void;
 50:   /** Heartbeat'i durdur */
 51:   stop: () => void;
 52: }
 53: 
 54: /**
 55:  * MCP notification gönder (varsa)
 56:  */
 57: async function sendProgressNotification(
 58:   progress: number,
 59:   total: number | undefined,
 60:   message: string
 61: ): Promise<void> {
 62:   const token = currentProgressToken;
 63:   if (!mcpServer || !token) return;
 64:   
 65:   try {
 66:     await mcpServer.notification({
 67:       method: "notifications/progress",
 68:       params: {
 69:         progressToken: token,
 70:         progress,
 71:         total,
 72:         message,
 73:       } as Record<string, unknown>,
 74:     });
 75:   } catch {
 76:     // Notification başarısız olursa sessizce devam et
 77:   }
 78: }
 79: 
 80: /**
 81:  * Progress tracker oluştur
 82:  * 
 83:  * Kullanım:
 84:  * ```ts
 85:  * const progress = createProgress({ operation: "Proje analizi", total: 100 });
 86:  * progress.update(25, "Dosyalar taranıyor...");
 87:  * progress.update(50, "Bağımlılıklar analiz ediliyor...");
 88:  * progress.done("Tamamlandı!");
 89:  * ```
 90:  */
 91: export function createProgress(options: ProgressOptions): ProgressTracker {
 92:   const { operation, total, interval = 2000, quiet = false, progressToken } = options;
 93:   const startTime = Date.now();
 94:   let currentStep = 0;
 95:   let lastMessage = "";
 96:   let heartbeatTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
 97:   let isRunning = true;
 98: 
 99:   // Progress token'ı override et (tool'dan gelebilir)
100:   if (progressToken) {
101:     setProgressToken(progressToken);
102:   }
103: 
104:   // Başlangıç mesajı
105:   if (!quiet) {
106:     console.error(`[PROGRESS] ⏳ ${operation} başladı...`);
107:   }
108:   
109:   // MCP notification gönder
110:   sendProgressNotification(0, total, `${operation} başladı...`);
111: 
112:   // Heartbeat - işlemin devam ettiğini göster
113:   heartbeatTimer = setInterval(() => {
114:     if (!isRunning) return;
115:     
116:     const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000);
117:     const progressStr = total 
118:       ? `${currentStep}/${total} (${Math.round(currentStep / total * 100)}%)`
119:       : `${currentStep} adım`;
120:     
121:     console.error(`[PROGRESS] ⏳ ${operation} devam ediyor... [${elapsed}s] ${progressStr}${lastMessage ? ` - ${lastMessage}` : ""}`);
122:     
123:     // Heartbeat notification
124:     sendProgressNotification(currentStep, total, `${operation} devam ediyor... ${lastMessage || ""}`);
125:   }, interval);
126: 
127:   return {
128:     update(current: number, message?: string) {
129:       currentStep = current;
130:       if (message) {
131:         lastMessage = message;
132:         if (!quiet) {
133:           const progressStr = total 
134:             ? `[${Math.round(current / total * 100)}%]`
135:             : `[${current}]`;
136:           console.error(`[PROGRESS] ${progressStr} ${message}`);
137:         }
138:         // MCP notification
139:         sendProgressNotification(current, total, message);
140:       }
141:     },
142: 
143:     log(message: string) {
144:       console.error(`[PROGRESS] ℹ️ ${message}`);
145:       sendProgressNotification(currentStep, total, message);
146:     },
147: 
148:     done(message?: string) {
149:       isRunning = false;
150:       if (heartbeatTimer) {
151:         clearInterval(heartbeatTimer);
152:         heartbeatTimer = null;
153:       }
154:       
155:       const elapsed = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
156:       const finalMessage = message || "Tamamlandı";
157:       console.error(`[PROGRESS] ✅ ${operation} ${finalMessage} (${elapsed}s)`);
158:       
159:       // Final notification (total'a ulaştı)
160:       sendProgressNotification(total || currentStep, total, `✅ ${operation} ${finalMessage} (${elapsed}s)`);
161:       setProgressToken(null);
162:     },
163: 
164:     fail(error: string) {
165:       isRunning = false;
166:       if (heartbeatTimer) {
167:         clearInterval(heartbeatTimer);
168:         heartbeatTimer = null;
169:       }
170:       
171:       const elapsed = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
172:       console.error(`[PROGRESS] ❌ ${operation} başarısız: ${error} (${elapsed}s)`);
173:       
174:       // Error notification
175:       sendProgressNotification(currentStep, total, `❌ ${operation} başarısız: ${error} (${elapsed}s)`);
176:       setProgressToken(null);
177:     },
178: 
179:     stop() {
180:       isRunning = false;
181:       if (heartbeatTimer) {
182:         clearInterval(heartbeatTimer);
183:         heartbeatTimer = null;
184:       }
185:       setProgressToken(null);
186:     },
187:   };
188: }
189: 
190: /**
191:  * Basit progress spinner (işlem adı ile)
192:  */
193: export function withProgress<T>(
194:   operation: string,
195:   fn: (progress: ProgressTracker) => Promise<T>
196: ): Promise<T> {
197:   const progress = createProgress({ operation });
198:   
199:   return fn(progress)
200:     .then((result) => {
201:       progress.done();
202:       return result;
203:     })
204:     .catch((error) => {
205:       progress.fail(error.message);
206:       throw error;
207:     });
208: }
209: 
210: /**
211:  * Uzun işlem için timeout wrapper
212:  * İşlem belirtilen süreden uzun sürerse progress mesajı gösterir
213:  */
214: export function withTimeout<T>(
215:   operation: string,
216:   fn: () => Promise<T>,
217:   timeoutMs: number = 5000
218: ): Promise<T> {
219:   let progress: ProgressTracker | null = null;
220: 
221:   const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
222:     progress = createProgress({ operation, quiet: true });
223:   }, timeoutMs);
224: 
225:   return fn()
226:     .then((result) => {
227:       clearTimeout(timeoutId);
228:       if (progress) {
229:         progress.done();
230:       }
231:       return result;
232:     })
233:     .catch((error) => {
234:       clearTimeout(timeoutId);
235:       if (progress) {
236:         progress.fail(error.message);
237:       }
238:       throw error;
239:     });
240: }

 98: /**

102: export function parseProviderConfig(projectRoot: string, provider: string): ProviderConfig | null {
103:   const configPath = getConfigPath(projectRoot, provider);
104:   
105:   if (!existsSync(configPath)) {
106:     return null;
107:   }
108:   
109:   try {
110:     const content = readFileSync(configPath, "utf-8");
111:     return extractConfigFromSource(content, provider);

118: /**
119:  * TypeScript source'dan config objesini çıkar
120:  */
121: function extractConfigFromSource(source: string, providerId: string): ProviderConfig {
122:   const config: ProviderConfig = {
123:     id: providerId,
124:     name: providerId.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + providerId.slice(1),
125:     baseUrl: "",
126:     selectors: {},
127:   };
128:   
129:   // baseUrl
130:   const baseUrlMatch = source.match(/baseUrl:\s*["']([^"']+)["']/);
131:   if (baseUrlMatch) config.baseUrl = baseUrlMatch[1];
132:   
133:   // loginUrl
134:   const loginUrlMatch = source.match(/loginUrl:\s*["']([^"']+)["']/);
135:   if (loginUrlMatch) config.loginUrl = loginUrlMatch[1];
136:   
137:   // lastVerified
138:   const lastVerifiedMatch = source.match(/lastVerified:\s*["']([^"']+)["']/);
139:   if (lastVerifiedMatch) config.lastVerified = lastVerifiedMatch[1];
140:   
141:   // inputType
142:   const inputTypeMatch = source.match(/inputType:\s*["']([^"']+)["']/);
143:   if (inputTypeMatch) config.inputType = inputTypeMatch[1];
144:   
145:   // messageIdStrategy
146:   const strategyMatch = source.match(/messageIdStrategy:\s*["']([^"']+)["']/);
147:   if (strategyMatch) config.messageIdStrategy = strategyMatch[1];
148:   
149:   // selectors object
150:   config.selectors = extractSelectorsObject(source, "selectors:");
151:   
152:   // scrapeSelectors object
153:   const scrapeSelectors = extractSelectorsObject(source, "scrapeSelectors:");
154:   if (Object.keys(scrapeSelectors).length > 0) {
155:     config.scrapeSelectors = scrapeSelectors as ScrapeSelectors;
156:   }
157:   
158:   // Array selectors
159:   config.criticalSelectors = extractStringArray(source, "criticalSelectors:");
160:   config.fileInputSelectors = extractStringArray(source, "fileInputSelectors:");
161:   config.uploadTargetSelectors = extractStringArray(source, "uploadTargetSelectors:");
162:   config.scrollerSelectors = extractStringArray(source, "scrollerSelectors:");
163:   config.excludedUrls = extractStringArray(source, "excludedUrls:");
164:   
165:   return config;
166: }
167: 
168: /**
169:  * Nested object içindeki string değerleri çıkar
170:  */
171: function extractSelectorsObject(source: string, objectKey: string): Record<string, string> {
172:   const result: Record<string, string> = {};
173:   
174:   // Object başlangıcını bul
175:   const objectStart = source.indexOf(objectKey);
176:   if (objectStart === -1) return result;
177:   
178:   // İlk { karakterini bul
179:   const braceStart = source.indexOf("{", objectStart);
180:   if (braceStart === -1) return result;
181:   
182:   // Eşleşen } karakterini bul
183:   let braceCount = 1;
184:   let braceEnd = braceStart + 1;
185:   while (braceCount > 0 && braceEnd < source.length) {
186:     if (source[braceEnd] === "{") braceCount++;
187:     if (source[braceEnd] === "}") braceCount--;
188:     braceEnd++;
189:   }
190:   
191:   const objectContent = source.slice(braceStart + 1, braceEnd - 1);
192:   
193:   // Key-value çiftlerini parse et - backtick template literal'ları destekle
194:   // Pattern: key: `value` (içinde " ve ' olabilir)
195:   const backtickPattern = /(\w+):\s*`([^`]*)`/g;
196:   let match;
197:   
198:   while ((match = backtickPattern.exec(objectContent)) !== null) {
199:     const key = match[1];
200:     const value = match[2];
201:     if (value && !value.includes("${")) {
202:       result[key] = value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
203:     }
204:   }
205:   
206:   // Pattern: key: "value" (içinde ' olabilir)
207:   const doubleQuotePattern = /(\w+):\s*"([^"]*)"/g;
208:   while ((match = doubleQuotePattern.exec(objectContent)) !== null) {
209:     const key = match[1];
210:     const value = match[2];
211:     if (value && !result[key]) {
212:       result[key] = value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
213:     }
214:   }
215:   
216:   // Pattern: key: 'value' (içinde " olabilir)
217:   const singleQuotePattern = /(\w+):\s*'([^']*)'/g;
218:   while ((match = singleQuotePattern.exec(objectContent)) !== null) {
219:     const key = match[1];
220:     const value = match[2];
221:     if (value && !result[key]) {
222:       result[key] = value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
223:     }
224:   }
225:   
226:   return result;
227: }
228: 
229: /**
230:  * String array'i çıkar
231:  */
232: function extractStringArray(source: string, arrayKey: string): string[] {
233:   const result: string[] = [];
234:   
235:   const arrayStart = source.indexOf(arrayKey);
236:   if (arrayStart === -1) return result;
237:   
238:   const bracketStart = source.indexOf("[", arrayStart);
239:   if (bracketStart === -1) return result;
240:   
241:   // Eşleşen ] karakterini bul
242:   let bracketCount = 1;
243:   let bracketEnd = bracketStart + 1;
244:   while (bracketCount > 0 && bracketEnd < source.length) {
245:     if (source[bracketEnd] === "[") bracketCount++;
246:     if (source[bracketEnd] === "]") bracketCount--;
247:     bracketEnd++;
248:   }
249:   
250:   const arrayContent = source.slice(bracketStart + 1, bracketEnd - 1);
251:   
252:   // String değerleri çıkar
253:   const stringPattern = /["'`]([^"'`]+)["'`]/g;
254:   let match;
255:   
256:   while ((match = stringPattern.exec(arrayContent)) !== null) {
257:     const value = match[1].replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
258:     if (value && !value.startsWith("//")) {
259:       result.push(value);
260:     }
261:   }
262:   
263:   return result;
264: }
265: 
266: /**
267:  * Config'deki tüm selector'ları düz listeye çevir
268:  */
269: export function flattenSelectors(config: ProviderConfig): FlatSelector[] {
270:   const result: FlatSelector[] = [];
271:   
272:   // selectors object
273:   if (config.selectors) {
274:     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(config.selectors)) {
275:       if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim()) {
276:         result.push({ category: "selectors", key, selector: value });
277:       } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
278:         value.forEach((sel, i) => {
279:           if (typeof sel === "string" && sel.trim()) {
280:             result.push({ category: "selectors", key, selector: sel, isArray: true, arrayIndex: i });
281:           }
282:         });
283:       }
284:     }
285:   }
286:   
287:   // scrapeSelectors object
288:   if (config.scrapeSelectors) {
289:     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(config.scrapeSelectors)) {
290:       if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim()) {
291:         result.push({ category: "scrapeSelectors", key, selector: value });
292:       }
293:     }
294:   }
295:   
296:   // Array selector'lar
297:   const arrayCategories = [
298:     "criticalSelectors",
299:     "fileInputSelectors", 
300:     "uploadTargetSelectors",
301:     "scrollerSelectors",
302:   ] as const;
303:   
304:   for (const category of arrayCategories) {
305:     const arr = config[category];
306:     if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
307:       arr.forEach((selector, index) => {
308:         if (typeof selector === "string" && selector.trim()) {
309:           result.push({ 
310:             category, 
311:             key: `[${index}]`, 
312:             selector,
313:             isArray: true,
314:             arrayIndex: index,
315:           });
316:         }
317:       });
318:     }
319:   }
320:   
321:   return result;
322: }
323: 
324: /**
325:  * Selector'ı kategoriye göre grupla
326:  */
327: export function groupSelectorsByCategory(selectors: FlatSelector[]): Record<string, FlatSelector[]> {
328:   const grouped: Record<string, FlatSelector[]> = {};
329:   
330:   for (const sel of selectors) {
331:     if (!grouped[sel.category]) {
332:       grouped[sel.category] = [];
333:     }
334:     grouped[sel.category].push(sel);
335:   }
336:   
337:   return grouped;
338: }

  1: /**

  5:  * - Dosyalar .rovodev/trash/ altına taşınır

 14: // Constants

 33: export interface Operation {

 36:   timestamp: string;

 38:     path: string;

 49: // ============================================

 53: /**
 54:  * Çöp kutusu dizinini hazırla
 55:  */
 56: export function ensureTrashDir(projectRoot: string): string {
 57:   const trashPath = join(projectRoot, TRASH_DIR);
 58:   if (!existsSync(trashPath)) {
 59:     mkdirSync(trashPath, { recursive: true });
 60:   }
 61:   return trashPath;
 62: }
 63: 
 64: /**
 65:  * Dosyayı çöp kutusuna taşı
 66:  */
 67: export function moveToTrash(projectRoot: string, filePath: string): TrashItem | null {
 68:   if (!existsSync(filePath)) {
 69:     return null;
 70:   }
 71: 
 72:   const trashDir = ensureTrashDir(projectRoot);
 73:   const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
 74:   const relativePath = relative(projectRoot, filePath).replace(/[/]/g, "__");
 75:   const trashName = `${timestamp}__${relativePath}`;
 76:   const trashPath = join(trashDir, trashName);
 77: 
 78:   const stats = statSync(filePath);
 79:   const isDirectory = stats.isDirectory();
 80: 
 81:   // Taşı
 82:   renameSync(filePath, trashPath);
 83: 
 84:   const item: TrashItem = {
 85:     originalPath: filePath,
 86:     trashPath,
 87:     deletedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
 88:     size: isDirectory ? 0 : stats.size,
 89:     isDirectory,
 90:   };
 91: 
 92:   // Operation log'a kaydet
 93:   logOperation(projectRoot, {
 94:     id: generateId(),
 95:     type: "delete",
 96:     timestamp: item.deletedAt,
 97:     files: [{ path: filePath, backupPath: trashPath }],
 98:     canUndo: true,
 99:   });
100: 
101:   return item;
102: }
103: 
104: /**
105:  * Çöp kutusundaki dosyaları listele
106:  */
107: export function listTrash(projectRoot: string): TrashItem[] {
108:   const trashDir = join(projectRoot, TRASH_DIR);
109:   if (!existsSync(trashDir)) {
110:     return [];
111:   }
112: 
113:   const items: TrashItem[] = [];
114:   const files = readdirSync(trashDir);
115: 
116:   for (const file of files) {
117:     const trashPath = join(trashDir, file);
118:     const stats = statSync(trashPath);
119:     
120:     // Parse filename: timestamp__original__path
121:     const parts = file.split("__");
122:     const timestamp = parts[0].replace(/-/g, ":").replace(/T/g, " ").slice(0, 19);
123:     const originalRelative = parts.slice(1).join("/");
124:     const originalPath = join(projectRoot, originalRelative);
125: 
126:     items.push({
127:       originalPath,
128:       trashPath,
129:       deletedAt: timestamp,
130:       size: stats.isDirectory() ? 0 : stats.size,
131:       isDirectory: stats.isDirectory(),
132:     });
133:   }
134: 
135:   return items.sort((a, b) => b.deletedAt.localeCompare(a.deletedAt));
136: }
137: 
138: /**
139:  * Çöp kutusundan geri yükle
140:  */
141: export function restoreFromTrash(projectRoot: string, trashPath: string): { success: boolean; restoredTo?: string; error?: string } {
142:   if (!existsSync(trashPath)) {
143:     return { success: false, error: "Dosya çöp kutusunda bulunamadı" };
144:   }
145: 
146:   const fileName = basename(trashPath);
147:   
148:   // Parse original path from filename
149:   const parts = fileName.split("__");
150:   const originalRelative = parts.slice(1).join("/");
151:   const originalPath = join(projectRoot, originalRelative);
152: 
153:   // Hedef dizini oluştur
154:   const targetDir = dirname(originalPath);
155:   if (!existsSync(targetDir)) {
156:     mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive: true });
157:   }
158: 
159:   // Hedefte dosya varsa yeniden adlandır
160:   let finalPath = originalPath;
161:   if (existsSync(originalPath)) {
162:     const ext = originalPath.includes(".") ? "." + originalPath.split(".").pop() : "";
163:     const base = originalPath.replace(ext, "");
164:     finalPath = `${base}_restored_${Date.now()}${ext}`;
165:   }
166: 
167:   renameSync(trashPath, finalPath);
168: 
169:   return { success: true, restoredTo: finalPath };
170: }
171: 
172: /**
173:  * Çöp kutusunu boşalt
174:  */
175: export function emptyTrash(projectRoot: string, olderThanDays?: number): { deleted: number; freedBytes: number } {
176:   const trashDir = join(projectRoot, TRASH_DIR);
177:   if (!existsSync(trashDir)) {
178:     return { deleted: 0, freedBytes: 0 };
179:   }
180: 
181:   const files = readdirSync(trashDir);
182:   let deleted = 0;
183:   let freedBytes = 0;
184:   const cutoff = olderThanDays ? Date.now() - (olderThanDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) : 0;
185: 
186:   for (const file of files) {
187:     const trashPath = join(trashDir, file);
188:     const stats = statSync(trashPath);
189: 
190:     // Yaş kontrolü
191:     if (olderThanDays && stats.mtimeMs > cutoff) {
192:       continue;
193:     }
194: 
195:     freedBytes += stats.isDirectory() ? 0 : stats.size;
196:     rmSync(trashPath, { recursive: true, force: true });
197:     deleted++;
198:   }
199: 
200:   return { deleted, freedBytes };
201: }
