207: /**
208:  * Dosyanın yedeğini al
209:  */
210: export function createBackup(projectRoot: string, filePath: string, suffix?: string): { success: boolean; backupPath?: string; error?: string } {
211:   if (!existsSync(filePath)) {
212:     return { success: false, error: "Dosya bulunamadı" };
213:   }
214: 
215:   const timestamp = suffix || new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-").slice(0, 19);
216:   const ext = filePath.includes(".") ? "." + filePath.split(".").pop() : "";
217:   const base = filePath.replace(ext, "");
218:   const backupPath = `${base}.${timestamp}.bak${ext}`;
219: 
220:   copyFileSync(filePath, backupPath);
221: 
222:   // Operation log'a kaydet
223:   logOperation(projectRoot, {
224:     id: generateId(),
225:     type: "backup",
226:     timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
227:     files: [{ path: filePath, backupPath }],
228:     canUndo: true,
229:   });
230: 
231:   return { success: true, backupPath };
232: }
233: 
234: // ============================================
235: // Operation Log (Undo desteği)
236: // ============================================
237: 
238: function generateId(): string {
239:   return Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
240: }
241: 
242: function getOperationLog(projectRoot: string): OperationLog {
243:   const logPath = join(projectRoot, OPERATION_LOG);
244:   if (!existsSync(logPath)) {
245:     return { operations: [] };
246:   }
247:   try {
248:     return JSON.parse(readFileSync(logPath, "utf-8"));
249:   } catch {
250:     return { operations: [] };
251:   }
252: }
253: 
254: function saveOperationLog(projectRoot: string, log: OperationLog): void {
255:   const logPath = join(projectRoot, OPERATION_LOG);
256:   const dir = dirname(logPath);
257:   if (!existsSync(dir)) {
258:     mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
259:   }
260:   writeFileSync(logPath, JSON.stringify(log, null, 2), "utf-8");
261: }
262: 
263: export function logOperation(projectRoot: string, operation: Operation): void {
264:   const log = getOperationLog(projectRoot);
265:   log.operations.unshift(operation);
266:   
267:   // Max limit
268:   if (log.operations.length > MAX_OPERATIONS) {
269:     log.operations = log.operations.slice(0, MAX_OPERATIONS);
270:   }
271:   
272:   saveOperationLog(projectRoot, log);
273: }
274: 
275: export function getLastOperation(projectRoot: string): Operation | null {
276:   const log = getOperationLog(projectRoot);
277:   return log.operations.find(op => op.canUndo) || null;
278: }
279: 
280: export function getOperationHistory(projectRoot: string, limit: number = 20): Operation[] {
281:   const log = getOperationLog(projectRoot);
282:   return log.operations.slice(0, limit);
283: }
284: 
285: /**
286:  * Son işlemi geri al
287:  */
288: export function undoLastOperation(projectRoot: string): { success: boolean; message: string; operation?: Operation } {
289:   const log = getOperationLog(projectRoot);
290:   const opIndex = log.operations.findIndex(op => op.canUndo);
291:   
292:   if (opIndex === -1) {
293:     return { success: false, message: "Geri alınacak işlem yok" };
294:   }
295: 
296:   const operation = log.operations[opIndex];
297: 
298:   try {
299:     switch (operation.type) {
300:       case "delete": {
301:         // Çöp kutusundan geri yükle
302:         for (const file of operation.files) {
303:           if (file.backupPath && existsSync(file.backupPath)) {
304:             const targetDir = dirname(file.path);
305:             if (!existsSync(targetDir)) {
306:               mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive: true });
307:             }
308:             renameSync(file.backupPath, file.path);
309:           }
310:         }
311:         break;
312:       }
313:       case "create": {
314:         // Oluşturulan dosyayı sil
315:         for (const file of operation.files) {
316:           if (existsSync(file.path)) {
317:             moveToTrash(projectRoot, file.path);
318:           }
319:         }
320:         break;
321:       }
322:       case "replace": {
323:         // Orijinal içeriği geri yükle
324:         for (const file of operation.files) {
325:           if (file.originalContent !== undefined) {
326:             writeFileSync(file.path, file.originalContent, "utf-8");
327:           } else if (file.backupPath && existsSync(file.backupPath)) {
328:             copyFileSync(file.backupPath, file.path);
329:           }
330:         }
331:         break;
332:       }
333:       case "move": {
334:         // Taşımayı geri al
335:         for (const file of operation.files) {
336:           if (file.backupPath && existsSync(file.path)) {
337:             renameSync(file.path, file.backupPath);
338:           }
339:         }
340:         break;
341:       }
342:       case "backup": {
343:         // Backup dosyasını sil
344:         for (const file of operation.files) {
345:           if (file.backupPath && existsSync(file.backupPath)) {
346:             unlinkSync(file.backupPath);
347:           }
348:         }
349:         break;
350:       }
351:     }
352: 
353:     // İşlemi undo edildi olarak işaretle
354:     log.operations[opIndex].canUndo = false;
355:     saveOperationLog(projectRoot, log);
356: 
357:     return { success: true, message: `İşlem geri alındı: ${operation.type}`, operation };
358:   } catch (error) {
359:     return { success: false, message: `Geri alma hatası: ${(error as Error).message}` };
360:   }
361: }

 77: /**
 78:  * Tüm webview target'larını bul ve provider'a göre etiketle
 79:  */
 80: export async function discoverWebviews(providerConfigs: ProviderConfig[]): Promise<WebviewTarget[]> {
 81:   const targets = await discoverTargets();
 82:   
 83:   return targets
 84:     .filter(t => t.type === "page" || t.type === "webview")
 85:     .map(t => {
 86:       // URL'e göre provider belirle
 87:       let provider: string | undefined;
 88:       for (const config of providerConfigs) {
 89:         if (t.url.includes(config.baseUrl.replace("https://", "").replace("http://", ""))) {
 90:           provider = config.id;
 91:           break;
 92:         }
 93:       }
 94:       
 95:       return {
 96:         id: t.id,
 97:         type: t.type,
 98:         title: t.title,
 99:         url: t.url,
100:         webSocketDebuggerUrl: t.webSocketDebuggerUrl,
101:         provider,
102:       };
103:     });
104: }

111:   providerConfigs: ProviderConfig[]

121: /**
122:  * Webview'a bağlan
123:  */
124: async function connectToWebview(wsUrl: string, timeout = 10000): Promise<WebSocket> {
125:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
126:     const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
127:     
128:     const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
129:       ws.close();
130:       reject(new Error("WebSocket bağlantı zaman aşımı"));
131:     }, timeout);
132:     
133:     ws.on("open", () => {
134:       clearTimeout(timeoutId);
135:       resolve(ws);
136:     });
137:     
138:     ws.on("error", (err) => {
139:       clearTimeout(timeoutId);
140:       reject(new Error(`WebSocket hatası: ${err.message}`));
141:     });
142:   });
143: }

149: /**
150:  * Webview'da tek bir selector'ı test et
151:  */
152: export async function testSelector(
153:   ws: WebSocket,
154:   selector: string
155: ): Promise<SelectorTestResult> {
156:   try {
157:     // JavaScript'te selector'ı test et
158:     const jsCode = `
159:       (() => {
160:         try {
161:           const elements = document.querySelectorAll(${JSON.stringify(selector)});
162:           
163:           if (elements.length === 0) {
164:             return { found: false, count: 0 };
165:           }
166:           
167:           const el = elements[0];
168:           const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
169:           const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
170:           
171:           return {
172:             found: true,
173:             count: elements.length,
174:             sample: {
175:               tagName: el.tagName,
176:               id: el.id || undefined,
177:               className: el.className?.toString()?.slice(0, 150) || undefined,
178:               textContent: el.textContent?.slice(0, 100)?.trim() || undefined,
179:               attributes: Object.fromEntries(
180:                 Array.from(el.attributes || [])
181:                   .slice(0, 10)
182:                   .map(a => [a.name, a.value?.slice(0, 50)])
183:               ),
184:               boundingRect: {
185:                 x: Math.round(rect.x),
186:                 y: Math.round(rect.y),
187:                 width: Math.round(rect.width),
188:                 height: Math.round(rect.height)
189:               },
190:               isVisible: rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden',
191:               isEnabled: !el.disabled
192:             }
193:           };
194:         } catch (e) {
195:           return { found: false, count: 0, error: e.message };
196:         }
197:       })()
198:     `;
199:     
200:     const result = await sendCDPCommand(ws, "Runtime.evaluate", {
201:       expression: jsCode,
202:       returnByValue: true,
203:       awaitPromise: false,
204:     });
205:     
206:     const value = (result as { result?: { value?: SelectorTestResult } }).result?.value;
207:     
208:     if (!value) {
209:       return { selector, found: false, count: 0, error: "Sonuç alınamadı" };
210:     }
211:     
212:     return { selector, found: value.found, count: value.count, error: value.error, sample: value.sample };
213:   } catch (error) {
214:     return { 
215:       selector, 
216:       found: false, 
217:       count: 0, 
218:       error: (error as Error).message 
219:     };
220:   }
221: }

223: /**
224:  * Webview'da element inspect et (detaylı)
225:  */
226: export async function inspectElement(
227:   ws: WebSocket,
228:   selector: string,
229:   options: {
230:     includeStyles?: boolean;
231:     includeParent?: boolean;
232:     includeChildren?: boolean;
233:     maxElements?: number;
234:   } = {}
235: ): Promise<{
236:   found: boolean;
237:   count: number;
238:   elements: ElementInfo[];
239:   error?: string;
240: }> {
241:   const { includeStyles = false, includeParent = false, includeChildren = false, maxElements = 5 } = options;
242:   
243:   try {
244:     const jsCode = `
245:       (() => {
246:         try {
247:           const elements = document.querySelectorAll(${JSON.stringify(selector)});
248:           
249:           if (elements.length === 0) {
250:             return { found: false, count: 0, elements: [] };
251:           }
252:           
253:           const results = [];
254:           const limit = Math.min(elements.length, ${maxElements});
255:           
256:           for (let i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
257:             const el = elements[i];
258:             const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
259:             const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
260:             
261:             const info = {
262:               tagName: el.tagName,
263:               id: el.id || undefined,
264:               className: el.className?.toString()?.slice(0, 200) || undefined,
265:               textContent: el.textContent?.slice(0, 150)?.trim() || undefined,
266:               attributes: Object.fromEntries(
267:                 Array.from(el.attributes || [])
268:                   .map(a => [a.name, a.value?.slice(0, 100)])
269:               ),
270:               boundingRect: {
271:                 x: Math.round(rect.x),
272:                 y: Math.round(rect.y),
273:                 width: Math.round(rect.width),
274:                 height: Math.round(rect.height)
275:               },
276:               isVisible: rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden',
277:               isEnabled: !el.disabled
278:             };
279:             
280:             ${includeStyles ? `
281:             info.computedStyles = {
282:               display: style.display,
283:               visibility: style.visibility,
284:               opacity: style.opacity,
285:               position: style.position,
286:               zIndex: style.zIndex
287:             };
288:             ` : ""}
289:             
290:             ${includeParent ? `
291:             if (el.parentElement) {
292:               info.parent = {
293:                 tagName: el.parentElement.tagName,
294:                 id: el.parentElement.id || undefined,
295:                 className: el.parentElement.className?.toString()?.slice(0, 100) || undefined
296:               };
297:             }
298:             ` : ""}
299:             
300:             ${includeChildren ? `
301:             info.children = Array.from(el.children).slice(0, 5).map(c => ({
302:               tagName: c.tagName,
303:               className: c.className?.toString()?.slice(0, 50) || undefined
304:             }));
305:             ` : ""}
306:             
307:             results.push(info);
308:           }
309:           
310:           return { found: true, count: elements.length, elements: results };
311:         } catch (e) {
312:           return { found: false, count: 0, elements: [], error: e.message };
313:         }
314:       })()
315:     `;
316:     
317:     const result = await sendCDPCommand(ws, "Runtime.evaluate", {
318:       expression: jsCode,
319:       returnByValue: true,
320:       awaitPromise: false,
321:     });
322:     
323:     const value = (result as { result?: { value?: { found: boolean; count: number; elements: ElementInfo[]; error?: string } } }).result?.value;
324:     
325:     if (!value) {
326:       return { found: false, count: 0, elements: [], error: "Sonuç alınamadı" };
327:     }
328:     
329:     return value;
330:   } catch (error) {
331:     return { 
332:       found: false, 
333:       count: 0, 
334:       elements: [],
335:       error: (error as Error).message 
336:     };
337:   }
338: }

343: 
344: /**
345:  * Provider'ın tüm selector'larını doğrula
346:  */
347: export async function validateProviderSelectors(
348:   webview: WebviewTarget,
349:   selectors: FlatSelector[],
350:   categories?: string[]
351: ): Promise<ProviderValidationResult> {
352:   const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
353:   
354:   // Kategori filtresi
355:   const filteredSelectors = categories 
356:     ? selectors.filter(s => categories.includes(s.category))
357:     : selectors;
358:   
359:   // Sonuç objesi
360:   const result: ProviderValidationResult = {
361:     provider: webview.provider || "unknown",
362:     url: webview.url,
363:     timestamp,
364:     connected: false,
365:     results: [],
366:     summary: {
367:       total: filteredSelectors.length,
368:       valid: 0,
369:       invalid: 0,
370:       successRate: "0%",
371:     },
372:   };
373:   
374:   // Webview'a bağlan
375:   let ws: WebSocket;
376:   try {
377:     ws = await connectToWebview(webview.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
378:     result.connected = true;
379:     
380:     // Runtime'ı etkinleştir
381:     await sendCDPCommand(ws, "Runtime.enable");
382:   } catch (error) {
383:     result.error = (error as Error).message;
384:     return result;
385:   }
386:   
387:   try {
388:     // Her selector'ı test et
389:     for (const sel of filteredSelectors) {
390:       const testResult = await testSelector(ws, sel.selector);
391:       
392:       result.results.push({
393:         category: sel.category,
394:         key: sel.key,
395:         selector: sel.selector,
396:         found: testResult.found,
397:         count: testResult.count,
398:         error: testResult.error,
399:         sample: testResult.sample,
400:       });
401:       
402:       if (testResult.found) {
403:         result.summary.valid++;
404:       } else {
405:         result.summary.invalid++;
406:       }
407:     }
408:     
409:     // Success rate hesapla
410:     const rate = result.summary.total > 0 
411:       ? Math.round((result.summary.valid / result.summary.total) * 100)
412:       : 0;
413:     result.summary.successRate = `${rate}%`;
414:     
415:   } finally {
416:     ws.close();
417:   }
418:   
419:   return result;
420: }

422: /**
423:  * Provider'da tek element inspect et
424:  */
425: export async function inspectProviderElement(
426:   webview: WebviewTarget,
427:   selector: string,
428:   options?: {
429:     includeStyles?: boolean;
430:     includeParent?: boolean;
431:     includeChildren?: boolean;
432:   }
433: ): Promise<{
434:   provider: string;
435:   url: string;
436:   selector: string;
437:   result: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof inspectElement>>;
438: }> {
439:   const ws = await connectToWebview(webview.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
440:   
441:   try {
442:     await sendCDPCommand(ws, "Runtime.enable");
443:     const result = await inspectElement(ws, selector, options);
444:     
445:     return {
446:       provider: webview.provider || "unknown",
447:       url: webview.url,
448:       selector,
449:       result,
450:     };
451:   } finally {
452:     ws.close();
453:   }
454: }

109:  * Timeout değerini insan-okunabilir formata çevir
110:  */
111: export function formatTimeout(ms: number): string {
112:   if (ms >= 60_000) {
113:     const minutes = Math.floor(ms / 60_000);
114:     const seconds = (ms % 60_000) / 1000;
115:     return seconds > 0 ? `${minutes}m ${seconds}s` : `${minutes}m`;
116:   }
117:   return `${ms / 1000}s`;
118: }

================
File: src/js/modules/slot/state-machine.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Slot State Machine - Robust State Management
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu modül SlotController için type-safe ve validasyonlu state machine sağlar.
  5:  * Geçersiz state transition'larını engeller ve debugging için history tutar.
  6:  * 
  7:  * Features:
  8:  * - Type-safe state ve event tanımları
  9:  * - Transition validation (izin verilen geçişler)
 10:  * - State history tracking
 11:  * - Guard conditions (koşullu geçişler)
 12:  * - Side effects (geçiş sonrası aksiyonlar)
 13:  */
 14: 
 15: import { LogManager } from "../log-manager.js";
 16: 
 17: // ============================================================================
 18: // State Definitions
 19: // ============================================================================
 20: 
 21: /**
 22:  * Slot durumları
 23:  */
 24: export const SlotStates = {
 25:   EMPTY: "empty",
 26:   ASSIGNED: "assigned", 
 27:   CONNECTING: "connecting",
 28:   CONNECTED: "connected",
 29:   DISCONNECTING: "disconnecting",
 30:   ERROR: "error",
 31: } as const;
 32: 
 33: export type SlotStateType = typeof SlotStates[keyof typeof SlotStates];
 34: 
 35: // ============================================================================
 36: // Transition Definitions
 37: // ============================================================================
 38: 
 39: /**
 40:  * İzin verilen state transition'ları
 41:  * Format: [fromState]: [toState1, toState2, ...]
 42:  */
 43: const ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Record<SlotStateType, SlotStateType[]> = {
 44:   [SlotStates.EMPTY]: [
 45:     SlotStates.ASSIGNED,  // Account atandığında
 46:   ],
 47:   [SlotStates.ASSIGNED]: [
 48:     SlotStates.EMPTY,       // Account kaldırıldığında
 49:     SlotStates.CONNECTING,  // Bağlantı başlatıldığında
 50:     SlotStates.ERROR,       // Hata durumunda
 51:   ],
 52:   [SlotStates.CONNECTING]: [
 53:     SlotStates.CONNECTED,     // Bağlantı başarılı
 54:     SlotStates.ASSIGNED,      // Bağlantı iptal edildi
 55:     SlotStates.ERROR,         // Bağlantı hatası
 56:     SlotStates.DISCONNECTING, // Force disconnect during connect
 57:   ],
 58:   [SlotStates.CONNECTED]: [
 59:     SlotStates.DISCONNECTING, // Normal disconnect
 60:     SlotStates.ERROR,         // Bağlantı koptu
 61:     SlotStates.CONNECTING,    // Force reconnect
 62:   ],
 63:   [SlotStates.DISCONNECTING]: [
 64:     SlotStates.ASSIGNED,  // Disconnect tamamlandı
 65:     SlotStates.EMPTY,     // Account da kaldırıldı
 66:     SlotStates.ERROR,     // Disconnect hatası
 67:   ],
 68:   [SlotStates.ERROR]: [
 69:     SlotStates.EMPTY,     // Account kaldırıldı
 70:     SlotStates.ASSIGNED,  // Recovery (manuel veya otomatik)
 71:     SlotStates.CONNECTING, // Retry connection
 72:   ],
 73: };
 74: 
 75: // ============================================================================
 76: // State History
 77: // ============================================================================
 78: 
 79: interface StateHistoryEntry {
 80:   fromState: SlotStateType;
 81:   toState: SlotStateType;
 82:   timestamp: number;
 83:   correlationId?: string;
 84:   reason?: string;
 85: }
 86: 
 87: const MAX_HISTORY_SIZE = 50;
 88: 
 89: // ============================================================================
 90: // State Machine Class
 91: // ============================================================================
 92: 
 93: export class SlotStateMachine {
 94:   private _slotId: string;
 95:   private _currentState: SlotStateType;
 96:   private _history: StateHistoryEntry[];
 97:   private _onTransitionCallbacks: Array<(from: SlotStateType, to: SlotStateType, context?: TransitionContext) => void>;
 98: 
 99:   constructor(slotId: string, initialState: SlotStateType = SlotStates.EMPTY) {
100:     this._slotId = slotId;
101:     this._currentState = initialState;
102:     this._history = [];
103:     this._onTransitionCallbacks = [];
104:   }
105: 
106:   /**
107:    * Mevcut state'i döndür
108:    */
109:   get state(): SlotStateType {
110:     return this._currentState;
111:   }
112: 
113:   /**
114:    * State history'yi döndür
115:    */
116:   get history(): readonly StateHistoryEntry[] {
117:     return this._history;
118:   }
119: 
120:   /**
121:    * Belirli bir state'e geçiş yapılabilir mi kontrol et
122:    */
123:   canTransitionTo(targetState: SlotStateType): boolean {
124:     const allowedTargets = ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[this._currentState];
125:     return allowedTargets?.includes(targetState) ?? false;
126:   }
127: 
128:   /**
129:    * Mevcut state'den geçilebilecek tüm state'leri döndür
130:    */
131:   getAvailableTransitions(): SlotStateType[] {
132:     return ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[this._currentState] ?? [];
133:   }
134: 
135:   /**
136:    * State geçişi yap
137:    * @returns true eğer geçiş başarılı, false eğer geçersiz
138:    */
139:   transition(
140:     targetState: SlotStateType,
141:     context?: TransitionContext
142:   ): TransitionResult {
143:     const fromState = this._currentState;
144: 
145:     // Aynı state'e geçiş - sessizce başarılı say
146:     if (fromState === targetState) {
147:       return {
148:         success: true,
149:         fromState,
150:         toState: targetState,
151:         wasNoOp: true,
152:       };
153:     }
154: 
155:     // Geçerlilik kontrolü
156:     if (!this.canTransitionTo(targetState)) {
157:       const error = `Invalid transition: ${fromState} → ${targetState}. Allowed: [${this.getAvailableTransitions().join(", ")}]`;
158:       
159:       LogManager.addEvent(
160:         `slot-${this._slotId}`,
161:         "error",
162:         `[StateMachine] ${error}`
163:       );
164: 
165:       return {
166:         success: false,
167:         fromState,
168:         toState: targetState,
169:         error,
170:       };
171:     }
172: 
173:     // Guard condition kontrolü (varsa)
174:     if (context?.guard && !context.guard(fromState, targetState)) {
175:       const error = `Transition guard rejected: ${fromState} → ${targetState}`;
176:       
177:       LogManager.addEvent(
178:         `slot-${this._slotId}`,
179:         "warning",
180:         `[StateMachine] ${error}`
181:       );
182: 
183:       return {
184:         success: false,
185:         fromState,
186:         toState: targetState,
187:         error,
188:         guardRejected: true,
189:       };
190:     }
191: 
192:     // State'i güncelle
193:     this._currentState = targetState;
194: 
195:     // History'e ekle
196:     const historyEntry: StateHistoryEntry = {
197:       fromState,
198:       toState: targetState,
199:       timestamp: Date.now(),
200:       correlationId: context?.correlationId,
201:       reason: context?.reason,
202:     };
203:     this._history.unshift(historyEntry);
204:     
205:     // History boyutunu sınırla
206:     if (this._history.length > MAX_HISTORY_SIZE) {
207:       this._history.pop();
208:     }
209: 
210:     // Log
211:     LogManager.addEvent(
212:       `slot-${this._slotId}`,
213:       "debug",
214:       `[StateMachine] ${fromState} → ${targetState}${context?.reason ? ` (${context.reason})` : ""}`
215:     );
216: 
217:     // Callback'leri çağır
218:     for (const callback of this._onTransitionCallbacks) {
219:       try {
220:         callback(fromState, targetState, context);
221:       } catch (err) {
222:         LogManager.addEvent(
223:           `slot-${this._slotId}`,
224:           "error",
225:           `[StateMachine] Transition callback error: ${err}`
226:         );
227:       }
228:     }
229: 
230:     // Side effect (varsa)
231:     if (context?.sideEffect) {
232:       try {
233:         context.sideEffect(fromState, targetState);
234:       } catch (err) {
235:         LogManager.addEvent(
236:           `slot-${this._slotId}`,
237:           "error",
238:           `[StateMachine] Side effect error: ${err}`
239:         );
240:       }
241:     }
242: 
243:     return {
244:       success: true,
245:       fromState,
246:       toState: targetState,
247:     };
248:   }
249: 
250:   /**
251:    * Transition callback ekle
252:    * @returns Unsubscribe fonksiyonu
253:    */
254:   onTransition(
255:     callback: (from: SlotStateType, to: SlotStateType, context?: TransitionContext) => void
256:   ): () => void {
257:     this._onTransitionCallbacks.push(callback);
258:     return () => {
259:       this._onTransitionCallbacks = this._onTransitionCallbacks.filter(
260:         (cb) => cb !== callback
261:       );
262:     };
263:   }
264: 
265:   /**
266:    * State machine'i resetle
267:    */
268:   reset(initialState: SlotStateType = SlotStates.EMPTY): void {
269:     this._currentState = initialState;
270:     this._history = [];
271:     LogManager.addEvent(
272:       `slot-${this._slotId}`,
273:       "info",
274:       `[StateMachine] Reset to ${initialState}`
275:     );
276:   }
277: 
278:   /**
279:    * State belirli bir değer mi kontrol et
280:    */
281:   is(state: SlotStateType): boolean {
282:     return this._currentState === state;
283:   }
284: 
285:   /**
286:    * State verilen değerlerden biri mi kontrol et
287:    */
288:   isOneOf(...states: SlotStateType[]): boolean {
289:     return states.includes(this._currentState);
290:   }
291: 
292:   /**
293:    * Debugging için state machine durumunu döndür
294:    */
295:   getDebugInfo(): SlotStateMachineDebugInfo {
296:     return {
297:       slotId: this._slotId,
298:       currentState: this._currentState,
299:       availableTransitions: this.getAvailableTransitions(),
300:       historyLength: this._history.length,
301:       lastTransition: this._history[0] ?? null,
302:     };
303:   }
304: }
305: 
306: // ============================================================================
307: // Types
308: // ============================================================================
309: 
310: export interface TransitionContext {
311:   correlationId?: string;
312:   reason?: string;
313:   guard?: (from: SlotStateType, to: SlotStateType) => boolean;
314:   sideEffect?: (from: SlotStateType, to: SlotStateType) => void;
315: }
316: 
317: export interface TransitionResult {
318:   success: boolean;
319:   fromState: SlotStateType;
320:   toState: SlotStateType;
321:   error?: string;
322:   wasNoOp?: boolean;
323:   guardRejected?: boolean;
324: }
325: 
326: export interface SlotStateMachineDebugInfo {
327:   slotId: string;
328:   currentState: SlotStateType;
329:   availableTransitions: SlotStateType[];
330:   historyLength: number;
331:   lastTransition: StateHistoryEntry | null;
332: }
333: 
334: // ============================================================================
335: // Factory
336: // ============================================================================
337: 
338: /**
339:  * Yeni slot state machine oluştur
340:  */
341: export function createSlotStateMachine(
342:   slotId: string,
343:   initialState?: SlotStateType
344: ): SlotStateMachine {
345:   return new SlotStateMachine(slotId, initialState);
346: }
347: 
348: // ============================================================================
349: // Utility Functions
350: // ============================================================================
351: 
352: /**
353:  * State transition geçerli mi kontrol et (static)
354:  */
355: export function isValidTransition(
356:   fromState: SlotStateType,
357:   toState: SlotStateType
358: ): boolean {
359:   const allowedTargets = ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[fromState];
360:   return allowedTargets?.includes(toState) ?? false;
361: }
362: 
363: /**
364:  * State'in "terminal" olup olmadığını kontrol et
365:  * Terminal state'ler: kullanıcı müdahalesi gerektiren durumlar
366:  */
367: export function isTerminalState(state: SlotStateType): boolean {
368:   return state === SlotStates.ERROR;
369: }
370: 
371: /**
372:  * State'in "transitioning" olup olmadığını kontrol et
373:  */
374: export function isTransitioningState(state: SlotStateType): boolean {
375:   return state === SlotStates.CONNECTING || state === SlotStates.DISCONNECTING;
376: }
377: 
378: /**
379:  * State'in "active" olup olmadığını kontrol et (connection var)
380:  */
381: export function isActiveState(state: SlotStateType): boolean {
382:   return state === SlotStates.CONNECTED || state === SlotStates.CONNECTING;
383: }

File: src/js/modules/webview/providers/shared/scraper-helpers.ts
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Scraper Helper Functions
 3:  * 
 4:  * Bu modül scraper'lar için ortak yardımcı fonksiyonları içerir.
 5:  * Scraper'lar webview'a toString() ile inject edildiği için,
 6:  * bu fonksiyonlar her scraper içinde inline olarak tanımlanmalıdır.
 7:  * 
 8:  * Bu dosya "tek kaynak" (single source of truth) olarak kullanılır:
 9:  * - Scraper'lar bu fonksiyonları kopyalayıp kendi içlerinde tanımlar
10:  * - Değişiklik gerektiğinde sadece bu dosya güncellenir ve scraper'lara kopyalanır
11:  * 
12:  * NOT: Bu fonksiyonlar doğrudan import edilmez, referans olarak kullanılır.
13:  * Webview injection sınırlaması nedeniyle her scraper kendi kopyasını içermelidir.
14:  */
15: 
16: // ============================================================================
17: // Text Normalization
18: // ============================================================================
19: 
20: /**
21:  * Metin normalizasyonu - hash tutarlılığı için
22:  * 
23:  * @param str - Normalize edilecek metin
24:  * @returns Normalize edilmiş metin
25:  * 
26:  * İşlemler:
27:  * - Windows line endings (\r\n) → Unix (\n)
28:  * - Old Mac line endings (\r) → Unix (\n)
29:  * - Multiple spaces/tabs → single space
30:  * - Spaces around newlines → just newline
31:  * - 3+ newlines → 2 newlines
32:  * - Leading/trailing whitespace trim
33:  */
34: export function normalizeText(str: string): string {
35:   if (!str) return "";
36:   return str
37:     .replace(/\r\n/g, "\n")           // Windows line endings → Unix
38:     .replace(/\r/g, "\n")             // Old Mac line endings → Unix
39:     .replace(/[\t ]+/g, " ")          // Multiple spaces/tabs → single space
40:     .replace(/ *\n */g, "\n")         // Spaces around newlines → just newline
41:     .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")       // 3+ newlines → 2 newlines
42:     .trim();                          // Leading/trailing whitespace
43: }
44: 
45: // ============================================================================
46: // Hash Function (djb2 algorithm)
47: // ============================================================================
48: 
49: /**
50:  * Hash fonksiyonu (djb2 algoritması)
51:  * 
52:  * @param str - Hash'lenecek metin
53:  * @returns Hexadecimal hash string
54:  * 
55:  * NOT: Fonksiyon içinde normalizeText çağrılır.
56:  * Bu, hash tutarlılığı için gereklidir - aynı içerik
57:  * farklı whitespace ile geldiğinde aynı hash'i üretir.
58:  */
59: export function hashString(str: string): string {
60:   if (!str) return "0";
61:   // Normalize before hashing for consistency
62:   const normalized = normalizeText(str);
63:   if (!normalized) return "0";
64:   let hash = 5381;
65:   for (let i = 0; i < normalized.length; i++) {
66:     hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) + normalized.charCodeAt(i);
67:     hash = hash >>> 0; // Convert to unsigned 32-bit integer
68:   }
69:   return hash.toString(16);
70: }

File: src/js/modules/error-boundary.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * ErrorBoundary - Global hata yakalama ve yönetimi
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu modül renderer process'te oluşan hataları yakalar ve güvenli bir şekilde
  5:  * işler. Kritik hataların tüm uygulamayı etkilemesini önler.
  6:  * 
  7:  * Kullanım:
  8:  * - Async fonksiyonları wrap etmek için: ErrorBoundary.wrap()
  9:  * - Global hata yakalama için: ErrorBoundary.init()
 10:  */
 11: 
 12: import { LogManager } from "./log-manager.js";
 13: import { getErrorMessage } from "../types/index.js";
 14: 
 15: // ============================================================================
 16: // Types
 17: // ============================================================================
 18: 
 19: interface ErrorContext {
 20:   source: string;
 21:   operation?: string;
 22:   metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
 23: }
 24: 
 25: interface ErrorReport {
 26:   message: string;
 27:   stack?: string;
 28:   source: string;
 29:   operation?: string;
 30:   timestamp: number;
 31:   metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
 32: }
 33: 
 34: type ErrorCallback = (report: ErrorReport) => void;
 35: 
 36: // ============================================================================
 37: // ErrorBoundary Class
 38: // ============================================================================
 39: 
 40: class ErrorBoundaryClass {
 41:   private _initialized = false;
 42:   private _errorCallbacks: ErrorCallback[] = [];
 43:   private _recentErrors: ErrorReport[] = [];
 44:   private _maxRecentErrors = 50;
 45: 
 46:   /**
 47:    * Global error handler'ları kur
 48:    */
 49:   init(): void {
 50:     if (this._initialized) return;
 51: 
 52:     // Unhandled promise rejections
 53:     window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (event) => {
 54:       const error = event.reason;
 55:       this._handleError(error, { source: "unhandled-rejection" });
 56:       // Varsayılan davranışı engelleme - sadece logla
 57:       event.preventDefault();
 58:     });
 59: 
 60:     // Global errors
 61:     window.addEventListener("error", (event) => {
 62:       this._handleError(event.error || event.message, {
 63:         source: "global-error",
 64:         metadata: {
 65:           filename: event.filename,
 66:           lineno: event.lineno,
 67:           colno: event.colno,
 68:         },
 69:       });
 70:       // Varsayılan davranışı engelleme
 71:       event.preventDefault();
 72:     });
 73: 
 74:     this._initialized = true;
 75:     LogManager.addEvent("error-boundary", "info", "ErrorBoundary initialized", { visibility: 2 });
 76:   }
 77: 
 78:   /**
 79:    * Async fonksiyonu güvenli bir şekilde çalıştır
 80:    * Hata oluşursa loglar ve null döner
 81:    * 
 82:    * @example
 83:    * const result = await ErrorBoundary.wrap(
 84:    *   () => riskyAsyncOperation(),
 85:    *   "module-name",
 86:    *   "operation-description"
 87:    * );
 88:    */
 89:   async wrap<T>(
 90:     fn: () => Promise<T>,
 91:     source: string,
 92:     operation?: string
 93:   ): Promise<T | null> {
 94:     try {
 95:       return await fn();
 96:     } catch (error) {
 97:       this._handleError(error, { source, operation });
 98:       return null;
 99:     }
100:   }
101: 
102:   /**
103:    * Sync fonksiyonu güvenli bir şekilde çalıştır
104:    */
105:   wrapSync<T>(
106:     fn: () => T,
107:     source: string,
108:     operation?: string
109:   ): T | null {
110:     try {
111:       return fn();
112:     } catch (error) {
113:       this._handleError(error, { source, operation });
114:       return null;
115:     }
116:   }
117: 
118:   /**
119:    * Callback fonksiyonunu güvenli bir şekilde çalıştır
120:    * Event handler'lar için ideal
121:    */
122:   safeCallback<T extends (...args: unknown[]) => unknown>(
123:     fn: T,
124:     source: string
125:   ): T {
126:     return ((...args: unknown[]) => {
127:       try {
128:         const result = fn(...args);
129:         // Promise ise wrap et
130:         if (result instanceof Promise) {
131:           return result.catch((error) => {
132:             this._handleError(error, { source, operation: "callback-async" });
133:             return null;
134:           });
135:         }
136:         return result;
137:       } catch (error) {
138:         this._handleError(error, { source, operation: "callback-sync" });
139:         return null;
140:       }
141:     }) as T;
142:   }
143: 
144:   /**
145:    * Hata callback'i ekle
146:    * UI'da hata göstermek veya telemetry için kullanılabilir
147:    */
148:   onError(callback: ErrorCallback): () => void {
149:     this._errorCallbacks.push(callback);
150:     return () => {
151:       this._errorCallbacks = this._errorCallbacks.filter((cb) => cb !== callback);
152:     };
153:   }
154: 
155:   /**
156:    * Son hataları getir (debugging için)
157:    */
158:   getRecentErrors(): ErrorReport[] {
159:     return [...this._recentErrors];
160:   }
161: 
162:   /**
163:    * Hata geçmişini temizle
164:    */
165:   clearErrors(): void {
166:     this._recentErrors = [];
167:   }
168: 
169:   /**
170:    * Internal: Hata işle
171:    */
172:   private _handleError(error: unknown, context: ErrorContext): void {
173:     const report: ErrorReport = {
174:       message: getErrorMessage(error),
175:       stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined,
176:       source: context.source,
177:       operation: context.operation,
178:       timestamp: Date.now(),
179:       metadata: context.metadata,
180:     };
181: 
182:     // Recent errors listesine ekle
183:     this._recentErrors.unshift(report);
184:     if (this._recentErrors.length > this._maxRecentErrors) {
185:       this._recentErrors.pop();
186:     }
187: 
188:     // Log
189:     const logMessage = context.operation
190:       ? `[${context.source}:${context.operation}] ${report.message}`
191:       : `[${context.source}] ${report.message}`;
192:     
193:     LogManager.addEvent("error-boundary", "error", logMessage, {
194:       stack: report.stack,
195:       ...context.metadata,
196:     });
197: 
198:     // Callback'leri çağır
199:     for (const callback of this._errorCallbacks) {
200:       try {
201:         callback(report);
202:       } catch (_e) {
203:         // Callback hatalarını sessizce geç
204:       }
205:     }
206:   }
207: }
208: 
209: export const ErrorBoundary = new ErrorBoundaryClass();

279: /**

281:  * 
282:  * Her IPC kanalı için params ve result tiplerini tanımlar.
283:  * Bu map, type-safe IPC çağrıları için kullanılır.
284:  */
285: export interface IPCChannelMap {
286:   // Database
287:   "db-init-account": { params: DbInitAccountParams; result: DbInitAccountResult };
288:   "db-get-conversations": { params: DbGetConversationsParams; result: DbGetConversationsResult };
289:   "db-get-messages": { params: DbGetMessagesParams; result: DbGetMessagesResult };
290:   "db-sync-messages": { params: DbSyncMessagesParams; result: DbSyncMessagesResult };
291:   "db-delete-conversation": { params: DbDeleteConversationParams; result: DbDeleteConversationResult };
292:   "db-update-conversation": { params: DbUpdateConversationParams; result: DbUpdateConversationResult };
293:   "db-save-attachment": { params: DbSaveAttachmentParams; result: DbSaveAttachmentResult };
294:   "db-get-attachments": { params: DbGetAttachmentsParams; result: DbGetAttachmentsResult };
295:   "db-search-messages": { params: DbSearchMessagesParams; result: DbSearchMessagesResult };
296:   "db-search-attachments": { params: DbSearchAttachmentsParams; result: DbSearchAttachmentsResult };
297:   "db-search-all-accounts": { params: DbSearchAllAccountsParams; result: DbSearchAllAccountsResult };
298:   
299:   // Settings
300:   "load-settings": { params: void; result: LoadSettingsResult };
301:   "save-settings": { params: SaveSettingsParams; result: SaveSettingsResult };
302:   
303:   // File System
304:   "read-file": { params: ReadFileParams; result: ReadFileResult };
305:   "write-file": { params: WriteFileParams; result: WriteFileResult };
306:   "file-exists": { params: FileExistsParams; result: FileExistsResult };
307:   
308:   // Window
309:   "open-devtools": { params: OpenDevToolsParams | void; result: void };
310:   "set-always-on-top": { params: SetAlwaysOnTopParams; result: void };
311:   "minimize-window": { params: void; result: void };
312:   "maximize-window": { params: void; result: void };
313:   "close-window": { params: void; result: void };
314: }

318:  */

327:  * IPC Channel Result Helper
328:  */

================
File: src/js/ui/animation-controller.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Animation Controller
  3:  *
  4:  * GSAP wrapper for consistent animations throughout the app.
  5:  * Provides simplified API for common animation patterns.
  6:  *
  7:  * @example
  8:  * ```typescript
  9:  * import { Anim } from './ui';
 10:  *
 11:  * // Simple animations
 12:  * Anim.fadeIn(element);
 13:  * Anim.fadeOut(element);
 14:  * Anim.slideIn(element, 'left');
 15:  *
 16:  * // Timeline for complex sequences
 17:  * const tl = Anim.timeline();
 18:  * tl.add(Anim.fadeIn(el1))
 19:  *   .add(Anim.slideIn(el2, 'bottom'), '-=0.2');
 20:  *
 21:  * // Stagger animations
 22:  * Anim.stagger('.card', { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, 0.1);
 23:  *
 24:  * // Draggable (for games)
 25:  * Anim.makeDraggable('.piece', { bounds: '.board' });
 26:  * ```
 27:  */
 28: 
 29: import { gsap } from 'gsap';
 30: import { LogManager } from '../modules/log-manager';
 31: 
 32: // ============================================================================
 33: // Types
 34: // ============================================================================
 35: 
 36: export type AnimationDirection = 'left' | 'right' | 'top' | 'bottom';
 37: 
 38: export interface AnimationOptions {
 39:   duration?: number;
 40:   delay?: number;
 41:   ease?: string;
 42:   onStart?: () => void;
 43:   onComplete?: () => void;
 44: }
 45: 
 46: export interface StaggerOptions extends AnimationOptions {
 47:   stagger?: number | gsap.StaggerVars;
 48: }
 49: 
 50: export interface DraggableOptions {
 51:   bounds?: string | Element;
 52:   onDragStart?: (e: Event) => void;
 53:   onDrag?: (e: Event) => void;
 54:   onDragEnd?: (e: Event) => void;
 55:   snap?: { x?: number | number[]; y?: number | number[] };
 56:   inertia?: boolean;
 57: }
 58: 
 59: // ============================================================================
 60: // Constants
 61: // ============================================================================
 62: 
 63: const DEFAULT_DURATION = 0.3;
 64: const DEFAULT_EASE = 'power2.out';
 65: 
 66: const SLIDE_DISTANCE = 30;
 67: 
 68: // ============================================================================
 69: // GSAP Configuration
 70: // ============================================================================
 71: 
 72: // Set GSAP defaults
 73: gsap.defaults({
 74:   duration: DEFAULT_DURATION,
 75:   ease: DEFAULT_EASE,
 76: });
 77: 
 78: // ============================================================================
 79: // Public API
 80: // ============================================================================
 81: 
 82: export const AnimationController = {
 83:   /**
 84:    * Get raw GSAP instance for advanced usage
 85:    */
 86:   get gsap() {
 87:     return gsap;
 88:   },
 89: 
 90:   // === BASIC ANIMATIONS ===
 91: 
 92:   /**
 93:    * Fade in element
 94:    */
 95:   fadeIn(
 96:     target: gsap.TweenTarget,
 97:     options: AnimationOptions = {}
 98:   ): gsap.core.Tween {
 99:     const { duration = DEFAULT_DURATION, delay = 0, ease = DEFAULT_EASE, onStart, onComplete } = options;
100: 
101:     return gsap.fromTo(
102:       target,
103:       { opacity: 0, visibility: 'visible' },
104:       {
105:         opacity: 1,
106:         duration,
107:         delay,
108:         ease,
109:         onStart,
110:         onComplete,
111:       }
112:     );
113:   },
114: 
115:   /**
116:    * Fade out element
117:    */
118:   fadeOut(
119:     target: gsap.TweenTarget,
120:     options: AnimationOptions = {}
121:   ): gsap.core.Tween {
122:     const { duration = DEFAULT_DURATION, delay = 0, ease = DEFAULT_EASE, onStart, onComplete } = options;
123: 
124:     return gsap.to(target, {
125:       opacity: 0,
126:       duration,
127:       delay,
128:       ease,
129:       onStart,
130:       onComplete,
131:       onCompleteParams: [target],
132:     });
133:   },
134: 
135:   /**
136:    * Slide in from direction
137:    */
138:   slideIn(
139:     target: gsap.TweenTarget,
140:     direction: AnimationDirection = 'bottom',
141:     options: AnimationOptions = {}
142:   ): gsap.core.Tween {
143:     const { duration = DEFAULT_DURATION, delay = 0, ease = 'power2.out', onStart, onComplete } = options;
144: 
145:     const fromVars: gsap.TweenVars = { opacity: 0, visibility: 'visible' };
146: 
147:     switch (direction) {
148:       case 'left':
149:         fromVars.x = -SLIDE_DISTANCE;
150:         break;
151:       case 'right':
152:         fromVars.x = SLIDE_DISTANCE;
153:         break;
154:       case 'top':
155:         fromVars.y = -SLIDE_DISTANCE;
156:         break;
157:       case 'bottom':
158:         fromVars.y = SLIDE_DISTANCE;
159:         break;
160:     }
161: 
162:     return gsap.fromTo(target, fromVars, {
163:       opacity: 1,
164:       x: 0,
165:       y: 0,
166:       duration,
167:       delay,
168:       ease,
169:       onStart,
170:       onComplete,
171:     });
172:   },
173: 
174:   /**
175:    * Slide out to direction
176:    */
177:   slideOut(
178:     target: gsap.TweenTarget,
179:     direction: AnimationDirection = 'bottom',
180:     options: AnimationOptions = {}
181:   ): gsap.core.Tween {
182:     const { duration = DEFAULT_DURATION, delay = 0, ease = 'power2.in', onStart, onComplete } = options;
183: 
184:     const toVars: gsap.TweenVars = {
185:       opacity: 0,
186:       duration,
187:       delay,
188:       ease,
189:       onStart,
190:       onComplete,
191:     };
192: 
193:     switch (direction) {
194:       case 'left':
195:         toVars.x = -SLIDE_DISTANCE;
196:         break;
197:       case 'right':
198:         toVars.x = SLIDE_DISTANCE;
199:         break;
200:       case 'top':
201:         toVars.y = -SLIDE_DISTANCE;
202:         break;
203:       case 'bottom':
204:         toVars.y = SLIDE_DISTANCE;
205:         break;
206:     }
207: 
208:     return gsap.to(target, toVars);
209:   },
210: 
211:   /**
212:    * Scale pop animation (for buttons, notifications)
213:    */
214:   pop(
215:     target: gsap.TweenTarget,
216:     options: AnimationOptions = {}
217:   ): gsap.core.Tween {
218:     const { duration = 0.4, delay = 0, ease = 'elastic.out(1, 0.5)', onComplete } = options;
219: 
220:     return gsap.fromTo(
221:       target,
222:       { scale: 0, opacity: 0 },
223:       {
224:         scale: 1,
225:         opacity: 1,
226:         duration,
227:         delay,
228:         ease,
229:         onComplete,
230:       }
231:     );
232:   },
233: 
234:   /**
235:    * Shake animation (for errors)
236:    */
237:   shake(
238:     target: gsap.TweenTarget,
239:     options: AnimationOptions = {}
240:   ): gsap.core.Tween {
241:     const { duration = 0.4, onComplete } = options;
242: 
243:     return gsap.to(target, {
244:       keyframes: [
245:         { x: -5, duration: duration / 5 },
246:         { x: 5, duration: duration / 5 },
247:         { x: -5, duration: duration / 5 },
248:         { x: 5, duration: duration / 5 },
249:         { x: 0, duration: duration / 5 },
250:       ],
251:       ease: 'power2.inOut',
252:       onComplete,
253:     });
254:   },
255: 
256:   /**
257:    * Pulse animation (for attention)
258:    */
259:   pulse(
260:     target: gsap.TweenTarget,
261:     options: AnimationOptions = {}
262:   ): gsap.core.Tween {
263:     const { duration = 0.6, onComplete } = options;
264: 
265:     return gsap.fromTo(
266:       target,
267:       { scale: 1 },
268:       {
269:         scale: 1.05,
270:         duration: duration / 2,
271:         ease: 'power2.out',
272:         yoyo: true,
273:         repeat: 1,
274:         onComplete,
275:       }
276:     );
277:   },
278: 
279:   // === TIMELINE ===
280: 
281:   /**
282:    * Create a new timeline
283:    */
284:   timeline(config?: gsap.TimelineVars): gsap.core.Timeline {
285:     return gsap.timeline(config);
286:   },
287: 
288:   // === STAGGER ANIMATIONS ===
289: 
290:   /**
291:    * Stagger animation for lists
292:    */
293:   stagger(
294:     targets: gsap.TweenTarget,
295:     fromVars: gsap.TweenVars,
296:     toVars: gsap.TweenVars,
297:     stagger: number | gsap.StaggerVars = 0.1
298:   ): gsap.core.Tween {
299:     return gsap.fromTo(targets, fromVars, {
300:       ...toVars,
301:       stagger,
302:     });
303:   },
304: 
305:   /**
306:    * Stagger fade in
307:    */
308:   staggerFadeIn(
309:     targets: gsap.TweenTarget,
310:     options: StaggerOptions = {}
311:   ): gsap.core.Tween {
312:     const { duration = DEFAULT_DURATION, delay = 0, stagger = 0.1, onComplete } = options;
313: 
314:     return gsap.fromTo(
315:       targets,
316:       { opacity: 0, y: 10 },
317:       {
318:         opacity: 1,
319:         y: 0,
320:         duration,
321:         delay,
322:         stagger,
323:         onComplete,
324:       }
325:     );
326:   },
327: 
328:   // === UTILITY ===
329: 
330:   /**
331:    * Set initial state (no animation)
332:    */
333:   set(target: gsap.TweenTarget, vars: gsap.TweenVars): gsap.core.Tween {
334:     return gsap.set(target, vars);
335:   },
336: 
337:   /**
338:    * Animate to values
339:    */
340:   to(target: gsap.TweenTarget, vars: gsap.TweenVars): gsap.core.Tween {
341:     return gsap.to(target, vars);
342:   },
343: 
344:   /**
345:    * Animate from values
346:    */
347:   from(target: gsap.TweenTarget, vars: gsap.TweenVars): gsap.core.Tween {
348:     return gsap.from(target, vars);
349:   },
350: 
351:   /**
352:    * Animate from/to values
353:    */
354:   fromTo(
355:     target: gsap.TweenTarget,
356:     fromVars: gsap.TweenVars,
357:     toVars: gsap.TweenVars
358:   ): gsap.core.Tween {
359:     return gsap.fromTo(target, fromVars, toVars);
360:   },
361: 
362:   /**
363:    * Kill all animations on target
364:    */
365:   kill(target: gsap.TweenTarget): void {
366:     gsap.killTweensOf(target);
367:   },
368: 
369:   /**
370:    * Pause all animations
371:    */
372:   pauseAll(): void {
373:     gsap.globalTimeline.pause();
374:   },
375: 
376:   /**
377:    * Resume all animations
378:    */
379:   resumeAll(): void {
380:     gsap.globalTimeline.resume();
381:   },
382:

389:    */
390:   makeDraggable(

394:     LogManager.addEvent(
395:       'AnimationController',
396:       'warn',
397:       'Draggable requires GSAP Club plugin - not available in free version',
398:       { target }
399:     );
400:     // Future implementation with Draggable plugin:
401:     // return Draggable.create(target, options);
402:   },
403: };

 71:    * @placeholder Loads default sounds

 74:     if (isInitialized) return;
 75: 
 76:     // In future: preload default sounds
 77:     // await Promise.all([
 78:     //   AudioManager.register('notification', '/sounds/notification.mp3'),
 79:     //   AudioManager.register('success', '/sounds/success.mp3'),
 80:     //   ...
 81:     // ]);
 82:

 84:     LogManager.addEvent('AudioManager', 'info', 'Initialized (placeholder mode)', { visibility: 2 });
 85:   },

 87:   /**
 88:    * Register a custom sound
 89:    * @placeholder Future implementation
 90:    */
 91:   async register(id: string, url: string): Promise<boolean> {
 92:     try {
 93:       const audio = new window.Audio(url);
 94:       await audio.load();
 95:       audioCache.set(id, audio);
 96:       LogManager.addEvent('AudioManager', 'debug', 'Sound registered', { id, url });
 97:       return true;
 98:     } catch (error) {
 99:       LogManager.addEvent('AudioManager', 'error', 'Failed to register sound', { id, error });
100:       return false;
101:     }

106:    * @placeholder Returns immediately without playing
107:    */
108:   play(id: SoundId | string, options: AudioOptions = {}): void {
109:     if (isMuted) return;
110: 
111:     const audio = audioCache.get(id);
112:     if (!audio) {
113:       LogManager.addEvent('AudioManager', 'debug', 'Sound not found (placeholder mode)', { id });
114:       return;
115:     }
116: 
117:     const { volume = globalVolume, loop = false } = options;
118: 
119:     try {
120:       audio.volume = volume;
121:       audio.loop = loop;
122:       audio.currentTime = 0;
123:       audio.play().catch(() => {
124:         // Autoplay might be blocked
125:       });
126:     } catch {
127:       // Ignore errors in placeholder mode
128:     }
129:   },

133:    */

138:       audio.currentTime = 0;
139:     }
140:   },

144:    */

150:   },

159:   },

File: src/js/ui/button-states.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Button States Manager
  3:  *
  4:  * Manages button loading, success, and error states with animations.
  5:  *
  6:  * @example
  7:  * ```typescript
  8:  * import { ButtonStates } from './ui';
  9:  *
 10:  * const btn = document.querySelector('#submit-btn') as HTMLButtonElement;
 11:  *
 12:  * // Set loading state
 13:  * ButtonStates.setLoading(btn, 'Kaydediliyor...');
 14:  *
 15:  * // After async operation
 16:  * ButtonStates.setSuccess(btn, 'Kaydedildi!'); // Auto-resets after 1.5s
 17:  *
 18:  * // Or on error
 19:  * ButtonStates.setError(btn, 'Hata!'); // Auto-resets after 2s
 20:  *
 21:  * // Manual reset
 22:  * ButtonStates.reset(btn);
 23:  * ```
 24:  */
 25: 
 26: import { LogManager } from '../modules/log-manager';
 27: 
 28: // ============================================================================
 29: // Types
 30: // ============================================================================
 31: 
 32: type ButtonState = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'success' | 'error';
 33: 
 34: interface ButtonData {
 35:   originalText: string;
 36:   originalDisabled: boolean;
 37:   state: ButtonState;
 38:   timeoutId?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
 39: }
 40: 
 41: // ============================================================================
 42: // Constants
 43: // ============================================================================
 44: 
 45: const DEFAULT_SUCCESS_DURATION = 1500;
 46: const DEFAULT_ERROR_DURATION = 2000;
 47: 
 48: const STATE_CLASSES = {
 49:   loading: 'btn-loading',
 50:   success: 'btn-state-success',
 51:   error: 'btn-state-error',
 52: };
 53: 
 54: const STATE_ICONS = {
 55:   success: '✓',
 56:   error: '✕',
 57: };
 58: 
 59: // ============================================================================
 60: // State
 61: // ============================================================================
 62: 
 63: const buttonDataMap: WeakMap<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonData> = new WeakMap();
 64: 
 65: // ============================================================================
 66: // Private Functions
 67: // ============================================================================
 68: 
 69: function getButtonData(button: HTMLButtonElement): ButtonData {
 70:   let data = buttonDataMap.get(button);
 71:   if (!data) {
 72:     data = {
 73:       originalText: button.textContent?.trim() || '',
 74:       originalDisabled: button.disabled,
 75:       state: 'idle',
 76:     };
 77:     buttonDataMap.set(button, data);
 78:   }
 79:   return data;
 80: }
 81: 
 82: function clearStateClasses(button: HTMLButtonElement): void {
 83:   button.classList.remove(
 84:     STATE_CLASSES.loading,
 85:     STATE_CLASSES.success,
 86:     STATE_CLASSES.error
 87:   );
 88: }
 89: 
 90: function clearTimeout(data: ButtonData): void {
 91:   if (data.timeoutId) {
 92:     globalThis.clearTimeout(data.timeoutId);
 93:     data.timeoutId = undefined;
 94:   }
 95: }
 96: 
 97: // ============================================================================
 98: // Public API
 99: // ============================================================================
100: 
101: export const ButtonStates = {
102:   /**
103:    * Set button to loading state
104:    * @param button - Target button element
105:    * @param text - Optional loading text (replaces button content)
106:    */
107:   setLoading(button: HTMLButtonElement, text?: string): void {
108:     const data = getButtonData(button);
109: 
110:     // Clear any existing timeout
111:     clearTimeout(data);
112: 
113:     // Store original state if not already in a special state
114:     if (data.state === 'idle') {
115:       data.originalText = button.textContent?.trim() || '';
116:       data.originalDisabled = button.disabled;
117:     }
118: 
119:     // Apply loading state
120:     clearStateClasses(button);
121:     button.classList.add(STATE_CLASSES.loading);
122:     button.disabled = true;
123:     data.state = 'loading';
124: 
125:     if (text) {
126:       button.textContent = text;
127:     }
128: 
129:     LogManager.addEvent('ButtonStates', 'debug', 'Loading state set', {
130:       text: text || data.originalText,
131:     });
132:   },
133: 
134:   /**
135:    * Set button to success state (auto-resets after duration)
136:    * @param button - Target button element
137:    * @param text - Optional success text
138:    * @param duration - Time before reset (ms), default: 1500
139:    */
140:   setSuccess(
141:     button: HTMLButtonElement,
142:     text?: string,
143:     duration: number = DEFAULT_SUCCESS_DURATION
144:   ): void {
145:     const data = getButtonData(button);
146: 
147:     // Clear any existing timeout
148:     clearTimeout(data);
149: 
150:     // Apply success state
151:     clearStateClasses(button);
152:     button.classList.add(STATE_CLASSES.success);
153:     button.disabled = false;
154:     data.state = 'success';
155: 
156:     if (text) {
157:       button.textContent = `${STATE_ICONS.success} ${text}`;
158:     } else {
159:       button.textContent = `${STATE_ICONS.success} ${data.originalText}`;
160:     }
161: 
162:     // Auto-reset after duration
163:     if (duration > 0) {
164:       data.timeoutId = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
165:         ButtonStates.reset(button);
166:       }, duration);
167:     }
168: 
169:     LogManager.addEvent('ButtonStates', 'debug', 'Success state set', {
170:       text: text || data.originalText,
171:     });
172:   },
173: 
174:   /**
175:    * Set button to error state (auto-resets after duration)
176:    * @param button - Target button element
177:    * @param text - Optional error text
178:    * @param duration - Time before reset (ms), default: 2000
179:    */
180:   setError(
181:     button: HTMLButtonElement,
182:     text?: string,
183:     duration: number = DEFAULT_ERROR_DURATION
184:   ): void {
185:     const data = getButtonData(button);
186: 
187:     // Clear any existing timeout
188:     clearTimeout(data);
189: 
190:     // Apply error state
191:     clearStateClasses(button);
192:     button.classList.add(STATE_CLASSES.error);
193:     button.disabled = false;
194:     data.state = 'error';
195: 
196:     if (text) {
197:       button.textContent = `${STATE_ICONS.error} ${text}`;
198:     } else {
199:       button.textContent = `${STATE_ICONS.error} ${data.originalText}`;
200:     }
201: 
202:     // Auto-reset after duration
203:     if (duration > 0) {
204:       data.timeoutId = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
205:         ButtonStates.reset(button);
206:       }, duration);
207:     }
208: 
209:     LogManager.addEvent('ButtonStates', 'debug', 'Error state set', {
210:       text: text || data.originalText,
211:     });
212:   },
213: 
214:   /**
215:    * Reset button to original state
216:    * @param button - Target button element
217:    */
218:   reset(button: HTMLButtonElement): void {
219:     const data = getButtonData(button);
220: 
221:     // Clear any existing timeout
222:     clearTimeout(data);
223: 
224:     // Remove all state classes
225:     clearStateClasses(button);
226: 
227:     // Restore original state
228:     button.textContent = data.originalText;
229:     button.disabled = data.originalDisabled;
230:     data.state = 'idle';
231: 
232:     LogManager.addEvent('ButtonStates', 'debug', 'Button reset', {
233:       text: data.originalText,
234:     });
235:   },
236: 
237:   /**
238:    * Get current button state
239:    * @param button - Target button element
240:    * @returns Current state
241:    */
242:   getState(button: HTMLButtonElement): ButtonState {
243:     const data = buttonDataMap.get(button);
244:     return data?.state || 'idle';
245:   },
246: 
247:   /**
248:    * Check if button is in loading state
249:    * @param button - Target button element
250:    */
251:   isLoading(button: HTMLButtonElement): boolean {
252:     return ButtonStates.getState(button) === 'loading';
253:   },
254: 
255:   /**
256:    * Execute async function with automatic button states
257:    * @param button - Target button element
258:    * @param fn - Async function to execute
259:    * @param options - Optional text overrides
260:    */
261:   async wrap<T>(
262:     button: HTMLButtonElement,
263:     fn: () => Promise<T>,
264:     options?: {
265:       loadingText?: string;
266:       successText?: string;
267:       errorText?: string;
268:     }
269:   ): Promise<T> {
270:     ButtonStates.setLoading(button, options?.loadingText);
271: 
272:     try {
273:       const result = await fn();
274:       ButtonStates.setSuccess(button, options?.successText);
275:       return result;
276:     } catch (error) {
277:       ButtonStates.setError(button, options?.errorText);
278:       throw error;
279:     }
280:   },
281: };

  1: /**
  2:  * Canvas Manager (Placeholder)
  3:  *
  4:  * Future implementation for Canvas/WebGL based visualizations.
  5:  * Planned features:
  6:  * - Game board rendering (tavla, satranç)
  7:  * - Particle effects
  8:  * - Data visualizations
  9:  * - Custom drawing canvas
 10:  *
 11:  * @example
 12:  * ```typescript
 13:  * import { Canvas } from './ui';
 14:  *
 15:  * // Create canvas instance
 16:  * const canvas = Canvas.create(container, { width: 800, height: 600 });
 17:  *
 18:  * // Draw operations
 19:  * canvas.clear();
 20:  * canvas.drawRect(0, 0, 100, 100, '#ff0000');
 21:  * canvas.drawCircle(50, 50, 25, '#00ff00');
 22:  *
 23:  * // Game board
 24:  * const board = Canvas.createBoard(container, 'backgammon');
 25:  * board.setPieces(gameState);
 26:  * board.onMove((from, to) => handleMove(from, to));
 27:  * ```
 28:  */
 29: 
 30: import { LogManager } from '../modules/log-manager';
 31: 
 32: // ============================================================================
 33: // Types
 34: // ============================================================================
 35: 
 36: export interface CanvasOptions {
 37:   width?: number;
 38:   height?: number;
 39:   pixelRatio?: number;
 40:   backgroundColor?: string;
 41: }
 42: 
 43: export interface CanvasInstance {
 44:   element: HTMLCanvasElement;
 45:   ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D;
 46:   width: number;
 47:   height: number;
 48:   clear: () => void;
 49:   destroy: () => void;
 50: }
 51: 
 52: // ============================================================================
 53: // Placeholder Implementation
 54: // ============================================================================
 55: 
 56: export const CanvasManager = {
 57:   /**
 58:    * Create a canvas instance
 59:    * @placeholder This is a placeholder for future implementation
 60:    */
 61:   create(
 62:     container: HTMLElement,
 63:     options: CanvasOptions = {}
 64:   ): CanvasInstance | null {
 65:     const { width = 800, height = 600, backgroundColor = 'transparent' } = options;
 66: 
 67:     try {
 68:       const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
 69:       canvas.width = width;
 70:       canvas.height = height;
 71:       canvas.style.backgroundColor = backgroundColor;
 72: 
 73:       const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
 74:       if (!ctx) {
 75:         LogManager.addEvent('CanvasManager', 'error', 'Failed to get 2D context');
 76:         return null;
 77:       }
 78: 
 79:       container.appendChild(canvas);
 80: 
 81:       const instance: CanvasInstance = {
 82:         element: canvas,
 83:         ctx,
 84:         width,
 85:         height,
 86:         clear: () => {
 87:           ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
 88:         },
 89:         destroy: () => {
 90:           canvas.remove();
 91:         },
 92:       };
 93: 
 94:       LogManager.addEvent('CanvasManager', 'info', 'Canvas created', { width, height });
 95:       return instance;
 96:     } catch (error) {
 97:       LogManager.addEvent('CanvasManager', 'error', 'Failed to create canvas', { error });
 98:       return null;
 99:     }
100:   },
101: 
102:   /**
103:    * Create a game board canvas
104:    * @placeholder Future implementation for game boards
105:    */
106:   createBoard(
107:     _container: HTMLElement,
108:     _gameType: 'backgammon' | 'chess' | 'checkers'
109:   ): null {
110:     LogManager.addEvent(
111:       'CanvasManager',
112:       'warn',
113:       'Game board canvas not yet implemented'
114:     );
115:     return null;
116:   },
117: 
118:   /**
119:    * Check if WebGL is supported
120:    */
121:   isWebGLSupported(): boolean {
122:     try {
123:       const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
124:       return !!(
125:         window.WebGLRenderingContext &&
126:         (canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl'))
127:       );
128:     } catch {
129:       return false;
130:     }
131:   },
132: 
133:   /**
134:    * Check if Canvas is supported
135:    */
136:   isCanvasSupported(): boolean {
137:     const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
138:     return !!(canvas.getContext && canvas.getContext('2d'));
139:   },
140: };
141: 
142: // Shorter alias
143: export const Canvas = CanvasManager;

  1: /**
  2:  * Modal Manager
  3:  *
  4:  * Manages modal dialogs with animations and keyboard support.
  5:  *
  6:  * @example
  7:  * ```typescript
  8:  * import { Modal } from './ui';
  9:  *
 10:  * // Basic modal
 11:  * const modal = Modal.open({
 12:  *   title: 'Onay',
 13:  *   content: 'Bu işlemi yapmak istediğinize emin misiniz?',
 14:  *   buttons: [
 15:  *     { label: 'İptal', variant: 'secondary', onClick: () => modal.close() },
 16:  *     { label: 'Onayla', variant: 'primary', onClick: () => handleConfirm() }
 17:  *   ]
 18:  * });
 19:  *
 20:  * // Confirm dialog (shorthand)
 21:  * const confirmed = await Modal.confirm({
 22:  *   title: 'Silme Onayı',
 23:  *   message: 'Bu öğeyi silmek istediğinize emin misiniz?',
 24:  *   confirmText: 'Sil',
 25:  *   confirmVariant: 'danger'
 26:  * });
 27:  *
 28:  * // Alert (shorthand)
 29:  * await Modal.alert('Hata', 'Bir şeyler ters gitti.');
 30:  * ```
 31:  */
 32: 
 33: import { LogManager } from '../modules/log-manager';
 34: 
 35: // ============================================================================
 36: // Types
 37: // ============================================================================
 38: 
 39: type ButtonVariant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'ghost';
 40: 
 41: interface ModalButton {
 42:   label: string;
 43:   variant?: ButtonVariant;
 44:   onClick?: () => void | Promise<void>;
 45:   closeOnClick?: boolean; // default: true
 46: }
 47: 
 48: interface ModalOptions {
 49:   title?: string;
 50:   content: string | HTMLElement;
 51:   size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';
 52:   closable?: boolean; // default: true
 53:   closeOnOverlay?: boolean; // default: true
 54:   closeOnEscape?: boolean; // default: true
 55:   buttons?: ModalButton[];
 56:   onClose?: () => void;
 57: }
 58: 
 59: interface ConfirmOptions {
 60:   title: string;
 61:   message: string;
 62:   confirmText?: string;
 63:   cancelText?: string;
 64:   confirmVariant?: ButtonVariant;
 65:   icon?: string;
 66: }
 67: 
 68: interface ModalInstance {
 69:   id: string;
 70:   element: HTMLDivElement;
 71:   options: ModalOptions;
 72:   close: () => void;
 73: }
 74: 
 75: // ============================================================================
 76: // State
 77: // ============================================================================
 78: 
 79: let idCounter = 0;
 80: const modals: Map<string, ModalInstance> = new Map();
 81: let activeModal: ModalInstance | null = null;
 82: 
 83: // ============================================================================
 84: // Private Functions
 85: // ============================================================================
 86: 
 87: function generateId(): string {
 88:   return `modal-${++idCounter}-${Date.now()}`;
 89: }
 90: 
 91: function createModalElement(id: string, options: ModalOptions): HTMLDivElement {
 92:   const overlay = document.createElement('div');
 93:   overlay.className = 'modal-overlay';
 94:   overlay.setAttribute('data-modal-id', id);
 95: 
 96:   const modal = document.createElement('div');
 97:   modal.className = `modal modal-${options.size || 'md'}`;
 98:   modal.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
 99:   modal.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
100: 
101:   // Header
102:   if (options.title || options.closable !== false) {
103:     const header = document.createElement('div');
104:     header.className = 'modal-header';
105: 
106:     if (options.title) {
107:       const title = document.createElement('h2');
108:       title.className = 'modal-title';
109:       title.textContent = options.title;
110:       header.appendChild(title);
111:     }
112: 
113:     if (options.closable !== false) {
114:       const closeBtn = document.createElement('button');
115:       closeBtn.className = 'modal-close';
116:       closeBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Kapat');
117:       closeBtn.innerHTML = '×';
118:       closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => Modal.close(id));
119:       header.appendChild(closeBtn);
120:     }
121: 
122:     modal.appendChild(header);
123:   }
124: 
125:   // Body
126:   const body = document.createElement('div');
127:   body.className = 'modal-body';
128: 
129:   if (typeof options.content === 'string') {
130:     body.innerHTML = options.content;
131:   } else {
132:     body.appendChild(options.content);
133:   }
134: 
135:   modal.appendChild(body);
136: 
137:   // Footer with buttons
138:   if (options.buttons && options.buttons.length > 0) {
139:     const footer = document.createElement('div');
140:     footer.className = 'modal-footer';
141: 
142:     options.buttons.forEach((btnConfig) => {
143:       const btn = document.createElement('button');
144:       btn.className = `btn btn-${btnConfig.variant || 'secondary'}`;
145:       btn.textContent = btnConfig.label;
146: 
147:       btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
148:         if (btnConfig.onClick) {
149:           await btnConfig.onClick();
150:         }
151:         if (btnConfig.closeOnClick !== false) {
152:           Modal.close(id);
153:         }
154:       });
155: 
156:       footer.appendChild(btn);
157:     });
158: 
159:     modal.appendChild(footer);
160:   }
161: 
162:   overlay.appendChild(modal);
163: 
164:   // Close on overlay click
165:   if (options.closeOnOverlay !== false) {
166:     overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
167:       if (e.target === overlay) {
168:         Modal.close(id);
169:       }
170:     });
171:   }
172: 
173:   return overlay;
174: }
175: 
176: function handleKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
177:   if (e.key === 'Escape' && activeModal) {
178:     const options = activeModal.options;
179:     if (options.closeOnEscape !== false && options.closable !== false) {
180:       Modal.close(activeModal.id);
181:     }
182:   }
183: }
184: 
185: // ============================================================================
186: // Public API
187: // ============================================================================
188: 
189: export const Modal = {
190:   /**
191:    * Open a modal dialog
192:    * @returns Modal instance with close method
193:    */
194:   open(options: ModalOptions): ModalInstance {
195:     const id = generateId();
196:     const element = createModalElement(id, options);
197: 
198:     document.body.appendChild(element);
199:     document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
200: 
201:     // Focus trap setup
202:     const focusableElements = element.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
203:       'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
204:     );
205:     if (focusableElements.length > 0) {
206:       focusableElements[0].focus();
207:     }
208: 
209:     const instance: ModalInstance = {
210:       id,
211:       element,
212:       options,
213:       close: () => Modal.close(id),
214:     };
215: 
216:     modals.set(id, instance);
217:     activeModal = instance;
218: 
219:     // Add escape key listener
220:     document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
221: 
222:     LogManager.addEvent('Modal', 'info', 'Opened', { id, title: options.title });
223: 
224:     return instance;
225:   },
226: 
227:   /**
228:    * Close a specific modal or the active one
229:    */
230:   close(id?: string): void {
231:     const modalId = id || activeModal?.id;
232:     if (!modalId) return;
233: 
234:     const instance = modals.get(modalId);
235:     if (!instance) return;
236: 
237:     // Animate out
238:     instance.element.classList.add('modal-closing');
239: 
240:     setTimeout(() => {
241:       instance.element.remove();
242:       modals.delete(modalId);
243: 
244:       // Update active modal
245:       if (activeModal?.id === modalId) {
246:         activeModal = modals.size > 0 
247:           ? Array.from(modals.values()).pop() || null 
248:           : null;
249:       }
250: 
251:       // Restore body scroll if no modals
252:       if (modals.size === 0) {
253:         document.body.style.overflow = '';
254:         document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
255:       }
256: 
257:       // Callback
258:       instance.options.onClose?.();
259: 
260:       LogManager.addEvent('Modal', 'info', 'Closed', { id: modalId, visibility: 3 });
261:     }, 200);
262:   },
263: 
264:   /**
265:    * Close all open modals
266:    */
267:   closeAll(): void {
268:     modals.forEach((_, id) => Modal.close(id));
269:   },
270: 
271:   /**
272:    * Confirm dialog - returns promise that resolves to boolean
273:    */
274:   async confirm(options: ConfirmOptions): Promise<boolean> {
275:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
276:       const content = document.createElement('div');
277:       content.className = 'modal-confirm';
278: 
279:       if (options.icon) {
280:         const iconDiv = document.createElement('div');
281:         iconDiv.className = 'modal-confirm-icon';
282:         iconDiv.textContent = options.icon;
283:         content.appendChild(iconDiv);
284:       }
285: 
286:       const titleEl = document.createElement('div');
287:       titleEl.className = 'modal-confirm-title';
288:       titleEl.textContent = options.title;
289:       content.appendChild(titleEl);
290: 
291:       const messageEl = document.createElement('div');
292:       messageEl.className = 'modal-confirm-message';
293:       messageEl.textContent = options.message;
294:       content.appendChild(messageEl);
295: 
296:       Modal.open({
297:         content,
298:         size: 'sm',
299:         closable: false,
300:         closeOnOverlay: false,
301:         buttons: [
302:           {
303:             label: options.cancelText || 'İptal',
304:             variant: 'secondary',
305:             onClick: () => resolve(false),
306:           },
307:           {
308:             label: options.confirmText || 'Onayla',
309:             variant: options.confirmVariant || 'primary',
310:             onClick: () => resolve(true),
311:           },
312:         ],
313:       });
314:     });
315:   },
316: 
317:   /**
318:    * Alert dialog - simple message with OK button
319:    */
320:   async alert(title: string, message: string): Promise<void> {
321:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
322:       Modal.open({
323:         title,
324:         content: `<p>${message}</p>`,
325:         size: 'sm',
326:         buttons: [
327:           {
328:             label: 'Tamam',
329:             variant: 'primary',
330:             onClick: () => resolve(),
331:           },
332:         ],
333:       });
334:     });
335:   },
336: 
337:   /**
338:    * Prompt dialog - input with OK/Cancel
339:    */
340:   async prompt(
341:     title: string,
342:     message: string,
343:     defaultValue: string = ''
344:   ): Promise<string | null> {
345:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
346:       const content = document.createElement('div');
347: 
348:       const messageEl = document.createElement('p');
349:       messageEl.textContent = message;
350:       messageEl.style.marginBottom = 'var(--space-4)';
351:       content.appendChild(messageEl);
352: 
353:       const input = document.createElement('input');
354:       input.type = 'text';
355:       input.className = 'input';
356:       input.value = defaultValue;
357:       content.appendChild(input);
358: 
359:       const modal = Modal.open({
360:         title,
361:         content,
362:         size: 'sm',
363:         buttons: [
364:           {
365:             label: 'İptal',
366:             variant: 'secondary',
367:             onClick: () => resolve(null),
368:           },
369:           {
370:             label: 'Tamam',
371:             variant: 'primary',
372:             onClick: () => resolve(input.value),
373:           },
374:         ],
375:       });
376: 
377:       // Focus input after modal opens
378:       setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 100);
379: 
380:       // Submit on Enter
381:       input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
382:         if (e.key === 'Enter') {
383:           resolve(input.value);
384:           modal.close();
385:         }
386:       });
387:     });
388:   },
389: 
390:   /**
391:    * Check if any modal is open
392:    */
393:   get isOpen(): boolean {
394:     return modals.size > 0;
395:   },
396: 
397:   /**
398:    * Get active modal instance
399:    */
400:   get active(): ModalInstance | null {
401:     return activeModal;
402:   },
403: };
404: 
405: // Alias for convenience
406: export const ModalManager = Modal;

File: src/js/ui/splash-screen.ts
