  1: /**
  2:  * Splash Screen Manager
  3:  *
  4:  * Full-screen loading splash with progress indication.
  5:  * Shows during app initialization with minimum display time.
  6:  *
  7:  * @example
  8:  * ```typescript
  9:  * import { SplashScreen } from './ui';
 10:  *
 11:  * // Show splash (usually already visible from HTML)
 12:  * SplashScreen.show();
 13:  *
 14:  * // Update progress
 15:  * SplashScreen.setStatus('Ayarlar yükleniyor...');
 16:  * SplashScreen.setProgress(25);
 17:  *
 18:  * // Continue with loading...
 19:  * SplashScreen.setStatus('Modüller başlatılıyor...');
 20:  * SplashScreen.setProgress(50);
 21:  *
 22:  * // Complete and hide (waits minimum time)
 23:  * SplashScreen.setStatus('Hazır!');
 24:  * SplashScreen.setProgress(100);
 25:  * await SplashScreen.hide(); // Waits min 2s, then fades out
 26:  * ```
 27:  */
 28: 
 29: import { LogManager } from '../modules/log-manager';
 30: 
 31: // ============================================================================
 32: // Types
 33: // ============================================================================
 34: 
 35: interface SplashElements {
 36:   container: HTMLElement | null;
 37:   progress: HTMLElement | null;
 38:   status: HTMLElement | null;
 39:   logo: HTMLElement | null;
 40: }
 41: 
 42: // ============================================================================
 43: // Constants
 44: // ============================================================================
 45: 
 46: const MINIMUM_DISPLAY_TIME = 2000; // 2 seconds minimum
 47: const HIDE_ANIMATION_DURATION = 400; // Match CSS --duration-slow
 48: const ELEMENT_IDS = {
 49:   container: 'splash-screen',
 50:   progress: 'splash-progress',
 51:   status: 'splash-status',
 52:   logo: 'splash-logo',
 53: };
 54: 
 55: // ============================================================================
 56: // State
 57: // ============================================================================
 58: 
 59: let elements: SplashElements = {
 60:   container: null,
 61:   progress: null,
 62:   status: null,
 63:   logo: null,
 64: };
 65: 
 66: let showTime: number = 0;
 67: let currentProgress: number = 0;
 68: let isVisible: boolean = false;
 69: let isInitialized: boolean = false;
 70: 
 71: // ============================================================================
 72: // Private Functions
 73: // ============================================================================
 74: 
 75: function getElements(): SplashElements {
 76:   if (!isInitialized) {
 77:     elements = {
 78:       container: document.getElementById(ELEMENT_IDS.container),
 79:       progress: document.getElementById(ELEMENT_IDS.progress),
 80:       status: document.getElementById(ELEMENT_IDS.status),
 81:       logo: document.getElementById(ELEMENT_IDS.logo) as HTMLImageElement | null,
 82:     };
 83:     isInitialized = true;
 84:   }
 85:   return elements;
 86: }
 87: 
 88: function createSplashElement(): HTMLElement {
 89:   const splash = document.createElement('div');
 90:   splash.id = ELEMENT_IDS.container;
 91:   splash.className = 'splash';
 92: 
 93:   splash.innerHTML = `
 94:     <div class="splash-content">
 95:       <div class="splash-logo-container">
 96:         <img src="/assets/logo.jpg" alt="Hayalet Ev" class="splash-logo" id="${ELEMENT_IDS.logo}" />
 97:         <div class="splash-logo-glow"></div>
 98:       </div>
 99:       <h1 class="splash-title">Hayalet Ev</h1>
100:       <p class="splash-version">v5.4.0</p>
101:       <div class="splash-loader">
102:         <div class="splash-progress" id="${ELEMENT_IDS.progress}"></div>
103:       </div>
104:       <p class="splash-status" id="${ELEMENT_IDS.status}">Başlatılıyor...</p>
105:     </div>
106:   `;
107: 
108:   return splash;
109: }
110: 
111: // ============================================================================
112: // Public API
113: // ============================================================================
114: 
115: export const SplashScreen = {
116:   /**
117:    * Show splash screen
118:    * Creates the element if it doesn't exist
119:    */
120:   show(): void {
121:     let container = getElements().container;
122: 
123:     // Create if doesn't exist
124:     if (!container) {
125:       container = createSplashElement();
126:       document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
127:       isInitialized = false; // Force re-fetch elements
128:       getElements();
129:     }
130: 
131:     // Show
132:     container.classList.remove('hidden', 'splash-hiding');
133:     showTime = Date.now();
134:     isVisible = true;
135:     currentProgress = 0;
136: 
137:     LogManager.addEvent('SplashScreen', 'info', 'Shown', { visibility: 3 });
138:   },
139: 
140:   /**
141:    * Hide splash screen with fade animation
142:    * Waits for minimum display time before hiding
143:    * @returns Promise that resolves when fully hidden
144:    */
145:   async hide(): Promise<void> {
146:     const { container } = getElements();
147:     if (!container || !isVisible) return;
148: 
149:     // Calculate remaining wait time
150:     const elapsed = Date.now() - showTime;
151:     const remainingTime = Math.max(0, MINIMUM_DISPLAY_TIME - elapsed);
152: 
153:     // Wait for minimum time
154:     if (remainingTime > 0) {
155:       await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, remainingTime));
156:     }
157: 
158:     // Start hide animation
159:     container.classList.add('splash-hiding');
160: 
161:     // Wait for animation to complete
162:     await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, HIDE_ANIMATION_DURATION));
163: 
164:     // Remove from DOM
165:     container.classList.add('hidden');
166:     container.classList.remove('splash-hiding');
167:     isVisible = false;
168: 
169:     LogManager.addEvent('SplashScreen', 'info', 'Hidden', {
170:       totalTime: Date.now() - showTime,
171:     });
172:   },
173: 
174:   /**
175:    * Set progress bar percentage
176:    * @param percent - Progress value (0-100)
177:    */
178:   setProgress(percent: number): void {
179:     const { progress } = getElements();
180:     if (!progress) return;
181: 
182:     // Clamp value
183:     const value = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent));
184:     currentProgress = value;
185: 
186:     // Remove indeterminate mode if was active
187:     progress.classList.remove('indeterminate');
188: 
189:     // Update width
190:     progress.style.width = `${value}%`;
191: 
192:     LogManager.addEvent('SplashScreen', 'debug', 'Progress updated', { percent: value });
193:   },
194: 
195:   /**
196:    * Set indeterminate progress (animated bar)
197:    */
198:   setIndeterminate(): void {
199:     const { progress } = getElements();
200:     if (!progress) return;
201: 
202:     progress.style.width = '';
203:     progress.classList.add('indeterminate');
204:   },
205: 
206:   /**
207:    * Set status message
208:    * @param message - Status text to display
209:    */
210:   setStatus(message: string): void {
211:     const { status } = getElements();
212:     if (!status) return;
213: 
214:     status.textContent = message;
215: 
216:     LogManager.addEvent('SplashScreen', 'debug', 'Status updated', { message, visibility: 3 });
217:   },
218: 
219:   /**
220:    * Update both progress and status in one call
221:    */
222:   update(percent: number, message: string): void {
223:     // Auto-initialize visibility state if splash is already in DOM
224:     if (!isVisible) {
225:       const { container } = getElements();
226:       if (container && !container.classList.contains('hidden')) {
227:         isVisible = true;
228:         showTime = Date.now();
229:       }
230:     }
231:     SplashScreen.setProgress(percent);
232:     SplashScreen.setStatus(message);
233:   },
234: 
235:   /**
236:    * Check if splash is currently visible
237:    */
238:   get isVisible(): boolean {
239:     return isVisible;
240:   },
241: 
242:   /**
243:    * Get current progress value
244:    */
245:   get progress(): number {
246:     return currentProgress;
247:   },
248: 
249:   /**
250:    * Complete splash - set to 100% with "Hazır!" message
251:    * Useful shorthand before calling hide()
252:    */
253:   complete(): void {
254:     SplashScreen.setProgress(100);
255:     SplashScreen.setStatus('Hazır!');
256:   },
257: 
258:   /**
259:    * Reset splash to initial state
260:    */
261:   reset(): void {
262:     SplashScreen.setProgress(0);
263:     SplashScreen.setStatus('Başlatılıyor...');
264:     currentProgress = 0;
265:   },
266: };

================
File: src/js/ui/toast-manager.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Toast Manager
  3:  *
  4:  * Non-blocking notification system with auto-dismiss.
  5:  *
  6:  * @example
  7:  * ```typescript
  8:  * import { Toast } from './ui';
  9:  *
 10:  * // Quick methods
 11:  * Toast.success('Başarılı!', 'Bağlantı kuruldu');
 12:  * Toast.error('Hata!', 'Bağlantı kesildi');
 13:  * Toast.warning('Dikkat!', 'Oturum süreniz dolmak üzere');
 14:  * Toast.info('Bilgi', 'Yeni güncelleme mevcut');
 15:  *
 16:  * // Loading with update
 17:  * const id = Toast.loading('Yükleniyor...');
 18:  * // ... async operation
 19:  * Toast.update(id, { type: 'success', title: 'Tamamlandı!' });
 20:  *
 21:  * // With action button
 22:  * Toast.show({
 23:  *   type: 'info',
 24:  *   title: 'Güncelleme',
 25:  *   message: 'Yeni sürüm mevcut',
 26:  *   action: { label: 'Güncelle', onClick: () => update() }
 27:  * });
 28:  * ```
 29:  */
 30: 
 31: import { LogManager } from '../modules/log-manager';
 32: 
 33: // ============================================================================
 34: // Types
 35: // ============================================================================
 36: 
 37: export type ToastType = 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'loading';
 38: 
 39: export interface ToastAction {
 40:   label: string;
 41:   onClick: () => void;
 42: }
 43: 
 44: export interface ToastOptions {
 45:   type: ToastType;
 46:   title: string;
 47:   message?: string;
 48:   duration?: number; // ms, 0 = manual close, default: 4000
 49:   closable?: boolean; // default: true
 50:   action?: ToastAction;
 51:   progress?: boolean; // show progress bar
 52: }
 53: 
 54: interface ToastInstance {
 55:   id: string;
 56:   element: HTMLDivElement;
 57:   options: ToastOptions;
 58:   timeoutId?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
 59: }
 60: 
 61: // ============================================================================
 62: // Constants
 63: // ============================================================================
 64: 
 65: const ICONS: Record<ToastType, string> = {
 66:   success: '✓',
 67:   error: '✕',
 68:   warning: '⚠',
 69:   info: 'ℹ',
 70:   loading: '', // CSS spinner
 71: };
 72: 
 73: const DEFAULT_DURATIONS: Record<ToastType, number> = {
 74:   success: 3000,
 75:   error: 5000,
 76:   warning: 4000,
 77:   info: 4000,
 78:   loading: 0, // No auto-dismiss
 79: };
 80: 
 81: // ============================================================================
 82: // State
 83: // ============================================================================
 84: 
 85: let container: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
 86: const toasts: Map<string, ToastInstance> = new Map();
 87: let idCounter = 0;
 88: 
 89: // ============================================================================
 90: // Private Functions
 91: // ============================================================================
 92: 
 93: function generateId(): string {
 94:   return `toast-${++idCounter}-${Date.now()}`;
 95: }
 96: 
 97: function ensureContainer(): HTMLDivElement {
 98:   if (!container || !document.body.contains(container)) {
 99:     container = document.createElement('div');
100:     container.id = 'toast-container';
101:     container.className = 'toast-container';
102:     container.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
103:     container.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
104:     document.body.appendChild(container);
105:   }
106:   return container;
107: }
108: 
109: function createToastElement(id: string, options: ToastOptions): HTMLDivElement {
110:   const toast = document.createElement('div');
111:   toast.className = `toast toast-${options.type}`;
112:   toast.setAttribute('data-toast-id', id);
113:   toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
114: 
115:   // Icon
116:   const iconDiv = document.createElement('div');
117:   iconDiv.className = 'toast-icon';
118:   if (options.type !== 'loading') {
119:     iconDiv.textContent = ICONS[options.type];
120:   }
121:   toast.appendChild(iconDiv);
122: 
123:   // Content
124:   const contentDiv = document.createElement('div');
125:   contentDiv.className = 'toast-content';
126: 
127:   const titleDiv = document.createElement('div');
128:   titleDiv.className = 'toast-title';
129:   titleDiv.textContent = options.title;
130:   contentDiv.appendChild(titleDiv);
131: 
132:   if (options.message) {
133:     const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
134:     messageDiv.className = 'toast-message';
135:     messageDiv.textContent = options.message;
136:     contentDiv.appendChild(messageDiv);
137:   }
138: 
139:   // Action button
140:   if (options.action) {
141:     const actionDiv = document.createElement('div');
142:     actionDiv.className = 'toast-action';
143: 
144:     const actionBtn = document.createElement('button');
145:     actionBtn.className = 'toast-action-btn';
146:     actionBtn.textContent = options.action.label;
147:     actionBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
148:       options.action?.onClick();
149:       Toast.dismiss(id);
150:     });
151: 
152:     actionDiv.appendChild(actionBtn);
153:     contentDiv.appendChild(actionDiv);
154:   }
155: 
156:   toast.appendChild(contentDiv);
157: 
158:   // Close button
159:   if (options.closable !== false) {
160:     const closeBtn = document.createElement('button');
161:     closeBtn.className = 'toast-close';
162:     closeBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Kapat');
163:     closeBtn.innerHTML = '×';
164:     closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => Toast.dismiss(id));
165:     toast.appendChild(closeBtn);
166:   }
167: 
168:   // Progress bar
169:   if (options.progress && options.duration && options.duration > 0) {
170:     const progressDiv = document.createElement('div');
171:     progressDiv.className = 'toast-progress';
172:     progressDiv.style.animationDuration = `${options.duration}ms`;
173:     toast.appendChild(progressDiv);
174:   }
175: 
176:   return toast;
177: }
178: 
179: function scheduleRemoval(instance: ToastInstance): void {
180:   const duration = instance.options.duration ?? DEFAULT_DURATIONS[instance.options.type];
181: 
182:   if (duration > 0) {
183:     instance.timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
184:       Toast.dismiss(instance.id);
185:     }, duration);
186:   }
187: }
188: 
189: // ============================================================================
190: // Public API
191: // ============================================================================
192: 
193: export const Toast = {
194:   /**
195:    * Show a toast notification
196:    * @returns Toast ID for later reference
197:    */
198:   show(options: ToastOptions): string {
199:     const id = generateId();
200:     const containerEl = ensureContainer();
201: 
202:     // Set default duration based on type
203:     const finalOptions: ToastOptions = {
204:       ...options,
205:       duration: options.duration ?? DEFAULT_DURATIONS[options.type],
206:       closable: options.closable ?? true,
207:       progress: options.progress ?? (options.type !== 'loading'),
208:     };
209: 
210:     const element = createToastElement(id, finalOptions);
211:     containerEl.appendChild(element);
212: 
213:     const instance: ToastInstance = {
214:       id,
215:       element,
216:       options: finalOptions,
217:     };
218: 
219:     toasts.set(id, instance);
220:     scheduleRemoval(instance);
221: 
222:     LogManager.addEvent('Toast', 'info', `Shown: ${options.type}`, { id, title: options.title, visibility: 3 });
223: 
224:     return id;
225:   },
226: 
227:   /**
228:    * Update an existing toast
229:    */
230:   update(id: string, options: Partial<ToastOptions>): void {
231:     const instance = toasts.get(id);
232:     if (!instance) {
233:       LogManager.addEvent('Toast', 'warn', 'Update failed: toast not found', { id });
234:       return;
235:     }
236: 
237:     // Clear existing timeout
238:     if (instance.timeoutId) {
239:       clearTimeout(instance.timeoutId);
240:     }
241: 
242:     // Update options
243:     const newOptions: ToastOptions = { ...instance.options, ...options };
244:     instance.options = newOptions;
245: 
246:     // Update element
247:     const parent = instance.element.parentNode;
248:     const newElement = createToastElement(id, newOptions);
249: 
250:     if (parent) {
251:       parent.replaceChild(newElement, instance.element);
252:     }
253: 
254:     instance.element = newElement;
255: 
256:     // Reschedule removal
257:     scheduleRemoval(instance);
258: 
259:     LogManager.addEvent('Toast', 'info', 'Updated', { id, type: newOptions.type, visibility: 3 });
260:   },
261: 
262:   /**
263:    * Dismiss a specific toast
264:    */
265:   dismiss(id: string): void {
266:     const instance = toasts.get(id);
267:     if (!instance) return;
268: 
269:     // Clear timeout
270:     if (instance.timeoutId) {
271:       clearTimeout(instance.timeoutId);
272:     }
273: 
274:     // Animate out
275:     instance.element.classList.add('toast-out');
276: 
277:     // Remove after animation
278:     setTimeout(() => {
279:       instance.element.remove();
280:       toasts.delete(id);
281:     }, 150);
282:   },
283: 
284:   /**
285:    * Dismiss all toasts
286:    */
287:   dismissAll(): void {
288:     toasts.forEach((_, id) => Toast.dismiss(id));
289:   },
290: 
291:   // === Shorthand Methods ===
292: 
293:   success(title: string, message?: string): string {
294:     return Toast.show({ type: 'success', title, message });
295:   },
296: 
297:   error(title: string, message?: string): string {
298:     return Toast.show({ type: 'error', title, message });
299:   },
300: 
301:   warning(title: string, message?: string): string {
302:     return Toast.show({ type: 'warning', title, message });
303:   },
304: 
305:   info(title: string, message?: string): string {
306:     return Toast.show({ type: 'info', title, message });
307:   },
308: 
309:   loading(title: string, message?: string): string {
310:     return Toast.show({ type: 'loading', title, message, closable: false });
311:   },
312: 
313:   /**
314:    * Promise helper - shows loading, then success/error based on result
315:    */
316:   async promise<T>(
317:     promise: Promise<T>,
318:     options: {
319:       loading: string;
320:       success: string | ((data: T) => string);
321:       error: string | ((err: unknown) => string);
322:     }
323:   ): Promise<T> {
324:     const id = Toast.loading(options.loading);
325: 
326:     try {
327:       const result = await promise;
328:       const successMsg = typeof options.success === 'function' 
329:         ? options.success(result) 
330:         : options.success;
331:       Toast.update(id, { type: 'success', title: successMsg, closable: true });
332:       return result;
333:     } catch (err) {
334:       const errorMsg = typeof options.error === 'function' 
335:         ? options.error(err) 
336:         : options.error;
337:       Toast.update(id, { type: 'error', title: errorMsg, closable: true });
338:       throw err;
339:     }
340:   },
341: };
342: 
343: // Alias for convenience (geriye uyumluluk)
344: export const ToastManager = Toast;

  1: ## 🎯 CDP-Driven Development & Testing
  2: 
  3: CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) entegrasyonu sayesinde AI asistanlar Electron uygulamasını **canlı olarak** kontrol edebilir, test edebilir ve debug yapabilir. Bu bölüm, geliştirme sürecinde CDP tool'larının nasıl kullanılacağını açıklar.
  4: 
  5: ### CDP Mimarisi
  6: 
  7: ```
  8: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  9: │                     AI Asistan (Rovodev)                        │
 10: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 11: │  MCP Server (mcp-server/index.js)                               │
 12: │       │                                                          │
 13: │       ├── cdp-tools.js (Tool handlers)                          │
 14: │       │       │                                                  │
 15: │       │       ├── cdp-connection.js (WebSocket bağlantı)        │
 16: │       │       └── cdp-commands.js (UI otomasyon komutları)      │
 17: │       │                                                          │
 18: │       └───────────────────┐                                      │
 19: │                           │ WebSocket (ws://localhost:9222)      │
 20: │                           ▼                                      │
 21: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
 22: │  │              Electron (--remote-debugging-port=9222)     │    │
 23: │  │  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐      │    │
 24: │  │  │ Main Window │  │  Webview 1  │  │  Webview 2  │      │    │
 25: │  │  │ (Renderer)  │  │  (ChatGPT)  │  │   (Grok)    │      │    │
 26: │  │  └─────────────┘  └─────────────┘  └─────────────┘      │    │
 27: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
 28: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 29: ```
 30: 
 31: ### CDP Tool Kategorileri
 32: 
 33: | Kategori | Tool'lar | Kullanım Amacı |
 34: |----------|----------|----------------|
 35: | **Bağlantı** | `hev_check_electron_connection` | Electron çalışıyor mu kontrolü |
 36: | **İnceleme** | `get_electron_window_info`, `get_page_dom_structure`, `inspect_element`, `query_elements` | UI durumunu anlama |
 37: | **Etkileşim** | `hev_click_element_by_selector`, `click_element_by_text`, `fill_input_field`, `send_key_press`, `scroll_page` | UI ile etkileşim |
 38: | **Görüntüleme** | `hev_take_cdp_screenshot` | Görsel doğrulama |
 39: | **Kod Çalıştırma** | `send_command_to_electron` | Arbitrary JavaScript |
 40: 
 41: ### Geliştirme Workflow'ları
 42: 
 43: #### 1. Yeni Özellik Geliştirme
 44: 
 45: ```
 46: 1. npm start                              # Uygulamayı başlat
 47: 2. check_electron_connection              # Bağlantıyı doğrula
 48: 3. get_page_dom_structure --maxDepth 2    # Mevcut UI'ı anla
 49: 4. [Kod değişikliği yap]                  # Özelliği implemente et
 50: 5. send_command_to_electron --command "location.reload()"  # Sayfayı yenile
 51: 6. query_elements --selector ".new-feature"  # Yeni elementin varlığını doğrula
 52: 7. take_cdp_screenshot --savePath "./test-ss.png"  # Görsel kontrol
 53: ```
 54: 
 55: #### 2. Bug Fix Workflow
 56: 
 57: ```
 58: 1. npm start                              # Uygulamayı başlat
 59: 2. check_electron_connection              # Bağlantıyı doğrula
 60: 3. [Bug'ı tetikle - click/fill/navigate]  # Hatayı reproduce et
 61: 4. read_electron_logs --type error        # Hata loglarını oku
 62: 5. inspect_element --selector "#problem-element"  # Sorunlu elementi incele
 63: 6. [Fix'i uygula]
 64: 7. send_command_to_electron --command "location.reload()"
 65: 8. [Bug'ı tekrar tetikle]                 # Fix'i doğrula
 66: 9. take_cdp_screenshot                    # Görsel onay
 67: ```
 68: 
 69: #### 3. UI Regression Testing
 70: 
 71: ```
 72: 1. npm start
 73: 2. check_electron_connection
 74: 
 75: # Ana sayfa kontrolü
 76: 3. get_electron_window_info               # Pencere boyutları
 77: 4. query_elements --selector "button"     # Tüm butonlar yerinde mi?
 78: 5. inspect_element --selector "#menu-toggle"  # Kritik elementler
 79: 
 80: # Navigasyon testi

186: ### CDP Kullanım Best Practices
187: 
188: #### ✅ Yapılması Gerekenler
189: 
190: 1. **Her zaman önce bağlantıyı kontrol et:**
191:    ```bash
192:    check_electron_connection
193:    ```
194: 
195: 2. **Değişikliklerden önce screenshot al:**
196:    ```bash
197:    take_cdp_screenshot --savePath "./before-change.png"
198:    ```
199: 
200: 3. **Element'e tıklamadan önce varlığını doğrula:**
201:    ```bash
202:    inspect_element --selector "#my-button"
203:    # exists: true ise tıkla
204:    click_element_by_selector --selector "#my-button"
205:    ```
206: 
207: 4. **Async işlemler için bekle:**
208:    ```bash
209:    send_command_to_electron --command "new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000))"
210:    ```
211: 
212: 5. **Hata durumunda logları kontrol et:**
213:    ```bash
214:    read_electron_logs --type error --tail 20
215:    ```
216: 
217: #### ❌ Yapılmaması Gerekenler
218: 
219: 1. **Bağlantı kontrolü yapmadan komut gönderme** - Timeout hatalarına yol açar
220: 2. **Olmayan elemente tıklama** - inspect_element ile önce kontrol et
221: 3. **Sayfayı yenilemeden kod değişikliği bekleme** - Hot reload her zaman çalışmaz
222: 4. **Çok hızlı ardışık komutlar** - UI'ın render olması için zaman tanı
223: 
224: ### Troubleshooting
225: 
226: #### "Electron'a bağlanılamadı" hatası
227: ```bash
228: # 1. Electron çalışıyor mu?
229: pgrep -f electron
230: 
231: # 2. Port açık mı?
232: curl -s http://localhost:9222/json
233: 
234: # 3. Farklı port dene
235: CDP_PORT=9223 npm start
236: ```

239: ```bash

242: 
243: # 2. DOM yapısını kontrol et
244: get_page_dom_structure --maxDepth 3
245: 
246: # 3. Alternatif selector dene
247: query_elements --selector "*"  # Tüm elementleri listele
248: ```
249: 
250: #### "CDP komut zaman aşımı" hatası
251: ```bash
252: # 1. Electron yanıt veriyor mu?
253: send_command_to_electron --command "1+1"  # Basit test
254: 
255: # 2. Uygulamayı yeniden başlat
256: pkill -f electron && npm start
257: 
258: # 3. Logları kontrol et
259: read_electron_logs --type error

287: 
288: **Log Klasör Yapısı:**
289: Her uygulama oturumu `logs/` altında tarih-saat formatında bir klasör oluşturur:
290: ```
291: logs/
292: └── DD-MM-YYYY_HH-MM-SS/           # Örnek: 13-01-2026_21-55-11
293:     ├── meta.json                  # Session başlangıç bilgileri (platform, versions)
294:     ├── console-001.log            # Ana console logları (tüm process'ler)
295:     ├── structured.jsonl           # JSON formatında structured eventler
296:     ├── summary.json               # Session özeti (kapanışta oluşur)
297:     └── error.log                  # Sadece hatalar (opsiyonel, hata varsa oluşur)
298: ```
299: 
300: **Log Analizi Komutları:**
301: ```bash
302: # 1. En son log session'ını bul (tarih sırasına göre)
303: # NOT: ls -t yerine ls | sort -r kullan (tarih formatı DD-MM-YYYY_HH-MM-SS)
304: LATEST_LOG=$(ls logs/ | sort -r | head -1)
305: echo "Session: $LATEST_LOG"
306: 
307: # 2. Tüm log dosyalarını listele
308: ls -la "logs/$LATEST_LOG/"
309: 
310: # 3. Her log dosyasını incele:
311: 
312: # meta.json - Session başlangıç bilgileri
313: cat "logs/$LATEST_LOG/meta.json"
314: 
315: # console-001.log - Ana log dosyası (tüm aktiviteler)
316: cat "logs/$LATEST_LOG/console-001.log"
317: # veya son N satır:
318: tail -50 "logs/$LATEST_LOG/console-001.log"
319: 
320: # structured.jsonl - JSON formatında eventler (jq ile parse)
321: cat "logs/$LATEST_LOG/structured.jsonl"
322: # veya jq ile:
323: cat "logs/$LATEST_LOG/structured.jsonl" | head -20
324: 
325: # summary.json - Session özeti (uygulama düzgün kapandıysa)
326: cat "logs/$LATEST_LOG/summary.json"
327: 
328: # error.log - Sadece hatalar (dosya varsa)
329: cat "logs/$LATEST_LOG/error.log" 2>/dev/null || echo "Hata yok"
330: ```
331: 
332: **Kullanıcı Log Session Paylaştığında:**
333: Kullanıcı log session path'i paylaştığında (örn: `/home/raistlin/hayalet-ev/logs/13-01-2026_21-55-11/`) bu 5 dosyayı sırayla kontrol et:
334: 1. `error.log` - Önce hataları kontrol et
335: 2. `console-001.log` - Ana aktivite logları
336: 3. `structured.jsonl` - Detaylı event bilgileri
337: 4. `meta.json` - Session bilgileri
338: 5. `summary.json` - Kapanış durumu
339: 
340: **Başarılı Test Kriterleri:**
341: - ✅ `error.log` boş veya sadece uyarılar içermeli (veya dosya yok)
342: - ✅ `summary.json` → `endReason: "normal"` olmalı
343: - ✅ `structured.jsonl` → Beklenen event'ler loglanmış olmalı
344: - ✅ `console-001.log` → Kritik hata mesajı olmamalı
345: 
346: **Yaygın Log Analiz Senaryoları:**
347: ```bash
348: # Sadece hataları filtrele
349: grep -i "error\|fail\|exception" "logs/$LATEST_LOG/console-001.log"
350: 
351: # Sync işlemlerini filtrele
352: grep -i "sync\|database\|db" "logs/$LATEST_LOG/console-001.log"
353: 
354: # Belirli bir modülün loglarını filtrele
355: grep "webview\|slot" "logs/$LATEST_LOG/structured.jsonl"
356: 
357: # Import/syntax hatalarını kontrol et

380: ### Workflow Tools (Test Otomasyonu)
381: 
382: Test hazırlık süreçlerini otomatize eden predefined workflow'lar:
383: 
384: | Tool | Açıklama |
385: |------|----------|
386: | `hev_run_workflow` | Predefined workflow çalıştır |
387: | `hev_run_steps` | Custom adımlar çalıştır |
388: | `hev_list_workflows` | Mevcut workflow'ları listele |
389: 
390: **Predefined Workflows:**
391: 
392: | Workflow | Açıklama | Adımlar |
393: |----------|----------|---------|
394: | `setup_asistan` | Asistan sayfası + bağlantı | navigate → wait → click → wait |
395: | `setup_entrance` | Entrance sayfası hazır | navigate → wait |
396: | `setup_ai1_slot` | AI1 slot bağlantısı | navigate → wait → click → wait |
397: | `check_app` | Uygulama durumu kontrol | wait → screenshot → assert |
398: 
399: **Kullanım:**
400: ```bash
401: # Predefined workflow
402: hev_run_workflow workflow="setup_asistan"
403: 
404: # Custom steps
405: hev_run_steps steps='[{"action":"navigate","page":"asistan"},{"action":"click","selector":"#btn"}]'
406: ```
407: 
408: **Adım Tipleri:**
409: - `click` - Element tıkla (selector veya text)
410: - `fill` - Input doldur
411: - `wait` - Element veya süre bekle
412: - `screenshot` - Ekran görüntüsü
413: - `navigate` - Sayfa geçişi
414: - `assert` - Koşul doğrula
415: 
416: ### Chunk Tools (Büyük Dosya Oluşturma)
417: 
418: LLM response limitlerini aşmak için chunk-based dosya oluşturma araçları:
419: 
420: | Tool | Açıklama |
421: |------|----------|
422: | `hev_fs_create_chunked` | Parçaları tek seferde birleştir |
423: | `hev_fs_append_chunk` | Dosyaya streaming append |
424: 
425: **fs_create_chunked Kullanımı:**
426: ```bash
427: # Tüm parçaları bir kerede gönder
428: fs_create_chunked file_path="src/big-file.ts" chunks='["part1...", "part2...", "part3..."]'
429: ```
430: 
431: **fs_append_chunk Kullanımı (Streaming):**
432: ```bash
433: # Parça parça ekle
434: fs_append_chunk file_path="src/big-file.ts" content="// Part 1\n..." create_if_missing=true
435: fs_append_chunk file_path="src/big-file.ts" content="// Part 2\n..."
436: fs_append_chunk file_path="src/big-file.ts" content="// Part 3\n..."
437: ```
438: 
439: **Ne Zaman Kullanılmalı:**
440: - Dosya içeriği 50KB'dan büyükse
441: - create_file tool'u hata veriyorsa
442: - Uzun kod dosyaları oluştururken

448: GitHub CLI (gh) entegrasyonu ile PR workflow otomasyonu:
449: 
450: | Tool | Açıklama |
451: |------|----------|
452: | `hev_git_fork_setup` | Repo fork et, clone et, branch oluştur |
453: | `hev_git_create_pr` | Commit et, push et, PR oluştur |
454: | `hev_git_check_guidelines` | CONTRIBUTING.md, DCO, PR template kontrolü |
455: | `hev_git_pr_status` | Git durumu ve açık PR'ları göster |

459: - GitHub'a giriş yapılmış olmalı: `gh auth login`
460: 
461: **Tam PR Workflow Örneği:**
462: ```bash
463: # 1. Fork ve branch hazırla

466: # 2. Değişiklik yap (hev_fs_find_and_replace, hev_fs_create_file vb.)
467: 
468: # 3. Guidelines kontrol et
469: hev_git_check_guidelines cwd="~/projects/repo"
470: 
471: # 4. PR oluştur
472: hev_git_create_pr base_branch="main" title="Fix: Bug #123" body="Bu PR şunu düzeltiyor..." cwd="~/projects/repo"
473: ```
474:

476: - ✅ Idempotent - Tekrar çalıştırılabilir

478: - ✅ Mevcut PR kontrolü (duplicate önleme)
479: - ✅ Shallow clone desteği (hızlı)

  1: # Hayalet-ev Log Sistemi Rehberi
  2: 
  3: Bu rehber, AI agent'ların Hayalet-ev projesinde log eklemesi ve test süreçlerinde log analizi yapması için gerekli talimatları içerir.
  4: 
  5: ---
  6: 
  7: ## 🚨 KRİTİK: Log Dosyalarını Okuma
  8: 
  9: **`structured.jsonl` dosyası asıl logların bulunduğu dosyadır!**
 10: 
 11: ```bash
 12: # ✅ DOĞRU - Detaylı loglar (visibility, correlationId, context dahil)
 13: cat logs/SESSION_ID/structured.jsonl | tail -50
 14: 
 15: # veya MCP tool ile:
 16: read_electron_logs --type structured --tail 100
 17: 
 18: # ⚠️ EKSIK - Sadece main process console çıktıları
 19: cat logs/SESSION_ID/console-001.log
 20: ```
 21: 
 22: | Dosya | İçerik | Kullanım |
 23: |-------|--------|----------|
 24: | `structured.jsonl` | **TÜM loglar** (JSON format, visibility dahil) | ✅ Ana analiz dosyası |
 25: | `console-001.log` | Main process console çıktıları | Debug için |
 26: | `error.log` | Sadece error/warning logları | Hızlı hata kontrolü |
 27: | `summary.json` | Session özeti | Genel durum |
 28: 
 29: ---
 30: 
 31: ## 🎯 3 Seviyeli Visibility Sistemi
 32: 
 33: Loglar 3 seviyede kategorize edilir:
 34: 
 35: | Seviye | Ad | Görünüm | Kullanım |
 36: |--------|-----|---------|----------|
 37: | **1** | Toast | Toast + Panel + Modal | Kullanıcı bildirimleri (bağlantı, hata, başarı) |
 38: | **2** | Panel | Panel + Modal | Süreç durumu (init, db, sync) |
 39: | **3** | Verbose | Sadece Modal | Debug (state, traffic, probe) |
 40: 
 41: ### Visibility Kullanımı
 42: 
 43: ```typescript
 44: // Yeni API (tercih edilen)
 45: LogManager.toast("entrance", "success", "AI1 bağlandı");     // Seviye 1
 46: LogManager.panel("system", "info", "Uygulama başlatıldı");    // Seviye 2
 47: LogManager.verbose("traffic", "debug", "Probe completed");  // Seviye 3
 48: 
 49: // Manuel visibility
 50: LogManager.addEvent("source", "info", "mesaj", { visibility: 1 });
 51: ```
 52: 
 53: ### Otomatik Visibility (_inferVisibility)
 54: 
 55: Visibility belirtilmezse otomatik belirlenir:
 56: 
 57: **Seviye 1 (Toast):**
 58: - `type: "success"` → Her zaman toast
 59: - `type: "error"` + kaynak: entrance, asistan, server, analyze, whisper
 60: 
 61: **Seviye 2 (Panel):**
 62: - Kaynaklar: system, slot-controller, relay, core, db, sync, lifecycle
 63: - `type: "warning"` → Her zaman panel
 64: 
 65: **Seviye 3 (Verbose):**
 66: - `type: "debug"` → Her zaman verbose
 67: - Kaynaklar: traffic, probe, state-machine, slot-ai*, renderer, toast, modal
 68: - **Default** → Bilinmeyen kaynaklar verbose
 69: 
 70: ---
 71: 
 72: ## ⚠️ ZORUNLU: console.log Kullanma!
 73: 
 74: Renderer process'te (`src/js/`) **kesinlikle** `console.log`, `console.error`, `console.warn` kullanma. Bunun yerine `LogManager` kullan.
 75: 
 76: ```typescript
 77: // ❌ YANLIŞ - Kullanma!
 78: console.log("Mesaj gönderildi");
 79: console.error("Hata oluştu:", error);
 80: 
 81: // ✅ DOĞRU - LogManager kullan
 82: import { LogManager } from "./modules/log-manager.ts";
 83: 
 84: LogManager.addEvent("webview", "info", "Mesaj gönderildi");
 85: LogManager.addEvent("webview", "error", `Hata oluştu: ${error.message}`);
 86: 
 87: // ✅ DAHA İYİ - Visibility ile
 88: LogManager.toast("entrance", "success", "Bağlandı");  // Kullanıcıya göster
 89: LogManager.panel("db", "info", "Database açıldı");     // Panel'de göster
 90: LogManager.verbose("traffic", "debug", "State changed"); // Sadece debug
 91: ```
 92: 
 93: ### İstisna: executeJavaScript İçi
 94: 
 95: Webview'da `executeJavaScript` ile çalıştırılan kodlar **istisnadır** - orada LogManager erişilemez:
 96: 
 97: ```javascript
 98: // Bu kabul edilebilir - webview context'inde çalışıyor
 99: webview.executeJavaScript(`
100:   try {
101:     // kod...
102:   } catch (e) {
103:     console.error('[Hayalet-Inject] Failed:', e);  // ✅ Kabul edilir
104:   }
105: `);
106: ```
107: 
108: ---
109: 
110: ## 📝 LogManager API
111: 
112: ### Import
113: 
114: ```typescript
115: import { LogManager } from "./modules/log-manager.ts";
116: ```
117: 
118: ### Metodlar
119: 
120: | Metod | Visibility | Kullanım |
121: |-------|------------|----------|
122: | `toast(source, type, message, meta?)` | 1 | Kullanıcı bildirimleri |
123: | `panel(source, type, message, meta?)` | 2 | Süreç durumu |
124: | `verbose(source, type, message, meta?)` | 3 | Debug |
125: | `addEvent(source, type, message, meta?)` | Otomatik | Genel kullanım |
126: 
127: ### Parametreler
128: 
129: | Parametre | Tip | Açıklama | Örnekler |
130: |-----------|-----|----------|----------|
131: | `source` | string | Log kaynağı/modülü | `"entrance"`, `"slot-controller"`, `"traffic"` |
132: | `type` | string | Log tipi | `"info"`, `"success"`, `"warning"`, `"error"`, `"debug"` |
133: | `message` | string | Log mesajı | `"Bağlantı başarılı"` |
134: | `meta` | object | Ek bilgiler | `{ visibility: 1, correlationId: "...", context: {...} }` |
135: 
136: ### Log Tipleri
137: 
138: | Tip | Kullanım | Default Visibility |
139: |-----|----------|--------------------|
140: | `success` | İşlem başarılı | 1 (Toast) |
141: | `error` | Kritik hata | 1 veya 2 (kaynağa göre) |
142: | `warning` | Uyarı | 2 (Panel) |
143: | `info` | Genel bilgi | 2 veya 3 (kaynağa göre) |
144: | `debug` | Debug detayı | 3 (Verbose) |
145:

155: 
156: // Hata

159: });
160: ```

163:

168: });
169: 
170: // Tamamlandı
171: LogManager.addEvent("file-upload", "info", `Upload tamamlandı: ${count} başarılı, ${errors} hata`);
172: 
173: // Hata
174: LogManager.addEvent("file-upload", "error", `Upload hatası: ${err.message}`);
175: ```

179: ```javascript

184:

187:   context: { provider, action: "click" } 
188: });
189: 
190: // Genel hata

================
File: electron/database/hash-utils.ts
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Hash Utils - Mesaj içerik hash'i oluşturma
 3:  *
 4:  * Incremental sync için content hash karşılaştırması yapılır.
 5:  * djb2 algoritması kullanılır - hızlı ve collision oranı düşük.
 6:  */
 7: 
 8: /**
 9:  * Text normalization - hash tutarlılığı için
10:  * Whitespace normalize, line ending fix, trim
11:  */
12: export function normalizeText(str: string | null | undefined): string {
13:   if (!str) return "";
14:   return str
15:     .replace(/\r\n/g, "\n")           // Windows line endings → Unix
16:     .replace(/\r/g, "\n")             // Old Mac line endings → Unix
17:     .replace(/[\t ]+/g, " ")          // Multiple spaces/tabs → single space
18:     .replace(/ *\n */g, "\n")         // Spaces around newlines → just newline
19:     .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")       // 3+ newlines → 2 newlines
20:     .trim();                          // Leading/trailing whitespace
21: }
22: 
23: /**
24:  * String'den hash oluştur (djb2 algoritması)
25:  * Text normalize edildikten sonra hash hesaplanır
26:  */
27: export function hashString(str: string | null | undefined): string {
28:   if (!str) return "0";
29: 
30:   // Normalize before hashing for consistency
31:   const normalized = normalizeText(str);
32:   if (!normalized) return "0";
33: 
34:   let hash = 5381;
35:   for (let i = 0; i < normalized.length; i++) {
36:     hash = (hash << 5) + hash + normalized.charCodeAt(i);
37:     hash = hash >>> 0; // Convert to unsigned 32-bit
38:   }
39:   return hash.toString(16);
40: }
41: 
42: /**
43:  * Mesaj için benzersiz ID oluştur
44:  */
45: export function generateId(prefix: string = "id"): string {
46:   const timestamp = Date.now();
47:   const random = Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 10);
48:   return `${prefix}-${timestamp}-${random}`;
49: }
50: 
51: /**
52:  * Message ID oluştur
53:  */
54: export function generateMessageId(): string {
55:   return generateId("msg");
56: }
57: 
58: /**
59:  * Attachment ID oluştur
60:  */
61: export function generateAttachmentId(): string {
62:   return generateId("att");
63: }

================
File: electron/database/schema.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Database Schema - Tablo şemaları ve migration
  3:  *
  4:  * Her hesap için ayrı SQLite dosyası:
  5:  * data/{accountId}/database.db
  6:  *
  7:  * Tablolar:
  8:  * - conversations: Konuşma metadata'sı
  9:  * - messages: Mesajlar
 10:  * - attachments: Ek dosya referansları
 11:  * - messages_fts: Full-text search (FTS5)
 12:  */
 13: 
 14: import type Database from "better-sqlite3";
 15: 
 16: // Schema versiyonu - migration için
 17: const SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;
 18: 
 19: /**
 20:  * Tablo oluşturma SQL'leri
 21:  */
 22: const CREATE_TABLES_SQL = `
 23: -- Conversations tablosu
 24: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (
 25:   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 26:   web_url TEXT NOT NULL,
 27:   title TEXT DEFAULT '',
 28:   summary TEXT DEFAULT '',
 29:   message_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
 30:   last_message_id TEXT,
 31:   created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 32:   updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
 33: );
 34: 
 35: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_web_url ON conversations(web_url);
 36: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_updated ON conversations(updated_at DESC);
 37: 
 38: -- Messages tablosu
 39: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
 40:   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 41:   conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 42:   role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('user', 'assistant')),
 43:   author TEXT,
 44:   content TEXT NOT NULL,
 45:   dom_index INTEGER,
 46:   dom_id TEXT,
 47:   content_hash TEXT,
 48:   created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 49:   FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
 50: );
 51: 
 52: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_conversation ON messages(conversation_id);
 53: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_hash ON messages(content_hash);
 54: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_dom_id ON messages(dom_id);
 55: 
 56: -- Attachments tablosu
 57: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attachments (
 58:   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 59:   message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 60:   conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 61:   original_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 62:   stored_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 63:   stored_path TEXT NOT NULL,
 64:   mime_type TEXT,
 65:   size INTEGER,
 66:   created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 67:   FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 68:   FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
 69: );
 70: 
 71: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attachments_message ON attachments(message_id);
 72: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attachments_conversation ON attachments(conversation_id);
 73: 
 74: -- Schema version tablosu
 75: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (
 76:   version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 77:   applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL
 78: );
 79: `;
 80: 
 81: /**
 82:  * FTS5 Full-Text Search tablosu
 83:  */
 84: const CREATE_FTS_SQL = `
 85: -- FTS5 virtual table for message search
 86: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages_fts USING fts5(
 87:   content,
 88:   author,
 89:   content='messages',
 90:   content_rowid='rowid',
 91:   tokenize='unicode61'
 92: );
 93: 
 94: -- Triggers to keep FTS in sync
 95: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS messages_ai AFTER INSERT ON messages BEGIN
 96:   INSERT INTO messages_fts(rowid, content, author) VALUES (NEW.rowid, NEW.content, NEW.author);
 97: END;
 98: 
 99: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS messages_ad AFTER DELETE ON messages BEGIN
100:   INSERT INTO messages_fts(messages_fts, rowid, content, author) VALUES('delete', OLD.rowid, OLD.content, OLD.author);
101: END;
102: 
103: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS messages_au AFTER UPDATE ON messages BEGIN
104:   INSERT INTO messages_fts(messages_fts, rowid, content, author) VALUES('delete', OLD.rowid, OLD.content, OLD.author);
105:   INSERT INTO messages_fts(rowid, content, author) VALUES (NEW.rowid, NEW.content, NEW.author);
106: END;
107: `;
108: 
109: /**
110:  * Schema'yı veritabanına uygula
111:  */
112: export function applySchema(db: Database.Database): void {
113:   // Ana tabloları oluştur
114:   db.exec(CREATE_TABLES_SQL);
115:   
116:   // FTS5 tablosunu oluştur
117:   try {
118:     db.exec(CREATE_FTS_SQL);
119:   } catch (err: unknown) {
120:     // FTS5 desteklenmiyorsa devam et (bazı sistemlerde olmayabilir)
121:     console.warn("[DB] FTS5 oluşturulamadı (desteklenmiyor olabilir):", (err as Error).message);
122:   }
123:   
124:   // Schema version kaydet
125:   const versionExists = db.prepare(
126:     "SELECT version FROM schema_version WHERE version = ?"
127:   ).get(SCHEMA_VERSION);
128:   
129:   if (!versionExists) {
130:     db.prepare(
131:       "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO schema_version (version, applied_at) VALUES (?, ?)"
132:     ).run(SCHEMA_VERSION, Date.now());
133:   }
134: }

44:   // Open terminal in specified directory
45:   registerHandler("open-terminal", async (_event, targetPath: string) => {
46:     const os = platform();
47:     let command: string;
48:     let args: string[];
49: 
50:     if (os === "darwin") {
51:       // macOS
52:       command = "open";
53:       args = ["-a", "Terminal", targetPath];
54:     } else if (os === "win32") {
55:       // Windows
56:       command = "cmd";
57:       args = ["/c", "start", "cmd", "/K", `cd /d "${targetPath}"`];
58:     } else {
59:       // Linux - use gnome-terminal or fallback
60:       command = "gnome-terminal";
61:       args = ["--working-directory=" + targetPath];
62:     }
63: 
64:     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
65:       const proc = spawn(command, args, {
66:         detached: true,
67:         stdio: "ignore",
68:         shell: os === "win32",
69:       });
70:       proc.unref();
71:       proc.on("error", reject);
72:       setTimeout(() => resolve({ success: true }), 100);
73:     });
74:   });
75: 
76:   // Open path in file manager
77:   registerHandler("shell-open-path", async (_event, path: string) => {
78:     return shell.openPath(path);
79:   });
80: }

================
File: electron/logger/log-reader.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * LogReader - Log okuma ve sorgulama işlemleri
  3:  *
  4:  * Bu modül log dosyalarını okuma ve sorgulama işlemlerini yönetir:
  5:  * - Console logları okuma
  6:  * - Error logları okuma
  7:  * - Tüm logları okuma (session bazlı)
  8:  * - Log sorgulama (filtre)
  9:  */
 10: 
 11: import { readFile, readdir } from "fs/promises";
 12: import { join } from "path";
 13: import { existsSync } from "fs";
 14: import { getSessionDir, getLogDir, getSessionId } from "./session-manager.ts";
 15: import { getErrorLogPath } from "./log-writer.ts";
 16: import type { LogQueryParams, SessionMeta, SessionSummary, StructuredLogEntry } from "../types/index.ts";
 17: 
 18: /**
 19:  * Console loglarını oku
 20:  */
 21: export async function readConsoleLogs(tail: number = 100): Promise<string> {
 22:   try {
 23:     const sessionDir = getSessionDir();
 24:     if (!sessionDir || !existsSync(sessionDir)) {
 25:       return "No session logs found";
 26:     }
 27:     
 28:     const files = await readdir(sessionDir);
 29:     const consoleFiles = files
 30:       .filter(f => f.startsWith("console-") && f.endsWith(".log"))
 31:       .sort();
 32:     
 33:     let allLines: string[] = [];
 34:     for (const file of consoleFiles) {
 35:       const content = await readFile(join(sessionDir, file), "utf-8");
 36:       allLines = allLines.concat(content.split("\n").filter(l => l.trim()));
 37:     }
 38:     
 39:     return allLines.slice(-tail).join("\n");
 40:   } catch (err: unknown) {
 41:     return `Failed to read logs: ${(err as Error).message}`;
 42:   }
 43: }
 44: 
 45: /**
 46:  * Error loglarını oku
 47:  */
 48: export async function readErrorLogs(tail: number = 100): Promise<string> {
 49:   try {
 50:     const errorLog = getErrorLogPath();
 51:     if (!errorLog || !existsSync(errorLog)) {
 52:       return "No error logs found";
 53:     }
 54:     
 55:     const content = await readFile(errorLog, "utf-8");
 56:     const lines = content.split("\n").filter(l => l.trim());
 57:     return lines.slice(-tail).join("\n");
 58:   } catch (err: unknown) {
 59:     return `Failed to read error logs: ${(err as Error).message}`;
 60:   }
 61: }
 62: 
 63: interface AllLogsResult {
 64:   sessionId: string | null;
 65:   console: string;
 66:   error: string;
 67:   structured: StructuredLogEntry[];
 68:   meta: SessionMeta | null;
 69:   summary: SessionSummary | null;
 70: }
 71: 
 72: /**
 73:  * Tüm logları oku (session bazlı)
 74:  */
 75: export async function readAllLogs(targetSessionId: string | null = null): Promise<AllLogsResult> {
 76:   const logDir = getLogDir();
 77:   const sessionId = targetSessionId || getSessionId();
 78:   const sessionDir = targetSessionId
 79:     ? join(logDir!, targetSessionId)
 80:     : getSessionDir();
 81: 
 82:   const result: AllLogsResult = {
 83:     sessionId,
 84:     console: "",
 85:     error: "",
 86:     structured: [],
 87:     meta: null,
 88:     summary: null,
 89:   };
 90:   
 91:   try {
 92:     if (!sessionDir || !existsSync(sessionDir)) {
 93:       return { ...result, error: "Session not found" };
 94:     }
 95:     
 96:     const files = await readdir(sessionDir);
 97:     const consoleFiles = files
 98:       .filter(f => f.startsWith("console-") && f.endsWith(".log"))
 99:       .sort();
100:     
101:     for (const file of consoleFiles) {
102:       result.console += await readFile(join(sessionDir, file), "utf-8");
103:     }
104:     
105:     const errorPath = join(sessionDir, "error.log");
106:     if (existsSync(errorPath)) {
107:       result.error = await readFile(errorPath, "utf-8");
108:     }
109:     
110:     const structuredPath = join(sessionDir, "structured.jsonl");
111:     if (existsSync(structuredPath)) {
112:       const content = await readFile(structuredPath, "utf-8");
113:       result.structured = content
114:         .split("\n")
115:         .filter(l => l.trim())
116:         .map(l => {
117:           try {
118:             return JSON.parse(l);
119:           } catch {
120:             return null;
121:           }
122:         })
123:         .filter(Boolean);
124:     }
125:     
126:     const metaPath = join(sessionDir, "meta.json");
127:     if (existsSync(metaPath)) {
128:       result.meta = JSON.parse(await readFile(metaPath, "utf-8"));
129:     }
130:     
131:     const summaryPath = join(sessionDir, "summary.json");
132:     if (existsSync(summaryPath)) {
133:       result.summary = JSON.parse(await readFile(summaryPath, "utf-8"));
134:     }
135:   } catch (err: unknown) {
136:     result.error = `Failed to read logs: ${(err as Error).message}`;
137:   }
138:   
139:   return result;
140: }
141: 
142: /**
143:  * Logları sorgula
144:  */
145: export async function queryLogs(query: LogQueryParams = {}): Promise<string[]> {
146:   const {
147:     type = "all",
148:     source = null,
149:     contains = null,
150:     level = null,
151:     since = null,
152:     tail = 100,
153:     sessionId = null,
154:   } = query;
155:   
156:   try {
157:     const logs = await readAllLogs(sessionId);
158:     let lines: string[] = [];
159:     
160:     if (type === "console" || type === "all") {
161:       lines = lines.concat(logs.console.split("\n"));
162:     }
163:     if (type === "error" || type === "all") {
164:       lines = lines.concat(logs.error.split("\n"));
165:     }
166:     
167:     let filtered = lines.filter(l => l.trim());
168:     
169:     if (source) {
170:       const sourcePattern = source.replace(/\*/g, ".*");
171:       const sourceRegex = new RegExp(`\\[${sourcePattern}\\]`, "i");
172:       filtered = filtered.filter(l => sourceRegex.test(l));
173:     }
174:     
175:     if (contains) {
176:       const containsLower = contains.toLowerCase();
177:       filtered = filtered.filter(l => l.toLowerCase().includes(containsLower));
178:     }
179:     
180:     if (level) {
181:       filtered = filtered.filter(l => l.includes(`[${level}]`));
182:     }
183:     
184:     if (since) {
185:       const sinceDate = new Date(since);
186:       filtered = filtered.filter(l => {
187:         const match = l.match(/^\[(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T[\d:.]+Z?)\]/);
188:         if (match) {
189:           return new Date(match[1]) >= sinceDate;
190:         }
191:         return true;
192:       });
193:     }
194:     
195:     return filtered.slice(-tail);
196:   } catch (err: unknown) {
197:     return [`Query error: ${(err as Error).message}`];
198:   }
199: }
200: 
201: /**
202:  * Log istatistiklerini hesapla (session summary için)
203:  */
204: export async function calculateLogStats(): Promise<{
205:   totalLogs: number;
206:   errorCount: number;
207:   warnCount: number;
208: }> {
209:   let totalLogs = 0;
210:   let errorCount = 0;
211:   let warnCount = 0;
212:   
213:   try {
214:     const sessionDir = getSessionDir();
215:     if (!sessionDir || !existsSync(sessionDir)) {
216:       return { totalLogs, errorCount, warnCount };
217:     }
218:     
219:     const errorPath = join(sessionDir, "error.log");
220:     if (existsSync(errorPath)) {
221:       const errorContent = await readFile(errorPath, "utf-8");
222:       const errorLines = errorContent.split("\n").filter(l => l.trim());
223:       errorCount = errorLines.filter(l => l.includes("[ERROR]")).length;
224:       warnCount = errorLines.filter(l => l.includes("[WARN]")).length;
225:     }
226:     
227:     const files = await readdir(sessionDir);
228:     for (const file of files) {
229:       if (file.startsWith("console-") && file.endsWith(".log")) {
230:         const content = await readFile(join(sessionDir, file), "utf-8");
231:         totalLogs += content.split("\n").filter(l => l.trim()).length;
232:       }
233:     }
234:   } catch (_err) {
235:   }
236:   
237:   return { totalLogs, errorCount, warnCount };
238: }

  1: /**

 14: import type { LogLevel, LogSource, LogContext, StructuredLogEntry } from "../types/index.ts";
 15: 
 16: let currentChunkIndex = 1;
 17: let currentChunkLines = 0;
 18: const MAX_CHUNK_LINES = 10000;
 19: 
 20: let CONSOLE_LOG: string | null = null;
 21: let ERROR_LOG: string | null = null;
 22: let STRUCTURED_LOG: string | null = null;

 24: /**
 25:  * Log dosya yollarını güncelle
 26:  */
 27: export function updateLogPaths(): void {

 29:   if (!sessionDir) return;
 30:   
 31:   CONSOLE_LOG = join(sessionDir, `console-${String(currentChunkIndex).padStart(3, "0")}.log`);
 32:   ERROR_LOG = join(sessionDir, "error.log");

 35: 
 36: /**
 37:  * Log mesajını formatla
 38:  */
 39: export function formatLog(
 40:   level: LogLevel | string,
 41:   source: LogSource | string,
 42:   args: unknown[],
 43:   context: LogContext | null = null
 44: ): string {
 45:   const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
 46:   const message = args
 47:     .map((arg) => {
 48:       if (typeof arg === "object") {
 49:         try {
 50:           return JSON.stringify(arg, null, 2);
 51:         } catch {
 52:           return String(arg);
 53:         }
 54:       }
 55:       return String(arg);
 56:     })
 57:     .join(" ");
 58: 
 59:   let logLine = `[${timestamp}] [${level}] [${source}]`;
 60:   
 61:   if (context?.correlationId) {
 62:     logLine += ` [${context.correlationId}]`;
 63:   }
 64:   
 65:   logLine += ` ${message}`;
 66:   
 67:   if (context && Object.keys(context).length > 0) {
 68:     const ctxWithoutCorrelation = { ...context };
 69:     delete ctxWithoutCorrelation.correlationId;
 70:     if (Object.keys(ctxWithoutCorrelation).length > 0) {
 71:       logLine += ` | ctx: ${JSON.stringify(ctxWithoutCorrelation)}`;
 72:     }
 73:   }
 74:   
 75:   return logLine + "\n";
 76: }
 77: 
 78: /**
 79:  * Log dosyasına yaz (chunk rotation ile)
 80:  */
 81: export async function writeLog(
 82:   level: LogLevel | string,
 83:   source: LogSource | string,
 84:   args: unknown[],
 85:   context: LogContext | null = null,
 86:   isError: boolean = false
 87: ): Promise<void> {
 88:   try {
 89:     await ensureSessionDir();
 90:     updateLogPaths();
 91:     
 92:     const logMessage = formatLog(level, source, args, context);
 93:     
 94:     if (CONSOLE_LOG) {
 95:       await appendFile(CONSOLE_LOG, logMessage);
 96:       
 97:       currentChunkLines++;
 98:       if (currentChunkLines >= MAX_CHUNK_LINES) {
 99:         currentChunkIndex++;
100:         currentChunkLines = 0;
101:         updateLogPaths();
102:       }
103:     }
104:     
105:     if (isError && ERROR_LOG) {
106:       await appendFile(ERROR_LOG, logMessage);
107:     }
108:   } catch (_err) {
109:   }
110: }
111: 
112: /**
113:  * Sadece error log'a yaz
114:  */
115: export async function writeErrorLog(
116:   level: LogLevel | string,
117:   source: LogSource | string,
118:   args: unknown[],
119:   context: LogContext | null = null
120: ): Promise<void> {
121:   try {
122:     await ensureSessionDir();
123:     updateLogPaths();
124:     
125:     if (!ERROR_LOG) return;
126:     
127:     const logMessage = formatLog(level, source, args, context);
128:     await appendFile(ERROR_LOG, logMessage);
129:   } catch (_err) {
130:   }
131: }
132: 
133: /**
134:  * Structured log yaz (JSONL format + console log'a da yaz)
135:  */
136: export async function writeStructuredLog(entry: StructuredLogEntry): Promise<void> {
137:   try {
138:     await ensureSessionDir();
139:     updateLogPaths();
140:     
141:     if (!STRUCTURED_LOG) return;
142:     
143:     // JSONL dosyasına yaz (detaylı analiz için)
144:     await appendFile(STRUCTURED_LOG, JSON.stringify(entry) + "\n");
145:     
146:     // Console log'a da okunabilir formatta yaz (birleşik log)
147:     if (CONSOLE_LOG) {
148:       const visibility = entry.visibility ? `[L${entry.visibility}]` : "";
149:       const source = entry.source || "unknown";
150:       const type = entry.type || "info";
151:       const message = entry.message || "";
152:       const timestamp = entry.isoTimestamp || new Date().toISOString();
153:       
154:       let logLine = `[${timestamp}] [${type.toUpperCase()}] ${visibility} [RENDERER] [${source}] ${message}`;
155:       
156:       if (entry.meta && Object.keys(entry.meta).length > 0) {
157:         logLine += ` | meta: ${JSON.stringify(entry.meta)}`;
158:       }
159:       
160:       await appendFile(CONSOLE_LOG, logLine + "\n");
161:       
162:       currentChunkLines++;
163:       if (currentChunkLines >= MAX_CHUNK_LINES) {
164:         currentChunkIndex++;
165:         currentChunkLines = 0;
166:         updateLogPaths();
167:       }
168:     }
169:   } catch (_err) {
170:   }
171: }
172: 
173: /**
174:  * State snapshot yaz
175:  */
176: export async function writeStateSnapshot(): Promise<void> {
177:   try {
178:     await ensureSessionDir();
179:     const sessionDir = getSessionDir();
180:     if (!sessionDir) return;
181:     
182:     const snapshot = {
183:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
184:       state: getAppState(),
185:       memory: process.memoryUsage(),
186:     };
187:     
188:     const snapshotPath = join(sessionDir, "state-snapshots.jsonl");
189:     await appendFile(snapshotPath, JSON.stringify(snapshot) + "\n");
190:   } catch (_err) {
191:   }
192: }
193: 
194: // ============================================
195: // Getters
196: // ============================================

199:   return CONSOLE_LOG;
200: }
201: 
202: export function getErrorLogPath(): string | null {
203:   return ERROR_LOG;
204: }
205: 
206: export function getStructuredLogPath(): string | null {
207:   return STRUCTURED_LOG;
208: }
209: 
210: export function getCurrentChunkIndex(): number {
211:   return currentChunkIndex;
212: }

================
File: electron/logger/session-manager.ts

  1: /**
  2:  * SessionManager - Log session yönetimi
  3:  *
  4:  * Bu modül log session'larını yönetir:
  5:  * - Session ID oluşturma
  6:  * - Session dizini oluşturma
  7:  * - Session meta ve summary yazma
  8:  * - Session listeleme
  9:  */
 10: 
 11: import { mkdir, writeFile, readFile, readdir, rm } from "fs/promises";
 12: import { join } from "path";
 13: import { existsSync } from "fs";
 14: import type { AppState, SessionMeta, SessionSummary, SessionListItem } from "../types/index.ts";
 15: 
 16: let LOG_DIR: string | null = null;
 17: let SESSION_ID: string | null = null;
 18: let SESSION_DIR: string | null = null;
 19: 
 20: let appStateSnapshot: AppState = {};
 21: 
 22: /**
 23:  * Session ID oluştur (LogManager ile aynı format)
 24:  */
 25: export function generateSessionId(): string {
 26:   const now = new Date();
 27:   const pad = (n: number) => n.toString().padStart(2, "0");
 28:   const day = pad(now.getDate());
 29:   const month = pad(now.getMonth() + 1);
 30:   const year = now.getFullYear();
 31:   const hours = pad(now.getHours());
 32:   const minutes = pad(now.getMinutes());
 33:   const seconds = pad(now.getSeconds());
 34:   return `${day}-${month}-${year}_${hours}-${minutes}-${seconds}`;
 35: }
 36: 
 37: /**
 38:  * Log sistemini başlat
 39:  */
 40: export function initLogSystem(
 41:   sessionId: string | null = null
 42: ): { sessionId: string; logDir: string; sessionDir: string } {
 43:   LOG_DIR = join(process.cwd(), "logs");
 44:   SESSION_ID = sessionId || generateSessionId();
 45:   SESSION_DIR = join(LOG_DIR, SESSION_ID);
 46: 
 47:   return { sessionId: SESSION_ID, logDir: LOG_DIR, sessionDir: SESSION_DIR };
 48: }
 49: 
 50: /**
 51:  * Session dizinini ve meta dosyasını oluştur
 52:  */
 53: export async function ensureSessionDir(): Promise<void> {
 54:   if (!SESSION_DIR) initLogSystem();
 55: 
 56:   if (!existsSync(SESSION_DIR!)) {
 57:     await mkdir(SESSION_DIR!, { recursive: true });
 58: 
 59:     const meta: SessionMeta = {
 60:       sessionId: SESSION_ID!,
 61:       startTime: new Date().toISOString(),
 62:       platform: process.platform,
 63:       nodeVersion: process.version,
 64:       electronVersion: process.versions?.electron || "unknown",
 65:       appVersion: process.env.npm_package_version || "unknown",
 66:     };
 67:     
 68:     await writeFile(
 69:       join(SESSION_DIR!, "meta.json"),
 70:       JSON.stringify(meta, null, 2)
 71:     );
 72:   }
 73: }
 74: 
 75: /**
 76:  * Session özeti yaz (uygulama kapanırken çağrılır)
 77:  */
 78: export async function writeSessionSummary(
 79:   totalLogs: number,
 80:   errorCount: number,
 81:   warnCount: number,
 82:   chunkIndex: number,
 83:   endReason: string = "normal"
 84: ): Promise<void> {
 85:   try {
 86:     await ensureSessionDir();
 87: 
 88:     const summary: SessionSummary = {
 89:       sessionId: SESSION_ID!,
 90:       startTime: (appStateSnapshot.startTime as string) || new Date().toISOString(),
 91:       endTime: new Date().toISOString(),
 92:       endReason: endReason as SessionSummary["endReason"],
 93:       stats: {
 94:         totalLogs,
 95:         errors: errorCount,
 96:         warnings: warnCount,
 97:         chunks: chunkIndex,
 98:       },
 99:       lastState: appStateSnapshot,
100:     };
101: 
102:     await writeFile(
103:       join(SESSION_DIR!, "summary.json"),
104:       JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)
105:     );
106:   } catch (_err) {
107:     // Ignore errors
108:   }
109: }
110: 
111: /**
112:  * Mevcut session'ları listele
113:  */
114: export async function listSessions(): Promise<SessionListItem[]> {
115:   try {
116:     if (!LOG_DIR) initLogSystem();
117:     if (!LOG_DIR || !existsSync(LOG_DIR)) return [];
118:     
119:     const entries = await readdir(LOG_DIR, { withFileTypes: true });
120:     const sessions = [];
121:     
122:     for (const entry of entries) {
123:       if (entry.isDirectory()) {
124:         const metaPath = join(LOG_DIR!, entry.name, "meta.json");
125:         const summaryPath = join(LOG_DIR!, entry.name, "summary.json");
126:         
127:         let meta = null;
128:         let summary = null;
129:         
130:         try {
131:           if (existsSync(metaPath)) {
132:             meta = JSON.parse(await readFile(metaPath, "utf-8"));
133:           }
134:           if (existsSync(summaryPath)) {
135:             summary = JSON.parse(await readFile(summaryPath, "utf-8"));
136:           }
137:         } catch {
138:         }
139:         
140:         sessions.push({
141:           sessionId: entry.name,
142:           startTime: meta?.startTime || null,
143:           endTime: summary?.endTime || null,
144:           endReason: summary?.endReason || (entry.name === SESSION_ID ? "active" : "unknown"),
145:           stats: summary?.stats || null,
146:         });
147:       }
148:     }
149:     
150:     sessions.sort((a, b) => {
151:       if (!a.startTime) return 1;
152:       if (!b.startTime) return -1;
153:       return new Date(b.startTime).getTime() - new Date(a.startTime).getTime();
154:     });
155:     
156:     return sessions;
157:   } catch (_err) {
158:     return [];
159:   }
160: }
161: 
162: /**
163:  * Log dosyalarını temizle
164:  */
165: export async function clearLogs(targetSessionId: string | null = null): Promise<void> {
166:   try {
167:     const sessionDir = targetSessionId 
168:       ? (LOG_DIR ? join(LOG_DIR, targetSessionId) : null)
169:       : SESSION_DIR;
170:     
171:     if (sessionDir && existsSync(sessionDir)) {
172:       await rm(sessionDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
173:     }
174:   } catch (err) {
175:     console.error("Failed to clear logs:", err);
176:   }
177: }
178: 
179: // ============================================
180: // ============================================
181: 
182: /**
183:  * Uygulama durumunu güncelle
184:  */
185: export function updateAppState(state: Partial<AppState>): void {
186:   appStateSnapshot = {
187:     ...appStateSnapshot,
188:     ...state,
189:     lastUpdate: new Date().toISOString(),
190:   };
191: }
192: 
193: /**
194:  * Son state snapshot'ı al
195:  */
196: export function getAppState(): AppState {
197:   return { ...appStateSnapshot };
198: }
199: 
200: // ============================================
201: // Getters
202: // ============================================
203: 
204: export function getSessionId(): string | null {
205:   return SESSION_ID;
206: }
207: 
208: export function getSessionDir(): string | null {
209:   return SESSION_DIR;
210: }
211: 
212: export function getLogDir(): string | null {
213:   return LOG_DIR;
214: }
215: 
216: export { SESSION_ID, SESSION_DIR, LOG_DIR };

 77: /**
 78:  * Erken loglar - UI hazır olmadan önce oluşan loglar
 79:  * Renderer hazır olduğunda bu loglar IPC ile gönderilir
 80:  */
 81: interface EarlyLog {
 82:   level: string;
 83:   source: string;
 84:   message: string;
 85:   timestamp: string;
 86:   visibility: 1 | 2 | 3;
 87: }
 88: 
 89: const earlyLogs: EarlyLog[] = [];
 90: const MAX_EARLY_LOGS = 100;
 91: 
 92: /**
 93:  * Log visibility seviyesini belirle
 94:  * 1 = toast (error, warning)
 95:  * 2 = panel (info, system)
 96:  * 3 = verbose (debug)
 97:  */
 98: function inferVisibility(level: string, source: string): 1 | 2 | 3 {
 99:   if (level === 'error' || level === 'warning') return 1;
100:   if (level === 'debug') return 3;
101:   
102:   // Sistem ve DB logları panel seviyesinde
103:   const panelSources = ['DB', 'session-manager', 'MAIN', 'WindowManager', 'OPENCODE'];
104:   if (panelSources.some(s => source.includes(s))) return 2;
105:   
106:   return 2; // Default panel
107: }

136: /**
137:  * LogManager'a IPC üzerinden log gönder
138:  */
139: function forwardToLogManager(
140:   level: string,
141:   source: string,
142:   message: string,
143:   context: Record<string, unknown> | null = null
144: ): void {
145:   const visibility = inferVisibility(level, source);
146:   const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
147:   
148:   // FIX: Daha kapsamlı hazırlık kontrolü - webContents tam hazır olmalı
149:   if (!mainWindowRef || mainWindowRef.isDestroyed()) {
150:     // Erken log olarak sakla
151:     if (earlyLogs.length < MAX_EARLY_LOGS) {
152:       earlyLogs.push({ level, source, message, timestamp, visibility });
153:     }
154:     return;
155:   }
156:   
157:   const webContents = mainWindowRef.webContents;
158:   if (!webContents || webContents.isDestroyed()) {
159:     if (earlyLogs.length < MAX_EARLY_LOGS) {
160:       earlyLogs.push({ level, source, message, timestamp, visibility });
161:     }
162:     return;
163:   }
164:   
165:   // WebContents'in IPC mesajı alabilecek durumda olup olmadığını kontrol et
166:   try {
167:     // Sadece hazır olan pencereye gönder
168:     if (webContents.isLoading()) {
169:       if (earlyLogs.length < MAX_EARLY_LOGS) {
170:         earlyLogs.push({ level, source, message, timestamp, visibility });
171:       }
172:       return;
173:     }
174:     
175:     webContents.send("console-log-forward", {
176:       level,
177:       source,
178:       message,
179:       context,
180:       timestamp,
181:       visibility,
182:     });
183:   } catch (_err) {
184:     // Sessizce geç - IPC henüz hazır değil
185:     if (earlyLogs.length < MAX_EARLY_LOGS) {
186:       earlyLogs.push({ level, source, message, timestamp, visibility });
187:     }
188:   }
189: }

200: export function generateCorrelationId(prefix: string = "op"): string {
201:   correlationCounter++;
202:   const timestamp = Date.now().toString(36);
203:   const counter = correlationCounter.toString(36).padStart(4, "0");
204:   return `${prefix}-${timestamp}-${counter}`;
205: }

255: /**
256:  * Renderer process loglarını dinle
257:  */
258: export function setupRendererLogger(webContents: Electron.WebContents): void {
259:   // Yeni Event<WebContentsConsoleMessageEventParams> API kullanımı
260:   webContents.on("console-message", (details) => {
261:     // Event objesinden değerleri al (yeni API)
262:     // level: 0=verbose, 1=info, 2=warning, 3=error
263:     const level = Number(details.level);
264:     const message = details.message as string;
265:     const line = (details as unknown as { line?: number }).line ?? 0;
266:     const sourceId = details.sourceId as string | undefined;
267:     
268:     const levelMap: Record<number, string> = {
269:       0: "LOG",
270:       1: "INFO",
271:       2: "WARN",
272:       3: "ERROR",
273:     };
274: 
275:     const levelName = levelMap[level] || "LOG";
276:     const source = sourceId ? ` (${sourceId}:${line})` : "";
277:     const fullMessage = `${message}${source}`;
278: 
279:     const isError = level === 3;
280:     const isWarn = level === 2;
281:     
282:     writeLog(levelName, "RENDERER", [fullMessage], null, isError || isWarn);
283: 
284:     const logType = isError ? "error" : isWarn ? "warning" : "info";
285:     forwardToLogManager(logType, "renderer", fullMessage);
286:   });
287: 
288:   webContents.on("render-process-gone", (_event, details) => {
289:     const msg = `Renderer process crashed: ${JSON.stringify(details)}`;
290:     writeErrorLog("FATAL", "RENDERER", [msg]);
291:     forwardToLogManager("error", "renderer", msg);
292:   });
293: 
294:   webContents.on("preload-error", (_event, preloadPath, error) => {
295:     const msg = `Preload script error: ${preloadPath} - ${error.stack || error}`;
296:     writeErrorLog("PRELOAD-ERROR", "RENDERER", [msg]);
297:     forwardToLogManager("error", "preload", msg);
298:   });
299: }

 26: export async function ensureScope(scope: string = "all"): Promise<ResultBase> {
 27:   try {
 28:     const paths = PATHS();
 29:     const scopes = scope === "all" ? ["data", "logs", "commands"] : [scope];
 30:     const resolved: Record<string, string> = {};
 31:     for (const key of scopes) {
 32:       const resolver = paths[key];
 33:       if (!resolver) continue;
 34:       const p = resolver();
 35:       await ensureDir(p);
 36:       resolved[key] = p;
 37:     }
 38:     return { success: true, ...resolved };
 39:   } catch (err: unknown) {
 40:     return { success: false, message: (err as Error)?.message || String(err) };
 41:   }
 42: }

 49:     logs: () => join(base, "logs"),

118: export async function copyToAssets(_event: IpcMainInvokeEvent, srcPath: string, _role: string = "", accountInfo: { email?: string; provider?: string } | null = null): Promise<ResultBase> {
119:   try {
120:     if (!srcPath || !existsSync(srcPath)) {
121:       throw new Error("Kaynak dosya bulunamadı");
122:     }
123:     const assetsDir = join(process.cwd(), "src", "assets");
124:     if (!existsSync(assetsDir)) {
125:       await mkdir(assetsDir, { recursive: true });
126:     }
127:     const baseName = basename(srcPath) || "avatar";
128:     const parts = baseName.split(".");
129:     const ext = parts.length > 1 ? "." + parts.pop() : "";
130:     let candidate;
131: 
132:     if (accountInfo && accountInfo.email && accountInfo.provider) {
133:       const safeEmail = String(accountInfo.email)
134:         .trim()
135:         .replace(/@/g, "at")
136:         .replace(/[^a-z0-9.-]/gi, "");
137:       const safeProvider = String(accountInfo.provider)
138:         .trim()
139:         .replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/gi, "");
140:       candidate = `${safeEmail}-${safeProvider}${ext}`;
141:     } else if (_role) {
142:       const safeRole =
143:         String(_role)
144:           .toLowerCase()
145:           .replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/g, "") || "avatar";
146:       candidate = `${safeRole}${ext}`;
147:     } else {
148:       const stem = parts.join(".") || "avatar";
149:       candidate = `${stem}${ext}`;
150:       let counter = 1;
151:       while (existsSync(join(assetsDir, candidate))) {
152:         candidate = `${stem} (${counter})${ext}`;
153:         counter += 1;
154:       }
155:     }
156: 
157:     if (String(_role).toLowerCase() === "user") {
158:       try {
159:         const entries = await readdir(assetsDir);
160:         for (const name of entries) {
161:           if (/^user\.[^./\\]+$/i.test(name)) {
162:             await rm(join(assetsDir, name), { force: true });
163:           }
164:         }
165:       } catch (e) {}
166:     }
167: 
168:     const destPath = join(assetsDir, candidate);
169:     await copyFile(srcPath, destPath);
170:     return { success: true, path: destPath, fileName: candidate };
171:   } catch (error: unknown) {
172:     return { success: false, message: (error as Error).message };
173:   }
174: }

213: interface GenerateTreeOptions {
214:   maxDepth?: number;
215:   exclude?: string[];
216: }
217: 
218: export async function generateTree(
219:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
220:   basePath: string = "",
221:   options: GenerateTreeOptions = {}
222: ): Promise<ResultBase & { tree?: string }> {
223:   try {
224:     if (!basePath) basePath = process.cwd();
225:     const maxDepth = options.maxDepth ?? 10;
226:     const excludePatterns = options.exclude || ["node_modules", "dist", ".vite"];
227:     const isProject = basePath === "project" || basePath === ".";
228:     if (isProject) basePath = process.cwd();
229:     if (!existsSync(basePath)) return { success: false, message: `Path not found: ${basePath}` };
230:     const shouldExclude = (name: string): boolean =>
231:       excludePatterns.some((pattern) => {
232:         if (pattern.includes("*")) {
233:           const regex = new RegExp(pattern.replace(/\*/g, ".*"));
234:           return regex.test(name);
235:         }
236:         return name === pattern;
237:       });
238:     const buildTree = async (dir: string, depth: number = 0, prefix: string = ""): Promise<string[]> => {
239:       if (depth > maxDepth) return [];
240:       try {
241:         const entries = await readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
242:         const lines: string[] = [];
243:         const filtered = entries.filter((e) => !shouldExclude(e.name));
244:         for (let idx = 0; idx < filtered.length; idx++) {
245:           const entry = filtered[idx];
246:           const isLast = idx === filtered.length - 1;
247:           const connector = isLast ? "└── " : "├── ";
248:           const nextPrefix = prefix + (isLast ? "    " : "│   ");
249:           lines.push(prefix + connector + entry.name + (entry.isDirectory() ? "/" : ""));
250:           if (entry.isDirectory()) {
251:             const childLines: string[] = await buildTree(join(dir, entry.name), depth + 1, nextPrefix);
252:             lines.push(...childLines);
253:           }
254:         }
255:         return lines;
256:       } catch (err: unknown) {
257:         return [];
258:       }
259:     };
260:     const lines = [basePath + "/"];
261:     const treeLines = await buildTree(basePath);
262:     lines.push(...treeLines);
263:     const treeContent = lines.join("\n");
264:     const tempDir = PATHS().commands();
265:     await ensureDir(tempDir);
266:     const timestamp = Date.now();
267:     const treeFile = join(tempDir, `tree-${timestamp}.txt`);
268:     await writeFile(treeFile, treeContent, "utf-8");
269:     return {
270:       success: true,
271:       path: treeFile,
272:       content: treeContent,
273:       fileName: `tree-${timestamp}.txt`,
274:       lines: lines.length,
275:     };
276:   } catch (error: unknown) {
277:     return { success: false, message: (error as Error).message };
278:   }
279: }
280: 
281: export async function openPath(targetPath: string): Promise<ResultBase> {
282:   try {
283:     if (!targetPath) throw new Error("path eksik");
284:     const absolutePath = resolve(process.cwd(), targetPath);
285:     const res = await shell.openPath(absolutePath);
286:     if (res) throw new Error(res);
287:     return { success: true };
288:   } catch (error: unknown) {
289:     return { success: false, message: (error as Error).message };
290:   }
291: }

 37:         .reduce((s: Record<string, unknown>, k: string) => (s && s[k] !== undefined ? s[k] as Record<string, unknown> : undefined) as Record<string, unknown>, obj as Record<string, unknown>) ??
 38:       def
 39:     );
 40:   } catch {
 41:     return def;
 42:   }
 43: }
 44: 
 45: export async function googledriveStartAuth(
 46:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent
 47: ): Promise<{ success: boolean; authUrl?: string; message?: string }> {
 48:   try {
 49:     let settings: Settings = {};
 50:     try {
 51:       settings = ((await loadSettings()) as unknown as Settings) || {};
 52:     } catch (_err) {
 53:       settings = {};
 54:     }
 55:     const gconf = safeGet(settings, "integrations.googledrive", {}) as GoogleDriveConfig;
 56:     const clientId = gconf.clientId || process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID || "";
 57:     const clientSecret =
 58:       gconf.clientSecret || process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET || "";
 59:     
 60:     if (!clientId || !clientSecret) {
 61:       return {
 62:         success: false,
 63:         message: "Google Client ID/Secret ayarlı değil",
 64:       };
 65:     }
 66:     
 67:     const redirect = "urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob";
 68:     const oauth2Client = new google.auth.OAuth2(
 69:       clientId,
 70:       clientSecret,
 71:       redirect,
 72:     );
 73:     
 74:     const authUrl = oauth2Client.generateAuthUrl({
 75:       access_type: "offline",
 76:       scope: [
 77:         "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file",
 78:         "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email",
 79:       ],
 80:     });
 81:     
 82:     return { success: true, authUrl };
 83:   } catch (err: unknown) {
 84:     return { success: false, message: (err as Error)?.message || "auth start failed" };
 85:   }
