 88: export async function googledriveExchangeCode(
 89:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
 90:   code: string
 91: ): Promise<{ success: boolean; account?: string; message?: string }> {
 92:   try {
 93:     if (!code) return { success: false, message: "Yetkilendirme kodu eksik" };
 94:     let settings: Settings = {};
 95:     try {
 96:       settings = ((await loadSettings()) as unknown as Settings) || {};
 97:     } catch (_err) {
 98:       settings = {};
 99:     }
100:     const gconf = safeGet(settings, "integrations.googledrive", {}) as GoogleDriveConfig;
101:     const clientId = gconf.clientId || process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID || "";
102:     const clientSecret =
103:       gconf.clientSecret || process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET || "";
104:     if (!clientId || !clientSecret) {
105:       return {
106:         success: false,
107:         message: "Google Client ID/Secret ayarlı değil",
108:       };
109:     }
110:     const redirect = "urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob";
111:     const oauth2Client = new google.auth.OAuth2(
112:       clientId,
113:       clientSecret,
114:       redirect,
115:     );
116:     const { tokens } = await oauth2Client.getToken(String(code).trim());
117:     oauth2Client.setCredentials(tokens);
118:     settings.integrations = settings.integrations || {};
119:     settings.integrations.googledrive = settings.integrations.googledrive || {};
120:     settings.integrations.googledrive.tokens = tokens;
121: 
122:     let accountEmail = "";
123:     try {
124:       const oauth2 = google.oauth2({ auth: oauth2Client, version: "v2" });
125:       const me = (await oauth2.userinfo.get()).data;
126:       accountEmail = me?.email || "";
127:     } catch (err: unknown) {
128:     }
129: 
130:     settings.integrations.googledrive.connected = true;
131:     settings.integrations.googledrive.account = accountEmail;
132: 
133:     try {
134:       await saveSettings(settings);
135:     } catch (err: unknown) {
136:     }
137: 
138:     return { success: true, account: accountEmail };
139:   } catch (err: unknown) {
140:     return { success: false, message: (err as Error)?.message || "exchange failed" };
141:   }
142: }

144: export async function googledriveDisconnect(
145:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent
146: ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message?: string }> {
147:   try {
148:     let settings: Settings = {};
149:     try {
150:       settings = ((await loadSettings()) as unknown as Settings) || {};
151:     } catch (_err) {
152:       settings = {};
153:     }
154:     if (settings.integrations && settings.integrations.googledrive) {
155:       delete settings.integrations.googledrive.tokens;
156:       delete settings.integrations.googledrive.connected;
157:       delete settings.integrations.googledrive.account;
158:       try {
159:         await saveSettings(null, settings);
160:       } catch (_err) {
161:         // Ignore
162:       }
163:     }
164:     return { success: true };
165:   } catch (err: unknown) {
166:     return { success: false, message: (err as Error)?.message || "disconnect failed" };
167:   }
168: }

170: export async function googledriveUpload(
171:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
172:   payload: UploadPayload = {}
173: ): Promise<{ success: boolean; uploadedLinks?: unknown[]; errors?: unknown[]; message?: string }> {
174:   try {
175:     const files = Array.isArray(payload?.files) ? payload.files : [];
176:     if (!files.length) return { success: false, message: "Dosya yok" };
177:     let settings: Settings = {};
178:     try {
179:       settings = ((await loadSettings()) as unknown as Settings) || {};
180:     } catch (_e) {
181:       settings = {};
182:     }
183:     const gconf = safeGet(settings, "integrations.googledrive", {}) as GoogleDriveConfig;
184:     const clientId = gconf.clientId || process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID || "";
185:     const clientSecret =
186:       gconf.clientSecret || process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET || "";
187:     const tokens = gconf.tokens || null;
188:     if (!clientId || !clientSecret || !tokens) {
189:       return { success: false, message: "Google Drive yetkilendirmesi eksik" };
190:     }
191:     const redirect = "urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob";
192:     const oauth2Client = new google.auth.OAuth2(
193:       clientId,
194:       clientSecret,
195:       redirect,
196:     );
197:     oauth2Client.setCredentials(tokens);
198:     const drive = google.drive({ version: "v3", auth: oauth2Client });
199:     const uploadedLinks = [];
200:     const errors = [];
201:     for (const file of files) {
202:       try {
203:         const buffer = Buffer.from(file.base64 || "", "base64");
204:         const pass = new PassThrough();
205:         pass.end(buffer);
206:         const name = file.name || `file-${Date.now()}`;
207:         const isText =
208:           (file.mimeType || "").startsWith("text") ||
209:           name.endsWith(".txt") ||
210:           name.endsWith(".md");
211:         const resource: { name: string; mimeType?: string } = { name };
212:         if (isText) resource.mimeType = "application/vnd.google-apps.document";
213:         const media = {
214:           mimeType: file.mimeType || "application/octet-stream",
215:           body: pass,
216:         };
217:         const res = await drive.files.create({
218:           requestBody: resource,
219:           media,
220:           fields: "id,name,webViewLink,webContentLink",
221:         });
222:         const fileId = res.data?.id;
223:         if (!fileId) throw new Error("Upload id missing");
224:         try {
225:           await drive.permissions.create({
226:             fileId,
227:             requestBody: { role: "reader", type: "anyone" },
228:           });
229:         } catch (err: unknown) {
230:         }
231:         let url = "";
232:         if (isText)
233:           url = `https://docs.google.com/document/d/${fileId}/export?format=pdf`;
234:         else url = `https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=${fileId}`;
235:         uploadedLinks.push({ name, url, id: fileId });
236:       } catch (err: unknown) {
237:         errors.push({
238:           name: file?.name || "file",
239:           message: (err as Error)?.message || err,
240:         });
241:       }
242:     }
243:     if (!uploadedLinks.length)
244:       return { success: false, message: "Yükleme başarısız", errors };
245:     return {
246:       success: true,
247:       uploadedLinks,
248:       errors: errors.length ? errors : undefined,
249:     };
250:   } catch (err: unknown) {
251:     return { success: false, message: (err as Error)?.message || "upload failed" };
252:   }
253: }

   4:  * Server-Sent Events (SSE) tabanlı real-time event streaming.
   5:  * OpenCode subprocess'inden gelen event'leri web UI'a iletir.
   6:  * 
   7:  * Özellikler:
   8:  * - SSE endpoint (/api/events)

  11:  * - Heartbeat (connection keep-alive)

 139: class OpenCodeEventBus extends EventEmitter {
 140:   publish(event: SSEEvent): void {
 141:     // Emit for internal listeners
 142:     this.emit('event', event);
 143:     this.emit(event.type, event);
 144:   }

 147:     this.on('event', listener);

 156: export const OpenCodeSSEServer = {
 157:   _server: null as ReturnType<typeof createServer> | null,
 158:   _eventBus: new OpenCodeEventBus(),
 159:   _clients: new Map<number, SSEClient>(),
 160:   _nextClientId: 0,
 161:   _heartbeatInterval: null as NodeJS.Timeout | null,
 162:   _session: null as SessionState | null,
 163:   _openCodeConnected: false,
 164:   _lastSentUserMessageId: null as string | null,  // Son gönderilen user mesajı ID'si (echo filtreleme için)
 165:   _config: {
 166:     port: 4097, // OpenCode server'dan farklı port
 167:     host: '127.0.0.1',
 168:     corsOrigin: '*',
 169:   } as SSEServerConfig,
 170: 
 171:   // =========================================================================
 172:   // Public API
 173:   // =========================================================================
 174: 
 175:   /**
 176:    * SSE Server'ı başlat
 177:    */
 178:   async start(config: Partial<SSEServerConfig> = {}): Promise<{ success: boolean; url?: string; workspace?: string; error?: string }> {
 179:     if (this._server) {
 180:       return { success: true, url: this._getServerUrl(), workspace: process.cwd() };
 181:     }
 182: 
 183:     this._config = { ...this._config, ...config };
 184: 
 185:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
 186:       try {
 187:         this._server = createServer((req, res) => this._handleRequest(req, res));
 188: 
 189:         this._server.on('error', (err: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => {
 190:           console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'error', `Server error: ${err.message}`);
 191:           if (err.code === 'EADDRINUSE') {
 192:             resolve({ success: false, error: `Port ${this._config.port} kullanımda` });
 193:           } else {
 194:             resolve({ success: false, error: err.message });
 195:           }
 196:         });
 197: 
 198:         this._server.listen(this._config.port, this._config.host, () => {
 199:           console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'info', `Server başlatıldı: ${this._getServerUrl()}`);
 200:           this._startHeartbeat();
 201:           resolve({ success: true, url: this._getServerUrl(), workspace: process.cwd() });
 202:         });
 203:       } catch (err: unknown) {
 204:         resolve({ success: false, error: (err as Error).message });
 205:       }
 206:     });
 207:   },
 208: 
 209:   /**
 210:    * SSE Server'ı durdur
 211:    */
 212:   async stop(): Promise<{ success: boolean }> {
 213:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
 214:       // OpenCode bağlantısını kes
 215:       this.disconnectFromOpenCode();
 216:       
 217:       this._stopHeartbeat();
 218:       this._disconnectAllClients();
 219: 
 220:       if (!this._server) {
 221:         resolve({ success: true });
 222:         return;
 223:       }
 224: 
 225:       this._server.close((err) => {
 226:         if (err) {
 227:           console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'error', `Server kapatma hatası: ${err.message}`);
 228:         } else {
 229:           console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'info', 'Server durduruldu');
 230:         }
 231:         this._server = null;
 232:         resolve({ success: true });
 233:       });
 234:     });
 235:   },
 236: 
 237:   /**
 238:    * Event yayınla (OpenCode Manager tarafından çağrılır)
 239:    * Tüm bağlı SSE client'lara event gönderir
 240:    */
 241:   publish(event: SSEEvent): void {
 242:     // Emit for internal listeners via event bus
 243:     this._eventBus.publish(event);
 244:     
 245:     // Send to all connected SSE clients
 246:     const eventData = `data: ${JSON.stringify(event)}\n\n`;
 247:     for (const [clientId, client] of this._clients) {
 248:       try {
 249:         client.response.write(eventData);
 250:       } catch (err) {
 251:         console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'warn', `Failed to write to client ${clientId}`, { error: (err as Error).message });
 252:         // Remove dead client
 253:         this._clients.delete(clientId);
 254:       }
 255:     }
 256:   },

 432:       type: 'step.finish',
 433:       timestamp: Date.now(),
 434:       sessionId: this._session?.id,
 435:       data: {
 436:         stepId,
 437:         messageId,
 438:         inputTokens: usage.inputTokens || 0,
 439:         outputTokens: usage.outputTokens || 0,
 440:         cost: usage.cost || 0,
 441:       },
 442:     });
 443:   },
 444: 
 445:   /**
 446:    * Permission request gönder
 447:    */
 448:   requestPermission(data: PermissionEventData): void {
 449:     if (this._session) {
 450:       this._session.status = 'waiting';
 451:       this._session.pendingPermission = data;
 452:     }
 453: 
 454:     this.publish({
 455:       type: 'permission.request',
 456:       timestamp: Date.now(),
 457:       sessionId: this._session?.id,
 458:       data,
 459:     });
 460:   },
 461: 
 462:   /**
 463:    * Question gönder
 464:    */
 465:   askQuestion(data: QuestionEventData): void {
 466:     if (this._session) {
 467:       this._session.status = 'waiting';
 468:       this._session.pendingQuestion = data;
 469:     }
 470: 
 471:     this.publish({
 472:       type: 'question.ask',
 473:       timestamp: Date.now(),
 474:       sessionId: this._session?.id,
 475:       data,
 476:     });
 477:   },
 478: 
 479:   /**
 480:    * Server durumunu al
 481:    */
 482:   getStatus(): { running: boolean; url: string | null; clients: number; openCodeConnected: boolean } {
 483:     return {
 484:       running: this._server !== null,
 485:       url: this._server ? this._getServerUrl() : null,
 486:       clients: this._clients.size,
 487:       openCodeConnected: this._openCodeConnected,
 488:     };
 489:   },
 490: 
 491:   // =========================================================================
 492:   // OpenCode Event Bridge
 493:   // =========================================================================
 494: 
 495:   _openCodeConnecting: false,
 496: 
 497:   /**
 498:    * OpenCode SSE stream'ine bağlan ve event'leri Native UI'a ilet
 499:    */
 500:   async connectToOpenCode(): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; sessionId?: string }> {
 501:     if (this._openCodeConnected) {
 502:       console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', 'OpenCode zaten bağlı');
 503:       return { success: true, sessionId: this._session?.id };
 504:     }
 505:     
 506:     if (this._openCodeConnecting) {
 507:       console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', 'OpenCode bağlantısı zaten devam ediyor');
 508:       return { success: true };
 509:     }
 510:     
 511:     this._openCodeConnecting = true;
 512: 
 513:     try {
 514:       // OpenCode server çalışıyor mu kontrol et
 515:       const status = OpenCodeManager.getStatus();
 516:       if (!status.running) {
 517:         return { success: false, error: 'OpenCode server çalışmıyor' };
 518:       }
 519: 
 520:       // Session oluştur veya mevcut session'a bağlan
 521:       const sessionResult = await OpenCodeManager.createOrGetSession();
 522:       if (!sessionResult.success) {
 523:         return { success: false, error: sessionResult.error || 'Session oluşturulamadı' };
 524:       }
 525: 
 526:       // Local session'ı güncelle
 527:       if (sessionResult.data) {
 528:         this._session = {
 529:           id: sessionResult.data.id,
 530:           status: 'idle',
 531:           startedAt: sessionResult.data.createdAt || Date.now(),
 532:           lastActivity: sessionResult.data.updatedAt || Date.now(),
 533:           messages: [],
 534:         };
 535:       }
 536: 
 537:       // OpenCode SSE event'lerine subscribe ol
 538:       OpenCodeManager.subscribeToEvents((event: NativeUIEvent) => {
 539:         this._handleOpenCodeEvent(event);
 540:       });
 541: 
 542:       this._openCodeConnected = true;
 543:       this._openCodeConnecting = false;
 544:       console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'info', 'OpenCode bağlantısı kuruldu', { 
 545:         sessionId: sessionResult.data?.id 
 546:       });
 547: 
 548:       // Bağlantı event'i yayınla
 549:       this.publish({
 550:         type: 'status.change',
 551:         timestamp: Date.now(),
 552:         sessionId: this._session?.id,
 553:         data: { status: 'opencode_connected' },
 554:       });
 555: 
 556:       return { success: true, sessionId: sessionResult.data?.id };
 557:     } catch (err) {
 558:       this._openCodeConnecting = false;
 559:       console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'error', 'OpenCode bağlantı hatası', { 
 560:         error: (err as Error).message 
 561:       });
 562:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
 563:     }
 564:   },
 565: 
 566:   /**
 567:    * OpenCode bağlantısını kes
 568:    */
 569:   disconnectFromOpenCode(): void {
 570:     if (!this._openCodeConnected) return;
 571: 
 572:     OpenCodeManager.unsubscribeFromEvents();
 573:     this._openCodeConnected = false;
 574: 
 575:     console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'info', 'OpenCode bağlantısı kesildi');
 576: 
 577:     this.publish({
 578:       type: 'status.change',
 579:       timestamp: Date.now(),
 580:       sessionId: this._session?.id,
 581:       data: { status: 'opencode_disconnected' },
 582:     });
 583:   },
 584: 
 585:   _currentAssistantMessageId: null as string | null,
 586:   _currentAssistantContent: '' as string,  // Kümülatif içerik takibi
 587:   // Not: Echo filtreleme artık client tarafında (StoreBridge) yapılıyor
 588: 
 589:   /**
 590:    * OpenCode'dan gelen event'leri işle ve Native UI'a ilet
 591:    * CodeNomad session-events.ts pattern'i takip edilir
 592:    */
 593:   _handleOpenCodeEvent(event: NativeUIEvent): void {
 594:     console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', 'OpenCode event alındı', { type: event.type });
 595:     
 596:     // Event tipine göre işle - CodeNomad tarzı
 597:     switch (event.type) {
 598:       // =========================================
 599:       // Message Events (CodeNomad: message.updated, message.part.updated)
 600:       // =========================================
 601:       case 'message.created': {
 602:         // DEVRE DIŞI - message.part.updated kullanıyoruz
 603:         // message.created sadece log için
 604:         const role = (event.data.role as 'user' | 'assistant') || 'assistant';
 605:         const messageId = (event.data.id as string) || '';
 606:         console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', 'message.created ignored', { role, messageId });
 607:         break;
 608:       }
 609: 
 610:       // =========================================
 611:       // Message Part Updated (CodeNomad/OpenCode streaming event)
 612:       // =========================================
 613:       case 'message.part.updated': {
 614:         // Farklı format destekleri - nested part objesi veya flat data
 615:         const partObj = event.data.part as { type?: string; content?: string; text?: string } | undefined;
 616:         const role = (event.data.role as 'user' | 'assistant') || 'assistant';
 617:         const messageId = (event.data.messageId || event.data.id) as string;
 618:         
 619:         // Part içeriğini al (nested veya flat format)
 620:         const fullContent = partObj?.content || partObj?.text || (event.data.fullContent as string) || (event.data.content as string) || '';
 621:         const partType = partObj?.type || (event.data.partType as string) || (event.data.type as string) || 'text';
 622:         
 623: 
 624:         // User mesajlarını atla (role veya messageId ile)
 625:         if (role === 'user') {
 626:           console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', 'User message.part.updated skipped (role)', { messageId });
 627:           break;
 628:         }
 629:         
 630:         // Echo filtreleme: Bizim gönderdiğimiz user mesajını atla
 631:         if (messageId && messageId === this._lastSentUserMessageId) {
 632:           console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', 'User message.part.updated skipped (echo filter)', { messageId });
 633:           break;
 634:         }
 635:         
 636:         // step-finish: Streaming bitişi sinyali
 637:         if (partType === 'step-finish') {
 638:           // reason event.data'dan veya partObj'den gelebilir
 639:           const reason = (event.data.reason as string) || (partObj as Record<string, unknown>)?.reason as string;
 640:           console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', 'step-finish received', { messageId, reason, hasCurrentMsg: !!this._currentAssistantMessageId });
 641:           
 642:           // reason: "stop" = mesaj tamamlandı, "tool-calls" = tool çağrısı yapılacak
 643:           if (reason === 'stop' && this._currentAssistantMessageId) {
 644:             console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'info', 'Streaming tamamlandı (step-finish:stop)', { messageId: this._currentAssistantMessageId });
 645:             this.endMessageStream(this._currentAssistantMessageId, this._currentAssistantContent);
 646:             this._currentAssistantMessageId = null;
 647:             this._currentAssistantContent = '';
 648:           }
 649:           break;
 650:         }
 651:         
 652:         // Sadece text ve thinking part'ları işle
 653:         if (partType !== 'text' && partType !== 'thinking') {
 654:           console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', 'Non-text part skipped', { partType, messageId });
 655:           break;
 656:         }
 657:         
 658:         // Boş içerik atla
 659:         if (!fullContent || fullContent.trim() === '') {
 660:           break;
 661:         }
 662:         
 663:         // Not: Echo filtreleme artık client tarafında (StoreBridge) yapılıyor
 664:         
 665:         // Mesaj başlatılmadıysa başlat
 666:         if (!this._currentAssistantMessageId) {
 667:           this._currentAssistantMessageId = messageId || `msg-${Date.now()}`;
 668:           this._currentAssistantContent = '';
 669:           this.startMessageStream('assistant', this._currentAssistantMessageId);
 670:         } else if (messageId && messageId !== this._currentAssistantMessageId) {
 671:           // Farklı mesaj - öncekini kapat
 672:           this.endMessageStream(this._currentAssistantMessageId, this._currentAssistantContent);
 673:           this._currentAssistantMessageId = messageId;
 674:           this._currentAssistantContent = '';
 675:           this.startMessageStream('assistant', this._currentAssistantMessageId);
 676:         }
 677:         
 678:         // Gerçek delta'yı hesapla
 679:         let actualDelta = fullContent;
 680:         if (fullContent.startsWith(this._currentAssistantContent)) {
 681:           actualDelta = fullContent.slice(this._currentAssistantContent.length);
 682:         }
 683:         
 684:         if (actualDelta) {
 685:           this._currentAssistantContent = fullContent;
 686:           this.appendMessageDelta(this._currentAssistantMessageId, actualDelta);
 687:         }
 688:         break;
 689:       }
 690: 
 691:       // message.updated - OpenCode bazen bu formatı kullanıyor
 692:       case 'message.updated': {
 693:         // DEBUG: message.updated event'ini logla
 694:         console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', 'message.updated RAW DATA', {
 695:           dataKeys: Object.keys(event.data || {}),
 696:           content: event.data.content,
 697:           text: event.data.text,
 698:           fullContent: event.data.fullContent,
 699:           role: event.data.role,
 700:           messageId: event.data.messageId,
 701:         });
 702:         
 703:         const updatedMessageId = (event.data.messageId || event.data.id) as string;
 704:         const updatedContent = (event.data.content || event.data.text || event.data.fullContent) as string;
 705:         const updatedRole = (event.data.role as string) || 'assistant';
 706:         
 707:         // User mesajlarını atla
 708:         if (updatedRole === 'user') {
 709:           break;
 710:         }
 711:         
 712:         if (!updatedContent) {
 713:           break;
 714:         }
 715:         
 716:         // Mesaj başlatılmamışsa başlat
 717:         if (!this._currentAssistantMessageId && updatedMessageId) {
 718:           this._currentAssistantMessageId = updatedMessageId;
 719:           this._currentAssistantContent = '';
 720:           this.startMessageStream('assistant', updatedMessageId);
 721:         }
 722:         
 723:         // Delta hesapla
 724:         let delta = updatedContent;
 725:         if (updatedContent.startsWith(this._currentAssistantContent)) {
 726:           delta = updatedContent.slice(this._currentAssistantContent.length);
 727:         }
 728:         
 729:         if (delta) {
 730:           this._currentAssistantContent = updatedContent;
 731:           this.appendMessageDelta(this._currentAssistantMessageId!, delta);
 732:         }
 733:         break;
 734:       }
 735: 
 736:       case 'message.delta': {
 737:         // Fallback: message.delta doğrudan delta gönderir
 738:         const deltaContent = (event.data.delta || event.data.content || event.data.fullContent || event.data.text) as string;
 739:         const deltaRole = event.data.role as string;
 740:         const deltaMessageId = (event.data.messageId || event.data.id) as string;
 741:         
 742:         // User mesajlarını atla
 743:         if (deltaRole === 'user') {
 744:           break;
 745:         }
 746:         
 747:         if (deltaContent) {
 748:           // Mesaj başlatılmamışsa başlat
 749:           if (!this._currentAssistantMessageId) {
 750:             this._currentAssistantMessageId = deltaMessageId || `msg-${Date.now()}`;
 751:             this._currentAssistantContent = '';
 752:             this.startMessageStream('assistant', this._currentAssistantMessageId);
 753:           }
 754:           
 755:           this._currentAssistantContent += deltaContent;
 756:           this.appendMessageDelta(this._currentAssistantMessageId, deltaContent);
 757:         }
 758:         break;
 759:       }
 760: 
 761:       case 'message.completed': {
 762:         const role = (event.data.role as 'user' | 'assistant') || 'assistant';
 763:         
 764:         // User mesajlarını atla
 765:         if (role === 'user') {
 766:           break;
 767:         }
 768:         
 769:         if (this._currentAssistantMessageId) {
 770:           const finalContent = (event.data.content as string) || this._currentAssistantContent;
 771:           this.endMessageStream(this._currentAssistantMessageId, finalContent);
 772:           this._currentAssistantMessageId = null;
 773:           this._currentAssistantContent = '';
 774:         }
 775:         break;
 776:       }
 777: 
 778:       // Message removed (CodeNomad)
 779:       case 'message.removed':
 780:         this.publish({
 781:           type: 'message.removed',
 782:           timestamp: event.timestamp,
 783:           sessionId: this._session?.id,
 784:           data: event.data,
 785:         });
 786:         break;
 787: 
 788:       // Message part removed (CodeNomad)
 789:       case 'message.part.removed':
 790:         this.publish({
 791:           type: 'message.part.removed',
 792:           timestamp: event.timestamp,
 793:           sessionId: this._session?.id,
 794:           data: event.data,
 795:         });
 796:         break;
 797: 
 798:       // =========================================
 799:       // Tool Events
 800:       // =========================================
 801:       case 'tool.start':
 802:         this.startToolCall(
 803:           event.data.toolId as string,
 804:           event.data.toolName as string,
 805:           event.data.toolInput as Record<string, unknown>
 806:         );
 807:         break;
 808: 
 809:       case 'tool.end':
 810:         this.endToolCall(
 811:           event.data.toolId as string,
 812:           event.data.isError ? 'error' : 'success',
 813:           event.data.output as string
 814:         );
 815:         break;
 816: 
 817:       // =========================================
 818:       // Permission Events (CodeNomad: permission.updated, permission.replied)
 819:       // =========================================
 820:       case 'permission.request':
 821:       case 'permission.updated':
 822:       case 'permission.asked':
 823:         this.requestPermission({
 824:           permissionId: (event.data.permissionId || event.data.id) as string,
 825:           toolName: event.data.toolName as string,
 826:           description: (event.data.message || event.data.description || `Tool "${event.data.toolName}" izin istiyor`) as string,
 827:           risk: 'medium',
 828:         });
 829:         break;
 830: 
 831:       case 'permission.resolved':
 832:       case 'permission.replied':
 833:         if (this._session) {
 834:           this._session.status = 'processing';
 835:           this._session.pendingPermission = undefined;
 836:         }
 837:         this.publish({
 838:           type: 'permission.resolved',
 839:           timestamp: event.timestamp,
 840:           sessionId: this._session?.id,
 841:           data: event.data,
 842:         });
 843:         break;
 844: 
 845:       // =========================================
 846:       // Question Events (CodeNomad: question.asked, question.replied)
 847:       // =========================================
 848:       case 'question.ask':
 849:       case 'question.asked':
 850:         this.askQuestion({
 851:           questionId: (event.data.questionId || event.data.id) as string,
 852:           question: (event.data.question || event.data.text) as string,
 853:           options: event.data.options as Array<{ label: string; value: string }>,
 854:           allowFreeform: true,
 855:         });
 856:         break;
 857: 
 858:       case 'question.answered':
 859:       case 'question.replied':
 860:       case 'question.rejected':
 861:         if (this._session) {
 862:           this._session.status = 'processing';
 863:           this._session.pendingQuestion = undefined;
 864:         }
 865:         this.publish({
 866:           type: 'status.change',
 867:           timestamp: event.timestamp,
 868:           sessionId: this._session?.id,
 869:           data: { status: 'question_answered', ...event.data },
 870:         });
 871:         break;
 872: 
 873:       // =========================================
 874:       // Thinking/Reasoning Events
 875:       // =========================================
 876:       case 'thinking.start':
 877:       case 'thinking.delta':
 878:       case 'thinking.end':
 879:         // Thinking event'lerini sadece yayınla, mesaj başlatma
 880:         // Mesaj başlatma işi message.delta'da yapılacak
 881:         this.publish({
 882:           type: event.type as SSEEventType,
 883:           timestamp: event.timestamp,
 884:           sessionId: this._session?.id,
 885:           data: {
 886:             ...event.data,
 887:             messageId: this._currentAssistantMessageId || `thinking-${Date.now()}`,
 888:           },
 889:         });
 890:         break;
 891: 
 892:       // =========================================
 893:       // Step Events (Token Tracking - CodeNomad pattern)
 894:       // =========================================
 895:       case 'step.start':
 896:         this.startStep(
 897:           (event.data.stepId as string) || `step-${Date.now()}`,
 898:           (event.data.messageId as string) || this._currentAssistantMessageId || undefined
 899:         );
 900:         break;
 901: 
 902:       case 'step.finish':
 903:         this.finishStep(
 904:           (event.data.stepId as string) || `step-${Date.now()}`,
 905:           {
 906:             inputTokens: (event.data.inputTokens as number) || 0,
 907:             outputTokens: (event.data.outputTokens as number) || 0,
 908:             cost: (event.data.cost as number) || 0,
 909:           },
 910:           (event.data.messageId as string) || this._currentAssistantMessageId || undefined
 911:         );
 912:         break;
 913: 
 914:       // =========================================
 915:       // Session Events (CodeNomad: session.idle, session.status, session.compacted, session.error)
 916:       // =========================================
 917:       case 'session.updated':
 918:         if (this._session && event.data.status) {
 919:           this._session.status = this._mapOpenCodeStatus(event.data.status as string);
 920:         }
 921:         this.publish({
 922:           type: 'session.updated',
 923:           timestamp: event.timestamp,
 924:           sessionId: this._session?.id,
 925:           data: event.data,
 926:         });
 927:         break;
 928: 
 929:       case 'session.compacted':
 930:         this.publish({
 931:           type: 'session.compacted',
 932:           timestamp: event.timestamp,
 933:           sessionId: this._session?.id,
 934:           data: event.data,
 935:         });
 936:         break;
 937: 
 938:       case 'session.error':
 939:         this.publish({
 940:           type: 'session.error',
 941:           timestamp: event.timestamp,
 942:           sessionId: this._session?.id,
 943:           data: event.data,
 944:         });
 945:         break;
 946: 
 947:       case 'status.change': {
 948:         const status = event.data.status;
 949:         const statusType = typeof status === 'object' && status !== null ? (status as { type?: string }).type : status;
 950:         
 951:         // Idle status'u sadece aktif streaming yoksa işle
 952:         // Aksi halde mesaj tamamlanmadan UI "Hazır" moduna geçer
 953:         if (statusType === 'idle') {
 954:           // Aktif streaming varsa idle'a geçme - message.completed bekle
 955:           if (this._currentAssistantMessageId && this._currentAssistantContent) {
 956:             console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', 'status.change:idle ignored - active streaming', {
 957:               messageId: this._currentAssistantMessageId,
 958:               contentLength: this._currentAssistantContent.length
 959:             });
 960:             // Session status'unu güncelleme, client'a gönderme
 961:             break;
 962:           }
 963:         }
 964:         
 965:         if (this._session) {
 966:           this._session.status = this._mapOpenCodeStatus(statusType as string);
 967:         }
 968:         
 969:         this.publish({
 970:           type: 'status.change',
 971:           timestamp: event.timestamp,
 972:           sessionId: this._session?.id,
 973:           data: { status: statusType },
 974:         });
 975:         break;
 976:       }
 977: 
 978:       case 'error':
 979:         this.publish({
 980:           type: 'session.error',
 981:           timestamp: event.timestamp,
 982:           sessionId: this._session?.id,
 983:           data: event.data,
 984:         });
 985:         break;
 986: 
 987:       // =========================================
 988:       // Default: Pass through unknown events
 989:       // =========================================
 990:       default:
 991:         this.publish({
 992:           type: event.type as SSEEventType,
 993:           timestamp: event.timestamp,
 994:           sessionId: this._session?.id,
 995:           data: event.data,
 996:         });
 997:     }
 998:   },
 999: 
1000:   /**
1001:    * OpenCode status'unu local status'a map et
1002:    */
1003:   _mapOpenCodeStatus(status: string): 'idle' | 'processing' | 'waiting' | 'error' {
1004:     switch (status) {
1005:       case 'idle':
1006:         return 'idle';
1007:       case 'processing':
1008:         return 'processing';
1009:       case 'waiting_permission':
1010:       case 'waiting_answer':
1011:         return 'waiting';
1012:       default:
1013:         return 'idle';
1014:     }
1015:   },
1016: 
1017:   // =========================================================================
1018:   // Private Methods - HTTP Handling
1019:   // =========================================================================
1020: 
1021:   _handleRequest(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse): void {
1022:     // CORS headers
1023:     res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', this._config.corsOrigin);
1024:     res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS');
1025:     res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');
1026:     res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Credentials', 'true');
1027: 
1028:     // Preflight
1029:     if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
1030:       res.writeHead(204);
1031:       res.end();
1032:       return;
1033:     }
1034: 
1035:     const url = new URL(req.url || '/', `http://${req.headers.host}`);
1036:     const path = url.pathname;
1037: 
1038:     // Route handling
1039:     if (path === '/api/events' && req.method === 'GET') {
1040:       this._handleSSE(req, res);
1041:     } else if (path === '/api/session' && req.method === 'GET') {
1042:       this._handleGetSession(res);
1043:     } else if (path === '/api/send' && req.method === 'POST') {
1044:       this._handleSendMessage(req, res);
1045:     } else if (path === '/api/approve' && req.method === 'POST') {
1046:       this._handleApprove(req, res);

1048:       this._handleAnswer(req, res);

1112:   _handleSSE(_req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse): void {
1113:     const clientId = ++this._nextClientId;
1114:     console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', `SSE client connected: ${clientId}`);
1115: 
1116:     // SSE headers
1117:     res.writeHead(200, {
1118:       'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
1119:       'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
1120:       'Connection': 'keep-alive',
1121:     });
1122: 
1123:     // Initial connection event
1124:     const connectEvent: SSEEvent = {
1125:       type: 'status.change',
1126:       timestamp: Date.now(),
1127:       data: { status: 'connected', clientId },
1128:     };
1129:     res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(connectEvent)}\n\n`);
1130: 
1131:     // Send current session state if exists
1132:     if (this._session) {
1133:       const sessionEvent: SSEEvent = {
1134:         type: 'session.started',
1135:         timestamp: Date.now(),
1136:         sessionId: this._session.id,
1137:         data: { session: this._session },
1138:       };
1139:       res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(sessionEvent)}\n\n`);
1140:     }
1141: 
1142:     // Register client
1143:     const client: SSEClient = {
1144:       id: clientId,
1145:       response: res,
1146:       connectedAt: Date.now(),
1147:     };
1148:     this._clients.set(clientId, client);
1149: 
1150:     // Handle disconnect
1151:     const cleanup = () => {
1152:       console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', `SSE client disconnected: ${clientId}`);
1153:       this._clients.delete(clientId);
1154:     };
1155: 
1156:     res.on('close', cleanup);
1157:     res.on('error', cleanup);
1158:   },
1159: 
1160:   _handleGetSession(res: ServerResponse): void {
1161:     res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1162:     res.end(JSON.stringify({ session: this._session }));
1163:   },

1165:   async _handleSendMessage(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse): Promise<void> {
1166:     try {
1167:       const body = await this._readBody(req);
1168:       const { message, messageId: clientMessageId } = JSON.parse(body);
1169: 
1170:       if (!message) {
1171:         res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1172:         res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Message required' }));
1173:         return;
1174:       }
1175: 
1176:       // Önceki streaming mesajı güvenli şekilde tamamla
1177:       if (this._currentAssistantMessageId && this._currentAssistantContent) {
1178:         console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', 'Önceki streaming mesaj tamamlanıyor', { 
1179:           messageId: this._currentAssistantMessageId 
1180:         });
1181:         this.endMessageStream(this._currentAssistantMessageId, this._currentAssistantContent);
1182:       }
1183: 
1184:       // Yeni mesaj için state'i sıfırla
1185:       this._currentAssistantContent = '';
1186:       this._currentAssistantMessageId = null;
1187: 
1188:       // OpenCode'a mesajı ilet (client-side messageId varsa kullan)
1189:       const result = await OpenCodeManager.sendMessage(message, undefined, clientMessageId);
1190:       
1191:       // User messageId'yi kaydet (echo filtreleme için)
1192:       if (result.success && result.data?.messageId) {
1193:         this._lastSentUserMessageId = result.data.messageId;
1194:         console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'debug', 'User messageId kaydedildi', { messageId: this._lastSentUserMessageId });
1195:       }
1196:       
1197:       if (!result.success) {
1198:         console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'error', 'OpenCode mesaj gönderme hatası', { error: result.error });
1199:         res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1200:         res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: result.error || 'Mesaj gönderilemedi' }));
1201:         return;
1202:       }
1203: 
1204:       // Streaming response başlat (assistant mesajı için)
1205:       this.startMessageStream('assistant', result.data?.messageId);
1206: 
1207:       res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1208:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ 
1209:         success: true, 
1210:         sessionId: this._session?.id,
1211:         messageId: result.data?.messageId 
1212:       }));
1213:     } catch (err: unknown) {
1214:       res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1215:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: (err as Error).message }));
1216:     }
1217:   },
1218: 
1219:   async _handleApprove(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse): Promise<void> {
1220:     try {
1221:       const body = await this._readBody(req);
1222:       const { permissionId, approved } = JSON.parse(body);
1223: 
1224:       if (!permissionId) {
1225:         res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1226:         res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Permission ID required' }));
1227:         return;
1228:       }
1229: 
1230:       // OpenCode'a onay/red bilgisini ilet
1231:       const result = await OpenCodeManager.respondToPermission(permissionId, approved);
1232:       
1233:       if (!result.success) {
1234:         console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'error', 'Permission response hatası', { error: result.error });
1235:         res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1236:         res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: result.error || 'Permission yanıtı gönderilemedi' }));
1237:         return;
1238:       }
1239: 
1240:       if (this._session) {
1241:         this._session.status = 'processing';
1242:         this._session.pendingPermission = undefined;
1243:       }
1244: 
1245:       // Permission resolved event yayınla
1246:       this.publish({
1247:         type: 'status.change',
1248:         timestamp: Date.now(),
1249:         sessionId: this._session?.id,
1250:         data: { 
1251:           status: approved ? 'permission_approved' : 'permission_denied',
1252:           permissionId 
1253:         },
1254:       });
1255: 
1256:       res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1257:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, permissionId, approved }));
1258:     } catch (err: unknown) {
1259:       res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1260:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: (err as Error).message }));
1261:     }
1262:   },

1383:   _broadcastToClients(event: SSEEvent): void {
1384:     const data = `data: ${JSON.stringify(event)}\n\n`;
1385:     
1386:     for (const client of this._clients.values()) {
1387:       try {
1388:         client.response.write(data);
1389:       } catch (err) {
1390:         console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'warn', `Client ${client.id} write error`);
1391:         this._clients.delete(client.id);
1392:       }
1393:     }
1394:   },
1395: 
1396:   _disconnectAllClients(): void {
1397:     for (const client of this._clients.values()) {
1398:       try {
1399:         client.response.end();
1400:       } catch {
1401:         // Ignore
1402:       }
1403:     }
1404:     this._clients.clear();
1405:   },
1406: 
1407:   _startHeartbeat(): void {
1408:     this._heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => {
1409:       const event: SSEEvent = {
1410:         type: 'heartbeat',
1411:         timestamp: Date.now(),
1412:       };
1413:       this._broadcastToClients(event);
1414:     }, 15000); // 15 saniye
1415:   },
1416: 
1417:   _stopHeartbeat(): void {
1418:     if (this._heartbeatInterval) {
1419:       clearInterval(this._heartbeatInterval);
1420:       this._heartbeatInterval = null;
1421:     }
1422:   },
1423: 
1424:   _readBody(req: IncomingMessage): Promise<string> {
1425:     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
1426:       let body = '';
1427:       req.on('data', chunk => body += chunk);
1428:       req.on('end', () => resolve(body));
1429:       req.on('error', reject);
1430:     });
1431:   },

1438:   _sessions: new Map<string, SessionState>(),
1439: 
1440:   _handleGetSessions(res: ServerResponse): void {
1441:     const sessions = Array.from(this._sessions.values()).map(s => ({
1442:       id: s.id,
1443:       title: `Session ${s.id.substring(0, 8)}`,
1444:       createdAt: s.startedAt,
1445:       updatedAt: s.lastActivity,
1446:       messageCount: s.messages.length,
1447:       status: s.status,
1448:     }));
1449:     
1450:     // Mevcut session'ı da ekle
1451:     if (this._session && !this._sessions.has(this._session.id)) {
1452:       sessions.unshift({
1453:         id: this._session.id,
1454:         title: `Session ${this._session.id.substring(0, 8)}`,
1455:         createdAt: this._session.startedAt,
1456:         updatedAt: this._session.lastActivity,
1457:         messageCount: this._session.messages.length,
1458:         status: this._session.status,
1459:       });
1460:     }
1461:     
1462:     res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1463:     res.end(JSON.stringify({ sessions }));
1464:   },

1467:     let session = this._sessions.get(sessionId);
1468:     if (!session && this._session?.id === sessionId) {
1469:       session = this._session;
1470:     }
1471:     
1472:     if (!session) {
1473:       res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1474:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Session not found' }));
1475:       return;
1476:     }
1477:     
1478:     res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1479:     res.end(JSON.stringify({ session }));
1480:   },
1481:

1491:       return;
1492:     }

1547:   /**
1548:    * Session güncelle (agent, model, provider değiştir)
1549:    */
1550:   async _handleUpdateSession(req: IncomingMessage, sessionId: string, res: ServerResponse): Promise<void> {
1551:     try {
1552:       const body = await this._readBody(req);
1553:       const { agent, provider, model } = JSON.parse(body || '{}');
1554:       
1555:       console.log('[SSE-SERVER]', 'info', `Session update: ${sessionId}`, { agent, provider, model });
1556:       
1557:       // OpenCode'a gönder (agent/model değiştirme)
1558:       if (agent) {
1559:         const result = await OpenCodeManager.setAgent(agent);
1560:         if (!result.success) {
1561:           res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1562:           res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: result.error || 'Failed to set agent' }));
1563:           return;
1564:         }
1565:       }
1566:       
1567:       if (provider && model) {
1568:         const result = await OpenCodeManager.setModel(provider, model);
1569:         if (!result.success) {
1570:           res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1571:           res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: result.error || 'Failed to set model' }));
1572:           return;
1573:         }
1574:       }
1575:       
1576:       // SSE event gönder
1577:       this.publish({
1578:         type: 'session.updated',
1579:         timestamp: Date.now(),
1580:         sessionId,
1581:         data: { agent, provider, model },
1582:       });
1583:       
1584:       res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1585:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, sessionId, agent, provider, model }));
1586:     } catch (err) {
1587:       console.error('[SSE-SERVER]', 'error', 'Update session error:', err);

1639:       const { messageId } = JSON.parse(body || '{}');
1640:       
1641:       if (!messageId || !this._session) {
1642:         res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1643:         res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Message ID required' }));

1649:         (m, i) => `msg-${m.timestamp}` === messageId || i.toString() === messageId
1650:       );

1653:         this._session.messages = this._session.messages.slice(0, messageIndex + 1);
1654:         this._session.lastActivity = Date.now();
1655:       }
1656:       
1657:       res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1658:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, messageId }));
1659:     } catch (err) {
1660:       res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1661:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: (err as Error).message }));
1662:     }

1665:   async _handleFork(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse): Promise<void> {
1666:     try {
1667:       const body = await this._readBody(req);
1668:       const { messageId, newSessionId } = JSON.parse(body || '{}');
1669:       
1670:       if (!this._session) {
1671:         res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1672:         res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'No active session' }));
1673:         return;
1674:       }
1675:       
1676:       // Mevcut session'ı kaydet
1677:       this._sessions.set(this._session.id, { ...this._session });
1678:       
1679:       // Yeni session oluştur (fork)
1680:       const forkId = newSessionId || `session-fork-${Date.now()}`;
1681:       const messageIndex = messageId 
1682:         ? this._session.messages.findIndex((m) => `msg-${m.timestamp}` === messageId)
1683:         : this._session.messages.length - 1;
1684:       
1685:       const forkedMessages = this._session.messages.slice(0, messageIndex + 1);
1686:       
1687:       const forkedSession: SessionState = {
1688:         id: forkId,
1689:         status: 'idle',
1690:         startedAt: Date.now(),
1691:         lastActivity: Date.now(),
1692:         messages: [...forkedMessages],
1693:       };
1694:       
1695:       this._sessions.set(forkId, forkedSession);
1696:       this._session = forkedSession;
1697:       
1698:       this.publish({
1699:         type: 'session.started',
1700:         timestamp: Date.now(),
1701:         sessionId: forkId,
1702:         data: { session: forkedSession, forkedFrom: messageId },
1703:       });
1704:       
1705:       res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1706:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, sessionId: forkId }));
1707:     } catch (err) {
1708:       res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1709:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: (err as Error).message }));
1710:     }
1711:   },

1717:   async _handleFileSearch(query: string, limit: number, res: ServerResponse): Promise<void> {
1718:     try {
1719:       const { readdirSync } = await import('fs');
1720:       const { join, relative } = await import('path');
1721:       
1722:       const cwd = process.cwd();
1723:       const results: Array<{ name: string; path: string; type: string }> = [];
1724:       
1725:       // Basit recursive dosya arama
1726:       const searchDir = (dir: string, depth = 0) => {
1727:         if (depth > 3 || results.length >= limit) return;
1728:         
1729:         try {
1730:           const entries = readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
1731:           for (const entry of entries) {
1732:             if (results.length >= limit) break;
1733:             if (entry.name.startsWith('.') || entry.name === 'node_modules') continue;
1734:             
1735:             const fullPath = join(dir, entry.name);
1736:             const relPath = './' + relative(cwd, fullPath);
1737:             
1738:             if (entry.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())) {
1739:               results.push({
1740:                 name: entry.name,
1741:                 path: relPath,
1742:                 type: entry.isDirectory() ? 'folder' : 'file',
1743:               });
1744:             }
1745:             
1746:             if (entry.isDirectory()) {
1747:               searchDir(fullPath, depth + 1);
1748:             }
1749:           }
1750:         } catch {
1751:           // Erişim hatası - atla
1752:         }
1753:       };
1754:       
1755:       if (query) {
1756:         searchDir(cwd);
1757:       } else {
1758:         // Query yoksa root dosyaları göster
1759:         try {
1760:           const entries = readdirSync(cwd, { withFileTypes: true });
1761:           for (const entry of entries.slice(0, limit)) {
1762:             if (entry.name.startsWith('.') || entry.name === 'node_modules') continue;
1763:             results.push({
1764:               name: entry.name,
1765:               path: './' + entry.name,
1766:               type: entry.isDirectory() ? 'folder' : 'file',
1767:             });
1768:           }
1769:         } catch {
1770:           // Hata
1771:         }
1772:       }
1773:       
1774:       res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1775:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ files: results }));
1776:     } catch (err) {
1777:       res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1778:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: (err as Error).message, files: [] }));
1779:     }
1780:   },
1781:

1799:       res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
1800:       res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: (err as Error).message }));
1801:     }

 1: import { dirname } from 'path';
 2: import { writeFile, mkdir } from 'fs/promises';
 3: import { existsSync } from 'fs';
 4: import { nativeImage, BrowserWindow, IpcMainInvokeEvent } from 'electron';
 5: import screenshot from 'screenshot-desktop';
 6: 
 7: interface CaptureResult {
 8:   success: boolean;
 9:   dataUrl?: string;
10:   path?: string | null;
11:   message?: string;
12: }
13: 
14: export async function capturePageHandler(
15:   event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
16:   _type: string = 'full',
17:   region: string = ''
18: ): Promise<CaptureResult> {
19:   try {
20:     const win = BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender) || BrowserWindow.getAllWindows()[0];
21:     if (!win) throw new Error('Pencere bulunamadı');
22:     const bounds = win.getBounds();
23:     let rect = { x: 0, y: 0, width: bounds.width, height: bounds.height };
24:     if (region) {
25:       const match = region.match(/(\d+)[;,](\d+)[: ](\d+)[;,](\d+)/);
26:       if (match) {
27:         const [, x, y, w, h] = match.map(Number);
28:         rect = { x, y, width: w, height: h };
29:       }
30:     }
31:     const img = await win.capturePage(rect);
32:     const dataUrl = img.toDataURL();
33:     return { success: true, dataUrl };
34:   } catch (error) {
35:     return { success: false, message: (error as Error).message };
36:   }
37: }
38: 
39: interface ScreenshotOptions {
40:   region?: string;
41:   hideCursor?: boolean;
42:   filePath?: string;
43:   format?: string;
44: }
45: 
46: export async function screenshotCaptureHandler(
47:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent | null,
48:   options: ScreenshotOptions = {}
49: ): Promise<CaptureResult> {
50:   const { region = '', hideCursor: _hideCursor = false, filePath = '', format = 'png' } = options || {};
51:   try {
52:     const useJpg = (format || '').toLowerCase() === 'jpg' || (format || '').toLowerCase() === 'jpeg';
53:     const buffer = await screenshot({ format: useJpg ? 'jpg' : 'png' } as Parameters<typeof screenshot>[0]);
54:     let img = nativeImage.createFromBuffer(Buffer.from(buffer));
55:     if (region) {
56:       const match = region.match(/(\d+)[;,](\d+)[: ](\d+)[;,](\d+)/);
57:       if (match) {
58:         const [, x, y, w, h] = match.map(Number);
59:         img = img.crop({ x, y, width: w, height: h });
60:       }
61:     }
62:     const dataBuffer = useJpg ? img.toJPEG(90) : img.toPNG();
63:     const dataUrl = `data:image/${useJpg ? 'jpeg' : 'png'};base64,${dataBuffer.toString('base64')}`;
64:     const savedPath = filePath;
65:     if (filePath) {
66:       const targetDir = dirname(filePath);
67:       if (!existsSync(targetDir)) {
68:         await mkdir(targetDir, { recursive: true });
69:       }
70:       await writeFile(filePath, dataBuffer);
71:     }
72:     return { success: true, dataUrl, path: savedPath || null };
73:   } catch (error) {
74:     return { success: false, message: (error as Error).message };
75:   }
76: }

143:     const res = await screenshotCaptureHandler(null, options);
144:     if (res?.success) {
145:       await appendLogLine(`[${nowStamp()}] ScreenshotManager saved ${res.path || 'in-memory'}`);
146:       return { success: true, path: res.path || null, dataUrl: res.dataUrl || null };
147:     }
148:     return { success: false, message: res?.message || 'screenshot failed' };
149:   } catch (err: unknown) {
150:     await appendLogLine(`[${nowStamp()}] ScreenshotManager error: ${(err as Error)?.message || err}`);
151:     return { success: false, message: (err as Error)?.message || 'ScreenshotManager error' };
152:   }
153: };
154: 
155: handlers.takescreenshot = handlers.screenshotmanager;
156: 
157: handlers.windowmanager = async (payload: CommandPayload = {}) => {
158:   try {
159:     const { action } = parseWindowArgs(payload?.args || '');
160:     if (!_mainWindow) return { success: false, message: 'no-window' };
161:     let result = false;
162:     if (action === 'minimize') {
163:       _mainWindow.minimize();
164:       result = true;
165:     } else if (action === 'fullscreen' || action === 'maximize') {
166:       _mainWindow.setFullScreen(true);
167:       result = true;
168:     } else if (action === 'restore') {
169:       _mainWindow.restore();
170:       result = true;
171:     }
172:     await appendLogLine(`[${nowStamp()}] WindowManager action=${action} -> ${result}`);
173:     return { success: !!result, action, executed: result };
174:   } catch (err: unknown) {
175:     await appendLogLine(`[${nowStamp()}] WindowManager error: ${(err as Error)?.message || err}`);
176:     return { success: false, message: (err as Error)?.message || 'WindowManager error' };
177:   }
178: };
179: 
180: handlers.restart = async (_payload: CommandPayload = {}) => {
181:   try {
182:     await appendLogLine(`[${nowStamp()}] Restart requested`);
183:     return { success: true, message: 'restart requested' };
184:   } catch (err: unknown) {
185:     await appendLogLine(`[${nowStamp()}] Restart error: ${(err as Error)?.message || err}`);
186:     return { success: false, message: (err as Error)?.message || 'Restart error' };
187:   }
188: };
189: 
190: handlers.listfiles = async (_payload: CommandPayload = {}) => {
191:   try {
192:     if (!_mainWindow) return { success: false, message: 'no-main-window' };
193:     const baseDir = process.cwd();
194:     return { success: true, command: 'ListFiles', path: baseDir, fileName: 'root', lines: 0 };
195:   } catch (err: unknown) {
196:     await appendLogLine(`[${nowStamp()}] ListFiles error: ${(err as Error)?.message || err}`);
197:     return { success: false, message: (err as Error)?.message || 'ListFiles error' };
198:   }
199: };

202:   init(opts: ServerCommandsOptions = {}): void {
203:     _mainWindow = opts.mainWindow || null;
204:   },
205:   async run(_event: IpcMainInvokeEvent | null, commandName: string, payload: CommandPayload = {}): Promise<unknown> {
206:     const key = (commandName || '').toLowerCase();
207:     const handler = handlers[key];
208:     if (handler) return handler(payload);
209:     await appendLogLine(`[${nowStamp()}] Undefined command: ${commandName}`);
210:     return { success: false, message: 'Undefined command' };
211:   },

================
File: electron/whisper-manager.ts
================
 1: import { join } from 'path';
 2: import { readFile, writeFile, mkdir } from 'fs/promises';
 3: import { existsSync } from 'fs';
 4: import type { IpcMainInvokeEvent } from 'electron';
 5: 
 6: interface WhisperData {
 7:   pending: unknown[];
 8:   done: unknown[];
 9: }
10: 
11: /**
12:  * Account ID'den klasör yolunu oluştur
13:  */
14: function getAccountPath(accountId: string): string {
15:   return join(process.cwd(), 'data', accountId);
16: }
17: 
18: /**
19:  * Whisper verilerini yükle (hesap bazlı)
20:  */
21: export async function whisperLoad(
22:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
23:   { accountId }: { accountId: string }
24: ): Promise<WhisperData> {
25:   try {
26:     if (!accountId) {
27:       return { pending: [], done: [] };
28:     }
29:     
30:     const baseDir = getAccountPath(accountId);
31:     const filePath = join(baseDir, 'whisper.json');
32:     
33:     if (!existsSync(filePath)) {
34:       return { pending: [], done: [] };
35:     }
36:     
37:     const data = await readFile(filePath, 'utf-8');
38:     return JSON.parse(data || '{"pending":[],"done":[]}');
39:   } catch (error: unknown) {
40:     return { pending: [], done: [] };
41:   }
42: }
43: 
44: /**
45:  * Whisper verilerini kaydet (hesap bazlı)
46:  */
47: export async function whisperSave(
48:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
49:   { accountId, payload }: { accountId: string; payload?: WhisperData }
50: ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message?: string }> {
51:   try {
52:     if (!accountId) {
53:       return { success: false, message: 'Account ID gerekli' };
54:     }
55:     
56:     const baseDir = getAccountPath(accountId);
57:     const filePath = join(baseDir, 'whisper.json');
58:     
59:     if (!existsSync(baseDir)) {
60:       await mkdir(baseDir, { recursive: true });
61:     }
62:     
63:     await writeFile(filePath, JSON.stringify(payload || { pending: [], done: [] }, null, 2), 'utf-8');
64:     return { success: true };
65:   } catch (error: unknown) {
66:     return { success: false, message: (error as Error).message };
67:   }
68: }

 29: /**

 32: export function minimizeToTray(): void {
 33:   if (!_mainWindow) {
 34:     console.error('[WindowManager] _mainWindow yok!');
 35:     return;
 36:   }
 37: 
 38:   try {
 39:     // Tray yoksa oluştur
 40:     if (!_tray) {
 41:       createTrayInternal();
 42:     }
 43:     
 44:     _isMinimizedToTray = true;
 45:     _mainWindow.hide();
 46:     console.log('[WindowManager] Pencere tray\'e küçültüldü');
 47:   } catch (err) {
 48:     console.error('[WindowManager] minimizeToTray hatası:', err);
 49:   }
 50: }
 51: 
 52: /**
 53:  * Internal: Tray oluştur (bir kez, uygulama boyunca kalır)
 54:  */
 55: function createTrayInternal(): void {
 56:   if (_tray) {
 57:     return;
 58:   }
 59:   
 60:   if (!_trayIconPath) {
 61:     console.error('[WindowManager] Tray icon path yok!');
 62:     return;
 63:   }
 64: 
 65:   try {
 66:     const icon = nativeImage.createFromPath(_trayIconPath);
 67:     _tray = new Tray(icon.resize({ width: 22, height: 22 }));
 68:     
 69:     updateTrayMenu();
 70: 
 71:     // Tek tıklama - pencereyi göster
 72:     _tray.on('click', () => {
 73:       console.log('[WindowManager] Tray click');
 74:       restoreFromTray();
 75:     });
 76: 
 77:     // Çift tıklama - maximize
 78:     _tray.on('double-click', () => {
 79:       console.log('[WindowManager] Tray double-click');
 80:       restoreFromTray();
 81:       _mainWindow?.maximize();
 82:     });
 83: 
 84:     console.log('[WindowManager] Tray oluşturuldu');
 85:   } catch (err) {
 86:     console.error('[WindowManager] Tray oluşturma hatası:', err);
 87:   }
 88: }

 90: /**
 91:  * Tray menüsünü güncelle
 92:  */
 93: function updateTrayMenu() {
 94:   if (!_tray) return;
 95:   
 96:   const contextMenu = Menu.buildFromTemplate([
 97:     {
 98:       label: 'Göster',
 99:       click: () => restoreFromTray()
100:     },
101:     {
102:       label: 'Tam Ekran',
103:       click: () => {

111:       click: () => {

113:         app.quit();
114:       }
115:     }
116:   ]);
117: 
118:   _tray.setToolTip('Hayalet-ev');
119:   _tray.setContextMenu(contextMenu);
120: }

183:       "connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* ws://localhost:*",

  7: /** Error pattern interface */
  8: interface ErrorPattern {
  9:   pattern: RegExp;
 10:   category: string;
 11:   suggestion: string;
 12:   checkFiles: (provider?: string) => string[];
 13:   severity: "high" | "medium" | "low";
 14: }

 16: /**
 17:  * Error pattern'leri
 18:  */
 19: const ERROR_PATTERNS: ErrorPattern[] = [
 20:   {
 21:     pattern: /Cannot read propert(?:y|ies).*of (?:null|undefined)/i,
 22:     category: "dom-selector",
 23:     suggestion: "Selector muhtemelen değişti. Provider'ın DOM yapısını kontrol et.",
 24:     checkFiles: (provider) => provider ? [`src/js/modules/webview/providers/${provider}/config.js`] : [],
 25:     severity: "high",
 26:   },
 27:   {
 28:     pattern: /net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED/i,
 29:     category: "network",
 30:     suggestion: "İnternet bağlantısı yok.",
 31:     checkFiles: () => [],
 32:     severity: "high",
 33:   },
 34:   {
 35:     pattern: /net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED/i,
 36:     category: "network",
 37:     suggestion: "DNS çözümlenemedi. Site erişilebilir mi kontrol et.",
 38:     checkFiles: () => [],
 39:     severity: "high",
 40:   },
 41:   {
 42:     pattern: /Timeout|ETIMEDOUT/i,
 43:     category: "timeout",
 44:     suggestion: "İşlem zaman aşımına uğradı. Ağ yavaş veya site yanıt vermiyor olabilir.",
 45:     checkFiles: () => ["src/js/constants/timeouts.js"],
 46:     severity: "medium",
 47:   },
 48:   {
 49:     pattern: /ENOENT/i,
 50:     category: "filesystem",
 51:     suggestion: "Dosya bulunamadı. Yol doğru mu kontrol et.",
 52:     checkFiles: () => [],
 53:     severity: "medium",
 54:   },
 55:   {
 56:     pattern: /WebSocket.*close|ECONNRESET/i,
 57:     category: "connection",
 58:     suggestion: "Bağlantı koptu. Electron veya site yeniden başlatılabilir.",
 59:     checkFiles: () => [],
 60:     severity: "medium",
 61:   },
 62:   {
 63:     pattern: /Invalid state|already|disposed/i,
 64:     category: "state",
 65:     suggestion: "Geçersiz durum. Webview lifecycle kontrolü yap.",
 66:     checkFiles: () => ["src/js/modules/webview/lifecycle-manager.js"],
 67:     severity: "low",
 68:   },
 69: ];
 70: 
 71: /** Match result interface */
 72: interface MatchResult {
 73:   category: string;
 74:   suggestion: string;
 75:   checkFiles: string[];
 76:   severity: "high" | "medium" | "low";
 77: }
 78: 
 79: /**
 80:  * Error pattern'i eşleştir (internal helper, dışarıdan da kullanılabilir)
 81:  */
 82: export function matchErrorPattern(errorMessage: string, provider: string | null = null): MatchResult | null {
 83:   for (const p of ERROR_PATTERNS) {
 84:     if (p.pattern.test(errorMessage)) {
 85:       return {
 86:         category: p.category,
 87:         suggestion: p.suggestion,
 88:         checkFiles: p.checkFiles(provider || undefined),
 89:         severity: p.severity,
 90:       };
 91:     }
 92:   }
 93:   
 94:   return null;
 95: }
 96: 
 97: /**
 98:  * Hata mesajını analiz et ve ipucu ver
 99:  */
100: export async function getErrorHints(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ToolResult> {
101:   const { errorMessage, provider } = args as { errorMessage?: string; provider?: string };
102:   
103:   if (!errorMessage) {
104:     return {
105:       content: [{ type: "text", text: "❌ 'errorMessage' parametresi gerekli" }],
106:       isError: true,
107:     };
108:   }
109:   
110:   // Pattern'leri kontrol et
111:   for (const ep of ERROR_PATTERNS) {
112:     if (ep.pattern.test(errorMessage)) {
113:       const hint = {
114:         ...ep,
115:         checkFiles: ep.checkFiles(provider),
116:       };
117:       
118:       const output = `🔍 Hata Analizi:
119: 
120: 📝 Mesaj: "${errorMessage}"
121: 
122: 📂 Kategori: ${hint.category}
123: ⚠️ Önem: ${hint.severity}
124: 
125: 💡 Öneri:
126: ${hint.suggestion}
127: 
128: ${hint.checkFiles.length > 0 ? `📁 Kontrol Edilecek Dosyalar:\n${hint.checkFiles.map(f => `- ${f}`).join("\n")}` : ""}`;
129:       
130:       return {
131:         content: [{ type: "text", text: output }],
132:       };
133:     }
134:   }
135:   
136:   // Eşleşme bulunamadı
137:   return {
138:     content: [
139:       {
140:         type: "text",
141:         text: `🔍 Hata analizi:\n\n"${errorMessage}"\n\n❓ Bu hata için bilinen bir pattern bulunamadı.\n\nÖneriler:\n- Log dosyalarını incele\n- Stack trace'i kontrol et\n- İlgili kodu debug et`,
142:       },
143:     ],
144:   };
145: }

  1: /**
  2:  * MCP Server Logger - Session Based
  3:  * 
  4:  * Her MCP server başlatıldığında yeni session oluşturur.
  5:  * Log dosyaları: mcp-server/logs/SESSION_ID/
  6:  *   - mcp.log: Tüm loglar
  7:  *   - error.log: Sadece hatalar
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: import { appendFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync, statSync } from "fs";
 11: import { join, dirname } from "path";
 12: import { fileURLToPath } from "url";
 13: 
 14: const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
 15: const __dirname = dirname(__filename);
 16: const LOG_BASE_DIR = join(__dirname, "..", "logs");
 17: 
 18: // Session ayarları
 19: const MAX_SESSION_AGE_DAYS = 7; // 7 günden eski session'ları sil
 20: const SESSION_ID = generateSessionId();
 21: const SESSION_DIR = join(LOG_BASE_DIR, SESSION_ID);
 22: const LOG_FILE = join(SESSION_DIR, "mcp.log");
 23: const ERROR_FILE = join(SESSION_DIR, "error.log");
 24: 
 25: // Session klasörünü oluştur
 26: ensureSessionDir();
 27: 
 28: export type LogLevel = "debug" | "info" | "warn" | "error";
 29: 
 30: interface LogEntry {
 31:   timestamp: string;
 32:   level: LogLevel;
 33:   tool?: string;
 34:   message: string;
 35:   args?: unknown;
 36:   error?: {
 37:     message: string;
 38:     stack?: string;
 39:   };
 40:   duration?: number;
 41: }
 42: 
 43: /**
 44:  * Session ID oluştur (timestamp bazlı)
 45:  */
 46: function generateSessionId(): string {
 47:   const now = new Date();
 48:   const year = now.getFullYear();
 49:   const month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
 50:   const day = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
 51:   const hour = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, "0");
 52:   const minute = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
 53:   const second = String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2, "0");
 54:   
 55:   return `${year}-${month}-${day}_${hour}-${minute}-${second}`;
 56: }
 57: 
 58: /**
 59:  * Session klasörünü oluştur ve eski session'ları temizle
 60:  */
 61: function ensureSessionDir(): void {
 62:   try {
 63:     // Base log klasörünü oluştur
 64:     if (!existsSync(LOG_BASE_DIR)) {
 65:       mkdirSync(LOG_BASE_DIR, { recursive: true });
 66:     }
 67:     
 68:     // Session klasörünü oluştur
 69:     if (!existsSync(SESSION_DIR)) {
 70:       mkdirSync(SESSION_DIR, { recursive: true });
 71:     }
 72:     
 73:     // Eski session'ları temizle
 74:     cleanOldSessions();
 75:   } catch {
 76:     // Silent fail
 77:   }
 78: }
 79: 
 80: /**
 81:  * 7 günden eski session'ları sil
 82:  */
 83: function cleanOldSessions(): void {
 84:   try {
 85:     const now = Date.now();
 86:     const maxAge = MAX_SESSION_AGE_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
 87:     
 88:     const entries = readdirSync(LOG_BASE_DIR, { withFileTypes: true });
 89:     
 90:     for (const entry of entries) {
 91:       // Sadece session klasörlerini kontrol et (YYYY-MM-DD formatında)
 92:       if (!entry.isDirectory() || !entry.name.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/)) {
 93:         continue;
 94:       }
 95:       
 96:       const sessionPath = join(LOG_BASE_DIR, entry.name);
 97:       const stats = statSync(sessionPath);
 98:       
 99:       if (now - stats.mtimeMs > maxAge) {
100:         rmSync(sessionPath, { recursive: true, force: true });
101:       }
102:     }
103:   } catch {
104:     // Silent fail
105:   }
106: }
107: 
108: /**
109:  * Log bir entry yaz
110:  */
111: function writeLog(entry: LogEntry): void {
112:   try {
113:     const line = JSON.stringify(entry) + "\n";
114:     
115:     // Ana log dosyasına yaz
116:     appendFileSync(LOG_FILE, line, "utf-8");
117:     
118:     // Hata ise error.log'a da yaz
119:     if (entry.level === "error") {
120:       appendFileSync(ERROR_FILE, line, "utf-8");
121:     }
122:   } catch {
123:     // Silent fail - logging hatası uygulamayı durdurmamalı
124:   }
125: }

129:  */
130: export function logToolCall(toolName: string, args: unknown): { startTime: number } {
131:   const startTime = Date.now();
132:   
133:   writeLog({
134:     timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
135:     level: "info",
136:     tool: toolName,
137:     message: "Tool çağrısı başladı",

139:   });

151:     timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),

173:       stack: error.stack,

188:     level: "error",

193:     } : undefined,

202:     timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
203:     level: "debug",
204:     message,
205:     args: data,
206:   });
207: }

209: /**
210:  * Büyük argümanları kısalt (log dosyasını şişirmemek için)
211:  */
212: function truncateArgs(args: unknown, maxLength: number = 1000): unknown {
213:   if (args === null || args === undefined) return args;
214:   
215:   if (typeof args === "string") {
216:     if (args.length > maxLength) {
217:       return args.slice(0, maxLength) + `... (${args.length - maxLength} karakter kesildi)`;
218:     }
219:     return args;
220:   }
221:   
222:   if (typeof args === "object") {
223:     const truncated: Record<string, unknown> = {};
224:     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(args as Record<string, unknown>)) {
225:       if (typeof value === "string" && value.length > maxLength) {
226:         truncated[key] = value.slice(0, maxLength) + `... (${value.length - maxLength} karakter kesildi)`;
227:       } else {
228:         truncated[key] = value;
229:       }
230:     }
231:     return truncated;
232:   }
233:   
234:   return args;
235: }

254: export function readLogs(tail: number = 50, sessionId?: string): string[] {
255:   try {
256:     const targetSession = sessionId || SESSION_ID;
257:     const logFile = join(LOG_BASE_DIR, targetSession, "mcp.log");
258:     
259:     if (!existsSync(logFile)) return [];
260:     
261:     const content = readFileSync(logFile, "utf-8");
262:     const lines = content.trim().split("\n");
263:     
264:     return lines.slice(-tail);
265:   } catch {
266:     return [];
267:   }
268: }

270: /**
271:  * Tüm session'ları listele
272:  */
273: export function listSessions(): Array<{ id: string; date: Date; size: number }> {
274:   try {
275:     const entries = readdirSync(LOG_BASE_DIR, { withFileTypes: true });
276:     const sessions: Array<{ id: string; date: Date; size: number }> = [];
277:     
278:     for (const entry of entries) {
279:       if (!entry.isDirectory() || !entry.name.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/)) {
280:         continue;
281:       }
282:       
283:       const sessionPath = join(LOG_BASE_DIR, entry.name);
284:       const logFile = join(sessionPath, "mcp.log");
285:       
286:       let size = 0;
287:       if (existsSync(logFile)) {
288:         size = statSync(logFile).size;
289:       }
290:       
291:       const stats = statSync(sessionPath);
292:       
293:       sessions.push({
294:         id: entry.name,
295:         date: stats.mtime,
296:         size,
297:       });
298:     }
299:     
300:     // Tarihe göre sırala (en yeni önce)
301:     return sessions.sort((a, b) => b.date.getTime() - a.date.getTime());
302:   } catch {
303:     return [];
304:   }
305: }

  1: /**
  2:  * Web Scraper Utility
  3:  * HTML'den temiz metin çıkarma ve içerik işleme

  5: 
  6: import * as cheerio from "cheerio";
  7: import type { AnyNode } from "domhandler";
  8: import { WEB_TIMEOUTS } from "./timeouts.js";
  9: 
 10: // Kaldırılacak elementler (noise)
 11: const REMOVE_SELECTORS = [
 12:   "script",
 13:   "style",
 14:   "noscript",
 15:   "iframe",
 16:   "svg",
 17:   "canvas",
 18:   "video",
 19:   "audio",
 20:   "nav",
 21:   "footer",
 22:   "header",
 23:   "aside",
 24:   "form",

 44:   "[role='complementary']",
 45:   "[aria-hidden='true']",

 48: // İçerik için öncelikli elementler
 49: const CONTENT_SELECTORS = [
 50:   "article",
 51:   "main",
 52:   "[role='main']",
 53:   ".content",
 54:   ".post",
 55:   ".article",
 56:   ".entry",
 57:   "#content",
 58:   "#main",

 60:   ".post-content",
