 65: export interface ScrapedContent {
 66:   title: string;
 67:   description: string;
 68:   content: string;
 69:   markdown: string;
 70:   url: string;
 71:   wordCount: number;
 72:   language?: string;
 73: }
 74: 
 75: export interface FetchOptions {
 76:   timeout?: number;
 77:   maxLength?: number;
 78:   includeLinks?: boolean;
 79:   userAgent?: string;
 80: }
 81: 
 82: const DEFAULT_OPTIONS: FetchOptions = {
 83:   timeout: WEB_TIMEOUTS.PAGE_FETCH,
 84:   maxLength: 50000, // ~50KB metin
 85:   includeLinks: true,
 86:   userAgent: "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Hayalet-ev/1.0; +https://github.com/)",
 87: };
 88: 
 89: /**
 90:  * URL'den sayfa içeriğini çek ve temizle
 91:  */
 92: export async function fetchAndParse(
 93:   url: string,
 94:   options: FetchOptions = {}
 95: ): Promise<ScrapedContent> {
 96:   const opts = { ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options };
 97: 
 98:   // URL doğrulama
 99:   const parsedUrl = new URL(url);
100:   if (!["http:", "https:"].includes(parsedUrl.protocol)) {
101:     throw new Error("Sadece HTTP/HTTPS URL'leri desteklenir");
102:   }
103: 
104:   // Fetch with timeout
105:   const controller = new AbortController();
106:   const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), opts.timeout);
107: 
108:   try {
109:     const response = await fetch(url, {
110:       signal: controller.signal,
111:       headers: {
112:         "User-Agent": opts.userAgent!,
113:         Accept: "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8",
114:         "Accept-Language": "tr-TR,tr;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7",
115:       },
116:     });
117: 
118:     clearTimeout(timeoutId);
119: 
120:     if (!response.ok) {
121:       throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
122:     }
123: 
124:     const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
125:     if (!contentType.includes("text/html") && !contentType.includes("application/xhtml")) {
126:       throw new Error(`Desteklenmeyen içerik tipi: ${contentType}`);
127:     }
128: 
129:     const html = await response.text();
130:     return parseHTML(html, url, opts);
131:   } finally {
132:     clearTimeout(timeoutId);
133:   }
134: }
135: 
136: /**
137:  * HTML'i parse et ve temiz içerik çıkar
138:  */
139: export function parseHTML(html: string, url: string, options: FetchOptions = {}): ScrapedContent {
140:   const opts = { ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options };
141:   const $ = cheerio.load(html);
142: 
143:   // Noise elementleri kaldır
144:   REMOVE_SELECTORS.forEach((selector) => {
145:     $(selector).remove();
146:   });
147: 
148:   // Metadata çıkar
149:   const title =
150:     $("title").text().trim() ||
151:     $('meta[property="og:title"]').attr("content") ||
152:     $("h1").first().text().trim() ||
153:     "Başlık bulunamadı";
154: 
155:   const description =
156:     $('meta[name="description"]').attr("content") ||
157:     $('meta[property="og:description"]').attr("content") ||
158:     "";
159: 
160:   const language = $("html").attr("lang") || $('meta[http-equiv="content-language"]').attr("content");
161: 
162:   // Ana içeriği bul
163:   let contentElement = null;
164:   for (const selector of CONTENT_SELECTORS) {
165:     const el = $(selector).first();
166:     if (el.length > 0 && el.text().trim().length > 100) {
167:       contentElement = el;
168:       break;
169:     }
170:   }
171: 
172:   // Fallback: body kullan
173:   if (!contentElement) {
174:     contentElement = $("body");
175:   }
176: 
177:   // İçeriği temizle ve çıkar
178:   const content = extractText(contentElement, $, opts.includeLinks!);
179:   const markdown = extractMarkdown(contentElement, $, opts.includeLinks!);
180: 
181:   // Uzunluk limiti uygula
182:   const truncatedContent = content.slice(0, opts.maxLength!);
183:   const truncatedMarkdown = markdown.slice(0, opts.maxLength!);
184: 
185:   return {
186:     title: title.slice(0, 500),
187:     description: description.slice(0, 1000),
188:     content: truncatedContent,
189:     markdown: truncatedMarkdown,
190:     url,
191:     wordCount: truncatedContent.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length,
192:     language: language || undefined,
193:   };
194: }
195: 
196: /**
197:  * Element'ten temiz metin çıkar
198:  */
199: function extractText(
200:   element: cheerio.Cheerio<AnyNode>,
201:   $: cheerio.CheerioAPI,
202:   _includeLinks: boolean
203: ): string {
204:   const lines: string[] = [];
205: 
206:   // Her bloğu işle
207:   element.find("p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, li, td, th, pre, blockquote, div").each((_, el) => {
208:     const $el = $(el);
209:     const tagName = el.tagName?.toLowerCase() || "";
210: 
211:     // Nested elementleri atla
212:     if ($el.find("p, div").length > 0 && !["pre", "blockquote"].includes(tagName)) {
213:       return;
214:     }
215: 
216:     let text = $el.text().trim();
217: 
218:     // Boş veya çok kısa içeriği atla
219:     if (text.length < 3) return;
220: 
221:     // Heading'ler için format
222:     if (tagName.startsWith("h")) {
223:       text = `\n## ${text}\n`;
224:     }
225: 
226:     // Liste elemanları
227:     if (tagName === "li") {
228:       text = `• ${text}`;
229:     }
230: 
231:     // Code blokları
232:     if (tagName === "pre") {
233:       text = `\n\`\`\`\n${text}\n\`\`\`\n`;
234:     }
235: 
236:     // Alıntılar
237:     if (tagName === "blockquote") {
238:       text = `> ${text}`;
239:     }
240: 
241:     lines.push(text);
242:   });
243: 
244:   // Tekrarlanan boş satırları temizle
245:   return lines
246:     .join("\n")
247:     .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
248:     .trim();
249: }
250: 
251: /**
252:  * Element'ten Markdown çıkar
253:  */
254: function extractMarkdown(
255:   element: cheerio.Cheerio<AnyNode>,
256:   $: cheerio.CheerioAPI,
257:   includeLinks: boolean
258: ): string {
259:   const lines: string[] = [];
260: 
261:   element.find("p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, li, pre, blockquote, a, code, strong, em").each((_, el) => {
262:     const $el = $(el);
263:     const tagName = el.tagName?.toLowerCase() || "";
264: 
265:     // İç içe elementleri atla (sadece üst seviye işle)
266:     if ($el.parents("p, li, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6").length > 0) {
267:       return;
268:     }
269: 
270:     let text = "";
271: 
272:     switch (tagName) {
273:       case "h1":
274:         text = `# ${$el.text().trim()}\n`;
275:         break;
276:       case "h2":
277:         text = `## ${$el.text().trim()}\n`;
278:         break;
279:       case "h3":
280:         text = `### ${$el.text().trim()}\n`;
281:         break;
282:       case "h4":
283:         text = `#### ${$el.text().trim()}\n`;
284:         break;
285:       case "h5":
286:       case "h6":
287:         text = `##### ${$el.text().trim()}\n`;
288:         break;
289:       case "p":
290:         text = `${processInlineElements($el, $, includeLinks)}\n`;
291:         break;
292:       case "li":
293:         text = `- ${processInlineElements($el, $, includeLinks)}`;
294:         break;
295:       case "pre": {
296:         const code = $el.find("code").text() || $el.text();
297:         const lang = $el.find("code").attr("class")?.match(/language-(\w+)/)?.[1] || "";
298:         text = `\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${code.trim()}\n\`\`\`\n`;
299:         break;
300:       }
301:       case "blockquote":
302:         text = `> ${$el.text().trim()}\n`;
303:         break;
304:       default:
305:         break;
306:     }
307: 
308:     if (text.trim()) {
309:       lines.push(text);
310:     }
311:   });
312: 
313:   return lines
314:     .join("\n")
315:     .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
316:     .trim();
317: }
318: 
319: /**
320:  * Inline elementleri işle (bold, italic, link, code)
321:  */
322: function processInlineElements(
323:   $el: cheerio.Cheerio<AnyNode>,
324:   $: cheerio.CheerioAPI,
325:   includeLinks: boolean
326: ): string {
327:   let html = $el.html() || "";
328: 
329:   // Strong/Bold
330:   html = html.replace(/<strong[^>]*>(.*?)<\/strong>/gi, "**$1**");
331:   html = html.replace(/<b[^>]*>(.*?)<\/b>/gi, "**$1**");
332: 
333:   // Em/Italic
334:   html = html.replace(/<em[^>]*>(.*?)<\/em>/gi, "*$1*");
335:   html = html.replace(/<i[^>]*>(.*?)<\/i>/gi, "*$1*");
336: 
337:   // Inline code
338:   html = html.replace(/<code[^>]*>(.*?)<\/code>/gi, "`$1`");
339: 
340:   // Links
341:   if (includeLinks) {
342:     html = html.replace(/<a[^>]*href="([^"]*)"[^>]*>(.*?)<\/a>/gi, "[$2]($1)");
343:   } else {
344:     html = html.replace(/<a[^>]*>(.*?)<\/a>/gi, "$1");
345:   }
346: 
347:   // Kalan HTML tag'lerini kaldır
348:   return html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").trim();
349: }
350: 
351: /**
352:  * Metni belirli uzunlukta özetle (basit truncate)
353:  */
354: export function truncateText(text: string, maxLength: number, suffix = "..."): string {
355:   if (text.length <= maxLength) return text;
356: 
357:   // Kelime sınırında kes
358:   const truncated = text.slice(0, maxLength);
359:   const lastSpace = truncated.lastIndexOf(" ");
360: 
361:   if (lastSpace > maxLength * 0.8) {
362:     return truncated.slice(0, lastSpace) + suffix;
363:   }
364: 
365:   return truncated + suffix;
366: }
367: 
368: /**
369:  * URL'in erişilebilir olup olmadığını kontrol et
370:  */
371: export async function checkUrlAccessible(url: string, timeout = WEB_TIMEOUTS.URL_CHECK): Promise<boolean> {
372:   try {
373:     const controller = new AbortController();
374:     const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeout);
375: 
376:     const response = await fetch(url, {
377:       method: "HEAD",
378:       signal: controller.signal,
379:     });
380: 
381:     clearTimeout(timeoutId);
382:     return response.ok;
383:   } catch {
384:     return false;
385:   }
386: }

  1: /**

  5: /**
  6:  * Dosya yolundan extension çıkar
  7:  * @param {string} filePath - Dosya yolu
  8:  * @returns {string} Extension (lowercase, noktasız)
  9:  */
 10: export function getExtension(filePath: string): string {
 11:   if (!filePath) return "";
 12:   return filePath.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() || "";
 13: }
 14: 
 15: /**
 16:  * Dosya yolundan dosya adını çıkar
 17:  * @param {string} filePath - Dosya yolu
 18:  * @returns {string} Dosya adı
 19:  */
 20: export function getFilename(filePath: string): string {
 21:   if (!filePath) return "";
 22:   return filePath.split(/[/\\]/).pop() || "";
 23: }
 24: 
 25: /**
 26:  * Extension'dan MIME type belirle
 27:  * @param {string} ext - Extension (png, jpg, etc.)
 28:  * @returns {string} MIME type
 29:  */
 30: export function getMimeType(ext: string): string {
 31:   const mimeTypes: Record<string, string> = {
 32:     png: "image/png",
 33:     jpg: "image/jpeg",
 34:     jpeg: "image/jpeg",
 35:     gif: "image/gif",
 36:     webp: "image/webp",
 37:     svg: "image/svg+xml",
 38:     bmp: "image/bmp",
 39:     ico: "image/x-icon",
 40:     pdf: "application/pdf",
 41:     txt: "text/plain",
 42:     json: "application/json",
 43:     js: "text/javascript",
 44:     css: "text/css",
 45:     html: "text/html",
 46:     xml: "application/xml",
 47:     zip: "application/zip",
 48:     mp3: "audio/mpeg",
 49:     mp4: "video/mp4",
 50:     wav: "audio/wav",
 51:   };
 52:   return mimeTypes[ext?.toLowerCase()] || "application/octet-stream";
 53: }
 54: 
 55: /**
 56:  * Dosya yolundan MIME type belirle
 57:  * @param {string} filePath - Dosya yolu
 58:  * @returns {string} MIME type
 59:  */
 60: export function getMimeTypeFromPath(filePath: string): string {
 61:   const ext = getExtension(filePath);
 62:   return getMimeType(ext);
 63: }
 64: 
 65: /**
 66:  * Benzersiz ID oluştur
 67:  * @param {string} prefix - ID prefix'i (örn: "cmd", "relay", "whisper")
 68:  * @returns {string} Benzersiz ID
 69:  */
 70: export function generateUniqueId(prefix = "id") {
 71:   return `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
 72: }
 73: 
 74: /**
 75:  * Email adresini dosya/klasör adı için güvenli formata çevir
 76:  * @param {string} email - Email adresi
 77:  * @returns {string} Sanitized email (örn: "user_at_gmail_com")
 78:  */
 79: export function sanitizeEmail(email: string): string {
 80:   if (!email) return "";
 81:   return email
 82:     .toLowerCase()
 83:     .trim()
 84:     .replace(/@/g, "_at_")
 85:     .replace(/\./g, "_");
 86: }
 87: 
 88: /**
 89:  * Email ve provider'dan deterministik account ID oluştur.
 90:  * Aynı email+provider her zaman aynı ID'yi üretir.
 91:  * @param {string} email - Kullanıcı email adresi
 92:  * @param {string} provider - AI provider (chatgpt, grok, gemini, opencode)
 93:  * @returns {string} Account ID (örn: "chatgpt_user_at_gmail_com")
 94:  */
 95: export function generateAccountId(email: string, provider: string): string {
 96:   if (!email || !provider) return "";
 97:   return `${provider}_${sanitizeEmail(email)}`;
 98: }
 99: 
100: /**
101:  * Account ID'den data klasör yolunu oluştur.
102:  * @param {string} accountId - Account ID
103:  * @returns {string} Klasör yolu (örn: "data/chatgpt_user_at_gmail_com")
104:  */
105: export function getAccountDataPath(accountId: string): string {
106:   if (!accountId) return "";
107:   return `data/${accountId}`;
108: }
109: 
110: /**
111:  * Base64 string'i UTF-8 text'e decode et
112:  * @param {string} base64 - Base64 encoded string
113:  * @returns {string} Decoded UTF-8 text
114:  */
115: export function decodeBase64(base64: string): string {
116:   if (!base64) return "";
117:   try {
118:     const binary = atob(base64);
119:     const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
120:     for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
121:       bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
122:     }
123:     const decoder = new TextDecoder("utf-8");
124:     return decoder.decode(bytes);
125:   } catch (_err) {
126:     return "";
127:   }
128: }

  1: /**
  2:  * AIAsistanRelay - AI ve Asistan (AI0) arasındaki iletişimi yöneten relay
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu sınıf AI-to-Asistan konuşmalarını yönetir:
  5:  * - AI1 ↔ AI0 (Asistan) mesaj iletimi
  6:  * - AI2 ↔ AI0 (Asistan) mesaj iletimi
  7:  * 
  8:  * Asistan (AI0) teknik sorulara cevap veren yardımcı AI rolündedir.
  9:  * 
 10:  * Akış:
 11:  * 1. Protokol AI'ye gönderilir (AI-asistan.txt)
 12:  * 2. AI cevap verir → Asistan'a iletilir
 13:  * 3. Asistan cevap verir → AI'ye iletilir
 14:  * 4. Döngü devam eder
 15:  */
 16: 
 17: import { BaseRelay } from "./base-relay.js";
 18: import { SlotController } from "../slot-controller.js";
 19: 
 20: // ============================================================================
 21: // Types
 22: // ============================================================================
 23: 
 24: interface SyncResult {
 25:   messages?: { role?: string; text?: string }[];
 26: }
 27: 
 28: interface CoreEngine {
 29:   sendMessage: (opts: { provider: string; text: string; page: string }) => Promise<unknown>;
 30: }
 31: 
 32: // AI-Asistan protokol dosyası yolu
 33: const PROTOCOL_PATH = "protocol/AI-asistan.txt";
 34: 
 35: export class AIAsistanRelay extends BaseRelay {
 36:   _sourceSlot: string | null;
 37:   _targetSlot: string;
 38:   _prevThinking: Record<string, string>;
 39:   _lastTexts: Record<string, string>;
 40:   _sessionState: string;
 41:   declare coreEngine: CoreEngine;
 42: 
 43:   constructor(coreEngine: CoreEngine) {
 44:     super(coreEngine);
 45:     // Kaynak AI slotu (ai1 veya ai2) ve hedef her zaman ai0 (asistan)
 46:     this._sourceSlot = null;
 47:     this._targetSlot = "ai0";
 48:     this._prevThinking = { ai0: "idle", ai1: "idle", ai2: "idle" };
 49:     this._lastTexts = { ai0: "", ai1: "", ai2: "" };
 50:     
 51:     // Session state: "idle" | "protocol-sent" | "ai-replied" | "relay-active"
 52:     this._sessionState = "idle";
 53:   }
 54: 
 55:   /**
 56:    * Bu relay bu provider'ı yönetiyor mu?
 57:    */
 58:   handlesProvider(provider: string): boolean {
 59:     if (!this._active) return false;
 60:     return provider === this._sourceSlot || provider === this._targetSlot;
 61:   }
 62: 
 63:   /**
 64:    * Kaynak slot'u döndür
 65:    */
 66:   get sourceSlot(): string | null {
 67:     return this._sourceSlot;
 68:   }
 69: 
 70:   /**
 71:    * AI-Asistan relay oturumu başlat
 72:    * Protokolü okur ve AI'ye gönderir, ardından relay aktif olur
 73:    */
 74:   async start(opts: { sourceSlot?: string } = {}): Promise<void> {
 75:     const source = opts.sourceSlot;
 76:     
 77:     if (!source || (source !== "ai1" && source !== "ai2")) {
 78:       throw new Error("Invalid sourceSlot: must be 'ai1' or 'ai2'");
 79:     }
 80: 
 81:     // Kaynak ve hedef bağlı mı kontrol et
 82:     if (!SlotController.isConnected(source)) {
 83:       throw new Error(`Source slot ${source} is not connected`);
 84:     }
 85:     
 86:     if (!SlotController.isConnected(this._targetSlot)) {
 87:       throw new Error(`Asistan (${this._targetSlot}) is not connected`);
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     this._sourceSlot = source;
 91:     this._active = true;
 92:     this._forwardCount = 0;
 93:     this._sessionState = "idle";
 94:     this._lastTexts = { 
 95:       [source]: "", 
 96:       [this._targetSlot]: "" 
 97:     };
 98:     
 99:     const sessionId = this._generateSessionId("ai-asistan");
100:     this._session = {
101:       id: sessionId,
102:       type: "ai-asistan",
103:       sourceSlot: source,
104:       targetSlot: this._targetSlot,
105:       createdAt: Date.now(),
106:     };
107: 
108:     this._log("info", `AI-Asistan Relay started: ${source} ↔ ${this._targetSlot}`);
109:     this._dispatchEvent("relay-changed", { 
110:       active: true, 
111:       type: "ai-asistan",
112:       sourceSlot: source,
113:       targetSlot: this._targetSlot 
114:     });
115: 
116:     // Protokolü oku ve AI'ye gönder
117:     await this._sendProtocolToAI(source);
118:   }
119: 
120:   /**
121:    * Protokol dosyasını oku ve AI'ye gönder
122:    * @private
123:    */
124:   async _sendProtocolToAI(aiSlot: string): Promise<void> {
125:     try {
126:       // Protokol dosyasını oku
127:       const protocol = await this._loadProtocol();
128:       
129:       if (!protocol) {
130:         this._log("warning", "Protocol file could not be loaded, starting without protocol");
131:         this._sessionState = "relay-active";
132:         return;
133:       }
134: 
135:       this._sessionState = "protocol-sent";
136:       this._log("info", `Sending protocol to ${aiSlot}`, { 
137:         sessionId: this._session?.id,
138:         protocolLength: protocol.length 
139:       });
140: 
141:       // AI'ye protokolü gönder
142:       await this.coreEngine.sendMessage({
143:         provider: aiSlot,
144:         text: protocol,
145:         page: "ai-asistan-protocol",
146:       });
147: 
148:       this._log("info", `Protocol sent to ${aiSlot}`);
149: 
150:     } catch (e) {
151:       const err = e as Error;
152:       this._log("warning", `Failed to send protocol: ${err?.message || String(err)}`);
153:       // Protokol gönderilemese de relay'i aktif tut
154:       this._sessionState = "relay-active";
155:     }
156:   }
157: 
158:   /**
159:    * Protokol dosyasını yükle
160:    * @private
161:    */
162:   async _loadProtocol(): Promise<string | null> {
163:     try {
164:       // electronAPI üzerinden dosya oku (base64 olarak döner)
165:       if (window.electronAPI?.readFile) {
166:         const base64 = await window.electronAPI.readFile(PROTOCOL_PATH);
167:         if (base64) {
168:           // Base64'ü decode et
169:           const decoded = this._decodeBase64(base64);
170:           return decoded;
171:         }
172:       }
173:       
174:       // Fallback: fetch ile dene
175:       const response = await fetch(`/${PROTOCOL_PATH}`);
176:       if (response.ok) {
177:         return await response.text();
178:       }
179:       
180:       return null;
181:     } catch (e) {
182:       const err = e as Error;
183:       this._log("warning", `Protocol load error: ${err?.message || String(err)}`);
184:       return null;
185:     }
186:   }
187: 
188:   /**
189:    * Base64 string'i UTF-8 text'e decode et
190:    * @private
191:    */
192:   _decodeBase64(base64: string): string {
193:     try {
194:       const binary = atob(base64);
195:       const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
196:       for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
197:         bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
198:       }
199:       const decoder = new TextDecoder("utf-8");
200:       return decoder.decode(bytes);
201:     } catch (e) {
202:       const err = e as Error;
203:       this._log("warning", `Base64 decode error: ${err?.message || String(err)}`);
204:       return "";
205:     }
206:   }
207: 
208:   /**
209:    * Relay oturumunu durdur
210:    */
211:   async stop(): Promise<void> {
212:     const sessionId = this._session?.id;
213:     const source = this._sourceSlot;
214:     
215:     if (sessionId) {
216:       this._log("info", `AI-Asistan Relay ${sessionId} stopped (${source} ↔ ${this._targetSlot})`);
217:     } else {
218:       this._log("info", "AI-Asistan Relay stopped");
219:     }
220: 
221:     this._sourceSlot = null;
222:     this._sessionState = "idle";
223:     this._resetState();
224:     this._prevThinking = { ai0: "idle", ai1: "idle", ai2: "idle" };
225:     this._lastTexts = { ai0: "", ai1: "", ai2: "" };
226:     
227:     this._dispatchEvent("relay-changed", { active: false, type: "ai-asistan" });
228:   }
229: 
230:   /**
231:    * AI thinking tamamlandığında çağrılır
232:    * State machine'e göre akışı yönetir
233:    */
234:   async handleThinkingComplete(provider: string, syncResult: SyncResult | null): Promise<void> {
235:     try {
236:       if (!syncResult || !Array.isArray(syncResult.messages)) return;
237: 
238:       // Son assistant mesajını bul
239:       const lastAssistant = [...syncResult.messages]
240:         .reverse()
241:         .find((m) => m.role === "assistant" && (m.text || "").trim());
242:       
243:       if (!lastAssistant?.text) return;
244:       
245:       const text = lastAssistant.text.trim();
246: 
247:       // State machine'e göre işle
248:       await this._handleStateMachine(provider, text);
249: 
250:     } catch (e) {
251:       const err = e as Error;
252:       this._log("warning", `handleThinkingComplete error: ${err?.message || String(err)}`);
253:     }
254:   }
255: 
256:   /**
257:    * State machine ile relay akışını yönet
258:    * @private
259:    */
260:   async _handleStateMachine(provider: string, text: string): Promise<void> {
261:     // Aynı mesajı tekrar iletme
262:     if (this._lastTexts[provider] === text) return;
263:     this._lastTexts[provider] = text;
264: 
265:     const sessionId = this._session?.id || "unknown";
266: 
267:     // State: protocol-sent - AI protokole cevap verdi
268:     if (this._sessionState === "protocol-sent" && provider === this._sourceSlot) {
269:       this._sessionState = "ai-replied";
270:       this._log("info", `Session ${sessionId}: AI (${provider}) replied to protocol`, { 
271:         excerpt: text.slice(0, 200) 
272:       });
273: 
274:       // AI'nin cevabını Asistan'a ilet
275:       await this._forwardMessage(provider, this._targetSlot, text);
276:       
277:       // Artık relay aktif
278:       this._sessionState = "relay-active";
279:       return;
280:     }
281: 
282:     // State: relay-active - Normal relay modu
283:     if (this._sessionState === "relay-active" || this._sessionState === "ai-replied") {
284:       await this._handleRelayFlow(provider, text);
285:       return;
286:     }
287: 
288:     // State: idle veya bilinmeyen durum - log yaz
289:     this._log("debug", `Ignoring message in state ${this._sessionState} from ${provider}`);
290:   }
291: 
292:   /**
293:    * Mesajı hedef slot'a ilet
294:    * @private
295:    */
296:   async _forwardMessage(from: string, to: string | null, text: string): Promise<boolean> {
297:     // Hedef bağlı mı kontrol et
298:     if (!to || !SlotController.isConnected(to)) {
299:       this._log("info", `Forward skipped: target ${to} not connected`);
300:       return false;
301:     }
302: 
303:     this._forwardCount += 1;
304:     this._log("info", `AI-Asistan Relay forwarding (#${this._forwardCount}) ${from} -> ${to}`, {
305:       job: { from, to },
306:       excerpt: text.slice(0, 200),
307:     });
308: 
309:     try {
310:       await this.coreEngine.sendMessage({
311:         provider: to,
312:         text,
313:         page: "ai-asistan-relay",
314:       });
315:       return true;
316:     } catch (e) {
317:       const err = e as Error;
318:       this._log("warning", `AI-Asistan Relay forwarding failed: ${err?.message || String(err)}`, {
319:         from,
320:         to,
321:       });
322:       return false;
323:     }
324:   }
325: 
326:   /**
327:    * Normal relay akışını yönet (relay-active state)
328:    * @private
329:    */
330:   async _handleRelayFlow(provider: string, text: string): Promise<void> {
331:     // Hedefi belirle
332:     let target;
333:     if (provider === this._sourceSlot) {
334:       // Kaynak AI'dan mesaj geldi -> Asistan'a ilet
335:       target = this._targetSlot;
336:     } else if (provider === this._targetSlot) {
337:       // Asistan'dan mesaj geldi -> Kaynak AI'a ilet
338:       target = this._sourceSlot;
339:     } else {
340:       // Bu provider bu relay'e ait değil
341:       return;
342:     }
343: 
344:     await this._forwardMessage(provider, target, text);
345:   }
346: 
347:   /**
348:    * Thinking state değişimini takip et
349:    */
350:   checkThinkingTransition(provider: string, thinkingState: string): boolean {
351:     const prev = this._prevThinking[provider] || "idle";
352:     this._prevThinking[provider] = thinkingState;
353:     return prev !== "idle" && thinkingState === "idle";
354:   }
355: }

  1: /**
  2:  * UrlHandler - Slot URL işlemleri
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu modül slot webview URL değişikliklerini yönetir:
  5:  * - URL değişiklik takibi
  6:  * - URL exclusion kontrolü
  7:  * - Navigation event handling
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: import { normalizeUrl, isUrlExcluded as checkUrlExcluded } from "../webview/methods/shared/url-utils.js";
 11: import type { SlotId, LogLevel } from "../../types/index.js";
 12: import type { BaseProviderConfig } from "../../types/provider.js";
 13: 
 14: // ============================================================================
 15: // Types
 16: // ============================================================================
 17: 
 18: /** Webview element tipi */
 19: type WebviewElement = HTMLElement & {
 20:   getURL?: () => string;
 21:   loadURL?: (url: string) => Promise<void>;
 22:   isLoading?: () => boolean;
 23:   src: string;
 24:   addEventListener: (type: string, listener: EventListener, options?: AddEventListenerOptions) => void;
 25:   removeEventListener: (type: string, listener: EventListener) => void;
 26: };
 27: 
 28: /** Slot state - url-handler için gerekli alanlar */
 29: interface UrlHandlerSlotState {
 30:   webview: WebviewElement | null;
 31:   providerConfig: BaseProviderConfig | null;
 32:   state: string;
 33:   currentUrl: string;
 34:   urlExcluded: boolean;
 35:   trafficStarted: boolean;
 36:   correlationId: string;
 37: }
 38: 
 39: /** URL change handler bilgisi */
 40: interface UrlChangeHandlerInfo {
 41:   handler: (event: { url?: string }) => void;
 42:   webview: WebviewElement;
 43: }
 44: 
 45: /** URL change event sabitleri */
 46: interface UrlEvents {
 47:   URL_CHANGED: string;
 48:   URL_EXCLUDED: string;
 49:   URL_INCLUDED: string;
 50: }
 51: 
 52: /** Log fonksiyonu tipi */
 53: type LogFn = (slot: SlotId, level: LogLevel, message: string) => void;
 54: 
 55: /** Event emit fonksiyonu tipi */
 56: type EmitFn = (slot: SlotId, event: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
 57: 
 58: /** Traffic kontrol fonksiyonu tipi */
 59: type TrafficFn = (slot: SlotId, correlationId: string) => void;
 60: 
 61: /** URL change callback tipi */
 62: type UrlChangeCallback = (slot: SlotId, url: string) => void;
 63: 
 64: // ============================================================================
 65: // State
 66: // ============================================================================
 67: 
 68: /**
 69:  * URL change handler'larını saklamak için map
 70:  */
 71: const urlChangeHandlers: Record<string, UrlChangeHandlerInfo> = {};
 72: 
 73: // ============================================================================
 74: // Functions
 75: // ============================================================================
 76: 
 77: /**
 78:  * URL'in excluded olup olmadığını kontrol et
 79:  */
 80: export function checkUrlExclusion(slotState: UrlHandlerSlotState, url: string): boolean {
 81:   const config = slotState.providerConfig;
 82:   
 83:   if (!config?.excludedUrls?.length || !url) return false;
 84: 
 85:   return checkUrlExcluded(url, config.excludedUrls);
 86: }
 87: 
 88: /**
 89:  * URL change handler'ı kur
 90:  */
 91: export function setupUrlChangeHandler(
 92:   slotState: UrlHandlerSlotState,
 93:   slot: SlotId,
 94:   _correlationId: string,
 95:   onUrlChange: UrlChangeCallback
 96: ): void {
 97:   clearUrlChangeHandler(slot);
 98: 
 99:   const webview = slotState.webview;
100:   if (!webview) return;
101: 
102:   const handler = (event: { url?: string }): void => {
103:     const url = event?.url || "";
104:     if (url && url !== "about:blank" && !url.startsWith("data:")) {
105:       onUrlChange(slot, url);
106:     }
107:   };
108: 
109:   urlChangeHandlers[slot] = { handler, webview };
110: 
111:   webview.addEventListener("did-navigate", handler as EventListener);
112:   webview.addEventListener("did-navigate-in-page", handler as EventListener);
113: }
114: 
115: /**
116:  * URL change handler'ı temizle
117:  */
118: export function clearUrlChangeHandler(slot: SlotId): void {
119:   const handlers = urlChangeHandlers[slot];
120:   if (!handlers) return;
121: 
122:   const { handler, webview } = handlers;
123:   try {
124:     webview?.removeEventListener?.("did-navigate", handler as EventListener);
125:     webview?.removeEventListener?.("did-navigate-in-page", handler as EventListener);
126:   } catch (_e) {
127:     // Ignore cleanup errors
128:   }
129:   delete urlChangeHandlers[slot];
130: }
131: 
132: /**
133:  * URL değişikliğini işle
134:  */
135: export function handleUrlChange(
136:   slotState: UrlHandlerSlotState, 
137:   slot: SlotId, 
138:   newUrl: string, 
139:   connectedState: string,
140:   logFn: LogFn, 
141:   emitFn: EmitFn, 
142:   events: UrlEvents,
143:   startTrafficFn: TrafficFn,
144:   stopTrafficFn: TrafficFn
145: ): void {
146:   if (slotState.state !== connectedState) return;
147: 
148:   const normalizedNew = normalizeUrl(newUrl);
149:   const normalizedOld = normalizeUrl(slotState.currentUrl);
150: 
151:   if (normalizedNew === normalizedOld) return;
152: 
153:   logFn(slot, "info", `URL changed: ${normalizedOld} → ${normalizedNew}`);
154:   emitFn(slot, events.URL_CHANGED, { oldUrl: slotState.currentUrl, newUrl });
155: 
156:   slotState.currentUrl = newUrl;
157:   const isExcluded = checkUrlExclusion(slotState, newUrl);
158:   const wasExcluded = slotState.urlExcluded;
159: 
160:   if (isExcluded !== wasExcluded) {
161:     slotState.urlExcluded = isExcluded;
162: 
163:     if (isExcluded && slotState.trafficStarted) {
164:       logFn(slot, "info", `URL now excluded: ${newUrl} - stopping traffic`);
165:       emitFn(slot, events.URL_EXCLUDED, { url: newUrl });
166:       stopTrafficFn(slot, slotState.correlationId);
167:     } else if (!isExcluded && !slotState.trafficStarted) {
168:       logFn(slot, "info", `URL no longer excluded: ${newUrl} - starting traffic`);
169:       emitFn(slot, events.URL_INCLUDED, { url: newUrl });
170:       startTrafficFn(slot, slotState.correlationId);
171:     }
172:   }
173: }
174: 
175: /**
176:  * Webview'ı belirtilen URL'e navigate et
177:  */
178: export function navigate(
179:   slotState: UrlHandlerSlotState,
180:   slot: SlotId,
181:   url: string | null,
182:   connectedState: string,
183:   logFn: LogFn,
184:   emitFn: EmitFn,
185:   navigatedEvent: string
186: ): void {
187:   if (slotState.state !== connectedState) {
188:     logFn(slot, "warning", "Cannot navigate: not connected");
189:     return;
190:   }
191: 
192:   const webview = slotState.webview;
193:   if (!webview) return;
194: 
195:   let targetUrl: string | undefined = url ?? undefined;
196:   if (!targetUrl) {
197:     targetUrl = slotState.providerConfig?.baseUrl;
198:   }
199: 
200:   if (!targetUrl) {
201:     logFn(slot, "warning", "No URL for navigation");
202:     return;
203:   }
204: 
205:   let currentUrl = "";
206:   try {
207:     currentUrl = webview.getURL?.() || webview.getAttribute?.("src") || "";
208:   } catch (_e) {
209:     // Ignore errors
210:   }
211:   
212:   if (normalizeUrl(currentUrl) === normalizeUrl(targetUrl)) {
213:     return;
214:   }
215: 
216:   logFn(slot, "info", `Navigating to ${targetUrl}`);
217: 
218:   try {
219:     if (typeof webview.loadURL === "function") {
220:       webview.loadURL(targetUrl).catch((err: Error) => {
221:         logFn(slot, "warning", `Navigation warning: ${err.message}`);
222:       });
223:     } else {
224:       webview.src = targetUrl;
225:     }
226:     emitFn(slot, navigatedEvent, { url: targetUrl });
227:   } catch (err) {
228:     const error = err as Error;
229:     logFn(slot, "error", `Navigation error: ${error.message}`);
230:   }
231: }

File: src/js/modules/traffic/webview-events.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * WebviewEvents - Traffic webview event yönetimi
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu modül webview navigation eventlerini yönetir:
  5:  * - Event listener attachment/detachment
  6:  * - Navigation event handling
  7:  * - DOM ready handling
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: // ============================================================================
 11: // Types
 12: // ============================================================================
 13: 
 14: interface WebviewElement {
 15:   getWebContentsId?: () => number;
 16:   getURL?: () => string;
 17:   isLoading?: () => boolean;
 18:   executeJavaScript: (script: string) => Promise<unknown>;
 19:   addEventListener: (type: string, listener: EventListener) => void;
 20:   removeEventListener: (type: string, listener: EventListener) => void;
 21: }
 22: 
 23: interface NavigationEvent {
 24:   url?: string;
 25: }
 26: 
 27: interface WebviewCallbacks {
 28:   onNavigation: (provider: string, href: string) => void;
 29:   onDomReady?: (provider: string) => void;
 30:   onFailLoad: (provider: string) => void;
 31:   buildProbeScript: (provider: string) => string;
 32: }
 33: 
 34: interface WebviewListeners {
 35:   didStartLoading: (e: NavigationEvent) => void;
 36:   didStartNavigation: (e: NavigationEvent) => void;
 37:   willNavigate: (e: NavigationEvent) => void;
 38:   didNavigate: (e: NavigationEvent) => void;
 39:   didNavigateInPage: (e: NavigationEvent) => void;
 40:   domReady: () => void;
 41:   failLoad: () => void;
 42: }
 43: 
 44: interface WebviewHandler {
 45:   handleNavEvent: (url: string | undefined, eventType: string) => void;
 46:   domReadyHandler: () => void;
 47:   failLoadHandler: () => void;
 48:   listeners: WebviewListeners;
 49:   webviewEl: WebviewElement;
 50: }
 51: 
 52: // ============================================================================
 53: // State
 54: // ============================================================================
 55: 
 56: /**
 57:  * Webview handler'larını saklamak için map
 58:  */
 59: const webviewHandlers: Record<string, WebviewHandler> = {};
 60: 
 61: // ============================================================================
 62: // Functions
 63: // ============================================================================
 64: 
 65: /**
 66:  * URL'i normalize et (query string ve hash'i kaldır)
 67:  */
 68: export function normalizeHref(href: string | undefined): string {
 69:   if (!href) return "";
 70:   const clean = href.split("?")[0].split("#")[0];
 71:   return clean;
 72: }
 73: 
 74: /**
 75:  * Webview'a event listener'ları ekle
 76:  */
 77: export function attachWebviewEvents(
 78:   provider: string,
 79:   webviewEl: WebviewElement,
 80:   callbacks: WebviewCallbacks
 81: ): void {
 82:   if (!provider || !webviewEl) return;
 83: 
 84:   if (webviewHandlers[provider]) {
 85:     return;
 86:   }
 87: 
 88:   const { onNavigation, onDomReady, onFailLoad, buildProbeScript } = callbacks;
 89: 
 90:   const ensureBridge = (): void => {
 91:     // FIX: Webview'ın hazır olduğunu doğrula
 92:     try {
 93:       if (typeof webviewEl.getWebContentsId !== "function") return;
 94:       webviewEl.getWebContentsId(); // Hazır değilse hata fırlatır
 95:       if (webviewEl.isLoading?.()) return; // Yükleme devam ediyorsa bekle
 96:     } catch (_) {
 97:       return; // Webview henüz hazır değil
 98:     }
 99:     
100:     const script = buildProbeScript(provider);
101:     webviewEl.executeJavaScript(script).catch(() => {
102:       // Ignore
103:     });
104:   };
105: 
106:   const handleNavEvent = (url: string | undefined, _eventType: string): void => {
107:     let href = "";
108:     if (url) {
109:       href = normalizeHref(url);
110:     } else {
111:       try {
112:         href = normalizeHref(webviewEl.getURL?.());
113:       } catch (_err) {
114:         href = "";
115:       }
116:     }
117:     if (!href) return;
118: 
119:     if (href === "about:blank" || href.startsWith("data:")) {
120:       return;
121:     }
122: 
123:     onNavigation(provider, href);
124:   };
125: 
126:   const domReadyHandler = (): void => {
127:     ensureBridge();
128:     try {
129:       handleNavEvent(webviewEl.getURL?.(), "dom-ready");
130:     } catch (_e) {
131:       // Ignore
132:     }
133:     onDomReady?.(provider);
134:   };
135: 
136:   const failLoadHandler = (): void => {
137:     onFailLoad(provider);
138:   };
139: 
140:   const listeners: WebviewListeners = {
141:     didStartLoading: (e: NavigationEvent) => handleNavEvent(e?.url, "did-start-loading"),
142:     didStartNavigation: (e: NavigationEvent) => handleNavEvent(e?.url, "did-start-navigation"),
143:     willNavigate: (e: NavigationEvent) => handleNavEvent(e?.url, "will-navigate"),
144:     didNavigate: (e: NavigationEvent) => handleNavEvent(e?.url, "did-navigate"),
145:     didNavigateInPage: (e: NavigationEvent) => handleNavEvent(e?.url, "did-navigate-in-page"),
146:     domReady: domReadyHandler,
147:     failLoad: failLoadHandler,
148:   };
149: 
150:   webviewHandlers[provider] = {
151:     handleNavEvent,
152:     domReadyHandler,
153:     failLoadHandler,
154:     listeners,
155:     webviewEl,
156:   };
157: 
158:   webviewEl.addEventListener("did-start-loading", listeners.didStartLoading as EventListener);
159:   webviewEl.addEventListener("did-start-navigation", listeners.didStartNavigation as EventListener);
160:   webviewEl.addEventListener("will-navigate", listeners.willNavigate as EventListener);
161:   webviewEl.addEventListener("did-navigate", listeners.didNavigate as EventListener);
162:   webviewEl.addEventListener("did-navigate-in-page", listeners.didNavigateInPage as EventListener);
163:   webviewEl.addEventListener("dom-ready", listeners.domReady as EventListener);
164:   webviewEl.addEventListener("did-fail-load", listeners.failLoad as EventListener);
165: 
166: }
167: 
168: /**
169:  * Webview'dan event listener'ları kaldır
170:  */
171: export function detachWebviewEvents(provider: string): void {
172:   if (!provider) return;
173: 
174:   const handlers = webviewHandlers[provider];
175:   if (!handlers) return;
176: 
177:   const webviewEl = handlers.webviewEl;
178:   const l = handlers.listeners || {};
179: 
180:   try {
181:     try { webviewEl.removeEventListener("did-start-loading", l.didStartLoading as EventListener); } catch (_) { void 0; }
182:     try { webviewEl.removeEventListener("did-start-navigation", l.didStartNavigation as EventListener); } catch (_) { void 0; }
183:     try { webviewEl.removeEventListener("will-navigate", l.willNavigate as EventListener); } catch (_) { void 0; }
184:     try { webviewEl.removeEventListener("did-navigate", l.didNavigate as EventListener); } catch (_) { void 0; }
185:     try { webviewEl.removeEventListener("did-navigate-in-page", l.didNavigateInPage as EventListener); } catch (_) { void 0; }
186:     try { webviewEl.removeEventListener("dom-ready", l.domReady as EventListener); } catch (_) { void 0; }
187:     try { webviewEl.removeEventListener("did-fail-load", l.failLoad as EventListener); } catch (_) { void 0; }
188:   } catch (_err) {
189:     // Ignore
190:   }
191: 
192:   delete webviewHandlers[provider];
193: }
194: 
195: /**
196:  * Provider için handler kayıtlı mı?
197:  */
198: export function hasHandlers(provider: string): boolean {
199:   return !!webviewHandlers[provider];
200: }

 1: /**
 2:  * Catbox.moe upload service
 3:  * Provider-agnostic implementation
 4:  */
 5: 
 6: import { UploadManager } from "../../../upload-manager.js";
 7: import { LogManager } from "../../../log-manager.js";
 8: 
 9: interface FilePayload {
10:   name: string;
11:   path?: string;
12:   base64?: string;
13:   mimeType?: string;
14: }
15: 
16: export async function attachFiles(_webview: HTMLElement, { files }: { files: FilePayload[] }) {
17:   const validation = UploadManager.validateFiles(files);
18:   if (!validation.valid) {
19:     return UploadManager.createError(validation.message || "Validation failed");
20:   }
21: 
22:   if (!UploadManager.isServiceAvailable("CATBOX")) {
23:     return UploadManager.createError("Catbox servisi mevcut değil");
24:   }
25: 
26:   try {
27:     const { uploadedLinks, uploadErrors } = await UploadManager.uploadMultipleFiles(
28:       "CATBOX",
29:       files
30:     );
31: 
32:     LogManager.addEvent(
33:       "file-upload",
34:       "info",
35:       `Catbox upload tamamlandı: ${uploadedLinks.length} başarılı, ${uploadErrors.length} hata`
36:     );
37: 
38:     return UploadManager.formatResponse(uploadedLinks, uploadErrors, "Catbox");
39:   } catch (err) {
40:     const errorMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
41:     LogManager.addEvent("file-upload", "error", `Catbox upload hatası: ${errorMsg}`);
42:     return UploadManager.createError(errorMsg, [], "Catbox");
43:   }
44: }

File: src/js/modules/webview/methods/message/injection.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Message injection method
  3:  * Provider-agnostic implementation using runtime config
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: interface InjectResult {
  7:   success?: boolean;
  8:   message?: string;
  9:   inputType?: string;
 10:   providerId?: string;
 11: }
 12: 
 13: interface WebviewElement extends HTMLElement {
 14:   executeJavaScript: (code: string) => Promise<InjectResult | undefined>;
 15:   sendInputEvent: (event: { type: string; keyCode: string }) => void;
 16: }
 17: 
 18: export async function sendMessage(webview: WebviewElement, { message }: { message: string }) {
 19:   // JSON.stringify ile mesajı güvenli hale getir - newline'lar korunur ("\n" olarak)
 20:   const safeMessage = JSON.stringify(message);
 21: 
 22:   const injectScript = `(function() {
 23:     const message = ${safeMessage};
 24: 
 25:     const config = window.__hayalet_provider_config;
 26:     if (!config || !config.selectors) {
 27:       return { success: false, message: 'Provider config bulunamadı' };
 28:     }
 29: 
 30:     const inputSelector = config.selectors.inputField;
 31: 
 32:     if (!inputSelector) {
 33:       return { success: false, message: 'Configde input selector bulunamadi' };
 34:     }
 35: 
 36:     const textarea = document.querySelector(inputSelector);
 37:     if (!textarea) {
 38:       return { success: false, message: 'Textarea (' + inputSelector + ') bulunamadi' };
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     const inputType = config.inputType || 'direct';
 42: 
 43:     if (inputType === 'character-by-character') {
 44:       textarea.focus();
 45:       if (typeof textarea.value !== 'undefined') textarea.value = '';
 46:       if (typeof textarea.textContent !== 'undefined') textarea.textContent = '';
 47:       return {
 48:         success: true,
 49:         message: 'Textarea temizlendi ve odaklandı',
 50:         providerId: config.id,
 51:         inputType: inputType
 52:       };
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     // ProseMirror editör kontrolü (ChatGPT ve benzeri)
 56:     // ProseMirror class'ı varsa veya içinde ProseMirror elementleri varsa
 57:     const isProseMirror = textarea.classList.contains('ProseMirror') || 
 58:                           textarea.querySelector('.ProseMirror') ||
 59:                           textarea.querySelector('[class*="ProseMirror"]') ||
 60:                           textarea.id === 'prompt-textarea';
 61: 
 62:     if (isProseMirror || textarea.contentEditable === 'true' || textarea.isContentEditable) {
 63:       textarea.focus();
 64:       
 65:       // Önce mevcut içeriği temizle
 66:       textarea.innerHTML = '';
 67:       
 68:       // ProseMirror için her satırı ayrı <p> elementi olarak ekle
 69:       // Bu newline'ları doğru şekilde korur
 70:       const lines = message.split('\\n');
 71:       const html = lines.map(line => {
 72:         // Boş satırlar için <br> ekle
 73:         if (line.trim() === '') {
 74:           return '<p><br></p>';
 75:         }
 76:         // HTML karakterlerini escape et
 77:         const escaped = line
 78:           .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
 79:           .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
 80:           .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
 81:         return '<p>' + escaped + '</p>';
 82:       }).join('');
 83:       
 84:       textarea.innerHTML = html;
 85:       textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
 86:       
 87:       return {
 88:         success: true,
 89:         message: 'Mesaj ProseMirror/contenteditable içine yazıldı',
 90:         providerId: config.id,
 91:         inputType: inputType,
 92:         isProseMirror: isProseMirror
 93:       };
 94:     }
 95: 
 96:     // Standard textarea için value kullan - newline'lar otomatik korunur
 97:     textarea.focus();
 98:     
 99:     // Önce mevcut içeriği temizle
100:     textarea.value = '';
101:     
102:     textarea.value = message;
103: 
104:     textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
105:     textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
106: 
107:     return {
108:       success: true,
109:       message: 'Mesaj textarea içine yazıldı',
110:       providerId: config.id,
111:       inputType: inputType
112:     };
113:   })();`;
114: 
115:   const result = await webview.executeJavaScript(injectScript);
116:   if (!result?.success) {
117:     return { success: false, message: result?.message || "Mesaj eklenemedi" };
118:   }
119: 
120:   if (result.inputType === "character-by-character") {
121:     const fullText = ` ${message}`;
122:     try {
123:       for (const ch of fullText) {
124:         if (ch === "\n") {
125:           // Newline için Shift+Enter - executeJavaScript ile simüle et
126:           // sendInputEvent modifiers düzgün çalışmıyor
127:           await webview.executeJavaScript(`(function() {
128:             const config = window.__hayalet_provider_config;
129:             const inputSelector = config?.selectors?.inputField;
130:             const el = inputSelector ? document.querySelector(inputSelector) : document.activeElement;
131:             if (!el) return;
132:             
133:             // Shift+Enter simülasyonu
134:             const keydownEvent = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {
135:               key: 'Enter',
136:               code: 'Enter',
137:               keyCode: 13,
138:               which: 13,
139:               shiftKey: true,
140:               bubbles: true,
141:               cancelable: true
142:             });
143:             el.dispatchEvent(keydownEvent);
144:             
145:             // Textarea ise value'ya newline ekle
146:             if (el.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || el.tagName === 'INPUT') {
147:               const start = el.selectionStart || el.value.length;
148:               const end = el.selectionEnd || el.value.length;
149:               el.value = el.value.substring(0, start) + '\\n' + el.value.substring(end);
150:               el.selectionStart = el.selectionEnd = start + 1;
151:               el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
152:             }
153:             
154:             const keyupEvent = new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {
155:               key: 'Enter',
156:               code: 'Enter',
157:               keyCode: 13,
158:               which: 13,
159:               shiftKey: true,
160:               bubbles: true,
161:               cancelable: true
162:             });
163:             el.dispatchEvent(keyupEvent);
164:           })();`);
165:         } else {
166:           webview.sendInputEvent({ type: "char", keyCode: ch });
167:         }
168:       }
169:     } catch (err) {
170:       return {
171:         success: false,
172:         message: `Metin yazılamadı: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`,
173:       };
174:     }
175:   }
176: 
177:   return {
178:     success: true,
179:     message: "Mesaj textarea içine yazıldı",
180:   };
181: }

================
File: src/js/modules/webview/methods/message/xdotools.ts
================
 1: /**
 2:  * XDotools message method
 3:  * System-level input simulation for message sending
 4:  */
 5: 
 6: interface WebviewElement extends HTMLElement {
 7:   executeJavaScript: (code: string) => Promise<unknown>;
 8:   sendInputEvent: (event: { type: string; keyCode: string }) => void;
 9: }
10: 
11: export async function sendMessage(webview: WebviewElement, { message }: { message: string }) {
12:   const fullText = ` ${message}`;
13: 
14:   const focusScript = `(function() {
15:     const config = window.__hayalet_provider_config;
16:     if (!config || !config.selectors?.inputField) {
17:       return false;
18:     }
19: 
20:     const textarea = document.querySelector(config.selectors.inputField);
21:     if (textarea) {
22:       textarea.focus();
23:       if (typeof textarea.value !== 'undefined') textarea.value = '';
24:       if (typeof textarea.textContent !== 'undefined') textarea.textContent = '';
25:       return true;
26:     }
27:     return false;
28:   })();`;
29: 
30:   const focused = await webview.executeJavaScript(focusScript);
31:   if (!focused) {
32:     return { success: false, message: "Composer textarea/div bulunamadı" };
33:   }
34: 
35:   try {
36:     for (const ch of fullText) {
37:       webview.sendInputEvent({ type: "char", keyCode: ch });
38:     }
39:   } catch (err) {
40:     return {
41:       success: false,
42:       message: `Metin yazılamadı: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`,
43:     };
44:   }
45: 
46:   return {
47:     success: true,
48:     message: "Mesaj karakter karakter yazıldı",
49:   };
50: }

File: src/js/modules/webview/methods/shared/file-utils.ts
================
 1: /**
 2:  * File utility functions shared across all upload methods
 3:  * Provider-agnostic and reusable
 4:  */
 5: 
 6: /**
 7:  * Validate files array
 8:  * @param {Array} files - Files to validate
 9:  * @returns {Object} Validation result
10:  */
11: interface FilePayload {
12:   name: string;
13:   base64?: string;
14:   path?: string;
15:   mimeType?: string;
16: }
17: 
18: interface UploadError {
19:   file: string;
20:   error: string;
21: }
22: 
23: export function validateFiles(files: FilePayload[]): { valid: boolean; message?: string } {
24:   if (!files?.length) {
25:     return { valid: false, message: "Aktarılacak dosya bulunamadı" };
26:   }
27: 
28:   for (const file of files) {
29:     if (!file.name || !file.base64) {
30:       return {
31:         valid: false,
32:         message: `Geçersiz dosya: ${file.name || "isimsiz"}`,
33:       };
34:     }
35:   }
36: 
37:   return { valid: true };
38: }
39: 
40: /**
41:  * Format upload response consistently
42:  * @param {Array} uploadedLinks - Successfully uploaded files
43:  * @param {Array} errors - Error messages
44:  * @param {string} serviceName - Name of the upload service
45:  * @returns {Object} Formatted response
46:  */
47: export function formatUploadResponse(
48:   uploadedLinks: string[],
49:   errors: UploadError[] = [],
50:   serviceName = "",
51: ) {
52:   if (!uploadedLinks.length) {
53:     return {
54:       success: false,
55:       message: `${serviceName} yükleme başarısız: ${errors.join("; ")}`,
56:       errors,
57:       injected: false,
58:     };
59:   }
60: 
61:   return {
62:     success: true,
63:     message: `${uploadedLinks.length} dosya yüklendi ve linki hazır`,
64:     uploadedLinks,
65:     errors: errors.length ? errors : undefined,
66:     injected: false,
67:   };
68: }
69: 
70: /**
71:  * Standardize error response
72:  * @param {string} message - Error message
73:  * @param {Array} errors - Additional errors (optional)
74:  * @param {string} serviceName - Service name (optional)
75:  * @returns {Object} Standardized error response
76:  */
77: export function createErrorResponse(message: string, errors: UploadError[] = [], serviceName = "") {
78:   return {
79:     success: false,
80:     message: serviceName ? `${serviceName} hatası: ${message}` : message,
81:     errors,
82:     injected: false,
83:   };
84: }

File: src/js/modules/webview/providers/opencode/scraper.ts
================
 1: /**
 2:  * OpenCode Provider - Conversation Scraper
 3:  * 
 4:  * DOM'dan mesajları çeker ve yapılandırılmış formata dönüştürür
 5:  */
 6: 
 7: interface ScrapedMessage {
 8:   index: number;
 9:   role: "user" | "assistant";
10:   text: string;
11: }
12: 
13: export function scrapeMessages(): ScrapedMessage[] {
14:   const result: ScrapedMessage[] = [];
15:   let index = 0;
16: 
17:   // Kullanıcı mesajlarını bul
18:   const userMessages = document.querySelectorAll(
19:     '[data-component="user-message"] [data-slot="user-message-text"]'
20:   );
21: 
22:   // Asistan mesajlarını bul
23:   const assistantMessages = document.querySelectorAll(
24:     '[data-slot="session-turn-summary-section"] [data-component="markdown"]'
25:   );
26: 
27:   // Session turn'leri bul (sıralama için)
28:   const sessionTurns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot="session-turn-message-content"]');
29:   
30:   if (sessionTurns.length > 0) {
31:     // Session turn bazlı scraping
32:     sessionTurns.forEach((turn) => {
33:       // Kullanıcı mesajı
34:       const userMsg = turn.querySelector('[data-component="user-message"] [data-slot="user-message-text"]') as HTMLElement | null;
35:       if (userMsg) {
36:         const text = (userMsg.innerText || userMsg.textContent || "").trim();
37:         if (text) {
38:           result.push({ index: index++, role: "user", text });
39:         }
40:       }
41:     });
42: 
43:     // Asistan response'ları (summary section içinde)
44:     const summaries = document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot="session-turn-summary-section"]');
45:     summaries.forEach((summary) => {
46:       const markdown = summary.querySelector('[data-component="markdown"]') as HTMLElement | null;
47:       if (markdown) {
48:         const text = (markdown.innerText || markdown.textContent || "").trim();
49:         if (text) {
50:           result.push({ index: index++, role: "assistant", text });
51:         }
52:       }
53:     });
54:   } else {
55:     // Fallback: Ayrı ayrı mesajları topla
56:     userMessages.forEach((node) => {
57:       const el = node as HTMLElement;
58:       const text = (el.innerText || el.textContent || "").trim();
59:       if (text) {
60:         result.push({ index: index++, role: "user", text });
61:       }
62:     });
63: 
64:     assistantMessages.forEach((node) => {
65:       const el = node as HTMLElement;
66:       const text = (el.innerText || el.textContent || "").trim();
67:       if (text) {
68:         result.push({ index: index++, role: "assistant", text });
69:       }
70:     });
71:   }
72: 
73:   return result;
74: }

  5: class CatchManagerClass {
  6:   /**
  7:    * Scans a list of messages for commands based on a given prefix.
  8:    * @param {object} options
  9:    * @param {string} options.provider - The provider of the messages (e.g., 'ai1', 'ai2').
 10:    * @param {string} options.webUrl - The URL of the conversation.
 11:    * @param {any[]} [options.messages=[]] - The list of message objects to scan.
 12:    * @param {number} [options.prevCount=0] - The number of messages previously synced.
 13:    * @param {boolean} [options.hasExisting=false] - Whether the conversation already exists in the archive.
 14:    * @param {string} [options.prefix='cmd'] - The command prefix to look for (e.g., 'cmd', 'chat', 'bg').
 15:    * @returns {Promise<any[]>} - A promise that resolves to an array of found and validated commands.
 16:    */
 17:   async catchCommands({
 18:     provider,
 19:     webUrl,
 20:     messages = [],
 21:     prevCount = 0,
 22:     hasExisting = false,
 23:     prefix = "cmd",
 24:   }: {
 25:     provider: string;
 26:     webUrl: string;
 27:     messages?: Array<{ role?: string; text?: string; index?: number }>;
 28:     prevCount?: number;
 29:     hasExisting?: boolean;
 30:     prefix?: string;
 31:   }) {
 32:     const list = Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : [];
 33:     const startIndex = hasExisting
 34:       ? Math.max(0, Math.min(prevCount, list.length))
 35:       : 0;
 36:     const targetMessages = list.filter(
 37:       (msg) => msg?.role === "assistant" && (msg.index || 0) >= startIndex,
 38:     );
 39: 
 40:     const found: Array<{ provider: string; command: string; args: string; prefix: string; text: string; webUrl: string }> = [];
 41: 
 42:     targetMessages.forEach((msg) => {
 43:       const text = msg.text || "";
 44:       const regex = new RegExp(
 45:         `\\+\\+${prefix}:([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\\(([^)]*)\\)`,
 46:         "g",
 47:       );
 48:       let match;
 49:       while ((match = regex.exec(text)) !== null) {
 50:         const [, name, argsRaw] = match;
 51:         found.push({
 52:           provider,
 53:           command: name,
 54:           args: (argsRaw || "").trim(),
 55:           prefix,
 56:           text,
 57:           webUrl,
 58:         });
 59:         LogManager.addEvent(
 60:           `catch-${provider}`,
 61:           "info",
 62:           `Komut bulundu [${prefix}]: ${name}${argsRaw ? " | " + argsRaw : ""}`,
 63:         );
 64:       }
 65:     });
 66: 
 67:     if (prefix === "cmd") {
 68:       try {
 69:         // Sistem komutları + custom komutlar
 70:         const systemCmds = (ServerCommands.list() || []).map((s) =>
 71:           String(s).toLowerCase(),
 72:         );
 73:         const customCmds = MetaCommandManager.getCommandNames().map((s) =>
 74:           String(s).toLowerCase(),
 75:         );
 76:         const valid = [...systemCmds, ...customCmds];
 77:         
 78:         const filtered = found.filter((f) =>
 79:           valid.includes(String(f.command || "").toLowerCase()),
 80:         );
 81:         if (found.length && !filtered.length) {
 82:           LogManager.addEvent(
 83:             `catch-${provider}`,
 84:             "warning",
 85:             `++cmd komutları bulundu fakat kayıtlı komut listesinde eşleşme yok (${found
 86:               .map((f) => f.command)
 87:               .join(", ")})`,
 88:           );
 89:         }
 90:         return filtered;
 91:       } catch (err) {
 92:         const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
 93:         LogManager.addEvent(
 94:           `catch-${provider}`,
 95:           "warning",
 96:           `ServerCommands kontrolü yapılamadı: ${message}`,
 97:         );
 98:         return found;
 99:       }
100:     }
101: 
102:     // Meta komutlar - DefineCommand, DeleteCommand, ListCommands
103:     if (prefix === "meta") {
104:       return found; // Tüm meta komutları geçerli
105:     }
106: 
107:     return found;
108:   }
109: }
110: 
111: export const CatchManager = new CatchManagerClass();

File: src/js/modules/ipc-client.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * IPC Client - Type-Safe IPC Wrapper
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu modül renderer process'ten main process'e type-safe IPC çağrıları yapmayı sağlar.
  5:  * 
  6:  * @example
  7:  * import { IPC } from "./ipc-client.js";
  8:  * 
  9:  * // Type-safe çağrı - params ve result tipleri otomatik
 10:  * const result = await IPC.invoke("db-get-conversations", { accountId: "123" });
 11:  * if (result.success) {
 12:  *   console.log(result.data); // DbConversation[] tipinde
 13:  * }
 14:  * 
 15:  * // Hata durumunda null döner
 16:  * const safeResult = await IPC.safeInvoke("db-get-messages", { accountId: "123", conversationId: "456" });
 17:  */
 18: 
 19: import { LogManager } from "./log-manager.js";
 20: import { getErrorMessage } from "../types/index.js";
 21: import type { IPCChannel, IPCParams, IPCResult } from "../types/ipc-channels.js";
 22: 
 23: // ============================================================================
 24: // Types
 25: // ============================================================================
 26: 
 27: interface ElectronAPI {
 28:   invoke: (channel: string, params?: unknown) => Promise<unknown>;
 29:   send: (channel: string, params?: unknown) => void;
 30:   on: (channel: string, callback: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => () => void;
 31: }
 32: 
 33: // ============================================================================
 34: // IPC Client Class
 35: // ============================================================================
 36: 
 37: class IPCClientClass {
 38:   private _api: ElectronAPI | null = null;
 39: 
 40:   /**
 41:    * ElectronAPI referansını al (lazy init)
 42:    */
 43:   private get api(): ElectronAPI {
 44:     if (!this._api) {
 45:       const electronAPI = (window as unknown as { electronAPI?: ElectronAPI }).electronAPI;
 46:       if (!electronAPI) {
 47:         throw new Error("electronAPI not available - preload script may not have loaded");
 48:       }
 49:       this._api = electronAPI;
 50:     }
 51:     return this._api;
 52:   }
 53: 
 54:   /**
 55:    * Type-safe IPC invoke
 56:    * 
 57:    * @param channel - IPC kanal adı
 58:    * @param params - Kanal parametreleri (tip otomatik)
 59:    * @returns Promise<Result> - Kanal sonucu (tip otomatik)
 60:    * @throws Error - IPC hatası durumunda
 61:    * 
 62:    * @example
 63:    * const result = await IPC.invoke("db-get-conversations", { accountId: "123" });
 64:    */
 65:   async invoke<T extends IPCChannel>(
 66:     channel: T,
 67:     ...args: IPCParams<T> extends void ? [] : [IPCParams<T>]
 68:   ): Promise<IPCResult<T>> {
 69:     const params = args[0];
 70:     return this.api.invoke(channel, params) as Promise<IPCResult<T>>;
 71:   }
 72: 
 73:   /**
 74:    * Safe IPC invoke - hata durumunda null döner, exception fırlatmaz
 75:    * 
 76:    * @param channel - IPC kanal adı
 77:    * @param params - Kanal parametreleri
 78:    * @returns Promise<Result | null> - Sonuç veya null
 79:    * 
 80:    * @example
 81:    * const result = await IPC.safeInvoke("db-get-messages", { accountId: "123", conversationId: "456" });
 82:    * if (result) {
 83:    *   // result tipi otomatik
 84:    * }
 85:    */
 86:   async safeInvoke<T extends IPCChannel>(
 87:     channel: T,
 88:     ...args: IPCParams<T> extends void ? [] : [IPCParams<T>]
 89:   ): Promise<IPCResult<T> | null> {
 90:     try {
 91:       const params = args[0];
 92:       return await this.api.invoke(channel, params) as IPCResult<T>;
 93:     } catch (error) {
 94:       LogManager.addEvent("ipc-client", "error", `IPC invoke failed: ${channel} - ${getErrorMessage(error)}`);
 95:       return null;
 96:     }
 97:   }
 98: 
 99:   /**
100:    * IPC send (fire-and-forget)
101:    * 
102:    * @param channel - IPC kanal adı
103:    * @param params - Kanal parametreleri
104:    */
105:   send<T extends IPCChannel>(
106:     channel: T,
107:     ...args: IPCParams<T> extends void ? [] : [IPCParams<T>]
108:   ): void {
109:     const params = args[0];
110:     this.api.send(channel, params);
111:   }
112: 
113:   /**
114:    * IPC event listener
115:    * 
116:    * @param channel - IPC kanal adı
117:    * @param callback - Event callback
118:    * @returns Unsubscribe fonksiyonu
119:    */
120:   on<T extends IPCChannel>(
121:     channel: T,
122:     callback: (result: IPCResult<T>) => void
123:   ): () => void {
124:     return this.api.on(channel, (data) => callback(data as IPCResult<T>));
125:   }
126: 
127:   /**
128:    * ElectronAPI mevcut mu kontrol et
129:    */
130:   isAvailable(): boolean {
131:     return !!(window as unknown as { electronAPI?: ElectronAPI }).electronAPI;
132:   }
133: }
134: 
135: /**
136:  * Singleton IPC Client instance
137:  */
138: export const IPC = new IPCClientClass();

  1: /**
  2:  * ServerCommands - Komut Dispatcher (Orchestrator)
  3:  * 
  4:  * Alt modüller:
  5:  * - commands/utils.js: Ortak yardımcı fonksiyonlar
  6:  * - commands/device-commands.js: DeviceManager handler
  7:  * - commands/screenshot-commands.js: Screenshot handler'ları
  8:  * - commands/window-commands.js: Window handler'ları
  9:  * - commands/whisper-commands.js: Whisper handler
 10:  * - commands/file-commands.js: File handler'ları
 11:  * - commands/ai-chat-commands.js: AI-AI chat handler'ları
 12:  */
 13: 
 14: import { LogManager } from "./log-manager.js";
 15: import { createDefaultHandler } from "./commands/utils.js";
 16: 
 17: import { deviceManagerHandler } from "./commands/device-commands.js";
 18: import { screenshotManagerHandler, takeScreenshotHandler } from "./commands/screenshot-commands.js";
 19: import { 
 20:   windowManagerHandler, 
 21:   minimizeHandler, 
 22:   maximizeHandler, 
 23:   restoreHandler,
 24:   restartHandler 
 25: } from "./commands/window-commands.js";
 26: import { whisperManagerHandler } from "./commands/whisper-commands.js";
 27: import { listFilesHandler } from "./commands/file-commands.js";
 28: import { aiaiChatStartHandler, aiaiChatStopHandler, aiAsistanChatStartHandler, aiAsistanChatStopHandler } from "./commands/ai-chat-commands.js";
 29: import { MetaCommandManager } from "./meta-command-manager.js";
 30: 
 31: // ============================================
 32: // ============================================
 33: 
 34: const COMMAND_LIST = [
 35:   "DeviceManager",
 36:   "FileManager",
 37:   "WebviewManager",
 38:   "WhisperManager",
 39:   "WindowManager",
 40:   "ScreenshotManager",
 41:   "TakeScreenshot",
 42:   "PlayMusic",
 43:   "Restart",
 44:   "AIAIChatStart",
 45:   "AIAIChatStop",
 46:   "AIAsistanChatStart",
 47:   "AIAsistanChatStop",
 48:   "GetFile",
 49:   "GetItDone",
 50:   "ListFiles",
 51:   // Meta komutlar
 52:   "DefineCommand",
 53:   "DeleteCommand",
 54:   "ListCustomCommands",
 55: ];
 56: 
 57: // ============================================
 58: // ============================================
 59: 
 60: const handlers: Record<string, (payload?: any) => Promise<any>> = {};
 61: 
 62: COMMAND_LIST.forEach((name) => {
 63:   const key = name.toLowerCase();
 64:   if (!["whispermanager", "devicemanager", "screenshotmanager", "takescreenshot", 
 65:        "windowmanager", "minimize", "maximize", "restore", "restart",
 66:        "listfiles", "aiaichatstart", "aiaichatstop", "aiasistanchatstart", "aiasistanchatstop"].includes(key)) {
 67:     handlers[key] = createDefaultHandler(name);
 68:   }
 69: });
 70: 
 71: handlers.devicemanager = deviceManagerHandler;
 72: handlers.screenshotmanager = screenshotManagerHandler;
 73: handlers.takescreenshot = takeScreenshotHandler;
 74: handlers.windowmanager = windowManagerHandler;
 75: handlers.minimize = minimizeHandler;
 76: handlers.maximize = maximizeHandler;
 77: handlers.restore = restoreHandler;
 78: handlers.restart = restartHandler;
 79: handlers.whispermanager = whisperManagerHandler;
 80: handlers.listfiles = listFilesHandler;
 81: handlers.aiaichatstart = aiaiChatStartHandler;
 82: handlers.aiaichatstop = aiaiChatStopHandler;
 83: handlers.aiasistanchatstart = aiAsistanChatStartHandler;
 84: handlers.aiasistanchatstop = aiAsistanChatStopHandler;
 85: 
 86: // Meta komut handler'ları
 87: handlers.definecommand = async (payload) => {
 88:   const args = payload?.args || "";
 89:   // Format: DefineCommand(Name, "description", `code`)
 90:   // Parse: İlk virgüle kadar isim, sonra açıklama, sonra kod
 91:   const match = args.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*,\s*"([^"]*)"\s*,\s*`([\s\S]*)`$/);
 92:   
 93:   if (!match) {
 94:     return { success: false, error: "Geçersiz format. Kullanım: DefineCommand(Name, \"açıklama\", `kod`)" };
 95:   }
 96:   
 97:   const [, name, description, code] = match;
 98:   const result = await MetaCommandManager.defineCommand(name, description, code, payload?.sender || "unknown");
 99:   return result;
100: };
101: 
102: handlers.deletecommand = async (payload) => {
103:   const name = (payload?.args || "").trim();
104:   if (!name) {
105:     return { success: false, error: "Komut adı gerekli" };
106:   }
107:   const result = await MetaCommandManager.deleteCommand(name);
108:   return result;
109: };
110: 
111: handlers.listcustomcommands = async () => {
112:   const commands = MetaCommandManager.listCommands();
113:   const names = Object.keys(commands);
114:   return { 
115:     success: true, 
116:     message: names.length ? `Custom komutlar: ${names.join(", ")}` : "Henüz custom komut tanımlanmamış",
117:     commands 
118:   };
119: };
120: 
121: // ============================================
122: // ============================================
123: 
124: export const ServerCommands = {
125:   /**
126:    * Komutu çalıştır
127:    * @param {string} commandName - Komut adı
128:    * @param {Object} payload - Komut payload'ı
129:    * @returns {Promise<Object>}
130:    */
131:   async run(commandName: string, payload: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
132:     const key = (commandName || "").toLowerCase();
133:     const handler = handlers[key];
134:     
135:     // Önce sistem handler'larına bak
136:     if (handler) {
137:       return handler(payload);
138:     }
139:     
140:     // Sonra custom komutlara bak
141:     if (MetaCommandManager.hasCommand(commandName)) {
142:       const argsStr = (payload as any)?.args || "";
143:       // Argümanları parse et (virgülle ayrılmış)
144:       const args = argsStr ? argsStr.split(",").map((s: string) => s.trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "")) : [];
145:       return MetaCommandManager.runCommand(commandName, args);
146:     }
147:     
148:     LogManager.addEvent(
149:       "server-command",
150:       "warning",
151:       `Tanımsız komut: ${commandName}`,
152:     );
153:     return { success: false, message: "Tanımsız komut" };
154:   },
155: 
156:   /**
157:    * Komut listesini getir (sistem + custom)
158:    * @returns {string[]}
159:    */
160:   list() {
161:     const customCmds = MetaCommandManager.getCommandNames();
162:     return [...COMMAND_LIST, ...customCmds];
163:   },
164: 
165:   /**
166:    * Handler kaydetli mi kontrol et (sistem + custom)
167:    * @param {string} commandName - Komut adı
168:    * @returns {boolean}
169:    */
170:   has(commandName: string) {
171:     const key = (commandName || "").toLowerCase();
172:     return !!handlers[key] || MetaCommandManager.hasCommand(commandName);
173:   },
174: 
175:   /**
176:    * Özel handler kaydet
177:    * @param {string} commandName - Komut adı
178:    * @param {Function} handler - Handler fonksiyonu
179:    */
180:   register(commandName: string, handler: (payload?: unknown) => Promise<unknown>) {
181:     if (typeof handler === "function") {
182:       handlers[commandName.toLowerCase()] = handler;
183:     }
184:   },
185: };

  1: /**
  2:  * ContextMenu - Analyze sayfası context menu ve modal işlemleri
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu modül mesaj context menu ve okuma modalını yönetir:
  5:  * - Context menu oluşturma ve gösterme
  6:  * - Read modal yönetimi
  7:  * - Context action handling
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: import { AppState } from "../../modules/app-state.js";
 11: 
 12: // ============================================================================
 13: // Types
 14: // ============================================================================
 15: 
 16: interface ContextPayload {
 17:   provider: string;
 18:   text?: string;
 19: }
 20: 
 21: type ActionCallback = () => void;
 22: 
 23: // ============================================================================
 24: // State
 25: // ============================================================================
 26: 
 27: let contextMenuEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
 28: let readModalEl: HTMLElement | null = null;
 29: 
 30: // ============================================================================
 31: // Functions
 32: // ============================================================================
 33: 
 34: /**
 35:  * Context menu'yu başlat
 36:  */
 37: export function initContextMenu(): void {
 38:   contextMenuEl = document.createElement("div");
 39:   contextMenuEl.className = "msg-context hidden";
 40:   contextMenuEl.innerHTML = `
 41:     <button data-action="read">Okuma modu</button>
 42:     <button data-action="prepend">Mesajın başına ekle</button>
 43:     <button data-action="append">Mesajın sonuna ekle</button>
 44:   `;
 45:   document.body.appendChild(contextMenuEl);
 46:   
 47:   document.addEventListener("click", hideContextMenu);
 48: }
 49: 
 50: /**
 51:  * Read modal'ı başlat
 52:  */
 53: export function initReadModal(): void {
 54:   readModalEl = document.getElementById("read-modal");
 55:   const closeBtn = document.getElementById("read-modal-close");
 56:   closeBtn?.addEventListener("click", hideReadModal);
 57: }
 58: 
 59: /**
 60:  * Context menu'yu göster
 61:  */
 62: export function showContextMenu(event: MouseEvent, payload: ContextPayload, onAction?: ActionCallback): void {
 63:   event.preventDefault();
 64:   
 65:   if (!contextMenuEl) return;
 66:   
 67:   contextMenuEl.dataset.provider = payload.provider;
 68:   contextMenuEl.dataset.text = payload.text || "";
 69:   contextMenuEl.style.left = `${event.pageX}px`;
 70:   contextMenuEl.style.top = `${event.pageY}px`;
 71:   contextMenuEl.classList.remove("hidden");
 72:   
 73:   contextMenuEl.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((btn) => {
 74:     btn.onclick = (e) => {
 75:       const target = e.currentTarget as HTMLButtonElement;
 76:       const action = target.dataset.action || "";
 77:       handleContextAction(action, payload, onAction);
 78:       hideContextMenu();
 79:     };
 80:   });
 81: }
 82: 
 83: /**
 84:  * Context menu'yu gizle
 85:  */
 86: function hideContextMenu(): void {
 87:   contextMenuEl?.classList.add("hidden");
 88: }
 89: 
 90: /**
 91:  * Context action'ı işle
 92:  */
 93: function handleContextAction(action: string, payload: ContextPayload, onAction?: ActionCallback): void {
 94:   if (action === "read") {
 95:     showReadModal(payload);
 96:     return;
 97:   }
 98:   
 99:   if (action === "prepend" || action === "append") {
100:     const textarea = document.getElementById("compose-input") as HTMLTextAreaElement | null;
101:     if (!textarea) return;
102:     
103:     const nickname = AppState.getNickname(payload.provider);
104:     const prefix = `${nickname} : `;
105:     const current = textarea.value || "";
106:     
107:     const newVal = action === "prepend"
108:       ? `${prefix}${payload.text}\n${current}`.trim()
109:       : `${current}\n${prefix}${payload.text}`.trim();
110:     
111:     textarea.value = newVal;
112:     
113:     onAction?.();
114:   }
115: }
116: 
117: /**
118:  * Read modal'ı göster
119:  */
120: export function showReadModal(payload: ContextPayload): void {
121:   if (!readModalEl) return;
122:   
123:   const body = document.getElementById("read-modal-body");
124:   if (body) {
125:     body.textContent = payload.text || "";
126:     body.scrollTop = 0;
127:   }
128:   
129:   readModalEl.classList.remove("hidden");
130: }
131: 
132: /**
133:  * Read modal'ı gizle
134:  */
135: function hideReadModal(): void {
136:   readModalEl?.classList.add("hidden");
137: }

 59:     const pendingAi1Raw = await CoreEngine.whisper("list", { user: "ai1" });
 60:     const pendingAi2Raw = await CoreEngine.whisper("list", { user: "ai2" });
 61:     const doneAi1Raw = await CoreEngine.whisper("done", { user: "ai1" });
 62:     const doneAi2Raw = await CoreEngine.whisper("done", { user: "ai2" });
 63:     
 64:     const pendingAi1 = Array.isArray(pendingAi1Raw) ? pendingAi1Raw : [];
 65:     const pendingAi2 = Array.isArray(pendingAi2Raw) ? pendingAi2Raw : [];
 66:     const doneAi1 = Array.isArray(doneAi1Raw) ? doneAi1Raw : [];
 67:     const doneAi2 = Array.isArray(doneAi2Raw) ? doneAi2Raw : [];
 68:     
 69:     this.fillList(this.pendingAi1, pendingAi1, "ai1");
 70:     this.fillList(this.pendingAi2, pendingAi2, "ai2");
 71:     this.fillList(this.doneAi1, doneAi1);
 72:     this.fillList(this.doneAi2, doneAi2);
 73:   }
 74: 
 75:   fillList(container: HTMLElement | null, items: any[], provider = "") {
 76:     if (!container) return;
 77:     container.innerHTML = "";
 78:     if (!items.length) {
 79:       const empty = document.createElement("div");
 80:       empty.className = "whisper-empty";
 81:       empty.textContent = "Kayıt yok";
 82:       container.appendChild(empty);
 83:       return;
 84:     }
 85:     items
 86:       .slice()
 87:       .sort((a, b) => (a.when || a.doneAt || 0) - (b.when || b.doneAt || 0))
 88:       .forEach((rec) => {
 89:         const row = document.createElement("div");
 90:         row.className = "whisper-row";
 91:         const text = document.createElement("div");
 92:         text.className = "whisper-text";
 93:         const stamp = this.formatDate(rec.doneAt || rec.when);
 94:         text.textContent = `${stamp} - ${rec.text}`;
 95:         row.appendChild(text);
 96:         if (provider) {
 97:           const del = document.createElement("button");
 98:           del.className = "whisper-remove";
 99:           del.textContent = "×";
100:           del.title = "Sil";
101:           del.addEventListener("click", async () => {
102:             await CoreEngine.whisper("remove", { user: provider, id: rec.id });
103:           });
104:           row.appendChild(del);
105:         }
106:         container.appendChild(row);
107:       });
108:   }
109: 
110:   async onShow() {
111:     await this.render();
112:   }
113: 
114:   onHide() {
115:   }
116: 
117:   formatDate(ts: number | undefined) {
118:     if (!ts) return "";
119:     const d = new Date(ts);
120:     if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "";
121:     return d.toLocaleString("tr-TR");
122:   }
123: 
124: }
