136: /**
137:  * Unknown tipindeki error'dan güvenli şekilde mesaj çıkarır
138:  * TypeScript'te catch bloklarında error tipi 'unknown' olduğu için bu helper gerekli
139:  * 
140:  * @param error - Herhangi bir tipte error
141:  * @returns Error mesajı string olarak
142:  */
143: export function getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
144:   if (error instanceof Error) {
145:     return error.message;
146:   }
147:   if (typeof error === "string") {
148:     return error;
149:   }
150:   if (error && typeof error === "object" && "message" in error) {
151:     return String((error as ErrorLike).message);
152:   }
153:   return String(error);
154: }

  1: /**
  2:  * DatabaseManager - Ana orchestrator
  3:  *
  4:  * Her hesap için ayrı SQLite veritabanı ve attachment yönetimi.
  5:  *
  6:  * Account ID formatı: {provider}_{sanitizedEmail}
  7:  * Örnek: chatgpt_user_at_gmail_com
  8:  *
  9:  * Dosya yapısı:
 10:  * data/
 11:  * └── {accountId}/                  # Hesap klasörü (örn: chatgpt_user_at_gmail_com/)
 12:  *     ├── database.db               # SQLite veritabanı
 13:  *     └── attachments/              # Attachment dosyaları
 14:  *         └── {conversationId}/     # Konuşma klasörü
 15:  *             └── {messageId}/      # Mesaj klasörü
 16:  *                 └── filename.ext  # Dosya
 17:  *
 18:  * @module electron/database
 19:  */
 20:

 22: import path from "path";
 23: import fs from "fs";
 24: import { applySchema } from "./schema.ts";
 25: import { createQueries } from "./queries.ts";
 26: import {
 27:   hashString,
 28:   generateId as _generateId,
 29:   generateMessageId,
 30:   generateAttachmentId,
 31: } from "./hash-utils.ts";

 59: /**
 60:  * Account ID'den klasör yolunu oluştur
 61:  */
 62: function getAccountFolderPath(accountId: string): string {
 63:   return path.join(DATA_DIR, accountId);
 64: }

 66: /**
 67:  * Account ID'den veritabanı dosya yolunu oluştur
 68:  */
 69: function getDatabasePath(accountId: string): string {
 70:   return path.join(getAccountFolderPath(accountId), "database.db");
 71: }
 72: 
 73: /**
 74:  * Account ID'den attachments klasör yolunu oluştur
 75:  */
 76: function getAttachmentsPath(accountId: string): string {
 77:   return path.join(getAccountFolderPath(accountId), "attachments");
 78: }

 80: /**
 81:  * Hesap dizinlerinin var olduğundan emin ol
 82:  */
 83: function ensureAccountDirectories(accountId: string): void {
 84:   const accountFolder = getAccountFolderPath(accountId);
 85:   const attachmentsFolder = getAttachmentsPath(accountId);
 86:   
 87:   if (!fs.existsSync(accountFolder)) {
 88:     fs.mkdirSync(accountFolder, { recursive: true });
 89:   }
 90:   if (!fs.existsSync(attachmentsFolder)) {
 91:     fs.mkdirSync(attachmentsFolder, { recursive: true });
 92:   }
 93: }

 99: interface InitAccountResult {
100:   success: boolean;
101:   error?: string;
102:   cached?: boolean;
103:   created?: boolean;
104: }

106: export const DatabaseManager = {
107:   /**
108:    * Hesap için veritabanını başlat
109:    */
110:   initAccount(
111:     _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent | null,
112:     { accountId }: { accountId: string }
113:   ): InitAccountResult {
114:     try {
115:       if (!accountId) {
116:         return { success: false, error: "Account ID gerekli" };
117:       }
118: 
119:       // Hesap klasörlerini oluştur (database.db ve attachments/)
120:       ensureAccountDirectories(accountId);
121: 
122:       // Zaten açıksa başarılı dön
123:       if (connectionPool.has(accountId)) {
124:         return { success: true, cached: true };
125:       }
126: 
127:       const dbPath = getDatabasePath(accountId);
128:       const isNew = !fs.existsSync(dbPath);
129: 
130:       // Veritabanını aç
131:       const db = new Database(dbPath);
132: 
133:       // WAL modu ve optimizasyonlar
134:       db.pragma("journal_mode = WAL");
135:       db.pragma("synchronous = NORMAL");
136:       db.pragma("foreign_keys = ON");
137: 
138:       // Schema uygula
139:       applySchema(db);
140: 
141:       // Prepared statement'ları oluştur
142:       const queries = createQueries(db);
143: 
144:       // Pool'a ekle
145:       connectionPool.set(accountId, { db, queries });
146: 
147:       console.log(`[DB] ${isNew ? "Oluşturuldu" : "Açıldı"}: ${dbPath}`);
148: 
149:       return { success: true, created: isNew };
150:     } catch (err: unknown) {
151:       console.error("[DB] initAccount hatası:", err);
152:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
153:     }
154:   },
155: 
156:   /**
157:    * Hesap için veritabanı bağlantısını al
158:    */
159:   getConnection(accountId: string): DbConnection | null {
160:     if (!connectionPool.has(accountId)) {
161:       // Otomatik olarak bağlantı kur
162:       const result = this.initAccount(null, { accountId });
163:       if (!result.success) {
164:         console.error("[DB] getConnection - initAccount başarısız:", result.error);
165:         return null;
166:       }
167:     }
168: 
169:     return connectionPool.get(accountId) || null;
170:   },

202:         folder: path.join(attachmentsBase, row.id),
203:         label: row.title || "İsimsiz Konuşma",
204:       }));

237:         domIndex: row.dom_index,
238:         domId: row.dom_id,
239:         createdAt: row.created_at,
240:       }));

249:   /**
250:    * Mesajları senkronize et (incremental sync)
251:    */
252:   syncMessages(
253:     _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent | null,
254:     { accountId, webUrl, messages, authors }: SyncMessagesParams
255:   ): SyncMessagesResult {
256:     try {
257:       const conn = DatabaseManager.getConnection(accountId);
258:       if (!conn) {
259:         return { success: false, error: "Veritabanı bağlantısı kurulamadı" };
260:       }
261: 
262:       const { db, queries } = conn;
263: 
264:       // Konuşmayı bul veya oluştur
265:       let conversation = queries.getConversationByUrl.get(webUrl);
266: 
267:       const now = Date.now();
268:       let conversationId;
269: 
270:       if (!conversation) {
271:         // Yeni konuşma ID'si - benzersiz ID (accountId prefix ile)
272:         const timestamp = Date.now();
273:         const random = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);
274:         conversationId = `conv-${timestamp}-${random}`;
275: 
276:         queries.insertConversation.run({
277:           id: conversationId,
278:           web_url: webUrl,
279:           title: "",
280:           summary: "",
281:           message_count: 0,
282:           last_message_id: null,
283:           created_at: now,
284:           updated_at: now,
285:         });
286: 
287:         conversation = { id: conversationId } as Partial<Conversation>;
288:       } else {
289:         conversationId = (conversation as Conversation).id;
290:       }
291: 
292:       // Mevcut mesaj hash'lerini al
293:       const existingHashes = new Set(
294:         (queries.getMessageHashes.all(conversationId) as Array<{ content_hash: string }>).map((r) => r.content_hash)
295:       );
296: 
297:       // Yeni mesajları filtrele
298:       const newMessages: Array<SyncMessagesParams["messages"][0] & { contentHash: string }> = [];
299:       for (const msg of messages) {
300:         const contentHash = msg.contentHash || hashString(msg.text);
301: 
302:         if (!existingHashes.has(contentHash)) {
303:           newMessages.push({
304:             ...msg,
305:             contentHash,
306:           });
307:         }
308:       }
309: 
310:       // Yeni mesajları ekle (transaction içinde)
311:       if (newMessages.length > 0) {
312:         const insertMany = db.transaction((msgs: typeof newMessages) => {
313:           for (const msg of msgs) {
314:             const messageId = generateMessageId();
315: 
316:             queries.insertMessage.run({
317:               id: messageId,
318:               conversation_id: conversationId,
319:               role: msg.role,
320:               author: msg.author || (authors as Record<string, string | undefined>)?.[msg.role] || null,
321:               content: msg.text,
322:               dom_index: msg.index ?? msg.domIndex ?? null,
323:               dom_id: msg.domId || null,
324:               content_hash: msg.contentHash,
325:               created_at: now,
326:             });
327:           }
328:         });
329: 
330:         insertMany(newMessages);
331:       }
332: 
333:       // Konuşma metadata'sını güncelle
334:       const messageCount = (queries.getMessageCount.get(conversationId) as { count: number } | undefined)?.count || 0;
335:       const lastMessage = queries.getLastMessage.get(conversationId) as Message | undefined;
336: 
337:       // Title: Mevcut başlık varsa değiştirme, yoksa "Sohbet001" formatında ata
338:       let title = (conversation as Conversation).title || "";
339:       if (!title) {
340:         // Mevcut konuşma sayısını al ve bir sonraki numarayı oluştur
341:         const convCount = (queries.getConversationCount.get() as { count: number } | undefined)?.count || 0;
342:         title = `Sohbet${String(convCount).padStart(3, "0")}`;
343:       }
344: 
345:       queries.updateConversation.run({
346:         id: conversationId,
347:         title,
348:         summary: (conversation as Conversation).summary || "",
349:         message_count: messageCount,
350:         last_message_id: lastMessage?.id || null,
351:         updated_at: now,
352:       });
353: 
354:       return {
355:         success: true,
356:         conversationId,
357:         added: newMessages.length,
358:         total: messageCount,
359:       };
360:     } catch (err: unknown) {
361:       console.error("[DB] syncMessages hatası:", err);
362:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
363:     }
364:   },
365: 
366:   /**
367:    * Attachment kaydet
368:    */
369:   saveAttachment(
370:     _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent | null,
371:     {
372:       accountId,
373:       conversationId,
374:       messageId,
375:       filePath,
376:       originalName,
377:       mimeType,
378:     }: {
379:       accountId: string;
380:       conversationId: string;
381:       messageId: string;
382:       filePath: string;
383:       originalName: string;
384:       mimeType?: string;
385:     }
386:   ): { success: boolean; attachmentId?: string; storedPath?: string; error?: string } {
387:     try {
388:       const conn = DatabaseManager.getConnection(accountId);
389:       if (!conn) {
390:         return { success: false, error: "Veritabanı bağlantısı kurulamadı" };
391:       }
392: 
393:       // Hedef klasörü oluştur: data/{accountId}/attachments/{conversationId}/{messageId}/
394:       const attachmentsBase = getAttachmentsPath(accountId);
395:       const targetDir = path.join(attachmentsBase, conversationId, messageId);
396:       if (!fs.existsSync(targetDir)) {
397:         fs.mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive: true });
398:       }
399: 
400:       // Dosya adı çakışmasını önle
401:       const ext = path.extname(originalName);
402:       const base = path.basename(originalName, ext);
403:       let storedName = originalName;
404:       let counter = 1;
405: 
406:       while (fs.existsSync(path.join(targetDir, storedName))) {
407:         storedName = `${base}_${counter}${ext}`;
408:         counter++;
409:       }
410: 
411:       const storedPath = path.join(targetDir, storedName);
412: 
413:       // Dosyayı kopyala
414:       fs.copyFileSync(filePath, storedPath);
415: 
416:       // Dosya boyutunu al
417:       const stats = fs.statSync(storedPath);
418: 
419:       // DB'ye kaydet
420:       const attachmentId = generateAttachmentId();
421: 
422:       conn.queries.insertAttachment.run({
423:         id: attachmentId,
424:         message_id: messageId,
425:         conversation_id: conversationId,
426:         original_name: originalName,
427:         stored_name: storedName,
428:         stored_path: storedPath,
429:         mime_type: mimeType || null,
430:         size: stats.size,
431:         created_at: Date.now(),
432:       });
433: 
434:       return {
435:         success: true,
436:         attachmentId,
437:         storedPath,
438:       };
439:     } catch (err: unknown) {
440:       console.error("[DB] saveAttachment hatası:", err);
441:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
442:     }
443:   },

574:       }
575: 
576:       // Dosya adında LIKE araması
577:       const searchPattern = `%${query}%`;
578:       interface SearchAttachmentRow {
579:         id: string;
580:         message_id: string;
581:         conversation_id: string;
582:         original_name: string;
583:         stored_path: string;
584:         mime_type: string | null;
585:         size: number;
586:         created_at: number;
587:         conversation_title: string | null;
588:         web_url: string;
589:       }
590:       const rows = conn.db.prepare(`
591:         SELECT 
592:           a.id,
593:           a.message_id,
594:           a.conversation_id,
595:           a.original_name,
596:           a.stored_path,
597:           a.mime_type,
598:           a.size,
599:           a.created_at,
600:           c.title as conversation_title,
601:           c.web_url
602:         FROM attachments a
603:         JOIN conversations c ON a.conversation_id = c.id
604:         WHERE a.original_name LIKE ?
605:         ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
606:         LIMIT ?
607:       `).all(searchPattern, limit) as SearchAttachmentRow[];
608: 
609:       const data = rows.map((row: SearchAttachmentRow) => ({
610:         id: row.id,
611:         messageId: row.message_id,
612:         conversationId: row.conversation_id,
613:         conversationTitle: row.conversation_title || "İsimsiz Konuşma",
614:         webUrl: row.web_url,
615:         originalName: row.original_name,
616:         storedPath: row.stored_path,
617:         mimeType: row.mime_type,
618:         size: row.size,
619:         createdAt: row.created_at,
620:       }));
621:       
622:       return { success: true, data };
623:     } catch (err: unknown) {
624:       console.error("[DB] searchAttachments hatası:", err);
625:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message, data: [] };
626:     }
627:   },
628: 
629:   /**
630:    * Tüm hesaplarda arama yap (mesaj + attachment)
631:    * @returns {{ success: boolean, data?: { messages: Array, attachments: Array }, error?: string }}
632:    */
633:   searchAllAccounts(
634:     event: IpcMainInvokeEvent | null,
635:     { query, limit = 50 }: { query: string; limit?: number }
636:   ): { success: boolean; data?: { messages: unknown[]; attachments: unknown[] }; error?: string } {
637:     try {
638:       // data/ klasöründeki tüm hesap klasörlerini bul
639:       if (!fs.existsSync(DATA_DIR)) {
640:         return { success: true, data: { messages: [], attachments: [] } };
641:       }
642: 
643:       const accountFolders = fs.readdirSync(DATA_DIR, { withFileTypes: true })
644:         .filter(dirent => dirent.isDirectory())
645:         .map(dirent => dirent.name);
646: 
647:       const allMessages: Array<Record<string, unknown> & { createdAt: number }> = [];
648:       const allAttachments: Array<Record<string, unknown> & { createdAt: number }> = [];
649: 
650:       for (const accountId of accountFolders) {
651:         // Mesajlarda ara
652:         const messagesResult = this.searchMessages(event, { accountId, query, limit: Math.ceil(limit / accountFolders.length) });
653:         if (messagesResult.success && messagesResult.data) {
654:           allMessages.push(...messagesResult.data.map((m) => ({ ...(m as Record<string, unknown>), accountId, createdAt: (m as Record<string, unknown>).createdAt as number })));
655:         }
656: 
657:         // Attachment'larda ara
658:         const attachmentsResult = this.searchAttachments(event, { accountId, query, limit: Math.ceil(limit / accountFolders.length) });
659:         if (attachmentsResult.success && attachmentsResult.data) {
660:           allAttachments.push(...attachmentsResult.data.map((a) => ({ ...(a as Record<string, unknown>), accountId, createdAt: (a as Record<string, unknown>).createdAt as number })));
661:         }
662:       }
663: 
664:       // Tarihe göre sırala ve limit uygula
665:       allMessages.sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
666:       allAttachments.sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
667: 
668:       return {
669:         success: true,
670:         data: {
671:           messages: allMessages.slice(0, limit),
672:           attachments: allAttachments.slice(0, limit),
673:         },
674:       };
675:     } catch (err: unknown) {
676:       console.error("[DB] searchAllAccounts hatası:", err);
677:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message, data: { messages: [], attachments: [] } };
678:     }
679:   },
680: 
681:   /**
682:    * Konuşma detayını güncelle
683:    */
684:   updateConversationDetails(
685:     _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent | null,
686:     {
687:       accountId,
688:       conversationId,
689:       title,
690:       summary,
691:     }: {
692:       accountId: string;
693:       conversationId: string;
694:       title?: string;
695:       summary?: string;
696:     }
697:   ): IpcResult {
698:     try {
699:       const conn = DatabaseManager.getConnection(accountId);
700:       if (!conn) {
701:         return { success: false, error: "Veritabanı bağlantısı kurulamadı" };
702:       }
703: 
704:       const conversation = conn.queries.getConversationById.get(conversationId);
705:       if (!conversation) {
706:         return { success: false, error: "Konuşma bulunamadı" };
707:       }
708: 
709:       const conv = conversation as Conversation;
710:       conn.queries.updateConversation.run({
711:         id: conversationId,
712:         title: title ?? conv.title,
713:         summary: summary ?? conv.summary,
714:         message_count: conv.message_count,
715:         last_message_id: conv.last_message_id,
716:         updated_at: Date.now(),
717:       });
718: 
719:       return { success: true };
720:     } catch (err: unknown) {
721:       console.error("[DB] updateConversationDetails hatası:", err);
722:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
723:     }
724:   },
725: 
726:   /**
727:    * Tüm bağlantıları kapat (uygulama kapanırken)
728:    */
729:   closeAll(): void {
730:     for (const [key, { db }] of connectionPool) {
731:       try {
732:         db.close();
733:         console.log(`[DB] Kapatıldı: ${key}`);
734:       } catch (err: unknown) {
735:         console.error(`[DB] Kapatma hatası (${key}):`, err);
736:       }
737:     }
738:     connectionPool.clear();
739:   },
740: 
741:   /**
742:    * Veritabanını optimize et
743:    */
744:   optimize(accountId: string): void {
745:     try {
746:       const conn = DatabaseManager.getConnection(accountId);
747:       if (conn) {
748:         conn.db.exec("VACUUM");
749:         conn.db.exec("ANALYZE");
750:         console.log(`[DB] Optimize edildi: ${accountId}`);
751:       }
752:     } catch (err: unknown) {
753:       console.error("[DB] Optimize hatası:", err);
754:     }
755:   },
756: };
757:

================
File: electron/log-manager.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Main Process Log Manager
  3:  *
  4:  * Renderer LogManager'dan gelen structured logları dosyaya yazar.
  5:  * Console-logger ile entegre çalışır.
  6:  * Session bazlı dizin yapısı kullanır.
  7:  */
  8: 
  9: import { join } from 'path';
 10: import { appendFile, mkdir } from 'fs/promises';
 11: import { existsSync } from 'fs';
 12: import { getSessionId, getSessionDir, getLogDir } from './console-logger.js';
 13: import { matchErrorPattern } from './error-patterns.js';
 14: import type { IpcMainInvokeEvent } from 'electron';
 15: 
 16: interface LogPayload {
 17:   sessionId?: string;
 18:   line?: string;
 19:   context?: Record<string, unknown>;
 20: }
 21: 
 22: interface AppendLogResult {
 23:   success: boolean;
 24:   message?: string;
 25:   hint?: object | null;
 26: }
 27: 
 28: /**
 29:  * Renderer'dan gelen log girdisini dosyaya yaz
 30:  */
 31: export async function appendLog(
 32:   _event: IpcMainInvokeEvent,
 33:   payload: LogPayload
 34: ): Promise<AppendLogResult> {
 35:   try {
 36:     const { sessionId, line, context } = payload || {};
 37:     
 38:     if (!sessionId || !line) {
 39:       return { success: false, message: 'Eksik parametre' };
 40:     }
 41:     
 42:     let sessionDir = getSessionDir();
 43:     const logDir = getLogDir() || join(process.cwd(), 'logs');
 44:     
 45:     if (sessionId !== getSessionId()) {
 46:       sessionDir = join(logDir, sessionId);
 47:     }
 48:     
 49:     if (!sessionDir) {
 50:       return { success: false, message: 'Session dizini bulunamadı' };
 51:     }
 52:     
 53:     if (!existsSync(sessionDir)) {
 54:       await mkdir(sessionDir, { recursive: true });
 55:     }
 56:     
 57:     const structuredLogPath = join(sessionDir, 'structured.jsonl');
 58:     const consoleLogPath = join(sessionDir, 'console-001.log');
 59:     
 60:     let entry;
 61:     try {
 62:       entry = JSON.parse(line);
 63:       
 64:       if (entry.type === 'error' && entry.message) {
 65:         const hint = matchErrorPattern(entry.message);
 66:         if (hint) {
 67:           entry.aiHint = hint;
 68:         }
 69:       }
 70:       
 71:       if (context) {
 72:         entry.context = { ...entry.context, ...context };
 73:       }
 74:       
 75:     } catch {
 76:       entry = { raw: line, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
 77:     }
 78:     
 79:     // Structured log (JSONL - detaylı analiz için)
 80:     await appendFile(structuredLogPath, JSON.stringify(entry) + '\n', 'utf-8');
 81:     
 82:     // Console log (okunabilir format - birleşik log)
 83:     const visibility = entry.visibility ? `[L${entry.visibility}]` : '';
 84:     const source = entry.source || 'unknown';
 85:     const type = entry.type || 'info';
 86:     const message = entry.message || entry.raw || '';
 87:     const timestamp = entry.isoTimestamp || new Date().toISOString();
 88:     
 89:     let consoleLine = `[${timestamp}] [${type.toUpperCase()}] ${visibility} [RENDERER] [${source}] ${message}`;
 90:     
 91:     if (entry.meta && Object.keys(entry.meta).length > 0) {
 92:       consoleLine += ` | meta: ${JSON.stringify(entry.meta)}`;
 93:     }
 94:     
 95:     await appendFile(consoleLogPath, consoleLine + '\n', 'utf-8');
 96:     
 97:     return { 
 98:       success: true,
 99:       hint: entry.aiHint || null,
100:     };
101:   } catch (error) {
102:     return { success: false, message: (error as Error).message };
103:   }
104: }

  1: /**
  2:  * OpenCode Event Parser
  3:  *
  4:  * OpenCode HTTP API'den gelen SSE event'lerini parse edip
  5:  * Native UI SSE Server formatına dönüştürür.
  6:  *
  7:  * @module opencode-event-parser
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: // LogManager electron'da console.log kullanıyor
 11: const log = (source: string, level: string, message: string) => {
 12:   console.log(`[${source}]`, level, message);
 13: };
 14: 
 15: // OpenCode API Event Types
 16: export interface OpenCodeEvent {
 17:   type: string;
 18:   properties?: Record<string, unknown>;
 19:   [key: string]: unknown;
 20: }
 21: 
 22: // Message Events
 23: export interface MessagePart {
 24:   type: "text" | "tool_call" | "tool_result";
 25:   text?: string;
 26:   toolCall?: {
 27:     id: string;
 28:     name: string;
 29:     input: Record<string, unknown>;
 30:   };
 31:   toolResult?: {
 32:     id: string;
 33:     content: string;
 34:     isError?: boolean;
 35:   };
 36: }
 37: 
 38: export interface OpenCodeMessage {
 39:   id: string;
 40:   role: "user" | "assistant";
 41:   parts: MessagePart[];
 42:   metadata?: {
 43:     time?: { created?: number; completed?: number };
 44:     model?: string;
 45:     cost?: { input: number; output: number; total: number };
 46:   };
 47: }
 48: 
 49: // Tool Events
 50: export interface ToolStartEvent {
 51:   sessionId: string;
 52:   messageId: string;
 53:   toolId: string;
 54:   toolName: string;
 55:   toolInput: Record<string, unknown>;
 56: }
 57: 
 58: export interface ToolEndEvent {
 59:   sessionId: string;
 60:   messageId: string;
 61:   toolId: string;
 62:   toolName: string;
 63:   output?: string;
 64:   isError?: boolean;
 65: }
 66: 
 67: // Permission Events
 68: export interface PermissionRequestEvent {
 69:   sessionId: string;
 70:   permissionId: string;
 71:   toolName: string;
 72:   toolInput: Record<string, unknown>;
 73:   message?: string;
 74: }
 75: 
 76: // Session Events
 77: export interface SessionUpdatedEvent {
 78:   id: string;
 79:   status: "idle" | "processing" | "waiting_permission" | "waiting_answer";
 80:   title?: string;
 81: }
 82: 
 83: // SSE Server Event Format (Native UI'a gönderilecek)
 84: export interface NativeUIEvent {
 85:   type: string;
 86:   data: Record<string, unknown>;
 87:   timestamp: number;
 88: }
 89: 
 90: /**
 91:  * OpenCode event'lerini Native UI formatına dönüştürür
 92:  */
 93: export class OpenCodeEventParser {
 94:   private static instance: OpenCodeEventParser;
 95: 
 96:   private constructor() {}
 97: 
 98:   static getInstance(): OpenCodeEventParser {
 99:     if (!OpenCodeEventParser.instance) {
100:       OpenCodeEventParser.instance = new OpenCodeEventParser();
101:     }
102:     return OpenCodeEventParser.instance;
103:   }
104: 
105:   /**
106:    * OpenCode SSE line'ını parse eder
107:    * Format: "event: <type>\ndata: <json>"
108:    */
109:   parseSSELine(line: string): OpenCodeEvent | null {
110:     if (!line || line.startsWith(":")) {
111:       // Comment veya empty line
112:       return null;
113:     }
114: 
115:     try {
116:       // "data: {...}" formatını parse et
117:       if (line.startsWith("data:")) {
118:         const jsonStr = line.slice(5).trim();
119:         if (!jsonStr) return null;
120:         return JSON.parse(jsonStr) as OpenCodeEvent;
121:       }
122: 
123:       // Bazı event'ler direkt JSON olabilir
124:       if (line.startsWith("{")) {
125:         return JSON.parse(line) as OpenCodeEvent;
126:       }
127: 
128:       return null;
129:     } catch (err) {
130:       log("opencode-parser", "warn", `SSE parse error: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown"}`);
131:       return null;
132:     }
133:   }
134: 
135:   /**
136:    * OpenCode event'ini Native UI formatına dönüştürür
137:    */
138:   toNativeUIEvent(event: OpenCodeEvent): NativeUIEvent | null {
139:     const timestamp = Date.now();
140: 
141:     switch (event.type) {
142:       // Message Events
143:       case "message.created":
144:         return this._handleMessageCreated(event, timestamp);
145: 
146:       case "message.updated":
147:         return this._handleMessageUpdated(event, timestamp);
148: 
149:       case "message.completed":
150:         return this._handleMessageCompleted(event, timestamp);
151: 
152:       // Tool Events
153:       case "tool.start":
154:         return this._handleToolStart(event, timestamp);
155: 
156:       case "tool.end":
157:         return this._handleToolEnd(event, timestamp);
158: 
159:       // Permission Events
160:       case "permission.request":
161:         return this._handlePermissionRequest(event, timestamp);
162: 
163:       case "permission.resolved":
164:         return this._handlePermissionResolved(event, timestamp);
165: 
166:       // Session Events
167:       case "session.updated":
168:         return this._handleSessionUpdated(event, timestamp);
169: 
170:       case "session.completed":
171:         return this._handleSessionCompleted(event, timestamp);
172: 
173:       // Text Delta (streaming)
174:       case "text.delta":
175:       case "content.delta":
176:         return this._handleTextDelta(event, timestamp);
177: 
178:       // Message Part Updated (OpenCode gerçek format)
179:       case "message.part.updated":
180:         return this._handleMessagePartUpdated(event, timestamp);
181: 
182:       // Session Events
183:       case "session.status":
184:         return {
185:           type: "status.change",
186:           data: { status: event.properties?.status || event.status },
187:           timestamp,
188:         };
189: 
190:       case "session.diff":
191:         // Session diff - genelde ignore edilebilir
192:         return null;
193: 
194:       case "session.idle":
195:         return {
196:           type: "status.change",
197:           data: { status: "idle", sessionId: event.properties?.sessionId || event.sessionId },
198:           timestamp,
199:         };
200: 
201:       // Session compacted (CodeNomad)
202:       case "session.compacted":
203:         return {
204:           type: "session.compacted",
205:           data: {
206:             sessionId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.sessionId || event.sessionId,
207:             info: event.properties,
208:           },
209:           timestamp,
210:         };
211: 
212:       // Session error (CodeNomad)
213:       case "session.error":
214:         return {
215:           type: "session.error",
216:           data: {
217:             sessionId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.sessionId || event.sessionId,
218:             error: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.error || event.error || "Unknown error",
219:           },
220:           timestamp,
221:         };
222: 
223:       // Message removed (CodeNomad)
224:       case "message.removed":
225:         return {
226:           type: "message.removed",
227:           data: {
228:             sessionId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.sessionID,
229:             messageId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.messageID,
230:           },
231:           timestamp,
232:         };
233: 
234:       // Message part removed (CodeNomad)
235:       case "message.part.removed":
236:         return {
237:           type: "message.part.removed",
238:           data: {
239:             sessionId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.sessionID,
240:             messageId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.messageID,
241:             partId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.partID,
242:           },
243:           timestamp,
244:         };
245: 
246:       // Permission events (CodeNomad style)
247:       case "permission.updated":
248:       case "permission.asked":
249:         return this._handlePermissionRequest(event, timestamp);
250: 
251:       case "permission.replied":
252:         return {
253:           type: "permission.resolved",
254:           data: {
255:             permissionId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.id || event.permissionId,
256:             approved: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.approved,
257:           },
258:           timestamp,
259:         };
260: 
261:       // Question events (CodeNomad)
262:       case "question.asked":
263:         return {
264:           type: "question.ask",
265:           data: {
266:             questionId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.id,
267:             sessionId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.sessionID,
268:             question: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.text || (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.question,
269:             options: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.options,
270:           },
271:           timestamp,
272:         };
273: 
274:       case "question.replied":
275:       case "question.rejected":
276:         return {
277:           type: "question.answered",
278:           data: {
279:             questionId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.id,
280:             answer: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.answer,
281:             rejected: event.type === "question.rejected",
282:           },
283:           timestamp,
284:         };
285: 
286:       // Server Events
287:       case "server.heartbeat":
288:         // Heartbeat - ignore
289:         return null;
290: 
291:       case "server.connected":
292:         return {
293:           type: "status.change",
294:           data: { status: "connected" },
295:           timestamp,
296:         };
297: 
298:       // Thinking/Reasoning
299:       case "thinking.start":
300:       case "reasoning.start":
301:         return {
302:           type: "thinking.start",
303:           data: { messageId: event.messageId },
304:           timestamp,
305:         };
306: 
307:       case "thinking.delta":
308:       case "reasoning.delta":
309:         return {
310:           type: "thinking.delta",
311:           data: {
312:             messageId: event.messageId,
313:             content: event.content || event.text || "",
314:           },
315:           timestamp,
316:         };
317: 
318:       case "thinking.end":
319:       case "reasoning.end":
320:         return {
321:           type: "thinking.end",
322:           data: { messageId: event.messageId },
323:           timestamp,
324:         };
325: 
326:       // Step Events (Token Tracking - CodeNomad pattern)
327:       case "step.start":
328:         return {
329:           type: "step.start",
330:           data: {
331:             stepId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.stepId || event.stepId || `step-${timestamp}`,
332:             sessionId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.sessionID || event.sessionId,
333:             messageId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.messageID || event.messageId,
334:           },
335:           timestamp,
336:         };
337: 
338:       case "step.finish":
339:       case "step.end":
340:         return {
341:           type: "step.finish",
342:           data: {
343:             stepId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.stepId || event.stepId,
344:             sessionId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.sessionID || event.sessionId,
345:             messageId: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.messageID || event.messageId,
346:             inputTokens: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.inputTokens || 
347:                          (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.input_tokens || 
348:                          event.inputTokens || 0,
349:             outputTokens: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.outputTokens || 
350:                           (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.output_tokens || 
351:                           event.outputTokens || 0,
352:             cost: (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.cost || 
353:                   (event.properties as Record<string, unknown>)?.totalCost || 
354:                   event.cost || 0,
355:           },
356:           timestamp,
357:         };
358: 
359:       // Error
360:       case "error":
361:         return {
362:           type: "error",
363:           data: {
364:             message: event.message || event.error || "Unknown error",
365:             code: event.code,
366:           },
367:           timestamp,
368:         };
369: 
370:       default:
371:         // Bilinmeyen event tiplerini log'la ama geçir
372:         log("opencode-parser", "debug", `Unknown event type: ${event.type}`);
373:         return {
374:           type: event.type,
375:           data: event.properties || event,
376:           timestamp,
377:         };
378:     }
379:   }
380: 
381:   // Private handlers
382: 
383:   private _handleMessageCreated(
384:     event: OpenCodeEvent,
385:     timestamp: number
386:   ): NativeUIEvent {
387:     const msg = event.properties as unknown as OpenCodeMessage;
388:     return {
389:       type: "message.created",
390:       data: {
391:         id: msg?.id || event.messageId || crypto.randomUUID(),
392:         role: msg?.role || event.role || "assistant",
393:         content: this._extractTextFromParts(msg?.parts || []),
394:         parts: msg?.parts || [],
395:       },
396:       timestamp,
397:     };
398:   }
399: 
400:   private _handleMessageUpdated(
401:     event: OpenCodeEvent,
402:     timestamp: number
403:   ): NativeUIEvent {
404:     const msg = event.properties as unknown as OpenCodeMessage;

559:   /**
560:    * OpenCode message.part.updated event'ini işle
561:    * Bu event mesaj içeriği güncellendiğinde gelir
562:    */
563:   private _handleMessagePartUpdated(
564:     event: OpenCodeEvent,
565:     timestamp: number
566:   ): NativeUIEvent | null {
567:     const props = event.properties as Record<string, unknown> || {};
568:     const part = props.part as Record<string, unknown> || {};
569:     const partType = part.type as string;
570:     
571: 
572:     // Text part
573:     if (partType === "text") {
574:       const text = part.text as string || "";
575:       // Boş text'i atla
576:       if (!text.trim()) return null;
577:       
578:       // Message info'dan role ve session bilgisi al
579:       const messageInfo = props.message as Record<string, unknown> || {};
580:       const role = messageInfo.role as string || "assistant";
581:       const sessionId = part.sessionID as string || messageInfo.sessionID as string || props.sessionID as string;
582:       const messageId = part.messageID as string || messageInfo.id as string || props.messageId as string || event.messageId as string;
583:       
584:       return {
585:         type: "message.part.updated",
586:         data: {
587:           messageId,
588:           sessionId,
589:           role,
590:           partType: "text",
591:           // Kümülatif içerik
592:           fullContent: text,
593:         },
594:         timestamp,
595:       };
596:     }
597:     
598:     // Step-start: Atla (sadece başlangıç sinyali)
599:     if (partType === "step-start") {
600:       return null;
601:     }
602:     
603:     // Step-finish: Streaming bitiş sinyali - SSE-Server'a ilet
604:     if (partType === "step-finish") {
605:       const reason = part.reason as string || "unknown";
606:       const messageId = part.messageID as string || props.messageId as string || event.messageId as string;
607:       const sessionId = part.sessionID as string || props.sessionID as string;
608:       
609:       return {
610:         type: "message.part.updated",
611:         data: {
612:           messageId,
613:           sessionId,
614:           partType: "step-finish",
615:           reason,
616:         },
617:         timestamp,
618:       };
619:     }
620:     
621:     // Thinking/Reasoning part
622:     if (partType === "thinking" || partType === "reasoning") {
623:       const thinking = part.thinking as string || part.reasoning as string || "";
624:       return {
625:         type: "thinking.delta",
626:         data: {
627:           messageId: props.messageId || event.messageId,
628:           content: thinking,
629:         },
630:         timestamp,
631:       };
632:     }
633:     
634:     // Tool call part
635:     if (partType === "tool-invocation" || partType === "tool_call") {
636:       const toolState = part.state as string || part.toolState as string;
637:       const toolName = part.toolName as string || "";
638:       const toolId = part.id as string || part.toolId as string || "";
639:       const toolInput = part.input as Record<string, unknown> || {};
640:       const toolOutput = part.output as string || part.result as string || "";
641:       
642:       if (toolState === "pending" || toolState === "running") {
643:         return {
644:           type: "tool.start",
645:           data: {
646:             toolId,
647:             toolName,
648:             toolInput,
649:             messageId: props.messageId || event.messageId,
650:           },
651:           timestamp,
652:         };
653:       } else if (toolState === "completed" || toolState === "done") {
654:         return {
655:           type: "tool.end",
656:           data: {
657:             toolId,
658:             toolName,
659:             output: toolOutput,
660:             isError: false,
661:             messageId: props.messageId || event.messageId,
662:           },
663:           timestamp,
664:         };
665:       } else if (toolState === "error" || toolState === "failed") {
666:         return {
667:           type: "tool.end",
668:           data: {
669:             toolId,
670:             toolName,
671:             output: toolOutput || "Tool execution failed",
672:             isError: true,
673:             messageId: props.messageId || event.messageId,
674:           },
675:           timestamp,
676:         };
677:       }
678:     }
679:     
680:     // Tool part - tool event'e dönüştür, message content'e ekleme
681:     if (partType === "tool") {
682:       const toolState = part.state as Record<string, unknown> || {};
683:       const status = toolState.status as string;
684:       const toolName = part.tool as string || "";
685:       const toolId = part.callID as string || part.id as string || "";
686:       const input = toolState.input as Record<string, unknown> || {};
687:       const output = toolState.output as string || "";
688:       
689:       if (status === "pending" || status === "running") {
690:         return {
691:           type: "tool.start",
692:           data: {
693:             toolId,
694:             toolName,
695:             toolInput: input,
696:             messageId: props.messageId || event.messageId,
697:           },
698:           timestamp,
699:         };
700:       } else if (status === "completed") {
701:         return {
702:           type: "tool.end",
703:           data: {
704:             toolId,
705:             toolName,
706:             output,
707:             isError: false,
708:             messageId: props.messageId || event.messageId,
709:           },
710:           timestamp,
711:         };
712:       }
713:       return null; // Diğer tool state'leri atla
714:     }
715:     
716:     // Diğer metadata part tiplerini atla (JSON gibi görünenler)
717:     const content = JSON.stringify(part);
718:     if (content.startsWith('{"id":"') || content.includes('"type":"step-')) {
719:       return null;
720:     }
721:     
722:     // Gerçekten bilinmeyen part tipleri için log
723:     log("opencode-parser", "debug", `Unknown part type: ${partType}`);
724:     return null;
725:   }
726: }

333:               let cur = obj;
334:               for (const part of parts) {
335:                 if (cur == null) break;
336:                 cur = cur[part];
337:               }
338:               if (cur != null) out.push(cur);
339:             } catch (_) {
340:             }
341:           });
342:           return out;
343:         } catch (_) {
344:           return [];
345:         }
346:       };
347: 
348:       try {
349:         const _fetch = window.fetch;
350:         window.fetch = async function (...args) {
351:           const res = await _fetch.apply(this, args);
352:           try {
353:             const reqUrl =
354:               typeof args[0] === "string"
355:                 ? args[0]
356:                 : (args[0] && args[0].url) || res.url;
357:             if (matchesEndpoint(reqUrl)) {
358:               try {
359:                 const clone = res.clone();
360:                 const ct =
361:                   (clone.headers &&
362:                     clone.headers.get &&
363:                     clone.headers.get("content-type")) ||
364:                   "";
365:                 if (ct.includes("application/json")) {
366:                   clone
367:                     .json()
368:                     .then((json) => {
369:                       const toks = extractTokens(json);
370:                       if (toks && toks.length) {
371:                         try {
372:                           ipcRenderer.sendToHost("provider-usage", {
373:                             providerId,
374:                             url: reqUrl,
375:                             tokens: toks,
376:                           });
377:                         } catch (_) {}
378:                       }
379:                     })
380:                     .catch(() => {});
381:                 }
382:               } catch (_) {
383:               }
384:             }
385:           } catch (_) {
386:           }
387:           return res;
388:         };
389:       } catch (_) {
390:       }
391: 
392:       try {
393:         const OrigXHR = window.XMLHttpRequest;
394:         function WrappedXHR() {
395:           const xhr = new OrigXHR();
396:           let _url = null;
397:           const _open = xhr.open;
398:           xhr.open = function (method, url, ...rest) {
399:             _url = url;
400:             return _open.call(this, method, url, ...rest);
401:           };
402:           const _onready = xhr.onreadystatechange;
403:           xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
404:             try {
405:               if (this.readyState === 4) {
406:                 try {
407:                   if (matchesEndpoint(_url)) {
408:                     const ct =
409:                       (this.getResponseHeader &&
410:                         this.getResponseHeader("content-type")) ||
411:                       "";
412:                     if (ct.includes("application/json")) {
413:                       try {
414:                         const json = JSON.parse(this.responseText || "{}");
415:                         const toks = extractTokens(json);
416:                         if (toks && toks.length) {
417:                           try {
418:                             ipcRenderer.sendToHost("provider-usage", {
419:                               providerId,
420:                               url: _url,
421:                               tokens: toks,
422:                             });
423:                           } catch (_) {}
424:                         }
425:                       } catch (_) {
426:                       }
427:                     }
428:                   }
429:                 } catch (_) {
430:                 }
431:               }
432:             } catch (_) {
433:             }
434:             if (typeof _onready === "function")
435:               return _onready.apply(this, arguments);
436:           };
437:           return xhr;
438:         }
439:         try {
440:           WrappedXHR.prototype = OrigXHR.prototype;
441:           window.XMLHttpRequest = WrappedXHR;
442:         } catch (_) {
443:         }
444:       } catch (_) {
445:       }
446:     } catch (_) {
447:     }
448:   } catch (err) {
449:     try {
450:       console.warn("hayalet-set-provider handler error", err);
451:     } catch (_) {}
452:   }

 66: /**
 67:  * list_plugins handler
 68:  */
 69: export async function listPlugins(projectRoot: string): Promise<ToolResult> {
 70:   const pluginsDir = join(projectRoot, "plugins");
 71:   const plugins: PluginInfo[] = [];
 72:   
 73:   if (!existsSync(pluginsDir)) {
 74:     return {
 75:       content: [{ type: "text", text: "Plugin dizini bulunamadı" }],
 76:     };
 77:   }
 78:   
 79:   const dirs = await readdir(pluginsDir, { withFileTypes: true });
 80:   
 81:   for (const dir of dirs) {
 82:     if (dir.isDirectory()) {
 83:       const manifestPath = join(pluginsDir, dir.name, ".claude-plugin", "plugin.json");
 84:       try {
 85:         if (existsSync(manifestPath)) {
 86:           const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(manifestPath, "utf-8")) as {
 87:             name?: string;
 88:             version?: string;
 89:             description?: string;
 90:           };
 91:           plugins.push({
 92:             name: manifest.name || dir.name,
 93:             version: manifest.version || "unknown",
 94:             description: manifest.description || "No description",
 95:           });
 96:         } else {
 97:           plugins.push({
 98:             name: dir.name,
 99:             version: "unknown",
100:             description: "No manifest",
101:           });
102:         }
103:       } catch {
104:         plugins.push({
105:           name: dir.name,
106:           version: "unknown",
107:           description: "Parse error",
108:         });
109:       }
110:     }
111:   }
112:   
113:   return {
114:     content: [
115:       {
116:         type: "text",
117:         text: `Hayalet-ev Plugin'leri:\n${plugins.map(p => `- ${p.name} (${p.version}): ${p.description}`).join("\n")}`,
118:       },
119:     ],
120:   };
121: }

  68: // İçerik boyutu limitleri
  69: const MAX_CONTENT_SIZE = 500 * 1024; // 500KB - çok büyük içerikler chunk'lanmalı
  70: const WARN_CONTENT_SIZE = 100 * 1024; // 100KB - uyarı eşiği
  71: const BASH_THRESHOLD = 10 * 1024; // 10KB üzeri içerikler bash ile yazılır (token limit için)
  72: 
  73: /**
  74:  * create_file - Yeni dosya oluştur
  75:  * 
  76:  * Büyük dosyalar (>10KB) için otomatik olarak bash heredoc kullanır.
  77:  * Bu, LLM output token limitini aşmayı önler.
  78:  */
  79: export async function createFile(
  80:   filePath: string,
  81:   initialContent: string = "",
  82:   overwrite: boolean = false,
  83:   projectRoot?: string
  84: ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
  85:   const progress = createProgress({ operation: "Dosya oluşturma", quiet: true });
  86:   
  87:   try {
  88:     // İçerik boyutu kontrolü
  89:     const contentSize = Buffer.byteLength(initialContent, "utf-8");
  90:     progress.update(0, `${filePath} oluşturuluyor (${(contentSize / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB)...`);
  91:     
  92:     if (contentSize > MAX_CONTENT_SIZE) {
  93:       progress.fail("İçerik çok büyük");
  94:       return { 
  95:         success: false, 
  96:         message: `İçerik çok büyük (${(contentSize / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB). Maksimum: ${MAX_CONTENT_SIZE / 1024}KB. Dosyayı parçalar halinde oluşturun.` 
  97:       };
  98:     }
  99:     
 100:     // Dosya var mı kontrol et
 101:     if (!overwrite) {
 102:       try {
 103:         await access(filePath);
 104:         progress.fail("Dosya zaten var");
 105:         return { success: false, message: `Dosya zaten var: ${filePath}. Üzerine yazmak için overwrite=true kullanın.` };
 106:       } catch {
 107:         // Dosya yok, devam et
 108:       }
 109:     }
 110:     
 111:     // Dizin yoksa oluştur
 112:     progress.update(1, "Dizin kontrol ediliyor...");
 113:     const dir = dirname(filePath);
 114:     await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
 115:     
 116:     // Büyük içerikler için bash heredoc kullan (token limit aşımını önler)
 117:     if (contentSize > BASH_THRESHOLD && projectRoot) {
 118:       progress.update(2, "Bash heredoc ile yazılıyor...");
 119:       const result = await createFileWithBash(filePath, initialContent, projectRoot);
 120:       if (result.success) {
 121:         progress.done(`${(contentSize / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB yazıldı (bash)`);
 122:         return { success: true, message: `Dosya oluşturuldu: ${filePath} (${(contentSize / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB, bash mode)` };
 123:       } else {
 124:         // Bash başarısız olursa normal yönteme geri dön
 125:         progress.update(2, "Normal yazma moduna geçiliyor...");
 126:       }
 127:     }
 128:     
 129:     // Dosyayı normal yöntemle yaz
 130:     progress.update(2, "Dosya yazılıyor...");
 131:     await writeFile(filePath, initialContent, "utf-8");
 132:     
 133:     let message = `Dosya oluşturuldu: ${filePath}`;
 134:     if (contentSize > WARN_CONTENT_SIZE) {
 135:       message += ` (${(contentSize / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB)`;
 136:     }
 137:     
 138:     progress.done(`${(contentSize / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB yazıldı`);
 139:     return { success: true, message };
 140:   } catch (error) {
 141:     const err = error as Error;
 142:     progress.fail(err.message);
 143:     logToolError("hev_fs_create_file", err, { filePath, contentSize: Buffer.byteLength(initialContent, "utf-8") });
 144:     return { 
 145:       success: false, 
 146:       message: `Dosya oluşturma hatası: ${err.message}\nYol: ${filePath}\nİçerik boyutu: ${Buffer.byteLength(initialContent, "utf-8")} byte` 
 147:     };
 148:   }
 149: }

 151: /**
 152:  * Bash heredoc ile dosya oluştur
 153:  * Token limit sorunlarını aşmak için kullanılır
 154:  */
 155: async function createFileWithBash(
 156:   filePath: string,
 157:   content: string,
 158:   projectRoot: string
 159: ): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
 160:   return new Promise((resolve) => {
 161:     // Benzersiz bir EOF marker oluştur (içerikte olmamasını garanti et)
 162:     let eofMarker = "HAYALET_EOF";
 163:     let counter = 0;
 164:     while (content.includes(eofMarker)) {
 165:       counter++;
 166:       eofMarker = `HAYALET_EOF_${counter}`;
 167:     }
 168:     
 169:     // Heredoc komutu oluştur
 170:     const command = `cat << '${eofMarker}' > "${filePath}"
 171: ${content}
 172: ${eofMarker}`;
 173:     
 174:     const child = spawn("bash", ["-c", command], {
 175:       cwd: projectRoot,
 176:       env: { ...process.env },
 177:       stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
 178:     });
 179:     
 180:     let stderr = "";
 181:     
 182:     child.stderr.on("data", (data) => {
 183:       stderr += data.toString();
 184:     });
 185:     
 186:     child.on("close", (code) => {
 187:       if (code === 0) {
 188:         resolve({ success: true });
 189:       } else {
 190:         resolve({ success: false, error: stderr || `Exit code: ${code}` });
 191:       }
 192:     });
 193:     
 194:     child.on("error", (err) => {
 195:       resolve({ success: false, error: err.message });
 196:     });
 197:     
 198:     // Bash heredoc timeout
 199:     setTimeout(() => {
 200:       child.kill("SIGTERM");
 201:       resolve({ success: false, error: "Timeout" });
 202:     }, FS_TIMEOUTS.BASH_HEREDOC);
 203:   });
 204: }

 206: /**
 207:  * fs_create_chunked - Büyük dosyaları parçalar halinde oluştur
 208:  * LLM response limitlerini aşmak için chunk-based yaklaşım
 209:  */
 210: export async function createChunkedFile(
 211:   filePath: string,
 212:   chunks: string[],
 213:   projectRoot: string,
 214:   overwrite: boolean = false
 215: ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; chunkCount: number }> {
 216:   const progress = createProgress({ operation: "hev_fs_create_chunked", total: 100 });
 217:   const tempDir = `${projectRoot}/.tmp_chunks`;
 218:   const tempFiles: string[] = [];
 219:   
 220:   try {
 221:     progress.log(`${chunks.length} parça birleştiriliyor...`);
 222:     
 223:     // Hedef dosya kontrolü
 224:     if (!overwrite) {
 225:       try {
 226:         await access(filePath);
 227:         return { success: false, message: `Dosya zaten var: ${filePath}`, chunkCount: 0 };
 228:       } catch { /* dosya yok, devam */ }
 229:     }
 230:     
 231:     // Temp dizini oluştur
 232:     await mkdir(tempDir, { recursive: true });
 233:     
 234:     // Her chunk'ı temp dosyaya yaz
 235:     for (let i = 0; i < chunks.length; i++) {
 236:       const tempPath = `${tempDir}/chunk_${String(i).padStart(4, "0")}.tmp`;
 237:       await writeFile(tempPath, chunks[i], "utf-8");
 238:       tempFiles.push(tempPath);
 239:       progress.update(Math.round(((i + 1) / chunks.length) * 50), `Parça ${i + 1}/${chunks.length} yazıldı`);
 240:     }
 241:     
 242:     // Hedef dizini oluştur
 243:     await mkdir(dirname(filePath), { recursive: true });
 244:     
 245:     // Tüm chunk'ları birleştir
 246:     progress.update(60, "Parçalar birleştiriliyor...");
 247:     let fullContent = "";
 248:     for (const tempPath of tempFiles) {
 249:       const chunk = await readFile(tempPath, "utf-8");
 250:       fullContent += chunk;
 251:     }
 252:     
 253:     // Hedef dosyaya yaz
 254:     progress.update(80, "Dosya yazılıyor...");
 255:     await writeFile(filePath, fullContent, "utf-8");
 256:     
 257:     // Temp dosyaları temizle
 258:     progress.update(90, "Temp dosyalar temizleniyor...");
 259:     for (const tempPath of tempFiles) {
 260:       try { await unlink(tempPath); } catch { /* ignore */ }
 261:     }
 262:     
 263:     const finalSize = Buffer.byteLength(fullContent, "utf-8");
 264:     progress.done(`${filePath} oluşturuldu (${chunks.length} parça, ${finalSize} byte)`);
 265:     
 266:     return {
 267:       success: true,
 268:       message: `Dosya oluşturuldu: ${filePath}\nParça sayısı: ${chunks.length}\nToplam boyut: ${finalSize} byte`,
 269:       chunkCount: chunks.length,
 270:     };
 271:   } catch (error) {
 272:     // Hata durumunda temp dosyaları temizle
 273:     for (const tempPath of tempFiles) {
 274:       try { await unlink(tempPath); } catch { /* ignore */ }
 275:     }
 276:     const err = error as Error;
 277:     progress.fail(err.message);
 278:     logToolError("hev_fs_create_chunked", err, { filePath, chunkCount: chunks.length });
 279:     return { success: false, message: `Chunk dosya oluşturma hatası: ${err.message}`, chunkCount: 0 };
 280:   }
 281: }

 286: export async function appendChunk(
 287:   filePath: string,
 288:   content: string,
 289:   createIfMissing: boolean = true
 290: ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {

 306:     return { success: true, message: `Chunk eklendi: ${filePath} (+${Buffer.byteLength(content, "utf-8")} byte)` };
 307:   } catch (error) {
 308:     const err = error as Error;

 317: export async function deleteFile(filePath: string, projectRoot: string, permanent: boolean = false): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
 318:   try {
 319:     if (permanent) {
 320:       await unlink(filePath);
 321:       return { success: true, message: `Dosya kalıcı olarak silindi: ${filePath}` };
 322:     }

 327:     }
 328:     return { success: false, message: `Dosya bulunamadı: ${filePath}` };
 329:   } catch (error) {
 330:     logToolError("hev_fs_delete_file", error as Error, { filePath });
 331:     return { success: false, message: `Hata: ${(error as Error).message}` };
 332:   }

 358: export async function expandCodeChunks(
 359:   filePath: string,
 360:   lineRanges: [number, number][] = [],

 390:   find: string,
 391:   replace: string
 392: ): Promise<ReplaceResult> {
 393:   const progress = createProgress({ operation: "Find & Replace", quiet: true });
 394:   progress.update(0, `${filePath} işleniyor...`);
 395:   
 396:   const result = await findAndReplace(filePath, find, replace);
 397:   
 398:   if (result.success) {
 399:     progress.done(`${result.replacements} değişiklik yapıldı`);
 400:   } else {
 401:     progress.fail(result.error || "Bilinmeyen hata");
 402:   }
 403:   
 404:   return {
 405:     file: filePath,
 406:     replacements: result.replacements,
 407:     success: result.success,
 408:     error: result.error,
 409:   };
 410: }
 411: 
 412: /**
 413:  * grep - Dosyalarda pattern ara
 414:  */
 415: export async function grep(
 416:   workspacePath: string,
 417:   contentPattern: string | null = null,
 418:   pathGlob: string | null = null
 419: ): Promise<GrepResult> {
 420:   let regex: RegExp | null = null;
 421:   
 422:   if (contentPattern) {
 423:     try {
 424:       regex = new RegExp(contentPattern, "i");
 425:     } catch {
 426:       regex = new RegExp(contentPattern.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&"), "i");
 427:     }
 428:   }
 429:   
 430:   const matches = await grepDirectory(workspacePath, regex, pathGlob);
 431:   
 432:   return {
 433:     pattern: contentPattern || pathGlob || "",
 434:     matches,
 435:     totalMatches: matches.length,
 436:     filesSearched: new Set(matches.map(m => m.file)).size,
 437:   };
 438: }

 440: /**
 441:  * expand_folder - Klasör yapısını göster
 442:  */
 443: export async function expandFolder(
 444:   folderPath: string,
 445:   maxDepth: number = 3
 446: ): Promise<{ structure: string; error?: string }> {
 447:   try {
 448:     const entries = await readFolderStructure(folderPath, maxDepth);
 449:     const structure = formatFolderStructure(entries);
 450:     return { structure: `${folderPath}/\n${structure}` };
 451:   } catch (error) {
 452:     logToolError("hev_fs_expand_folder", error as Error, { folderPath, maxDepth });
 453:     return { structure: "", error: (error as Error).message };
 454:   }
 455: }
 456: 
 457: /**
 458:  * bash - Shell komutu çalıştır
 459:  */
 460: export async function executeBash(
 461:   command: string | number,
 462:   workspacePath: string,
 463:   timeout: number = FS_TIMEOUTS.BASH_DEFAULT
 464: ): Promise<BashResult> {
 465:   return new Promise((resolve) => {
 466:     // PID ile log alma (şimdilik desteklenmiyor)
 467:     if (typeof command === "number") {
 468:       resolve({
 469:         stdout: "",
 470:         stderr: "PID ile log alma henüz desteklenmiyor",
 471:         exitCode: 1,
 472:       });
 473:       return;
 474:     }
 475:     
 476:     const isBackground = command.trim().endsWith("&");
 477:     const actualCommand = isBackground ? command.slice(0, -1).trim() : command;
 478:     
 479:     const child = spawn("bash", ["-c", actualCommand], {
 480:       cwd: workspacePath,
 481:       env: { ...process.env },
 482:       stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
 483:     });
 484:     
 485:     let stdout = "";
 486:     let stderr = "";
 487:     let timedOut = false;
 488:     
 489:     const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
 490:       timedOut = true;
 491:       child.kill("SIGTERM");
 492:     }, timeout);
 493:     
 494:     child.stdout.on("data", (data) => {
 495:       stdout += data.toString();
 496:     });
 497:     
 498:     child.stderr.on("data", (data) => {
 499:       stderr += data.toString();
 500:     });
 501:     
 502:     child.on("close", (code) => {
 503:       clearTimeout(timeoutId);
 504:       
 505:       // Output limitlenmesi (çok büyük çıktılar için)
 506:       const maxOutput = 50000;
 507:       if (stdout.length > maxOutput) {
 508:         stdout = stdout.slice(0, maxOutput) + `\n... (${stdout.length - maxOutput} karakter kesildi)`;
 509:       }
 510:       if (stderr.length > maxOutput) {
 511:         stderr = stderr.slice(0, maxOutput) + `\n... (${stderr.length - maxOutput} karakter kesildi)`;
 512:       }
 513:       
 514:       resolve({
 515:         stdout,
 516:         stderr,
 517:         exitCode: code ?? (timedOut ? 124 : 1),
 518:         pid: child.pid,
 519:         timedOut,
 520:       });
 521:     });
 522:     
 523:     child.on("error", (err) => {
 524:       clearTimeout(timeoutId);
 525:       resolve({
 526:         stdout,
 527:         stderr: err.message,
 528:         exitCode: 1,
 529:       });
 530:     });
 531:     
 532:     // Background process için hemen dön
 533:     if (isBackground) {
 534:       clearTimeout(timeoutId);
 535:       setTimeout(() => {
 536:         resolve({
 537:           stdout: `Background process başlatıldı`,
 538:           stderr: "",
 539:           exitCode: 0,
 540:           pid: child.pid,
 541:         });
 542:       }, 100);
 543:     }
 544:   });
 545: }

 547: // ============================================
 548: // Recycle Bin & Backup Tools
 549: // ============================================
 550: 
 551: /**
 552:  * fs_trash_list - Çöp kutusunu listele
 553:  */
 554: export function trashList(projectRoot: string): { items: Array<{ path: string; deletedAt: string; size: string }>; total: number } {
 555:   const items = listTrash(projectRoot);
 556:   return {
 557:     items: items.map(item => ({
 558:       path: item.originalPath,
 559:       deletedAt: item.deletedAt,
 560:       size: item.isDirectory ? "DIR" : formatBytes(item.size),
 561:     })),
 562:     total: items.length,
 563:   };
 564: }
 565: 
 566: function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
 567:   if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes}B`;
 568:   if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB`;
 569:   return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)}MB`;
 570: }
 571: 
 572: /**
 573:  * fs_restore - Çöp kutusundan geri yükle
 574:  */
 575: export function restoreFile(projectRoot: string, index?: number): { success: boolean; message: string } {
 576:   const items = listTrash(projectRoot);
 577:   
 578:   if (items.length === 0) {
 579:     return { success: false, message: "Çöp kutusu boş" };
 580:   }
 581:   
 582:   const targetIndex = index ?? 0; // Default: en son silinen
 583:   if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= items.length) {
 584:     return { success: false, message: `Geçersiz index. 0-${items.length - 1} arasında olmalı` };
 585:   }
 586:   
 587:   const item = items[targetIndex];
 588:   const result = restoreFromTrash(projectRoot, item.trashPath);
 589:   
 590:   if (result.success) {
 591:     return { success: true, message: `✅ Geri yüklendi: ${result.restoredTo}` };
 592:   }
 593:   return { success: false, message: result.error || "Bilinmeyen hata" };
 594: }
 595: 
 596: /**
 597:  * fs_trash_empty - Çöp kutusunu boşalt
 598:  */
 599: export function trashEmpty(projectRoot: string, olderThanDays?: number): { success: boolean; message: string } {
 600:   const result = emptyTrash(projectRoot, olderThanDays);
 601:   const freedStr = formatBytes(result.freedBytes);
 602:   
 603:   if (olderThanDays) {
 604:     return { success: true, message: `🗑️ ${result.deleted} dosya silindi (${olderThanDays} günden eski), ${freedStr} boşaltıldı` };
 605:   }
 606:   return { success: true, message: `🗑️ Çöp kutusu boşaltıldı: ${result.deleted} dosya, ${freedStr}` };
 607: }

 611:  */
 612: export function backupFile(projectRoot: string, filePath: string): { success: boolean; message: string; backupPath?: string } {
 613:   const result = createBackup(projectRoot, filePath);
 614:   if (result.success) {
 615:     return { success: true, message: `✅ Yedek oluşturuldu: ${result.backupPath}`, backupPath: result.backupPath };
 616:   }
 617:   return { success: false, message: result.error || "Yedekleme başarısız" };
 618: }

 677: /**
 678:  * create_technical_plan - Teknik plan oluştur
 679:  */
 680: export function createTechnicalPlan(
 681:   plan: TechnicalPlan
 682: ): { success: boolean; summary: string } {
 683:   // Plan validasyonu
 684:   if (!plan.logicalChanges || plan.logicalChanges.length === 0) {
 685:     return { success: false, summary: "Plan boş olamaz" };
 686:   }
 687:   
 688:   // Özet oluştur
 689:   const summaryLines: string[] = ["# Teknik Plan\n"];
 690:   
 691:   for (let i = 0; i < plan.logicalChanges.length; i++) {
 692:     const change = plan.logicalChanges[i];
 693:     summaryLines.push(`## ${i + 1}. ${change.summary}\n`);
 694:     
 695:     for (const file of change.filesToChange) {
 696:       summaryLines.push(`- **${file.filePath}**: ${file.descriptionOfChange}`);
 697:       if (file.clarifyingQuestionIfAny) {
 698:         summaryLines.push(`  - ❓ ${file.clarifyingQuestionIfAny}`);
 699:       }
 700:     }
 701:     summaryLines.push("");
 702:   }
 703:   
 704:   return { success: true, summary: summaryLines.join("\n") };
 705: }

  1: /**
  2:  * LogTools - Log okuma ve sorgulama araçları
  3:  */
  4: 
  5: import { readdir } from "fs/promises";
  6: import { join } from "path";
  7: import { existsSync } from "fs";
  8: import { findLatestSession, readSessionLogs, filterLogs, readSessionInfo } from "../utils/log-utils.js";
  9: import { logToolError } from "../utils/mcp-logger.js";
 10: import type { ToolResult } from "../types/index.js";
 11: 
 12: /** Log read arguments */
 13: interface LogReadArgs {
 14:   type?: "all" | "console" | "error" | "structured";
 15:   tail?: number;
 16:   source?: string;
 17:   level?: string;
 18:   contains?: string;
 19:   correlationId?: string;
 20:   sessionId?: string;
 21: }
 22: 
 23: /**
 24:  * read_electron_logs handler
 25:  * 
 26:  * NOT: Default olarak "console" logları okur - artık tüm loglar (main + renderer) birleşik.
 27:  * Structured loglar JSON analizi için hâlâ mevcut.
 28:  */
 29: export async function readElectronLogs(
 30:   logDir: string, 
 31:   args?: LogReadArgs
 32: ): Promise<ToolResult> {
 33:   const { 
 34:     type = "console",  // Default: console (birleşik log - main + renderer)
 35:     tail = 50, 
 36:     source, 
 37:     level, 
 38:     contains, 
 39:     correlationId,
 40:     sessionId: requestedSessionId,
 41:   } = args || {};
 42:   
 43:   const sessionId = requestedSessionId || await findLatestSession(logDir);
 44:   
 45:   if (!sessionId) {
 46:     return {
 47:       content: [{ type: "text", text: "Log session bulunamadı. Uygulama hiç çalıştırılmamış olabilir." }],
 48:       isError: true,
 49:     };
 50:   }
 51:   
 52:   // Error logs
 53:   if (type === "error") {
 54:     const content = await readSessionLogs(logDir, sessionId, "error");
 55:     const filtered = filterLogs(content, { tail });
 56:     return {
 57:       content: [{ 
 58:         type: "text", 
 59:         text: `📕 Error Logs (Session: ${sessionId})\n\n${filtered.join("\n") || "Hata yok ✅"}`,
 60:       }],
 61:     };
 62:   }
 63:   
 64:   // Structured logs (default - en detaylı log kaynağı)
 65:   if (type === "structured") {
 66:     const content = await readSessionLogs(logDir, sessionId, "structured");
 67:     let lines = content.split("\n").filter(l => l.trim());
 68:     
 69:     // Filtreleme
 70:     if (source) {
 71:       lines = lines.filter(l => {
 72:         try {
 73:           const json = JSON.parse(l);
 74:           return json.source?.toLowerCase().includes(source.toLowerCase());
 75:         } catch { return false; }
 76:       });
 77:     }
 78:     if (level) {
 79:       lines = lines.filter(l => {
 80:         try {
 81:           const json = JSON.parse(l);
 82:           return json.type === level;
 83:         } catch { return false; }
 84:       });
 85:     }
 86:     if (contains) {
 87:       lines = lines.filter(l => l.toLowerCase().includes(contains.toLowerCase()));
 88:     }
 89:     if (correlationId) {
 90:       lines = lines.filter(l => l.includes(correlationId));
 91:     }
 92:     
 93:     // Son N satır
 94:     lines = lines.slice(-tail);
 95:     
 96:     // Okunabilir format
 97:     const formatted = lines.map(l => {
 98:       try {
 99:         const json = JSON.parse(l);
100:         const vis = json.visibility ? `[L${json.visibility}]` : '';
101:         return `[${json.timestamp}] ${vis} [${json.source}] ${json.message}`;
102:       } catch { return l; }
103:     });
104:     
105:     const filterInfo = [
106:       source && `source=${source}`,
107:       level && `level=${level}`,
108:       contains && `contains="${contains}"`,
109:       correlationId && `correlationId=${correlationId}`,
110:     ].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
111:     
112:     return {
113:       content: [{ 
114:         type: "text", 
115:         text: `📗 Structured Logs (Session: ${sessionId})${filterInfo ? `\nFiltre: ${filterInfo}` : ""}\n\n${formatted.join("\n") || "Log bulunamadı"}`,
116:       }],
117:     };
118:   }
119:   
120:   // Console logs (default - birleşik main + renderer)
121:   const content = await readSessionLogs(logDir, sessionId, "console");
122:   let lines = content.split("\n").filter(l => l.trim());
123:   
124:   // Filtreleme
125:   if (source) {
126:     lines = lines.filter(l => l.toLowerCase().includes(`[${source.toLowerCase()}]`));
127:   }
128:   if (level) {
129:     lines = lines.filter(l => l.toLowerCase().includes(`[${level.toLowerCase()}]`));
130:   }
131:   if (contains) {
132:     lines = lines.filter(l => l.toLowerCase().includes(contains.toLowerCase()));
133:   }
134:   if (correlationId) {
135:     lines = lines.filter(l => l.includes(correlationId));
136:   }
137:   
138:   // Son N satır
139:   lines = lines.slice(-tail);
140:   
141:   const filterInfo = [
142:     source && `source=${source}`,
143:     level && `level=${level}`,
144:     contains && `contains="${contains}"`,
145:     correlationId && `correlationId=${correlationId}`,
146:   ].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
147:   
148:   return {
149:     content: [{ 
150:       type: "text", 
151:       text: `📘 Birleşik Loglar (Session: ${sessionId})${filterInfo ? `\nFiltre: ${filterInfo}` : ""}\n\n${lines.join("\n") || "Log bulunamadı"}`,
152:     }],
153:   };
154: }

156: /** Session list item */
157: interface SessionListItem {
158:   id: string;
159:   hasErrors: boolean;
160:   hasSummary: boolean;
161: }
162: 
163: /**
164:  * list_log_sessions handler
165:  */
166: export async function listLogSessions(
167:   logDir: string, 
168:   args?: { limit?: number }
169: ): Promise<ToolResult> {
170:   const limit = args?.limit || 10;
171:   
172:   if (!existsSync(logDir)) {
173:     return {
174:       content: [{ type: "text", text: "Log dizini bulunamadı" }],
175:       isError: true,
176:     };
177:   }
178:   
179:   try {
180:     const entries = await readdir(logDir, { withFileTypes: true });
181:     const sessions: SessionListItem[] = entries
182:       .filter(e => e.isDirectory())
183:       .map(e => ({
184:         id: e.name,
185:         hasErrors: existsSync(join(logDir, e.name, "error.log")),
186:         hasSummary: existsSync(join(logDir, e.name, "summary.json")),
187:       }))
188:       .sort((a, b) => b.id.localeCompare(a.id))
189:       .slice(0, limit);
190:     
191:     const output = sessions.map(s => {
192:       const status = s.hasErrors ? "⚠️" : "✅";
193:       const state = s.hasSummary ? "tamamlandı" : "aktif/tamamlanmamış";
194:       return `${status} ${s.id} (${state})`;
195:     }).join("\n");
196:     
197:     return {
198:       content: [{ 
199:         type: "text", 
200:         text: `📂 Log Session'ları (son ${limit}):\n\n${output}`,
201:       }],
202:     };
203:   } catch (err) {
204:     const error = err as Error;
205:     logToolError("hev_list_log_sessions", error, { limit });
206:     return {
207:       content: [{ type: "text", text: `❌ Session listesi okunamadı: ${error.message}` }],
208:       isError: true,
209:     };
210:   }
211: }

225:       isError: true,
226:     };
227:   }
228:

234:       isError: true,

236:   }
237:   
238:   const output = `📊 Session Özeti: ${sessionId}
239: 
240: 📅 Başlangıç: ${(meta?.startTime as string) || "unknown"}
241: 📅 Bitiş: ${(summary?.endTime as string) || "active (devam ediyor)"}
242: 🏁 Durum: ${(summary?.endReason as string) || "active"}
243: 
244: 💻 Platform: ${(meta?.platform as string) || "unknown"}
245: 📦 Electron: ${(meta?.electronVersion as string) || "unknown"}
246: 🟢 Node: ${(meta?.nodeVersion as string) || "unknown"}
247: 
248: 📈 İstatistikler:
249: - Toplam Log: ${(summary?.stats as Record<string, unknown>)?.totalLogs || "N/A"}
250: - Hatalar: ${(summary?.stats as Record<string, unknown>)?.errors || 0}
251: - Uyarılar: ${(summary?.stats as Record<string, unknown>)?.warnings || 0}
252: - Chunk Sayısı: ${(summary?.stats as Record<string, unknown>)?.chunks || 1}`;
253:   
254:   return {
255:     content: [{ type: "text", text: output }],
256:   };
257: }

  1: /**
  2:  * Web Tools - MCP Web Search & Fetch
  3:  * 
  4:  * SearXNG meta-search engine entegrasyonu ile web araması,
  5:  * sayfa içeriği çekme ve özetleme araçları.
  6:  */
  7: 
  8: import { fetchAndParse, truncateText } from "../utils/web-scraper.js";
  9: import { logToolError } from "../utils/mcp-logger.js";
 10: import { WEB_TIMEOUTS } from "../utils/timeouts.js";
 11: import type { ToolResult } from "../types/index.js";
 12: 
 13: // SearXNG yapılandırması (host network mode için 8080 portu)
 14: const SEARXNG_URL = process.env.SEARXNG_URL || "http://localhost:8080";
 15: 
 16: // ============================================
 17: // Types
 18: // ============================================
 19: 
 20: export interface SearchResult {
 21:   title: string;
 22:   url: string;
 23:   snippet: string;
 24:   engine: string;
 25:   category?: string;
 26:   publishedDate?: string;
 27: }
 28: 
 29: export interface SearchResponse {
 30:   query: string;
 31:   results: SearchResult[];
 32:   totalResults: number;
 33:   searchTime: number;
 34:   engines: string[];
 35:   error?: string;
 36: }
 37: 
 38: export interface FetchResponse {
 39:   url: string;
 40:   title: string;
 41:   content: string;
 42:   markdown: string;
 43:   wordCount: number;
 44:   error?: string;
 45: }
 46: 
 47: // ============================================
 48: // Tool 1: Web Search
 49: // ============================================
 50: 
 51: /**
 52:  * SearXNG ile web araması yap
 53:  */
 54: export async function webSearch(options: {
 55:   query: string;
 56:   categories?: string;
 57:   engines?: string;
 58:   language?: string;
 59:   limit?: number;
 60:   timeRange?: string;
 61: }): Promise<SearchResponse> {
 62:   const {
 63:     query,
 64:     categories = "general",
 65:     engines,
 66:     language = "tr-TR",
 67:     limit = 10,
 68:     timeRange,
 69:   } = options;
 70: 
 71:   const startTime = Date.now();
 72: 
 73:   try {
 74:     // SearXNG API URL oluştur
 75:     const params = new URLSearchParams({
 76:       q: query,
 77:       format: "json",
 78:       categories,
 79:       language,
 80:     });
 81: 
 82:     if (engines) params.append("engines", engines);
 83:     if (timeRange) params.append("time_range", timeRange);
 84: 
 85:     const url = `${SEARXNG_URL}/search?${params}`;
 86: 
 87:     // Fetch with timeout
 88:     const controller = new AbortController();
 89:     const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), WEB_TIMEOUTS.SEARCH_API);
 90: 
 91:     const response = await fetch(url, {
 92:       signal: controller.signal,
 93:       headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
 94:     });
 95: 
 96:     clearTimeout(timeoutId);
 97: 
 98:     if (!response.ok) {
 99:       throw new Error(`SearXNG API hatası: ${response.status}`);
100:     }
101: 
102:     const data = await response.json() as {
103:       results?: Array<{
104:         title?: string;
105:         url?: string;
106:         content?: string;
107:         engines?: string[];
108:         engine?: string;
109:         category?: string;
110:         publishedDate?: string;
111:       }>;
112:       number_of_results?: number;
113:       engines?: string[];
114:     };
115:     const searchTime = Date.now() - startTime;
116: 
117:     // Sonuçları formatla
118:     const results: SearchResult[] = (data.results || [])
119:       .slice(0, limit)
120:       .map((r) => ({
121:         title: r.title || "",
122:         url: r.url || "",
123:         snippet: r.content || "",
124:         engine: r.engines?.[0] || r.engine || "unknown",
125:         category: r.category,
126:         publishedDate: r.publishedDate,
127:       }));
128: 
129:     return {
130:       query,
131:       results,
132:       totalResults: data.number_of_results || results.length,
133:       searchTime,
134:       engines: data.engines || [],
135:     };
136:   } catch (error) {
137:     const err = error as Error;
138:     logToolError("hev_web_search", err, { query, categories });
139: 
140:     // SearXNG bağlantı hatası için anlamlı mesaj
141:     if (err.name === "AbortError") {
142:       return {
143:         query,
144:         results: [],
145:         totalResults: 0,
146:         searchTime: Date.now() - startTime,
147:         engines: [],
148:         error: "Arama zaman aşımına uğradı. SearXNG çalışıyor mu?",
149:       };
150:     }
151: 
152:     return {
153:       query,
154:       results: [],
155:       totalResults: 0,
156:       searchTime: Date.now() - startTime,
157:       engines: [],
158:       error: err.message,
159:     };
160:   }
161: }
