164: // Tool 2: Web Fetch
165: // ============================================
166: 
167: /**
168:  * URL'den sayfa içeriğini çek ve temizle
169:  */
170: export async function webFetch(options: {
171:   url: string;
172:   maxLength?: number;
173:   includeLinks?: boolean;
174:   format?: "text" | "markdown";
175: }): Promise<FetchResponse> {
176:   const {
177:     url,
178:     maxLength = 30000,
179:     includeLinks = true,
180:     format = "markdown",
181:   } = options;
182: 
183:   try {
184:     const result = await fetchAndParse(url, {
185:       maxLength,
186:       includeLinks,
187:     });
188: 
189:     return {
190:       url: result.url,
191:       title: result.title,
192:       content: format === "markdown" ? result.markdown : result.content,
193:       markdown: result.markdown,
194:       wordCount: result.wordCount,
195:     };
196:   } catch (error) {
197:     const err = error as Error;
198:     logToolError("hev_web_fetch", err, { url });
199: 
200:     return {
201:       url,
202:       title: "",
203:       content: "",
204:       markdown: "",
205:       wordCount: 0,
206:       error: err.message,
207:     };
208:   }
209: }

211: // ============================================
212: // Tool 3: Search & Fetch (Combined)
213: // ============================================
214: 
215: /**
216:  * Arama yap ve ilk N sonucun içeriğini çek
217:  */
218: export async function webSearchAndFetch(options: {
219:   query: string;
220:   fetchCount?: number;
221:   maxContentLength?: number;
222:   categories?: string;
223: }): Promise<{
224:   query: string;
225:   results: Array<SearchResult & { content?: string; fetchError?: string }>;
226:   searchTime: number;
227:   error?: string;
228: }> {
229:   const {
230:     query,
231:     fetchCount = 3,
232:     maxContentLength = 10000,
233:     categories = "general",
234:   } = options;
235: 
236:   // Önce arama yap
237:   const searchResult = await webSearch({ query, categories, limit: fetchCount + 2 });
238: 
239:   if (searchResult.error) {
240:     return {
241:       query,
242:       results: [],
243:       searchTime: searchResult.searchTime,
244:       error: searchResult.error,
245:     };
246:   }
247: 
248:   // İlk N sonucun içeriğini çek (paralel)
249:   const fetchPromises = searchResult.results.slice(0, fetchCount).map(async (result) => {
250:     try {
251:       const fetched = await webFetch({
252:         url: result.url,
253:         maxLength: maxContentLength,
254:         format: "markdown",
255:       });
256: 
257:       return {
258:         ...result,
259:         content: fetched.error ? undefined : truncateText(fetched.content, maxContentLength),
260:         fetchError: fetched.error,
261:       };
262:     } catch (err) {
263:       return {
264:         ...result,
265:         fetchError: (err as Error).message,
266:       };
267:     }
268:   });
269: 
270:   const resultsWithContent = await Promise.all(fetchPromises);
271: 
272:   return {
273:     query,
274:     results: resultsWithContent,
275:     searchTime: searchResult.searchTime,
276:   };
277: }

286: export async function handleWebSearch(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ToolResult> {
287:   const result = await webSearch({
288:     query: args.query as string,
289:     categories: args.categories as string,
290:     engines: args.engines as string,
291:     language: args.language as string,
292:     limit: args.limit as number,
293:     timeRange: args.time_range as string,
294:   });
295: 
296:   if (result.error) {
297:     return {
298:       content: [{ type: "text", text: `❌ Arama hatası: ${result.error}` }],
299:       isError: true,
300:     };
301:   }
302: 
303:   // Sonuçları formatla
304:   let output = `## Arama: "${result.query}"\n\n`;
305:   output += `📊 ${result.totalResults} sonuç bulundu (${result.searchTime}ms)\n\n`;
306: 
307:   if (result.results.length === 0) {
308:     output += "Sonuç bulunamadı.";
309:   } else {
310:     result.results.forEach((r, i) => {
311:       output += `### ${i + 1}. ${r.title}\n`;
312:       output += `🔗 ${r.url}\n`;
313:       output += `📝 ${r.snippet}\n`;
314:       output += `🔍 ${r.engine}${r.publishedDate ? ` • ${r.publishedDate}` : ""}\n\n`;
315:     });
316:   }
317: 
318:   return { content: [{ type: "text", text: output }] };
319: }

347: /**

349:  */
350: export async function handleWebSearchAndFetch(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ToolResult> {
351:   const result = await webSearchAndFetch({
352:     query: args.query as string,
353:     fetchCount: args.fetch_count as number,
354:     maxContentLength: args.max_content_length as number,
355:     categories: args.categories as string,
356:   });
357: 
358:   if (result.error) {
359:     return {
360:       content: [{ type: "text", text: `❌ Arama hatası: ${result.error}` }],
361:       isError: true,
362:     };
363:   }
364: 
365:   let output = `## Arama ve İçerik: "${result.query}"\n\n`;
366:   output += `⏱️ ${result.searchTime}ms\n\n`;
367: 
368:   if (result.results.length === 0) {
369:     output += "Sonuç bulunamadı.";
370:   } else {
371:     result.results.forEach((r, i) => {
372:       output += `---\n\n### ${i + 1}. ${r.title}\n`;
373:       output += `🔗 ${r.url}\n`;
374:       output += `🔍 ${r.engine}\n\n`;
375: 
376:       if (r.fetchError) {
377:         output += `⚠️ İçerik alınamadı: ${r.fetchError}\n\n`;
378:         output += `📝 Snippet: ${r.snippet}\n\n`;
379:       } else if (r.content) {
380:         output += r.content + "\n\n";
381:       }
382:     });
383:   }
384: 
385:   return { content: [{ type: "text", text: output }] };
386: }

================
File: src/js/modules/settings/settings-events.ts
================
 1: import { LogManager } from "../log-manager.js";
 2: import { getErrorMessage } from "../../types/index.js";
 3: 
 4: type ListenerFn = (payload: any) => void;
 5: 
 6: export class Emitter {
 7:   listeners: Set<ListenerFn>;
 8: 
 9:   constructor() {
10:     this.listeners = new Set();
11:   }
12:   on(fn: ListenerFn) {
13:     if (typeof fn === "function") this.listeners.add(fn);
14:     return () => this.off(fn);
15:   }
16:   off(fn: ListenerFn) {
17:     this.listeners.delete(fn);
18:   }
19:   emit(payload: any) {
20:     for (const fn of Array.from(this.listeners)) {
21:       try {
22:         fn(payload);
23:       } catch (err: any) {
24:         LogManager.addEvent("settings-events", "warning", "Listener error", { error: getErrorMessage(err) });
25:       }
26:     }
27:   }
28: }
29: 
30: export function createSettingsBroadcast(channelName = "hayalet-settings") {
31:   try {
32:     const bc = new BroadcastChannel(channelName);
33:     return {
34:       post: (msg: unknown) => {
35:         bc.postMessage(msg);
36:       },
37:       on: (handler: (data: unknown) => void) => {
38:         bc.onmessage = (e) => {
39:           handler?.(e?.data);
40:         };
41:         return () => {
42:           try {
43:             bc.onmessage = null;
44:             bc.close();
45:           } catch {
46:           }
47:         };
48:       },
49:     };
50:   } catch (err) {
51:     LogManager.addEvent("settings-events", "warning", `Failed to create BroadcastChannel: ${channelName}`, { error: getErrorMessage(err) });
52:     return {
53:       post: () => {},
54:       on: () => () => {},
55:     };
56:   }
57: }

  1: /**
  2:  * TimeoutHandler - Slot timeout ve hata yönetimi
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu modül slot işlemlerinin timeout ve hata durumlarını yönetir:
  5:  * - Timeout başlatma/temizleme
  6:  * - Bağlantı hatası yönetimi
  7:  * - Hata sonrası temizlik
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: import { getErrorMessage } from "../../types/index.js";
 11: import type { SlotId } from "../../types/index.js";
 12: 
 13: /**
 14:  * Timeout'ları saklamak için map
 15:  */
 16: const timeouts: Record<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>> = {};
 17: 
 18: /**
 19:  * Timeout başlat
 20:  */
 21: export function startTimeout(slot: string, operation: string, ms: number, callback: () => void) {
 22:   const key = `${slot}-${operation}`;
 23:   clearTimeout(slot, operation);
 24:   timeouts[key] = setTimeout(callback, ms);
 25: }
 26: 
 27: /**
 28:  * Timeout'u temizle
 29:  */
 30: export function clearTimeout(slot: string, operation: string) {
 31:   const key = `${slot}-${operation}`;
 32:   if (timeouts[key]) {
 33:     globalThis.clearTimeout(timeouts[key]);
 34:     delete timeouts[key];
 35:   }
 36: }
 37: 
 38: interface SlotState {
 39:   error?: Error | null;
 40:   trafficStarted?: boolean;
 41:   webview?: unknown;
 42:   domReady?: boolean;
 43: }
 44: 
 45: type LogFn = (slot: string, level: string, message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
 46: type EmitFn = (slot: string, event: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
 47: type TransitionFn = (slot: string, state: string) => void;
 48: type CleanupFn = (slot: string, correlationId: string) => void;
 49: 
 50: /**
 51:  * Bağlantı timeout'unu işle
 52:  */
 53: export function handleConnectTimeout(
 54:   slotState: SlotState,
 55:   slot: string,
 56:   correlationId: string,
 57:   errorState: string,
 58:   logFn: LogFn,
 59:   emitFn: EmitFn,
 60:   transitionFn: TransitionFn,
 61:   connectFailedEvent: string,
 62:   cleanupFn: CleanupFn
 63: ) {
 64:   logFn(slot, "error", "Connection timeout", { correlationId });
 65:   
 66:   slotState.error = new Error("Connection timeout");
 67:   emitFn(slot, connectFailedEvent, { correlationId, error: "timeout" });
 68:   
 69:   cleanupFn(slot, correlationId);
 70:   transitionFn(slot, errorState);
 71: }
 72: 
 73: /**
 74:  * Bağlantı hatasını işle
 75:  */
 76: export function handleConnectError(
 77:   slotState: SlotState,
 78:   slot: string,
 79:   correlationId: string,
 80:   error: unknown,
 81:   errorState: string,
 82:   logFn: LogFn,
 83:   emitFn: EmitFn,
 84:   transitionFn: TransitionFn,
 85:   connectFailedEvent: string,
 86:   cleanupFn: CleanupFn
 87: ): { success: boolean; message: string; correlationId: string } {
 88:   const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
 89:   logFn(slot, "error", `Connection failed: ${errorMsg}`, { correlationId });
 90:   
 91:   slotState.error = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(errorMsg);
 92:   emitFn(slot, connectFailedEvent, { correlationId, error: errorMsg });
 93:   
 94:   cleanupFn(slot, correlationId);
 95:   transitionFn(slot, errorState);
 96:   
 97:   return { success: false, message: errorMsg, correlationId };
 98: }
 99: 
100: /**
101:  * Hata sonrası temizlik yap
102:  */
103: export async function cleanupAfterError(
104:   slotState: SlotState,
105:   slot: string,
106:   correlationId: string,
107:   logFn: LogFn,
108:   clearUrlChangeHandlerFn: (slot: SlotId | string) => void,
109:   clearDomReadyHandlerFn: (slot: SlotId | string) => void,
110:   stopTrafficFn: (slot: string, correlationId: string) => Promise<void>,
111:   detachWebviewFn: (slot: string, correlationId: string) => Promise<void>
112: ) {
113:   try {
114:     clearUrlChangeHandlerFn(slot);
115:     clearDomReadyHandlerFn(slot);
116:     
117:     if (slotState.trafficStarted) {
118:       await stopTrafficFn(slot, correlationId);
119:     }
120:     
121:     if (slotState.webview) {
122:       await detachWebviewFn(slot, correlationId);
123:     }
124:     
125:     slotState.domReady = false;
126:     slotState.trafficStarted = false;
127:   } catch (err) {
128:     logFn(slot, "warning", `Cleanup warning: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, { correlationId });
129:   }
130: }

 74:   /**
 75:    * Scroll to bottom of the webview
 76:    */
 77:   async scrollToBottom(provider: string, webview: WebviewElement): Promise<boolean> {
 78:     if (!webview || webview.isDestroyed?.()) return false;
 79:     
 80:     // FIX: Webview'ın DOM'a attach olduğunu ve hazır olduğunu kontrol et
 81:     try {
 82:       if (typeof webview.getWebContentsId !== "function") return false;
 83:       webview.getWebContentsId(); // Hazır değilse hata fırlatır
 84:       if (webview.isLoading?.()) return false;
 85:     } catch (_) {
 86:       return false;
 87:     }
 88:     
 89:     const providerId = AppState.getProviderIdForSlot(provider) || "";
 90:     const cfg = providerId ? ProviderRegistry.get(providerId as "opencode" | "chatgpt" | "grok" | "gemini") : null;
 91:     const cfgWithSelectors = cfg as { scrollerSelectors?: string[]; contentContainers?: string[] } | null;
 92:     const scrollerSelectors = cfgWithSelectors?.scrollerSelectors || [
 93:       "div.flex.h-full.flex-col.overflow-y-auto",
 94:       "main div.overflow-y-auto",
 95:       "main section.overflow-y-auto",
 96:       'div[role="main"] .overflow-y-auto',
 97:     ];
 98:     const contentContainers = cfgWithSelectors?.contentContainers || [
 99:       "main",
100:       "section",
101:       "div",
102:       "article",
103:     ];
104:     
105:     const script = `(() => {
106:       const scrollerSelectors = ${JSON.stringify(scrollerSelectors)};
107:       const contentContainers = ${JSON.stringify(contentContainers)};
108:       
109:       const findChatScroller = () => {
110:         for (const sel of scrollerSelectors) {
111:           try {
112:             const el = document.querySelector(sel);
113:             if (el) {
114:               const style = getComputedStyle(el);
115:               const gap = el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight;
116:               const isScrollable = gap > 12 && (style.overflowY === 'auto' || style.overflowY === 'scroll');
117:               
118:               if (isScrollable) {
119:                 return el;
120:               }
121:               
122:               const scrollableChild = el.querySelector('[class*="overflow-y"]');
123:               if (scrollableChild) {
124:                 const childStyle = getComputedStyle(scrollableChild);
125:                 const childGap = scrollableChild.scrollHeight - scrollableChild.clientHeight;
126:                 if (childGap > 12 && (childStyle.overflowY === 'auto' || childStyle.overflowY === 'scroll')) {
127:                   return scrollableChild;
128:                 }
129:               }
130:               
131:               return el;
132:             }
133:           } catch (_) { /* noop */ }
134:         }
135:         return null;
136:       };
137:       
138:       const findFallbackScroller = () => {
139:         const candidates = [];
140:         const pushIfScrollable = (el) => {
141:           if (!el) return;
142:           const style = getComputedStyle(el);
143:           if (style.overflowY === 'hidden') return;
144:           const gap = el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight;
145:           if (gap > 8 && el.clientHeight > 120) {
146:             const priority = (style.overflowY === 'auto' || style.overflowY === 'scroll') ? gap * 2 : gap;
147:             candidates.push({ el, gap, priority });
148:           }
149:         };
150:         pushIfScrollable(document.scrollingElement);
151:         pushIfScrollable(document.documentElement);
152:         pushIfScrollable(document.body);
153:         for (const tag of contentContainers) {
154:           try {
155:             const list = document.querySelectorAll(tag);
156:             for (let i = 0; i < list.length && i < 250; i += 1) {
157:               pushIfScrollable(list[i]);
158:             }
159:           } catch (_) { /* noop */ }
160:         }
161:         candidates.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority);
162:         return (candidates[0] && candidates[0].el) || document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement || document.body;
163:       };
164:       
165:       const scroller = findChatScroller() || findFallbackScroller();
166:       if (!scroller) return false;
167:       
168:       try {
169:         const scrollHeight = scroller.scrollHeight;
170:         const clientHeight = scroller.clientHeight;
171:         const maxScroll = scrollHeight - clientHeight;
172:         
173:         const scrollMethods = [
174:           () => { scroller.scrollTop = maxScroll; },
175:           () => { scroller.scrollTop = scrollHeight; },
176:           () => { scroller.scrollTop = 999999; },
177:           () => { if (scroller.scrollTo) scroller.scrollTo({ top: maxScroll, behavior: 'auto' }); },
178:           () => { if (scroller.scrollTo) scroller.scrollTo({ top: scrollHeight, behavior: 'auto' }); },
179:           () => { if (scroller.scrollTo) scroller.scrollTo({ top: 999999, behavior: 'auto' }); },
180:           () => { if (scroller.scrollTo) scroller.scrollTo({ top: maxScroll, behavior: 'instant' }); },
181:           () => { if (scroller.scrollTo) scroller.scrollTo(0, maxScroll); },
182:         ];
183:         
184:         let bestScrollTop = scroller.scrollTop || 0;
185:         const maxAttempts = 12;
186:         
187:         for (let attempt = 0; attempt < maxAttempts; attempt += 1) {
188:           for (const method of scrollMethods) {
189:             try {
190:               method();
191:               const newScrollTop = scroller.scrollTop || 0;
192:               if (newScrollTop > bestScrollTop) {
193:                 bestScrollTop = newScrollTop;
194:               }
195:             } catch (_) { void 0; }
196:           }
197:           
198:           const currentTop = scroller.scrollTop || 0;
199:           const currentHeight = scroller.scrollHeight || 0;
200:           const currentClient = scroller.clientHeight || 0;
201:           const gap = Math.abs(currentHeight - currentTop - currentClient);
202:           
203:           if (gap < 8) {
204:             return true;
205:           }
206:           
207:           if (attempt < maxAttempts - 1) {
208:             const start = Date.now();
209:             while (Date.now() - start < 10) { /* busy wait 10ms */ }
210:           }
211:         }
212:         
213:         const finalTop = scroller.scrollTop || 0;
214:         const finalHeight = scroller.scrollHeight || 0;
215:         const finalClient = scroller.clientHeight || 0;
216:         const finalGap = Math.abs(finalHeight - finalTop - finalClient);
217:         return finalGap < 8;
218:       } catch (_) { 
219:         return false; 
220:       }
221:     })();`;
222:     
223:     try {
224:       const result = await webview.executeJavaScript?.(script, true);
225:       return typeof result === "boolean" ? result : false;
226:     } catch (_) {
227:       return false;
228:     }
229:   }

231:   /**
232:    * Handle probe data for loading tracking
233:    */
234:   async handleProbe(
235:     provider: string,
236:     viewState: ViewState,
237:     data: ProbeData,
238:     now: number,
239:     webview: WebviewElement,
240:     currentHref: string
241:   ): Promise<ProbeResult> {
242:     let indicator = viewState.status?.loading || "busy";
243:     let event = null;
244: 
245:     if (currentHref && currentHref !== viewState.lastHref) {
246:       viewState.lastHref = currentHref;
247:       
248:       this.startLoading(viewState, now);
249:       indicator = "busy";
250:       event = {
251:         type: "loading-started",
252:         message: `loading started for ${provider}: ${currentHref}`,
253:       };
254:     }
255: 
256:     if (viewState.loadingActive) {
257:       const result = await this.checkLoadingEnd(
258:         provider,
259:         viewState,
260:         data,
261:         now,
262:         webview,
263:         currentHref
264:       );
265: 
266:       if (result.shouldEnd) {
267:         indicator = "idle";
268:         event = {
269:           type: "loading-ended",
270:           message: `loading ended (${result.reason}) for ${provider}: ${currentHref}`,
271:         };
272:       } else {
273:         indicator = "busy";
274:       }
275: 
276:       viewState = result.newState;
277:     }
278: 
279:     return { indicator, newState: viewState, event };
280:   }
281: 
282:   /**
283:    * Initialize loading state for a provider
284:    */
285:   startLoading(viewState: ViewState, now: number): ViewState {
286:     viewState.loadingActive = true;
287:     viewState.loadingStartTime = now;
288:     viewState.loadingScrollAppeared = false;
289:     viewState.lastScrollChange = 0;
290:     viewState.lastAutoScrollAt = 0;
291:     return viewState;
292:   }
293: 
294:   /**
295:    * Check if loading should end based on current state
296:    */
297:   async checkLoadingEnd(
298:     provider: string,
299:     viewState: ViewState,
300:     data: ProbeData,
301:     now: number,
302:     webview: WebviewElement,
303:     currentUrl = ""
304:   ): Promise<CheckResult> {
305:     if (!viewState.loadingActive) {
306:       return { shouldEnd: false, reason: null, newState: viewState };
307:     }
308: 
309:     const scroll = data.scroll || {};
310:     const loadingElapsed = now - (viewState.loadingStartTime || now);
311: 
312:     // Default page kontrolü - scroll yerine send button varlığı ile loading sonlandır
313:     const providerId = AppState.getProviderIdForSlot(provider) || "";
314:     const onDefaultPage = isDefaultPage(currentUrl, providerId);
315:     
316:     if (onDefaultPage) {
317:       // Default page'de scroll yok, send butonu bulunduğunda (aktif veya pasif) loading biter
318:       // sendState: "enabled" (aktif), "disabled" (pasif), "missing" (bulunamadı)
319:       const sendButtonFound = data.sendState === "enabled" || data.sendState === "disabled";
320:       
321:       if (sendButtonFound) {
322:         return {
323:           shouldEnd: true,
324:           reason: "default page ready (send button found)",
325:           newState: this.endLoading(viewState, now),
326:         };
327:       }
328:       
329:       // Default page için daha kısa timeout (5 saniye)
330:       if (loadingElapsed > 5000) {
331:         return {
332:           shouldEnd: true,
333:           reason: "default page timeout",
334:           newState: this.endLoading(viewState, now),
335:         };
336:       }
337:       
338:       return { shouldEnd: false, reason: null, newState: viewState };
339:     }
340: 
341:     const scrollGap = (scroll.scrollHeight || 0) - (scroll.clientHeight || 0);
342:     const hasScroll = scrollGap > 12;
343:     const scrollChanged =
344:       scroll.lastChange && scroll.lastChange !== viewState.lastScrollChange;
345: 
346:     if (scrollChanged) {
347:       viewState.lastScrollChange = scroll.lastChange;
348:     }
349: 
350:     if (loadingElapsed > this.config.loading.maxWaitForScrollMs) {
351:       return {
352:         shouldEnd: true,
353:         reason: "timeout",
354:         newState: this.endLoading(viewState, now),
355:       };
356:     }
357: 
358:     if (!hasScroll) {
359:       return { shouldEnd: false, reason: null, newState: viewState };
360:     }
361: 
362:     if (hasScroll && !viewState.loadingScrollAppeared) {
363:       viewState.loadingScrollAppeared = true;
364:       viewState.lastScrollChange = scroll.lastChange || now;
365:     }
366: 
367:     if (viewState.loadingScrollAppeared) {
368:       const atBottom = scroll.atBottom || false;
369:       const timeSinceLastScroll = now - (viewState.lastAutoScrollAt || 0);
370: 
371:       if (
372:         !atBottom &&
373:         timeSinceLastScroll >= this.config.loading.autoScrollIntervalMs
374:       ) {
375:         try {
376:           const scrolled = await this.scrollToBottom(provider, webview);
377:           viewState.lastAutoScrollAt = now;
378:           if (scrolled) {
379:             viewState.loadingScrollAppeared = true;
380:             viewState.lastScrollChange = Date.now();
381:           }
382:         } catch (_) {
383:           viewState.lastAutoScrollAt = now;
384:         }
385:       }
386: 
387:       if ((viewState.lastScrollChange || 0) > 0) {
388:         const timeSinceLastScrollChange = now - (viewState.lastScrollChange || 0);
389:         if (
390:           timeSinceLastScrollChange >=
391:           this.config.loading.noScrollChangeTimeoutMs
392:         ) {
393:           return {
394:             shouldEnd: true,
395:             reason: "no more scroll",
396:             newState: this.endLoading(viewState, now),
397:           };
398:         }
399:       }
400:     }
401: 
402:     return { shouldEnd: false, reason: null, newState: viewState };
403:   }
404: 
405:   /**
406:    * End loading state
407:    */
408:   endLoading(viewState: ViewState, now: number): ViewState {
409:     viewState.loadingActive = false;
410:     viewState.loadingJustEnded = true;
411:     viewState.loadingEndedAt = now;
412:     return viewState;
413:   }
414: 
415:   /**
416:    * Clear the "just ended" flag after a delay
417:    */
418:   clearJustEnded(viewState: ViewState): ViewState {
419:     viewState.loadingJustEnded = false;
420:     return viewState;
421:   }
422: }

File: src/js/modules/traffic/probe-script-builder.ts

  1: /**
  2:  * ProbeScriptBuilder - Webview probe script oluşturucu
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu modül webview içinde çalıştırılacak probe script'ini oluşturur.
  5:  * Probe script:
  6:  * - Send/Stop/Voice butonlarını tespit eder
  7:  * - Scroll durumunu takip eder
  8:  * - Kullanıcı etkileşimlerini dinler
  9:  */
 10: 
 11: import { ProviderRegistry } from "../webview/provider-registry.js";
 12: import { AppState } from "../app-state.js";
 13: 
 14: /**
 15:  * Provider için probe script'i oluştur
 16:  */
 17: export function buildProbeScript(provider: string): string {
 18:   const providerId = AppState.getProviderIdForSlot(provider) || "";
 19:   const cfg = providerId ? ProviderRegistry.get(providerId) : null;
 20:   
 21:   if (!cfg) {
 22:     return `// No config for provider: ${JSON.stringify(providerId)}`; 
 23:   }
 24: 
 25:   // sendButtonBase varsa onu kullan (disabled kontrolü script içinde yapılır)
 26:   // yoksa sendButton kullan (eski davranış)
 27:   const selectors = cfg.selectors as { sendButtonBase?: string; sendButton?: string; stopButton?: string; voiceButton?: string };
 28:   const sendSel = selectors.sendButtonBase || selectors.sendButton || "";
 29:   const stopSel = selectors.stopButton || "";
 30:   const voiceSel = selectors.voiceButton || "";
 31:   const scrollerSels = cfg.scrollerSelectors || [];
 32:   const contentContainers = cfg.contentContainers || [
 33:     "main",
 34:     "section",
 35:     "div",
 36:     "article",
 37:   ];
 38: 
 39:   return `(() => {
 40:     try {
 41:       const sendSelector = ${JSON.stringify(sendSel)};
 42:       const stopSelector = ${JSON.stringify(stopSel)};
 43:       const voiceSelector = ${JSON.stringify(voiceSel)};
 44:       const scrollerSelectors = ${JSON.stringify(scrollerSels)};
 45:       const contentContainers = ${JSON.stringify(contentContainers)};
 46:       const now = Date.now();
 47:       
 48:       const findSendButton = () => {
 49:         try {
 50:           return sendSelector ? document.querySelector(sendSelector) : null;
 51:         } catch (_) {
 52:           return null;
 53:         }
 54:       };
 55:       
 56:       const findStopButton = () => {
 57:         try {
 58:           return stopSelector ? document.querySelector(stopSelector) : null;
 59:         } catch (_) {
 60:           return null;
 61:         }
 62:       };
 63:       
 64:       const findVoiceButton = () => {
 65:         try {
 66:           return voiceSelector ? document.querySelector(voiceSelector) : null;
 67:         } catch (_) {
 68:           return null;
 69:         }
 70:       };
 71:       
 72:       const recordSend = () => {
 73:         const slot = window.__codexState || (window.__codexState = {});
 74:         slot.lastSend = Date.now();
 75:       };
 76:       
 77:       const slot = window.__codexState || (window.__codexState = {});
 78:       if (!slot.lastSend) slot.lastSend = 0;
 79:       
 80:       if (!slot.sendListenersAttached) {
 81:         document.addEventListener('submit', () => recordSend(), true);
 82:         document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
 83:           if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && (e.target?.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || e.target?.getAttribute('contenteditable') === 'true')) recordSend();
 84:         }, true);
 85:         document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 86:           const btn = e.target?.closest(sendSelector || stopSelector || 'button');
 87:           if (btn) recordSend();
 88:         }, true);
 89:         [sendSelector, stopSelector].filter(Boolean).forEach((sel) => {
 90:           document.addEventListener('mousedown', (ev) => {
 91:             if (ev.target?.closest(sel)) recordSend();
 92:           }, true);
 93:           document.addEventListener('mouseup', (ev) => {
 94:             if (ev.target?.closest(sel)) recordSend();
 95:           }, true);
 96:         });
 97:         slot.sendListenersAttached = true;
 98:       }
 99:       
100:       const ensureScrollState = () => {
101:         if (!slot.scrollData) {
102:           slot.scrollData = { scrollTop: 0, scrollHeight: 0, clientHeight: 0, atBottom: false, lastChange: now };
103:         }
104:         return slot.scrollData;
105:       };
106:       
107:       const findChatScroller = () => {
108:         for (const sel of scrollerSelectors) {
109:           try {
110:             const el = document.querySelector(sel);
111:             if (el) return el;
112:           } catch (_) {}
113:         }
114:         return null;
115:       };
116:       
117:       const findFallbackScroller = () => {
118:         const candidates = [];
119:         const pushIfScrollable = (el) => {
120:           if (!el) return;
121:           const style = getComputedStyle(el);
122:           if (style.overflowY === 'hidden') return;
123:           const gap = el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight;
124:           if (gap > 8 && el.clientHeight > 120) candidates.push({ el, gap });
125:         };
126:         pushIfScrollable(document.scrollingElement);
127:         pushIfScrollable(document.documentElement);
128:         pushIfScrollable(document.body);
129:         for (const tag of contentContainers) {
130:           try {
131:             const list = document.querySelectorAll(tag);
132:             for (let i = 0; i < list.length && i < 250; i += 1) pushIfScrollable(list[i]);
133:           } catch (_) { /* noop */ }
134:         }
135:         candidates.sort((a, b) => b.gap - a.gap);
136:         return (candidates[0] && candidates[0].el) || document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement || document.body;
137:       };
138:       
139:       const scrollData = ensureScrollState();
140:       let scroller = findChatScroller() || slot.scroller || findFallbackScroller();
141:       
142:       const updateScrollSnapshot = () => {
143:         if (!scroller || !scrollData) return;
144:         const top = scroller.scrollTop || 0;
145:         const height = scroller.scrollHeight || 0;
146:         const client = scroller.clientHeight || 0;
147:         const atBottom = height ? Math.abs(height - top - client) < 8 : false;
148:         if (scrollData.scrollHeight !== height || scrollData.clientHeight !== client || Math.abs(scrollData.scrollTop - top) > 1) {
149:           scrollData.lastChange = Date.now();
150:         }
151:         scrollData.scrollTop = top;
152:         scrollData.scrollHeight = height;
153:         scrollData.clientHeight = client;
154:         scrollData.atBottom = atBottom;
155:       };
156:       
157:       if (scroller && scroller !== slot.scroller) {
158:         if (slot.scroller && slot.scrollHandler) {
159:           try {
160:             slot.scroller.removeEventListener('scroll', slot.scrollHandler);
161:           } catch (_) {
162:             void 0;
163:           }
164:         }
165:         if (slot.scrollObserver) {
166:           try {
167:             slot.scrollObserver.disconnect();
168:           } catch (_) {
169:             void 0;
170:           }
171:         }
172:         slot.scroller = scroller;
173:         slot.scrollHandler = () => updateScrollSnapshot();
174:         scroller.addEventListener('scroll', slot.scrollHandler, { passive: true });
175:         slot.scrollObserver = new MutationObserver(() => { scrollData.lastMut = Date.now(); updateScrollSnapshot(); });
176:         slot.scrollObserver.observe(scroller, { childList: true, subtree: true });
177:         updateScrollSnapshot();
178:       } else {
179:         updateScrollSnapshot();
180:       }
181:       
182:       const atBottom = scrollData.atBottom;
183:       const sendBtn = findSendButton();
184:       const stopBtn = findStopButton();
185:       const voiceBtn = findVoiceButton();
186:       
187:       let sendState = 'missing';
188:       if (sendBtn) {
189:         const disabledAttr = sendBtn.disabled || sendBtn.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true';
190:         const disabledStyle = getComputedStyle(sendBtn).pointerEvents === 'none';
191:         const disabledClass = /disabled|opacity-4|opacity-5|cursor-not-allowed/i.test(sendBtn.className || '');
192:         const disabledParent = sendBtn.closest('button[disabled], [aria-disabled="true"], [data-disabled="true"]');
193:         const disabled = disabledAttr || disabledStyle || disabledClass || disabledParent;
194:         sendState = disabled ? 'disabled' : 'enabled';
195:       }
196:       
197:       return {
198:         atBottom,
199:         sendState,
200:         stopVisible: !!stopBtn,
201:         voiceMode: !!voiceBtn,
202:         lastSend: slot.lastSend || 0,
203:         href: location.href,
204:         scroll: {
205:           scrollTop: scrollData.scrollTop,
206:           scrollHeight: scrollData.scrollHeight,
207:           clientHeight: scrollData.clientHeight,
208:           atBottom: scrollData.atBottom,
209:           lastChange: scrollData.lastChange,
210:         },
211:       };
212:     } catch (err) {
213:       return { error: String(err) };
214:     }
215:   })();`;
216: }

 1: export class SendTracker {
 2:   config: any;
 3: 
 4:   constructor(config: any) {
 5:     this.config = config;
 6:   }
 7: 
 8:   /**
 9:    * Handle probe data for send button tracking
10:    * @param {string} provider - Provider identifier (ai1/ai2)
11:    * @param {Object} viewState - Current state
12:    * @param {Object} data - Probe data containing sendState
13:    * @param {number} _now - Current timestamp (unused)
14:    * @returns {Object} { indicator: string, newState: Object }
15:    */
16:   handleProbe(_provider: string, viewState: Record<string, unknown>, data: { sendState?: string }, _now: number) {
17:     const sendState = data.sendState || "missing";
18:     const indicator = this.getSendStatus(sendState);
19:     return { indicator, newState: viewState };
20:   }
21: 
22:   /**
23:    * Get the send indicator status based on send button state
24:    * @param {string} sendState - The send button state: 'enabled', 'disabled', or 'missing'
25:    * @returns {string} Status: 'idle' (green), 'busy' (red)
26:    */
27:   getSendStatus(sendState: string) {
28:     if (sendState === "enabled") {
29:       return "idle";
30:     } else {
31:       return "busy";
32:     }
33:   }
34: 
35:   /**
36:    * Check if send button was triggered (for starting thinking state)
37:    * @param {Object} viewState - Current state
38:    * @param {number} lastSendTime - Last send timestamp from probe
39:    * @returns {boolean} True if send was just triggered
40:    */
41:   isSendTriggered(viewState: { lastSendSeen?: number }, lastSendTime: number) {
42:     return lastSendTime > (viewState.lastSendSeen || 0);
43:   }
44: 
45:   /**
46:    * Wait for send button to become enabled
47:    * @param {Function} getState - Function to get current state
48:    * @param {number} timeout - Maximum wait time in ms
49:    * @param {number} interval - Check interval in ms
50:    * @returns {Promise<boolean>} True if enabled within timeout
51:    */
52:   waitForSendEnabled(getState: () => { status: { send: string } }, timeout = 4000, interval = 100): Promise<boolean> {
53:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
54:       const start = Date.now();
55:       const check = () => {
56:         const state = getState();
57:         if (state.status.send === "idle") {
58:           resolve(true);
59:           return;
60:         }
61:         if (Date.now() - start >= timeout) {
62:           resolve(false);
63:           return;
64:         }
65:         setTimeout(check, interval);
66:       };
67:       check();
68:     });
69:   }
70: }

  1: // ============================================================================
  2: // Types
  3: // ============================================================================
  4: 
  5: interface ThinkingConfig {
  6:   thinking: {
  7:     stopButtonDetectionTimeoutMs: number;
  8:   };
  9: }
 10: 
 11: interface ViewState {
 12:   status?: {
 13:     thinking?: string;
 14:   };
 15:   lastSendSeen?: number;
 16:   stopButtonLastSeen?: number;
 17:   stopButtonDisappearedAt?: number;
 18:   thinkingJustEnded?: boolean;
 19:   thinkingEndedAt?: number;
 20: }
 21: 
 22: interface ProbeData {
 23:   stopVisible?: boolean;
 24:   sendState?: string;
 25:   voiceMode?: boolean;
 26:   lastSend?: number;
 27: }
 28: 
 29: interface ThinkingEvent {
 30:   type: string;
 31:   message: string;
 32: }
 33: 
 34: interface ProbeResult {
 35:   indicator: string;
 36:   newState: ViewState;
 37:   event: ThinkingEvent | null;
 38: }
 39: 
 40: interface CheckResult {
 41:   shouldEnd: boolean;
 42:   newState: ViewState;
 43: }
 44: 
 45: // ============================================================================
 46: // ThinkingTracker
 47: // ============================================================================
 48: 
 49: export class ThinkingTracker {
 50:   config: ThinkingConfig;
 51: 
 52:   constructor(config: ThinkingConfig) {
 53:     this.config = config;
 54:   }
 55: 
 56:   /**
 57:    * Handle probe data for thinking tracking
 58:    */
 59:   handleProbe(provider: string, viewState: ViewState, data: ProbeData, now: number): ProbeResult {
 60:     const lastSend = data.lastSend || 0;
 61: 
 62:     let event = null;
 63:     let indicator = viewState.status?.thinking || "idle";
 64: 
 65:     if (lastSend > (viewState.lastSendSeen || 0)) {
 66:       this.startThinking(viewState, now, lastSend);
 67:       indicator = "busy";
 68:       event = {
 69:         type: "thinking-started",
 70:         message: `send detected for ${provider} (lastSend=${lastSend})`,
 71:       };
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     if (viewState.status?.thinking === "busy") {
 75:       const result = this.checkThinkingEnd(provider, viewState, data, now);
 76:       if (result.shouldEnd) {
 77:         indicator = "idle";
 78:         event = {
 79:           type: "thinking-ended",
 80:           message: `thinking ended for ${provider}`,
 81:         };
 82:       }
 83:       viewState = result.newState;
 84:     }
 85: 
 86:     return { indicator, newState: viewState, event };
 87:   }
 88: 
 89:   /**
 90:    * Start thinking state when send button is triggered
 91:    */
 92:   startThinking(viewState: ViewState, now: number, lastSendTime: number): ViewState {
 93:     viewState.lastSendSeen = lastSendTime;
 94:     viewState.stopButtonLastSeen = now;
 95:     viewState.stopButtonDisappearedAt = 0;
 96:     return viewState;
 97:   }
 98: 
 99:   /**
100:    * Check if thinking should end based on stop button visibility and send state
101:    */
102:   checkThinkingEnd(_provider: string, viewState: ViewState, data: ProbeData, now: number): CheckResult {
103:     const sendState = data.sendState || "missing";
104:     const stopVisible = !!data.stopVisible;
105:     const voiceMode = !!data.voiceMode;
106: 
107:     if (viewState.status?.thinking !== "busy") {
108:       return { shouldEnd: false, newState: viewState };
109:     }
110: 
111:     // Stop button is still visible - continue thinking
112:     if (stopVisible) {
113:       viewState.stopButtonLastSeen = now;
114:       viewState.stopButtonDisappearedAt = 0;
115:       return { shouldEnd: false, newState: viewState };
116:     }
117: 
118:     // Stop button disappeared - start countdown
119:     if (!viewState.stopButtonDisappearedAt) {
120:       viewState.stopButtonDisappearedAt = now;
121:     }
122: 
123:     const timeSinceDisappeared = now - (viewState.stopButtonDisappearedAt || 0);
124:     const shouldCheckEndThinking =
125:       timeSinceDisappeared >=
126:       this.config.thinking.stopButtonDetectionTimeoutMs;
127: 
128:     if (!shouldCheckEndThinking) {
129:       return { shouldEnd: false, newState: viewState };
130:     }
131: 
132:     // Thinking bitiş koşulları:
133:     // 1. Stop button kaybolmuş (yukarıda kontrol edildi)
134:     // 2. Send button görünür (enabled veya disabled)
135:     // 3. Veya voice mode aktif (bazı provider'larda)
136:     // 
137:     // Not: ChatGPT thinking bittiğinde önce disabled send button gösteriyor,
138:     // sonra enabled oluyor. Bu yüzden disabled da geçerli bitiş durumu.
139:     const shouldEndThinking =
140:       sendState === "enabled" || sendState === "disabled" || voiceMode;
141: 
142:     if (shouldEndThinking) {
143:       return {
144:         shouldEnd: true,
145:         newState: this.endThinking(viewState, now),
146:       };
147:     }
148: 
149:     return { shouldEnd: false, newState: viewState };
150:   }
151: 
152:   /**
153:    * End thinking state
154:    */
155:   endThinking(viewState: ViewState, now: number): ViewState {
156:     viewState.thinkingJustEnded = true;
157:     viewState.thinkingEndedAt = now;
158:     return viewState;
159:   }
160: 
161:   /**
162:    * Clear the "just ended" flag after a delay
163:    */
164:   clearJustEnded(viewState: ViewState): ViewState {
165:     viewState.thinkingJustEnded = false;
166:     return viewState;
167:   }
168: }

  1: /**
  2:  * MessageSender - Webview mesaj gönderim yönetimi
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu modül AI webview'larına mesaj ve dosya gönderimini yönetir:
  5:  * - Mesaj injection/xdotools metodları
  6:  * - Dosya yükleme (dragdrop, injection, link-based)
  7:  * - Send button tetikleme
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: import { LogManager } from "../log-manager.js";

 12: import { FileManager } from "../file-manager.js";

 14: import { ProviderRegistry } from "./provider-registry.js";

 18: import type { AppSettings } from "../../types/settings.js";

 21: // Types

 27:   focus?: () => void;
 28: }

 65: class MessageSenderClass {
 66:   _settings: AppSettings | null;
 67: 
 68:   constructor() {
 69:     this._settings = null;
 70:   }
 71: 
 72:   /**
 73:    * Ayarları güncelle
 74:    */
 75:   setSettings(settings: AppSettings | null): void {
 76:     this._settings = settings;
 77:   }
 78: 
 79:   /**
 80:    * Slot için provider modülünü getir
 81:    */
 82:   getProviderModule(providerSlot: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
 83:     const providerId = AppState.getProviderIdForSlot(providerSlot);
 84:     return providerId ? getProvider(providerId) : null;
 85:   }
 86: 
 87:   /**
 88:    * URL excluded mı kontrol et
 89:    * @deprecated Use isSlotUrlExcluded from url-utils.ts directly
 90:    */
 91:   isUrlExcluded(providerSlot: string, url: string): boolean {
 92:     return isSlotUrlExcluded(providerSlot, url);
 93:   }
 94: 
 95:   /**
 96:    * Mesaj ve dosya gönder
 97:    */
 98:   async send({ provider, text, attachments = [], webview }: SendOptions): Promise<SendResult> {
 99:     if (!webview) {
100:       throw new Error(`Webview for provider "${provider}" not found.`);
101:     }
102: 
103:     const currentUrl = webview.getURL?.() || "";
104:     if (this.isUrlExcluded(provider, currentUrl)) {
105:       LogManager.addEvent(
106:         `webview-${provider}`,
107:         "warning",
108:         `URL excluded: ${currentUrl}, send operation disabled`,
109:       );
110:       throw new Error(`URL excluded from operations: ${currentUrl}`);
111:     }
112: 
113:     const providerId = AppState.getProviderIdForSlot(provider);
114:     if (!providerId) {
115:       throw new Error(
116:         `Provider for slot "${provider}" not configured (no account/provider).`,
117:       );
118:     }
119: 
120:     const providerModule = this.getProviderModule(provider);
121:     if (!providerModule) {
122:       throw new Error(
123:         `Provider module for "${provider}" (${providerId}) not found.`,
124:       );
125:     }
126: 
127:     LogManager.addEvent(
128:       `webview-${provider}`,
129:       "debug",
130:       `Using provider: ${providerId} for slot: ${provider}`,
131:     );
132: 
133:     await waitForDomReady(webview as unknown as HTMLElement & { isLoading?: () => boolean });
134: 
135:     // Provider config fallback - sadece config yoksa inject et
136:     const providerConfig = ProviderRegistry.get(providerId);
137:     if (providerConfig) {
138:       try {
139:         const checkScript = `(function() { return !!window.__hayalet_provider_config; })();`;
140:         const hasConfig = await webview.executeJavaScript(checkScript);
141:         
142:         if (!hasConfig) {
143:           const configScript = `
144:             (function() {
145:               window.__hayalet_slot = ${JSON.stringify(provider)};
146:               window.__hayalet_provider_config = ${JSON.stringify(providerConfig)};
147:               return true;
148:             })();
149:           `;
150:           await webview.executeJavaScript(configScript);
151:         }
152:       } catch (_err) {
153:         // Config kontrolü veya injection başarısız - devam et
154:       }
155:     }
156: 
157:     // ai0 (asistan) için asistanSlot'tan, diğerleri için slots'tan al
158:     const slots = this._settings?.slots as Record<string, { messageMethod?: string; fileMethod?: string }> | undefined;
159:     const asistanSlot = this._settings?.asistanSlot as { messageMethod?: string; fileMethod?: string } | undefined;
160:     const slotConfig = provider === "ai0" 
161:       ? asistanSlot
162:       : slots?.[provider];
163:     
164:     const messageMethodName = slotConfig?.messageMethod;
165:     if (!messageMethodName) {
166:       throw new Error(`messageMethod is not configured for slot "${provider}"`);
167:     }
168:     
169:     const fileMethodName = slotConfig?.fileMethod;
170:     if (!fileMethodName) {
171:       throw new Error(`fileMethod is not configured for slot "${provider}"`);
172:     }
173: 
174:     const messageFn = messageMethodName === "xdotools"
175:       ? providerModule.sendMessage_xdotools
176:       : providerModule.sendMessage;
177:     
178:     const fileFn = attachments?.length
179:       ? providerModule[`attachFiles_${fileMethodName}`]
180:       : null;
181: 
182:     if (!messageFn) {
183:       throw new Error(
184:         `Message function "${messageMethodName}" not found in provider module for "${provider}"`,
185:       );
186:     }
187:     
188:     if (attachments?.length && !fileFn) {
189:       throw new Error(
190:         `File function "attachFiles_${fileMethodName}" not found in provider module for "${provider}"`,
191:       );
192:     }
193: 
194:     LogManager.addEvent(
195:       `webview-${provider}`,
196:       "debug",
197:       `Methods: messageMethod=${messageMethodName}, fileMethod=${fileMethodName}`,
198:     );
199: 
200:     try {
201:       webview.focus?.();
202:     } catch (_e) {
203:     }
204: 
205:     const isLinkBased = ["tmpfile", "catbox", "uguu", "googledrive"].includes(fileMethodName);
206: 
207:     let finalMessage = text || "";
208:     let fileResult = null;
209: 
210:     if (attachments?.length > 0 && isLinkBased) {
211:       fileResult = await this._handleLinkBasedUpload(
212:         webview, provider, attachments, fileFn as FileFn, fileMethodName
213:       );
214:       
215:       if (fileResult?.uploadedLinks?.length) {
216:         const linkText = fileResult.uploadedLinks
217:           .map((l) => `[${l.name}](${l.url})`)
218:           .join("\n");
219:         finalMessage = finalMessage.trim()
220:           ? `${finalMessage}\n${linkText}`
221:           : linkText;
222:       }
223:     }
224: 
225:     if (attachments?.length > 0 && !isLinkBased) {
226:       fileResult = await this._handleDirectUpload(
227:         webview, provider, attachments, fileFn as FileFn, fileMethodName
228:       );
229:     }
230: 
231:     if (finalMessage.trim().length > 0) {
232:       LogManager.addEvent(
233:         `webview-${provider}`,
234:         "info",
235:         `Adding message to input field using ${messageMethodName}`,
236:       );
237:       const sendResult = await (messageFn as (wv: WebviewElement, opts: { message: string }) => Promise<{ success?: boolean; message?: string }>)(webview, { message: finalMessage });
238:       if (!sendResult?.success) {
239:         throw new Error(sendResult?.message || "Mesaj metin alanına yazılamadı.");
240:       }
241:     }
242: 
243:     LogManager.addEvent(
244:       `webview-${provider}`,
245:       "info",
246:       "Waiting for send button to be enabled...",
247:     );
248:     await TrafficManager.waitForSendEnabled(provider, 20000);
249: 
250:     LogManager.addEvent(
251:       `webview-${provider}`,
252:       "info",
253:       "Triggering send button...",
254:     );
255:     
256:     // Default page'deyse, URL değişiminde loading tetiklemeyi atla
257:     // (thinking tracker zaten takip edecek)
258:     const urlBeforeSend = webview.getURL?.() || "";
259:     if (isDefaultPage(urlBeforeSend, providerId)) {
260:       TrafficManager.skipNextLoadingFor(provider);
261:     }
262:     
263:     await this._triggerSendButton(webview, provider, providerId);
264: 
265:     return {
266:       success: true,
267:       message: "Gönderim başarılı",
268:       files: fileResult,
269:     };
270:   }
271: 
272:   /**
273:    * Link-based dosya yükleme (catbox, uguu, googledrive, tmpfile)
274:    * @private
275:    */
276:   async _handleLinkBasedUpload(
277:     webview: WebviewElement,
278:     provider: string,
279:     attachments: FileEntry[],
280:     fileFn: FileFn,
281:     fileMethodName: string
282:   ): Promise<FileResult | null> {
283:     const files = await FileManager.readUploadFiles(attachments);
284:     if (files.length === 0) return null;
285: 
286:     LogManager.addEvent(
287:       `webview-${provider}`,
288:       "info",
289:       `Uploading ${files.length} files using ${fileMethodName}`,
290:     );
291: 
292:     const fileResult = await fileFn(webview, { files, provider });
293: 
294:     if (!fileResult?.success) {
295:       LogManager.addEvent(
296:         `webview-${provider}`,
297:         "error",
298:         `File upload failed (${fileMethodName}): ${fileResult?.message || "unknown error"}`,
299:       );
300:       throw new Error(fileResult?.message || `${fileMethodName} upload failed`);
301:     }
302: 
303:     if (!fileResult?.uploadedLinks?.length) {
304:       LogManager.addEvent(
305:         `webview-${provider}`,
306:         "error",
307:         `File upload returned no links (${fileMethodName}). Raw result: ${JSON.stringify(fileResult)}`,
308:       );
309:       throw new Error(
310:         `${fileMethodName} upload returned no links. Check Google Drive auth and IPC response.`,
311:       );
312:     }
313: 
314:     return fileResult;
315:   }
316: 
317:   /**
318:    * Direct dosya yükleme (injection, dragdrop, xdotools)
319:    * @private
320:    */
321:   async _handleDirectUpload(
322:     webview: WebviewElement,
323:     provider: string,
324:     attachments: FileEntry[],
325:     fileFn: FileFn,
326:     fileMethodName: string
327:   ): Promise<FileResult | null> {
328:     const files = await FileManager.readUploadFiles(attachments);
329:     if (files.length === 0) return null;
330: 
331:     LogManager.addEvent(
332:       `webview-${provider}`,
333:       "info",
334:       `Attaching ${files.length} files using ${fileMethodName}`,
335:     );
336: 
337:     const fileResult = await fileFn(webview, { files, provider });
338: 
339:     if (!fileResult?.success) {
340:       LogManager.addEvent(
341:         `webview-${provider}`,
342:         "warning",
343:         `File attachment failed: ${fileResult?.message}`,
344:       );
345:     }
346: 
347:     return fileResult;
348:   }
349: 
350:   /**
351:    * Send button'a tıkla
352:    * @private
353:    */
354:   async _triggerSendButton(webview: WebviewElement, provider: string, providerId: string): Promise<void> {
355:     const providerConfig = ProviderRegistry.get(providerId as "opencode" | "chatgpt" | "grok" | "gemini");
356: 
357:     if (!providerConfig?.selectors?.sendButton) {
358:       throw new Error(`Provider config bulunamadı: providerId="${providerId}", provider="${provider}", hasConfig=${!!providerConfig}, hasSelectors=${!!providerConfig?.selectors}`);
359:     }
360: 
361:     const sendSel = JSON.stringify(providerConfig.selectors.sendButton);
362:     
363:     // Retry logic - dosya yüklemesi sonrası buton gecikmeli aktif olabilir
364:     const maxRetries = 10;
365:     const retryInterval = 500;
366:     
367:     for (let attempt = 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++) {
368:       const script = `(function() {
369:         const sendButton = document.querySelector(${sendSel});
370:         if (!sendButton) {
371:           return { success: false, message: 'send button not found', retry: true };
372:         }
373:         
374:         // Kapsamlı disabled kontrolü
375:         const disabledAttr = sendButton.disabled || sendButton.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true';
376:         const disabledStyle = getComputedStyle(sendButton).pointerEvents === 'none';
377:         const disabledClass = /disabled|opacity-4|opacity-5|cursor-not-allowed/i.test(sendButton.className || '');
378:         const isDisabled = disabledAttr || disabledStyle || disabledClass;
379:         
380:         if (isDisabled) {
381:           return { success: false, message: 'send button disabled', retry: true, 
382:                    debug: { disabled: sendButton.disabled, ariaDisabled: sendButton.getAttribute('aria-disabled'), className: sendButton.className } };
383:         }
384:         
385:         sendButton.click();
386:         return { success: true, message: 'send clicked' };
387:       })();`;
388: 
389:       const res = await webview.executeJavaScript(script) as { success?: boolean; retry?: boolean; message?: string; debug?: Record<string, unknown> } | null;
390:       
391:       if (res?.success) {
392:         return; // Başarılı
393:       }
394:       
395:       if (!res?.retry || attempt >= maxRetries - 1) {
396:         LogManager.addEvent(
397:           `webview-${provider}`,
398:           "warning",
399:           `Send button trigger failed: ${res?.message || "unknown"}, debug: ${JSON.stringify(res?.debug || {})}`,
400:         );
401:         throw new Error("Send butonu tetiklenemedi");
402:       }
403:       
404:       // Retry için bekle
405:       await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, retryInterval));
406:     }
407:     
408:     throw new Error("Send butonu tetiklenemedi (max retries)");
409:   }
410: 
411: }
412: 
413: export const MessageSender = new MessageSenderClass();

  1: /**
  2:  * Provider Factory - Lazy Loading Support
  3:  * 
  4:  * Provider modüllerini dinamik olarak yükler.
  5:  * İlk kullanımda yükleme yaparak startup süresini kısaltır.
  6:  */
  7: 
  8: import { LogManager } from "../log-manager.js";
  9: 
 10: // ============================================================================
 11: // Types
 12: // ============================================================================
 13: 
 14: type ProviderId = "chatgpt" | "grok" | "gemini" | "opencode";
 15: 
 16: /**
 17:  * Provider modül tipi - esnek yapı
 18:  * Her provider kendi metodlarını export eder
 19:  */
 20: type ProviderModule = Record<string, unknown>;
 21: 
 22: // ============================================================================
 23: // Provider Cache (Lazy Loading)
 24: // ============================================================================
 25: 
 26: const providerCache: Map<ProviderId, ProviderModule> = new Map();
 27: const loadingPromises: Map<ProviderId, Promise<ProviderModule | null>> = new Map();
 28: 
 29: /**
 30:  * Provider modülünü lazy load et
 31:  * @param providerId - Provider ID
 32:  * @returns Provider modülü veya null
 33:  */
 34: async function loadProvider(providerId: ProviderId): Promise<ProviderModule | null> {
 35:   // Cache'de varsa döndür
 36:   if (providerCache.has(providerId)) {
 37:     return providerCache.get(providerId)!;
 38:   }
 39: 
 40:   // Zaten yükleniyor mu kontrol et (prevent duplicate loads)
 41:   if (loadingPromises.has(providerId)) {
 42:     return loadingPromises.get(providerId)!;
 43:   }
 44: 
 45:   // Yükleme promise'i oluştur
 46:   const loadPromise = (async () => {
 47:     try {
 48:       let module: ProviderModule;
 49:       
 50:       switch (providerId) {
 51:         case "chatgpt":
 52:           module = await import("./providers/chatgpt/index.js");
 53:           break;
 54:         case "grok":
 55:           module = await import("./providers/grok/index.js");
 56:           break;
 57:         case "gemini":
 58:           module = await import("./providers/gemini/index.js");
 59:           break;
 60:         case "opencode":
 61:           module = await import("./providers/opencode/index.js");
 62:           break;
 63:         default:
 64:           LogManager.addEvent("provider-factory", "warn", `Unknown provider: ${providerId}`);
 65:           return null;
 66:       }
 67: 
 68:       // Cache'e ekle
 69:       providerCache.set(providerId, module);
 70:       LogManager.addEvent("provider-factory", "debug", `Provider loaded: ${providerId}`, { visibility: 3 });
 71:       return module;
 72:     } catch (error) {
 73:       LogManager.addEvent("provider-factory", "error", `Failed to load provider ${providerId}: ${error}`);
 74:       return null;
 75:     } finally {
 76:       // Loading promise'i temizle
 77:       loadingPromises.delete(providerId);
 78:     }
 79:   })();
 80: 
 81:   loadingPromises.set(providerId, loadPromise);
 82:   return loadPromise;
 83: }
 84: 
 85: // ============================================================================
 86: // Eager Loading (Backward Compatibility)
 87: // ============================================================================
 88: 
 89: // Startup'ta tüm provider'ları yükle (eski davranış)
 90: import * as chatgptProvider from "./providers/chatgpt/index.js";
 91: import * as grokProvider from "./providers/grok/index.js";
 92: import * as geminiProvider from "./providers/gemini/index.js";
 93: import * as opencodeProvider from "./providers/opencode/index.js";
 94: 
 95: // Cache'i startup'ta doldur
 96: providerCache.set("chatgpt", chatgptProvider);
 97: providerCache.set("grok", grokProvider);
 98: providerCache.set("gemini", geminiProvider);
 99: providerCache.set("opencode", opencodeProvider);
100: 
101: // Ana AI provider'ları (legacy)
102: const providers = {
103:   chatgpt: chatgptProvider,
104:   grok: grokProvider,
105:   gemini: geminiProvider,
106: };
107: 
108: // Asistan provider'ları (legacy)
109: const asistanProviders = {
110:   opencode: opencodeProvider,
111: };
112: 
113: // Tüm provider'lar (legacy)
114: const allProviders = {
115:   ...providers,
116:   ...asistanProviders,
117: };
118: 
119: // ============================================================================
120: // Public API
121: // ============================================================================
122: 
123: /**
124:  * Returns the provider module for the given provider ID (sync - legacy).
125:  * Searches in all providers (AI + Asistan).
126:  * @deprecated Use getProviderAsync for lazy loading support
127:  */
128: export function getProvider(providerId: keyof typeof allProviders) {
129:   return allProviders[providerId];
130: }
131: 
132: /**
133:  * Returns the provider module for the given provider ID (async - lazy loading).
134:  * Use this for new code to benefit from lazy loading.
135:  * 
136:  * @example
137:  * const provider = await getProviderAsync("chatgpt");
138:  * if (provider) {
139:  *   await provider.sendMessage(webview, "Hello");
140:  * }
141:  */
142: export async function getProviderAsync(providerId: ProviderId): Promise<ProviderModule | null> {
143:   return loadProvider(providerId);
144: }
145: 
146: /**
147:  * Provider yüklü mü kontrol et
148:  */
149: export function isProviderLoaded(providerId: ProviderId): boolean {
150:   return providerCache.has(providerId);
151: }
152: 
153: /**
154:  * Tüm provider'ları preload et (startup optimization için)
155:  */
156: export async function preloadAllProviders(): Promise<void> {
157:   const ids: ProviderId[] = ["chatgpt", "grok", "gemini", "opencode"];
158:   await Promise.all(ids.map(id => loadProvider(id)));
159: }
160: 
161: /**
162:  * Provider cache'ini temizle (testing için)
163:  */
164: export function clearProviderCache(): void {
165:   providerCache.clear();
166: }

 64:     if (!settings) return null;
 65:     
 66:     // AI0 (Asistan) için asistanSlot ve asistanAccounts kullan
 67:     if (slot === "ai0") {
 68:       const accountId = settings.asistanSlot?.accountId;

 87:     if (!settings) return "";
 88:     if (provider === "user") {
 89:       return settings.user?.avatarPath || "";
 90:     }
 91:     const account = this.getAccountForSlot(provider);
 92:     return account?.avatarPath || "";
 93:   }

100:     }
101:     if (provider === "user") {

145:   subscribe(listener: (state: ReturnType<AppStateClass["getState"]>) => void) {
146:     if (typeof listener === "function") {
147:       this.listeners.push(listener);
148:     }
149:     return () => {
150:       this.listeners = this.listeners.filter((l) => l !== listener);
151:     };
152:   }

159:       } catch (err) {

161:       }
162:     });

 1: import { SlotController, SlotState } from "./slot-controller.js";
 2: import { LogManager } from "./log-manager.js";

 4: /**
 5:  * Check if slot is ready for protocol communication
 6:  * - Must be CONNECTED (not CONNECTING, DISCONNECTING, or ERROR)
 7:  */
 8: function isSlotReady(slot: string): boolean {
 9:   const state = SlotController.getState(slot);
10:   if (!state) return false;
11:   
12:   if (state.state !== SlotState.CONNECTED) {
13:     LogManager.addEvent(
14:       "protocol",
15:       "debug",
16:       `Slot ${slot} not ready for protocol: state=${state.state}`
17:     );
18:     return false;
19:   }
20:   
21:   if (state.urlExcluded) {
22:     LogManager.addEvent(
23:       "protocol",
24:       "debug",
25:       `Slot ${slot} URL excluded, skipping protocol`
26:     );
27:     return false;
28:   }
29:   
30:   return true;
31: }
32: 
33: function buildProtocolPayload({
34:   room = "",
35:   scenario = "",
36:   targets = [] as string[],
37:   context = {} as { starter?: string },
38: }) {
39:   const connected = (targets || []).filter((t) => isSlotReady(t));
40: 
41:   if (room === "analyze") {
42:     if (scenario === "user-ai-ai") {
43:       return {
44:         message: "Kullanıcı - AI - AI Analiz Sohbeti Başladı",
45:         protocolPath: "protocol/analyze-user-AI-AI.txt",
46:         targets: /** @type {any[]} */ (connected),
47:       };
48:     }
49:     if (scenario === "user-ai-ai-stop") {
50:       return {
51:         message: "Kullanıcı - AI - AI Analiz Sohbeti Durduruldu",
52:         targets: /** @type {any[]} */ (connected),
53:       };
54:     }
55: 
56:     if (scenario === "ai-ai") {
57:       const starter = context.starter === "ai2" ? "ai2" : "ai1";
58:       const protocolFile =
59:         starter === "ai2"
60:           ? "protocol/analyze-AI2-AI1.txt"
61:           : "protocol/analyze-AI1-AI2.txt";
62: 
63:       return {
64:         message: "AI-AI Analiz Sohbeti Başladı",
65:         protocolPath: protocolFile,
66:         targets: /** @type {any[]} */ (connected),
67:       };
68:     }
69: 
70:     if (scenario === "ai-ai-stop") {
71:       return {
72:         message: "AI-AI Analiz Sohbeti Durduruldu",
73:         targets: /** @type {any[]} */ (connected),
74:       };
75:     }
76:   }
77: 
78:   if (room === "server" && scenario === "takecontrol") {
79:     return {
80:       message: "Kontrol Devredildi",
81:       protocolPath: "protocol/takecontrol.txt",
82:       targets: /** @type {any[]} */ (connected),
83:     };
84:   }
85: 
86:   return null;
87: }

File: src/js/modules/upload-manager.ts

  1: /**
  2:  * UploadManager - Centralized Upload Management
  3:  *
  4:  * Bu modül tüm dosya yükleme işlemlerini ve servis kontrollerini yönetir.
  5:  * webview/methods/shared altındaki dağınık yapıyı replace eder.
  6:  */
  7: 
  8: interface FilePayload {
  9:   name: string;
 10:   path?: string;
 11:   base64?: string;
 12:   mimeType?: string;
 13: }
 14: 
 15: interface UploadError {
 16:   file: string;
 17:   error: string;
 18: }
 19: 
 20: type ServiceName = "CATBOX" | "UGUU" | "TMPFILE" | "GOOGLEDRIVE";
 21: 
 22: const UPLOAD_SERVICES: Record<ServiceName, { ipcMethod: string; available: () => boolean }> = {
 23:   CATBOX: {
 24:     ipcMethod: "catboxUpload",
 25:     available: () => !!window?.electronAPI?.catboxUpload,
 26:   },
 27:   UGUU: {
 28:     ipcMethod: "uguuUpload",
 29:     available: () => !!window?.electronAPI?.uguuUpload,
 30:   },
 31:   TMPFILE: {
 32:     ipcMethod: "tmpfileUpload",
 33:     available: () => !!window?.electronAPI?.tmpfileUpload,
 34:   },
 35:   GOOGLEDRIVE: {
 36:     ipcMethod: "googledriveUpload",
 37:     available: () => !!window?.electronAPI?.googledriveUpload,
 38:   },
 39: };
 40: 
 41: export const UploadManager = {
 42:   /**
 43:    * Servis kullanılabilir mi kontrol et
 44:    */
 45:   isServiceAvailable(serviceName: ServiceName): boolean {
 46:     const service = UPLOAD_SERVICES[serviceName];
 47:     if (!service) return false;
 48:     try {
 49:       return service.available();
 50:     } catch {
 51:       return false;
 52:     }
 53:   },
 54: 
 55:   /**
 56:    * Dosyaları validate et
 57:    */
 58:   validateFiles(files: FilePayload[]): { valid: boolean; message?: string } {
 59:     if (!files?.length) {
 60:       return { valid: false, message: "Aktarılacak dosya bulunamadı" };
 61:     }
 62: 
 63:     for (const file of files) {
 64:       if (!file.name || !file.base64) {
 65:         return {
 66:           valid: false,
 67:           message: `Geçersiz dosya: ${file.name || "isimsiz"}`,
 68:         };
 69:       }
 70:     }
 71: 
 72:     return { valid: true };
 73:   },
 74: 
 75:   /**
 76:    * Çoklu dosya yükle
 77:    */
 78:   async uploadMultipleFiles(serviceName: ServiceName, files: FilePayload[]): Promise<{ uploadedLinks: string[]; uploadErrors: UploadError[] }> {
 79:     const service = UPLOAD_SERVICES[serviceName];
 80:     if (!service) {
 81:       throw new Error(`Unknown service: ${serviceName}`);
 82:     }
 83: 
 84:     const api = window?.electronAPI;
 85:     const ipcMethod = api?.[service.ipcMethod as keyof typeof api] as ((options: unknown) => Promise<{ success?: boolean; url?: string; message?: string }>) | undefined;
 86:     if (!ipcMethod) {
 87:       throw new Error(`IPC method not available: ${service.ipcMethod}`);
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     const uploadedLinks = [];
 91:     const uploadErrors = [];
 92: 
 93:     for (const file of files) {
 94:       try {
 95:         const result = await ipcMethod({
 96:           name: file.name,
 97:           mimeType: file.mimeType,
 98:           base64: file.base64,
 99:         });
100: 
101:         if (result?.success && result?.url) {
102:           uploadedLinks.push(result.url);
103:         } else {
104:           uploadErrors.push({
105:             file: file.name,
106:             error: result?.message || "Upload failed",
107:           });
108:         }
109:       } catch (err) {
110:         uploadErrors.push({
111:           file: file.name,
112:           error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
113:         });
114:       }
115:     }
116: 
117:     return { uploadedLinks, uploadErrors };
118:   },
119: 
120:   /**
121:    * Google Drive Upload (Batch)
122:    */
123:   async uploadGoogleDrive(files: FilePayload[]): Promise<{ uploadedLinks: string[]; errors: UploadError[] }> {
124:     if (!this.isServiceAvailable("GOOGLEDRIVE")) {
125:       throw new Error("Google Drive IPC servisi mevcut değil");
126:     }
127: 
128:     const payloadFiles = files.map((f) => ({
129:       name: f.name,
130:       mimeType: f.mimeType,
131:       base64: f.base64,
132:     }));
133: 
134:     if (!window.electronAPI?.googledriveUpload) {
135:       throw new Error("electronAPI.googledriveUpload not available");
136:     }
137: 
138:     const result = await window.electronAPI.googledriveUpload({
139:       files: payloadFiles,
140:     });
141: 
142:     if (!result?.success) {
143:       throw new Error(result?.message || "Google Drive yükleme başarısız");
144:     }
145: 
146:     const r = result as { uploadedLinks?: string[]; uploaded?: string[]; data?: { uploadedLinks?: string[] }; errors?: string[] };
147:     const uploaded = r.uploadedLinks || r.uploaded || (r.data && r.data.uploadedLinks) || [];
148: 
149:     return {
150:       uploadedLinks: Array.isArray(uploaded) ? uploaded : [],
151:       errors: (r.errors || []) as unknown as UploadError[],
152:     };
153:   },
154: 
155:   /**
156:    * Response formatla
157:    */
158:   formatResponse(uploadedLinks: string[], errors: UploadError[] = [], serviceName = "") {
159:     if (!uploadedLinks.length) {
160:       return {
161:         success: false,
162:         message: `${serviceName} yükleme başarısız: ${errors.join("; ")}`,
163:         errors,
164:         injected: false,
165:       };
166:     }
167: 
168:     return {
169:       success: true,
170:       message: `${uploadedLinks.length} dosya yüklendi ve linki hazır`,
171:       uploadedLinks,
172:       errors: errors.length ? errors : undefined,
173:       injected: false,
174:     };
175:   },
176: 
177:   /**
178:    * Hata response oluştur
179:    */
180:   createError(message: string, errors: UploadError[] = [], serviceName = "") {
181:     return {
182:       success: false,
183:       message: serviceName ? `${serviceName} hatası: ${message}` : message,
184:       errors,
185:       injected: false,
186:     };
187:   },
188: };

 18:   } catch (err) {
 19:   }

 23:   try {
 24:     window.electronAPI?.windowClose?.();
 25:   } catch (err) {
 26:   }

 28: 
 29: function setWindowState(state: string, _payload: any = {}) {
 30:   const normalized = (state || "").toLowerCase();
 31:   if (normalized === "fullscreen" || normalized === "full") {
 32:     toggleFullscreen();
 33:     return true;
 34:   }
 35:   if (normalized === "close") {
 36:     closeApp();
 37:     return true;
 38:   }
 39:   if (normalized === "minimize") {
 40:     minimizeToTaskbar();
 41:     return true;
 42:   }
 43:   if (
 44:     normalized === "hidemenu" ||
 45:     normalized === "hidemen" ||
 46:     normalized === "hide-menu"
 47:   ) {
 48:     document.body?.classList.add("menu-hidden");
 49:     return true;
 50:   }
 51:   if (
 52:     normalized === "showmenu" ||
 53:     normalized === "show-men" ||
 54:     normalized === "show-menu"
 55:   ) {
 56:     document.body?.classList.remove("menu-hidden");
 57:     return true;
 58:   }
 59:   if (
 60:     normalized === "togglemenu" ||
 61:     normalized === "toggle-men" ||
 62:     normalized === "toggle-menu"
 63:   ) {
 64:     document.body?.classList.toggle("menu-hidden");
 65:     return true;
 66:   }
 67:   return minimizeToTaskbar();
 68: }
 69: 
 70: export const WindowManager = {
 71:   minimizeToTaskbar,
 72:   minimizeToTray,
 73:   toggleFullscreen,
 74:   closeApp,
 75:   setWindowState,
 76:   apply(action: string, payload: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
 77:     switch (action) {
 78:       case "minimize":
 79:         minimizeToTaskbar();
 80:         return true;
 81:       case "fullscreen":
 82:         toggleFullscreen();
 83:         return true;
 84:       case "hideMenu":
 85:         document.body?.classList.add("menu-hidden");
 86:         return true;
 87:       case "showMenu":
 88:         document.body?.classList.remove("menu-hidden");
 89:         return true;
 90:       case "toggleMenu":
 91:         document.body?.classList.toggle("menu-hidden");
 92:         return true;
 93:       case "alwaysOnTop":
 94:         window.electronAPI?.windowToggleFullscreen?.();
 95:         return true;
 96:       default:
 97:         return setWindowState(action, payload);
 98:     }
 99:   },
100: };

 1: /**
 2:  * DraftManager - Analyze sayfası draft yönetimi
 3:  * 
 4:  * Bu modül compose alanındaki taslak mesajı yönetir:
 5:  * - Draft kaydetme (beforeunload)
 6:  * - Draft yükleme
 7:  * - Base64 decode
 8:  */
 9: 
10: import { LogManager } from "../../modules/log-manager.js";
11: import { getErrorMessage } from "../../types/index.js";
12: import { FileManager } from "../../modules/file-manager.js";
13: 
14: let draftPath = "";
15: 
16: /**
17:  * Base64 encoded string'i decode et
18:  * @param {string} data - Base64 encoded string
19:  * @returns {string}
20:  */
21: function decodeBase64(data: string): string {
22:   try {
23:     const binary = atob(data);
24:     const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
25:     for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
26:       bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
27:     }
28:     const decoder = new TextDecoder("utf-8");
29:     return decoder.decode(bytes);
30:   } catch (_err) {
31:     return "";
32:   }
33: }
34: 
35: /**
36:  * Draft sistemini başlat
37:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
38:  */
39: export async function initDraft() {
40:   try {
41:     // Draft dosyası data klasöründe tutulacak
42:     draftPath = "data/analyze-draft.json";
43:   } catch (err) {
44:     LogManager.addEvent("analyze", "warning", `Draft yolu hazırlanamadı: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`);
45:   }
46: }
47: 
48: /**
49:  * Draft'ı yükle
50:  * @returns {Promise<{message: string, files: Array}>}
51:  */
52: export async function loadDraft() {
53:   if (!draftPath || !window.electronAPI?.readFile) {
54:     return { message: "", files: [] };
55:   }
56:   
57:   try {
58:     const base64 = await window.electronAPI.readFile(draftPath);
59:     
60:     if (!base64) {
61:       return { message: "", files: [] };
62:     }
63:     
64:     const text = decodeBase64(base64);
65:     const parsed = JSON.parse(text || "{}");
66:     
67:     return {
68:       message: parsed.message || "",
69:       files: Array.isArray(parsed.files) ? parsed.files : [],
70:     };
71:   } catch (err) {
72:     LogManager.addEvent("analyze", "warning", `Draft okunamadı: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`);
73:     return { message: "", files: [] };
74:   }
75: }
76: 
77: /**
78:  * Draft'ı kaydet
79:  * @param {string} message - Compose input değeri
80:  * @param {Array} files - Staged files
81:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
82:  */
83: export async function persistDraft(message: string, files: unknown[]) {
84:   if (!draftPath) return;
85:   
86:   try {
87:     const payload = { message: message || "", files: files || [] };
88:     const json = JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2);
89:     await FileManager.writeFileAtomic(draftPath, json, "utf-8");
90:   } catch (err) {
91:     LogManager.addEvent("analyze", "warning", `Draft yazılamadı: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`);
92:   }
93: }

 1: export class WhisperPanel {
 2:     listEl: HTMLElement | null;
 3:     overdueWhispers: any[];
 4: 
 5:     constructor() {
 6:         this.listEl = null;
 7:         this.overdueWhispers = [];
 8:     }
 9: 
10:     init() {
11:         this.listEl = document.getElementById("whisper-pending-list");
12:         this.setupListeners();
13:         this.render();
14:     }
15: 
16:     setupListeners() {
17:         this.listEl?.addEventListener("click", (ev) => this.handleListClick(ev));
18:         document.getElementById("whisper-clear-btn")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
19:             this.clearAll();
20:         });
21:     }
22: 
23:     async render() {
24:         if (!this.listEl) return;
25:         
26:         // This requires CoreEngine to be imported or available globally/passed in.
27:         // Assuming CoreEngine is available via window or import. 
28:         // We will pass it or import it in the main controller, but here we can try dynamic import or rely on CoreEngine module
29:         const { CoreEngine } = await import("../../modules/core-engine.js");
30: 
31:         const now = Date.now();
32:         const chatList = (await CoreEngine.whisper("list", { user: "ai1" })) || [];
33:         const ai2List = (await CoreEngine.whisper("list", { user: "ai2" })) || [];
34:         
35:         const records = [...(Array.isArray(chatList) ? chatList : []), ...(Array.isArray(ai2List) ? ai2List : [])].filter(
36:             (rec) => !rec.done && (rec.when || 0) <= now,
37:         );
38:         
39:         this.overdueWhispers = records.sort((a, b) => (a.when || 0) - (b.when || 0));
40:         
41:         this.listEl.innerHTML = "";
42:         
43:         if (!this.overdueWhispers.length) {
44:             this.listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-message">Kayıt yok</div>';
45:             return;
46:         }
47: 
48:         this.overdueWhispers.forEach((rec) => {
49:             const row = document.createElement("div");
50:             row.className = "whisper-item";
51:             
52:             const when = rec.when ? new Date(rec.when).toLocaleTimeString("tr-TR", {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) : "-";
53:             
54:             row.innerHTML = `
55:                 <div class="whisper-content">
56:                     <div class="whisper-meta">
57:                         <span class="badge ${rec.user}">${rec.user.toUpperCase()}</span>
58:                         <span>${when}</span>
59:                     </div>
60:                     <div class="whisper-text" title="${this.escapeHtml(rec.text)}">${this.escapeHtml(rec.text)}</div>
61:                 </div>
62:                 <button class="icon-btn-text delete-btn" title="Sil">×</button>
63:             `;
64: 
65:             row.querySelector(".delete-btn")?.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
66:                 e.stopPropagation();
67:                 await CoreEngine.whisper("remove", { user: rec.user, id: rec.id });
68:                 this.render();
69:             });
70: 
71:             this.listEl!.appendChild(row);
72:         });
73:     }
74: 
75:     async clearAll() {
76:         const { CoreEngine } = await import("../../modules/core-engine.js");
77:         for (const rec of this.overdueWhispers) {
78:             await CoreEngine.whisper("remove", { user: rec.user, id: rec.id });
79:         }
80:         this.overdueWhispers = [];
81:         this.render();
82:     }
83: 
84:     handleListClick(_ev: Event) {
85:         // Selection logic if needed
86:     }
87: 
88:     escapeHtml(text: string) {
89:         if (!text) return "";
90:         return text.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
91:     }
92: }
