  1: /**
  2:  * Theme Manager
  3:  *
  4:  * Manages application themes with 3 palettes:
  5:  * - Obsidian (dark, cyan accents)
  6:  * - Midnight (dark, violet accents)
  7:  * - Aurora (light, teal accents)
  8:  *
  9:  * @example
 10:  * ```typescript
 11:  * import { ThemeManager } from './ui/theme-manager';
 12:  *
 13:  * // Set theme
 14:  * ThemeManager.set('midnight');
 15:  *
 16:  * // Cycle through themes
 17:  * ThemeManager.next();
 18:  *
 19:  * // Get available themes
 20:  * ThemeManager.getAvailableThemes();
 21:  *
 22:  * // Listen for changes
 23:  * const unsubscribe = ThemeManager.onChange((theme) => {
 24:  *   console.log('Theme changed to:', theme);
 25:  * });
 26:  * ```
 27:  */
 28: 
 29: import { LogManager } from '../modules/log-manager';
 30: 
 31: // ============================================================================
 32: // Types
 33: // ============================================================================
 34: 
 35: export type ThemeId = 'obsidian' | 'midnight' | 'aurora';
 36: 
 37: type ThemeChangeCallback = (theme: ThemeId) => void;
 38: 
 39: interface ThemeInfo {
 40:   id: ThemeId;
 41:   name: string;
 42:   icon: string;
 43:   isDark: boolean;
 44: }
 45: 
 46: interface ThemeConfig {
 47:   storageKey: string;
 48:   defaultTheme: ThemeId;
 49:   attribute: string;
 50:   transitionDuration: number;
 51: }
 52: 
 53: // ============================================================================
 54: // Theme Definitions
 55: // ============================================================================
 56: 
 57: export const THEMES: Record<ThemeId, ThemeInfo> = {
 58:   obsidian: {
 59:     id: 'obsidian',
 60:     name: 'Obsidian',
 61:     icon: '🌑',
 62:     isDark: true,
 63:   },
 64:   midnight: {
 65:     id: 'midnight',
 66:     name: 'Midnight',
 67:     icon: '🌙',
 68:     isDark: true,
 69:   },
 70:   aurora: {
 71:     id: 'aurora',
 72:     name: 'Aurora',
 73:     icon: '❄️',
 74:     isDark: false,
 75:   },
 76: };
 77: 
 78: const THEME_ORDER: ThemeId[] = ['obsidian', 'midnight', 'aurora'];
 79: 
 80: // ============================================================================
 81: // Configuration
 82: // ============================================================================
 83: 
 84: const CONFIG: ThemeConfig = {
 85:   storageKey: 'hayalet-ev-theme',
 86:   defaultTheme: 'obsidian',
 87:   attribute: 'data-theme',
 88:   transitionDuration: 200,
 89: };
 90: 
 91: // ============================================================================
 92: // State
 93: // ============================================================================
 94: 
 95: let currentTheme: ThemeId = CONFIG.defaultTheme;
 96: const listeners: Set<ThemeChangeCallback> = new Set();
 97: let isInitialized = false;
 98: 
 99: // ============================================================================
100: // Private Functions
101: // ============================================================================
102: 
103: /**
104:  * Validate if a string is a valid theme ID
105:  */
106: function isValidTheme(theme: string): theme is ThemeId {
107:   return theme in THEMES;
108: }
109: 
110: /**
111:  * Get stored theme from localStorage
112:  */
113: function getStoredTheme(): ThemeId | null {
114:   try {
115:     const stored = localStorage.getItem(CONFIG.storageKey);
116:     if (stored && isValidTheme(stored)) {
117:       return stored;
118:     }
119:   } catch {
120:     // localStorage not available
121:   }
122:   return null;
123: }
124: 
125: /**
126:  * Store theme in localStorage
127:  */
128: function storeTheme(theme: ThemeId): void {
129:   try {
130:     localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKey, theme);
131:   } catch {
132:     // localStorage not available
133:   }
134: }
135: 
136: /**
137:  * Apply theme to document
138:  */
139: function applyTheme(theme: ThemeId, animate: boolean = true): void {
140:   const root = document.documentElement;
141: 
142:   if (animate) {
143:     root.style.transition = `background-color ${CONFIG.transitionDuration}ms ease, color ${CONFIG.transitionDuration}ms ease`;
144:     setTimeout(() => {
145:       root.style.transition = '';
146:     }, CONFIG.transitionDuration);
147:   }
148: 
149:   root.setAttribute(CONFIG.attribute, theme);
150: 
151:   // Update theme dropdown UI if exists
152:   updateThemeDropdownUI(theme);
153: }
154: 
155: /**
156:  * Update theme dropdown UI elements
157:  */
158: function updateThemeDropdownUI(theme: ThemeId): void {
159:   const themeInfo = THEMES[theme];
160:   
161:   // Update current theme display
162:   const currentIcon = document.getElementById('theme-current-icon');
163:   const currentName = document.getElementById('theme-current-name');
164:   
165:   if (currentIcon) currentIcon.textContent = themeInfo.icon;
166:   if (currentName) currentName.textContent = themeInfo.name;
167:   
168:   // Update active state in dropdown menu
169:   const menuItems = document.querySelectorAll('.theme-dropdown-item');
170:   menuItems.forEach((item) => {
171:     const itemTheme = item.getAttribute('data-theme');
172:     item.classList.toggle('is-active', itemTheme === theme);
173:   });
174: }
175: 
176: /**
177:  * Notify all listeners of theme change
178:  */
179: function notifyListeners(theme: ThemeId): void {
180:   listeners.forEach((callback) => {
181:     try {
182:       callback(theme);
183:     } catch (err) {
184:       LogManager.addEvent('ThemeManager', 'error', 'Listener error', { error: err });
185:     }
186:   });
187: }
188: 
189: /**
190:  * Setup dropdown event listeners
191:  */
192: function setupDropdownListeners(): void {
193:   const dropdown = document.getElementById('theme-dropdown');
194:   const btn = document.getElementById('theme-dropdown-btn');
195:   const menu = document.getElementById('theme-dropdown-menu');
196: 
197:   if (!dropdown || !btn || !menu) return;
198: 
199:   // Toggle dropdown
200:   btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
201:     e.stopPropagation();
202:     dropdown.classList.toggle('is-open');
203:   });
204: 
205:   // Close on outside click
206:   document.addEventListener('click', () => {
207:     dropdown.classList.remove('is-open');
208:   });
209: 
210:   // Theme selection
211:   menu.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
212:     const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
213:     const item = target.closest('.theme-dropdown-item') as HTMLElement;
214:     
215:     if (item) {
216:       const theme = item.getAttribute('data-theme');
217:       if (theme && isValidTheme(theme)) {
218:         ThemeManager.set(theme);
219:         dropdown.classList.remove('is-open');
220:       }
221:     }
222:   });
223: }
224: 
225: // ============================================================================
226: // Public API
227: // ============================================================================
228: 
229: export const ThemeManager = {
230:   /**
231:    * Current theme ID
232:    */
233:   get current(): ThemeId {
234:     return currentTheme;
235:   },
236: 
237:   /**
238:    * Current theme info object
239:    */
240:   get currentInfo(): ThemeInfo {
241:     return THEMES[currentTheme];
242:   },
243: 
244:   /**
245:    * Check if current theme is dark
246:    */
247:   get isDark(): boolean {
248:     return THEMES[currentTheme].isDark;
249:   },
250: 
251:   /**
252:    * Check if current theme is light
253:    */
254:   get isLight(): boolean {
255:     return !THEMES[currentTheme].isDark;
256:   },
257: 
258:   /**
259:    * Initialize theme manager
260:    * Call this once when the app starts
261:    */
262:   init(): void {
263:     if (isInitialized) {
264:       return;
265:     }
266: 
267:     // Get stored theme or use default
268:     const storedTheme = getStoredTheme();
269:     currentTheme = storedTheme ?? CONFIG.defaultTheme;
270: 
271:     // Apply theme without animation on init
272:     applyTheme(currentTheme, false);
273: 
274:     // Setup dropdown listeners after DOM is ready
275:     if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
276:       document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setupDropdownListeners);
277:     } else {
278:       setupDropdownListeners();
279:     }
280: 
281:     isInitialized = true;
282:     LogManager.addEvent('ThemeManager', 'info', 'Initialized', { theme: currentTheme, visibility: 2 });
283:   },
284: 
285:   /**
286:    * Set theme
287:    * @param theme - Theme ID to set
288:    * @param persist - Whether to persist to localStorage (default: true)
289:    */
290:   set(theme: ThemeId, persist: boolean = true): void {
291:     if (!isValidTheme(theme)) {
292:       LogManager.addEvent('ThemeManager', 'warn', 'Invalid theme', { theme });
293:       return;
294:     }
295: 
296:     if (theme === currentTheme) {
297:       return;
298:     }
299: 
300:     currentTheme = theme;
301:     applyTheme(theme, true);
302: 
303:     if (persist) {
304:       storeTheme(theme);
305:     }
306: 
307:     notifyListeners(theme);
308:     LogManager.addEvent('ThemeManager', 'info', 'Theme changed', { theme, visibility: 3 });
309:   },
310: 
311:   /**
312:    * Cycle to next theme
313:    */
314:   next(): void {
315:     const currentIndex = THEME_ORDER.indexOf(currentTheme);
316:     const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % THEME_ORDER.length;
317:     ThemeManager.set(THEME_ORDER[nextIndex]);
318:   },
319: 
320:   /**
321:    * Cycle to previous theme
322:    */
323:   prev(): void {
324:     const currentIndex = THEME_ORDER.indexOf(currentTheme);
325:     const prevIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + THEME_ORDER.length) % THEME_ORDER.length;
326:     ThemeManager.set(THEME_ORDER[prevIndex]);
327:   },
328: 
329:   /**
330:    * Toggle between dark themes (obsidian/midnight) or to light (aurora)
331:    */
332:   toggle(): void {
333:     ThemeManager.next();
334:   },
335: 
336:   /**
337:    * Get all available themes
338:    */
339:   getAvailableThemes(): ThemeInfo[] {
340:     return THEME_ORDER.map((id) => THEMES[id]);
341:   },
342: 
343:   /**
344:    * Get theme info by ID
345:    */
346:   getTheme(id: ThemeId): ThemeInfo {
347:     return THEMES[id];
348:   },
349: 
350:   /**
351:    * Subscribe to theme changes
352:    * @param callback - Function to call when theme changes
353:    * @returns Unsubscribe function
354:    */
355:   onChange(callback: ThemeChangeCallback): () => void {
356:     listeners.add(callback);
357:     return () => {
358:       listeners.delete(callback);
359:     };
360:   },
361: 
362:   /**
363:    * Get theme icon emoji
364:    */
365:   getIcon(): string {
366:     return THEMES[currentTheme].icon;
367:   },
368: 
369:   /**
370:    * Get theme name
371:    */
372:   getName(): string {
373:     return THEMES[currentTheme].name;
374:   },
375: };
376: 
377: // Auto-initialize when module is imported
378: if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
379:   // Wait for DOM to be ready
380:   if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
381:     document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => ThemeManager.init());
382:   } else {
383:     ThemeManager.init();
384:   }
385: 
386:   // Expose to window for consistent access across Vite HMR reloads
387:   (window as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).__ThemeManager = ThemeManager;
388: }

  1: # Hayalet-ev Test Rehberi
  2: 
  3: Bu rehber, AI agent'ların Hayalet-ev projesinde test süreçlerini yürütmesi için gerekli workflow'ları ve best practice'leri içerir.
  4: 
  5: ## 🎯 AI Agent Test Workflow'u
  6: 
  7: ### Standart Test Döngüsü
  8: 
  9: ```
 10: 1. Kod değişikliği yap
 11: 2. Lint kontrolü (npm run lint)
 12: 3. Uygulamayı başlat (npm start)
 13: 4. CDP ile bağlantı kontrolü
 14: 5. Fonksiyonel test (CDP tool'ları ile)
 15: 6. Log analizi
 16: 7. Hata varsa düzelt, döngüyü tekrarla
 17: 8. Commit & push
 18: ```
 19: 
 20: ---
 21: 
 22: ## 🔧 Temel Test Komutları
 23: 
 24: ### 1. Lint Kontrolü
 25: 
 26: ```bash
 27: # Tüm kodu kontrol et
 28: npm run lint
 29: 
 30: # Otomatik düzeltme
 31: npm run lint:fix
 32: 
 33: # Sadece hatalar (uyarıları atla)
 34: npm run lint 2>&1 | grep -i "error"
 35: ```
 36: 
 37: **Beklenen:** Sadece uyarılar kabul edilebilir, hata olmamalı.
 38: 
 39: ### 2. Uygulamayı Başlatma
 40: 
 41: ```bash
 42: # Development mode
 43: npm start
 44: 
 45: # Background'da başlat (AI agent için)
 46: npm start &
 47: 
 48: # PID'i kaydet
 49: echo $! > /tmp/hayalet-ev.pid
 50: ```
 51: 
 52: ### 3. Uygulamayı Durdurma
 53: 
 54: ```bash
 55: # Electron'u kapat
 56: pkill -f "electron . --no-sandbox"
 57: pkill -f "vite"
 58: 
 59: # veya PID ile
 60: kill $(cat /tmp/hayalet-ev.pid)
 61: ```

121: 
122: ### Test Sonrası Log Kontrolü
123: 
124: ```bash
125: # En son session'ı bul
126: LATEST_LOG=$(ls logs/ | sort -r | head -1)
127: 
128: # 1. Önce hataları kontrol et
129: cat "logs/$LATEST_LOG/error.log" 2>/dev/null || echo "Hata yok ✅"
130: 
131: # 2. Ana logları incele
132: tail -100 "logs/$LATEST_LOG/console-001.log"
133: 
134: # 3. Belirli pattern ara
135: grep -i "error\|fail\|exception" "logs/$LATEST_LOG/console-001.log"
136: 
137: # 4. Session özetini kontrol et
138: cat "logs/$LATEST_LOG/summary.json"
139: ```
140: 
141: ### Başarı Kriterleri
142: 
143: | Kontrol | Beklenen | Komut |
144: |---------|----------|-------|
145: | error.log | Boş veya yok | `cat logs/$LATEST_LOG/error.log` |
146: | summary.json | `endReason: "normal"` | `cat logs/$LATEST_LOG/summary.json` |
147: | console.log | Kritik hata yok | `grep -i "error" logs/$LATEST_LOG/console-001.log` |

  1: /**
  2:  * CDP Tools - TypeScript
  3:  */
  4: 
  5: import type { ToolResult } from "../types/index.js";
  6: 
  7: /**
  8:  * CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) MCP Tools
  9:  * 
 10:  * Electron uygulamasını uzaktan kontrol etmek için tool handler'lar.
 11:  */
 12: 
 13: import {
 14:   checkConnection,
 15:   discoverTargets as _discoverTargets,
 16: } from "../utils/cdp-connection.js";
 17: 
 18: import {
 19:   clickBySelector,
 20:   clickByText,
 21:   fillInput,
 22:   getPageStructure,
 23:   checkElement,
 24:   findElements,
 25:   takeScreenshot,
 26:   getWindowInfo,
 27:   scrollTo,
 28:   pressKey,
 29:   executeScript,
 30: } from "../utils/cdp-commands.js";
 31: 
 32: import { logToolError } from "../utils/mcp-logger.js";
 33: 
 34: /**
 35:  * CDP hatalarını logla ve hata sonucu döndür
 36:  */
 37: function cdpError(toolName: string, error: Error, message?: string): ToolResult {
 38:   logToolError(toolName, error, {});
 39:   return {
 40:     content: [{ type: "text", text: `❌ ${message || error.message}` }],
 41:     isError: true,
 42:   };
 43: }
 44: 
 45: /**
 46:  * Electron bağlantı durumunu kontrol et
 47:  */
 48: export async function checkElectronConnection(): Promise<ToolResult> {
 49:   try {
 50:     const status = await checkConnection();
 51:     
 52:     if (status.connected) {
 53:       return {
 54:         content: [{
 55:           type: "text",
 56:           text: `✅ Electron bağlantısı aktif
 57: 
 58: 📡 **Bağlantı Bilgileri:**
 59: - Port: ${status.port}
 60: - Hedef sayısı: ${status.targetsCount}
 61: 
 62: 🪟 **Ana Pencere:**
 63: - Başlık: ${status.mainWindow?.title || "N/A"}
 64: - URL: ${status.mainWindow?.url || "N/A"}
 65: - Tip: ${status.mainWindow?.type || "N/A"}`,
 66:         }],
 67:       };
 68:     } else {
 69:       return {
 70:         content: [{
 71:           type: "text",
 72:           text: `❌ Electron bağlantısı yok
 73: 
 74: **Hata:** ${status.error}
 75: 
 76: **Çözüm:**
 77: 1. Hayalet-ev uygulamasını başlatın: \`npm start\`
 78: 2. Uygulama otomatik olarak port ${status.port}'da debug modunda başlar
 79: 3. Tekrar deneyin`,
 80:         }],
 81:       };
 82:     }
 83:   } catch (err) {
 84:     return cdpError("hev_check_electron_connection", err as Error, `Hata: ${(err as Error).message}`);
 85:   }
 86: }
 87: 
 88: /**
 89:  * Electron'a komut gönder (JavaScript çalıştır)
 90:  */
 91: export async function sendCommandToElectron(args: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Promise<ToolResult> {
 92:   const { command, description } = args as { command?: string; description?: string };
 93:   
 94:   if (!command) {
 95:     return {
 96:       content: [{ type: "text", text: "❌ 'command' parametresi gerekli" }],
 97:       isError: true,
 98:     };
 99:   }
100:   
101:   try {
102:     const result = await executeScript(command);
103:     
104:     return {
105:       content: [{
106:         type: "text",
107:         text: `✅ Komut çalıştırıldı${description ? ` (${description})` : ""}
108: 
109: **Sonuç:**
110: \`\`\`json
111: ${JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)}
112: \`\`\``,
113:       }],
114:     };
115:   } catch (err) {
116:     return cdpError("hev_send_command_to_electron", err as Error, `Komut hatası: ${(err as Error).message}`);
117:   }
118: }
119: 
120: /**
121:  * Electron penceresinin ekran görüntüsünü al
122:  */
123: export async function takeCdpScreenshot(args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ToolResult> {
124:   const { format = "png", quality = 80, savePath } = args as { format?: string; quality?: number; savePath?: string };
125:   
126:   try {
127:     const base64Data = await takeScreenshot(format, quality);
128:     
129:     // Dosyaya kaydetme opsiyonu
130:     if (savePath) {
131:       const { writeFile } = await import("fs/promises");
132:       const buffer = Buffer.from(base64Data, "base64");
133:       await writeFile(savePath, buffer);
134:       
135:       return {
136:         content: [{
137:           type: "text",
138:           text: `✅ Screenshot kaydedildi: ${savePath}\n\nBoyut: ${buffer.length} bytes`,
139:         }],
140:       };
141:     }
142:     
143:     // Base64 olarak döndür (küçük önizleme için)
144:     return {
145:       content: [{
146:         type: "text",
147:         text: `✅ Screenshot alındı (${format.toUpperCase()})
148: 
149: **Boyut:** ~${Math.round(base64Data.length * 0.75 / 1024)} KB
150: 
151: **Kullanım:** Dosyaya kaydetmek için \`savePath\` parametresi ekleyin.`,
152:       }],
153:     };
154:   } catch (err) {
155:     return cdpError("hev_take_cdp_screenshot", err as Error, `Screenshot hatası: ${(err as Error).message}`);
156:   }

 13: import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync } from "fs";
 14: import { readdir } from "fs/promises";
 15: import { join, relative, extname, basename } from "path";
 16: import { execSync } from "child_process";
 17: import { createHash } from "crypto";

 22: // ============================================
 23: // Shared Configuration
 24: // ============================================

 26: const CONFIG = {
 27:   srcDirs: ["src/js", "electron", "mcp-server"],
 28:   ignoreDirs: ["node_modules", ".git", "dist", ".vite", "logs", "data", "test-screenshots"],
 29:   extensions: [".ts", ".js", ".cjs", ".mjs"],
 30:   safeModules: [
 31:     "file-utils.ts", "url-utils.ts", "provider-registry.ts",
 32:     "device-manager.ts", "screenshot-manager.ts", "whisper-manager.ts",
 33:     "googledrive-manager.ts", "server-commands.ts",

 37: // ============================================
 38: // Shared Utilities
 39: // ============================================
 40: 
 41: async function getAllFiles(dir: string, projectRoot: string, files: string[] = []): Promise<string[]> {
 42:   const fullDir = join(projectRoot, dir);
 43:   if (!existsSync(fullDir)) return files;
 44:   
 45:   const entries = await readdir(fullDir, { withFileTypes: true });
 46:   
 47:   for (const entry of entries) {
 48:     const fullPath = join(fullDir, entry.name);
 49:     const relativePath = relative(projectRoot, fullPath);
 50:     
 51:     if (entry.isDirectory()) {
 52:       if (!CONFIG.ignoreDirs.includes(entry.name)) {
 53:         await getAllFiles(relativePath, projectRoot, files);
 54:       }
 55:     } else if (entry.isFile() && CONFIG.extensions.some(ext => entry.name.endsWith(ext))) {
 56:       files.push(relativePath);
 57:     }
 58:   }
 59:   
 60:   return files;
 61: }
 62: 
 63: function countLines(filePath: string): number {
 64:   try {
 65:     const content = readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
 66:     return content.split("\n").length;
 67:   } catch {
 68:     return 0;
 69:   }
 70: }
 71: 
 72: // ============================================
 73: // Tool 1: Analyze Project
 74: // ============================================
 75: 
 76: interface AnalyzeResult {
 77:   summary: {
 78:     totalFiles: number;
 79:     totalLines: number;
 80:     byDirectory: Record<string, { files: number; lines: number }>;
 81:   };
 82:   dependencies?: {
 83:     production: string[];
 84:     development: string[];
 85:   };
 86:   modules?: Array<{ file: string; imports: string[]; exports: string[] }>;
 87:   git?: {
 88:     branch: string;
 89:     lastCommits: string[];
 90:     hasChanges: boolean;
 91:   };
 92: }
 93: 
 94: export async function analyzeProject(
 95:   projectRoot: string,
 96:   options: { mode?: "summary" | "deps" | "modules" | "full" } = {}
 97: ): Promise<AnalyzeResult> {
 98:   const mode = options.mode || "summary";
 99:   const progress = createProgress({ operation: "Proje analizi", total: CONFIG.srcDirs.length + 3 });
100:   
101:   const result: AnalyzeResult = {
102:     summary: { totalFiles: 0, totalLines: 0, byDirectory: {} },
103:   };
104: 
105:   // Dosya istatistikleri
106:   let step = 0;
107:   for (const srcDir of CONFIG.srcDirs) {
108:     progress.update(++step, `${srcDir} taranıyor...`);
109:     const files = await getAllFiles(srcDir, projectRoot);
110:     let dirLines = 0;
111:     
112:     for (const file of files) {
113:       const lines = countLines(join(projectRoot, file));
114:       dirLines += lines;
115:     }
116:     
117:     result.summary.byDirectory[srcDir] = { files: files.length, lines: dirLines };
118:     result.summary.totalFiles += files.length;
119:     result.summary.totalLines += dirLines;
120:   }
121: 
122:   // Dependencies
123:   if (mode === "deps" || mode === "full") {
124:     try {
125:       const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(projectRoot, "package.json"), "utf-8"));
126:       result.dependencies = {
127:         production: Object.keys(pkg.dependencies || {}),
128:         development: Object.keys(pkg.devDependencies || {}),
129:       };
130:     } catch { /* ignore */ }
131:   }
132: 
133:   // Git info
134:   if (mode === "summary" || mode === "full") {
135:     try {
136:       const branch = execSync("git branch --show-current", { cwd: projectRoot, encoding: "utf-8" }).trim();
137:       const commits = execSync("git log --oneline -5", { cwd: projectRoot, encoding: "utf-8" }).trim().split("\n");
138:       const status = execSync("git status --short", { cwd: projectRoot, encoding: "utf-8" }).trim();
139:       result.git = { branch, lastCommits: commits, hasChanges: status.length > 0 };
140:     } catch { /* ignore */ }
141:   }
142: 
143:   // Module analysis
144:   if (mode === "modules" || mode === "full") {
145:     progress.update(++step, "Modüller analiz ediliyor...");
146:     result.modules = [];
147:     const allFiles: string[] = [];
148:     for (const srcDir of CONFIG.srcDirs) {
149:       const files = await getAllFiles(srcDir, projectRoot);
150:       allFiles.push(...files);
151:     }
152:     
153:     for (const file of allFiles.slice(0, 50)) { // Limit for performance
154:       try {
155:         const content = readFileSync(join(projectRoot, file), "utf-8");
156:         const imports = [...content.matchAll(/import\s+.*?\s+from\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g)].map(m => m[1]);
157:         const exports = [...content.matchAll(/export\s+(?:async\s+)?(?:function|const|class|interface|type)\s+(\w+)/g)].map(m => m[1]);
158:         if (imports.length > 0 || exports.length > 0) {
159:           result.modules.push({ file, imports, exports });
160:         }
161:       } catch { /* ignore */ }
162:     }
163:   }
164: 
165:   progress.done(`${result.summary.totalFiles} dosya analiz edildi`);
166:   return result;
167: }

194:     lines.push("## 📦 Proje Bilgisi");

196:     
197:     // Git info
198:     try {
199:       const branch = execSync("git branch --show-current", { cwd: projectRoot, encoding: "utf-8" }).trim();
200:       const status = execSync("git status --short", { cwd: projectRoot, encoding: "utf-8" }).trim();
201:       lines.push(`- **Branch:** ${branch}`);
202:       lines.push(`- **Uncommitted:** ${status ? `${status.split("\n").length} dosya` : "Yok ✓"}`);
203:     } catch { /* ignore */ }
204:     lines.push("");
205:   } catch { /* ignore */ }
206: 
207:   // Directory stats

209:   for (const srcDir of CONFIG.srcDirs) {
210:     const files = await getAllFiles(srcDir, projectRoot);
211:     let totalLines = 0;
212:     for (const file of files) {
213:       totalLines += countLines(join(projectRoot, file));

227:   lines.push("");
228: 
229:   // Critical rules
230:   lines.push("## ⚡ Kritik Kurallar");
231:   lines.push("- ❌ console.log kullanma → LogManager.addEvent() kullan");
232:   lines.push("- ✅ Her error log'a context ekle");
233:   lines.push("- ✅ Test sonrası logs/ klasörünü kontrol et");
234:   lines.push("");
235: 
236:   // Commands
237:   lines.push("## 🛠️ Sık Kullanılan Komutlar");
238:   lines.push("- `npm start` - Uygulamayı başlat");
239:   lines.push("- `npm run lint` - Kod kontrolü");
240:   lines.push("- `npm run pre-commit` - Commit öncesi");
241:   lines.push("");
242:

244:   try {
245:     const commits = execSync("git log --oneline -5", { cwd: projectRoot, encoding: "utf-8" }).trim().split("\n");
246:     lines.push("## 🔄 Son Commit'ler");
247:     for (const commit of commits) {
248:       lines.push(`- ${commit}`);

272: // ============================================
273: // Tool 3: Generate Diagram
274: // ============================================
275: 
276: interface DiagramResult {
277:   format: "mermaid" | "dot";
278:   diagram: string;
279:   nodeCount: number;
280:   edgeCount: number;
281: }
282: 
283: export async function generateDiagram(
284:   projectRoot: string,
285:   options: { format?: "mermaid" | "dot"; module?: string; depth?: number } = {}
286: ): Promise<DiagramResult> {
287:   const format = options.format || "mermaid";
288:   const _maxDepth = options.depth || 10; // TODO: Implement depth limiting
289:   
290:   const allFiles: string[] = [];
291:   for (const srcDir of CONFIG.srcDirs) {
292:     const files = await getAllFiles(srcDir, projectRoot);
293:     allFiles.push(...files);
294:   }
295: 
296:   // Build dependency graph
297:   const graph: Map<string, string[]> = new Map();
298:   
299:   for (const file of allFiles) {
300:     const fileName = basename(file).replace(/\.(ts|js|mjs|cjs)$/, "");
301:     
302:     // Filter by module if specified
303:     if (options.module && !file.includes(options.module)) continue;
304:     
305:     try {
306:       const content = readFileSync(join(projectRoot, file), "utf-8");
307:       const imports = [...content.matchAll(/from\s+['"]\.\.?\/([^'"]+)['"]/g)]
308:         .map(m => basename(m[1]).replace(/\.(ts|js|mjs|cjs)$/, ""));
309:       
310:       if (imports.length > 0) {
311:         graph.set(fileName, imports);
312:       }
313:     } catch { /* ignore */ }
314:   }
315: 
316:   // Generate output
317:   let diagram = "";
318:   let edgeCount = 0;
319:   
320:   if (format === "mermaid") {
321:     diagram = "```mermaid\nflowchart TD\n";
322:     for (const [from, tos] of graph) {
323:       for (const to of tos) {
324:         diagram += `  ${from} --> ${to}\n`;
325:         edgeCount++;
326:       }
327:     }
328:     diagram += "```";
329:   } else {
330:     diagram = "digraph Dependencies {\n  rankdir=LR;\n  node [shape=box];\n";
331:     for (const [from, tos] of graph) {
332:       for (const to of tos) {
333:         diagram += `  "${from}" -> "${to}";\n`;
334:         edgeCount++;
335:       }
336:     }
337:     diagram += "}";
338:   }
339: 
340:   return {
341:     format,
342:     diagram,
343:     nodeCount: graph.size,
344:     edgeCount,
345:   };
346: }

348: // ============================================
349: // Tool 5: Update Cache
350: // ============================================
351: 
352: interface CacheData {
353:   version: string;
354:   timestamp: string;
355:   files: Record<string, { hash: string; lines: number; exports: string[] }>;
356:   stats: { totalFiles: number; totalLines: number; totalExports: number };
357: }
358: 
359: interface CacheResult {
360:   updated: boolean;
361:   path: string;
362:   stats: { totalFiles: number; totalLines: number; totalExports: number };
363:   changedFiles: string[];
364: }
365: 
366: export async function updateCache(
367:   projectRoot: string,
368:   options: { force?: boolean; show?: boolean } = {}
369: ): Promise<CacheResult> {
370:   const cachePath = join(projectRoot, ".rovodev/cache.json");
371:   
372:   // Load existing cache
373:   let existingCache: CacheData | null = null;
374:   if (existsSync(cachePath) && !options.force) {
375:     try {
376:       existingCache = JSON.parse(readFileSync(cachePath, "utf-8"));
377:     } catch { /* ignore */ }
378:   }
379: 
380:   // Show mode
381:   if (options.show && existingCache) {
382:     return {
383:       updated: false,
384:       path: cachePath,
385:       stats: existingCache.stats,
386:       changedFiles: [],
387:     };
388:   }
389: 
390:   // Build new cache
391:   const newCache: CacheData = {
392:     version: "1.0.0",
393:     timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
394:     files: {},
395:     stats: { totalFiles: 0, totalLines: 0, totalExports: 0 },
396:   };
397: 
398:   const changedFiles: string[] = [];
399:   const allFiles: string[] = [];
400:   
401:   for (const srcDir of CONFIG.srcDirs) {
402:     const files = await getAllFiles(srcDir, projectRoot);
403:     allFiles.push(...files);
404:   }
405: 
406:   for (const file of allFiles) {
407:     try {
408:       const content = readFileSync(join(projectRoot, file), "utf-8");
409:       const hash = createHash("md5").update(content).digest("hex").slice(0, 8);
410:       const lines = content.split("\n").length;
411:       const exports = [...content.matchAll(/export\s+(?:async\s+)?(?:function|const|class|interface|type)\s+(\w+)/g)]
412:         .map(m => m[1]);
413: 
414:       // Check if changed
415:       if (existingCache?.files[file]?.hash !== hash) {
416:         changedFiles.push(file);
417:       }
418: 
419:       newCache.files[file] = { hash, lines, exports };
420:       newCache.stats.totalFiles++;
421:       newCache.stats.totalLines += lines;
422:       newCache.stats.totalExports += exports.length;
423:     } catch { /* ignore */ }
424:   }
425: 
426:   // Write cache
427:   writeFileSync(cachePath, JSON.stringify(newCache, null, 2), "utf-8");
428: 
429:   return {
430:     updated: true,
431:     path: cachePath,
432:     stats: newCache.stats,
433:     changedFiles,
434:   };
435: }

437: // ============================================
438: // Tool 6: Edit Lines
439: // ============================================
440: 
441: interface EditLinesResult {
442:   success: boolean;
443:   message: string;
444:   linesAffected?: number;
445:   preview?: string;
446: }
447: 
448: export function editLines(
449:   filePath: string,
450:   options: {
451:     operation: "replace" | "delete" | "insert" | "show";
452:     startLine: number;
453:     endLine?: number;
454:     content?: string;
455:     dryRun?: boolean;
456:   }
457: ): EditLinesResult {
458:   if (!existsSync(filePath)) {
459:     return { success: false, message: `Dosya bulunamadı: ${filePath}` };
460:   }
461: 
462:   const originalContent = readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
463:   const lines = originalContent.split("\n");
464:   const start = options.startLine - 1; // 1-indexed to 0-indexed
465:   const end = options.endLine ? options.endLine : start + 1;
466: 
467:   // Validate range
468:   if (start < 0 || start >= lines.length) {
469:     return { success: false, message: `Geçersiz başlangıç satırı: ${options.startLine}` };
470:   }
471: 
472:   switch (options.operation) {
473:     case "show": {
474:       const showEnd = Math.min(end, lines.length);
475:       const preview = lines.slice(start, showEnd)
476:         .map((line, i) => `${String(start + i + 1).padStart(4)} | ${line}`)
477:         .join("\n");
478:       return { success: true, message: "Satırlar gösteriliyor", preview, linesAffected: showEnd - start };
479:     }
480: 
481:     case "delete": {
482:       const newLines = [...lines.slice(0, start), ...lines.slice(end)];
483:       if (!options.dryRun) {
484:         writeFileSync(filePath, newLines.join("\n"), "utf-8");
485:       }
486:       return { 
487:         success: true, 
488:         message: options.dryRun ? "Dry run: silme yapılacak" : `${end - start} satır silindi`,
489:         linesAffected: end - start,
490:       };
491:     }
492: 
493:     case "insert": {
494:       if (!options.content) {
495:         return { success: false, message: "İçerik gerekli" };
496:       }
497:       const insertLines = options.content.split("\n");
498:       const newLines = [...lines.slice(0, start + 1), ...insertLines, ...lines.slice(start + 1)];
499:       if (!options.dryRun) {
500:         writeFileSync(filePath, newLines.join("\n"), "utf-8");
501:       }
502:       return { 
503:         success: true, 
504:         message: options.dryRun ? "Dry run: ekleme yapılacak" : `${insertLines.length} satır eklendi`,
505:         linesAffected: insertLines.length,
506:       };
507:     }
508: 
509:     case "replace": {
510:       if (!options.content) {
511:         return { success: false, message: "İçerik gerekli" };
512:       }
513:       const replaceLines = options.content.split("\n");
514:       const newLines = [...lines.slice(0, start), ...replaceLines, ...lines.slice(end)];
515:       if (!options.dryRun) {
516:         writeFileSync(filePath, newLines.join("\n"), "utf-8");
517:       }
518:       return { 
519:         success: true, 
520:         message: options.dryRun ? "Dry run: değişiklik yapılacak" : `${end - start} satır değiştirildi`,
521:         linesAffected: end - start,
522:       };
523:     }
524: 
525:     default:
526:       return { success: false, message: `Bilinmeyen işlem: ${options.operation}` };
527:   }
528: }

531: // Tool 7: Git Diff
532: // ============================================
533: 
534: export function gitDiff(projectRoot: string, options: { staged?: boolean; file?: string } = {}): { success: boolean; diff: string; stats?: { additions: number; deletions: number } } {
535:   try {
536:     let cmd = "git diff";
537:     if (options.staged) cmd += " --staged";
538:     if (options.file) cmd += ` -- "${options.file}"`;
539:     
540:     const diff = execSync(cmd, { cwd: projectRoot, encoding: "utf-8", maxBuffer: 10 * 1024 * 1024 });
541:     
542:     // Stats
543:     let statsCmd = "git diff --stat";
544:     if (options.staged) statsCmd += " --staged";
545:     if (options.file) statsCmd += ` -- "${options.file}"`;
546:     
547:     const statOutput = execSync(statsCmd, { cwd: projectRoot, encoding: "utf-8" });
548:     const statMatch = statOutput.match(/(\d+) insertions?\(\+\).*?(\d+) deletions?\(-\)/);
549:     
550:     return {
551:       success: true,
552:       diff: diff || "Değişiklik yok",
553:       stats: statMatch ? { additions: parseInt(statMatch[1]), deletions: parseInt(statMatch[2]) } : undefined,
554:     };
555:   } catch (error) {
556:     logToolError("hev_dev_git_diff", error as Error, { staged: options.staged, file: options.file });
557:     return { success: false, diff: (error as Error).message };
558:   }
559: }

562: // Tool 8: Lint File
563: // ============================================
564: 
565: export function lintFile(projectRoot: string, filePath: string, fix: boolean = false): { success: boolean; output: string; errorCount: number; warningCount: number } {
566:   const progress = createProgress({ operation: "ESLint", interval: 5000 });
567:   
568:   try {
569:     const fixArg = fix ? " --fix" : "";
570:     const cmd = `npx eslint "${filePath}" --format stylish${fixArg}`;
571:     progress.update(0, `${filePath} lint ediliyor...`);
572:     
573:     try {
574:       const output = execSync(cmd, { cwd: projectRoot, encoding: "utf-8", timeout: DEV_TIMEOUTS.LINT });
575:       progress.done("Hata bulunamadı");
576:       return { success: true, output: output || "✅ Hata bulunamadı", errorCount: 0, warningCount: 0 };
577:     } catch (err) {
578:       const error = err as { stdout?: string; stderr?: string; status?: number };
579:       const output = error.stdout || error.stderr || "";
580:       
581:       // Parse error/warning counts
582:       const errorMatch = output.match(/(\d+) errors?/);
583:       const warningMatch = output.match(/(\d+) warnings?/);
584:       const errorCount = errorMatch ? parseInt(errorMatch[1]) : 0;
585:       const warningCount = warningMatch ? parseInt(warningMatch[1]) : 0;
586:       
587:       progress.fail(`${errorCount} hata, ${warningCount} uyarı`);
588:       return {
589:         success: false,
590:         output,
591:         errorCount,
592:         warningCount,
593:       };
594:     }
595:   } catch (error) {
596:     progress.fail((error as Error).message);
597:     logToolError("hev_dev_lint_file", error as Error, { filePath, fix });
598:     return { success: false, output: (error as Error).message, errorCount: 0, warningCount: 0 };
599:   }
600: }

602: // ============================================
603: // Tool 9: Search Symbol
604: // ============================================
605: 
606: export async function searchSymbol(projectRoot: string, symbol: string, options: { type?: "function" | "class" | "interface" | "type" | "const" | "all" } = {}): Promise<{ matches: Array<{ file: string; line: number; type: string; context: string }>; total: number }> {
607:   const allFiles: string[] = [];
608:   for (const srcDir of CONFIG.srcDirs) {
609:     const files = await getAllFiles(srcDir, projectRoot);
610:     allFiles.push(...files);
611:   }
612:   
613:   const matches: Array<{ file: string; line: number; type: string; context: string }> = [];
614:   const symbolType = options.type || "all";
615:   
616:   // Build regex patterns based on type
617:   const patterns: Record<string, RegExp> = {
618:     function: new RegExp(`(?:export\\s+)?(?:async\\s+)?function\\s+(${symbol})\\s*\\(`, "i"),
619:     class: new RegExp(`(?:export\\s+)?(?:abstract\\s+)?class\\s+(${symbol})`, "i"),
620:     interface: new RegExp(`(?:export\\s+)?interface\\s+(${symbol})`, "i"),
621:     type: new RegExp(`(?:export\\s+)?type\\s+(${symbol})\\s*=`, "i"),
622:     const: new RegExp(`(?:export\\s+)?const\\s+(${symbol})\\s*[=:]`, "i"),
623:   };
624:   
625:   const searchPatterns = symbolType === "all" ? Object.entries(patterns) : [[symbolType, patterns[symbolType]]];
626:   
627:   for (const file of allFiles) {
628:     try {
629:       const content = readFileSync(join(projectRoot, file), "utf-8");
630:       const lines = content.split("\n");
631:       
632:       for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
633:         const line = lines[i];
634:         
635:         for (const [type, pattern] of searchPatterns as [string, RegExp][]) {
636:           if (pattern && pattern.test(line)) {
637:             matches.push({
638:               file,
639:               line: i + 1,
640:               type,
641:               context: line.trim().slice(0, 100),
642:             });
643:           }
644:         }
645:         
646:         // Also search for usage (not just definition)
647:         if (line.includes(symbol) && !matches.some(m => m.file === file && m.line === i + 1)) {
648:           matches.push({
649:             file,
650:             line: i + 1,
651:             type: "usage",
652:             context: line.trim().slice(0, 100),
653:           });
654:         }
655:       }
656:     } catch { /* ignore */ }
657:   }
658:   
659:   // Limit results
660:   return { matches: matches.slice(0, 100), total: matches.length };
661: }

664: // Tool 10: Test Run
665: // ============================================
666: 
667: export function testRun(projectRoot: string, options: { file?: string; grep?: string; timeout?: number } = {}): { success: boolean; output: string; passed: number; failed: number } {
668:   const progress = createProgress({ operation: "Test çalıştırma", interval: 3000 });
669:   
670:   try {
671:     let cmd = "npm test";
672:     
673:     // Check if project uses vitest, jest, or mocha
674:     const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(projectRoot, "package.json"), "utf-8"));
675:     const hasVitest = pkg.devDependencies?.vitest || pkg.dependencies?.vitest;
676:     const hasJest = pkg.devDependencies?.jest || pkg.dependencies?.jest;
677:     
678:     if (hasVitest) {
679:       cmd = "npx vitest run";
680:       if (options.file) cmd += ` ${options.file}`;
681:       if (options.grep) cmd += ` --grep "${options.grep}"`;
682:     } else if (hasJest) {
683:       cmd = "npx jest";
684:       if (options.file) cmd += ` ${options.file}`;
685:       if (options.grep) cmd += ` -t "${options.grep}"`;
686:     }
687:     
688:     const timeout = options.timeout || DEV_TIMEOUTS.TEST;
689:     progress.update(0, `${cmd} çalıştırılıyor...`);
690:     
691:     try {
692:       const output = execSync(cmd, { cwd: projectRoot, encoding: "utf-8", timeout, maxBuffer: 10 * 1024 * 1024 });
693:       
694:       // Parse test results
695:       const passMatch = output.match(/(\d+)\s+pass/i);
696:       const failMatch = output.match(/(\d+)\s+fail/i);
697:       const passed = passMatch ? parseInt(passMatch[1]) : 0;
698:       const failed = failMatch ? parseInt(failMatch[1]) : 0;
699:       
700:       progress.done(`${passed} passed, ${failed} failed`);
701:       return {
702:         success: true,
703:         output,
704:         passed,
705:         failed,
706:       };
707:     } catch (err) {
708:       const error = err as { stdout?: string; stderr?: string };
709:       const output = error.stdout || error.stderr || "";
710:       
711:       const passMatch = output.match(/(\d+)\s+pass/i);
712:       const failMatch = output.match(/(\d+)\s+fail/i);
713:       const passed = passMatch ? parseInt(passMatch[1]) : 0;
714:       const failed = failMatch ? parseInt(failMatch[1]) : 0;
715:       
716:       progress.fail(`${passed} passed, ${failed} failed`);
717:       return {
718:         success: false,
719:         output,
720:         passed,
721:         failed,
722:       };
723:     }
724:   } catch (error) {
725:     progress.fail((error as Error).message);
726:     logToolError("hev_dev_test_run", error as Error, { file: options.file, grep: options.grep, timeout: options.timeout });
727:     return { success: false, output: (error as Error).message, passed: 0, failed: 0 };
728:   }
729: }

 33: /**
 34:  * Mevcut provider'ları ve webview'ları listele
 35:  */
 36: export async function listProviderWebviews(
 37:   projectRoot: string
 38: ): Promise<{
 39:   providers: Array<{ id: string; name: string; hasConfig: boolean }>;
 40:   webviews: WebviewTarget[];
 41:   connected: Array<{ provider: string; url: string; title: string }>;
 42: }> {
 43:   const providers = listProviders(projectRoot);
 44:   const configs = providers
 45:     .map(p => parseProviderConfig(projectRoot, p.id))
 46:     .filter((c): c is ProviderConfig => c !== null);
 47:   
 48:   let webviews: WebviewTarget[] = [];
 49:   try {
 50:     webviews = await discoverWebviews(configs);
 51:   } catch {
 52:     // CDP bağlantısı yok
 53:   }
 54:   
 55:   const connected = webviews
 56:     .filter(w => w.provider)
 57:     .map(w => ({ provider: w.provider!, url: w.url, title: w.title }));
 58:   
 59:   return {
 60:     providers: providers.map(p => ({ id: p.id, name: p.name, hasConfig: p.exists })),
 61:     webviews,
 62:     connected,
 63:   };
 64: }

 66: /**
 67:  * Provider selector'larını listele (config'den)
 68:  */
 69: export function listProviderSelectors(
 70:   projectRoot: string,
 71:   provider: string
 72: ): {
 73:   provider: string;
 74:   found: boolean;
 75:   config?: {
 76:     baseUrl: string;
 77:     lastVerified?: string;
 78:   };
 79:   selectors: FlatSelector[];
 80:   grouped: Record<string, FlatSelector[]>;
 81:   summary: {
 82:     total: number;
 83:     byCategory: Record<string, number>;
 84:   };
 85: } {
 86:   const config = parseProviderConfig(projectRoot, provider);
 87:   
 88:   if (!config) {
 89:     return {
 90:       provider,
 91:       found: false,
 92:       selectors: [],
 93:       grouped: {},
 94:       summary: { total: 0, byCategory: {} },
 95:     };
 96:   }
 97:   
 98:   const selectors = flattenSelectors(config);
 99:   const grouped = groupSelectorsByCategory(selectors);
100:   
101:   const byCategory: Record<string, number> = {};
102:   for (const [category, sels] of Object.entries(grouped)) {
103:     byCategory[category] = sels.length;
104:   }
105:   
106:   return {
107:     provider,
108:     found: true,
109:     config: {
110:       baseUrl: config.baseUrl,
111:       lastVerified: config.lastVerified,
112:     },
113:     selectors,
114:     grouped,
115:     summary: {
116:       total: selectors.length,
117:       byCategory,
118:     },
119:   };
120: }

122: /**
123:  * Provider selector'larını canlı webview'da doğrula
124:  */
125: export async function validateSelectors(
126:   projectRoot: string,
127:   provider: string,
128:   categories?: string[]
129: ): Promise<ProviderValidationResult> {
130:   const progress = createProgress({ operation: `${provider} selector doğrulama` });
131:   
132:   try {
133:     progress.update(0, "Config okunuyor...");
134:     
135:     // Config'i parse et
136:     const config = parseProviderConfig(projectRoot, provider);
137:     if (!config) {
138:       progress.fail("Config bulunamadı");
139:       return {
140:         provider,
141:         url: "",
142:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
143:         connected: false,
144:         error: `Provider config bulunamadı: ${provider}`,
145:         results: [],
146:         summary: { total: 0, valid: 0, invalid: 0, successRate: "0%" },
147:       };
148:     }
149:     
150:     progress.update(1, "Webview aranıyor...");
151:     
152:     // Tüm provider config'lerini al (webview discovery için)
153:     const providers = listProviders(projectRoot);
154:     const allConfigs = providers
155:       .map(p => parseProviderConfig(projectRoot, p.id))
156:       .filter((c): c is ProviderConfig => c !== null);
157:     
158:     // Webview'ı bul
159:     const webview = await findProviderWebview(provider, allConfigs);
160:     if (!webview) {
161:       progress.fail("Webview bulunamadı");
162:       return {
163:         provider,
164:         url: "",
165:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
166:         connected: false,
167:         error: `${provider} webview'ı bulunamadı. Uygulama açık ve ${provider} sayfası yüklü mü?`,
168:         results: [],
169:         summary: { total: 0, valid: 0, invalid: 0, successRate: "0%" },
170:       };
171:     }
172:     
173:     progress.update(2, "Selector'lar test ediliyor...");
174:     
175:     // Selector'ları al ve doğrula
176:     const selectors = flattenSelectors(config);
177:     const result = await validateProviderSelectors(webview, selectors, categories);
178:     
179:     progress.done(`${result.summary.valid}/${result.summary.total} geçerli`);
180:     return result;
181:     
182:   } catch (error) {
183:     progress.fail((error as Error).message);
184:     logToolError("hev_validate_provider_selectors", error as Error, { provider, categories });
185:     return {
186:       provider,
187:       url: "",
188:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
189:       connected: false,
190:       error: (error as Error).message,
191:       results: [],
192:       summary: { total: 0, valid: 0, invalid: 0, successRate: "0%" },
193:     };
194:   }
195: }

197: /**
198:  * Provider webview'ında element inspect et
199:  */
200: export async function inspectProviderElementTool(
201:   projectRoot: string,
202:   provider: string,
203:   selector: string,
204:   options?: {
205:     includeStyles?: boolean;
206:     includeParent?: boolean;
207:     includeChildren?: boolean;
208:   }
209: ): Promise<{
210:   provider: string;
211:   selector: string;
212:   found: boolean;
213:   count: number;
214:   error?: string;
215:   elements?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
216: }> {
217:   const progress = createProgress({ operation: `${provider} element inspect`, quiet: true });
218:   
219:   try {
220:     // Config'leri al
221:     const providers = listProviders(projectRoot);
222:     const allConfigs = providers
223:       .map(p => parseProviderConfig(projectRoot, p.id))
224:       .filter((c): c is ProviderConfig => c !== null);
225:     
226:     // Webview'ı bul
227:     const webview = await findProviderWebview(provider, allConfigs);
228:     if (!webview) {
229:       progress.fail("Webview bulunamadı");
230:       return {
231:         provider,
232:         selector,
233:         found: false,
234:         count: 0,
235:         error: `${provider} webview'ı bulunamadı`,
236:       };
237:     }
238:     
239:     // Element inspect et
240:     const result = await inspectElement(webview, selector, options);
241:     
242:     if (result.result.found) {
243:       progress.done(`${result.result.count} element bulundu`);
244:     } else {
245:       progress.fail("Element bulunamadı");
246:     }
247:     
248:     return {
249:       provider,
250:       selector,
251:       found: result.result.found,
252:       count: result.result.count,
253:       error: result.result.error,
254:       elements: result.result.elements as unknown as Array<Record<string, unknown>>,
255:     };
256:     
257:   } catch (error) {
258:     progress.fail((error as Error).message);
259:     logToolError("hev_inspect_provider_element", error as Error, { provider, selector });
260:     return {
261:       provider,
262:       selector,
263:       found: false,
264:       count: 0,
265:       error: (error as Error).message,
266:     };
267:   }
268: }

 66: /**
 67:  * Selector ile element'e tıkla
 68:  */
 69: export async function clickBySelector(selector: string): Promise<ClickResult> {
 70:   return withConnection(async (ws: WebSocket) => {
 71:     const script = `
 72:       (function() {
 73:         const el = document.querySelector(${JSON.stringify(selector)});
 74:         if (!el) return { success: false, error: "Element bulunamadı: " + ${JSON.stringify(selector)} };
 75:         el.click();
 76:         return { success: true, tagName: el.tagName, id: el.id, className: el.className };
 77:       })()
 78:     `;
 79:     return evaluateJS(ws, script) as Promise<ClickResult>;
 80:   });
 81: }

 83: /**
 84:  * Metin içeriğine göre element'e tıkla
 85:  */
 86: export async function clickByText(text: string, tagName = "*"): Promise<ClickResult> {
 87:   return withConnection(async (ws: WebSocket) => {
 88:     const script = `
 89:       (function() {
 90:         const xpath = "//${tagName}[contains(text(), ${JSON.stringify(text)})]";
 91:         const result = document.evaluate(xpath, document, null, XPathResult.FIRST_ORDERED_NODE_TYPE, null);
 92:         const el = result.singleNodeValue;
 93:         if (!el) return { success: false, error: "Metin içeren element bulunamadı: " + ${JSON.stringify(text)} };
 94:         el.click();
 95:         return { success: true, tagName: el.tagName, textContent: el.textContent.substring(0, 50) };
 96:       })()
 97:     `;
 98:     return evaluateJS(ws, script) as Promise<ClickResult>;
 99:   });
100: }

105: export async function fillInput(
106:   selector: string, 
107:   value: string, 
108:   clear = true
109: ): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; newValue?: string }> {
110:   return withConnection(async (ws: WebSocket) => {
111:     const script = `
112:       (function() {
113:         const el = document.querySelector(${JSON.stringify(selector)});
114:         if (!el) return { success: false, error: "Input bulunamadı: " + ${JSON.stringify(selector)} };
115:         
116:         if (${clear}) el.value = "";
117:         el.value = ${JSON.stringify(value)};
118:         
119:         // Input event'lerini tetikle
120:         el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
121:         el.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
122:         
123:         return { success: true, newValue: el.value };
124:       })()
125:     `;
126:     return evaluateJS(ws, script) as Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; newValue?: string }>;
127:   });
128: }

130: /**
131:  * Sayfa yapısını al (debug için)
132:  */
133: export async function getPageStructure(maxDepth = 3): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
134:   return withConnection(async (ws: WebSocket) => {
135:     const script = `
136:       (function() {
137:         function getStructure(el, depth, maxDepth) {
138:           if (depth > maxDepth || !el) return null;
139:           
140:           const children = Array.from(el.children || [])
141:             .slice(0, 10) // Max 10 child per element
142:             .map(child => getStructure(child, depth + 1, maxDepth))
143:             .filter(Boolean);
144:           
145:           return {
146:             tag: el.tagName?.toLowerCase(),
147:             id: el.id || undefined,
148:             class: el.className || undefined,
149:             text: el.childNodes.length === 1 && el.childNodes[0].nodeType === 3 
150:               ? el.textContent?.substring(0, 30) 
151:               : undefined,
152:             children: children.length > 0 ? children : undefined,
153:           };
154:         }
155:         
156:         return {
157:           title: document.title,
158:           url: window.location.href,
159:           body: getStructure(document.body, 0, ${maxDepth}),
160:         };
161:       })()
162:     `;
163:     return evaluateJS(ws, script) as Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
164:   });
165: }

170: export async function checkElement(selector: string): Promise<ElementInfo> {
171:   return withConnection(async (ws: WebSocket) => {
172:     const script = `
173:       (function() {
174:         const el = document.querySelector(${JSON.stringify(selector)});
175:         if (!el) return { exists: false, selector: ${JSON.stringify(selector)} };
176:         
177:         const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
178:         return {
179:           exists: true,
180:           selector: ${JSON.stringify(selector)},
181:           tagName: el.tagName,
182:           id: el.id,
183:           className: el.className,
184:           visible: rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0,
185:           bounds: { x: rect.x, y: rect.y, width: rect.width, height: rect.height },
186:           disabled: el.disabled,
187:           textContent: el.textContent?.substring(0, 100),
188:         };
189:       })()
190:     `;
191:     return evaluateJS(ws, script) as Promise<ElementInfo>;
192:   });
193: }

217: /**

219:  * 
220:  * Not: Çift monitör ortamlarında pencere arka plandayken screenshot
221:  * alamıyor. Bu yüzden önce Page.bringToFront çağrılıyor.
222:  */
223: export async function takeScreenshot(format = "png", quality = 80): Promise<string> {
224:   return withConnection(async (ws: WebSocket) => {
225:     // Pencereyi öne getir (çift monitör/arka plan sorunu için gerekli)
226:     await sendCDPCommand(ws, "Page.bringToFront", {}, CDP_TIMEOUTS.COMMAND_FAST);
227:     
228:     // Page domain'ini etkinleştir
229:     await sendCDPCommand(ws, "Page.enable", {}, CDP_TIMEOUTS.COMMAND_FAST);
230:     
231:     // Screenshot al
232:     const result = await sendCDPCommand(ws, "Page.captureScreenshot", {
233:       format,
234:       quality: format === "jpeg" ? quality : undefined,
235:       fromSurface: true, // Compositor surface'den al (daha güvenilir)
236:     }, CDP_TIMEOUTS.SCREENSHOT);
237:     return result.data as string; // Base64 encoded
238:   });
239: }

  1: /**
  2:  * CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) Connection Manager
  3:  * 
  4:  * Electron uygulamasına WebSocket üzerinden bağlanır ve
  5:  * JavaScript kodlarını uzaktan çalıştırır.
  6:  */
  7: 
  8: import WebSocket from "ws";
  9: import { CDP_TIMEOUTS } from "./timeouts.js";
 10: 
 11: const CDP_PORT = process.env.CDP_PORT || 9223;
 12: const CDP_HOST = process.env.CDP_HOST || "localhost";
 13: 
 14: /** CDP Target interface */
 15: interface CDPTarget {
 16:   id: string;
 17:   type: string;
 18:   title: string;
 19:   url: string;
 20:   webSocketDebuggerUrl: string;
 21: }
 22: 
 23: /** CDP Response interface */
 24: interface CDPResponse {
 25:   id?: number;
 26:   result?: Record<string, unknown>;
 27:   error?: { code: number; message: string };
 28:   exceptionDetails?: {
 29:     exception?: { description?: string };
 30:     text?: string;
 31:   };
 32: }
 33: 
 34: /** CDP Evaluate Result */
 35: interface EvaluateResult {
 36:   result?: { value?: unknown };
 37:   exceptionDetails?: {
 38:     exception?: { description?: string };
 39:     text?: string;
 40:   };
 41: }
 42: 
 43: /**
 44:  * Electron debug endpoint'lerini keşfet
 45:  */
 46: export async function discoverTargets(): Promise<CDPTarget[]> {
 47:   try {
 48:     // Target discovery timeout
 49:     const controller = new AbortController();
 50:     const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), CDP_TIMEOUTS.TARGET_DISCOVERY);
 51:     
 52:     const response = await fetch(`http://${CDP_HOST}:${CDP_PORT}/json`, {
 53:       signal: controller.signal,
 54:     });
 55:     clearTimeout(timeoutId);
 56:     
 57:     if (!response.ok) {
 58:       throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
 59:     }
 60:     return (await response.json()) as CDPTarget[];
 61:   } catch (error) {
 62:     const err = error as Error & { code?: string };
 63:     
 64:     // Timeout hatası
 65:     if (err.name === "AbortError") {
 66:       throw new Error(
 67:         `Electron bağlantı zaman aşımı (5s). Port ${CDP_PORT} açık mı kontrol edin.`
 68:       );
 69:     }
 70:     
 71:     // Connection refused
 72:     if (err.code === "ECONNREFUSED" || err.message.includes("ECONNREFUSED")) {
 73:       throw new Error(
 74:         `Electron'a bağlanılamadı (port ${CDP_PORT}). ` +
 75:         `Uygulama --remote-debugging-port=${CDP_PORT} ile başlatıldığından emin olun.`
 76:       );
 77:     }
 78:     
 79:     // fetch failed (genel ağ hatası)
 80:     if (err.message.includes("fetch failed")) {
 81:       throw new Error(
 82:         `Electron'a bağlanılamadı (port ${CDP_PORT}). Uygulama çalışıyor mu?`
 83:       );
 84:     }
 85:     
 86:     throw error;
 87:   }
 88: }

 90: /**
 91:  * Ana pencere hedefini bul
 92:  */
 93: async function findMainWindow(): Promise<CDPTarget | null> {
 94:   const targets = await discoverTargets();
 95:   
 96:   // Önce "page" tipinde hedef ara
 97:   const pageTarget = targets.find(t => t.type === "page");
 98:   if (pageTarget) return pageTarget;
 99:   
100:   // Yoksa ilk hedefi döndür
101:   return targets[0] || null;
102: }

104: /**
105:  * Belirli bir hedefe WebSocket bağlantısı aç
106:  */
107: function connectToTarget(wsUrl: string): Promise<WebSocket> {
108:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
109:     let resolved = false;
110:     const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
111:     
112:     ws.on("open", () => {
113:       if (!resolved) {
114:         resolved = true;
115:         resolve(ws);
116:       }
117:     });
118:     
119:     ws.on("error", (err: Error) => {
120:       if (!resolved) {
121:         resolved = true;
122:         reject(new Error(`WebSocket hatası: ${err.message}`));
123:       }
124:     });
125:     
126:     // WebSocket bağlantı timeout
127:     setTimeout(() => {
128:       if (!resolved) {
129:         resolved = true;
130:         ws.terminate();
131:         reject(new Error("WebSocket bağlantı zaman aşımı"));
132:       }
133:     }, CDP_TIMEOUTS.WEBSOCKET_CONNECT);
134:   });
135: }
136: 
137: // Global ID counter for CDP commands
138: let cdpCommandId = 1;
139: 
140: /**
141:  * CDP komutu gönder ve yanıt bekle
142:  */
143: export function sendCDPCommand(
144:   ws: WebSocket, 
145:   method: string, 
146:   params: Record<string, unknown> = {}, 
147:   timeout: number = CDP_TIMEOUTS.COMMAND_DEFAULT
148: ): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
149:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
150:     const id = cdpCommandId++;
151:     // eslint-disable-next-line prefer-const
152:     let timeoutId: NodeJS.Timeout;
153:     
154:     const messageHandler = (data: WebSocket.RawData): void => {
155:       try {
156:         const response = JSON.parse(data.toString()) as CDPResponse;
157:         if (response.id === id) {
158:           clearTimeout(timeoutId);
159:           ws.off("message", messageHandler);
160:           if (response.error) {
161:             reject(new Error(`CDP Hatası: ${response.error.message}`));
162:           } else {
163:             resolve(response.result || {});
164:           }
165:         }
166:       } catch {
167:         // JSON parse hatası, devam et
168:       }
169:     };
170:     
171:     ws.on("message", messageHandler);
172:     
173:     try {
174:       ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }));
175:     } catch (e) {
176:       const err = e as Error;
177:       ws.off("message", messageHandler);
178:       reject(new Error(`WebSocket gönderim hatası: ${err.message}`));
179:       return;
180:     }
181:     
182:     timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
183:       ws.off("message", messageHandler);
184:       reject(new Error(`CDP komut zaman aşımı: ${method}`));
185:     }, timeout);
186:   });
187: }
188: 
189: /**
190:  * JavaScript kodunu Electron'da çalıştır
191:  */
192: export async function evaluateJS(
193:   ws: WebSocket, 
194:   expression: string, 
195:   awaitPromise = true
196: ): Promise<unknown> {
197:   const result = (await sendCDPCommand(ws, "Runtime.evaluate", {
198:     expression,
199:     awaitPromise,
200:     returnByValue: true,
201:   })) as EvaluateResult;
202:   
203:   if (result.exceptionDetails) {
204:     throw new Error(
205:       `JavaScript hatası: ${result.exceptionDetails.exception?.description || result.exceptionDetails.text}`
206:     );
207:   }
208:   
209:   return result.result?.value;
210: }
211: 
212: /**
213:  * Electron'a bağlan, komutu çalıştır ve bağlantıyı kapat
214:  */
215: export async function withConnection<T>(action: (ws: WebSocket) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
216:   const target = await findMainWindow();
217:   if (!target) {
218:     throw new Error("Electron penceresi bulunamadı. Uygulama çalışıyor mu?");
219:   }
220:   
221:   const ws = await connectToTarget(target.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
222:   
223:   try {
224:     // Runtime'ı etkinleştir
225:     await sendCDPCommand(ws, "Runtime.enable");
226:     return await action(ws);
227:   } finally {
228:     ws.close();
229:   }
230: }

255:       port: CDP_PORT,

257:       mainWindow: mainWindow ? {

260:         type: mainWindow.type,
261:       } : null,
262:     };
263:   } catch (error) {

265:     return {
266:       connected: false,
267:       port: CDP_PORT,

269:     };

  1: /**
  2:  * AIAIRelay - İki AI arasındaki iletişimi yöneten relay
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu sınıf AI-to-AI konuşmalarını yönetir:
  5:  * - Basit relay: AI1 ↔ AI2 mesaj iletimi
  6:  * - Protokol relay: Structured protocol ile başlayan oturumlar
  7:  */
  8: 
  9: import { BaseRelay } from "./base-relay.js";
 10: import { SlotController } from "../slot-controller.js";
 11: import { getErrorMessage } from "../../types/index.js";
 12: 
 13: export class AIAIRelay extends BaseRelay {
 14:   _providers: string[];
 15:   _prevThinking: Record<string, string>;
 16:   _lastTexts: Record<string, string>;
 17: 
 18:   constructor(coreEngine: any) {
 19:     super(coreEngine);
 20:     this._providers = ["ai1", "ai2"];
 21:     this._prevThinking = { ai1: "idle", ai2: "idle" };
 22:     this._lastTexts = { ai1: "", ai2: "" };
 23:   }
 24: 
 25:   /**
 26:    * Bu relay bu provider'ı yönetiyor mu?
 27:    * @param {string} provider - AI slot
 28:    * @returns {boolean}
 29:    */
 30:   handlesProvider(provider: string) {
 31:     return this._active && this._providers.includes(provider);
 32:   }
 33: 
 34:   /**
 35:    * Basit AI-AI relay oturumu başlat
 36:    * @param {Object} opts - { providers: ['ai1', 'ai2'] }
 37:    */
 38:   async start(opts: { providers?: string[] } = {}) {
 39:     this._providers = Array.isArray(opts.providers) && opts.providers.length
 40:       ? opts.providers
 41:       : ["ai1", "ai2"];
 42:     
 43:     this._active = true;
 44:     this._forwardCount = 0;
 45:     this._lastTexts = { [this._providers[0]]: "", [this._providers[1]]: "" };
 46:     
 47:     this._log("info", `AI-AI Relay started: ${this._providers.join(",")}`);
 48:     this._dispatchEvent("relay-changed", { active: true, type: "ai-ai" });
 49:   }
 50: 
 51:   /**
 52:    * Protokol tabanlı AI-AI oturumu başlat
 53:    * Önce providers[0]'a protokol gönderir, yanıt alınca providers[1]'e iletir,
 54:    * sonra relay aktif olarak mesajları ileri geri taşır.
 55:    * 
 56:    * @param {Object} opts - { providers, protocolPayload, attachments }
 57:    */
 58:   async startProtocolSession(opts: { providers?: string[]; protocolPayload?: any; attachments?: any[] } = {}) {
 59:     try {
 60:       if (!opts?.protocolPayload || !Array.isArray(opts.providers) || opts.providers.length < 2) {
 61:         throw new Error("Invalid protocol session args");
 62:       }
 63: 
 64:       const providers = opts.providers;
 65:       const id = this._generateSessionId("ai-ai-protocol");
 66:       
 67:       this._session = {
 68:         id,
 69:         type: "protocol",
 70:         providers: [...providers],
 71:         protocolPayload: { ...opts.protocolPayload },
 72:         attachments: Array.isArray(opts.attachments) ? [...opts.attachments] : [],
 73:         state: "sent-to-ai1",
 74:         lastTexts: { [providers[0]]: "", [providers[1]]: "" },
 75:         forwardCount: 0,
 76:         createdAt: Date.now(),
 77:       };
 78:       
 79:       this._providers = [...providers];
 80:       this._active = true;
 81:       this._lastTexts = this._session?.lastTexts || {};
 82: 
 83:       const first = providers[0];
 84:       const protocolPayload = this._session?.protocolPayload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
 85:       const message = String(protocolPayload?.message || "");
 86:       const attachments = (this._session?.attachments || []) as unknown[];
 87: 
 88:       this._log("info", `Protocol session ${id}: sending to ${first}`);
 89: 
 90:       await this.coreEngine.sendToTargets({
 91:         targets: [first],
 92:         text: message,
 93:         page: "protocol-relay",
 94:         attachments: attachments as string[],
 95:       });
 96: 
 97:       this._log("info", `Protocol session ${id}: sent to ${first}`);
 98:       this._dispatchEvent("relay-changed", { active: true, type: "ai-ai-protocol" });
 99: 
100:     } catch (err) {
101:       this._log("warning", `startProtocolSession error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`);
102:       throw err;
103:     }
104:   }
105: 
106:   /**
107:    * Relay oturumunu durdur
108:    */
109:   async stop() {
110:     const wasProtocol = this._session?.type === "protocol";
111:     const sessionId = this._session?.id;
112:     
113:     if (sessionId) {
114:       this._log("info", `${wasProtocol ? "Protocol session" : "Relay"} ${sessionId} stopped`);
115:     } else {
116:       this._log("info", "AI-AI Relay stopped");
117:     }
118: 
119:     this._resetState();
120:     this._prevThinking = { ai1: "idle", ai2: "idle" };
121:     this._lastTexts = { ai1: "", ai2: "" };
122:     
123:     this._dispatchEvent("relay-changed", { active: false, type: "ai-ai" });
124:   }
125: 
126:   /**
127:    * Protokol oturumunu durdur (alias for stop)
128:    */
129:   async stopProtocolSession() {
130:     await this.stop();
131:   }
132: 
133:   /**
134:    * AI thinking tamamlandığında çağrılır
135:    * @param {string} provider - AI slot (ai1 veya ai2)
136:    * @param {Object} syncResult - Conversation sync sonucu
137:    */
138:   async handleThinkingComplete(provider: string, syncResult: { messages?: Array<{ role: string; text?: string }> }) {
139:     try {
140:       if (!syncResult || !Array.isArray(syncResult.messages)) return;
141: 
142:       const lastAssistant = [...syncResult.messages]
143:         .reverse()
144:         .find((m) => m.role === "assistant" && (m.text || "").trim());
145:       
146:       if (!lastAssistant?.text) return;
147:       
148:       const text = lastAssistant.text.trim();
149: 
150:       if (this._session?.type === "protocol") {
151:         await this._handleProtocolFlow(provider, text);
152:         return;
153:       }
154: 
155:       await this._handleSimpleRelayFlow(provider, text);
156: 
157:     } catch (err) {
158:       this._log("warning", `handleThinkingComplete error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`);
159:     }
160:   }
161: 
162:   /**
163:    * Protokol akışını yönet
164:    * @private
165:    */
166:   async _handleProtocolFlow(provider: string, text: string) {
167:     const s = this._session;
168:     if (!s || !s.providers || !s.lastTexts) return;
169:     
170:     const [ai1, ai2] = s.providers;
171: 
172:     if (s.state === "sent-to-ai1" && provider === ai1) {
173:       if (s.lastTexts[ai1] === text) return;
174:       s.lastTexts[ai1] = text;
175: 
176:       this._log("info", `Protocol session ${s.id}: ${ai1} replied`, { excerpt: text.slice(0, 200) });
177: 
178:       const protocolPayload = s.protocolPayload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
179:       const baseMsg = String(protocolPayload?.message || "");
180:       const forwardText = `${baseMsg}\n\n[${ai1}]: ${text}`;
181:       s.state = "sent-to-ai2";
182: 
183:       try {
184:         await this.coreEngine.sendToTargets({
185:           targets: [ai2],
186:           text: forwardText,
187:           page: "protocol-relay",
188:           attachments: (s.attachments || []) as string[],
189:         });
190:         this._log("info", `Protocol session ${s.id}: forwarded ${ai1} -> ${ai2}`);
191:       } catch (e) {
192:         this._log("warning", `Protocol session ${s.id}: forward to ${ai2} failed: ${getErrorMessage(e)}`);
193:       }
194:       return;
195:     }
196: 
197:     if ((s.state === "sent-to-ai2" || s.state === "relay-active") && provider === ai2) {
198:       if (s.lastTexts[ai2] === text) return;
199:       s.lastTexts[ai2] = text;
200:       
201:       s.state = "relay-active";
202:       s.forwardCount = (s.forwardCount || 0) + 1;
203:       this._forwardCount = s.forwardCount;
204: 
205:       this._log("info", `Protocol session ${s.id}: forwarding ${ai2} -> ${ai1} (#${s.forwardCount})`, { excerpt: text.slice(0, 200) });
206: 
207:       try {
208:         await this.coreEngine.sendMessage({
209:           provider: ai1,
210:           text,
211:           page: "relay",
212:         });
213:       } catch (e) {
214:         this._log("warning", `Protocol session ${s.id}: forward ${ai2}->${ai1} failed: ${getErrorMessage(e)}`);
215:       }
216:       return;
217:     }
218: 
219:     if (s.state === "relay-active" && provider === ai1) {
220:       if (s.lastTexts[ai1] === text) return;
221:       s.lastTexts[ai1] = text;
222:       
223:       s.forwardCount = (s.forwardCount || 0) + 1;
224:       this._forwardCount = s.forwardCount;
225: 
226:       this._log("info", `Protocol session ${s.id}: forwarding ${ai1} -> ${ai2} (#${s.forwardCount})`, { excerpt: text.slice(0, 200) });
227: 
228:       try {
229:         await this.coreEngine.sendMessage({
230:           provider: ai2,
231:           text,
232:           page: "relay",
233:         });
234:       } catch (e) {
235:         this._log("warning", `Protocol session ${s.id}: forward ${ai1}->${ai2} failed: ${getErrorMessage(e)}`);
236:       }
237:     }
238:   }
239: 
240:   /**
241:    * Basit relay akışını yönet
242:    * @private
243:    */
244:   async _handleSimpleRelayFlow(provider: string, text: string) {
245:     if (this._lastTexts[provider] === text) return;
246:     this._lastTexts[provider] = text;
247: 
248:     const target = this._determineTarget(provider);
249:     
250:     if (!SlotController.isConnected(target)) {
251:       this._log("info", `Relay skipped: target ${target} not connected`);
252:       return;
253:     }
254: 
255:     this._forwardCount += 1;
256:     this._log("info", `Relay forwarding (#${this._forwardCount}) ${provider} -> ${target}`, {
257:       job: { from: provider, to: target },
258:       excerpt: text.slice(0, 200),
259:     });
260: 
261:     try {
262:       await this.coreEngine.sendMessage({
263:         provider: target,
264:         text,
265:         page: "relay",
266:       });
267:     } catch (err) {
268:       this._log("warning", `Relay forwarding failed: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, {
269:         from: provider,
270:         to: target,
271:       });
272:     }
273:   }
274: 
275:   /**
276:    * Kaynak provider'a göre hedef provider'ı belirle
277:    * @private
278:    * @param {string} source - Kaynak AI slot
279:    * @returns {string} - Hedef AI slot
280:    */
281:   _determineTarget(source: string) {
282:     const idx = this._providers.indexOf(source);
283:     if (idx === -1) return this._providers[0];
284:     return this._providers[(idx + 1) % this._providers.length];
285:   }
286: 
287:   /**
288:    * Thinking state değişimini takip et
289:    * @param {string} provider - AI slot
290:    * @param {string} thinkingState - Yeni thinking state
291:    * @returns {boolean} - Thinking tamamlandı mı?
292:    */
293:   checkThinkingTransition(provider: string, thinkingState: string) {
294:     const prev = this._prevThinking[provider] || "idle";
295:     this._prevThinking[provider] = thinkingState;
296:     return prev !== "idle" && thinkingState === "idle";
297:   }
298: }

 70: function mergeDefaults(obj: unknown, defaults: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
 71:   if (!isPlainObject(obj)) return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaults)) as Record<string, unknown>;
 72:   const out = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaults)) as Record<string, unknown>;
 73:   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj as Record<string, unknown>)) {
 74:     if (isPlainObject(v) && isPlainObject(out[k])) {
 75:       out[k] = mergeDefaults(v, out[k] as Record<string, unknown>);
 76:     } else {
 77:       out[k] = v;
 78:     }
 79:   }
 80:   return out;
 81: }

 83: function normalizeLegacy(raw: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
 84:   if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") {
 85:     return {};
 86:   }
 87: 
 88:    
 89:   const r = raw as any;
 90:   const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
 91: 
 92:   if (isPlainObject(r.user)) {
 93:     out.user = r.user;
 94:   }
 95: 
 96:   const gd = r?.integrations?.googledrive;
 97:   if (isPlainObject(gd)) {
 98:     out.integrations = { googledrive: gd };
 99:   }
100: 
101:   if (Array.isArray(r.accounts)) {
102:     out.accounts = r.accounts;
103:   }
104: 
105:   // Asistan hesapları
106:   if (Array.isArray(r.asistanAccounts)) {
107:     out.asistanAccounts = r.asistanAccounts;
108:   }
109: 
110:   const slots: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
111:   ["ai1", "ai2"].forEach((slot) => {
112:     const slotData = r?.slots?.[slot];
113:     if (!isPlainObject(slotData)) {
114:       return;
115:     }
116:     slots[slot] = {
117:       accountId: slotData.accountId ?? null,
118:       catchCommands:
119:         typeof slotData.catchCommands === "boolean"
120:           ? slotData.catchCommands
121:           : true,
122:       messageMethod: slotData.messageMethod || "injection",
123:       fileMethod: slotData.fileMethod || "dragdrop",
124:     };
125:   });
126:   out.slots = slots;
127: 
128:   // Asistan slotu (AI0)
129:   if (isPlainObject(r.asistanSlot)) {
130:     out.asistanSlot = {
131:       accountId: r.asistanSlot.accountId ?? null,
132:       catchCommands:
133:         typeof r.asistanSlot.catchCommands === "boolean"
134:           ? r.asistanSlot.catchCommands
135:           : false,
136:       messageMethod: r.asistanSlot.messageMethod || "injection",
137:       fileMethod: r.asistanSlot.fileMethod || "injection",
138:     };
139:   }
140: 
141:   return out;
142: }

238: 
239: export function getChangedPaths(prev: unknown, next: unknown): string[] {
240:   if (!prev) {
241:     return ["*"];
242:   }
243:   const changed: string[] = [];
244: 
245:   const walk = (a: unknown, b: unknown, path: string) => {
246:     if (a === b) return;
247:     const aObj = isPlainObject(a);
248:     const bObj = isPlainObject(b);
249:     if (aObj && bObj) {
250:       const keys = new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)]);
251:       for (const k of keys) {
252:         walk(a[k], b[k], path ? `${path}.${k}` : k);
253:       }
254:       return;
255:     }
256:     const aArr = Array.isArray(a);
257:     const bArr = Array.isArray(b);
258:     if (aArr && bArr) {
259:       if (JSON.stringify(a) !== JSON.stringify(b)) changed.push(path || "*");
260:       return;
261:     }
262:     changed.push(path || "*");
263:   };
264: 
265:   walk(prev, next, "");
266:   return changed.length ? changed : ["*"];
267: }

 65:  * Settings değişikliklerini işle
 66:  */
 67: export function handleSettingsChange(
 68:   _slots: Record<string, SlotState>,
 69:   settings: Settings | null,
 70:   changedPaths: string[],
 71:   syncSlotFn: SyncSlotFn
 72: ): void {
 73:   if (!settings) return;
 74: 
 75:   // AI1 ve AI2 için normal slot settings kontrolü
 76:   ["ai1", "ai2"].forEach((slot) => {
 77:     const slotPath = `slots.${slot}.accountId`;
 78:     const accountChanged = changedPaths.includes("*") || 
 79:                           changedPaths.some((p) => p === slotPath || p.startsWith("accounts"));
 80:

 82:       syncSlotFn(slot, settings);
 83:     }
 84:   });
 85:

 87:   const asistanChanged = changedPaths.includes("*") || 
 88:                          changedPaths.some((p) => p.startsWith("asistanSlot") || p.startsWith("asistanAccounts"));

 98:   _slots: Record<string, SlotState>,
 99:   settings: Settings | null,
100:   syncSlotFn: SyncSlotFn
