108: /**
109:  * Tek bir slot'u settings ile senkronize et
110:  */
111: export function syncSlotWithSettings(
112:   slotState: SlotState,
113:   slot: string,
114:   settings: Settings | null,
115:   states: SlotStates,
116:   events: SlotEvents,
117:   logFn: LogFn,
118:   transitionFn: TransitionFn,
119:   emitFn: EmitFn,
120:   disconnectFn: DisconnectFn,
121:   navigateFn: NavigateFn
122: ): void {
123:   if (!settings) return;
124: 
125:   // AI0 (Asistan) için asistanSlot ve asistanAccounts kullan
126:   const isAsistan = slot === "ai0";
127:   const slotSettings = isAsistan ? settings.asistanSlot : settings.slots?.[slot];
128:   const newAccountId = slotSettings?.accountId || null;
129:   const oldAccountId = slotState.accountId;
130: 
131:   if (newAccountId === oldAccountId) return;
132: 
133:   logFn(slot as SlotId, "info", `Account changed: ${oldAccountId} -> ${newAccountId}`);
134: 
135:   if (!newAccountId) {
136:     // Sadece CONNECTED veya CONNECTING durumunda disconnect çağır
137:     // ASSIGNED veya EMPTY durumunda disconnect gereksiz ve hata üretir
138:     if (slotState.state === states.CONNECTED || slotState.state === states.CONNECTING) {
139:       disconnectFn(slot, { force: true });
140:     }
141:     
142:     // Zaten EMPTY durumundaysa sadece cleanup yap
143:     if (slotState.state === states.EMPTY) {
144:       slotState.accountId = null;
145:       slotState.providerId = null;
146:       slotState.providerConfig = null;
147:       return;
148:     }
149:     
150:     slotState.accountId = null;
151:     slotState.providerId = null;
152:     slotState.providerConfig = null;
153:     transitionFn(slot, states.EMPTY);
154:     emitFn(slot, events.ACCOUNT_REMOVED, { oldAccountId });
155:     return;
156:   }
157: 
158:   // Asistan için asistanAccounts, diğerleri için accounts kullan
159:   const accountList = isAsistan ? settings.asistanAccounts : settings.accounts;
160:   const account = accountList?.find((a) => a.id === newAccountId);
161:   const providerId = account?.provider || null;
162:   const providerConfig = providerId 
163:     ? ProviderRegistry.get(providerId as "opencode" | "chatgpt" | "grok" | "gemini") as BaseProviderConfig | null
164:     : null;
165: 
166:   slotState.accountId = newAccountId;
167:   slotState.providerId = providerId;
168:   slotState.providerConfig = providerConfig;
169: 
170:   if (slotState.state === states.CONNECTED) {
171:     logFn(slot as SlotId, "info", "Account changed while connected - will navigate to new provider");
172:     navigateFn(slot);
173:   } else if (slotState.state === states.EMPTY) {
174:     transitionFn(slot, states.ASSIGNED);
175:   }
176: 
177:   emitFn(slot, events.ACCOUNT_ASSIGNED, { accountId: newAccountId, providerId });
178: }

  1: /**
  2:  * WebviewHandler - Slot webview işlemleri
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu modül slot'a bağlı webview'ların yaşam döngüsünü yönetir:
  5:  * - attach: Webview'ı slot'a bağla ve src ayarla

  7:  * - waitForDomReady: DOM hazır olana kadar bekle
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: import { TIMEOUTS } from "../../constants/index.js";
 11: import type { SlotId, LogLevel } from "../../types/index.js";
 12: import type { BaseProviderConfig } from "../../types/provider.js";
 13: 
 14: // ============================================================================
 15: // Types
 16: // ============================================================================

 18: /** Webview element tipi */
 19: type WebviewElement = HTMLElement & {
 20:   getURL?: () => string;
 21:   loadURL?: (url: string) => Promise<void>;
 22:   isLoading?: () => boolean;
 23:   src: string;
 24:   style: CSSStyleDeclaration;
 25:   addEventListener: (type: string, listener: EventListener, options?: AddEventListenerOptions) => void;
 26:   removeEventListener: (type: string, listener: EventListener) => void;

 30: interface WebviewHandlerSlotState {
 31:   webview: WebviewElement | null;
 32:   providerConfig: BaseProviderConfig | null;
 33:   lastActivity: number;
 34:   _overrideUrl?: string;
 35:   _pendingLoad?: boolean;

 41:   needsLoad: boolean;

 45: /** DOM ready handler bilgisi */
 46: interface DomReadyHandlerInfo {
 47:   handler: () => void;
 48:   errorHandler: (event: { errorCode?: number; errorDescription?: string }) => void;
 49:   webview: WebviewElement;
 50:   timeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
 51: }

 53: /** Log fonksiyonu tipi */
 54: type LogFn = (slot: SlotId, level: LogLevel, message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
 55:

 57: type EmitFn = (slot: SlotId, event: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
 58: 
 59: /**
 60:  * Webview'ı slot'a bağla
 61:  */
 62: export async function attachWebview(
 63:   slotState: WebviewHandlerSlotState,
 64:   slot: SlotId,
 65:   correlationId: string,
 66:   logFn: LogFn,
 67:   emitFn: EmitFn,
 68:   eventAttached: string
 69: ): Promise<AttachResult> {
 70:   const webview = slotState.webview;
 71:   
 72:   if (!webview) {
 73:     throw new Error("Webview not available");
 74:   }
 75: 
 76:   if (webview.getAttribute?.("data-detached")) {
 77:     webview.removeAttribute("data-detached");
 78:   }
 79:   
 80:   // Webview'ı mount noktasına taşı (dom-ready event için görünür olması gerekli!)
 81:   const mountEl = document.getElementById(`${slot}-webview-mount`);
 82:   if (mountEl && !mountEl.contains(webview)) {
 83:     mountEl.appendChild(webview);
 84:     webview.style.position = "relative";
 85:     webview.style.top = "0";
 86:     webview.style.left = "0";
 87:     webview.style.width = "100%";
 88:     webview.style.height = "100%";
 89:     logFn(slot, "debug", "Webview moved to mount point", { correlationId });
 90:   }
 91:   
 92:   webview.style.display = "";
 93: 
 94:   const currentSrc = webview.getAttribute("src") || "";
 95:   let currentUrl = "";
 96:   try {
 97:     currentUrl = (webview.getURL?.() || "").split("?")[0].split("#")[0];
 98:   } catch (_e) {
 99:     // Ignore errors
100:   }
101: 
102:   // Override URL varsa onu kullan, yoksa provider config'den al
103:   const targetUrl = slotState._overrideUrl || slotState.providerConfig?.baseUrl || "";
104:   const normalizedTarget = targetUrl.split("?")[0].split("#")[0];
105:   
106:   // Override URL kullanıldıysa temizle (tek seferlik)
107:   if (slotState._overrideUrl) {
108:     delete slotState._overrideUrl;
109:   }
110: 
111:   const needsLoad = (!currentSrc && !currentUrl) ||
112:                     (currentUrl && normalizedTarget && 
113:                      !currentUrl.startsWith(normalizedTarget) && 
114:                      !normalizedTarget.startsWith(currentUrl));
115: 
116:   slotState._pendingLoad = !!(needsLoad && targetUrl);
117:   slotState._targetUrl = targetUrl;
118: 
119:   if (!needsLoad && currentUrl) {
120:     logFn(slot, "debug", `Webview already loaded: ${currentUrl}`, { correlationId });
121:   }
122: 
123:   slotState.lastActivity = Date.now();
124:   emitFn(slot, eventAttached, { correlationId });
125:   logFn(slot, "debug", "Webview attached", { correlationId });
126:   
127:   return { needsLoad: slotState._pendingLoad ?? false, targetUrl };
128: }
129: 
130: /**
131:  * Webview'ı slot'tan ayır
132:  */
133: export async function detachWebview(
134:   slotState: WebviewHandlerSlotState,
135:   slot: SlotId,
136:   correlationId: string,
137:   logFn: LogFn,
138:   emitFn: EmitFn,
139:   eventDetached: string
140: ): Promise<void> {
141:   const webview = slotState.webview;
142: 
143:   if (!webview) return;
144: 
145:   try {
146:     webview.setAttribute("data-detached", "1");
147:     webview.removeAttribute("src");
148:     
149:     emitFn(slot, eventDetached, { correlationId });
150:     logFn(slot, "debug", "Webview detached", { correlationId });
151:   } catch (err) {
152:     const error = err as Error;
153:     logFn(slot, "warning", `Webview detach warning: ${error.message}`, { correlationId });
154:   }
155: }

157: // ============================================================================
158: // State
159: // ============================================================================
160: 
161: /**
162:  * DOM ready handler'larını saklamak için map
163:  */
164: const domReadyHandlers: Record<string, DomReadyHandlerInfo> = {};
165: 
166: /**
167:  * DOM ready olana kadar bekle
168:  * Event listener'ları ÖNCE ekler, SONRA src set eder (race condition önleme)
169:  */
170: export function waitForDomReady(
171:   slotState: WebviewHandlerSlotState,
172:   slot: SlotId,
173:   correlationId: string,
174:   logFn: LogFn
175: ): Promise<void> {
176:   const webview = slotState.webview;
177: 
178:   if (!webview) {
179:     return Promise.reject(new Error("Webview not available"));
180:   }
181: 
182:   return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
183:     // Yükleme gerekmiyorsa ve zaten yüklüyse hemen resolve et
184:     if (!slotState._pendingLoad) {
185:       try {
186:         if (webview.getURL?.() && !webview.isLoading?.()) {
187:           logFn(slot, "debug", "Webview already loaded", { correlationId });
188:           resolve();
189:           return;
190:         }
191:       } catch (_e) {
192:         // Ignore errors
193:       }
194:     }
195: 
196:     const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
197:       clearDomReadyHandler(slot);
198:       reject(new Error("DOM ready timeout"));
199:     }, TIMEOUTS.DOM_READY);
200: 
201:     const handler = (): void => {
202:       clearTimeout(timeoutId);
203:       clearDomReadyHandler(slot);
204:       logFn(slot, "debug", "DOM ready event received", { correlationId });
205:       resolve();
206:     };
207: 
208:     const errorHandler = (event: { errorCode?: number; errorDescription?: string }): void => {
209:       clearTimeout(timeoutId);
210:       clearDomReadyHandler(slot);
211:       if (event?.errorCode !== -3 && event?.errorCode !== -102) {
212:         reject(new Error(`Load failed: ${event?.errorDescription || "unknown"}`));
213:       } else {
214:         resolve();
215:       }
216:     };
217: 
218:     domReadyHandlers[slot] = { handler, errorHandler, webview, timeoutId };
219: 
220:     // ÖNCE event listener'ları ekle
221:     webview.addEventListener("dom-ready", handler, { once: true });
222:     webview.addEventListener("did-fail-load", errorHandler as EventListener, { once: true });
223: 
224:     // SONRA src set et (race condition önleme)
225:     if (slotState._pendingLoad && slotState._targetUrl) {
226:       logFn(slot, "info", `Loading URL: ${slotState._targetUrl}`, { correlationId });
227:       webview.setAttribute("src", slotState._targetUrl);
228:       slotState._pendingLoad = false;
229:       delete slotState._targetUrl;
230:     }
231:   });
232: }
233: 
234: /**
235:  * DOM ready handler'ı temizle
236:  */
237: export function clearDomReadyHandler(slot: SlotId): void {
238:   const handlers = domReadyHandlers[slot];
239:   if (!handlers) return;
240: 
241:   const { handler, errorHandler, webview, timeoutId } = handlers;
242:   try {
243:     if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
244:     webview?.removeEventListener?.("dom-ready", handler);
245:     webview?.removeEventListener?.("did-fail-load", errorHandler as EventListener);
246:   } catch (_e) {
247:     // Ignore cleanup errors
248:   }
249:   delete domReadyHandlers[slot];
250: }
251: 
252: /**
253:  * Webview'ın mevcut URL'ini al
254:  */
255: export function getCurrentUrl(slotState: WebviewHandlerSlotState | null): string {
256:   const webview = slotState?.webview;
257:   if (!webview) return "";
258:   try {
259:     return webview.getURL?.() || webview.getAttribute?.("src") || "";
260:   } catch (_e) {
261:     return "";
262:   }
263: }

  1: /**
  2:  * File drag and drop method
  3:  * Simulates drag-and-drop file upload
  4:  * Provider-agnostic implementation using runtime config for DOM selectors
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { waitForDomReady } from "../../../../app.js";
  8: import { validateFiles, createErrorResponse } from "../shared/file-utils.js";
  9: 
 10: interface FilePayload {
 11:   name: string;
 12:   path?: string;
 13:   base64?: string;
 14:   mimeType?: string;
 15: }
 16: 
 17: export async function attachFiles(webview: HTMLElement, { files }: { files: FilePayload[] }) {
 18:   await waitForDomReady(webview);
 19: 
 20:   const validation = validateFiles(files);
 21:   if (!validation.valid) {
 22:     return createErrorResponse(validation.message || "Validation failed");
 23:   }
 24: 
 25:   const filesPayload = JSON.stringify(files);
 26:   const dropScript = `(async function() {
 27:     const files = ${filesPayload};
 28:     if (!files.length) {
 29:       return { success: false, message: 'Dosya listesi boş' };
 30:     }
 31: 
 32:     function base64ToUint8(base64) {
 33:       const binary = atob(base64);
 34:       const len = binary.length;
 35:       const bytes = new Uint8Array(len);
 36:       for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
 37:         bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
 38:       }
 39:       return bytes;
 40:     }
 41: 
 42:     const dataTransfer = new DataTransfer();
 43:     files.forEach((file) => {
 44:       const bytes = base64ToUint8(file.base64);
 45:       const f = new File([bytes], file.name, { type: file.mimeType || 'application/octet-stream' });
 46:       dataTransfer.items.add(f);
 47:     });
 48: 
 49:     const cleanupDragOverlay = () => {
 50:       const config = window.__hayalet_provider_config;
 51:       
 52:       let overlaySelectors = [
 53:         '[data-dnd-overlay]',
 54:         '[data-testid*="drop"]',
 55:         '[data-testid*="drag"]',
 56:         '.drag-overlay',
 57:         '.drag-drop-overlay',
 58:         '.file-drop-target',
 59:         '.dnd-active-overlay'
 60:       ];
 61:       
 62:       if (
 63:         Array.isArray(config?.filters?.dragOverlaySelectors) &&
 64:         config.filters.dragOverlaySelectors.length
 65:       ) {
 66:         overlaySelectors = config.filters.dragOverlaySelectors;
 67:       }
 68: 
 69:       let criticalSelectors = [
 70:         'textarea',
 71:         'input[type="text"]',
 72:         'input[type="search"]',
 73:         '[contenteditable="true"]',
 74:         '[data-message-author-role]'
 75:       ];
 76:       
 77:       if (config?.criticalSelectors) {
 78:         criticalSelectors = config.criticalSelectors;
 79:       }
 80: 
 81:       const isCritical = (node) => {
 82:         if (!node) return false;
 83:         if (node === document.body || node === document.documentElement) return true;
 84:         return criticalSelectors.some((sel) => {
 85:           try { 
 86:             return node.matches?.(sel) || !!node.querySelector?.(sel); 
 87:           } catch (_) { 
 88:             return false; 
 89:           }
 90:         });
 91:       };
 92: 
 93:       overlaySelectors.forEach((selector) => {
 94:         document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach((overlay) => {
 95:           if (isCritical(overlay)) return;
 96:           
 97:           const rect = overlay.getBoundingClientRect();
 98:           const style = getComputedStyle(overlay);
 99:           const isLarge = rect.width >= window.innerWidth * 0.25 && rect.height >= window.innerHeight * 0.25;
100:           const isFloating = style.position === 'fixed' || style.position === 'absolute';
101:           
102:           if (isLarge && isFloating) {
103:             const textContent = overlay.textContent?.toLowerCase() || '';
104:             let containsDragText = false;
105:             
106:             let textMatchers = ['sürükleyin', 'drop', 'dosya', 'file'];
107:             if (config?.filters?.dragTextMatchers) {
108:               textMatchers = config.filters.dragTextMatchers;
109:             }
110:             
111:             for (const matcher of textMatchers) {
112:               if (textContent.includes(matcher.toLowerCase())) {
113:                 containsDragText = true;
114:                 break;
115:               }
116:             }
117:             
118:             if (containsDragText) {
119:               try {
120:                 overlay.remove();
121:               } catch (_) {
122:                 overlay.style.display = 'none';
123:               }
124:             }
125:           }
126:         });
127:       });
128:     };
129: 
130:     cleanupDragOverlay();
131: 
132:     const config = window.__hayalet_provider_config;
133:     let uploadTargets = ['textarea', 'form'];
134:     
135:     if (config?.uploadTargetSelectors) {
136:       uploadTargets = config.uploadTargetSelectors;
137:     } else if (config?.selectors?.inputField) {
138:       uploadTargets = [config.selectors.inputField];
139:     }
140: 
141:     function querySelectorDeep(selector) {
142:       try {
143:         const direct = document.querySelector(selector);
144:         if (direct) return direct;
145:       } catch (_) {}
146: 
147:       const all = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("*"));
148:       for (const el of all) {
149:         const sr = el.shadowRoot;
150:         if (!sr) continue;
151:         try {
152:           const found = sr.querySelector(selector);
153:           if (found) return found;
154:         } catch (_) {}
155:       }
156:       return null;
157:     }
158: 
159:     function sleep(ms) {
160:       return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
161:     }
162: 
163:     let target = null;
164:     for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 8 && !target; attempt++) {
165:       for (const selector of uploadTargets) {
166:         try {
167:           const el = querySelectorDeep(selector);
168:           if (el) {
169:             target = el;
170:             break;
171:           }
172:         } catch (_) {}
173:       }
174:       if (!target) {
175:         await sleep(120);
176:       }
177:     }
178: 
179:     if (!target) {
180:       target = document.body;
181:     }
182: 
183:     if (!target) {
184:       return { success: false, message: 'Drop hedefi bulunamadı' };
185:     }
186: 
187:     let cx = 10;
188:     let cy = 10;
189:     try {
190:       const rect = target?.getBoundingClientRect?.();
191:       if (rect) {
192:         cx = Math.round(rect.left + rect.width / 2);
193:         cy = Math.round(rect.top + rect.height / 2);
194:       }
195:     } catch (_) {}
196: 
197:     try {
198:       dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'copy';
199:       dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'all';
200:     } catch (_) {}
201: 
202:     const dragEnterEvent = new DragEvent('dragenter', {
203:       bubbles: true,
204:       cancelable: true,
205:       composed: true,
206:       clientX: cx,
207:       clientY: cy,
208:       dataTransfer: dataTransfer
209:     });
210: 
211:     const dragOverEvent = new DragEvent('dragover', {
212:       bubbles: true,
213:       cancelable: true,
214:       composed: true,
215:       clientX: cx,
216:       clientY: cy,
217:       dataTransfer: dataTransfer
218:     });
219: 
220:     const dropEvent = new DragEvent('drop', {
221:       bubbles: true,
222:       cancelable: true,
223:       composed: true,
224:       clientX: cx,
225:       clientY: cy,
226:       dataTransfer: dataTransfer
227:     });
228: 
229:     // FIX: Sadece tek bir target'a dispatch et - birden fazla target dosyanın
230:     // çoklu eklenmesine neden olabilir
231:     const dropTarget = target || document.body;
232: 
233:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
234:       try { dropTarget.dispatchEvent(dragEnterEvent); } catch (_) {}
235: 
236:       setTimeout(() => {
237:         try { dropTarget.dispatchEvent(dragOverEvent); } catch (_) {}
238:         setTimeout(() => {
239:           try { dropTarget.dispatchEvent(dropEvent); } catch (_) {}
240: 
241:           setTimeout(() => {

243:             const config = window.__hayalet_provider_config;
244:             let previewSelectors = [
245:               'uploader-file-preview',
246:               '.file-preview-wrapper',
247:               '[data-test-id="image-preview"]',

249:               '[data-testid*="file"]',

251:               '.file-attachment'
252:             ];
253:             
254:             if (config?.selectors?.filePreview) {
255:               // Config'de array veya string olabilir
256:               previewSelectors = Array.isArray(config.selectors.filePreview) 
257:                 ? config.selectors.filePreview 
258:                 : [config.selectors.filePreview];
259:             }
260: 
261:             const hasPreview = previewSelectors.some((sel) => {
262:               try {
263:                 return !!document.querySelector(sel);
264:               } catch (_) {
265:                 return false;
266:               }
267:             });
268:             
269:             const providerName = config?.name || config?.id || 'Provider';
270: 
271:             resolve({

273:               message: hasPreview
274:                 ? 'Dosyalar drag-drop ile eklendi'
275:                 : 'Drag-drop tetiklendi ama ' + providerName + ' dosyayı kabul etmedi (preview oluşmadı)',
276:               count: dataTransfer.files.length,
277:               target: (target?.tagName || 'unknown').toLowerCase() + (target?.id ? '#' + target.id : ''),

File: src/js/modules/webview/methods/file/injection.ts

  1: /**
  2:  * File injection method
  3:  * Direct file input element manipulation
  4:  * Provider-agnostic implementation using runtime config
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { waitForDomReady } from "../../../../app.js";
  8: import { validateFiles, createErrorResponse } from "../shared/file-utils.js";
  9: 
 10: interface FilePayload {
 11:   name: string;
 12:   path?: string;
 13:   base64?: string;
 14:   mimeType?: string;
 15: }
 16: 
 17: export async function attachFiles(webview: HTMLElement, { files }: { files: FilePayload[] }) {
 18:   await waitForDomReady(webview);
 19: 
 20:   const validation = validateFiles(files);
 21:   if (!validation.valid) {
 22:     return createErrorResponse(validation.message || "Validation failed");
 23:   }
 24: 
 25:   const filesPayload = JSON.stringify(files);
 26:   const injectScript = `(async function() {
 27:     const files = ${filesPayload};
 28:     if (!files.length) {
 29:       return { success: false, message: 'Dosya listesi boş' };
 30:     }
 31: 
 32:     function base64ToUint8(base64) {
 33:       const binary = atob(base64);
 34:       const len = binary.length;
 35:       const bytes = new Uint8Array(len);
 36:       for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
 37:         bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
 38:       }
 39:       return bytes;
 40:     }
 41: 
 42:     const dataTransfer = new DataTransfer();
 43:     files.forEach((file) => {
 44:       const bytes = base64ToUint8(file.base64);
 45:       const f = new File([bytes], file.name, { type: file.mimeType || 'application/octet-stream' });
 46:       dataTransfer.items.add(f);
 47:     });
 48: 
 49:     const config = window.__hayalet_provider_config;
 50:     let inputSelectors = ['input[type="file"][multiple]', 'input[type="file"]'];
 51:     
 52:     if (config && config.fileInputSelectors) {
 53:       inputSelectors = config.fileInputSelectors;
 54:     } else if (config && config.selectors && config.selectors.fileInput) {
 55:       inputSelectors = [config.selectors.fileInput];
 56:     }
 57: 
 58:     const attachButtonSelector = config?.selectors?.attachButton;
 59:     if (attachButtonSelector) {
 60:       try {
 61:         const btn = document.querySelector(attachButtonSelector);
 62:         if (btn) btn.click();
 63:       } catch (_) {}
 64:     }
 65: 
 66:     function querySelectorDeep(selector) {
 67:       try {
 68:         const direct = document.querySelector(selector);
 69:         if (direct) return direct;
 70:       } catch (_) {}
 71: 
 72:       const all = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("*"));
 73:       for (const el of all) {
 74:         const sr = el.shadowRoot;
 75:         if (!sr) continue;
 76:         try {
 77:           const found = sr.querySelector(selector);
 78:           if (found) return found;
 79:         } catch (_) {}
 80:       }
 81:       return null;
 82:     }
 83: 
 84:     let input = null;
 85:     for (const selector of inputSelectors) {
 86:       try {
 87:         input = querySelectorDeep(selector);
 88:       } catch (_) {
 89:         input = input || null;
 90:       }
 91:       if (input) break;
 92:     }
 93: 
 94:     if (!input) {
 95:       return { 
 96:         success: false, 
 97:         message: 'Dosya inputu bulunamadı. Denenen selectorlar: ' + inputSelectors.join(', ') 
 98:       };
 99:     }
100: 
101:     input.files = dataTransfer.files;
102:     input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
103:     input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
104: 
105:     return { 
106:       success: true, 
107:       message: 'Dosyalar input ile eklendi', 
108:       count: dataTransfer.files.length,
109:       foundSelector: input.tagName.toLowerCase() + (input.id ? '#' + input.id : '') + (input.className ? '.' + input.className.split(' ').join('.') : '')
110:     };
111:   })();`;
112: 
113:   const result = await webview.executeJavaScript?.(injectScript) as { success?: boolean; message?: string; count?: number } | undefined;
114:   return {
115:     success: !!result?.success,
116:     message: result?.message || "Dosya inject denemesi yapıldı",
117:     count: result?.count || files.length,
118:   };
119: }

  1: /**
  2:  * PendingArchiveHandler - Bekleyen arşiv işlemleri yönetimi
  3:  *
  4:  * Bu modül AI yanıtı tamamlandığında işlenecek arşiv kopyalama işlemlerini yönetir:
  5:  * - Pending archive kayıt
  6:  * - Stable durumda işleme
  7:  * - Cleanup işlemleri
  8:  */
  9: 
 10: import { LogManager } from "../log-manager.js";
 11: import { getErrorMessage } from "../../types/index.js";
 12: import { FileManager } from "../file-manager.js";
 13: import { AppState } from "../app-state.js";
 14: 
 15: class PendingArchiveHandlerClass {
 16:   _pendingArchives: Record<string, any[]>;
 17: 
 18:   constructor() {
 19:     this._pendingArchives = {};
 20:   }
 21: 
 22:   addPending(provider: string, entry: { jobId: string; folder?: string; temp?: string[]; stagedFiles?: any[] }) {
 23:     if (!provider || !entry) return;
 24: 
 25:     this._pendingArchives[provider] = this._pendingArchives[provider] || [];
 26:     this._pendingArchives[provider].push(entry);
 27: 
 28:     LogManager.addEvent("archive", "debug", "Pending archive registered", { visibility: 3,
 29:       jobId: entry.jobId,
 30:       provider,
 31:       folder: entry.folder,
 32:     });
 33:   }
 34: 
 35:   processPending(provider: string, syncResult: { messages?: any[]; conversationId?: string }) {
 36:     try {
 37:       const list = this._pendingArchives[provider] || [];
 38:       if (!list.length) return;
 39: 
 40:       delete this._pendingArchives[provider];
 41: 
 42:       const history = syncResult?.messages || [];
 43:       const conversationId = syncResult?.conversationId;
 44: 
 45:       const lastUserIdx = [...history].reverse().findIndex((m) => m.role === "user");
 46: 
 47:       const messageIndex = lastUserIdx === -1 ? history.length : history.length - 1 - lastUserIdx;
 48: 
 49:       const message = history[messageIndex];
 50: 
 51:       for (const entry of list) {
 52:         this._processEntry(entry, provider, message, conversationId);
 53:       }
 54:     } catch (e) {
 55:       LogManager.addEvent("archive", "warning", `processPending error: ${getErrorMessage(e)}`);
 56:     }
 57:   }
 58: 
 59:   async _processEntry(
 60:     entry: { jobId: string; temp?: string[]; stagedFiles?: any[] },
 61:     provider: string,
 62:     message: { id?: string } | undefined,
 63:     conversationId: string | undefined
 64:   ) {
 65:     try {
 66:       const accountInfo = AppState.getAccountForSlot(provider);
 67:       if (!accountInfo?.id || !message?.id || !conversationId) {
 68:         LogManager.addEvent("archive", "warning", "Missing info for archive processing", {
 69:           jobId: entry.jobId,
 70:           accountId: accountInfo?.id,
 71:           messageId: message?.id,
 72:           conversationId,
 73:         });
 74:         return;
 75:       }
 76: 
 77:       const stagedFiles = entry.stagedFiles || [];
 78: 
 79:       LogManager.addEvent(
 80:         "archive",
 81:         "info",
 82:         `Processing ${stagedFiles.length} attachments for message ${message.id}`,
 83:         { jobId: entry.jobId }
 84:       );
 85: 
 86:       for (const file of stagedFiles) {
 87:         const filePath = file.commandPath || file.path;
 88:         if (!filePath) continue;
 89: 
 90:         const res = await window.electronAPI?.dbSaveAttachment({
 91:           accountId: accountInfo.id,
 92:           conversationId,
 93:           messageId: message.id,
 94:           filePath,
 95:           originalName: file.originalName || file.name,
 96:           mimeType: null,
 97:         });
 98: 
 99:         if (!res?.success) {
100:           LogManager.addEvent("archive", "error", `Attachment save failed: ${res?.error}`, {
101:             file: file.name,
102:           });
103:         }
104:       }
105: 
106:       LogManager.addEvent("archive", "info", "Attachments processed successfully", {
107:         jobId: entry.jobId,
108:       });
109: 
110:       this._cleanup(entry);
111:     } catch (e) {
112:       LogManager.addEvent(
113:         "archive",
114:         "warning",
115:         `Pending archive processing error: ${getErrorMessage(e)}`,
116:         { jobId: entry.jobId }
117:       );
118:     }
119:   }
120: 
121:   _cleanup(entry: { jobId: string; temp?: string[] }) {
122:     try {
123:       FileManager.commandCleanup(entry.jobId, (entry.temp || []).map((t: string) => ({ tempPath: t })));
124:     } catch (e) {
125:       LogManager.addEvent(
126:         "command",
127:         "warning",
128:         `Arşiv sonrası temizlik hatası: ${getErrorMessage(e)}`,
129:         { jobId: entry.jobId }
130:       );
131:     }
132:   }
133: 
134:   clearPending(provider: string) {
135:     if (provider) {
136:       delete this._pendingArchives[provider];
137:     }
138:   }
139: 
140:   /**
141:    * Tüm bekleyen arşivleri temizle
142:    */
143:   clearAll() {
144:     this._pendingArchives = {};
145:   }
146: 
147:   hasPending(provider: string): boolean {
148:     return (this._pendingArchives[provider]?.length || 0) > 0;
149:   }
150: 
151:   getPendingCount(provider?: string): number {
152:     if (provider) {
153:       return this._pendingArchives[provider]?.length || 0;
154:     }
155: 
156:     return Object.values(this._pendingArchives).reduce((sum, list) => sum + (list?.length || 0), 0);
157:   }
158: }
159: 
160: export const PendingArchiveHandler = new PendingArchiveHandlerClass();

File: src/js/modules/whisper-manager.ts

  1: import { generateUniqueId } from "../constants/index.js";
  2: import { LogManager } from "./log-manager.js";
  3: import { AppState } from "./app-state.js";
  4: 
  5: // ============================================================================
  6: // Types
  7: // ============================================================================
  8: 
  9: interface WhisperRecord {
 10:   id: string;
 11:   user: string;
 12:   text: string;
 13:   when: number;
 14:   createdAt: number;
 15:   done: boolean;
 16:   queued: boolean;
 17:   queuedAt?: number;
 18:   doneAt?: number;
 19: }
 20: 
 21: interface WhisperData {
 22:   pending: WhisperRecord[];
 23:   done: WhisperRecord[];
 24: }
 25: 
 26: type SenderFn = (slot: string, text: string) => void | Promise<void>;
 27: 
 28: // ============================================================================
 29: // Constants & Helpers
 30: // ============================================================================
 31: 
 32: const PROVIDERS = ["ai1", "ai2"];
 33: 
 34: function resolveProvider(name = ""): string {
 35:   const lowered = name.toLowerCase();
 36:   
 37:   const nick1 = AppState.getNickname("ai1").toLowerCase();
 38:   const nick2 = AppState.getNickname("ai2").toLowerCase();
 39: 
 40:   if (lowered === "ai1" || (nick1 && lowered === nick1)) return "ai1";
 41:   if (lowered === "ai2" || (nick2 && lowered === nick2)) return "ai2";
 42: 
 43:   return PROVIDERS.includes(lowered) ? lowered : "ai1";
 44: }
 45: 
 46: // ============================================================================
 47: // WhisperManagerClass
 48: // ============================================================================
 49: 
 50: class WhisperManagerClass {
 51:   data: Record<string, WhisperData>;
 52:   timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null;
 53:   sender: SenderFn | null;
 54:   settings: Record<string, unknown>;
 55:   paused: boolean;
 56: 
 57:   constructor() {
 58:     this.data = {
 59:       ai1: { pending: [], done: [] },
 60:       ai2: { pending: [], done: [] },
 61:     };
 62:     this.timer = null;
 63:     this.sender = null;
 64:     this.settings = {};
 65:     this.paused = false;
 66:   }
 67: 
 68:   async init(options: { settings?: Record<string, unknown>; sender?: SenderFn } = {}): Promise<void> {
 69:     this.settings = options.settings || {};
 70:     if (typeof options.sender === "function") {
 71:       this.sender = options.sender;
 72:     }
 73:     await this.loadAll();
 74:     if (!this.timer) {
 75:       this.timer = setInterval(() => this.WhisperManagerCheck(), 60 * 1000);
 76:     }
 77:   }
 78: 
 79:   setSender(fn: SenderFn): void {
 80:     this.sender = fn;
 81:   }
 82: 
 83:   async loadAll(): Promise<void> {
 84:     for (const p of PROVIDERS) {
 85:       this.data[p] = await this.loadProvider(p);
 86:     }
 87:   }
 88: 
 89:   async loadProvider(provider: string): Promise<WhisperData> {
 90:     try {
 91:       // Slot'tan hesap bilgisini al
 92:       const accountInfo = AppState.getAccountForSlot(provider);
 93:       if (!accountInfo?.id) {
 94:         return { pending: [], done: [] };
 95:       }
 96:       
 97:       const res = await window.electronAPI?.whisperLoad?.(accountInfo.id);
 98:       if (res && typeof res === "object") {
 99:         return {
100:           pending: Array.isArray(res.pending)
101:             ? res.pending.map((r) => ({ ...r, queued: false }))
102:             : [],
103:           done: Array.isArray(res.done) ? res.done : [],
104:         };
105:       }
106:     } catch (e) {
107:       const err = e as Error;
108:       LogManager.addEvent(
109:         "whisper",
110:         "warning",
111:         `Whisper yüklenemedi (${provider}): ${err.message}`,
112:       );
113:     }
114:     return { pending: [], done: [] };
115:   }
116: 
117:   async saveProvider(provider: string): Promise<void> {
118:     try {
119:       // Slot'tan hesap bilgisini al
120:       const accountInfo = AppState.getAccountForSlot(provider);
121:       if (!accountInfo?.id) {
122:         return;
123:       }
124:       
125:       await window.electronAPI?.whisperSave?.(accountInfo.id, this.data[provider]);
126:     } catch (e) {
127:       const err = e as Error;
128:       LogManager.addEvent(
129:         "whisper",
130:         "error",
131:         `Whisper kaydedilemedi (${provider}): ${err.message}`,
132:       );
133:     }
134:   }
135: 
136:   WhisperManagerAdd(userName: string | undefined, text: string, when: unknown): WhisperRecord {
137:     const provider = resolveProvider(userName);
138:     const whenTs = this.parseWhen(when);
139:     const rec = {
140:       id: generateUniqueId("whisper"),
141:       user: provider,
142:       text,
143:       when: whenTs,
144:       createdAt: Date.now(),
145:       done: false,
146:       queued: false,
147:     };
148:     this.data[provider].pending.push(rec);
149:     this.sortPending(provider);
150:     this.saveProvider(provider);
151:     LogManager.addEvent("whisper", "info", `Whisper eklendi (${provider})`);
152:     this.notify();
153:     return rec;
154:   }
155: 
156:   WhisperManagerDone(userName: string | undefined, whisperId: string): boolean {
157:     const provider = resolveProvider(userName);
158:     const idx = this.data[provider].pending.findIndex(
159:       (r) => r.id === whisperId,
160:     );
161:     if (idx === -1) return false;
162:     const rec = this.data[provider].pending.splice(idx, 1)[0];
163:     this.data[provider].done.push({ ...rec, done: true, doneAt: Date.now() });
164:     this.saveProvider(provider);
165:     LogManager.addEvent(
166:       "whisper",
167:       "success",
168:       `Whisper tamamlandı (${provider})`,
169:     );
170:     this.notify();
171:     return true;
172:   }
173: 
174:   WhisperManagerDelete(userName: string | undefined, whisperId: string | undefined): boolean {
175:     const provider = resolveProvider(userName);
176:     const before = this.data[provider].pending.length;
177:     this.data[provider].pending = this.data[provider].pending.filter(
178:       (r) => r.id !== whisperId,
179:     );
180:     if (before !== this.data[provider].pending.length) {
181:       this.saveProvider(provider);
182:       LogManager.addEvent("whisper", "info", `Whisper silindi (${provider})`, { visibility: 1 });
183:       this.notify();
184:       return true;
185:     }
186:     return false;
187:   }
188: 
189:   WhisperManagerClear(userName: string | undefined): boolean {
190:     const provider = resolveProvider(userName);
191:     this.data[provider].pending = [];
192:     this.saveProvider(provider);
193:     LogManager.addEvent(
194:       "whisper",
195:       "info",
196:       `Whisper kayıtları temizlendi (${provider})`,
197:     );
198:     this.notify();
199:     return true;
200:   }
201: 
202:   WhisperManagerCheck(): boolean {
203:     if (this.paused) return false;
204:     const now = Date.now();
205:     PROVIDERS.forEach((provider) => {
206:       const due = this.data[provider].pending.filter(
207:         (r) => r.when <= now && !r.queued,
208:       );
209:       if (!due.length) return;
210:       due.forEach(async (rec) => {
211:         const msg = `Zamanlı Fısıltı Kaydı: ${rec.text}`;
212:         let sent = false;
213:         this.markQueued(provider, rec.id);
214:         if (typeof this.sender === "function") {
215:           try {
216:             await this.sender(provider, msg);
217:             sent = true;
218:             if (!sent) {
219:               this.markReady(provider, rec.id);
220:             }
221:           } catch (e) {
222:             const err = e as Error;
223:             LogManager.addEvent(
224:               "whisper",
225:               "error",
226:               `Whisper gönderilemedi (${provider}): ${err.message}`,
227:             );
228:             this.markReady(provider, rec.id);
229:           }
230:         } else {
231:           this.markReady(provider, rec.id);
232:         }
233:         if (sent) {
234:           this.WhisperManagerDone(provider, rec.id);
235:         }
236:       });
237:     });
238:     return true;
239:   }
240: 
241:   getRecords(provider: string | undefined): WhisperRecord[] {
242:     const p = resolveProvider(provider);
243:     return [...(this.data[p]?.pending || [])];
244:   }
245: 
246:   getDoneRecords(provider: string | undefined): WhisperRecord[] {
247:     const p = resolveProvider(provider);
248:     return [...(this.data[p]?.done || [])];
249:   }
250: 
251:   parseWhen(raw: unknown): number {
252:     if (!raw) return Date.now();
253:     if (raw instanceof Date) return raw.getTime();
254:     if (typeof raw === "number" && Number.isFinite(raw)) return raw;
255:     const str = String(raw).trim();
256:     let parsed = Date.parse(str);
257:     if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
258:       const m = str.match(
259:         /^(\d{1,2})[./](\d{1,2})[./](\d{4})[:\s](\d{1,2})[.:](\d{2})$/,
260:       );
261:       if (m) {
262:         const [, d, mo, y, h, min] = m;
263:         parsed = new Date(
264:           Number(y),
265:           Number(mo) - 1,
266:           Number(d),
267:           Number(h),
268:           Number(min),
269:         ).getTime();
270:       }
271:     }
272:     return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : Date.now();
273:   }
274: 
275:   sortPending(provider: string): void {
276:     this.data[provider].pending.sort((a, b) => (a.when || 0) - (b.when || 0));
277:   }
278: 
279:   markQueued(provider: string, whisperId: string): void {
280:     const rec = (this.data[provider]?.pending || []).find(
281:       (r) => r.id === whisperId,
282:     );
283:     if (rec) {
284:       rec.queued = true;
285:       rec.queuedAt = Date.now();
286:       this.saveProvider(provider);
287:     }
288:   }
289: 
290:   markReady(provider: string, whisperId: string): void {
291:     const rec = (this.data[provider]?.pending || []).find(
292:       (r) => r.id === whisperId,
293:     );
294:     if (rec) {
295:       rec.queued = false;
296:       this.saveProvider(provider);
297:     }
298:   }
299: 
300:   catch(): (WhisperRecord & { provider: string })[] {
301:     const now = Date.now();
302:     const due: (WhisperRecord & { provider: string })[] = [];
303:     PROVIDERS.forEach((provider) => {
304:       const list = (this.data[provider]?.pending || []).filter(
305:         (r) => !r.queued && (r.when || 0) <= now,
306:       );
307:       due.push(...list.map((r) => ({ ...r, provider })));
308:     });
309:     return due;
310:   }
311: 
312:   pause(): void {
313:     this.paused = true;
314:   }
315: 
316:   resume(runCheck = false): void {
317:     this.paused = false;
318:     if (runCheck) {
319:       this.WhisperManagerCheck();
320:     }
321:   }
322: 
323:   notify(): void {
324:     try {
325:       window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("whisper-updated"));
326:     } catch (_e) {
327:       // Ignore
328:     }
329:   }
330: }
331: 
332: export const WhisperManager = new WhisperManagerClass();

 1: import { getFilename } from "../../constants/index.js";
 2: 
 3: /**
 4:  * UploadHandler - Analyze sayfası dosya yükleme işlemleri
 5:  * 
 6:  * Bu modül dosya seçme ve listeleme işlemlerini yönetir:
 7:  * - Dosya seçim dialog'u
 8:  * - Staged files yönetimi
 9:  * - Upload list render
10:  */
11: 
12: interface StagedFile {
13:   name: string;
14:   path: string;
15: }
16: 
17: export function renderUploadList(stagedFiles: StagedFile[], onRemove: (name: string) => void) {
18:   const box = document.getElementById("upload-list");
19:   const info = document.querySelector(".files-header div");
20:   
21:   if (!box) return;
22:   
23:   box.innerHTML = "";
24:   
25:   if (!stagedFiles.length) {
26:     box.textContent = "Henüz dosya yok.";
27:     if (info) info.textContent = "Henüz dosya yok.";
28:     return;
29:   }
30:   
31:   if (info) info.textContent = `${stagedFiles.length} dosya eklendi.`;
32:   
33:   stagedFiles.forEach((file: StagedFile) => {
34:     const row = document.createElement("div");
35:     row.className = "upload-item";
36:     
37:     const name = document.createElement("span");
38:     name.textContent = file.name;
39:     
40:     const btn = document.createElement("button");
41:     btn.className = "upload-remove";
42:     btn.textContent = "×";
43:     btn.title = "Kaldır";
44:     btn.addEventListener("click", () => onRemove(file.name));
45:     
46:     row.appendChild(name);
47:     row.appendChild(btn);
48:     box.appendChild(row);
49:   });
50: }
51: 
52: export async function addUploadFiles(currentFiles: StagedFile[]): Promise<StagedFile[]> {
53:   try {
54:     const selection = await window.electronAPI?.showOpenDialog?.({
55:       properties: ["openFile", "multiSelections"],
56:     });
57:     
58:     // Dialog iptal edildi veya sonuç yok
59:     if (!selection) return currentFiles;
60:     if (selection.canceled) return currentFiles;
61:     
62:     const paths = selection.filePaths || [];
63:     if (!paths.length) return currentFiles;
64:     
65:     const newEntries = paths.map((p) => {
66:       const name = getFilename(String(p)) || "dosya";
67:       return { name, path: p };
68:     });
69:     
70:     return [...currentFiles, ...newEntries];
71:   } catch (_err) {
72:     return currentFiles;
73:   }
74: }
75: 
76: export function removeUploadFile(currentFiles: StagedFile[], name: string): StagedFile[] {
77:   return currentFiles.filter((f: StagedFile) => f.name !== name);
78: }

 41:

 48:   async render() {
 49:     const settings = this.settingsManager.getSnapshot();
 50:     const slotSettings = settings.slots?.[this.slotId] || {};
 51:     const accounts = settings.accounts || [];
 52: 
 53:     // Filter accounts (don't show account used by OTHER slot)
 54:     const otherSlot = this.slotId === "ai1" ? "ai2" : "ai1";
 55:     const otherAccountId = settings.slots?.[otherSlot]?.accountId;
 56:     
 57:     const availableAccounts = accounts.filter((a: { id: string }) => {
 58:         if (a.id === slotSettings.accountId) return true; // Show self
 59:         if (a.id === otherAccountId) return false; // Hide other
 60:         return true;
 61:     });
 62: 
 63:     // Render Account Select
 64:     const accSelect = document.getElementById(`${this.slotId}-account-select`) as HTMLSelectElement | null;
 65:     if (accSelect) {
 66:       const currentVal = slotSettings.accountId || "";
 67:       accSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Hesap Seç --</option>' + 
 68:         availableAccounts.map((a: any) => 
 69:             `<option value="${a.id}">${a.nickname || a.email} (${a.provider})</option>`
 70:         ).join("");
 71:       accSelect.value = currentVal;
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     // Render Settings
 75:     const msgSelect = document.getElementById(`${this.slotId}-msg-method`) as HTMLSelectElement | null;
 76:     if (msgSelect) msgSelect.value = slotSettings.messageMethod || "injection";
 77: 
 78:     const fileSelect = document.getElementById(`${this.slotId}-file-method`) as HTMLSelectElement | null;
 79:     if (fileSelect) fileSelect.value = slotSettings.fileMethod || "dragdrop";
 80: 
 81:     const catchCheck = document.getElementById(`${this.slotId}-catch-check`) as HTMLInputElement | null;
 82:     if (catchCheck) catchCheck.checked = slotSettings.catchCommands ?? true;
 83:   }
 84: 
 85:   async updateSetting(key: string, value: unknown) {
 86:     const settings = this.settingsManager.getSnapshot();
 87:     const slots = settings.slots || {};
 88:     
 89:     const updated = {
 90:         ...settings,
 91:         slots: {
 92:             ...slots,
 93:             [this.slotId]: {
 94:                 ...slots[this.slotId],
 95:                 [key]: value
 96:             }
 97:         }
 98:     };
 99:     
100:     await this.settingsManager.save(updated);
101:     
102:     // Hesap değiştiğinde her iki slot'un listesini güncelle
103:     if (key === "accountId") {
104:       window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("slot-account-changed", { 
105:         detail: { slot: this.slotId, accountId: value } 
106:       }));
107:     }
108:     
109:     this.render(); 
110:   }

 21: import { renderUploadList, addUploadFiles, removeUploadFile } from "./analyze/upload-handler.js";
 22: import { initContextMenu, initReadModal, showContextMenu, showReadModal } from "./analyze/context-menu.js";
 23: import { initDraft, loadDraft, persistDraft } from "./analyze/draft-manager.js";

 25: export class AnalyzeController {
 26:   stagedFiles: any[];
 27:   lastMessages: { ai1: string; ai2: string };
 28:   beforeUnloadHandler: (() => void) | null;
 29:   _unsubSettings: (() => void) | null;

 34:   constructor() {
 35:     this.stagedFiles = [];
 36:     this.lastMessages = { ai1: "", ai2: "" };
 37:     this.beforeUnloadHandler = null;
 38:     this._unsubSettings = null;
 39:     this._unsubSlotController = null;

 47:   async init() {
 48:     await this.loadSettings();
 49:     this.applyAvatars();
 50:     this.applyNames();
 51: 
 52:     if (!this._unsubSettings) {
 53:       this._unsubSettings = SettingsManager.subscribe(() => {
 54:         this.applyAvatars();
 55:         this.applyNames();
 56:         this.updateConnectionStates();
 57:       });
 58:     }
 59: 
 60:     this.bindActions();
 61:     TrafficManager.onUpdate(() => this.updateSendButtonState());
 62: 
 63:     if (!this._unsubSlotController) {
 64:       this._unsubSlotController = SlotController.on(SlotEvent.STATE_CHANGED, () => {
 65:         this.applyNames();
 66:         this.updateConnectionStates();
 67:       });
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     if (!this._unsubAppState) {
 71:       this._unsubAppState = AppState.subscribe(() => {
 72:         this.applyNames();
 73:       });
 74:     }
 75: 
 76:     await this.updateConnectionStates();
 77:     await this.refreshUploads();
 78:     
 79:     initContextMenu();
 80:     initReadModal();
 81:     await this._initDraftSystem();
 82: 
 83:     this._setupRelayListener();
 84: 
 85:     window.addEventListener("conversation-selected", (e) => {
 86:       const detail = (e as CustomEvent).detail;
 87:       if (detail?.provider) {
 88:         this._renderMessages(detail.provider);
 89:       }
 90:     });
 91:   }

 94:     await SettingsManager.load();
 95:   }

100:   applyAvatars() {
101:     ["ai1", "ai2"].forEach((provider) => {
102:       const path = AppState.getAvatar(provider);
103:       
104:       const el = document.getElementById(`avatar-${provider}`);
105:       if (!el) return;
106:       
107:       if (!path || !window.electronAPI?.readFile) {
108:         el.textContent = "";
109:         return;
110:       }
111:       
112:       window.electronAPI.readFile(path)
113:         .then((data) => {
114:           if (!data) {
115:             el.textContent = "";
116:             return;
117:           }
118:           const mime = getMimeTypeFromPath(path);
119:           el.innerHTML = `<img src="data:${mime};base64,${data}" alt="${provider} avatar" class="img-cover" />`;
120:         })
121:         .catch(() => {
122:           el.textContent = "";
123:         });
124:     });
125:   }
126: 
127:   applyNames() {
128:     const nickAi1 = AppState.getNickname("ai1");
129:     const nickAi2 = AppState.getNickname("ai2");
130: 
131:     const nameAi1 = document.getElementById("name-ai1");
132:     const nameAi2 = document.getElementById("name-ai2");
133:     if (nameAi1) nameAi1.textContent = nickAi1;
134:     if (nameAi2) nameAi2.textContent = nickAi2;
135: 
136:     const sendLabelAi1 = document.getElementById("send-ai1-label");
137:     const sendLabelAi2 = document.getElementById("send-ai2-label");
138:     if (sendLabelAi1) sendLabelAi1.textContent = nickAi1;
139:     if (sendLabelAi2) sendLabelAi2.textContent = nickAi2;
140: 
141:     const relayLabelAi1 = document.getElementById("relay-ai1-label");
142:     const relayLabelAi2 = document.getElementById("relay-ai2-label");
143:     if (relayLabelAi1) relayLabelAi1.textContent = nickAi1;
144:     if (relayLabelAi2) relayLabelAi2.textContent = nickAi2;
145: 
146:     const aiChatBtn = document.getElementById("ai-chat-start");
147:     if (aiChatBtn) {
148:       aiChatBtn.textContent = `${nickAi1} - ${nickAi2} Sohbet Başlat`;
149:     }
150:   }

155:   async updateConnectionStates() {
156:     const composeInput = document.getElementById("compose-input") as HTMLTextAreaElement | null;
157:     const uploadBtn = document.getElementById("upload-add-btn") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
158:     const sendBtn = document.getElementById("compose-send-btn") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
159:     if (composeInput) composeInput.disabled = false;
160:     if (uploadBtn) uploadBtn.disabled = false;
161:     if (sendBtn) sendBtn.disabled = false;
162: 
163:     const ai1Connected = SlotController.isConnected("ai1");
164:     const ai2Connected = SlotController.isConnected("ai2");
165:     const ai1HasAccount = !!AppState.getAccountForSlot("ai1");
166:     const ai2HasAccount = !!AppState.getAccountForSlot("ai2");
167: 
168:     ["ai1", "ai2"].forEach((slot) => {
169:       const hasAccount = slot === "ai1" ? ai1HasAccount : ai2HasAccount;
170:       const connected = slot === "ai1" ? ai1Connected : ai2Connected;
171: 
172:       this._updateSlotUI(slot, hasAccount, connected);
173:     });
174: 
175:     // Tek AI bağlıysa layout'u ayarla
176:     this._updateGridLayout(ai1Connected, ai2Connected);
177: 
178:     this._updateAIAIControls();
179:   }
180: 
181:   _updateSlotUI(slot: string, hasAccount: boolean, connected: boolean) {
182:     const card = document.getElementById(`card-${slot}`);
183:     const status = document.getElementById(`status-${slot}`);
184:     const sendToggle = document.getElementById(`send-${slot}`);
185:     const messageArea = document.getElementById(`${slot}-message-area`);
186:     const filterCount = document.getElementById(`filter-count-${slot}`);
187: 
188:     if (status) {
189:       if (!hasAccount) status.textContent = "Slot boş";
190:       else if (connected) status.textContent = "Bağlı";
191:       else status.textContent = "Bağlı değil";
192:     }
193: 
194:     if (card) {
195:       card.classList.toggle("slot-empty", !hasAccount);
196:       card.classList.toggle("slot-disconnected", hasAccount && !connected);
197:       card.classList.toggle("slot-connected", hasAccount && connected);
198:     }
199: 
200:     if (sendToggle) {
201:       (sendToggle as HTMLInputElement).disabled = !hasAccount || !connected;
202:       if (!hasAccount || !connected) (sendToggle as HTMLInputElement).checked = false;
203:     }
204: 
205:     if (messageArea) {
206:       messageArea.style.opacity = (!hasAccount || !connected) ? "0.5" : "1";
207:       messageArea.style.pointerEvents = (!hasAccount || !connected) ? "none" : "auto";
208:     }
209: 
210:     if (filterCount) {
211:       (filterCount as HTMLInputElement).disabled = !hasAccount || !connected;
212:     }
213:   }

215:   _updateGridLayout(ai1Connected: boolean, ai2Connected: boolean) {
216:     const grid = document.querySelector(".conversation-grid");
217:     const cardAi1 = document.getElementById("card-ai1");
218:     const cardAi2 = document.getElementById("card-ai2");
219:     
220:     if (!grid) return;
221:     
222:     const onlyAi1 = ai1Connected && !ai2Connected;
223:     const onlyAi2 = !ai1Connected && ai2Connected;
224:     const singleAi = onlyAi1 || onlyAi2;
225:     
226:     // Grid class'ını ayarla
227:     grid.classList.toggle("single-ai", singleAi);
228:     
229:     // Bağlı olmayan kartı gizle
230:     if (cardAi1) cardAi1.classList.toggle("hidden-slot", onlyAi2);
231:     if (cardAi2) cardAi2.classList.toggle("hidden-slot", onlyAi1);
232:   }
233: 
234:   _updateAIAIControls() {
235:     const ai1Assigned = !!AppState.getAccountForSlot("ai1");
236:     const ai2Assigned = !!AppState.getAccountForSlot("ai2");
237:     const ai1Connected = SlotController.isConnected("ai1");
238:     const ai2Connected = SlotController.isConnected("ai2");
239:     const bothAIsConnected = ai1Connected && ai2Connected;
240:     const aiChatEnabled = ai1Assigned && ai2Assigned && bothAIsConnected;
241: 
242:     const aiChatBtn = document.getElementById("ai-chat-start") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
243:     if (aiChatBtn) aiChatBtn.disabled = !aiChatEnabled;
244: 
245:     const relayRadioAi1 = document.querySelector('input[name="relay-starter"][value="ai1"]') as HTMLInputElement | null;
246:     const relayRadioAi2 = document.querySelector('input[name="relay-starter"][value="ai2"]') as HTMLInputElement | null;
247:     if (relayRadioAi1) relayRadioAi1.disabled = !aiChatEnabled;
248:     if (relayRadioAi2) relayRadioAi2.disabled = !aiChatEnabled;
249: 
250:     const analyzeBtn = document.getElementById("compose-start-btn") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
251:     if (analyzeBtn) analyzeBtn.disabled = !aiChatEnabled;
252: 
253:     this._updateCrossCheckboxState();
254:   }

259:   bindActions() {
260:     // Guard: Event listener'ları sadece bir kez bağla
261:     if (this._boundActions) return;
262:     this._boundActions = true;
263: 
264:     document.getElementById("ai-chat-start")?.addEventListener("click", () => this.handleAIAIControl());
265:     document.getElementById("compose-start-btn")?.addEventListener("click", () => this.handleAnalyzeStart());
266:     document.getElementById("compose-send-btn")?.addEventListener("click", () => this.handleSend());
267:     document.getElementById("upload-add-btn")?.addEventListener("click", () => this.handleUploadClick());
268:     document.getElementById("filter-count-ai1")?.addEventListener("change", () => this._renderMessages("ai1"));
269:     document.getElementById("filter-count-ai2")?.addEventListener("change", () => this._renderMessages("ai2"));
270:     document.getElementById("compose-input")?.addEventListener("input", () => this.updateSendButtonState());
271:     
272:     // Ctrl+Enter ile mesaj gönderme
273:     document.getElementById("compose-input")?.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
274:       if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === "Enter") {
275:         e.preventDefault();
276:         this.handleSend();
277:       }
278:     });
279:     
280:     ["send-ai1", "send-ai2", "send-cross"].forEach((id) => {
281:       document.getElementById(id)?.addEventListener("change", () => this.updateSendButtonState());
282:     });
283:   }

288:   async _renderMessages(provider: "ai1" | "ai2") {
289:     const result = await renderMessages(provider, {
290:       onContextMenu: (e: MouseEvent, payload: any) => showContextMenu(e, payload, () => this.updateSendButtonState()),
291:       onDoubleClick: (payload: any) => showReadModal(payload),
292:     });
293:     this.lastMessages[provider] = result.lastMessage;
294:   }

303:   async handleUploadClick() {
304:     const btn = document.getElementById("upload-add-btn") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
305:     if (btn?.disabled) return;
306:     if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
307:     
308:     try {
309:       this.stagedFiles = await addUploadFiles(this.stagedFiles);
310:       this._renderUploadList();
311:     } finally {
312:       if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
313:     }
314:   }
315: 
316:   _renderUploadList() {
317:     renderUploadList(this.stagedFiles, (name) => {
318:       this.stagedFiles = removeUploadFile(this.stagedFiles, name);
319:       this._renderUploadList();
320:     });
321:     this.updateSendButtonState();
322:   }

327:   async _initDraftSystem() {
328:     await initDraft();
329:     const draft = await loadDraft();
330:     
331:     const textarea = document.getElementById("compose-input") as HTMLTextAreaElement | null;
332:     if (textarea) textarea.value = draft.message;
333:     this.stagedFiles = draft.files;
334:     this._renderUploadList();
335: 
336:     this.beforeUnloadHandler = () => this._persistDraft();
337:     window.addEventListener("beforeunload", this.beforeUnloadHandler);
338:   }

340:   _persistDraft() {
341:     const composeInput = document.getElementById("compose-input") as HTMLTextAreaElement | null;
342:     const message = composeInput ? composeInput.value : "";
343:     persistDraft(message, this.stagedFiles);
344:   }

349:   handleSend() {
350:     const msg = ((document.getElementById("compose-input") as HTMLTextAreaElement | null)?.value || "").trim();
351:     const hasFiles = this.stagedFiles.length > 0;
352:     const sendAi1 = (document.getElementById("send-ai1") as HTMLInputElement | null)?.checked;
353:     const sendAi2 = (document.getElementById("send-ai2") as HTMLInputElement | null)?.checked;
354:     const cross = (document.getElementById("send-cross") as HTMLInputElement | null)?.checked;
355:     const sendBtn = document.getElementById("compose-send-btn") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
356: 
357:     if ((!sendAi1 && !sendAi2) || (!msg && !hasFiles)) return;
358: 
359:     // Loading state
360:     if (sendBtn) {
361:       ButtonStates.setLoading(sendBtn, "Gönderiliyor...");
362:     }
363: 
364:     LogManager.addEvent("analyze", "info", "Gönderim başlatılıyor", { visibility: 2 });
365: 
366:     const targets: string[] = [];
367:     const textByProvider: Record<string, string> = {};
368:     const archiveFolders: Record<string, string> = {};
369: 
370:     if (sendAi1) {
371:       let text = msg;
372:       if (cross && sendAi2) {
373:         const otherName = AppState.getNickname("ai2");
374:         const otherMsg = (this.lastMessages.ai2 || "").trim();
375:         text = otherMsg ? `${otherName} : ${otherMsg} | ${msg}` : msg;
376:       }
377:       textByProvider.ai1 = text;
378:       targets.push("ai1");
379:       archiveFolders.ai1 = this._getConversationFolder("ai1");
380:     }
381: 
382:     if (sendAi2) {
383:       let text = msg;
384:       if (cross && sendAi1) {
385:         const otherName = AppState.getNickname("ai1");
386:         const otherMsg = (this.lastMessages.ai1 || "").trim();
387:         text = otherMsg ? `${otherName} : ${otherMsg} | ${msg}` : msg;
388:       }
389:       textByProvider.ai2 = text;
390:       targets.push("ai2");
391:       archiveFolders.ai2 = this._getConversationFolder("ai2");
392:     }
393: 
394:     const texts = targets.map((p) => textByProvider[p] || msg);
395:     const allSame = texts.every((t) => t === texts[0]);
396:     const attachList = [...this.stagedFiles];
397: 
398:     const sendFlow = async () => {
399:       try {
400:         if (allSame) {
401:           await CoreEngine.sendBatch({ targets, text: texts[0], attachments: attachList, page: "analyze", archiveFolders });
402:         } else {
403:           for (const provider of targets) {
404:             await CoreEngine.sendBatch({ targets: [provider], text: textByProvider[provider], attachments: attachList, page: "analyze", archiveFolders });
405:           }
406:         }
407:         // Success state
408:         if (sendBtn) {
409:           ButtonStates.setSuccess(sendBtn, "Gönderildi!", 1500);
410:         }
411:         LogManager.addEvent("analyze", "success", "Mesaj gönderildi", { visibility: 1 });
412:       } catch (error) {
413:         // Error state
414:         if (sendBtn) {
415:           ButtonStates.setError(sendBtn, "Hata!", 1500);
416:         }
417:         LogManager.addEvent("analyze", "error", `Gönderim hatası: ${error}`, { visibility: 1 });
418:       }
419:     };
420: 
421:     sendFlow().finally(() => {
422:       this.stagedFiles = [];
423:       this._renderUploadList();
424:       const composeInput = document.getElementById("compose-input") as HTMLTextAreaElement | null;
425:       if (composeInput) composeInput.value = "";
426:       
427:       // Reset button after animation completes
428:       setTimeout(() => this.updateSendButtonState(), 1600);
429:     });
430:   }
431: 
432:   async handleAnalyzeStart() {
433:     const targets = this._getConnectedAIs();
434:     if (!targets.length) {
435:       LogManager.addEvent("analyze", "warning", "Analiz protokolü gönderilemedi: bağlı AI yok");
436:       return;
437:     }
438:     await CoreEngine.sendProtocol({
439:       room: "analyze",
440:       scenario: "user-ai-ai",
441:       targets,
442:       mode: targets.length >= 2 ? "aiRelay" : "normal",
443:     });
444:   }
445: 
446:   async handleAIAIControl() {
447:     const targets = this._getConnectedAIs();
448:     const btn = document.getElementById("ai-chat-start");
449:     const nickAi1 = AppState.getNickname("ai1");
450:     const nickAi2 = AppState.getNickname("ai2");
451: 
452:     if (targets.length < 2) {
453:       LogManager.addEvent("analyze", "warning", "AI-AI başlatılamadı: iki AI bağlı değil");
454:       return;
455:     }
456: 
457:     const relayActive = !!(CoreEngine.relay?.isActive?.());
458: 
459:     if (relayActive) {
460:       await CoreEngine.sendProtocol({ room: "analyze", scenario: "ai-ai-stop", targets });
461:       if (btn) btn.textContent = `${nickAi1} - ${nickAi2} Sohbet Başlat`;
462:       return;
463:     }
464: 
465:     const starter = (document.querySelector('input[name="relay-starter"]:checked') as HTMLInputElement | null)?.value || "ai1";
466:     await CoreEngine.sendProtocol({ room: "analyze", scenario: "ai-ai", targets, mode: "aiRelaySequential", context: { starter } });
467:     if (btn) btn.textContent = `${nickAi1} - ${nickAi2} Sohbet Bitir`;
468:   }
469: 
470:   // ============================================
471:   // ============================================
472: 
473:   updateSendButtonState() {
474:     const btn = document.getElementById("compose-send-btn") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
475:     if (!btn) return;
476: 
477:     const sendAi1 = (document.getElementById("send-ai1") as HTMLInputElement | null)?.checked;
478:     const sendAi2 = (document.getElementById("send-ai2") as HTMLInputElement | null)?.checked;
479:     const hasTarget = sendAi1 || sendAi2;
480:     const message = ((document.getElementById("compose-input") as HTMLTextAreaElement | null)?.value || "").trim();
481:     const hasContent = message || this.stagedFiles.length > 0;
482: 
483:     btn.disabled = !hasTarget || !hasContent;
484:     this._updateCrossCheckboxState();
485:   }
486: 
487:   _updateCrossCheckboxState() {
488:     const cross = document.getElementById("send-cross") as HTMLInputElement | null;
489:     const sendAi1 = document.getElementById("send-ai1") as HTMLInputElement | null;
490:     const sendAi2 = document.getElementById("send-ai2") as HTMLInputElement | null;
491: 
492:     if (cross && sendAi1 && sendAi2) {
493:       const bothChecked = sendAi1.checked && sendAi2.checked;
494:       cross.disabled = !bothChecked;
495:       if (!bothChecked) cross.checked = false;
496:     }
497:   }
498: 
499:   // ============================================
500:   // ============================================
501: 
502:   _setupRelayListener() {
503:     try {
504:       window.addEventListener("relay-changed", (e) => {
505:         const btn = document.getElementById("ai-chat-start");
506:         const nickAi1 = AppState.getNickname("ai1");
507:         const nickAi2 = AppState.getNickname("ai2");
508:         if (!btn) return;
509:         const detail = (e as CustomEvent).detail;
510:         const active = !!detail?.active;
511:         btn.textContent = active ? `${nickAi1} - ${nickAi2} Sohbet Bitir` : `${nickAi1} - ${nickAi2} Sohbet Başlat`;
512:       });
513:     } catch (_e) { /* noop */ }
514:   }
515: 
516:   _getConnectedAIs() {
517:     const list = [];
518:     if (SlotController.isConnected("ai1")) list.push("ai1");
519:     if (SlotController.isConnected("ai2")) list.push("ai2");
520:     return list;
521:   }
522: 
523:   _getConversationFolder(provider: string) {
524:     const select = document.getElementById(`conversation-${provider}`) as HTMLSelectElement | null;
525:     if (!select) {
526:       return "";
527:     }
528:     const opt = select.selectedOptions?.[0];
529:     if (!opt || opt.value === "new") {
530:       return "";
531:     }
532:     return opt.dataset?.folder || "";
533:   }
534: 
535:   // ============================================
536:   // ============================================
537: 
538:   async onShow() {
539:     await this.refreshUploads();
540:     this.updateSendButtonState();
541:   }
542: 
543:   onHide() {
544:     try {
545:       this._persistDraft();
546:     } catch (_) { /* noop */ }
547: 
548:     if (this.beforeUnloadHandler) {
549:       window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", this.beforeUnloadHandler);
550:       this.beforeUnloadHandler = null;
551:     }
552:   }
553: }

 1: import { BrowserWindow } from "electron";

   1: /**
   2:  * OpenCode Manager
   3:  * 
   4:  * OpenCode serve subprocess yönetimi
   5:  * - Server başlatma/durdurma
   6:  * - Port kontrolü
   7:  * - Graceful shutdown
   8:  * - Process state tracking
   9:  * 
  10:  * Config değerleri: src/js/modules/webview/providers/opencode/config.js
  11:  */
  12: 
  13: import { spawn } from "child_process";
  14: import { OPENCODE_DEFAULTS } from "./opencode-config.ts";
  15: import { eventParser, type NativeUIEvent } from "./opencode-event-parser.ts";
  16: 
  17: // ===========================================================================
  18: // ID Generation (adapted from CodeNomad's session-actions.ts)
  19: // ===========================================================================
  20: 
  21: const ID_LENGTH = 26;
  22: const BASE62_CHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz";
  23: 
  24: let _lastTimestamp = 0;
  25: let _localCounter = 0;
  26: 
  27: /**
  28:  * Generate random base62 string
  29:  */
  30: function randomBase62(length: number): string {
  31:   let result = "";
  32:   const cryptoObj = globalThis.crypto;
  33:   if (cryptoObj && typeof cryptoObj.getRandomValues === "function") {
  34:     const bytes = new Uint8Array(length);
  35:     cryptoObj.getRandomValues(bytes);
  36:     for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
  37:       result += BASE62_CHARS[bytes[i] % BASE62_CHARS.length];
  38:     }
  39:   } else {
  40:     for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
  41:       const idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * BASE62_CHARS.length);
  42:       result += BASE62_CHARS[idx];
  43:     }
  44:   }
  45:   return result;
  46: }
  47: 
  48: /**
  49:  * Create a unique, sortable ID with prefix
  50:  * Format: prefix_timestamp(hex)_random
  51:  */
  52: function createId(prefix: string): string {
  53:   const timestamp = Date.now();
  54:   if (timestamp !== _lastTimestamp) {
  55:     _lastTimestamp = timestamp;
  56:     _localCounter = 0;
  57:   }
  58:   _localCounter++;
  59: 
  60:   const value = (BigInt(timestamp) << BigInt(12)) + BigInt(_localCounter);
  61:   const bytes = new Array<number>(6);
  62:   for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
  63:     const shift = BigInt(8 * (5 - i));
  64:     bytes[i] = Number((value >> shift) & BigInt(0xff));
  65:   }
  66:   const hex = bytes.map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  67:   const random = randomBase62(ID_LENGTH - 12);
  68: 
  69:   return `${prefix}_${hex}${random}`;
  70: }
  71: 
  72: // Timeout değerleri
  73: const STARTUP_TIMEOUT = 30000; // 30 saniye (server başlatma için)
  74: const SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT = 10000; // 10 saniye (server kapatma için)
  75: const API_TIMEOUT = 60000; // 60 saniye (API istekleri için)

 110: export const OpenCodeManager = {
 111:   _process: null as import("child_process").ChildProcess | null,
 112:   _eventSource: null as EventSource | null,
 113:   _eventCallback: null as ((event: NativeUIEvent) => void) | null,
 114: 
 115:   _state: {
 116:     running: false,
 117:     pid: null,
 118:     port: OPENCODE_DEFAULTS.port,
 119:     projectPath: null,
 120:     error: null,
 121:     sessionId: null,
 122:     connected: false,
 123:     authHeader: null,
 124:   } as OpenCodeState,
 125: 
 126:   _statusListeners: [] as Array<(state: OpenCodeState) => void>,
 127:

 129:   // Public API

 131: 
 132:   /**
 133:    * OpenCode server'ı başlat
 134:    */
 135:   async start(options: OpenCodeOptions = {}): Promise<{
 136:     success: boolean;
 137:     url?: string;
 138:     error?: string;
 139:     alreadyRunning?: boolean;
 140:     existingServer?: boolean;
 141:   }> {
 142:     const port = options.port || OPENCODE_DEFAULTS.port;
 143:     const cors = options.cors || OPENCODE_DEFAULTS.cors;
 144:     const projectPath = options.projectPath || null;
 145: 
 146:     // Zaten çalışıyorsa
 147:     if (this._process && this._state.running) {
 148:       console.log("[OPENCODE]", "warn", "Server zaten çalışıyor", { pid: this._state.pid });
 149:       return {
 150:         success: true,
 151:         url: this._getProjectUrl(projectPath, port),
 152:         alreadyRunning: true,
 153:       };
 154:     }
 155: 
 156:     try {
 157:       // Port kontrolü - eğer port kullanımdaysa farklı port dene
 158:       let actualPort = port;
 159:       const portInUse = await this._isPortInUse(port);
 160:       if (portInUse) {
 161:         // Port kullanımda - farklı bir port bul (auth sorunlarından kaçınmak için kendi server'ımızı başlat)
 162:         console.log("[OPENCODE]", "warn", `Port ${port} kullanımda, alternatif port aranıyor...`);
 163:         
 164:         // 4096'dan başlayarak boş port bul
 165:         for (let testPort = port + 1; testPort < port + 100; testPort++) {
 166:           const inUse = await this._isPortInUse(testPort);
 167:           if (!inUse) {
 168:             actualPort = testPort;
 169:             console.log("[OPENCODE]", "info", `Alternatif port bulundu: ${actualPort}`);
 170:             break;
 171:           }
 172:         }
 173:         
 174:         if (actualPort === port) {
 175:           throw new Error(`Port ${port} ve sonraki 100 port kullanımda`);
 176:         }
 177:       }
 178: 
 179:       // Server'ı başlat (kendi auth bilgilerimizle)
 180:       await this._spawnServer(actualPort, cors);
 181:       
 182:       // Server hazır olana kadar bekle
 183:       await this._waitForServer(actualPort);
 184:       
 185:       this._state.running = true;
 186:       this._state.port = actualPort;
 187:       this._state.projectPath = projectPath;
 188:       this._state.error = null;
 189:       
 190:       const url = this._getProjectUrl(projectPath, actualPort);
 191:       console.log("[OPENCODE]", "info", "Server başlatıldı", { port: actualPort, url, pid: this._state.pid, authEnabled: !!this._state.authHeader });
 192:       
 193:       this._notifyListeners();
 194:       
 195:       return { success: true, url };
 196:     } catch (error: unknown) {
 197:       this._state.error = (error as Error).message;
 198:       console.log("[OPENCODE]", "error", "Server başlatılamadı", { error: (error as Error).message });
 199:       return { success: false, error: (error as Error).message };
 200:     }
 201:   },
 202: 
 203:   /**
 204:    * OpenCode server'ı durdur
 205:    * @returns {Promise<{success: boolean, error?: string, alreadyStopped?: boolean}>}
 206:    */
 207:   async stop() {
 208:     if (!this._process) {
 209:       console.log("[OPENCODE]", "debug", "Server zaten çalışmıyor");
 210:       this._resetState();
 211:       return { success: true, alreadyStopped: true };
 212:     }
 213: 
 214:     try {
 215:       await this._killProcess();
 216:       this._resetState();
 217:       console.log("[OPENCODE]", "info", "Server durduruldu");
 218:       this._notifyListeners();
 219:       return { success: true };
 220:     } catch (error: unknown) {
 221:       console.log("[OPENCODE]", "error", "Server durdurulamadı", { error: (error as Error).message });
 222:       return { success: false, error: (error as Error).message };
 223:     }
 224:   },
 225: 
 226:   /**
 227:    * Server durumunu al
 228:    * @returns {OpenCodeState}
 229:    */
 230:   getStatus() {
 231:     return { ...this._state };
 232:   },
 233: 
 234:   /**
 235:    * Durum değişikliği dinleyicisi ekle
 236:    * @param {Function} callback
 237:    */
 238:   onStatusChange(callback: (state: OpenCodeState) => void) {
 239:     this._statusListeners.push(callback);
 240:   },
 241: 
 242:   /**
 243:    * Dinleyiciyi kaldır
 244:    * @param {Function} callback
 245:    */
 246:   removeStatusListener(callback: (state: OpenCodeState) => void) {
 247:     this._statusListeners = this._statusListeners.filter(cb => cb !== callback);
 248:   },
 249: 
 250:   /**
 251:    * Uygulama kapanırken çağrılacak cleanup
 252:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
 253:    */
 254:   async cleanup() {
 255:     console.log("[OPENCODE]", "info", "Cleanup başlatılıyor...");
 256:     this._disconnectEventSource();
 257:     await this.stop();
 258:   },

 266:    */
 267:   _getApiUrl(): string {

 269:   },

 271:   // =========================================================================
 272:   // Auth Helper
 273:   // =========================================================================
 274: 
 275:   /**
 276:    * Get headers for API requests including auth
 277:    */
 278:   _getHeaders(contentType = "application/json"): Record<string, string> {
 279:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
 280:       "Content-Type": contentType,
 281:     };
 282:     
 283:     if (this._state.authHeader) {
 284:       headers["Authorization"] = this._state.authHeader;
 285:     }
 286:     
 287:     return headers;
 288:   },
 289: 
 290:   /**
 291:    * Get headers for SSE connections
 292:    */
 293:   _getSSEHeaders(): Record<string, string> {
 294:     const headers: Record<string, string> = {
 295:       "Accept": "text/event-stream",
 296:     };
 297:     
 298:     if (this._state.authHeader) {
 299:       headers["Authorization"] = this._state.authHeader;
 300:     }
 301:     
 302:     return headers;
 303:   },
