 305:   // =========================================================================
 306:   // Config API (Providers & Models)
 307:   // =========================================================================
 308: 
 309:   /**
 310:    * Provider ve model listesini OpenCode server'dan al
 311:    * Endpoint: GET /config -> providers objesi
 312:    */
 313:   async getProviders(): Promise<ApiResponse<{
 314:     providers: Array<{
 315:       id: string;
 316:       name: string;
 317:       models: Record<string, {
 318:         name: string;
 319:         limit?: { context?: number; output?: number };
 320:         cost?: { input?: number; output?: number };
 321:       }>;
 322:     }>;
 323:     default?: Record<string, string>;
 324:   }>> {
 325:     try {
 326:       // /config/providers endpoint'inden provider ve model listesini al
 327:       const headers = this._getHeaders();
 328:       
 329:       // DEBUG: Auth header kontrolü
 330:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "debug", "getProviders request", {
 331:         url: `${this._getApiUrl()}/config/providers`,
 332:         hasAuthHeader: !!headers["Authorization"],
 333:         authHeaderPreview: headers["Authorization"]?.substring(0, 20) + "...",
 334:       });
 335:       
 336:       const response = await fetch(`${this._getApiUrl()}/config/providers`, {
 337:         method: "GET",
 338:         headers,
 339:         signal: AbortSignal.timeout(API_TIMEOUT),
 340:       });
 341: 
 342:       if (!response.ok) {
 343:         // 401 Unauthorized ise auth header eksik olabilir
 344:         if (response.status === 401) {
 345:           console.warn("[OPENCODE-API]", "warn", "getProviders unauthorized - auth may be required");
 346:           return { success: false, error: "Unauthorized - auth required" };
 347:         }
 348:         const errorText = await response.text();
 349:         console.error("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "getProviders failed", { status: response.status, error: errorText });
 350:         return { success: false, error: `HTTP ${response.status}: ${errorText}` };
 351:       }
 352: 
 353:       // Response'un JSON olduğundan emin ol
 354:       const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');
 355:       if (!contentType || !contentType.includes('application/json')) {
 356:         console.error("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "getProviders returned non-JSON", { contentType });
 357:         return { success: false, error: "Server returned non-JSON response" };
 358:       }
 359: 
 360:       // /config.providers endpoint'i providers array'i ve default map'i döndürüyor
 361:       const rawData = await response.json() as {
 362:         providers: Array<{
 363:           id: string;
 364:           name: string;
 365:           models: Record<string, {
 366:             name: string;
 367:             limit?: { context?: number; output?: number };
 368:             cost?: { input?: number; output?: number };
 369:           }>;
 370:         }>;
 371:         default?: Record<string, string>;
 372:       };
 373:       
 374:       // DEBUG: Raw response'u logla
 375:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "debug", "Raw config.providers response", { 
 376:         providersCount: rawData?.providers?.length || 0,
 377:         defaultKeys: Object.keys(rawData?.default || {}),
 378:         firstProvider: rawData?.providers?.[0]?.id,
 379:       });
 380:       
 381:       // Providers zaten array formatında, models'ları düzelt
 382:       const providers = (rawData.providers || []).map(provider => {
 383:         const models: Record<string, {
 384:           name: string;
 385:           limit?: { context?: number; output?: number };
 386:           cost?: { input?: number; output?: number };
 387:         }> = {};
 388:         
 389:         if (provider.models) {
 390:           for (const [modelKey, modelValue] of Object.entries(provider.models)) {
 391:             models[modelKey] = {
 392:               name: modelValue.name || modelKey,
 393:               limit: modelValue.limit,
 394:               cost: modelValue.cost,
 395:             };
 396:           }
 397:         }
 398:         
 399:         return {
 400:           id: provider.id,
 401:           name: provider.name,
 402:           models,
 403:         };
 404:       });
 405:       
 406:       const data = {
 407:         providers,
 408:         default: rawData.default,
 409:       };
 410:       
 411:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "info", "Providers fetched", { 
 412:         providerCount: providers.length,
 413:         modelCount: providers.reduce((sum, p) => sum + Object.keys(p.models || {}).length, 0)
 414:       });
 415:       
 416:       return { success: true, data };
 417:     } catch (err) {
 418:       const errorMessage = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
 419:       console.error("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "getProviders error", { error: errorMessage });
 420:       return { success: false, error: errorMessage };
 421:     }
 422:   },
 423: 
 424:   /**
 425:    * Agent listesini OpenCode server'dan al
 426:    * Endpoint: GET /app.agents
 427:    */
 428:   async getAgents(): Promise<ApiResponse<Array<{ name: string; description?: string }>>> {
 429:     try {
 430:       // /agent endpoint'inden agent listesini al
 431:       const response = await fetch(`${this._getApiUrl()}/agent`, {
 432:         method: "GET",
 433:         headers: this._getHeaders(),
 434:         signal: AbortSignal.timeout(API_TIMEOUT),
 435:       });
 436: 
 437:       if (!response.ok) {
 438:         if (response.status === 401) {
 439:           console.warn("[OPENCODE-API]", "warn", "getAgents unauthorized");
 440:           return { success: false, error: "Unauthorized" };
 441:         }
 442:         const errorText = await response.text();
 443:         console.error("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "getAgents failed", { status: response.status, error: errorText });
 444:         return { success: false, error: `HTTP ${response.status}: ${errorText}` };
 445:       }
 446: 
 447:       // Response'un JSON olduğundan emin ol
 448:       const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');
 449:       if (!contentType || !contentType.includes('application/json')) {
 450:         console.error("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "getAgents returned non-JSON");
 451:         return { success: false, error: "Server returned non-JSON response" };
 452:       }
 453: 
 454:       // /app.agents endpoint'i direkt array döndürüyor
 455:       const rawData = await response.json() as Array<{ 
 456:         name: string; 
 457:         description?: string;
 458:         mode?: string;
 459:         model?: { providerID?: string; modelID?: string };
 460:       }>;
 461:       
 462:       const data = (rawData || []).map(agent => ({
 463:         name: agent.name,
 464:         description: agent.description || '',
 465:       }));
 466:       
 467:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "info", "Agents fetched", { count: data.length });
 468:       
 469:       return { success: true, data };
 470:     } catch (err) {
 471:       const errorMessage = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
 472:       console.error("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "getAgents error", { error: errorMessage });
 473:       return { success: false, error: errorMessage };
 474:     }
 475:   },
 476: 
 477:   // =========================================================================
 478:   // Session API  
 479:   // =========================================================================
 480: 
 481:   /**
 482:    * Session listesini al
 483:    */
 484:   async getSessions(): Promise<ApiResponse<OpenCodeSession[]>> {
 485:     try {
 486:       const response = await fetch(`${this._getApiUrl()}/session`, {
 487:         method: "GET",
 488:         headers: this._getHeaders(),
 489:         signal: AbortSignal.timeout(API_TIMEOUT),
 490:       });
 491: 
 492:       if (!response.ok) {
 493:         throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
 494:       }
 495: 
 496:       const data = await response.json() as { sessions?: OpenCodeSession[] };
 497:       return { success: true, data: data.sessions || (data as unknown as OpenCodeSession[]) };
 498:     } catch (err) {
 499:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "getSessions hatası", { error: (err as Error).message });
 500:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
 501:     }
 502:   },
 503: 
 504:   /**
 505:    * Yeni session oluştur veya mevcut session'a bağlan
 506:    */
 507:   async createOrGetSession(path?: string): Promise<ApiResponse<OpenCodeSession>> {
 508:     try {
 509:       // Önce mevcut session'ları kontrol et
 510:       const sessionsResult = await this.getSessions();
 511:       if (sessionsResult.success && sessionsResult.data && sessionsResult.data.length > 0) {
 512:         // Path'e göre eşleşen session bul
 513:         const targetPath = path || process.cwd();
 514:         const existingSession = sessionsResult.data.find(s => s.path === targetPath);
 515:         
 516:         if (existingSession) {
 517:           console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "info", "Mevcut session bulundu", { id: existingSession.id });
 518:           this._state.sessionId = existingSession.id;
 519:           return { success: true, data: existingSession };
 520:         }
 521:       }
 522: 
 523:       // Yeni session oluştur
 524:       const response = await fetch(`${this._getApiUrl()}/session`, {
 525:         method: "POST",
 526:         headers: this._getHeaders(),
 527:         body: JSON.stringify({ path: path || process.cwd() }),
 528:         signal: AbortSignal.timeout(API_TIMEOUT),
 529:       });
 530: 
 531:       if (!response.ok) {
 532:         throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
 533:       }
 534: 
 535:       const data = await response.json() as { session?: OpenCodeSession };
 536:       const session = data.session || (data as unknown as OpenCodeSession);
 537:       this._state.sessionId = session.id;
 538:       
 539:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "info", "Yeni session oluşturuldu", { id: session.id });
 540:       return { success: true, data: session };
 541:     } catch (err) {
 542:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "createOrGetSession hatası", { error: (err as Error).message });
 543:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
 544:     }
 545:   },
 546: 
 547:   /**
 548:    * Mesaj gönder (async - streaming response için)
 549:    * OpenCode API formatı: { messageID, parts: [{ id, type: "text", text: "..." }] }
 550:    * CodeNomad pattern: messageID ve partID client-side üretilir
 551:    */
 552:   async sendMessage(message: string, sessionId?: string, messageId?: string): Promise<ApiResponse<{ messageId: string }>> {
 553:     let sid = sessionId || this._state.sessionId;
 554:     
 555:     // Session yoksa otomatik oluştur
 556:     if (!sid) {
 557:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "info", "Session yok, otomatik oluşturuluyor...");
 558:       const sessionResult = await this.createOrGetSession();
 559:       if (!sessionResult.success || !sessionResult.data?.id) {
 560:         return { success: false, error: "Session oluşturulamadı: " + (sessionResult.error || "Bilinmeyen hata") };
 561:       }
 562:       sid = sessionResult.data.id;
 563:       this._state.sessionId = sid;
 564:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "info", "Session oluşturuldu", { sessionId: sid });
 565:     }
 566: 
 567:     try {
 568:       // Client-side ID üretimi (CodeNomad pattern)
 569:       const msgId = messageId || createId("msg");
 570:       const partId = createId("part");
 571:       
 572:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "debug", "Mesaj gönderiliyor", { 
 573:         sessionId: sid, 
 574:         messageId: msgId,
 575:         partId,
 576:         messageLength: message.length 
 577:       });
 578:       
 579:       // OpenCode API formatı: messageID + parts array (CodeNomad uyumlu)
 580:       // Not: model ve agent parametreleri OpenCode'un kendi config'inden alınır
 581:       const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
 582:         messageID: msgId,
 583:         parts: [
 584:           { id: partId, type: "text", text: message }
 585:         ],
 586:       };
 587:       
 588:       const response = await fetch(`${this._getApiUrl()}/session/${sid}/prompt_async`, {
 589:         method: "POST",
 590:         headers: this._getHeaders(),
 591:         body: JSON.stringify(body),
 592:         signal: AbortSignal.timeout(API_TIMEOUT),
 593:       });
 594: 
 595:       if (!response.ok) {
 596:         const errorText = await response.text();
 597:         throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText} - ${errorText}`);
 598:       }
 599: 
 600:       // prompt_async 204 No Content dönebilir - bu durumda client-side ID kullan
 601:       if (response.status === 204) {
 602:         console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "info", "Mesaj gönderildi (async)", { messageId: msgId });
 603:         return { success: true, data: { messageId: msgId } };
 604:       }
 605: 
 606:       const data = await response.json() as { messageId?: string; id?: string };
 607:       // Server ID döndürürse onu kullan, yoksa client-side ID
 608:       const finalMessageId = data.messageId || data.id || msgId;
 609:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "info", "Mesaj gönderildi", { messageId: finalMessageId });
 610:       
 611:       return { success: true, data: { messageId: finalMessageId } };
 612:     } catch (err) {
 613:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "sendMessage hatası", { error: (err as Error).message });
 614:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
 615:     }
 616:   },
 617: 
 618:   /**
 619:    * Permission isteğine yanıt ver
 620:    */
 621:   async respondToPermission(
 622:     permissionId: string,
 623:     approved: boolean,
 624:     sessionId?: string
 625:   ): Promise<ApiResponse<void>> {
 626:     const sid = sessionId || this._state.sessionId;
 627:     
 628:     if (!sid) {
 629:       return { success: false, error: "Session ID gerekli" };
 630:     }
 631: 
 632:     try {
 633:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "debug", "Permission yanıtı gönderiliyor", { 
 634:         sessionId: sid, 
 635:         permissionId, 
 636:         approved 
 637:       });
 638:       
 639:       const response = await fetch(`${this._getApiUrl()}/session/${sid}/permissions/${permissionId}`, {
 640:         method: "POST",
 641:         headers: this._getHeaders(),
 642:         body: JSON.stringify({ approved }),
 643:         signal: AbortSignal.timeout(API_TIMEOUT),
 644:       });
 645: 
 646:       if (!response.ok) {
 647:         throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
 648:       }
 649: 
 650:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "info", "Permission yanıtı gönderildi", { permissionId, approved });
 651:       return { success: true };
 652:     } catch (err) {
 653:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "respondToPermission hatası", { error: (err as Error).message });
 654:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
 655:     }
 656:   },
 657: 
 658:   /**
 659:    * Session'ı iptal et (mevcut işlemi durdur)
 660:    */
 661:   async cancelSession(sessionId?: string): Promise<ApiResponse<void>> {
 662:     const sid = sessionId || this._state.sessionId;
 663:     
 664:     if (!sid) {
 665:       return { success: false, error: "Session ID gerekli" };
 666:     }
 667: 
 668:     try {
 669:       const response = await fetch(`${this._getApiUrl()}/session/${sid}/cancel`, {
 670:         method: "POST",
 671:         headers: this._getHeaders(),
 672:         signal: AbortSignal.timeout(API_TIMEOUT),
 673:       });
 674: 
 675:       if (!response.ok) {
 676:         throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
 677:       }
 678: 
 679:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "info", "Session iptal edildi", { sessionId: sid });
 680:       return { success: true };
 681:     } catch (err) {
 682:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "cancelSession hatası", { error: (err as Error).message });
 683:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
 684:     }
 685:   },
 686: 
 687:   /**
 688:    * Session context'sıkıştır (compact)
 689:    * Token sayısını azaltmak için eski mesajları özetler
 690:    */
 691:   async compactSession(sessionId?: string): Promise<ApiResponse<{ tokens?: number }>> {
 692:     const sid = sessionId || this._state.sessionId;
 693:     
 694:     if (!sid) {
 695:       return { success: false, error: "Session ID gerekli" };
 696:     }
 697: 
 698:     try {
 699:       // OpenCode API'de compact endpoint'i varsa kullan
 700:       const response = await fetch(`${this._getApiUrl()}/session/${sid}/compact`, {
 701:         method: "POST",
 702:         headers: this._getHeaders(),
 703:         signal: AbortSignal.timeout(API_TIMEOUT),
 704:       });
 705: 
 706:       if (!response.ok) {
 707:         // Compact endpoint yoksa başarılı dön (opsiyonel özellik)
 708:         if (response.status === 404) {
 709:           console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "warn", "Compact endpoint bulunamadı");
 710:           return { success: true, data: { tokens: 0 } };
 711:         }
 712:         throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
 713:       }
 714: 
 715:       const data = await response.json() as { tokens?: number; compactedTokens?: number };
 716:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "info", "Session compact edildi", { sessionId: sid, tokens: data.tokens });
 717:       return { success: true, data: { tokens: data.tokens || data.compactedTokens || 0 } };
 718:     } catch (err) {
 719:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "compactSession hatası", { error: (err as Error).message });
 720:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
 721:     }
 722:   },
 723: 
 724:   /**
 725:    * Agent değiştir
 726:    */

 728:     if (!this._state.running) {
 729:       return { success: false, error: "OpenCode çalışmıyor" };

 731: 
 732:     try {

 734:       const response = await fetch(url, {
 735:         method: "POST",
 736:         headers: this._getHeaders(),
 737:         body: JSON.stringify({ name: agentName }),
 738:         signal: AbortSignal.timeout(API_TIMEOUT),
 739:       });
 740: 
 741:       if (!response.ok) {
 742:         const error = await response.text();
 743:         return { success: false, error: error || `HTTP ${response.status}` };
 744:       }
 745: 
 746:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "info", "Agent değiştirildi", { agent: agentName });
 747:       return { success: true };
 748:     } catch (err) {
 749:       console.log("[OPENCODE-API]", "error", "setAgent hatası", { error: (err as Error).message });
 750:       return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
 751:     }
 752:   },

 784:   // =========================================================================
 785:   // SSE Event Subscription
 786:   // =========================================================================
 787: 
 788:   /**
 789:    * OpenCode SSE event stream'ine bağlan
 790:    */
 791:   subscribeToEvents(callback: (event: NativeUIEvent) => void): void {
 792:     this._eventCallback = callback;
 793:     this._connectEventSource();
 794:   },
 795: 
 796:   /**
 797:    * Event subscription'ı durdur
 798:    */
 799:   unsubscribeFromEvents(): void {
 800:     this._eventCallback = null;
 801:     this._disconnectEventSource();
 802:   },
 803: 
 804:   /**
 805:    * EventSource bağlantısı kur
 806:    */
 807:   _connectEventSource(): void {
 808:     // Zaten bağlıysa veya bağlanıyorsa tekrar bağlanma
 809:     if (this._state.connected) {
 810:       console.log("[OPENCODE-SSE]", "debug", "SSE zaten bağlı, yeni bağlantı atlanıyor");
 811:       return;
 812:     }
 813:     
 814:     if (this._eventSource) {
 815:       console.log("[OPENCODE-SSE]", "debug", "Mevcut EventSource kapatılıyor");
 816:       this._disconnectEventSource();
 817:     }
 818: 
 819:     const url = `${this._getApiUrl()}/event`;
 820:     console.log("[OPENCODE-SSE]", "info", "SSE bağlantısı kuruluyor", { url });
 821: 
 822:     // Node.js'te EventSource yok, fetch ile SSE okuyacağız
 823:     this._startSSEReader(url);
 824:   },
 825: 
 826:   /**
 827:    * EventSource bağlantısını kapat
 828:    */
 829:   _disconnectEventSource(): void {
 830:     if (this._eventSource) {
 831:       // @ts-expect-error - custom abort controller
 832:       this._eventSource.abort?.();
 833:       this._eventSource = null;
 834:     }
 835:     this._state.connected = false;
 836:   },
 837: 
 838:   /**
 839:    * SSE stream okuyucu (Node.js uyumlu)
 840:    */
 841:   async _startSSEReader(url: string): Promise<void> {
 842:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 843:     // @ts-expect-error - store abort controller as eventSource
 844:     this._eventSource = { abort: () => abortController.abort() };
 845: 
 846:     try {
 847:       const response = await fetch(url, {
 848:         method: "GET",
 849:         headers: this._getSSEHeaders(),
 850:         signal: abortController.signal,
 851:       });
 852: 
 853:       if (!response.ok) {
 854:         throw new Error(`SSE bağlantısı başarısız: ${response.status}`);
 855:       }
 856: 
 857:       if (!response.body) {
 858:         throw new Error("Response body yok");
 859:       }
 860: 
 861:       this._state.connected = true;
 862:       console.log("[OPENCODE-SSE]", "info", "SSE bağlantısı kuruldu");
 863: 
 864:       const reader = response.body.getReader();
 865:       const decoder = new TextDecoder();
 866:       let buffer = "";
 867: 
 868:       while (true) {
 869:         const { done, value } = await reader.read();
 870:         
 871:         if (done) {
 872:           console.log("[OPENCODE-SSE]", "info", "SSE stream sona erdi");
 873:           break;
 874:         }
 875: 
 876:         buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
 877:         
 878:         // SSE standardı: \n\n ile ayrılmış event chunk'larını işle
 879:         // CodeNomad flushEvents pattern'i
 880:         buffer = this._flushSSEEvents(buffer);
 881:       }
 882:     } catch (err) {
 883:       if ((err as Error).name === "AbortError") {
 884:         console.log("[OPENCODE-SSE]", "debug", "SSE bağlantısı iptal edildi");
 885:       } else {
 886:         console.log("[OPENCODE-SSE]", "error", "SSE hatası", { error: (err as Error).message });
 887:       }
 888:     } finally {
 889:       this._state.connected = false;
 890:       this._eventSource = null;
 891:     }
 892:   },
 893: 
 894:   // =========================================================================
 895:   // Private Methods
 896:   // =========================================================================
 897: 
 898:   /**
 899:    * Server process'ini başlat
 900:    * @param {number} port
 901:    * @param {string} cors
 902:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
 903:    */
 904:   _spawnServer(port: number, cors: string): Promise<void> {
 905:     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 906:       // Generate a random password for this server instance
 907:       const serverPassword = randomBase62(32);
 908:       const username = "opencode";
 909:       
 910:       // Create Basic auth header
 911:       const credentials = Buffer.from(`${username}:${serverPassword}`).toString('base64');
 912:       this._state.authHeader = `Basic ${credentials}`;
 913:       
 914:       const args = ["serve", "--port", String(port), "--cors", cors];
 915:       
 916:       // Set password via environment variable
 917:       const env = {
 918:         ...process.env,
 919:         OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD: serverPassword,
 920:         OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME: username,
 921:       };
 922:       
 923:       console.log("[OPENCODE]", "debug", "Server başlatılıyor", { 
 924:         command: OPENCODE_DEFAULTS.command, 
 925:         args,
 926:         authEnabled: true 
 927:       });
 928:       
 929:       this._process = spawn(OPENCODE_DEFAULTS.command, args, {
 930:         stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
 931:         detached: false,
 932:         env,
 933:       });
 934: 
 935:       this._state.pid = this._process.pid ?? null;
 936: 
 937:       // Stdout log
 938:       this._process.stdout?.on("data", (data) => {
 939:         const output = data.toString().trim();
 940:         if (output) {
 941:           console.log("[OPENCODE-STDOUT]", "debug", output);
 942:         }
 943:       });
 944: 
 945:       // Stderr log
 946:       this._process.stderr?.on("data", (data) => {
 947:         const output = data.toString().trim();
 948:         if (output) {
 949:           console.log("[OPENCODE-STDERR]", "warn", output);
 950:         }
 951:       });
 952: 
 953:       // Process kapandığında
 954:       this._process.on("close", (code) => {
 955:         console.log("[OPENCODE]", "info", `Server process kapandı`, { code });
 956:         this._resetState();
 957:         this._notifyListeners();
 958:       });
 959: 
 960:       // Hata durumunda
 961:       this._process.on("error", (err) => {
 962:         console.log("[OPENCODE]", "error", "Process hatası", { error: (err as Error).message });
 963:         this._state.error = (err as Error).message;
 964:         reject(err);
 965:       });
 966: 
 967:       // Spawn başarılı
 968:       resolve(undefined);
 969:     });
 970:   },
 971: 
 972:   /**
 973:    * Server'ın hazır olmasını bekle
 974:    * @param {number} port
 975:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
 976:    */
 977:   async _waitForServer(port: number) {
 978:     const startTime = Date.now();
 979:     // OpenCode server 127.0.0.1'de dinliyor
 980:     const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`;
 981:     
 982:     while (Date.now() - startTime < STARTUP_TIMEOUT) {
 983:       try {
 984:         const response = await fetch(url, { 
 985:           method: "GET", 
 986:           signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2000) 
 987:         });
 988:         // Herhangi bir yanıt aldıysak server hazır demektir
 989:         // Status 200, 404, 405 vb. olabilir - önemli olan yanıt vermesi
 990:         console.log("[OPENCODE]", "debug", "Server yanıt verdi", { status: response.status });
 991:         return;
 992:       } catch (err: unknown) {
 993:         // Connection refused veya timeout - henüz hazır değil
 994:         console.log("[OPENCODE]", "debug", "Server henüz hazır değil, bekleniyor...");
 995:       }
 996:       await this._sleep(500);
 997:     }
 998:     
 999:     throw new Error(`Server ${STARTUP_TIMEOUT}ms içinde başlamadı`);
1000:   },
1001: 
1002:   /**
1003:    * Port'un kullanımda olup olmadığını kontrol et
1004:    * @param {number} port
1005:    * @returns {Promise<boolean>}
1006:    */
1007:   async _isPortInUse(port: number) {
1008:     try {
1009:       await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`, { 
1010:         method: "GET", 
1011:         signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1000) 
1012:       });
1013:       return true; // Yanıt aldık, port kullanımda
1014:     } catch {
1015:       return false; // Bağlantı başarısız, port boş
1016:     }
1017:   },
1018: 
1019:   /**
1020:    * Process'i öldür
1021:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
1022:    */
1023:   _killProcess(): Promise<void> {
1024:     return new Promise((resolve, _reject) => {
1025:       if (!this._process) {
1026:         resolve(undefined);
1027:         return;
1028:       }
1029: 
1030:       const pid = this._process.pid;
1031:       let resolved = false;
1032:       
1033:       const cleanup = () => {
1034:         if (resolved) return;
1035:         resolved = true;
1036:         this._process = null;
1037:         resolve(undefined);
1038:       };
1039: 
1040:       // İlk timeout: SIGKILL dene
1041:       const killTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
1042:         console.log("[OPENCODE]", "warn", "Graceful shutdown timeout, SIGKILL gönderiliyor");
1043:         try {
1044:           this._process?.kill("SIGKILL");
1045:         } catch (e) {
1046:           // Process zaten öldüyse hata verebilir
1047:         }
1048:       }, SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT);
1049:       
1050:       // İkinci timeout: Port bazlı kill dene ve zorla resolve et
1051:       const forceTimeout = setTimeout(async () => {
1052:         console.log("[OPENCODE]", "warn", "Force shutdown - process yanıt vermiyor, port bazlı kill deneniyor");
1053:         clearTimeout(killTimeout);
1054:         
1055:         // Port bazlı kill dene
1056:         try {
1057:           await this._killByPort(this._state.port);
1058:         } catch (e) {
1059:           console.log("[OPENCODE]", "debug", "Port bazlı kill başarısız", { error: (e as Error).message });
1060:         }
1061:         
1062:         cleanup();
1063:       }, SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT + 5000); // SIGKILL'den 5 saniye sonra
1064: 
1065:       this._process.on("close", () => {
1066:         clearTimeout(killTimeout);
1067:         clearTimeout(forceTimeout);
1068:         cleanup();
1069:       });
1070:       
1071:       this._process.on("error", (err) => {
1072:         console.log("[OPENCODE]", "error", "Process error", { error: err.message });
1073:         clearTimeout(killTimeout);
1074:         clearTimeout(forceTimeout);
1075:         cleanup();
1076:       });
1077: 
1078:       // Önce SIGTERM dene
1079:       console.log("[OPENCODE]", "debug", "SIGTERM gönderiliyor", { pid });
1080:       try {
1081:         this._process.kill("SIGTERM");
1082:       } catch (e) {
1083:         // Process zaten öldüyse
1084:         clearTimeout(killTimeout);
1085:         clearTimeout(forceTimeout);
1086:         cleanup();
1087:       }
1088:     });
1089:   },
1090: 
1091:   /**
1092:    * Port kullanan process'i öldür (Linux/Mac için)
1093:    */
1094:   async _killByPort(port: number): Promise<void> {
1095:     const { exec } = await import("child_process");
1096:     const { promisify } = await import("util");
1097:     const execAsync = promisify(exec);
1098:     
1099:     try {
1100:       // Linux/Mac: lsof ile portu kullanan PID'i bul
1101:       const { stdout } = await execAsync(`lsof -t -i:${port} 2>/dev/null || fuser ${port}/tcp 2>/dev/null || true`);
1102:       const pids = stdout.trim().split('\n').filter(p => p);
1103:       
1104:       if (pids.length > 0) {
1105:         for (const pid of pids) {
1106:           try {
1107:             console.log("[OPENCODE]", "debug", "Port bazlı kill", { port, pid });
1108:             await execAsync(`kill -9 ${pid} 2>/dev/null || true`);
1109:           } catch {
1110:             // Ignore
1111:           }
1112:         }
1113:       }
1114:     } catch (e) {
1115:       // Windows veya komut başarısız - ignore
1116:       console.log("[OPENCODE]", "debug", "Port kill komutu başarısız", { error: (e as Error).message });
1117:     }
1118:   },
1119: 
1120:   /**
1121:    * State'i sıfırla
1122:    */

1124:     this._process = null;
1125:     this._state = {
1126:       running: false,
1127:       pid: null,
1128:       port: OPENCODE_DEFAULTS.port,
1129:       projectPath: null,
1130:       error: null,
1131:       sessionId: null,
1132:       connected: false,
1133:       authHeader: null,

1153:    */
1154:   _notifyListeners() {
1155:     const state = this.getStatus();
1156:     this._statusListeners.forEach(cb => {
1157:       try {
1158:         cb(state);
1159:       } catch (err: unknown) {
1160:         console.log("[OPENCODE]", "error", "Status listener hatası", { error: (err as Error).message });
1161:       }
1162:     });
1163:   },
1164: 
1165:   /**
1166:    * SSE buffer'dan tam event'leri çıkar ve işle
1167:    * CodeNomad flushEvents pattern'i - SSE standardı \n\n separator
1168:    * @param {string} buffer - Mevcut buffer
1169:    * @returns {string} - Kalan buffer (incomplete event)
1170:    */
1171:   _flushSSEEvents(buffer: string): string {
1172:     let separatorIndex = buffer.indexOf("\n\n");
1173: 
1174:     while (separatorIndex >= 0) {
1175:       const chunk = buffer.slice(0, separatorIndex);
1176:       buffer = buffer.slice(separatorIndex + 2);
1177:       this._processSSEChunk(chunk);
1178:       separatorIndex = buffer.indexOf("\n\n");
1179:     }
1180: 
1181:     return buffer;
1182:   },
1183: 
1184:   /**
1185:    * Tek bir SSE chunk'ını işle
1186:    * Birden fazla data: satırını birleştirerek parse eder
1187:    * @param {string} chunk - SSE event chunk'ı
1188:    */
1189:   _processSSEChunk(chunk: string): void {
1190:     const lines = chunk.split(/\r?\n/);
1191:     const dataLines: string[] = [];
1192: 
1193:     for (const line of lines) {
1194:       // Comment satırlarını atla
1195:       if (line.startsWith(":")) {
1196:         continue;
1197:       }
1198:       // data: ile başlayan satırları topla
1199:       if (line.startsWith("data:")) {
1200:         dataLines.push(line.slice(5).trimStart());
1201:       }
1202:     }
1203: 
1204:     if (dataLines.length === 0) {
1205:       return;
1206:     }
1207: 
1208:     // Tüm data satırlarını birleştir
1209:     const payload = dataLines.join("\n").trim();
1210:     if (!payload) {
1211:       return;
1212:     }
1213: 
1214:     try {
1215:       const openCodeEvent = JSON.parse(payload);
1216:       console.log("[OPENCODE-SSE]", "debug", "Event parsed", { type: openCodeEvent.type });
1217:       
1218:       const nativeEvent = eventParser.toNativeUIEvent(openCodeEvent);
1219:       if (nativeEvent && this._eventCallback) {
1220:         console.log("[OPENCODE-SSE]", "debug", "Dispatching event", { type: nativeEvent.type });
1221:         this._eventCallback(nativeEvent);
1222:       }
1223:     } catch (err) {
1224:       console.log("[OPENCODE-SSE]", "warn", "SSE chunk parse hatası", { 
1225:         error: (err as Error).message,
1226:         payload: payload.substring(0, 200) 
1227:       });
1228:     }
1229:   },
1230: 
1231:   /**
1232:    * Sleep utility
1233:    * @param {number} ms
1234:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
1235:    */
1236:   _sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
1237:     return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
1238:   },

 10: // ============================================================================
 11: // Conversation Store

 14: export const ConversationStore = {
 15:   /**
 16:    * Konuşmaları listele
 17:    * @param {string} accountId - Account ID
 18:    * @returns {Promise<Array>}
 19:    */
 20:   async list(accountId: string) {
 21:     try {
 22:       if (!accountId) {
 23:         return [];
 24:       }
 25: 
 26:       const result = await window.electronAPI?.dbGetConversations?.({ accountId });
 27: 
 28:       return result?.data ?? [];
 29:     } catch (err) {
 30:       LogManager.addEvent("database", "error", `ConversationStore.list error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, { context: { accountId } });
 31:       return [];
 32:     }
 33:   },
 34: 
 35:   /**
 36:    * Tek bir konuşmayı getir
 37:    * @param {string} accountId - Account ID
 38:    * @param {string} conversationId
 39:    * @returns {Promise<Object|null>}
 40:    */
 41:   async get(accountId: string, conversationId: string) {
 42:     try {
 43:       const conversations = await this.list(accountId);
 44:       return conversations.find((c) => c.id === conversationId) || null;
 45:     } catch (err) {
 46:       LogManager.addEvent("database", "error", `ConversationStore.get error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, { context: { accountId, conversationId } });
 47:       return null;
 48:     }
 49:   },
 50: 
 51:   /**
 52:    * Konuşmayı güncelle
 53:    * @param {string} accountId - Account ID
 54:    * @param {string} conversationId
 55:    * @param {Object} data - { title?, summary? }
 56:    * @returns {Promise<{ success: boolean }>}
 57:    */
 58:   async update(accountId: string, conversationId: string, data: { title?: string; summary?: string }) {
 59:     try {
 60:       const result = await window.electronAPI?.dbUpdateConversation?.({
 61:         accountId,
 62:         conversationId,
 63:         ...data,
 64:       });
 65: 
 66:       return result || { success: false, error: "API not available" };
 67:     } catch (err) {
 68:       LogManager.addEvent("database", "error", `ConversationStore.update error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, { context: { accountId, conversationId, data } });
 69:       return { success: false, error: getErrorMessage(err) };
 70:     }
 71:   },
 72: 
 73:   /**
 74:    * Konuşmayı sil
 75:    * @param {string} accountId - Account ID
 76:    * @param {string} conversationId
 77:    * @returns {Promise<{ success: boolean }>}
 78:    */
 79:   async delete(accountId: string, conversationId: string) {
 80:     try {
 81:       const result = await window.electronAPI?.dbDeleteConversation?.({ accountId, conversationId });
 82: 
 83:       return result || { success: false, error: "API not available" };
 84:     } catch (err) {
 85:       LogManager.addEvent("database", "error", `ConversationStore.delete error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, { context: { accountId, conversationId } });
 86:       return { success: false, error: getErrorMessage(err) };
 87:     }
 88:   },
 89: 
 90:   /**
 91:    * URL'ye göre konuşma bul
 92:    * @param {string} accountId - Account ID
 93:    * @param {string} webUrl
 94:    * @returns {Promise<Object|null>}
 95:    */
 96:   async findByUrl(accountId: string, webUrl: string) {
 97:     try {
 98:       const conversations = await this.list(accountId);
 99:       return conversations.find((c) => c.webUrl === webUrl) || null;
100:     } catch (err) {
101:       LogManager.addEvent("database", "error", `ConversationStore.findByUrl error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, { context: { accountId, webUrl } });
102:       return null;
103:     }
104:   },
105: };
106: 
107: export default ConversationStore;

File: src/js/modules/webview/methods/shared/url-utils.ts
================
  1: /**
  2:  * URL Utilities - Merkezi URL işleme fonksiyonları
  3:  * 
  4:  * Bu modül daha önce farklı dosyalarda (slot-controller, webview-manager, traffic-manager, app.js)
  5:  * tekrarlanan URL fonksiyonlarını tek bir yerde toplar.
  6:  * 
  7:  * NOT: isSlotUrlExcluded fonksiyonu slot-aware URL kontrolü için merkezi çözümdür.
  8:  * Tüm modüller kendi wrapper metodları yerine bu fonksiyonu kullanmalıdır.
  9:  */
 10: 
 11: import { ProviderRegistry } from "../../provider-registry.js";
 12: import { AppState } from "../../../app-state.js";
 13: 
 14: /**
 15:  * URL'i normalize et (query string ve hash kaldır, trailing slash temizle)
 16:  * @param {string} url - Normalize edilecek URL
 17:  * @returns {string} - Normalize edilmiş URL
 18:  */
 19: export function normalizeUrl(url: string): string {
 20:   if (!url) return "";
 21:   return url.split("?")[0].split("#")[0].replace(/\/+$/, "");
 22: }
 23: 
 24: /**
 25:  * URL'in provider'ın default (ana) sayfası olup olmadığını kontrol et
 26:  * Default page = baseUrl ile aynı veya sadece trailing slash farkı olan URL
 27:  * Örn: chatgpt.com, chatgpt.com/, grok.com, gemini.google.com
 28:  * @param {string} url - Kontrol edilecek URL
 29:  * @param {string} providerId - Provider ID (chatgpt, grok, gemini)
 30:  * @returns {boolean} - URL default page mi?
 31:  */
 32: export function isDefaultPage(url: string, providerId: string): boolean {
 33:   if (!url || !providerId) return false;
 34:   
 35:   const config = ProviderRegistry.get(providerId as "opencode" | "chatgpt" | "grok" | "gemini");
 36:   if (!config?.baseUrl) return false;
 37:   
 38:   const normalizedUrl = normalizeUrl(url);
 39:   const normalizedBase = normalizeUrl(config.baseUrl);
 40:   
 41:   // Tam eşleşme kontrolü
 42:   if (normalizedUrl === normalizedBase) return true;
 43:   
 44:   // Bazı provider'lar /app veya benzeri path kullanabilir
 45:   // Örn: gemini.google.com/app
 46:   const configWithPaths = config as { defaultPaths?: string[]; baseUrl: string };
 47:   if (configWithPaths.defaultPaths) {
 48:     for (const path of configWithPaths.defaultPaths) {
 49:       const fullPath = normalizeUrl(`${config.baseUrl}${path}`);
 50:       if (normalizedUrl === fullPath) return true;
 51:     }
 52:   }
 53:   
 54:   return false;
 55: }
 56: 
 57: /**
 58:  * URL'in exclude listesinde olup olmadığını kontrol et
 59:  * @param {string} url - Kontrol edilecek URL
 60:  * @param {string[]} excludedUrls - Exclude edilmiş URL listesi (wildcard destekler)
 61:  * @returns {boolean} - URL exclude edilmiş mi?
 62:  */
 63: export function isUrlExcluded(url: string, excludedUrls: string[]) {
 64:   if (!url || !excludedUrls?.length) return false;
 65: 
 66:   const normalizedUrl = normalizeUrl(url);
 67: 
 68:   for (const excluded of excludedUrls) {
 69:     const normalizedExcluded = normalizeUrl(excluded);
 70: 
 71:     if (excluded.includes("*")) {
 72:       const pattern = normalizedExcluded.replace(/\*/g, ".*");
 73:       const regex = new RegExp(`^${pattern}$`);
 74:       if (regex.test(normalizedUrl)) return true;
 75:     } else {
 76:       if (normalizedUrl === normalizedExcluded) return true;
 77:     }
 78:   }
 79: 
 80:   return false;
 81: }
 82: 
 83: /**
 84:  * Slot-aware URL exclusion kontrolü (MERKEZİ FONKSİYON)
 85:  * 
 86:  * Bu fonksiyon tüm modüllerde tekrar eden isUrlExcluded wrapper metodlarının
 87:  * yerine kullanılmalıdır. Provider config'i otomatik olarak çözer.
 88:  * 
 89:  * @param {string} providerSlot - Slot ID (ai0, ai1, ai2)
 90:  * @param {string} url - Kontrol edilecek URL
 91:  * @returns {boolean} - URL excluded mı?
 92:  * 
 93:  * @example
 94:  * // Eski kullanım (her modülde tekrar):
 95:  * // const providerId = AppState.getProviderIdForSlot(slot);
 96:  * // const cfg = ProviderRegistry.get(providerId);
 97:  * // return checkUrlExcluded(url, cfg.excludedUrls);
 98:  * 
 99:  * // Yeni kullanım (merkezi):
100:  * import { isSlotUrlExcluded } from "./url-utils.js";
101:  * if (isSlotUrlExcluded("ai1", currentUrl)) return;
102:  */
103: export function isSlotUrlExcluded(providerSlot: string, url: string): boolean {
104:   if (!providerSlot || !url) return false;
105:   
106:   const providerId = AppState.getProviderIdForSlot(providerSlot);
107:   if (!providerId) return false;
108:   
109:   const cfg = ProviderRegistry.get(providerId as "opencode" | "chatgpt" | "grok" | "gemini");
110:   if (!cfg?.excludedUrls?.length) return false;
111:   
112:   return isUrlExcluded(url, cfg.excludedUrls);
113: }

File: src/js/modules/webview/providers/chatgpt/scraper.ts
================
 1: /**
 2:  * ChatGPT mesajlarını scrape et
 3:  * 
 4:  * NOT: normalizeText ve hashString fonksiyonları webview injection sınırlaması
 5:  * nedeniyle inline tanımlanmıştır. Tek kaynak (single source of truth):
 6:  * @see ../shared/scraper-helpers.ts
 7:  * 
 8:  * @returns {Array<{ index: number, role: string, text: string, contentHash: string, domIndex: number }>}
 9:  */
10: export function scrapeMessages() {
11:   // Text normalization - hash tutarlılığı için (kaynak: scraper-helpers.ts)
12:   function normalizeText(str: string): string {
13:     if (!str) return "";
14:     return str
15:       .replace(/\r\n/g, "\n")           // Windows line endings → Unix
16:       .replace(/\r/g, "\n")             // Old Mac line endings → Unix
17:       .replace(/[\t ]+/g, " ")          // Multiple spaces/tabs → single space
18:       .replace(/ *\n */g, "\n")         // Spaces around newlines → just newline
19:       .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")       // 3+ newlines → 2 newlines
20:       .trim();                          // Leading/trailing whitespace
21:   }
22: 
23:   // Hash fonksiyonu (djb2 algoritması) - fonksiyon içinde tanımlı olmalı
24:   // çünkü toString() ile webview'a inject edildiğinde dış fonksiyonlar görünmez
25:   function hashString(str: string) {
26:     if (!str) return "0";
27:     // Normalize before hashing for consistency
28:     const normalized = normalizeText(str);
29:     let hash = 5381;
30:     for (let i = 0; i < normalized.length; i++) {
31:       hash = (hash << 5) + hash + normalized.charCodeAt(i);
32:       hash = hash >>> 0;
33:     }
34:     return hash.toString(16);
35:   }
36: 
37:   const preferredSel =
38:     (window.__hayalet_provider_config &&
39:       window.__hayalet_provider_config.scrapeSelectors?.preferred) ||
40:     "[data-message-author-role]";
41:   const fallbackSel =
42:     (window.__hayalet_provider_config &&
43:       window.__hayalet_provider_config.scrapeSelectors?.fallback) ||
44:     ".message-bubble, .markdown.prose";
45:   const preferred = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(preferredSel));
46:   const fallback = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(fallbackSel));
47:   const base = preferred.length ? preferred : fallback;
48:   const nodes = base.filter((n, i, arr) => !arr.some((o, j) => i !== j && o.contains(n)));
49:   const mid = window.innerWidth / 2;
50:   const result: { index: number; role: string; text: string; contentHash: string; domIndex: number }[] = [];
51:   nodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
52:     const roleNode = node.getAttribute("data-message-author-role")
53:       ? node
54:       : node.closest("[data-message-author-role]");
55:     const roleAttr = roleNode?.getAttribute("data-message-author-role") || "";
56:     let text = ((node as HTMLElement).innerText || node.textContent || "").trim();
57:     if (!text) {
58:       const imgs = Array.from(node.querySelectorAll("img")) as HTMLImageElement[];
59:       const alt = imgs
60:         .map((img) => (img.alt || "").trim())
61:         .filter(Boolean)
62:         .join(" ");
63:       if (alt) text = alt;
64:       else if (imgs.length) text = "[image]";
65:     }
66:     if (!text) return;
67:     let role = "assistant";
68:     if (roleAttr === "user") role = "user";
69:     else if (roleAttr === "assistant") role = "assistant";
70:     else {
71:       const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
72:       role = rect.left > mid ? "user" : "assistant";
73:     }
74:     // Hash ekle (incremental sync için)
75:     const contentHash = hashString(text);
76: 
77:     result.push({ index: idx, role, text, contentHash, domIndex: idx });
78:   });
79:   return result;
80: }

File: src/js/modules/webview/providers/gemini/scraper.ts

  1: /**
  2:  * Gemini mesajlarını scrape et
  3:  * Gemini'de DOM ID mevcut olduğu için önce onu kullanır, yoksa hash
  4:  * 
  5:  * NOT: normalizeText ve hashString fonksiyonları webview injection sınırlaması
  6:  * nedeniyle inline tanımlanmıştır. Tek kaynak (single source of truth):
  7:  * @see ../shared/scraper-helpers.ts
  8:  * 
  9:  * @returns {Array<{ index: number, role: string, text: string, contentHash: string, domIndex: number, domId?: string }>}
 10:  */
 11: interface ScrapedMessage {
 12:   index: number;
 13:   role: string;
 14:   text: string;
 15:   contentHash: string;
 16:   domIndex: number;
 17:   domId?: string | null;
 18: }
 19: 
 20: export function scrapeMessages(): ScrapedMessage[] {
 21:   // Text normalization - hash tutarlılığı için
 22:   function normalizeText(str: string): string {
 23:     if (!str) return "";
 24:     return str
 25:       .replace(/\r\n/g, "\n")
 26:       .replace(/\r/g, "\n")
 27:       .replace(/[\t ]+/g, " ")
 28:       .replace(/ *\n */g, "\n")
 29:       .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
 30:       .trim();
 31:   }
 32: 
 33:   // Hash fonksiyonu (djb2 algoritması) - fonksiyon içinde tanımlı olmalı
 34:   function hashString(str: string): string {
 35:     if (!str) return "0";
 36:     const normalized = normalizeText(str);
 37:     if (!normalized) return "0";
 38:     let hash = 5381;
 39:     for (let i = 0; i < normalized.length; i++) {
 40:       hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) + normalized.charCodeAt(i);
 41:       hash = hash >>> 0;
 42:     }
 43:     return hash.toString(16);
 44:   }
 45: 
 46:   const config = (window.__hayalet_provider_config || {}) as { scrapeSelectors?: Record<string, string>; roleSelectors?: Record<string, string> };
 47:   const { scrapeSelectors = {}, roleSelectors = {} } = config;
 48: 
 49:   const preferredSel = scrapeSelectors.preferred || ".message-content";
 50:   const fallbackSel =
 51:     scrapeSelectors.fallback ||
 52:     ".user-query-bubble-with-background, .markdown-main-panel";
 53:   const messageIdSel = scrapeSelectors.messageId || '[id^="message-content-id-"]';
 54: 
 55:   const preferred = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(preferredSel));
 56:   const base = preferred.length
 57:     ? preferred
 58:     : Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(fallbackSel));
 59: 
 60:   const nodes = base.filter(
 61:     (n, i, arr) => !arr.some((o, j) => i !== j && o.contains(n)),
 62:   );
 63: 
 64:   const result: ScrapedMessage[] = [];
 65:   nodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
 66:     let role = "assistant";
 67: 
 68:     if (roleSelectors.user && node.matches(roleSelectors.user)) {
 69:       role = "user";
 70:     } else if (
 71:       roleSelectors.assistant &&
 72:       node.matches(roleSelectors.assistant)
 73:     ) {
 74:       role = "assistant";
 75:     } else {
 76:       if (roleSelectors.user && node.querySelector(roleSelectors.user)) {
 77:         role = "user";
 78:       } else if (
 79:         roleSelectors.assistant &&
 80:         node.querySelector(roleSelectors.assistant)
 81:       ) {
 82:         role = "assistant";
 83:       }
 84:     }
 85: 
 86:     let textContent = "";
 87:     if (roleSelectors.text) {
 88:       const textNodes = Array.from(node.querySelectorAll(roleSelectors.text)) as HTMLElement[];
 89:       textContent = textNodes
 90:         .map((t) => t.innerText)
 91:         .join(" ")
 92:         .trim();
 93:     }
 94: 
 95:     if (!textContent) {
 96:       textContent = ((node as HTMLElement).innerText || "").trim();
 97:     }
 98: 
 99:     if (!textContent) {
100:       const imgs = Array.from(node.querySelectorAll("img")) as HTMLImageElement[];
101:       const alt = imgs
102:         .map((img) => (img.alt || "").trim())
103:         .filter(Boolean)
104:         .join(" ");
105:       if (alt) textContent = alt;
106:       else if (imgs.length) textContent = "[image]";
107:     }
108: 
109:     if (!textContent) return;
110: 
111:     // DOM ID'yi çıkarmayı dene (Gemini'de benzersiz ID var)
112:     let domId = null;
113:     const idElement = node.matches(messageIdSel) ? node : node.querySelector(messageIdSel);
114:     if (idElement && idElement.id) {
115:       domId = idElement.id;
116:     }
117: 
118:     // Hash ekle (fallback veya duplicate detection için)
119:     const contentHash = hashString(textContent);
120:     result.push({ index: idx, role, text: textContent, contentHash, domIndex: idx, domId });
121:   });
122: 
123:   return result;
124: }

22:     return str
23:       .replace(/\r\n/g, "\n")

35:     if (!normalized) return "0";
36:     let hash = 5381;
37:     for (let i = 0; i < normalized.length; i++) {
38:       hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) + normalized.charCodeAt(i);
39:       hash = hash >>> 0;
40:     }
41:     return hash.toString(16);
42:   }
43: 
44:   const preferredSel =
45:     (window.__hayalet_provider_config &&
46:       window.__hayalet_provider_config.scrapeSelectors?.preferred) ||
47:     "[data-message-author-role]";
48:   const fallbackSel =
49:     (window.__hayalet_provider_config &&
50:       window.__hayalet_provider_config.scrapeSelectors?.fallback) ||
51:     ".message-bubble";
52:   const preferred = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(preferredSel));
53:   const fallback = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(fallbackSel));
54:   const base = preferred.length ? preferred : fallback;
55:   const nodes = base.filter(
56:     (n, i, arr) => !arr.some((o, j) => i !== j && o.contains(n)),
57:   );
58:   const mid = window.innerWidth / 2;
59:   const result: ScrapedMessage[] = [];
60:   nodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
61:     const roleNode = node.getAttribute("data-message-author-role")
62:       ? node
63:       : node.closest("[data-message-author-role]");
64:     const roleAttr = roleNode?.getAttribute("data-message-author-role") || "";
65:     let text = ((node as HTMLElement).innerText || "").trim();
66:     if (!text) {
67:       const imgs = Array.from(node.querySelectorAll("img")) as HTMLImageElement[];
68:       const alt = imgs
69:         .map((img) => (img.alt || "").trim())
70:         .filter(Boolean)
71:         .join(" ");
72:       if (alt) text = alt;
73:       else if (imgs.length) text = "[image]";
74:     }
75:     if (!text) return;
76:     const cls = (node.className || "").toString();
77:     const hasUserBorder = /border-border/i.test(cls) || /bg-surface/i.test(cls);
78:     const isFullWidth = /max-w-none/i.test(cls);
79:     let role = "assistant";
80:     if (roleAttr === "user") role = "user";
81:     else if (roleAttr === "assistant") role = "assistant";
82:     else if (hasUserBorder) role = "user";
83:     else if (isFullWidth) role = "assistant";
84:     else {
85:       const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
86:       role = rect.left > mid ? "user" : "assistant";
87:     }
88:     // Hash ekle (incremental sync için)
89:     const contentHash = hashString(text);
90:     result.push({ index: idx, role, text, contentHash, domIndex: idx });
91:   });
92:   return result;
93: }

File: src/js/modules/webview/lifecycle-manager.ts

  1: /**
  2:  * LifecycleManager - Webview yaşam döngüsü yönetimi
  3:  *
  4:  * Bu modül webview'ların kayıt, bağlama, ayırma ve bellek yönetimini sağlar:
  5:  * - register: Webview'ı kaydet
  6:  * - attach: Webview'ı slot'a bağla
  7:  * - detach: Webview'ı slot'tan ayır
  8:  * - destroy: Webview'ı tamamen kaldır
  9:  * - cleanupInactive: İnaktif webview'ları temizle
 10:  */
 11: 
 12: import { LogManager } from "../log-manager.js";
 13: import { getErrorMessage } from "../../types/index.js";
 14: import { TrafficManager } from "../traffic-manager.js";
 15: import { AppState } from "../app-state.js";
 16: import { SlotController } from "../slot-controller.js";
 17: import { ProviderRegistry } from "./provider-registry.js";
 18: 
 19: import { ConversationSyncer } from "./conversation-syncer.js";
 20: 
 21: class LifecycleManagerClass {
 22:   webviews: Record<string, any>;
 23:   _lastActivity: Record<string, number>;
 24:   _inactivityThreshold: number;
 25: 
 26:   constructor() {
 27:     this.webviews = {};
 28:     this._lastActivity = {};
 29:     this._inactivityThreshold = 30 * 60 * 1000;
 30:   }
 31: 
 32:   register(provider: string, webview: HTMLElement) {
 33:     if (!provider || !webview) return;
 34:     this.webviews[provider] = webview;
 35:     this._lastActivity[provider] = Date.now();
 36:   }
 37: 
 38:   get(provider: string): HTMLElement | null {
 39:     return this.webviews[provider] || null;
 40:   }
 41: 
 42:   resolve(provider: string): HTMLElement | null {
 43:     if (this.webviews[provider]) return this.webviews[provider];
 44: 
 45:     // Dinamik ID arama: önce provider-webview dene
 46:     const fallbackId = `${provider}-webview`;
 47:     const found = document.getElementById(fallbackId);
 48:     if (found) {
 49:       this.webviews[provider] = found;
 50:     }
 51:     return found;
 52:   }
 53: 
 54:   /**
 55:    * Webview'ı slot'a bağla
 56:    * @param {string} provider - Slot ID
 57:    * @param {HTMLElement} webview - Webview elementi
 58:    * @param {Object} opts - { providerId, onReady }
 59:    */
 60:   attach(provider: string, webview: any, opts: { providerId?: string; onReady?: () => void; urgent?: boolean } = {}) {
 61:     if (!provider || !webview) return;
 62: 
 63:     this.register(provider, webview);
 64: 
 65:     const { providerId, onReady } = opts;
 66: 
 67:     try {
 68:       if (!providerId) {
 69:         LogManager.addEvent(
 70:           `webview-${provider}`,
 71:           "warning",
 72:           "attach: no provider configured for slot"
 73:         );
 74:         return;
 75:       }
 76: 
 77:       const cfg = ProviderRegistry.get(providerId as "opencode" | "chatgpt" | "grok" | "gemini");
 78:       const defaultPage = cfg?.baseUrl || "";
 79: 
 80:       if (webview.getAttribute?.("data-detached")) {
 81:         webview.removeAttribute("data-detached");
 82:         if (webview.style) webview.style.display = "";
 83:       }
 84: 
 85:       // Lazy Loading Optimizasyonu
 86:       const isActive = AppState.getState()?.provider === provider;
 87:       const isUrgent = opts.urgent || false;
 88: 
 89:       const loadWebview = () => {
 90:         const currentSrc = webview.getAttribute("src") || "";
 91:         let currentUrl = "";
 92:         try {
 93:           currentUrl = (webview.getURL?.() || "").split("?")[0].split("#")[0];
 94:         } catch (_err) {}
 95: 
 96:         const targetUrl = defaultPage.split("?")[0].split("#")[0];
 97: 
 98:         const needsReload =
 99:           (!currentSrc && !currentUrl) ||
100:           (currentUrl &&
101:             targetUrl &&
102:             !currentUrl.startsWith(targetUrl) &&
103:             !targetUrl.startsWith(currentUrl));
104: 
105:         if (defaultPage && needsReload) {
106:           LogManager.addEvent(`webview-${provider}`, "info", `attach: loading URL ${defaultPage}`);
107:           webview.setAttribute("src", defaultPage);
108:         } else if (currentUrl) {
109:           LogManager.addEvent(
110:             `webview-${provider}`,
111:             "debug",
112:             `attach: webview already loaded (${currentUrl}), skipping reload`
113:           );
114:         }
115: 
116:         this._setupWebviewLogger(webview, provider, providerId);
117:       };
118: 
119:       if (isActive || isUrgent) {
120:         loadWebview();
121:       } else {
122:         // Aktif değilse idle zamanında yükle
123:         if ("requestIdleCallback" in window) {
124:           window.requestIdleCallback(() => loadWebview(), { timeout: 2000 });
125:         } else {
126:           setTimeout(loadWebview, 100);
127:         }
128:       }
129: 
130:       if (onReady && typeof onReady === "function") {
131:         const handleReady = () => {
132:           try {
133:             onReady();
134:             LogManager.addEvent(
135:               `webview-${provider}`,
136:               "info",
137:               "attach: onReady callback executed after dom-ready"
138:             );
139:           } catch (err) {
140:             LogManager.addEvent(
141:               `webview-${provider}`,
142:               "error",
143:               `attach: onReady callback error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`
144:             );
145:           }
146:         };
147:         webview.addEventListener("dom-ready", handleReady, { once: true });
148:       }
149: 
150:       LogManager.addEvent(`webview-${provider}`, "info", "attach: webview attached", { visibility: 2 });
151:     } catch (err) {
152:       LogManager.addEvent(`webview-${provider}`, "error", `attach error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`);
153:     }
154:   }
155: 
156:   detach(provider: string, { cleanupDom = true, skipTrafficStop = false } = {}) {
157:     if (!provider) return;
158: 
159:     const webview = this.webviews[provider];
160: 
161:     try {
162:       if (!skipTrafficStop) {
163:         TrafficManager.stop(provider, { force: true });
164:         TrafficManager.detachWebview(provider);
165:       }
166: 
167:       // Listener temizliği (Memory Leak önlemi)
168:       ConversationSyncer.cancelListeners(provider);
169: 
170:       if (webview && cleanupDom) {
171:         webview.setAttribute("data-detached", "1");
172:         if (webview.style) webview.style.display = "none";
173:         webview.removeAttribute("src");
174:       }
175:     } catch (_err) {
176:     } finally {
177:       delete this.webviews[provider];
178:       LogManager.addEvent(
179:         `webview-${provider}`,
180:         "info",
181:         `detached (cleanup=${!!cleanupDom}, skipTrafficStop=${!!skipTrafficStop})`
182:       );
183:     }
184:   }
185: 
186:   destroy(provider: string) {
187:     if (!provider) return;
188: 
189:     const webview = this.webviews[provider];
190:     if (!webview) return;
191: 
192:     try {
193:       TrafficManager.detachWebview(provider);
194: 
195:       if (webview.parentNode) {
196:         webview.parentNode.removeChild(webview);
197:       }
198: 
199:       delete this.webviews[provider];
200:       delete this._lastActivity[provider];
201: 
202:       LogManager.addEvent(`webview-${provider}`, "info", "Webview destroyed to free memory", { visibility: 2 });
203:     } catch (err) {
204:       LogManager.addEvent(
205:         `webview-${provider}`,
206:         "error",
207:         `Webview destroy failed: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`
208:       );
209:     }
210:   }
211: 
212:   markActive(provider: string) {
213:     if (!provider) return;
214:     this._lastActivity[provider] = Date.now();
215:   }
216: 
217:   /**
218:    * İnaktif webview'ları temizle
219:    */
220:   cleanupInactive() {
221:     const now = Date.now();
222:     const providers = Object.keys(this.webviews);
223: 
224:     for (const provider of providers) {
225:       const lastActivity = this._lastActivity[provider] || 0;
226:       const inactive = now - lastActivity > this._inactivityThreshold;
227: 
228:       const isVisible = AppState.getState()?.provider === provider;
229:       const isConnected = SlotController.isConnected(provider);
230: 
231:       if (inactive && !isVisible && !isConnected) {
232:         LogManager.addEvent(
233:           `webview-${provider}`,
234:           "info",
235:           `Detaching inactive webview (${Math.floor((now - lastActivity) / 60000)}min idle)`
236:         );
237:         this.detach(provider, { cleanupDom: true, skipTrafficStop: false });
238:       }
239:     }
240:   }
241: 
242:   _setupWebviewLogger(webview: any, provider: string, providerId: string) {
243:     try {
244:       const webContentsId = webview.getWebContentsId?.();
245:       if (webContentsId && window.electronAPI?.setupWebviewLogger) {
246:         window.electronAPI
247:           .setupWebviewLogger(webContentsId, provider, providerId)
248:           .then((result) => {
249:             if (result?.success) {
250:               LogManager.addEvent(
251:                 `webview-${provider}`,
252:                 "debug",
253:                 `Webview logger kuruldu (${providerId})`
254:               );
255:             }
256:           })
257:           .catch(() => {});
258:       }
259:     } catch (_err) {}
260:   }
261: 
262:   /**
263:    * Tüm kayıtlı webview'ları getir
264:    * @returns {Object}
265:    */
266:   getAll() {
267:     return { ...this.webviews };
268:   }
269: 
270:   has(provider: string): boolean {
271:     return !!this.webviews[provider];
272:   }
273: }
274: 
275: export const LifecycleManager = new LifecycleManagerClass();

  1: /**
  2:  * Renderer Process Log Manager
  3:  * 
  4:  * Merkezi olay kayıt sistemi. UI güncellemeleri ve dosya persistence sağlar.
  5:  * Main process console-logger ile senkronize çalışır.
  6:  * AI debugging için optimize edilmiş yapı.
  7:  * 
  8:  * Toast Entegrasyonu: success, error, warning tipli loglar otomatik Toast gösterir.
  9:  */
 10: 
 11: // Toast import - lazy loaded to avoid circular dependencies
 12: let ToastModule: typeof import('../ui/toast-manager') | null = null;
 13: const getToast = async () => {
 14:   if (!ToastModule) {
 15:     try {
 16:       ToastModule = await import('../ui/toast-manager.js');
 17:     } catch {
 18:       // Toast modülü yüklenemedi - sessizce devam et
 19:     }
 20:   }
 21:   return ToastModule?.Toast;
 22: };
 23: 
 24: /**
 25:  * Log Visibility Seviyeleri:
 26:  * 1 = Toast: Kullanıcı bildirimi (bağlantı, hata, başarı)
 27:  * 2 = Panel: Süreç durumu (db açıldı, sync, loading)
 28:  * 3 = Verbose: Debug (state transition, IPC, probe)
 29:  * 
 30:  * Her seviye alt seviyeleri içerir:
 31:  * - Toast (1): Toast + Panel + Verbose görünür
 32:  * - Panel (2): Panel + Verbose görünür
 33:  * - Verbose (3): Sadece Verbose görünür
 34:  */
 35: export type LogVisibility = 1 | 2 | 3;
 36: 
 37: export interface LogEntry {
 38:   timestamp: string;
 39:   isoTimestamp?: string;
 40:   source: string;
 41:   type: string;
 42:   message: string;
 43:   sessionId: string | null;
 44:   correlationId?: string | null;
 45:   context?: unknown;
 46:   meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
 47:   aiHint?: unknown;
 48:   /** Log görünürlük seviyesi: 1=toast, 2=panel, 3=verbose */
 49:   visibility: LogVisibility;
 50: }

 52: class LogManagerClass {
 53:   logs: LogEntry[];
 54:   maxMemoryLogs: number;
 55:   listeners: ((entry: LogEntry) => void)[];
 56:   sessionId: string | null;
 57:   lastThrottle: Map<string, number>;
 58:   _consoleListenerSetup: boolean;
 59:   _initialized: boolean;
 60:   _activeOperations: Map<string, any>;
 61:   _correlationCounter: number;

 63:   constructor() {
 64:     this.logs = [];
 65:     this.maxMemoryLogs = 200;
 66:     this.listeners = [];
 67:     this.sessionId = null;
 68:     this.lastThrottle = new Map();
 69:     this._consoleListenerSetup = false;
 70:     this._initialized = false;
 71:     this._activeOperations = new Map();
 72:     this._correlationCounter = 0;
 73:   }
 74: 
 75:   /**
 76:    * Log sistemini başlat
 77:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
 78:    */
 79:   async init() {
 80:     if (this._initialized) return;
 81:     
 82:     try {
 83:       const mainSessionId = await window.electronAPI?.getSessionId?.();
 84:       this.sessionId = mainSessionId || this.generateSessionId();
 85:     } catch {
 86:       this.sessionId = this.generateSessionId();
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     this._initialized = true;
 90:     
 91:     // Main process'in erken loglarını yükle (UI hazır olmadan önce oluşanlar)
 92:     await this.loadEarlyLogs();
 93:     
 94:     this.addEvent(
 95:       "system",
 96:       "info",
 97:       `Yeni oturum başlatıldı: ${this.sessionId}`,
 98:       { visibility: 2 } // Panel seviyesi
 99:     );
100:

102:   }

104:   /**
105:    * Main process'in erken loglarını yükle
106:    * UI hazır olmadan önce oluşan logları retroaktif olarak ekler
107:    */
108:   private async loadEarlyLogs() {
109:     try {
110:       const earlyLogs = await window.electronAPI?.getEarlyLogs?.();
111:       if (Array.isArray(earlyLogs) && earlyLogs.length > 0) {
112:         earlyLogs.forEach((log: { source: string; level: string; message: string; timestamp?: string; visibility?: number }) => {
113:           // Erken logları persist etmeden ekle (zaten dosyaya yazılmış)
114:           this.addEventInternal(
115:             log.source || 'main',
116:             log.level || 'info',
117:             log.message,
118:             { visibility: log.visibility || 2 },
119:             false // shouldPersist = false
120:           );
121:         });
122:         this.addEvent('system', 'debug', `${earlyLogs.length} erken log yüklendi`, { visibility: 3 });
123:       }
124:     } catch {
125:       // Early logs yüklenemedi - kritik değil
126:     }
127:   }
128: 
129:   /**
130:    * Main process'ten gelen console loglarını dinle
131:    */
132:   setupConsoleLogListener() {
133:     if (this._consoleListenerSetup) return;
134:     this._consoleListenerSetup = true;
135: 
136:     try {
137:       window.electronAPI?.onConsoleLogForward?.((data) => {
138:         this.addEventInternal(
139:           data.source || "console",
140:           data.level,
141:           data.message || "",
142:           { context: data.context },
143:           false
144:         );
145:       });
146:     } catch (err) {
147:     }
148:   }
