150:   /**
151:    * Session ID oluştur
152:    * @returns {string}
153:    */
154:   generateSessionId() {
155:     const now = new Date();
156:     const pad = (n: number) => n.toString().padStart(2, "0");
157:     const day = pad(now.getDate());
158:     const month = pad(now.getMonth() + 1);
159:     const year = now.getFullYear();
160:     const hours = pad(now.getHours());
161:     const minutes = pad(now.getMinutes());
162:     const seconds = pad(now.getSeconds());
163:     return `${day}-${month}-${year}_${hours}-${minutes}-${seconds}`;
164:   }
165: 
166:   /**
167:    * Benzersiz correlation ID oluştur
168:    * @param {string} [prefix='op'] - ID prefix'i
169:    * @returns {string}
170:    */
171:   generateCorrelationId(prefix = 'op') {
172:     this._correlationCounter++;
173:     const timestamp = Date.now().toString(36);
174:     const counter = this._correlationCounter.toString(36).padStart(4, '0');
175:     return `${prefix}-${timestamp}-${counter}`;
176:   }
177: 
178:   /**
179:    * İşlem başlat (correlation tracking için)
180:    * @param {string} operationName - İşlem adı
181:    * @param {object} [initialContext] - Başlangıç bağlamı
182:    * @returns {string} Correlation ID
183:    */
184:   startOperation(operationName: string, initialContext: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
185:     const correlationId = this.generateCorrelationId(operationName);
186:     
187:     this._activeOperations.set(correlationId, {
188:       name: operationName,
189:       startTime: Date.now(),
190:       context: initialContext,
191:       events: [],
192:     });
193:     
194:     this.addEvent(
195:       operationName,
196:       "info",
197:       `İşlem başladı: ${operationName}`,
198:       { correlationId, ...initialContext }
199:     );
200:     
201:     return correlationId;
202:   }
203: 
204:   /**
205:    * İşlemi sonlandır
206:    * @param {string} correlationId - Correlation ID
207:    * @param {'success' | 'error' | 'cancelled'} [status='success'] - Sonuç durumu
208:    * @param {object} [result] - Sonuç verisi
209:    */
210:   endOperation(correlationId: string, status: 'success' | 'error' | 'cancelled' = 'success', result: unknown = null) {
211:     const operation = this._activeOperations.get(correlationId);
212:     if (!operation) return;
213:     
214:     const duration = Date.now() - operation.startTime;
215:     
216:     this.addEvent(
217:       operation.name,
218:       status === 'error' ? 'error' : 'info',
219:       `İşlem ${status === 'success' ? 'tamamlandı' : status === 'error' ? 'başarısız' : 'iptal edildi'}: ${operation.name} (${duration}ms)`,
220:       { correlationId, status, duration, result }
221:     );
222:     
223:     this._activeOperations.delete(correlationId);
224:   }
225: 
226:   /**
227:    * Log girdisi ekle
228:    * @param {string} source - Kaynak modül
229:    * @param {'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'debug' | 'system' | 'success'} type - Log tipi
230:    * @param {string} message - Mesaj
231:    * @param {object | null} [meta=null] - Ek metadata (visibility: 1|2|3 içerebilir)
232:    */
233:   addEvent(source: string, type: string, message: string, meta: Record<string, unknown> | null = null) {
234:     this.addEventInternal(source, type, message, meta, true);
235:   }
236: 
237:   /**
238:    * Toast seviyesinde log ekle (visibility: 1)
239:    * Kullanıcıya gösterilmesi gereken önemli mesajlar için
240:    */
241:   toast(source: string, type: string, message: string, meta: Record<string, unknown> | null = null) {
242:     this.addEvent(source, type, message, { ...meta, visibility: 1 });
243:   }
244: 
245:   /**
246:    * Panel seviyesinde log ekle (visibility: 2)
247:    * Süreç durumu mesajları için
248:    */
249:   panel(source: string, type: string, message: string, meta: Record<string, unknown> | null = null) {
250:     this.addEvent(source, type, message, { ...meta, visibility: 2 });
251:   }
252: 
253:   /**
254:    * Verbose seviyesinde log ekle (visibility: 3) - default
255:    * Debug ve detaylı mesajlar için
256:    */
257:   verbose(source: string, type: string, message: string, meta: Record<string, unknown> | null = null) {
258:     this.addEvent(source, type, message, { ...meta, visibility: 3 });
259:   }
260: 
261:   /**
262:    * Internal event adder with persist control
263:    * @param {string} source
264:    * @param {string} type
265:    * @param {string} message
266:    * @param {object | null} meta - visibility: 1|2|3 içerebilir
267:    * @param {boolean} shouldPersist - Dosyaya yazılsın mı?
268:    */
269:   addEventInternal(source: string, type: string, message: string, meta: Record<string, unknown> | null = null, shouldPersist = true) {
270:     const key = `${source}|${type}|${message}`;
271:     const nowTs = Date.now();
272:     const last = this.lastThrottle.get(key);
273:     if (type !== "error" && last && nowTs - last < 2000) return;
274:     this.lastThrottle.set(key, nowTs);
275: 
276:     const correlationId = (meta?.correlationId as string | null) || null;
277:     const context = meta?.context ?? null;
278:     
279:     // Visibility seviyesi: 1=toast, 2=panel, 3=verbose (default)
280:     const visibility = (meta?.visibility as LogVisibility) || this._inferVisibility(source, type);
281:     
282:     let cleanMeta = meta ? { ...meta } : undefined;
283:     if (cleanMeta) {
284:       delete cleanMeta.correlationId;
285:       delete cleanMeta.context;
286:       delete cleanMeta.showToast; // eski API uyumluluğu için
287:       delete cleanMeta.visibility;
288:       if (Object.keys(cleanMeta).length === 0) {
289:         cleanMeta = undefined;
290:       }
291:     }
292: 
293:     const entry: LogEntry = {
294:       timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString("tr-TR"),
295:       isoTimestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
296:       source,
297:       type,
298:       message,
299:       sessionId: this.sessionId,
300:       correlationId,
301:       context,
302:       meta: cleanMeta && Object.keys(cleanMeta).length > 0 ? cleanMeta : undefined,
303:       visibility,
304:     };
305: 
306:     this.logs.push(entry);
307: 
308:     // Bellekte yalnızca son `maxMemoryLogs` kaydı tut
309:     if (this.logs.length > this.maxMemoryLogs) {
310:       this.logs.shift();
311:     }
312: 
313:     // Listeners'a bildir (UI güncellemesi için)
314:     this.listeners.forEach((listener) => {
315:       try {
316:         listener(entry);
317:       } catch (error) {
318:         // Log listener error - silent to prevent infinite loop
319:       }
320:     });
321: 
322:     // Sadece shouldPersist true ise dosyaya yaz
323:     // (console-logger'dan gelen loglar zaten yazıldı)
324:     if (shouldPersist) {
325:       this.persist(entry);
326:     }
327: 
328:     // Toast entegrasyonu - visibility 1 olan loglar için Toast göster
329:     if (visibility === 1) {
330:       this._showToast(source, type, message);
331:     }
332:   }
333: 
334:   /**
335:    * Visibility seviyesini source, type ve message'a göre otomatik belirle
336:    * Mevcut loglar için geriye uyumluluk sağlar
337:    * 
338:    * Seviye 1 (Toast): Kullanıcının görmesi gereken önemli bildirimler
339:    * Seviye 2 (Panel): Süreç durumu, init mesajları
340:    * Seviye 3 (Verbose): Debug, teknik detaylar
341:    */
342:   private _inferVisibility(source: string, type: string): LogVisibility {
343:     const srcLower = source.toLowerCase();
344:     
345:     // ============================================
346:     // SEVIYE 3 (Verbose) - Debug ve teknik loglar
347:     // ============================================
348:     
349:     // Debug tipi her zaman verbose
350:     if (type === 'debug') return 3;
351:     
352:     // Teknik/verbose kaynaklar - error/warning olsa bile verbose
353:     const verboseSources = [
354:       // Traffic ve probe
355:       'traffic', 'probe', 'webview-events',
356:       // State machine
357:       'slot-state', 'state-machine', 'statemachine',
358:       // IPC ve teknik
359:       'ipc-client', 'app-state', 'settings-events', 'settings-ipc',
360:       // UI bileşenleri (sık tetiklenir)
361:       'buttonstates', 'audiomanager', 'canvasmanager', 
362:       'toast', 'modal', 'thememanager', 'splashscreen',
363:       // Provider ve factory
364:       'provider-factory', 'provider-registry',
365:       // Webview detay logları (slot-ai1, slot-ai2, webview-chatgpt vb.)
366:       'slot-ai', 'webview-chatgpt', 'webview-grok', 'webview-gemini', 'webview-opencode',
367:       // Renderer ve console
368:       'renderer', 'console',
369:       // Sync detayları
370:       'conversation-syncer', 'pending-archive'
371:     ];
372:     if (verboseSources.some(s => srcLower.includes(s))) {
373:       return 3;
374:     }
375:     
376:     // ============================================
377:     // SEVIYE 1 (Toast) - Kullanıcı bildirimleri
378:     // ============================================
379:     
380:     // Success mesajları genellikle toast (kullanıcı aksiyonu sonucu)
381:     if (type === 'success') return 1;
382:     
383:     // Kritik hatalar toast seviyesinde
384:     if (type === 'error') {
385:       // Kaynak bazlı toast error'lar (bağlantı, upload, komut hataları)
386:       const toastErrorSources = ['entrance', 'asistan', 'server', 'analyze', 'file-upload', 'whisper'];
387:       if (toastErrorSources.some(s => srcLower.includes(s))) return 1;
388:       // Diğer error'lar panel seviyesinde
389:       return 2;
390:     }
391:     
392:     // Warning'ler panel seviyesinde
393:     if (type === 'warning') {
394:       return 2;
395:     }
396:     
397:     // ============================================
398:     // SEVIYE 2 (Panel) - Süreç durumu (SADECE bunlar)
399:     // ============================================
400:     
401:     // Sadece önemli sistem ve süreç logları
402:     const panelSources = [
403:       'system',           // Uygulama başlatıldı
404:       'slot-controller',  // SlotController initialized
405:       'relay',            // RelayManager initialized
406:       'error-boundary',   // ErrorBoundary initialized
407:       'core',             // CoreEngine
408:       'meta-command',     // Custom komut yüklendi
409:       'asistan',          // AsistanController (init, server start/stop)
410:       'entrance',         // Bağlanıyor/kesiliyor bilgileri
411:       'db', 'database',   // Database açıldı/kapandı
412:       'sync',             // Sync initialized
413:       'webview-panel',    // Preload script ayarlandı
414:       'lifecycle',        // Webview attached/destroyed
415:     ];
416:     if (panelSources.some(s => srcLower.includes(s))) {
417:       return 2;
418:     }
419:     
420:     // Default: VERBOSE (bilinmeyen kaynaklar debug seviyesinde)
421:     return 3;
422:   }
423: 
424:   /**
425:    * Belirli visibility seviyesine göre logları filtrele
426:    * @param maxVisibility - Maksimum görünürlük seviyesi (1, 2 veya 3)
427:    * @returns Filtrelenmiş log dizisi
428:    */
429:   getByVisibility(maxVisibility: LogVisibility): LogEntry[] {
430:     return this.logs.filter(entry => entry.visibility <= maxVisibility);
431:   }
432: 
433:   /**
434:    * Toast seviyesindeki logları al (visibility: 1)
435:    */
436:   getToastLogs(): LogEntry[] {
437:     return this.getByVisibility(1);
438:   }
439: 
440:   /**
441:    * Panel seviyesindeki logları al (visibility: 1 ve 2)
442:    */
443:   getPanelLogs(): LogEntry[] {
444:     return this.getByVisibility(2);
445:   }
446: 
447:   /**
448:    * Tüm logları al (verbose - visibility: 1, 2 ve 3)
449:    */
450:   getVerboseLogs(): LogEntry[] {
451:     return this.getByVisibility(3);
452:   }
453: 
454:   /**
455:    * Toast göster
456:    */
457:   private _showToast(source: string, type: string, message: string): void {
458:     getToast().then(Toast => {
459:       if (!Toast) return;
460:       
461:       // Source'u başlık olarak kullan (capitalize)
462:       const title = source.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + source.slice(1);
463:       
464:       switch (type) {
465:         case 'success':
466:           Toast.success(title, message);
467:           break;
468:         case 'error':
469:           Toast.error(title, message);
470:           break;
471:         case 'warning':
472:           Toast.warning(title, message);
473:           break;
474:       }
475:     });
476:   }
477: 
478:   /**
479:    * Context ile log ekle (webview işlemleri için)
480:    * @param {string} source - Kaynak
481:    * @param {string} type - Tip
482:    * @param {string} message - Mesaj
483:    * @param {object} context - Bağlam (provider, slot, url, action, selector, etc.)
484:    * @param {string} [correlationId] - İşlem ID
485:    */
486:   addEventWithContext(source: string, type: string, message: string, context: Record<string, unknown>, correlationId: string | null = null) {
487:     this.addEvent(source, type, message, { context, correlationId });
488:   }
489: 
490:   /**
491:    * Log girdisini dosyaya yaz
492:    * @param {LogEntry} entry
493:    */
494:   persist(entry: LogEntry) {
495:     try {
496:       if (!this.sessionId) return;
497: 
498:       const line = JSON.stringify(entry);
499:       window.electronAPI?.appendLog?.({
500:         sessionId: this.sessionId,
501:         line,
502:         context: entry.context,
503:       });
504:     } catch (error) {
505:     }
506:   }
507: 
508:   /**
509:    * Log değişikliklerini dinle
510:    * @param {(entry: LogEntry) => void} listener
511:    * @returns {() => void} Unsubscribe fonksiyonu
512:    */
513:   onUpdate(listener: (entry: LogEntry) => void) {
514:     if (typeof listener !== "function")
515:       return () => {
516:       };
517:     this.listeners.push(listener);
518:     return () => {
519:       this.listeners = this.listeners.filter((l) => l !== listener);
520:     };
521:   }
522: 
523:   /**
524:    * Son N log girdisini al
525:    * @param {number} [limit=50]
526:    * @returns {LogEntry[]}
527:    */
528:   getRecent(limit = 50) {
529:     return this.logs.slice(-limit);
530:   }
531: 
532:   /**
533:    * Tüm logları al
534:    * @returns {LogEntry[]}
535:    */
536:   getAll() {
537:     return [...this.logs];
538:   }
539: 
540:   /**
541:    * Logları filtrele
542:    * @param {object} filter - Filtre kriterleri
543:    * @returns {LogEntry[]}
544:    */
545:   filter(filter: { source?: string; type?: string; correlationId?: string; contains?: string; since?: string | Date } = {}) {
546:     const { source, type, correlationId, contains, since } = filter;
547:     
548:     return this.logs.filter(entry => {
549:       if (source && !entry.source.toLowerCase().includes(source.toLowerCase())) {
550:         return false;
551:       }
552:       if (type && entry.type !== type) {
553:         return false;
554:       }
555:       if (correlationId && entry.correlationId !== correlationId) {
556:         return false;
557:       }
558:       if (contains && !entry.message.toLowerCase().includes(contains.toLowerCase())) {
559:         return false;
560:       }
561:       if (since) {
562:         const entryTime = new Date(entry.timestamp);
563:         const sinceTime = new Date(since);
564:         if (entryTime < sinceTime) {
565:           return false;
566:         }
567:       }
568:       return true;
569:     });
570:   }
571: 
572:   /**
573:    * Aktif işlemleri al
574:    * @returns {Map<string, object>}
575:    */
576:   getActiveOperations() {
577:     return new Map(this._activeOperations);
578:   }
579: 
580:   /**
581:    * Hata sayısını al
582:    * @returns {number}
583:    */
584:   getErrorCount() {
585:     return this.logs.filter(l => l.type === 'error').length;
586:   }
587: 
588:   /**
589:    * Uyarı sayısını al
590:    * @returns {number}
591:    */
592:   getWarningCount() {
593:     return this.logs.filter(l => l.type === 'warning').length;
594:   }
595: 
596:   /**
597:    * İstatistikleri al
598:    * @returns {object}
599:    */
600:   getStats() {
601:     const stats: { total: number; byType: Record<string, number>; bySource: Record<string, number>; errors: number; warnings: number } = {
602:       total: this.logs.length,
603:       byType: {},
604:       bySource: {},
605:       errors: 0,
606:       warnings: 0,
607:     };
608:     
609:     for (const log of this.logs) {
610:       stats.byType[log.type] = (stats.byType[log.type] || 0) + 1;
611:       
612:       stats.bySource[log.source] = (stats.bySource[log.source] || 0) + 1;
613:       
614:       if (log.type === 'error') stats.errors++;
615:       if (log.type === 'warning') stats.warnings++;
616:     }
617:     
618:     return stats;
619:   }
620: 
621:   /**
622:    * Logları temizle
623:    */
624:   clear() {
625:     this.logs = [];
626:     this.lastThrottle.clear();
627:   }
628: 
629:   // ============================================================================
630:   // ============================================================================
631: 
632:   LoggerNewSession() {
633:     return this.init();
634:   }
635: 
636:   /**
637:    * @param {string} source
638:    * @param {string} type
639:    * @param {string} message
640:    */
641:   LoggerAddEvent(source: string, type: string, message: string) {
642:     return this.addEvent(source, type, message);
643:   }
644: 
645:   /**
646:    * @param {number} [limit=50]
647:    */
648:   LoggerGetRecent(limit = 50) {
649:     return this.getRecent(limit);
650:   }
651: }

  1: import { LogManager } from "./log-manager.js";
  2: import { FileManager } from "./file-manager.js";
  3: import { getErrorMessage } from "../types/index.js";
  4: 
  5: interface ScreenshotOpts {
  6:   tag?: string;
  7:   format?: string;
  8:   hideCursor?: boolean;
  9:   allowRegionFallback?: boolean;
 10: }
 11: 
 12: interface ScreenshotResult {
 13:   success?: boolean;
 14:   dataUrl?: string;
 15:   data?: string;
 16:   path?: string;
 17: }
 18: 
 19: class ScreenshotManagerClass {
 20:   async captureRegion(selector: string | null, opts: ScreenshotOpts = {}) {
 21:     const bounds = selector ? this.resolveRegion(selector) : null;
 22:     const region = bounds
 23:       ? `${Math.round(bounds.x)};${Math.round(bounds.y)}:${Math.round(bounds.width)};${Math.round(bounds.height)}`
 24:       : "";
 25:     const tag = opts.tag || "region";
 26:     let res = null;
 27:     try {
 28:       if (window.electronAPI?.capturePage) {
 29:         res = await window.electronAPI.capturePage("region", region);
 30:       }
 31:     } catch (err) {
 32:       LogManager.addEvent(
 33:         "screenshot",
 34:         "warning",
 35:         `capturePage başarısız: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`,
 36:       );
 37:     }
 38:     if (!res?.success || !((res as any).dataUrl || res.data)) {
 39:       res = await this.captureSystem("", {
 40:         ...opts,
 41:         allowRegionFallback: false,
 42:       });
 43:     }
 44:     return this.persist(res as ScreenshotResult, tag, opts.format);
 45:   }
 46: 
 47:   async captureWindow(windowId: number, opts: ScreenshotOpts = {}) {
 48:     const tag = opts.tag || `window-${windowId || "main"}`;
 49:     let res = null;
 50:     try {
 51:       if (window.electronAPI?.capturePage) {
 52:         res = await window.electronAPI.capturePage("window", "");
 53:       }
 54:     } catch (err) {
 55:       LogManager.addEvent(
 56:         "screenshot",
 57:         "warning",
 58:         `captureWindow fallback: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`,
 59:       );
 60:     }
 61:     if (!res?.success || !((res as any).dataUrl || res.data)) {
 62:       res = await this.captureSystem("", opts);
 63:     }
 64:     return this.persist(res as ScreenshotResult, tag, opts.format);
 65:   }
 66: 
 67:   async captureSystem(_screenId = "", opts: ScreenshotOpts = {}) {
 68:     const tag = opts.tag || "system";
 69:     try {
 70:       if (window.electronAPI?.screenshotCapture) {
 71:         const res = await window.electronAPI.screenshotCapture({
 72:           region: "",
 73:           hideCursor: opts.hideCursor ?? false,
 74:           format: opts.format || "png",
 75:         });
 76:         return this.persist(res, tag, opts.format);
 77:       }
 78:     } catch (err) {
 79:       LogManager.addEvent(
 80:         "screenshot",
 81:         "error",
 82:         `captureSystem hata: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`,
 83:       );
 84:     }
 85:     try {
 86:       const res = await window.electronAPI?.capturePage?.("full", "");
 87:       return this.persist(res as ScreenshotResult | null, tag, opts.format);
 88:     } catch (err) {
 89:       LogManager.addEvent(
 90:         "screenshot",
 91:         "error",
 92:         `captureSystem fallback hata: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`,
 93:       );
 94:       return "";
 95:     }
 96:   }
 97: 
 98:   resolveRegion(selector: string) {
 99:     if (!selector) return null;
100:     const el = document.querySelector(selector);
101:     if (!el) return null;
102:     const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
103:     return { x: rect.x, y: rect.y, width: rect.width, height: rect.height };
104:   }
105: 
106:   async persist(result: ScreenshotResult | null, tag = "shot", format = "png") {
107:     const dataUrl = result?.dataUrl || result?.data;
108:     if (!result?.success || !dataUrl) {
109:       return "";
110:     }
111:     try {
112:       const ext = (format || "png").toLowerCase() === "jpg" ? "jpg" : "png";
113:       const target = await FileManager.screenshotPath(tag, ext);
114:       if (!target) return "";
115:       const base64 = (dataUrl.split(",")[1] || "").trim();
116:       await FileManager.writeFileAtomic(target, base64, "base64");
117:       LogManager.addEvent(
118:         "screenshot",
119:         "info",
120:         `Screenshot kaydedildi: ${target}`,
121:       );
122:       return target;
123:     } catch (err) {
124:       LogManager.addEvent(
125:         "screenshot",
126:         "error",
127:         `Screenshot yazılamadı: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`,
128:       );
129:       return "";
130:     }
131:   }
132: }
133: 
134: export const ScreenshotManager = new ScreenshotManagerClass();

File: src/js/modules/command-executor.ts

  1: import { WebviewManager } from "./webview-manager.js";
  2: import { FileManager } from "./file-manager.js";
  3: import { LogManager } from "./log-manager.js";
  4: import { TrafficManager } from "./traffic-manager.js";
  5: import { getErrorMessage } from "../types/index.js";
  6: 
  7: interface CommandJob {
  8:   id: string;
  9:   provider: string;
 10:   message?: string;
 11:   attachments?: unknown[];
 12:   attachmentsMeta?: {
 13:     staged?: unknown[];
 14:     temp?: string[];
 15:   };
 16:   meta?: {
 17:     archiveFolders?: Record<string, string>;
 18:     attachments?: unknown[];
 19:   };
 20: }
 21: 
 22: class CommandExecutorClass {
 23:   coreEngine: any;
 24: 
 25:   constructor() {
 26:     this.coreEngine = null;
 27:   }
 28: 
 29:   init(coreEngineInstance: any) {
 30:     this.coreEngine = coreEngineInstance;
 31:   }
 32: 
 33:   async executeJob(job: CommandJob) {
 34:     const startTime = Date.now();
 35:     const hasAttachments = (job.attachments?.length ?? 0) > 0;
 36:     
 37:     LogManager.addEventWithContext(
 38:       "command",
 39:       "info",
 40:       `Job başlatılıyor: ${job.provider}`,
 41:       {
 42:         provider: job.provider,
 43:         hasAttachments,
 44:         attachmentCount: job.attachments?.length || 0,
 45:         messageLength: job.message?.length || 0,
 46:       },
 47:       job.id
 48:     );
 49: 
 50:     const result = await WebviewManager.send({
 51:       provider: job.provider,
 52:       text: job.message || "",
 53:       attachments: job.attachments,
 54:     });
 55: 
 56:     const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
 57: 
 58:     if (!result?.success) {
 59:       LogManager.addEventWithContext(
 60:         "command",
 61:         "error",
 62:         `Job başarısız: ${job.provider} - ${result?.message || "E_WEBVIEW_SEND"}`,
 63:         {
 64:           provider: job.provider,
 65:           duration,
 66:           errorCode: (result as any)?.code || "E_WEBVIEW_SEND",
 67:         },
 68:         job.id
 69:       );
 70:       const err = new Error(result?.message || "E_WEBVIEW_SEND") as Error & { code?: string };
 71:       err.code = (result as any)?.code || "E_WEBVIEW_SEND";
 72:       throw err;
 73:     }
 74:     
 75:     LogManager.addEventWithContext(
 76:       "command",
 77:       "info",
 78:       `Job tamamlandı: ${job.provider} (${duration}ms)`,
 79:       { provider: job.provider, duration },
 80:       job.id
 81:     );
 82:     
 83:     return result;
 84:   }
 85: 
 86:   async handleJobSuccess(job: CommandJob) {
 87:     TrafficManager.signal(job.provider, "sent", job.message || "");
 88:     try {
 89:       const folder = job.meta?.archiveFolders?.[job.provider];
 90:       const stagedFiles =
 91:         job.attachmentsMeta?.staged || job.meta?.attachments || [];
 92: 
 93:       if (folder && stagedFiles.length > 0) {
 94:         WebviewManager.addPendingArchive(job.provider, {
 95:           jobId: job.id,
 96:           folder,
 97:           temp: job.attachmentsMeta?.temp || [],
 98:         } as { jobId: string; folder: string; temp?: string[]; stagedFiles?: unknown[] });
 99:         LogManager.addEvent(
100:           "archive",
101:           "info",
102:           "Archive copy deferred until sync",
103:           {
104:             jobId: job.id,
105:             provider: job.provider,
106:             folder,
107:           },
108:         );
109:       } else {
110:         await FileManager.commandCleanup(
111:           job.id,
112:           (job.attachmentsMeta?.temp || []).map((t: string) => ({ tempPath: t })),
113:         );
114:       }
115:     } catch (err) {
116:       LogManager.addEvent(
117:         "core",
118:         "warning",
119:         `Sync/temizlik hatası: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`,
120:         {
121:           jobId: job.id,
122:         },
123:       );
124:     }
125:   }
126: 
127:   handleJobFailure(job: CommandJob, error: unknown) {
128:     const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
129:     TrafficManager.signal(job.provider, "error", errorMessage);
130:     FileManager.commandFail(job.id, (job.attachmentsMeta?.temp || []).map((t: string) => ({ tempPath: t })));
131:     LogManager.addEvent(
132:       "command",
133:       "error",
134:       `Komut hata: ${job.provider} - ${errorMessage}`,
135:       {
136:         jobId: job.id,
137:       },
138:     );
139:   }
140: }
141: 
142: export const CommandExecutor = new CommandExecutorClass();

  1: import { LogManager } from "./log-manager.js";
  2: import { getErrorMessage } from "../types/index.js";
  3: import { getExtension, getMimeType, getFilename, generateUniqueId } from "../constants/index.js";
  4: 
  5: // ============================================================================
  6: // Types
  7: // ============================================================================
  8: 
  9: /** Dosya girişi tipi */
 10: interface FileEntry {
 11:   name?: string;
 12:   originalName?: string;
 13:   path?: string;
 14:   tempPath?: string;
 15:   commandPath?: string;
 16: }
 17: 
 18: /** Okuma sonucu */
 19: interface ReadResult {
 20:   name: string;
 21:   base64: string;
 22:   mimeType: string;
 23: }
 24: 
 25: /** Stage sonucu */
 26: interface StageResult {
 27:   staged: unknown[];
 28:   temp: string[];
 29:   commandDir: string;
 30: }
 31: 
 32: // ============================================================================
 33: // FileManagerClass
 34: // ============================================================================
 35: 
 36: class FileManagerClass {
 37:   paths: Record<string, string>;
 38: 
 39:   constructor() {
 40:     this.paths = {};
 41:   }
 42: 
 43:   async ensureDirs(scope = "all"): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
 44:     try {
 45:       const res = await window.electronAPI?.fmEnsureDirs?.(scope) as { success: boolean; message?: string; paths?: Record<string, string> } | undefined;
 46:       if (!res?.success) throw new Error(res?.message || "ensureDirs failed");
 47:       if (res.paths && typeof res.paths === "object") {
 48:         this.paths = { ...this.paths, ...res.paths };
 49:       }
 50:       return res.paths || {};
 51:     } catch (err) {
 52:       const error = /** @type {Error} */ (err);
 53:       LogManager.addEvent("file", "error", `ensureDirs hata: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`);
 54:       return {};
 55:     }
 56:   }
 57: 
 58:   getPath(scope: string): string {
 59:     return this.paths[scope] || "";
 60:   }
 61: 
 62:   async readUploadFiles(filterNames: (FileEntry | string)[] = []): Promise<ReadResult[]> {
 63:     const results: ReadResult[] = [];
 64: 
 65:     // Sequential read (batch read kaldırıldı - readFilesMulti implement değil)
 66:     for (const entry of filterNames) {
 67:       const entryObj = typeof entry === "string" ? { path: entry } : entry;
 68:       const base = entryObj?.name || getFilename(entryObj?.path || "");
 69:       const path = entryObj?.path || entryObj?.tempPath || entryObj?.commandPath;
 70:       if (!base || !path) continue;
 71:       try {
 72:         const data = await window.electronAPI?.readFile?.(path);
 73:         if (!data) continue;
 74:         const ext = getExtension(base);
 75:         const mimeType = getMimeType(ext);
 76:         results.push({ name: base, base64: data, mimeType });
 77:       } catch (err) {
 78:         const error = err as Error;
 79:         LogManager.addEvent("file", "warning", `Dosya okunamadı: ${path}`, {
 80:           error: error?.message,
 81:         });
 82:       }
 83:     }
 84:     return results;
 85:   }
 86: 
 87:   async stageCommandFiles(jobId: string, names: (FileEntry | string)[] = []): Promise<StageResult> {
 88:     if (!jobId) return { staged: [], temp: [], commandDir: "" };
 89:     const payload = {
 90:       jobId,
 91:       files: names
 92:         .map((n) =>
 93:           typeof n === "string" ? n : n?.path || n?.commandPath || n?.name,
 94:         )
 95:         .filter((f): f is string => Boolean(f)),
 96:     };
 97:     const stagedRes = await window.electronAPI?.commandStageAttachments?.(payload) as { success?: boolean; message?: string; staged?: unknown[]; temp?: string[]; commandDir?: string } | undefined;
 98:     if (!stagedRes?.success) {
 99:       LogManager.addEvent(
100:         "file",
101:         "error",
102:         `commandStageAttachments hata: ${stagedRes?.message || "bilinmiyor"}`,
103:         { jobId },
104:       );
105:       return { staged: [], temp: [], commandDir: "" };
106:     }
107:     return {
108:       staged: stagedRes.staged || [],
109:       temp: [],
110:       commandDir: stagedRes.commandDir || "",
111:     };
112:   }
113: 
114:   async commandArchiveCopy(jobId: string, targetDir: string): Promise<{ success?: boolean; message?: string }> {
115:     if (!jobId || !targetDir)
116:       return { success: false, message: "parametre eksik" };
117:     const res = await window.electronAPI?.commandArchiveCopy?.({
118:       jobId,
119:       targetDir,
120:     }) as { success?: boolean; message?: string } | undefined;
121:     if (!res?.success) {
122:       LogManager.addEvent(
123:         "file",
124:         "warning",
125:         `commandArchiveCopy başarısız: ${res?.message || "bilinmiyor"}`,
126:         { jobId, targetDir },
127:       );
128:     }
129:     return res || { success: false };
130:   }
131: 
132:   async commandCleanup(jobId: string, tempEntries: { tempPath?: string }[] = []): Promise<void> {
133:     const tempPaths = (tempEntries || [])
134:       .map((t) => t.tempPath)
135:       .filter((p): p is string => Boolean(p));
136:     await window.electronAPI
137:       ?.commandCleanupJob?.({ jobId, tempPaths })
138:       .catch(() => {
139:         // Ignore cleanup errors
140:       });
141:   }
142: 
143:   async commandFail(jobId: string, tempEntries: { tempPath?: string }[] = []): Promise<{ success?: boolean; message?: string } | undefined> {
144:     const tempPaths = (tempEntries || [])
145:       .map((t) => t.tempPath)
146:       .filter((p): p is string => Boolean(p));
147:     const res = await window.electronAPI?.commandMoveFailed?.({
148:       jobId,
149:       tempPaths,
150:     }) as { success?: boolean; message?: string } | undefined;
151:     if (!res?.success) {
152:       LogManager.addEvent(
153:         "file",
154:         "warning",
155:         `commandMoveFailed başarısız: ${res?.message || "bilinmiyor"}`,
156:         { jobId },
157:       );
158:     }
159:     return res;
160:   }
161: 
162:   async writeFileAtomic(path: string, data: string | Uint8Array | unknown, encoding = "utf-8"): Promise<string> {
163:     try {
164:       let payload;
165:       if (typeof data === "string") {
166:         payload = { path, data, encoding };
167:       } else if (data instanceof Uint8Array) {
168:         const base64 = btoa(
169:           Array.from(data)
170:             .map((b) => String.fromCharCode(b))
171:             .join(""),
172:         );
173:         payload = { path, data: base64, encoding: "base64" };
174:       } else {
175:         const textEncoder = new TextEncoder();
176:         const bytes = textEncoder.encode(String(data || ""));
177:         const base64 = btoa(
178:           Array.from(bytes)
179:             .map((b) => String.fromCharCode(b))
180:             .join(""),
181:         );
182:         payload = { path, data: base64, encoding: "base64" };
183:       }
184:       const res = await window.electronAPI?.fmWriteFileAtomic?.(payload);
185:       if (!res?.success) {
186:         throw new Error(res?.message || "writeFileAtomic failed");
187:       }
188:       return res.path || "";
189:     } catch (err) {
190:       const error = /** @type {Error} */ (err);
191:       LogManager.addEvent(
192:         "file",
193:         "error",
194:         `writeFileAtomic hata: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`,
195:       );
196:       return "";
197:     }
198:   }
199: 
200:   async tempPath(prefix = "tmp", ext = "tmp") {
201:     try {
202:       const res = /** @type {{ path: string }} */ (
203:         await window.electronAPI?.fmTempPath?.(prefix, ext)
204:       );
205:       return res?.path || "";
206:     } catch (err) {
207:       const error = /** @type {Error} */ (err);
208:       LogManager.addEvent("file", "error", `tempPath hata: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`);
209:       return "";
210:     }
211:   }
212: 
213:   async screenshotPath(tag = "shot", ext = "png") {
214:     const dirs = await this.ensureDirs("commands");
215:     const baseDir = dirs.commands || this.getPath("commands") || "";
216:     if (!baseDir) {
217:       return "";
218:     }
219:     const cleanTag = (tag || "shot").replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, "_");
220:     const filename = generateUniqueId(cleanTag) + "." + ext;
221:     return `${baseDir}/screenshots/${filename}`;
222:   }
223: 
224: }
225:

  1: /**
  2:  * Meta Command Manager - Renderer Process
  3:  * 
  4:  * AI'ların dinamik olarak yeni komutlar tanımlamasını sağlar.
  5:  * Komutlar JavaScript kodu olarak saklanır ve çalıştırılır.
  6:  * 
  7:  * Komut Formatı:
  8:  * ++meta:DefineCommand(KomutAdi, "açıklama", `
  9:  *   async function(args, context) {
 10:  *     // context: { LogManager, AppState, TrafficManager, ... }
 11:  *     return { success: true, result: "..." };
 12:  *   }
 13:  * `)
 14:  * 
 15:  * ++meta:DeleteCommand(KomutAdi)
 16:  * ++meta:ListCommands()
 17:  */
 18: 
 19: import { LogManager } from "./log-manager.js";
 20: import { AppState } from "./app-state.js";
 21: import { TrafficManager } from "./traffic-manager.js";
 22: import { SlotController } from "./slot-controller.js";
 23: import { WebviewManager } from "./webview-manager.js";
 24: import { RelayManager } from "./relay-manager.js";
 25: 
 26: // ============================================================================
 27: // Types
 28: // ============================================================================
 29: 
 30: interface CustomCommand {
 31:   name: string;
 32:   description: string;
 33:   code: string;
 34:   createdAt?: number;
 35:   createdBy?: string;
 36: }
 37: 
 38: interface CommandResult {
 39:   success: boolean;
 40:   message?: string;
 41:   error?: string;
 42:   result?: unknown;
 43:   command?: CustomCommand;
 44:   commands?: Record<string, CustomCommand>;
 45: }
 46: 
 47: type CompiledHandler = (args: unknown[], context: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown>;
 48: 
 49: // ============================================================================
 50: // State
 51: // ============================================================================
 52: 
 53: // Runtime'da yüklenen custom komutlar
 54: let _customCommands: Record<string, CustomCommand> = {};
 55: let _compiledHandlers: Record<string, CompiledHandler> = {};
 56: 
 57: // ============================================================================
 58: // Functions
 59: // ============================================================================
 60: 
 61: /**
 62:  * Context objesi - custom komutlara geçirilir
 63:  */
 64: function createContext(): Record<string, unknown> {
 65:   return {
 66:     LogManager,
 67:     AppState,
 68:     TrafficManager,
 69:     SlotController,
 70:     WebviewManager,
 71:     RelayManager,
 72:     // Utility fonksiyonlar
 73:     delay: (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)),
 74:     log: (msg: string) => LogManager.addEvent("custom-cmd", "info", msg),
 75:     error: (msg: string) => LogManager.addEvent("custom-cmd", "error", msg),
 76:   };
 77: }
 78: 
 79: /**
 80:  * Komut kodunu derle ve handler oluştur
 81:  */
 82: function compileCommand(name: string, code: string): CompiledHandler | null {
 83:   try {
 84:     // Kodu Function constructor ile derle (güvenlik kısıtlaması yok - tam yetki)
 85:     const fn = new Function("args", "context", `
 86:       return (async function() {
 87:         ${code}
 88:       })();
 89:     `);
 90: 
 91:     LogManager.addEvent("meta-command", "info", `Komut derlendi: ${name}`);
 92:     return fn as CompiledHandler;
 93:   } catch (err) {
 94:     LogManager.addEvent("meta-command", "error", `Komut derleme hatası (${name}): ${(err as Error).message}`);
 95:     return null;
 96:   }
 97: }
 98: 
 99: /**
100:  * Custom komutları electron'dan yükle
101:  */
102: async function loadCommands(): Promise<void> {
103:   try {
104:     const result = await window.electronAPI?.metaListCommands?.() as CommandResult | undefined;
105:     if (result?.success && result.commands) {
106:       _customCommands = result.commands;
107: 
108:       // Tüm komutları derle
109:       _compiledHandlers = {};
110:       for (const [name, cmd] of Object.entries(_customCommands)) {
111:         const handler = compileCommand(name, cmd.code);
112:         if (handler) {
113:           _compiledHandlers[name.toLowerCase()] = handler;
114:         }
115:       }
116: 
117:       LogManager.addEvent("meta-command", "info", `${Object.keys(_customCommands).length} custom komut yüklendi`, { visibility: 2 });
118:     }
119:   } catch (err) {
120:     LogManager.addEvent("meta-command", "error", `loadCommands hatası: ${(err as Error).message}`);
121:   }
122: }
123: 
124: /**
125:  * Yeni komut tanımla
126:  */
127: async function defineCommand(
128:   name: string,
129:   description: string,
130:   code: string,
131:   createdBy = "unknown"
132: ): Promise<CommandResult> {
133:   try {
134:     // Önce kodu test et (derleme hatası var mı?)
135:     const testHandler = compileCommand(name, code);
136:     if (!testHandler) {
137:       return { success: false, error: "Kod derleme hatası" };
138:     }
139: 
140:     // Electron'a kaydet
141:     const result = await window.electronAPI?.metaDefineCommand?.({
142:       name,
143:       description,
144:       code,
145:       createdBy,
146:     }) as { success?: boolean; command?: string; error?: string } | undefined;
147: 
148:     if (result?.success && result.command) {
149:       // Runtime cache'i güncelle
150:       _customCommands[name] = result.command as unknown as CustomCommand;
151:       _compiledHandlers[name.toLowerCase()] = testHandler;
152: 
153:       LogManager.addEvent("meta-command", "info", `Komut tanımlandı: ${name}`);
154:     }
155: 
156:     return (result as CommandResult) || { success: false, error: "API hatası" };
157:   } catch (err) {
158:     LogManager.addEvent("meta-command", "error", `defineCommand hatası: ${(err as Error).message}`);
159:     return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
160:   }
161: }
162: 
163: /**
164:  * Komutu sil
165:  */
166: async function deleteCommand(name: string): Promise<CommandResult> {
167:   try {
168:     const result = await window.electronAPI?.metaDeleteCommand?.({ name }) as { success?: boolean; error?: string } | undefined;
169: 
170:     if (result?.success) {
171:       // Runtime cache'den kaldır
172:       const key = Object.keys(_customCommands).find(
173:         (k) => k.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()
174:       );
175:       if (key) {
176:         delete _customCommands[key];
177:         delete _compiledHandlers[key.toLowerCase()];
178:       }
179: 
180:       LogManager.addEvent("meta-command", "info", `Komut silindi: ${name}`);
181:     }
182: 
183:     return (result as CommandResult) || { success: false, error: "API hatası" };
184:   } catch (err) {
185:     LogManager.addEvent("meta-command", "error", `deleteCommand hatası: ${(err as Error).message}`);
186:     return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
187:   }
188: }
189: 
190: /**
191:  * Tüm custom komutları listele
192:  */
193: function listCommands(): Record<string, CustomCommand> {
194:   return { ..._customCommands };
195: }
196: 
197: /**
198:  * Custom komut var mı kontrol et
199:  */
200: function hasCommand(name: string): boolean {
201:   return !!_compiledHandlers[name.toLowerCase()];
202: }
203: 
204: /**
205:  * Custom komutu çalıştır
206:  */
207: async function runCommand(name: string, args: unknown[] = []): Promise<CommandResult> {
208:   const handler = _compiledHandlers[name.toLowerCase()];
209: 
210:   if (!handler) {
211:     return { success: false, error: `Custom komut bulunamadı: ${name}` };
212:   }
213: 
214:   try {
215:     LogManager.addEvent("meta-command", "info", `Çalıştırılıyor: ${name}(${args.join(", ")})`);
216: 
217:     const context = createContext();
218:     const result = await handler(args, context);
219: 
220:     LogManager.addEvent("meta-command", "info", `Tamamlandı: ${name}`);
221: 
222:     return { success: true, result };
223:   } catch (err) {
224:     LogManager.addEvent("meta-command", "error", `Çalıştırma hatası (${name}): ${(err as Error).message}`);
225:     return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message };
226:   }
227: }
228: 
229: /**
230:  * Custom komut isimlerini döndür (ServerCommands için)
231:  */
232: function getCommandNames(): string[] {
233:   return Object.keys(_customCommands);
234: }
235: 
236: /**
237:  * MetaCommandManager export
238:  */
239: export const MetaCommandManager = {
240:   loadCommands,
241:   defineCommand,
242:   deleteCommand,
243:   listCommands,
244:   hasCommand,
245:   runCommand,
246:   getCommandNames,
247: };

126:   async _onTrafficUpdate(snapshot: { provider?: string; state?: { thinkingState?: string } }) {
127:     try {
128:       const provider = snapshot?.provider;
129:       if (!provider) return;
130: 
131:       const state = snapshot?.state || {};
132:       const currentThinking = state.thinkingState || "idle";
133: 
134:       let activeRelay = null;
135:       let thinkingComplete = false;
136: 
137:       // Önce AI-Asistan relay'i kontrol et
138:       if (this._aiAsistanRelay?.handlesProvider(provider)) {
139:         activeRelay = this._aiAsistanRelay;
140:         thinkingComplete = activeRelay.checkThinkingTransition(provider, currentThinking);
141:       }
142:       // Sonra AI-AI relay'i kontrol et
143:       else if (this._aiaiRelay?.handlesProvider(provider)) {
144:         activeRelay = this._aiaiRelay;
145:         thinkingComplete = activeRelay.checkThinkingTransition(provider, currentThinking);
146:       }
147: 
148:       if (activeRelay && thinkingComplete) {
149:         const syncResult = await WebviewManager.syncConversation(provider, null, {});
150:         await activeRelay.handleThinkingComplete(provider, syncResult);
151:       }
152: 
153:     } catch (err) {
154:       LogManager.addEventWithContext(
155:         "relay",
156:         "warning",
157:         `Traffic update handler error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`,
158:         { provider: snapshot?.provider, error: getErrorMessage(err) }
159:       );
160:     }
161:   }
162: 
163:   // ==========================================

  1: import {
  2:   defaultSettings,
  3:   normalizeSettings,
  4:   getChangedPaths,
  5: } from "./settings/settings-schema.js";
  6: import {
  7:   Emitter,
  8:   createSettingsBroadcast,
  9: } from "./settings/settings-events.js";
 10: import { ipcLoadSettings, ipcSaveSettings } from "./settings/settings-ipc.js";
 11: import { LogManager } from "./log-manager.js";
 12: 
 13: function deepClone<T>(obj: T): T {
 14:   return obj ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj)) : obj;
 15: }
 16: 
 17: function setByPath(obj: Record<string, unknown>, path: string, value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
 18:   const parts = String(path || "")
 19:     .split(".")
 20:     .filter(Boolean);
 21:   if (!parts.length) return obj;
 22:   let cur: Record<string, unknown> = obj;
 23:   for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) {
 24:     const p = parts[i];
 25:     if (!cur[p] || typeof cur[p] !== "object") cur[p] = {};
 26:     cur = cur[p] as Record<string, unknown>;
 27:   }
 28:   cur[parts[parts.length - 1]] = value;
 29:   return obj;
 30: }
 31: 
 32: /** Settings broadcast interface */
 33: interface SettingsBroadcast {
 34:   on: (callback: (msg: unknown) => void) => () => void;
 35:   post: (msg: unknown) => void;
 36: }
 37: 
 38:  
 39: type SettingsData = any;
 40: 
 41: class SettingsManagerClass {
 42:   _settings: SettingsData;
 43:   _loaded: boolean;
 44:   _emitter: Emitter;
 45:   _lastSaved: SettingsData;
 46:   _broadcast: SettingsBroadcast;
 47:   _stopBroadcast: () => void;
 48: 
 49:   constructor() {
 50:     this._settings = defaultSettings();
 51:     this._loaded = false;
 52:     this._emitter = new Emitter();
 53:     this._lastSaved = defaultSettings();
 54:     this._broadcast = createSettingsBroadcast("hayalet-settings");
 55:     this._stopBroadcast = this._broadcast.on((data) => {
 56:       const msg = data as { type?: string; payload?: unknown };
 57:       if (!msg || msg.type !== "settings-changed") {
 58:         return;
 59:       }
 60:       
 61:       if (msg.payload && typeof msg.payload === "object") {
 62:         const next = normalizeSettings(msg.payload);
 63:         const changedPaths = getChangedPaths(this._settings, next);
 64:         
 65:         this._settings = next;
 66:         this._loaded = true;
 67:         
 68:         this._emitter.emit({ settings: this._settings, changedPaths });
 69:       }
 70:     });
 71:   }
 72: 
 73:   getSnapshot() {
 74:     return this._settings;
 75:   }
 76: 
 77:   get settings() {
 78:     return this._settings;
 79:   }
 80: 
 81:   async load(options: { force?: boolean } = {}) {
 82:     const force = !!options.force;
 83:     
 84:     if (this._loaded && !force) {
 85:       return this._settings;
 86:     }
 87:     
 88:     const loaded = await ipcLoadSettings();
 89:     this._settings = normalizeSettings(loaded);
 90:     
 91:     this._lastSaved = this._settings;
 92:     this._loaded = true;
 93:     
 94:     this._emitter.emit({ settings: this._settings, changedPaths: ["*"] });
 95:     this._broadcast.post({ type: "settings-changed", payload: this._settings });
 96:     
 97:     return this._settings;
 98:   }
 99: 
100:   async reload() {
101:     return await this.load({ force: true });
102:   }
103: 
104:   get(path?: string) {
105:     if (!path) return this._settings;
106:     const parts = String(path).split(".");
107:     let cur = this._settings;
108:     for (const p of parts) cur = cur?.[p];
109:     return cur;
110:   }
111: 
112:   subscribe(listener: (event: { settings: unknown; changedPaths: string[] }) => void) {
113:     return this._emitter.on(listener);
114:   }
115: 
116:   async save(nextSettings: Record<string, unknown>) {
117:     const next = normalizeSettings(nextSettings);
118:     const changedPaths = getChangedPaths(this._lastSaved, next);
119:     
120:     this._settings = next;
121:     this._loaded = true;
122:     
123:     await ipcSaveSettings(next);
124:     
125:     this._lastSaved = next;
126:     
127:     this._emitter.emit({ settings: this._settings, changedPaths });
128:     this._broadcast.post({ type: "settings-changed", payload: this._settings });
129:     
130:     return true;
131:   }
132: 
133:   async set(path: string, value: unknown) {
134:     const next = deepClone(this._settings);
135:     setByPath(next, path, value);
136:     return await this.save(next);
137:   }
138: 
139:   async patch(fnOrPartial: ((settings: Record<string, unknown>) => void) | Record<string, unknown>) {
140:     const next = deepClone(this._settings);
141:     if (typeof fnOrPartial === "function") {
142:       fnOrPartial(next);
143:     } else if (fnOrPartial && typeof fnOrPartial === "object") {
144:       Object.assign(next, fnOrPartial);
145:     }
146:     return await this.save(next);
147:   }
148: 
149:   async resetToDefaults() {
150:     LogManager.addEvent("settings", "warning", "resetToDefaults() called - resetting all settings to default values");
151:     const defaults = defaultSettings();
152:     return await this.save(defaults);
153:   }
154: }
155: 
156: export const SettingsManager = new SettingsManagerClass();

  1: /**
  2:  * TrafficManager - Webview traffic gösterge takibi (Orchestrator)
  3:  * 
  4:  * Alt modüller:
  5:  * - traffic/loading-tracker.js: Sayfa yükleme durumu
  6:  * - traffic/thinking-tracker.js: AI thinking durumu
  7:  * - traffic/send-tracker.js: Send button durumu
  8:  * - traffic/probe-script-builder.js: Probe script oluşturucu
  9:  * - traffic/webview-events.js: Webview event yönetimi

103:   skipNextLoadingFor(provider: string) {
104:     if (provider && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this._skipNextLoading, provider)) {
105:       this._skipNextLoading[provider] = true;
106:       // 5 saniye sonra otomatik reset (güvenlik için)
107:       setTimeout(() => {
108:         this._skipNextLoading[provider] = false;
109:       }, 5000);
110:     }

170:   attachWebview(provider: string, webviewEl: HTMLElement & { isDestroyed?: () => boolean; getWebContentsId?: () => number; isLoading?: () => boolean; getWebContents?: () => { isLoading?: () => boolean }; executeJavaScript?: (script: string) => Promise<unknown> }) {
171:     if (!provider || !webviewEl) return;
172:     this.webviews[provider] = webviewEl;
173: 
174:     if (hasHandlers(provider)) return;
175: 
176:     attachWebviewEvents(provider, webviewEl as any, {
177:       onNavigation: (prov: string, href: string) => this._handleNavigation(prov, href),
178:       onDomReady: () => {},
179:       onFailLoad: (prov: string) => this.setAllUnreachable(prov),
180:       buildProbeScript,
181:     });
182:   }

185:     if (!provider) return;
186:     detachWebviewEvents(provider);
187:     this.setAllUnreachable(provider);
188:   }

190:   _handleNavigation(provider: string, href: string) {
191:     if (this.isUrlExcluded(provider, href)) return;
192: 
193:     const viewState = this.state[provider] || defaultState();
194: 
195:     if (href && href !== viewState.lastHref) {
196:       const previousHref = viewState.lastHref;
197:       viewState.lastHref = href;
198:       
199:       // Default page'den conversation page'e geçiş kontrolü
200:       const providerId = AppState.getProviderIdForSlot(provider) || "";
201:       const wasOnDefaultPage = isDefaultPage(previousHref, providerId);
202:       const isOnDefaultPage = isDefaultPage(href, providerId);
203:       
204:       // Skip flag aktifse (mesaj gönderiminden kaynaklı URL değişimi)
205:       if (this._skipNextLoading[provider] && wasOnDefaultPage && !isOnDefaultPage) {
206:         this._skipNextLoading[provider] = false;
207:         this.state[provider] = viewState;
208:         // Loading başlatma, sadece thinking tracker takip edecek
209:         return;
210:       }
211:       
212:       this.loadingTracker.startLoading(viewState, Date.now());
213:       this.state[provider] = viewState;
214:       this.setIndicator(provider, "loading", "busy");
215:     }
216:   }

221:   async start(provider: string) {
222:     if (!provider) return;
223:     if (this._runners[provider]) return;
224:     this._runners[provider] = {
225:       startedAt: Date.now(),
226:       backoffMs: TIMING_CONFIG.pollIntervalMs,
227:       nextProbeAt: Date.now(),
228:       probing: false, // Race condition fix: probe lock flag
229:     };
230:     this.startPolling();
231:     this.setIndicator(provider, "loading", this.state[provider]?.status?.loading || "busy");
232:   }
233: 
234:   async stop(provider: string, { force: _force = false } = {}) {
235:     if (!provider) return;
236:     if (!this._runners[provider]) return;
237:     try {
238:       delete this._runners[provider];
239:       this.setAllUnreachable(provider);
240:     } catch (err) {
241:       LogManager.addEvent("traffic", "error", `TrafficManager.stop error for ${provider}: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`);
242:     }
243:     if (Object.keys(this._runners).length === 0 && this.pollTimer) {
244:       try { clearTimeout(this.pollTimer); } catch (_) { void 0; }
245:       this.pollTimer = null;
246:     }
247:   }
248: 
249:   // ============================================
250:   // ============================================
251: 
252:   startPolling() {
253:     if (this.pollTimer) return;
254:     const loop = async () => {
255:       try {
256:         const now = Date.now();
257:         const providers = Object.keys(this.webviews || {});
258:         for (const provider of providers) {
259:           const runner = this._runners[provider];
260:           if (!runner) continue;
261:           if (now < (runner.nextProbeAt || 0)) continue;
262:           // Race condition fix: Skip if already probing this provider
263:           if (runner.probing) continue;
264:           
265:           try {
266:             runner.probing = true; // Lock
267:             const ok = await this.probe(provider);
268:             if (ok) {
269:               runner.backoffMs = TIMING_CONFIG.pollIntervalMs;
270:             } else {
271:               runner.backoffMs = Math.min((runner.backoffMs || TIMING_CONFIG.pollIntervalMs) * 2, INTERVALS.BACKOFF_MAX);
272:             }
273:             runner.nextProbeAt = Date.now() + (runner.backoffMs || TIMING_CONFIG.pollIntervalMs);
274:           } catch (_) {
275:             runner.backoffMs = Math.min((runner.backoffMs || TIMING_CONFIG.pollIntervalMs) * 2, INTERVALS.BACKOFF_MAX);
276:             runner.nextProbeAt = Date.now() + (runner.backoffMs || TIMING_CONFIG.pollIntervalMs);
277:           } finally {
278:             runner.probing = false; // Unlock
279:           }
280:         }
281:       } catch (_err) {
282:       } finally {
283:         this.pollTimer = setTimeout(loop, Math.max(250, Math.floor(TIMING_CONFIG.pollIntervalMs / 4)));
284:       }
285:     };
286:     loop();
287:   }
288: 
289:   async probe(provider: string) {
290:     if (!provider) return;
291:     const webview = this.webviews[provider];
292:     if (!webview || webview.isDestroyed?.()) return;
293:     
294:     // FIX: Webview'ın DOM'a attach olup olmadığını kontrol et
295:     // getWebContentsId yoksa veya hata veriyorsa webview henüz hazır değil
296:     try {
297:       if (typeof webview.getWebContentsId !== "function") {
298:         return false;
299:       }
300:       // getWebContentsId çağrısı webview hazır değilse hata fırlatır
301:       webview.getWebContentsId();
302:     } catch (_) {
303:       // Webview henüz DOM'a attach olmamış, sessizce geç
304:       return false;
305:     }
306:     
307:     const viewState = this.state[provider] || defaultState();
308:     if (viewState.polling) return;
309:     viewState.polling = true;
310:     this.state[provider] = viewState;
311:     try {
312:       const script = buildProbeScript(provider);
313:       const isLoading = typeof webview.isLoading === "function"
314:         ? webview.isLoading()
315:         : typeof webview.getWebContents === "function"
316:           ? !!webview.getWebContents()?.isLoading?.()
317:           : false;
318:       
319:       // isLoading true ise executeJavaScript çağırma
320:       if (isLoading) {
321:         return false;
322:       }
323:       
324:       const result = await webview.executeJavaScript(script, true);
325:       const ok = await this.handleProbe(provider, result, isLoading);
326:       return !!ok;
327:     } catch (_) {
328:       this.setAllUnreachable(provider);
329:       return false;
330:     } finally {
331:       viewState.polling = false;
332:       this.state[provider] = viewState;
333:     }
334:   }
335: 
336:   // ============================================
337:   // ============================================
338: 
339:   async handleProbe(provider: string, data: { error?: string; href?: string; sendState?: string; thinkingState?: string; thinkingText?: string; messageCount?: number } | null, isStillLoading = false) {
340:     if (!this.state[provider]) {
341:       this.state[provider] = defaultState();
342:     }
343:     let viewState = this.state[provider];
344: 
345:     if (!data || data.error) {
346:       LogManager.addEvent("traffic", "warn", `probe data error for ${provider}: ${String(data?.error || "no-data")}`);
347:       this.setAllUnreachable(provider);
348:       return false;
349:     }
350: 
351:     if (isStillLoading) {
352:       return;
353:     }
354: 
355:     const currentHref = normalizeHref(data.href);
356: 
357:     if (this.isUrlExcluded(provider, currentHref)) {
358:       this.setIndicator(provider, "loading", "idle");
359:       this.setIndicator(provider, "thinking", "idle");
360:       this.setIndicator(provider, "send", "idle");
361:       return false;
362:     }
363: 
364:     const now = Date.now();
365:     const webview = this.webviews[provider];
366: 
367:     const loadingResult = await this.loadingTracker.handleProbe(provider, viewState, data, now, webview, currentHref);
368:     viewState = loadingResult.newState;
369:     this.setIndicator(provider, "loading", loadingResult.indicator);
370:     if (loadingResult.event) {
371:       this.logEvent(loadingResult.event);
372:       if (loadingResult.event.type === "loading-ended") {
373:         setTimeout(() => {
374:           try {
375:             const st = this.state[provider] || defaultState();
376:             this.loadingTracker.clearJustEnded(st);
377:             this.state[provider] = st;
378:           } catch (_) { void 0; }
379:         }, DELAYS.STATE_CLEAR);
380:       }
381:     }
382: 
383:     const thinkingResult = this.thinkingTracker.handleProbe(provider, viewState, data, now);
384:     viewState = thinkingResult.newState;
385:     this.setIndicator(provider, "thinking", thinkingResult.indicator);
386:     if (thinkingResult.event) {
387:       this.logEvent(thinkingResult.event);
388:       if (thinkingResult.event.type === "thinking-ended") {
389:         setTimeout(() => {
390:           try {
391:             const st = this.state[provider] || defaultState();
392:             this.thinkingTracker.clearJustEnded(st);
393:             this.state[provider] = st;
394:           } catch (_) { void 0; }
395:         }, DELAYS.STATE_CLEAR);
396:       }
397:     }
398: 
399:     const sendResult = this.sendTracker.handleProbe(provider, viewState, data, now);
400:     viewState = sendResult.newState;
401:     this.setIndicator(provider, "send", sendResult.indicator);
402: 
403:     this.state[provider] = viewState;
404:     return true;
405:   }
406: 
407:   logEvent(event: { message: string }) {
408:     try {
409:       LogManager.addEvent("traffic", "info", event.message);
410:     } catch (_) { /* noop */ }
411:   }
412:

414:   // ============================================

416:   refreshIndicators(provider: string) {
417:     if (!provider) return;
418:     const st = this.state[provider] || defaultState();
419:     this.setIndicator(provider, "loading", st.status.loading);
420:     this.setIndicator(provider, "thinking", st.status.thinking);
421:     this.setIndicator(provider, "send", st.status.send);
422:   }
423: 
424:   setIndicator(provider: string, kind: string, status: string) {
425:     if (!provider) return;
426:     if (!this.state[provider]) {
427:       this.state[provider] = defaultState();
428:     }
429:     const viewState = this.state[provider];
430:     viewState.status = { ...viewState.status, [kind]: status };
431:     this.state[provider] = viewState;
432:     this.updateDerivedStates(provider);
433: 
434:     const dot = this.indicators[provider]?.[kind];
435:     if (dot) {
436:       const color = STATUS_COLORS[status as keyof typeof STATUS_COLORS] || STATUS_COLORS.busy;
437:       dot.style.display = "inline-block";
438:       dot.style.backgroundColor = color;
439:       
440:       // Loading ve thinking için sadece busy (kırmızı) durumunda pulse animasyonu
441:       if (kind === "loading" || kind === "thinking") {
442:         if (status === "busy") {
443:           dot.classList.add("is-busy");
444:         } else {
445:           dot.classList.remove("is-busy");
446:         }
447:       }
448:     }
449:     
450:     // Thinking durumunda cluster'a glow efekti ekle/kaldır
451:     if (kind === "thinking") {
452:       this._updateClusterThinkingGlow(provider, status);
453:     }
454:     
455:     this.notifyListeners(provider);
456: 
457:   }
458: 
459:   /**
460:    * Cluster'a thinking glow efekti ekle/kaldır
461:    * @param {string} provider - ai0, ai1, ai2
462:    * @param {string} status - busy veya idle
463:    */
464:   _updateClusterThinkingGlow(provider: string, status: string) {
465:     const cluster = document.getElementById(`cluster-${provider}`);
466:     if (!cluster) return;
467:     
468:     if (status === "busy") {
469:       cluster.classList.add("thinking-active");
470:     } else {
471:       cluster.classList.remove("thinking-active");
472:     }
473:   }
474: 
475:   setAllUnreachable(provider: string) {
476:     this.setIndicator(provider, "loading", "idle");
477:     this.setIndicator(provider, "thinking", "idle");
478:     this.setIndicator(provider, "send", "busy");
479:     const st = this.state[provider] || defaultState();
480:     st.loadingActive = false;
481:     this.state[provider] = st;
482:   }
483: 
484:   updateDerivedStates(provider: string) {
485:     const st = this.state[provider] || defaultState();
486:     st.readyState = st.status.loading === "idle" ? "ready" : "loading";
487:     st.sendState = st.status.send === "idle" ? "enabled" : st.status.send === "busy" ? "disabled" : "not-found";
488:     st.thinkingState = st.status.thinking === "busy" ? "thinking" : "idle";
489:     this.state[provider] = st;
490:   }

497:       () => this.state[provider] || defaultState(),
498:       timeout,
499:       interval
500:     );
501:   }
502: 
503:   waitForThinkingCoolDown(provider: string, coolDownMs = 5000, timeoutMs = 45000) {
504:     const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
505:     const waitIdle = () =>
506:       new Promise((resolve) => {
507:         const tick = () => {
508:           const st = this.state[provider] || defaultState();
509:           if (st.status.thinking !== "busy") {
510:             resolve(true);
511:             return;
512:           }
513:           if (Date.now() > deadline) {
514:             resolve(false);
515:             return;
516:           }
517:           setTimeout(tick, INTERVALS.THINKING_TICK);
518:         };
519:         tick();
520:       });
521:     return waitIdle().then(async () => {
522:       if (coolDownMs > 0) {
523:         await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, coolDownMs));
524:       }
525:       return true;
526:     });
527:   }
528:

530:   // ============================================
531: 
532:   signal(channel: string, status: string, message = "") {
533:     if (status === "error") {
534:       LogManager.addEvent("traffic", "error", `[${channel}] ${message || status}`);
535:     }
536:     this.listeners.forEach((listener) => {
537:       try {
538:         listener({ channel, status, message });
539:       } catch (_err) {
540:       }
541:     });
542:   }
543: }

 14: function formatTimestamp(timestamp: number | undefined): string {
 15:   if (!timestamp) return "";
 16:   const d = new Date(timestamp);
 17:   return d.toLocaleString("tr-TR", {
 18:     day: "2-digit",
 19:     month: "2-digit",
 20:     year: "numeric",
 21:     hour: "2-digit",
 22:     minute: "2-digit",
 23:   });
 24: }

 27:   onContextMenu?: (e: MouseEvent, data: { provider: string; text: string }) => void;
 28:   onDoubleClick?: (data: { provider: string; text: string }) => void;
 29: }

 31: export async function renderMessages(provider: string, callbacks: RenderCallbacks = {}): Promise<{ lastMessage: string }> {
 32:   const container = document.getElementById(`messages-${provider}`);
 33:   const select = document.getElementById(`conversation-${provider}`) as HTMLSelectElement | null;
 34:   const filter = document.getElementById(`filter-count-${provider}`) as HTMLSelectElement | null;
 35: 
 36:   if (!container) return { lastMessage: "" };
 37: 
 38:   container.innerHTML = "";
 39: 
 40:   // Select element yoksa veya seçili option yoksa placeholder göster
 41:   if (!select) {
 42:     container.innerHTML = '<div class="message-placeholder">Sohbet listesi yükleniyor...</div>';
 43:     return { lastMessage: "" };
 44:   }
 45: 
 46:   const selected = select.selectedOptions?.[0];
 47:   const folder = selected?.dataset?.folder || "";
 48: 
 49:   if (!selected || selected.value === "new") {
 50:     container.innerHTML = '<div class="message-placeholder">Yeni sohbet başlatılıyor...</div>';
 51:     return { lastMessage: "" };
 52:   }
 53: 
 54:   if (!folder) {
 55:     container.innerHTML = '<div class="message-placeholder">Sohbet seçiniz.</div>';
 56:     return { lastMessage: "" };
 57:   }
 58: 
 59:   try {
 60:     // DB'den mesajları çek
 61:     const conversationId = selected?.value;
 62:     const accountInfo = AppState.getAccountForSlot(provider);
 63: 
 64:     if (!accountInfo?.id) {
 65:       container.innerHTML = '<div class="message-placeholder">Hesap bilgisi bulunamadı.</div>';
 66:       return { lastMessage: "" };
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     type MessageItem = { id: string; role: string; content?: string; text?: string; author?: string; createdAt?: number };
 70:     const messagesResult = await window.electronAPI?.dbGetMessages?.({
 71:       accountId: accountInfo.id,
 72:       conversationId,
 73:     });
 74:     
 75:     // DB sonucu { success, data } formatında geliyor
 76:     const messages = (messagesResult?.data || []) as MessageItem[];
 77: 
 78:     if (!messages.length) {
 79:       container.innerHTML = '<div class="message-placeholder">Mesaj bulunamadı.</div>';
 80:       return { lastMessage: "" };
 81:     }
 82: 
 83:     // Conversation attachments'larını DB'den al
 84:     const attachmentsByMessage: Record<string, any[]> = {};
 85:     try {
 86:       const attachmentsResult = await window.electronAPI?.dbGetAttachments?.({
 87:         accountId: accountInfo.id,
 88:         conversationId,
 89:       }) as { data?: Array<{ messageId: string }> } | undefined;
 90:       const attachments = attachmentsResult?.data ?? [];
 91:       if (attachments.length) {
 92:         // messageId'ye göre grupla (DB camelCase döndürüyor)
 93:         attachments.forEach((att) => {
 94:           if (!attachmentsByMessage[att.messageId]) {
 95:             attachmentsByMessage[att.messageId] = [];
 96:           }
 97:           attachmentsByMessage[att.messageId].push(att);
 98:         });
 99:       }
100:     } catch (_e) {
101:       // Attachments alınamazsa boş
102:     }
103: 
104:     const attachmentsBasePath = `data/${accountInfo.id}/attachments/${conversationId}`;
105: 
106:     let items = messages;
107: 
108:     const limitVal = filter?.value;
109:     if (limitVal && limitVal !== "all") {
110:       const n = parseInt(limitVal, 10);
111:       if (!Number.isNaN(n)) {
112:         items = items.slice(-n);
113:       }
114:     }
115: 
116:     items.forEach((msg) => {
117:       const msgAttachments = attachmentsByMessage[msg.id] || [];
118:       const bubble = createMessageBubble(
119:         msg,
120:         provider,
121:         attachmentsBasePath,
122:         msgAttachments,
123:         callbacks
124:       );
125:       container.appendChild(bubble);
126:     });
127: 
128:     if (!items.length) {
129:       container.innerHTML = '<div class="message-placeholder">Mesaj bulunamadı.</div>';
130:     }
131: 
132:     const lastAssistant = [...items]
133:       .reverse()
134:       .find((m) => m.role === "assistant" && (m.content || "").trim());
135: 
136:     container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
137: 
138:     return { lastMessage: lastAssistant?.text || "" };
139:   } catch (_err) {
140:     container.innerHTML = '<div class="message-placeholder">Mesajlar okunamadı.</div>';
141:     return { lastMessage: "" };
142:   }
143: }
144: 
145: interface MessageData {
146:   id: string;
147:   role: string;
148:   content?: string;
149:   text?: string;
150:   author?: string;
151:   createdAt?: number;
152: }
153: 
154: interface AttachmentData {
155:   messageId: string;
156:   originalName?: string;
157:   storedName?: string;
158:   storedPath?: string;
159: }
160: 
161: function createMessageBubble(
162:   msg: MessageData,
163:   provider: string,
164:   attachmentsBasePath: string,
165:   msgAttachments: AttachmentData[],
166:   callbacks: RenderCallbacks
167: ): HTMLElement {
168:   const bubble = document.createElement("div");
169:   bubble.className = `msg-bubble ${msg.role === "assistant" ? "msg-ai" : "msg-user"}`;
170: 
171:   // Mesaj içeriği - DB'de 'content' alanında saklanıyor
172:   const messageText = msg.content || msg.text || "";
173: 
174:   // Header: meta (author) + timestamp
175:   const header = document.createElement("div");
176:   header.className = "msg-header";
177: 
178:   const meta = document.createElement("div");
179:   meta.className = "msg-meta";
180:   meta.textContent = msg.author || msg.role || "";
181:   header.appendChild(meta);
182: 
183:   // Tarih-saat gösterimi (DB camelCase döndürüyor)
184:   if (msg.createdAt) {
185:     const time = document.createElement("div");
186:     time.className = "msg-time";
187:     time.textContent = formatTimestamp(msg.createdAt);
188:     header.appendChild(time);
189:   }
190: 
191:   bubble.appendChild(header);
192: 
193:   // Mesaj içeriği
194:   const text = document.createElement("div");
195:   text.className = "msg-text";
196:   text.textContent = messageText;
197:   bubble.appendChild(text);
198: 
199:   // Mesaja ait attachments (DB'den - camelCase alanlar)
200:   if (msgAttachments && msgAttachments.length > 0) {
201:     const attWrap = document.createElement("div");
202:     attWrap.className = "msg-attachments";
203: 
204:     msgAttachments.forEach((att: AttachmentData) => {
205:       const link = document.createElement("button");
206:       link.className = "attachment-link";
207:       link.textContent = `📎 ${att.originalName || att.storedName || "dosya"}`;
208:       link.addEventListener("click", () => {
209:         const filePath =
210:           att.storedPath || `${attachmentsBasePath}/${att.messageId}/${att.storedName}`;
211:         openAttachmentByPath(filePath);
212:       });
213:       attWrap.appendChild(link);
214:     });
215: 
216:     bubble.appendChild(attWrap);
217:   }
218: 
219:   if (callbacks.onContextMenu) {
220:     bubble.addEventListener("contextmenu", (e) => {
221:       callbacks.onContextMenu?.(e, { provider, text: messageText });
222:     });
223:   }
224: 
225:   if (callbacks.onDoubleClick) {
226:     bubble.addEventListener("dblclick", () => {
227:       callbacks.onDoubleClick?.({ provider, text: messageText });
228:     });
229:   }
230: 
231:   return bubble;
232: }
233: 
234: async function openAttachmentByPath(filePath: string) {
235:   if (!filePath) return;
236: 
237:   try {
238:     const res = await window.electronAPI?.openPath?.(filePath);
239:     if (!res?.success) {
240:       throw new Error(res?.message || "açılamadı");
241:     }
242:   } catch (err) {
243:     LogManager.addEvent("analyze", "warning", `Dosya açılamadı: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`);
244:   }
245: }

268:     const emailEl = document.getElementById("new-account-email") as HTMLInputElement | null;
269:     const nicknameEl = document.getElementById("new-account-nickname") as HTMLInputElement | null;
270: 
271:     const email = emailEl?.value?.trim();
272:     const nickname = nicknameEl?.value?.trim();
273: 
274:     if (!email) {
275:       this.showFeedback("Email gerekli", "error");
276:       return;
277:     }
278: 
279:     try {
280:         const settings = this.settingsManager.getSnapshot();
281:         const accounts = settings?.accounts || [];
282:         const accountIndex = accounts.findIndex((a: { id: string }) => a.id === this._editingAccountId);
283: 
284:         if (accountIndex === -1) {
285:             this.showFeedback("Düzenlenen hesap bulunamadı", "error");
286:             this.cancelEdit();
287:             return;
288:         }
289: 
290:         const oldAccount = accounts[accountIndex];
291:         let finalAvatarPath = oldAccount.avatarPath;
292: 
293:         // If avatar changed (and isn't just the same path)
294:         if (this._newAccountAvatarPath && this._newAccountAvatarPath !== oldAccount.avatarPath) {
295:             const copied = await window.electronAPI?.copyToAssets(
296:                 this._newAccountAvatarPath,
297:                 "account",
298:                 { id: oldAccount.id, email: oldAccount.email, provider: oldAccount.provider },
299:             );
300:             finalAvatarPath = copied?.path || finalAvatarPath;
301:         }
302: 
303:         const updatedAccount = {
304:             ...oldAccount,
305:             email: email, // Email update might affect ID technically, but we keep ID stable for now or block email edit? 
306:                           // Allowing email edit but keeping ID stable is safer for DB, but ID was based on email. 
307:                           // Let's assume ID is persistent.
308:             nickname: nickname || oldAccount.provider,
309:             avatarPath: finalAvatarPath
310:         };
311: 
312:         const newAccounts = [...accounts];
313:         newAccounts[accountIndex] = updatedAccount;
314: 
315:         const updated = { ...settings, accounts: newAccounts };
316:         await this.settingsManager.save(updated);
317: 
318:         this.cancelEdit();
319:         this.showFeedback("Hesap güncellendi", "success");
320: 
321:     } catch (err) {
322:         LogManager.addEvent("entrance", "error", `Hesap güncelleme hatası: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`);
323:         this.showFeedback(`Güncelleme hatası: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, "error");
324:     }

327:   async deleteAccount(accountId: string) {
328:     const result = await window.electronAPI?.showMessageBox?.({
329:       type: "question",
330:       buttons: ["İptal", "Sil"],
331:       defaultId: 0,
332:       cancelId: 0,
333:       title: "Hesap Silme",
334:       message: "Bu hesabı silmek istediğinizden emin misiniz?",
335:     });
336:     
337:     if (!result || result.response === 0) return;
338: 
339:     try {
340:       const settings = this.settingsManager.getSnapshot();
341:       const accounts = settings?.accounts || [];
342:       
343:       const updatedAccounts = accounts.filter((a: { id: string }) => a.id !== accountId);
344:       
345:       // Cleanup slots using this account
346:       const slots = { ...settings.slots };
347:       if (slots.ai1?.accountId === accountId) slots.ai1 = { ...slots.ai1, accountId: null };
348:       if (slots.ai2?.accountId === accountId) slots.ai2 = { ...slots.ai2, accountId: null };
349: 
350:       const updated = { ...settings, accounts: updatedAccounts, slots };
351:       await this.settingsManager.save(updated);
352: 
353:       if (this._editingAccountId === accountId) {
354:           this.cancelEdit();
355:       }
356: 
357:       this.showFeedback("Hesap silindi", "success");

360:     }

381:     }, 3000);

279:     }

288:     if (!currentlyConnected) return;

310:       }

318:   async updateUserStatus(userType: string) {
319:     const statusDot = document.getElementById(`${userType}-status-dot`);
320:     const statusText = document.getElementById(`${userType}-status-text`);
321:     const toggleBtn = document.getElementById(`${userType}-toggle-btn`);
322:     const avatarEl = document.getElementById(`${userType}-avatar`);
323: 
324:     if (userType === "user") {
325:         // User always "connected" in UI context
326:         if (avatarEl) avatarEl.style.opacity = "1";
327:         return;
328:     }
329: 
330:     const hasAccount = !!AppState.getAccountForSlot(userType);
331:     const connected = SlotController.isConnected(userType);
332: 
333:     if (avatarEl) {
334:       avatarEl.style.opacity = hasAccount && !connected ? "0.5" : "1";
335:     }
336: 
337:     if (statusDot) {
338:       if (!hasAccount) {
339:         statusDot.classList.remove("connected");
340:         statusDot.style.backgroundColor = "#999";
341:       } else if (connected) {
342:         statusDot.classList.add("connected");
343:         statusDot.style.backgroundColor = "#4CAF50";
344:       } else {
345:         statusDot.classList.remove("connected");
346:         statusDot.style.backgroundColor = "#FFA726";
347:       }
348:     }
349: 
350:     if (statusText) {
351:       statusText.textContent = !hasAccount ? "Hesap yok" : (connected ? "Bağlı" : "Bağlı değil");
352:     }
353: 
354:     if (toggleBtn) {
355:       const btn = toggleBtn as HTMLButtonElement;
356:       if (!hasAccount) {
357:         btn.textContent = "Hesap Seçin";
358:         btn.disabled = true;
359:       } else if (connected) {
360:         btn.textContent = "Bağlantıyı Kes";
361:         btn.disabled = false;
362:         btn.classList.remove("btn-primary");
363:         btn.classList.add("btn-secondary");
364:       } else {
365:         btn.textContent = "Bağlan";
366:         btn.disabled = false;
367:         btn.classList.remove("btn-secondary");
368:         btn.classList.add("btn-primary");
369:       }
370:     }
371:   }
372: 
373:   async updateUI() {
374:     ["user", "ai1", "ai2"].forEach((userType) => {
375:       this.updateUserStatus(userType);
376:     });
377:     this.whisperPanel.render();
378:   }

383:     this.updateUI();
384:   }
