  1: /**
  2:  * Message Store - Mesaj CRUD ve Sync İşlemleri
  3:  *
  4:  * @module src/js/modules/database/message-store
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { LogManager } from "../log-manager.js";
  8: import { getErrorMessage } from "../../types/index.js";
  9: 
 10: // ============================================================================
 11: // Hash Utility (Renderer-side)
 12: // ============================================================================
 13: 
 14: /**
 15:  * String'den hash oluştur (djb2 algoritması)
 16:  * Main process ile aynı algoritma kullanılmalı
 17:  * @param {string} str
 18:  * @returns {string}
 19:  */
 20: export function hashString(str: string): string {
 21:   if (!str) return "0";
 22: 
 23:   let hash = 5381;
 24:   for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
 25:     hash = (hash << 5) + hash + str.charCodeAt(i);
 26:     hash = hash >>> 0; // Convert to unsigned 32-bit
 27:   }
 28:   return hash.toString(16);
 29: }
 30: 
 31: // ============================================================================
 32: // Message Store
 33: // ============================================================================
 34: 
 35: export const MessageStore = {
 36:   /**
 37:    * Mesajları listele
 38:    * @param {string} accountId - Account ID
 39:    * @param {string} conversationId
 40:    * @returns {Promise<Array>}
 41:    */
 42:   async list(accountId: string, conversationId: string) {
 43:     try {
 44:       if (!accountId || !conversationId) {
 45:         return [];
 46:       }
 47: 
 48:       const result = await window.electronAPI?.dbGetMessages?.({ accountId, conversationId });
 49: 
 50:       return result?.data ?? [];
 51:     } catch (err) {
 52:       LogManager.addEvent("database", "error", `MessageStore.list error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, { context: { accountId, conversationId } });
 53:       return [];
 54:     }
 55:   },
 56: 
 57:   /**
 58:    * Mesajları senkronize et (incremental sync)
 59:    * @param {Object} params
 60:    * @param {string} params.accountId - Account ID
 61:    * @param {string} params.webUrl - Konuşma URL'i
 62:    * @param {Array} params.messages - Scrape edilmiş mesajlar
 63:    * @param {Object} params.authors - { user: "...", assistant: "..." }
 64:    * @returns {Promise<{ success: boolean, conversationId?: string, added?: number, total?: number }>}
 65:    */
 66:   async sync(params: { accountId: string; webUrl: string; messages: Array<{ role?: string; text?: string; index?: number; contentHash?: string }>; authors?: unknown }) {
 67:     try {
 68:       const { accountId, webUrl, messages, authors: _authors } = params;
 69: 
 70:       if (!accountId || !webUrl) {
 71:         return { success: false, error: "Missing required parameters" };
 72:       }
 73: 
 74:       // Mesajlara hash ekle (eğer yoksa)
 75:       const messagesWithHash = messages.map((msg: { role?: string; text?: string; index?: number; contentHash?: string }, index: number) => ({
 76:         ...msg,
 77:         index: msg.index ?? index,
 78:         contentHash: msg.contentHash || hashString(msg.text || ""),
 79:       }));
 80: 
 81:       const result = await window.electronAPI?.dbSyncMessages?.({
 82:         accountId,
 83:         webUrl,
 84:         messages: messagesWithHash,
 85:       });
 86: 
 87:       return result || { success: false, error: "API not available" };
 88:     } catch (err) {
 89:       LogManager.addEvent("database", "error", `MessageStore.sync error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, { context: { webUrl: params.webUrl, accountId: params.accountId } });
 90:       return { success: false, error: getErrorMessage(err) };
 91:     }
 92:   },
 93: 
 94:   /**
 95:    * Mesajlarda arama yap (FTS5)
 96:    * @param {string} accountId - Account ID
 97:    * @param {string} query
 98:    * @param {number} limit
 99:    * @returns {Promise<Array>}
100:    */
101:   async search(accountId: string, query: string, limit = 50) {
102:     try {
103:       if (!accountId || !query) {
104:         return [];
105:       }
106: 
107:       const result = await window.electronAPI?.dbSearchMessages?.({ accountId, query, limit });
108: 
109:       return result?.data ?? [];
110:     } catch (err) {
111:       LogManager.addEvent("database", "error", `MessageStore.search error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, { context: { accountId, query } });
112:       return [];
113:     }
114:   },
115: 
116:   /**
117:    * Hash hesapla (utility)
118:    * @param {string} content
119:    * @returns {string}
120:    */
121:   hash(content: string) {
122:     return hashString(content);
123:   },
124: };
125: 
126: export default MessageStore;

 52: class ConversationSyncerClass {
 53:   _settings: AppSettings | null;
 54:   _syncInProgress: Record<string, boolean>;
 55:   _lastThinkingState: Record<string, string>;
 56:   _lastLoadingEnded: Record<string, number>;
 57:   _syncRetryTimers: Record<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>;
 58:   _syncRetryCounts: Record<string, number>;
 59:   _stableListeners: Record<string, StableCallback[]>;
 60:   _lastSyncResult: Record<string, SyncResult>;
 61:   _trafficUnsubscribe: (() => void) | null;
 62:   _coreEngine: CoreEngine | null;
 63:   _resolveWebviewFn: ResolveWebviewFn | null;
 64:   syncRetryLimit: number;
 65: 
 66:   constructor() {
 67:     this._settings = null;
 68:     this._syncInProgress = {};
 69:     this._lastThinkingState = { ai1: "idle", ai2: "idle" };
 70:     this._lastLoadingEnded = { ai1: 0, ai2: 0 };
 71:     this._syncRetryTimers = {};
 72:     this._syncRetryCounts = {};
 73:     this._stableListeners = {};
 74:     this._lastSyncResult = {};
 75:     this._trafficUnsubscribe = null;
 76:     this._coreEngine = null;
 77:     this._resolveWebviewFn = null;
 78:     this.syncRetryLimit = 2;
 79:   }
 80: 
 81:   /**
 82:    * Ayarları güncelle
 83:    */
 84:   setSettings(settings: AppSettings | null): void {
 85:     this._settings = settings;
 86:   }
 87: 
 88:   /**
 89:    * Syncer'ı başlat
 90:    */
 91:   init(coreEngine: CoreEngine, resolveWebviewFn: ResolveWebviewFn): void {
 92:     this._coreEngine = coreEngine;
 93:     this._resolveWebviewFn = resolveWebviewFn;
 94: 
 95:     if (this._trafficUnsubscribe) {
 96:       this._trafficUnsubscribe();
 97:     }
 98: 
 99:     this._trafficUnsubscribe = TrafficManager.onUpdate(async (snapshot) => {
100:       try {
101:         const provider = snapshot?.provider;
102:         const state = (snapshot?.state || {}) as { thinkingState?: string; loadingJustEnded?: boolean; loadingEndedAt?: number };
103:         if (!provider) return;
104: 
105:         const currentThinking = state.thinkingState || "idle";
106:         const prevThinking = this._lastThinkingState[provider] || "idle";
107:         this._lastThinkingState[provider] = currentThinking;
108: 
109:         if (prevThinking !== "idle" && currentThinking === "idle") {
110:           await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
111:           await this.syncProvider(provider, { from: "auto" });
112:         }
113: 
114:         if (state.loadingJustEnded && state.loadingEndedAt && state.loadingEndedAt > this._lastLoadingEnded[provider]) {
115:           this._lastLoadingEnded[provider] = state.loadingEndedAt;
116:           await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
117:           await this.syncProvider(provider, { from: "auto" });
118:         }
119:       } catch (_err) {}
120:     });
121: 
122:     LogManager.addEvent("sync", "info", "ConversationSyncer initialized", { visibility: 2 });
123:   }

140:   async syncConversation(provider: string, webview: any, options: { catchEnabled?: boolean } = {}) {

144:     }
145: 
146:     const currentUrl = webview.getURL?.() || "";
147:     if (this.isUrlExcluded(provider, currentUrl)) {
148:       LogManager.addEvent(
149:         `webview-${provider}`,
150:         "warning",
151:         `URL excluded: ${currentUrl}, sync operation disabled`
152:       );
153:       return { success: false, message: "URL excluded from operations" };
154:     }
155: 
156:     // Default page kontrolü - ana sayfada sync yapma
157:     const providerId = AppState.getProviderIdForSlot(provider);
158:     if (providerId && isDefaultPage(currentUrl, providerId)) {
159:       LogManager.addEvent(
160:         `webview-${provider}`,
161:         "info",
162:         `Default page, sync skipped: ${currentUrl}`,
163:         { visibility: 3 }
164:       );
165:       return { success: false, message: "default-page" };
166:     }
167: 
168:     if (this._syncInProgress[provider]) {
169:       LogManager.addEvent(`webview-${provider}`, "info", "sync skipped: already in progress", { visibility: 3 });
170:       return { success: false, message: "sync-in-progress" };
171:     }
172:     this._syncInProgress[provider] = true;
173: 
174:     try {
175:       await waitForDomReady(webview);
176: 
177:       const providerId = AppState.getProviderIdForSlot(provider);
178:       const providerModule = providerId ? getProvider(providerId) : null;
179: 
180:       if (!providerModule || typeof providerModule.scrapeMessages !== "function") {
181:         throw new Error(`Provider module or scrapeMessages function for "${provider}" not found.`);
182:       }
183: 
184:       const messages = await webview.executeJavaScript(
185:         `(${providerModule.scrapeMessages.toString()})();`
186:       );
187: 
188:       const rawUrl = webview.getURL() || "";
189:       const webUrl = normalizeUrl(rawUrl);
190: 
191:       const { existing, prevCount, newEntry } = await this._getArchiveStatus(provider, webUrl);
192: 
193:       if (!messages || messages.length === 0) {
194:         this._syncInProgress[provider] = false;
195:         return {
196:           success: true,
197:           count: 0,
198:           messages: [],
199:           commands: [],
200:           webUrl,
201:           newEntry: false,
202:         };
203:       }
204: 
205:       const authors = {
206:         user: AppState.getNickname("user"),
207:         ai: AppState.getNickname(provider),
208:       };
209: 
210:       const normalized = messages.map((m: { role?: string; [key: string]: unknown }) => ({
211:         ...m,
212:         author: m.role === "assistant" ? authors.ai : authors.user,
213:         ts: Date.now(),
214:       }));
215: 
216:       const slots = this._settings?.slots as Record<string, { catchCommands?: boolean }> | undefined;
217:       const catchEnabled =
218:         options.catchEnabled ?? slots?.[provider]?.catchCommands ?? true;
219: 
220:       const commands = catchEnabled
221:         ? await CatchManager.catchCommands({
222:             provider,
223:             webUrl,
224:             messages: normalized,
225:             prevCount,
226:             hasExisting: !!existing,
227:           })
228:         : [];
229: 
230:       const accountInfo = AppState.getAccountForSlot(provider);
231: 
232:       if (!accountInfo?.id) {
233:         LogManager.addEvent(
234:           `webview-${provider}`,
235:           "warning",
236:           `Sync skipped: No account info for slot ${provider}`
237:         );
238:         this._syncInProgress[provider] = false;
239:         return { success: false, message: "No account assigned to slot" };
240:       }
241: 
242:       // Database sync (incremental - sadece yeni mesajları ekler)
243:       const syncResult = await window.electronAPI?.dbSyncMessages?.({
244:         accountId: accountInfo.id,
245:         webUrl,
246:         messages: normalized,
247:         authors,
248:       });
249: 
250:       if (!syncResult?.success) {
251:         throw new Error(syncResult?.error || "Database sync failed");
252:       }
253: 
254:       // Fetch messages with IDs from DB
255:       const dbMessagesResult = await window.electronAPI?.dbGetMessages?.({
256:         accountId: accountInfo.id,
257:         conversationId: syncResult.conversationId,
258:       });
259: 
260:       return {
261:         success: true,
262:         count: normalized.length,
263:         messages: dbMessagesResult?.data ?? normalized,
264:         commands,
265:         webUrl,
266:         newEntry,
267:         added: syncResult.added,
268:         total: syncResult.total,
269:         conversationId: syncResult.conversationId,
270:       };
271:     } catch (error) {
272:       LogManager.addEvent(
273:         `webview-${provider}`,
274:         "error",
275:         `Sync failed: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`
276:       );
277:       return { success: false, message: getErrorMessage(error) };
278:     } finally {
279:       this._syncInProgress[provider] = false;
280:     }
281:   }
282: 
283:   /**
284:    * Provider'ı senkronize et (SyncHandler'dan taşındı)
285:    * @param {string} provider - Slot ID
286:    * @param {Object} opts - { from: 'auto' | 'manual' | 'retry' }
287:    * @returns {Promise<Object>}
288:    */
289:   async syncProvider(provider: string, opts: { from?: string } = {}) {
290:     if (!provider) return { success: false, message: "no-provider" };
291: 
292:     if (opts?.from === "manual") {
293:       if (this._syncRetryTimers[provider]) {
294:         clearTimeout(this._syncRetryTimers[provider]);
295:       }
296:       this._syncRetryCounts[provider] = 0;
297:     }
298: 
299:     try {
300:       LogManager.addEvent(
301:         "sync",
302:         "info",
303:         `syncProvider called for ${provider} (source=${opts.from || "manual"})`
304:       );
305: 
306:       const webview = this._resolveWebviewFn?.(provider);
307:       const res = await this.syncConversation(provider, webview);
308: 
309:       this._lastSyncResult[provider] = res;
310: 
311:       const lastAfter = res.messages?.[res.messages.length - 1];
312:       const stableAfter = lastAfter && lastAfter.role && lastAfter.role !== "user";
313: 
314:       if (stableAfter) {
315:         this._notifyStable(provider, res);
316:       }
317: 
318:       if (!res) return { success: false, message: "no-result" };
319:       if (res.count === 0) return res;
320: 
321:       const last = res.messages?.[res.messages.length - 1];
322:       if (last?.role === "user") {
323:         const tried = this._syncRetryCounts[provider] || 0;
324:         if (tried < this.syncRetryLimit) {
325:           LogManager.addEvent(
326:             "sync",
327:             "info",
328:             `SyncProvider: last message is user for ${provider}, scheduling retry...`
329:           );
330:           this._syncRetryCounts[provider] = tried + 1;
331:           this._syncRetryTimers[provider] = setTimeout(() => {
332:             if (SlotController.isConnected(provider)) {
333:               this.syncProvider(provider, { from: "retry" });
334:             }
335:           }, 3000);
336:         }
337:       } else {
338:         if (this._syncRetryTimers[provider]) {
339:           clearTimeout(this._syncRetryTimers[provider]);
340:         }
341:         this._syncRetryCounts[provider] = 0;
342:       }
343: 
344:       if (res.success) {
345:         await ConversationListManager.refresh({
346:           silent: true,
347:           forceSelectId: res.conversationId,
348:           provider, // Sadece bu provider için mesaj listesini güncelle
349:         });
350:       }
351: 
352:       if (res.commands && res.commands.length > 0 && this._coreEngine) {
353:         for (const cmd of res.commands) {
354:           await this._coreEngine.handleCaughtCommand(cmd.command, {
355:             ...cmd,
356:             source: opts.from || "auto",
357:           });
358:         }
359:       }
360: 
361:       return res;
362:     } catch (err) {
363:       const message = err instanceof Error ? getErrorMessage(err) : String(err);
364:       LogManager.addEvent("sync", "error", `syncProvider error for ${provider}: ${message}`);
365:       return { success: false, message };
366:     }
367:   }
368: 
369:   /**
370:    * Stable durumunu bildir
371:    * @private
372:    */
373:   _notifyStable(provider: string, res: SyncResult): void {
374:     try {
375:       const list = this._stableListeners[provider] || [];
376:       delete this._stableListeners[provider];
377: 
378:       for (const cb of list) {
379:         try {
380:           cb(null, res);
381:         } catch (_e) {}
382:       }
383: 
384:       try {
385:         PendingArchiveHandler.processPending(provider, res);
386:       } catch (_e) {}
387:     } catch (_e) {}
388:   }
389: 
390:   /**
391:    * Stable listener ekle
392:    */
393:   addStableListener(provider: string, callback: StableCallback): void {
394:     if (!this._stableListeners[provider]) {
395:       this._stableListeners[provider] = [];
396:     }
397:     this._stableListeners[provider].push(callback);
398:   }
399: 
400:   /**
401:    * Belirli bir provider için bekleyen tüm listener'ları iptal et
402:    */
403:   cancelListeners(provider: string): void {
404:     if (this._stableListeners[provider]) {
405:       LogManager.addEvent("sync", "info", `Canceling listeners for ${provider}`, { visibility: 3 });
406:       delete this._stableListeners[provider];
407:     }
408: 
409:     // Retry timer'larını da temizle
410:     if (this._syncRetryTimers[provider]) {
411:       clearTimeout(this._syncRetryTimers[provider]);
412:       delete this._syncRetryTimers[provider];
413:     }
414:     delete this._syncRetryCounts[provider];
415:   }
416: 
417:   /**
418:    * Son sync sonucunu getir
419:    */
420:   getLastSyncResult(provider: string): SyncResult | null {
421:     return this._lastSyncResult[provider] || null;
422:   }
423: 
424:   /**
425:    * Archive durumunu getir (DB'den)
426:    * @private
427:    */
428:   async _getArchiveStatus(provider: string, webUrl: string): Promise<{ existing: unknown; prevCount: number; newEntry: boolean }> {
429:     try {
430:       const accountInfo = AppState.getAccountForSlot(provider);
431:       if (!accountInfo?.id) {
432:         return { existing: null, prevCount: 0, newEntry: true };
433:       }
434: 
435:       const conversations = await window.electronAPI?.dbGetConversations?.({
436:         accountId: accountInfo.id,
437:       }) as Array<{ webUrl?: string; messageCount?: number }> | undefined;
438: 
439:       const existing =
440:         (conversations || []).find((item) => normalizeUrl(item.webUrl as string) === webUrl) || null;
441: 
442:       return {
443:         existing,
444:         prevCount: (existing?.messageCount || 0) as number,
445:         newEntry: !existing,
446:       };
447:     } catch (_error) {
448:       return { existing: null, prevCount: 0, newEntry: true };
449:     }
450:   }
451: 
452:   /**
453:    * Cleanup (destroy için)
454:    */
455:   destroy() {
456:     if (this._trafficUnsubscribe) {
457:       this._trafficUnsubscribe();
458:       this._trafficUnsubscribe = null;
459:     }
460: 
461:     Object.values(this._syncRetryTimers).forEach((timer) => {
462:       clearTimeout(timer);
463:     });
464:     this._syncRetryTimers = {};
465:     this._syncRetryCounts = {};
466:     this._stableListeners = {};
467:   }
468: }

  1: import { generateUniqueId } from "../constants/index.js";
  2: import { LogManager } from "./log-manager.js";
  3: import { getErrorMessage } from "../types/index.js";

  5: /** Attachment dosya bilgisi */
  6: interface CommandAttachment {
  7:   path: string;
  8:   name?: string;
  9:   type?: string;
 10:   size?: number;
 11: }
 12: 
 13: /** Command meta bilgileri */
 14: interface CommandMeta {
 15:   source?: string;
 16:   priority?: number;
 17:   retryCount?: number;
 18:   [key: string]: unknown;
 19: }
 20: 
 21: /** Deferred promise yapısı */
 22: interface DeferredPromise<T = unknown> {
 23:   resolve: (value: T) => void;
 24:   reject: (reason?: unknown) => void;
 25:   promise: Promise<T>;
 26: }
 27: 
 28: /** Command job result */
 29: interface CommandResult {
 30:   success: boolean;
 31:   message?: string;
 32:   data?: unknown;
 33: }
 34: 
 35: interface CommandJob {
 36:   id: string;
 37:   provider: string;
 38:   target?: string;
 39:   command: string;
 40:   message: string;
 41:   attachments: CommandAttachment[];
 42:   sessionId: string | null;
 43:   meta: CommandMeta;
 44:   payload: Record<string, unknown>;
 45:   createdAt: number;
 46:   status: 'queued' | 'processing' | 'sent' | 'failed';
 47:   run: (() => Promise<CommandResult>) | null;
 48:   _deferred: DeferredPromise<CommandResult> | null;
 49:   done: Promise<CommandResult> | null;
 50:   result?: CommandResult;
 51: }
 52: 
 53: /** Event listener tipi - esnek payload */
 54:  
 55: type CommandEventListener = (payload: any) => void;
 56: 
 57: class CommandManagerClass {
 58:   queue: CommandJob[];
 59:   processing: boolean;
 60:   executor: ((job: CommandJob) => Promise<CommandResult>) | null;
 61:   listeners: Record<string, CommandEventListener[]>;
 62: 
 63:   constructor() {
 64:     this.queue = [];
 65:     this.processing = false;
 66:     this.executor = null;
 67:     this.listeners = { queued: [], sent: [], failed: [], status: [] };
 68:   }
 69: 
 70:   async init() {
 71:     try {
 72:       await window.electronAPI?.commandInit?.();
 73:       // Init logu kaldırıldı - gereksiz gürültü
 74:       this.queue = [];
 75:     } catch (err) {
 76:       const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
 77:       LogManager.addEvent(
 78:         "command",
 79:         "error",
 80:         `CommandManager init hatası: ${message}`,
 81:       );
 82:     }
 83:   }
 84: 
 85:   setExecutor(fn: ((job: CommandJob) => Promise<CommandResult>) | null) {
 86:     this.executor = typeof fn === "function" ? fn : null;
 87:   }
 88: 
 89:   on(event: string, listener: CommandEventListener) {
 90:     if (!this.listeners[event]) this.listeners[event] = [];
 91:     if (typeof listener === "function") {
 92:       this.listeners[event].push(listener);
 93:     }
 94:     return () => {
 95:       this.listeners[event] = (this.listeners[event] || []).filter(
 96:         (l) => l !== listener,
 97:       );
 98:     };
 99:   }
100: 
101:   emit(event: string, payload: CommandJob | CommandResult | unknown) {
102:     (this.listeners[event] || []).forEach((l) => {
103:       try {
104:         l(payload);
105:       } catch (err) {
106:         LogManager.addEvent("command", "warning", `Listener error: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`);
107:       }
108:     });
109:   }
110: 
111:   defer(): DeferredPromise<CommandResult> {
112:     let resolve: ((value: CommandResult) => void) | undefined;
113:     let reject: ((reason?: unknown) => void) | undefined;
114:     const promise = new Promise<CommandResult>((res, rej) => {
115:       resolve = res;
116:       reject = rej;
117:     });
118:     return { promise, resolve: resolve!, reject: reject! };
119:   }
120: 
121:   /**
122:    * @param {object} [payload={}]
123:    * @returns {object}
124:    */
125:   sanitizePayload(payload = {}) {
126:     const rest = payload || {};
127:     try {
128:       return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(rest));
129:     } catch {
130:       const cleaned: Record<string, any> = {};
131:       Object.entries(rest || {}).forEach(([key, value]) => {
132:         if (typeof value === "function") return;
133:         try {
134:           cleaned[key] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
135:         } catch (e) {
136:         }
137:       });
138:       return cleaned;
139:     }
140:   }
141: 
142:   enqueue(items: Partial<CommandJob>[] = []) {
143:     const list = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [items];
144:     const jobs = list.map((item) => this.addJob(item));
145:     this.processNext();
146:     return jobs;
147:   }
148: 
149:   /**
150:    * @param {any} [item={}]
151:    * @returns {CommandJob}
152:    */
153:   addJob(item: Partial<CommandJob> & { target?: string } = {}) {
154:     const deferred = this.defer();
155:     const payloadObj = (item.payload || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
156:     const metaObj = (item.meta || {}) as CommandMeta;
157:     const job: CommandJob = {
158:       id: item.id || generateUniqueId("cmd"),
159:       provider: item.provider || item.target || "default",
160:       command: String(item.command || payloadObj.command || metaObj.command || ""),
161:       message: String(item.message || payloadObj.message || item.command || ""),
162:       attachments: item.attachments || [],
163:       sessionId: item.sessionId || null,
164:       meta: metaObj,
165:       payload: this.sanitizePayload(payloadObj),
166:       createdAt: Date.now(),
167:       status: "queued" as const,
168:       run: item.run || null,
169:       _deferred: deferred,
170:       done: deferred.promise,
171:     };
172:     this.queue.push(job);
173:     this.persist(job);
174:     this.emit("queued", job);
175:     return job;
176:   }
177: 
178:   /**
179:    * @returns {CommandJob | undefined}
180:    */
181:   getNextJob() {
182:     if (!this.queue.length) return undefined;
183:     return this.queue.shift();
184:   }
185: 
186:   async processNext() {
187:     if (this.processing) return;
188:     const job = this.getNextJob();
189:     if (!job) return;
190:     this.processing = true;
191:     job.status = "processing";
192:     this.emit("status", { job, status: "processing" });
193:     try {
194:       const runner = job.run || this.executor;
195:       if (runner) {
196:         const res = await runner(job);
197:         job.result = res;
198:         job.status = "sent";
199:         this.emit("sent", { job, result: res });
200:       } else {
201:         job.result = { success: true, message: "No executor" };
202:         job.status = "sent";
203:         this.emit("sent", { job, result: job.result });
204:       }
205:       this.markDone(job.id);
206:       job._deferred?.resolve(job.result);
207:     } catch (err) {
208:       job.status = "failed";
209:       this.emit("failed", { job, error: err });
210:       const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown error";
211:       this.markFailed(job.id, message);
212:       job._deferred?.reject(err);
213:     } finally {
214:       this._cleanupJobReferences(job);
215:       
216:       this.processing = false;
217:       if (this.queue.length) {
218:         this.processNext();
219:       }
220:     }
221:   }
222: 
223:   _cleanupJobReferences(job: CommandJob | null) {
224:     if (!job) return;
225:     job._deferred = null;
226:     job.done = null;
227:     job.run = null;
228:   }
229: 
230:   markDone(id: string) {
231:     const mover = window.electronAPI?.commandMove;
232:     if (typeof mover === "function") {
233:       mover(id, "done").catch?.(() => {
234:       });
235:     }
236:     LogManager.addEvent("command", "info", `Komut tamamlandı (${id})`);
237:     return true;
238:   }
239: 
240:   markFailed(id: string, reason = "") {
241:     const mover = window.electronAPI?.commandMove;
242:     if (typeof mover === "function") {
243:       mover(id, "failed").catch?.(() => {
244:       });
245:     }
246:     LogManager.addEvent("command", "error", `Komut hatası (${id}): ${reason}`);
247:     return false;
248:   }
249: 
250:   persist(job: CommandJob) {
251:     const writer = window.electronAPI?.commandWrite;
252:     if (typeof writer === "function") {
253:       const safeJob = {
254:         ...job,
255:         command: job.command,
256:         payload: this.sanitizePayload(job.payload),
257:         run: undefined,
258:         _deferred: undefined,
259:         done: undefined,
260:       };
261:       writer(safeJob).catch((err) => {
262:         const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
263:         LogManager.addEvent(
264:           "command",
265:           "error",
266:           `Komut dosyası yazılamadı: ${message}`,
267:         );
268:       });
269:     }
270:   }
271: 
272:   list() {
273:     return [...this.queue];
274:   }
275: 
276:   clearQueue() {
277:     this.queue = [];
278:     this.processing = false;
279:     LogManager.addEvent("command", "info", "Komut kuyruğu temizlendi", { visibility: 2 });
280:   }
281: 
282:   CommandManagerEnqueue(
283:     target: string,
284:     command: string,
285:     _mode = "default",
286:     payload: Record<string, any> = {},
287:     executor: (() => Promise<any>) | null = null,
288:     _priority = "normal",
289:   ) {
290:     const [job] = this.enqueue([
291:       {
292:         provider: target,
293:         command,
294:         message: (payload as any).message || "",
295:         payload,
296:         run: executor || undefined,
297:       } as any,
298:     ]);
299:     return job;
300:   }
301: }

 61:   handleConversationChange(provider: string, options = { isInitial: false }) {
 62:     const select = this.selects[provider];
 63:     if (!select) return;
 64: 
 65:     const conversationId = select.value;
 66:     this.currentSelections[provider] = conversationId;
 67: 
 68:     // Hem ID hem provider eşleşmeli (aynı ID farklı provider'larda olabilir)
 69:     const entry = this.entries.find((e) => e.id === conversationId && e.provider === provider);
 70:     SlotController.navigate(provider, entry?.webUrl || null);
 71: 
 72:     if (!options.isInitial) {
 73:       LogManager.addEvent(
 74:         "conversation",
 75:         "info",
 76:         `User selected: ${provider} -> ${conversationId}`,
 77:       );
 78:     }
 79:   }
 80: 
 81:   async refresh(
 82:     options: { silent?: boolean; forceSelectId?: any; skipNotify?: boolean; provider?: string } = {},
 83:   ) {
 84:     const { silent = false, forceSelectId = null, skipNotify = false, provider = null } = options;
 85:     try {
 86:       // Her slot için hesap bilgisini al ve DB'den konuşmaları çek
 87:       const ai1Account = AppState.getAccountForSlot("ai1");
 88:       const ai2Account = AppState.getAccountForSlot("ai2");
 89: 
 90:       const [ai1Result, ai2Result] = await Promise.all([
 91:         ai1Account?.id ? window.electronAPI?.dbGetConversations?.({ accountId: ai1Account.id }) : { data: [] },
 92:         ai2Account?.id ? window.electronAPI?.dbGetConversations?.({ accountId: ai2Account.id }) : { data: [] },
 93:       ]);
 94: 
 95:       // DB sonuçlarını validate et - { success, data } formatından data'yı çıkar
 96:       const ai1Entries = Array.isArray(ai1Result?.data) ? ai1Result.data : [];
 97:       const ai2Entries = Array.isArray(ai2Result?.data) ? ai2Result.data : [];
 98: 
 99:       // Provider bilgisini slot olarak ekle (ai1/ai2)
100:       this.entries = [
101:         ...ai1Entries.map(e => ({ ...e, provider: "ai1", mtime: e.updatedAt || e.createdAt })),
102:         ...ai2Entries.map(e => ({ ...e, provider: "ai2", mtime: e.updatedAt || e.createdAt })),
103:       ];
104: 
105:       this.renderAll({ silent });
106:       if (forceSelectId) {
107:         this.updateSelection(forceSelectId, { silent: true });
108:       }
109:       if (!skipNotify) {
110:         // Provider belirtilmişse sadece o provider için event dispatch et
111:         // Belirtilmemişse her iki provider için de dispatch et
112:         const providers = provider ? [provider] : ["ai1", "ai2"];
113:         for (const p of providers) {
114:           window.dispatchEvent(
115:             new CustomEvent("conversation-selected", {
116:               detail: { provider: p },
117:             }),
118:           );
119:         }
120:       }
121:     } catch (error) {
122:       const err = /** @type {Error} */ (error);
123:       LogManager.addEvent(
124:         "conversation",
125:         "error",
126:         `Listeyi yenileme hatası: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`,
127:       );
128:     }
129:   }
130: 
131:   renderAll(options: { silent?: boolean } = {}) {
132:     for (const provider in this.selects) {
133:       this.render(provider, options);
134:     }
135:   }
136: 
137:   render(provider: string, options: { silent?: boolean } = {}) {
138:     const select = this.selects[provider];
139:     if (!select) return;
140: 
141:     const settings = SettingsManager.getSnapshot();
142:     const slot = settings?.slots?.[provider] || {};
143:     const hasAccount = !!slot.accountId;
144:     const isConnected = SlotController.isConnected(provider);
145: 
146:     select.disabled = !hasAccount || !isConnected;
147: 
148:     const currentVal = options.silent
149:       ? select.value
150:       : this.currentSelections[provider] || "new";
151: 
152:     select.innerHTML = "";
153: 
154:     if (!hasAccount) {
155:       const emptyOpt = new Option("— Slot boş —", "empty");
156:       emptyOpt.disabled = true;
157:       emptyOpt.selected = true;
158:       select.appendChild(emptyOpt);
159:       this.currentSelections[provider] = "empty";
160:       return;
161:     }
162: 
163:     const newOption = new Option("Yeni Sohbet", "new");
164:     newOption.dataset.url = "";
165:     newOption.dataset.folder = "";
166:     select.appendChild(newOption);
167: 
168:     const providerEntries = this.entries.filter((e) => e.provider === provider);
169:     providerEntries.sort((a, b) => b.mtime - a.mtime);
170: 
171:     for (const entry of providerEntries) {
172:       const option = new Option(entry.title || entry.id, entry.id);
173:       option.dataset.folder = entry.folder || "";
174:       option.dataset.url = entry.webUrl || "";
175:       select.appendChild(option);
176:     }
177: 
178:     select.value = currentVal;
179:     if (select.selectedIndex === -1) {
180:       select.value = "new";
181:     }
182:     this.currentSelections[provider] = select.value;
183:   }
184: 
185:   updateSelection(conversationId: string, options: { silent?: boolean; provider?: string | null } = {}) {
186:     const { silent = false, provider: targetProvider = null } = options;
187:     // Provider belirtilmişse ona göre, değilse ilk eşleşeni bul
188:     const entry = targetProvider 
189:       ? this.entries.find((e) => e.id === conversationId && e.provider === targetProvider)
190:       : this.entries.find((e) => e.id === conversationId);
191:     if (!entry) return;
192: 
193:     const { provider } = entry;
194:     const select = this.selects[provider];
195:     if (select && select.value !== conversationId) {
196:       select.value = conversationId;
197:       this.currentSelections[provider] = conversationId;
198:       if (!silent) {
199:         this.handleConversationChange(provider);
200:       }
201:     }
202:   }
203: }

193:     provider: string,
194:     connected: boolean,
195:     opts: { force?: boolean } = {}
196:   ): Promise<ConnectionResult> {
197:     if (!provider) return { success: false, message: "no-provider" };
198: 
199:     if (provider !== "ai0" && provider !== "ai1" && provider !== "ai2") {
200:       return { success: false, message: "invalid-provider" };
201:     }

204:     const now = !!connected;
205:     const force = !!opts.force;
206:

208:       "core",
209:       "info",
210:       `setConnection ${provider} => ${now} (force=${force}, prev=${prev})`,
211:     );
212: 
213:     if (!force && prev === now) {
214:       return { success: true, message: "no-change" };
215:     }

220:     } else {

222:     }
223:

245:     targets = [],
246:     text = "",
247:     page = "generic",
248:     archiveFolders = {},
249:     attachments = [],
250:     jobIds = {},
251:   }: SendBatchParams = {}): Promise<{ success: boolean; message?: string }> {
252:     await this.ensureReady();
253:     const list = Array.isArray(targets)
254:       ? targets.filter(Boolean)
255:       : [targets].filter(Boolean);
256:     if (!list.length) return { success: false, message: "Hedef yok" };
257: 
258:     const attachmentItems = attachments.map((a: string | AttachmentInput) => {
259:       const name =
260:         typeof a === "string"
261:           ? getFilename(a)
262:           : a.name ||
263:             getFilename(a.path || "") ||
264:             getFilename(a.commandPath || "");
265:       const path =
266:         typeof a === "string" ? a : a.path || a.commandPath || a.name;
267:       return { name, path };
268:     });
269:     const attachmentPaths = attachmentItems.map((a) => a.path).filter(Boolean);
270:     const hasAttachments = attachmentPaths.length > 0;
271:     /** @type {Array<any>} */

273:     for (const provider of list) {
274:       const jobId =
275:         jobIds?.[provider] ||
276:         generateUniqueId("cmd");
277:       let staged: { staged: unknown[]; temp: string[]; commandDir: string } = { staged: [], temp: [], commandDir: "" };

280:         staged = stageResult;

284:           `Dosyalar komut için hazırlandı (${jobId})`,
285:           {
286:             jobId,
287:             count: staged.staged?.length || 0,
288:           },
289:         );
290:       }
291:       const stagedEntries = ((staged && staged.staged) || []).map((s) => {
292:         const item = s as { name?: string; renamedName?: string; originalName?: string; commandPath?: string };
293:         return {
294:           ...item,
295:           name:
296:             item.name ||
297:             item.renamedName ||
298:             item.originalName ||
299:             getFilename(item.commandPath || ""),
300:         };
301:       });
302:       jobs.push({
303:         id: jobId,
304:         provider,
305:         message: text || "",
306:         attachments: stagedEntries,
307:         attachmentsMeta: { ...staged, staged: stagedEntries, temp: [] as string[] },
308:         meta: {
309:           targets: list,
310:           page,
311:           attachments: stagedEntries,
312:           archiveFolders,
313:         },
314:       });
315:     }
316:     CommandManager.enqueue(jobs as never[]);
317:     LogManager.addEvent(
318:       "command",
319:       "info",

321:       {
322:         targets: list,
323:         page,
324:       },
325:     );
326:     this.setActiveTargets(list);
327:     return { success: true };

347:   async sendProtocol({
348:     room = "",
349:     scenario = "",
350:     targets = [],
351:     context = {},
352:     mode = null,
353:   }: SendProtocolParams = {}): Promise<{ success: boolean; message?: string }> {
354:     await this.ensureReady();
355:     /** @type {any} */
356:     const payload = ProtocolHandler.buildPayload({
357:       room,
358:       scenario,
359:       targets: /** @type {any} */ (targets),
360:       context,
361:     });
362:     if (!payload) {
363:       LogManager.addEvent(
364:         "protocol",
365:         "warning",
366:         `Bilinmeyen protokol: ${room}:${scenario}`,
367:       );
368:       return { success: false, message: "Bilinmeyen protokol" };
369:     }
370:     /** @type {any[]} */
371:     const targetList = (payload.targets || []).filter((t) =>
372:       SlotController.isConnected(t),
373:     );
374:     if (!targetList.length) {
375:       LogManager.addEvent(
376:         "protocol",
377:         "warning",
378:         "Protokol gönderilemedi, bağlı AI yok",
379:       );
380:       return { success: false, message: "Bağlı hedef yok" };
381:     }
382: 
383:     if (payload.protocolPath && window.electronAPI?.readFile) {
384:       try {
385:         const base64 = await window.electronAPI.readFile(payload.protocolPath);
386:         if (base64) {
387:           payload.message = decodeBase64(base64);
388:           LogManager.addEvent(
389:             "protocol",
390:             "info",
391:             `Protokol dosyası okundu: ${payload.protocolPath}`,
392:           );
393:         }
394:       } catch (err) {
395:         LogManager.addEvent(
396:           "protocol",
397:           "error",
398:           `Protokol dosyası okunamadı: ${(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)) || "unknown error"}`,
399:         );
400:       }
401:     }
402: 
403:     const attachments = ((payload as any).attachments || []).map((att: any) => ({
404:       name: att.name || getFilename(att.path || ""),
405:       path: att.path || att,
406:     }));
407:     if (
408:       room === "analyze" &&
409:       scenario === "ai-ai" &&
410:       mode === "aiRelaySequential"
411:     ) {
412:       try {
413:         let orderedTargets = [...targetList];
414:         const contextStarter =
415:           context && typeof context === "object" && "starter" in context
416:             ? context.starter
417:             : null;
418:         if (contextStarter && orderedTargets.includes(contextStarter as string)) {
419:           orderedTargets = [
420:             contextStarter as string,
421:             ...orderedTargets.filter((t) => t !== contextStarter),
422:           ];
423:         }
424: 
425:         await this.relay?.startProtocolSession?.({
426:           providers: orderedTargets,
427:           protocolPayload: payload,
428:           attachments,
429:         });
430:         LogManager.addEvent(
431:           "protocol",
432:           "info",
433:           `Started sequential protocol session for ${orderedTargets.join(", ")}`,
434:         );
435:         return { success: true, message: "sequential-session-started" };
436:       } catch (e) {
437:         LogManager.addEvent(
438:           "protocol",
439:           "error",
440:           `Failed to start sequential session: ${(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)) || "unknown error"}`,
441:         );
442:       }
443:     }
444: 
445:     const res = await this.sendBatch({
446:       targets: /** @type {any[]} */ (targetList),
447:       text: payload.message,
448:       attachments,
449:       page: `protocol-${room || "generic"}`,
450:     });
451:     try {
452:       if (room === "analyze") {
453:         if (scenario === "ai-ai") {
454:           this.relay?.startSession({ providers: targetList });
455:         }
456:         if (scenario === "ai-ai-stop") {
457:           this.relay?.stopProtocolSession?.();
458:           this.relay?.stopSession?.();
459:         }
460:       }
461:     } catch (e) {
462:       LogManager.addEvent(
463:         "relay",
464:         "warning",
465:         `Failed to apply relay action from protocol: ${(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)) || "unknown error"}`,
466:       );
467:     }
468:     if (res?.success) {
469:       LogManager.addEvent(
470:         "protocol",
471:         "info",
472:         `Protokol gönderildi: ${room}:${scenario} -> ${targetList.join(", ")}`,
473:       );
474:     } else {
475:       LogManager.addEvent(
476:         "protocol",
477:         "error",
478:         `Protokol hata: ${res?.message || "bilinmiyor"} (${room}:${scenario})`,
479:       );
480:     }
481:     return res;
482:   }

484:   async whisper(
485:     op: string,
486:     args?: { user?: string; text?: string; when?: unknown; id?: string }
487:   ): Promise<unknown> {
488:     switch (op) {
489:       case "add":
490:         return WhisperManager.WhisperManagerAdd(
491:           args?.user,
492:           args?.text || "",
493:           args?.when,
494:         );
495:       case "remove":
496:         return WhisperManager.WhisperManagerDelete(args?.user, args?.id || "");
497:       case "list":
498:         return WhisperManager.getRecords(args?.user);
499:       case "done":
500:         return WhisperManager.getDoneRecords(args?.user);
501:       case "catch":
502:         return WhisperManager.catch();
503:       default:
504:         return null;
505:     }

518:     record: WhisperRecord = {},
519:     messageOverride = ""
520:   ): Promise<{ success: boolean; jobId?: string }> {
521:     const text = messageOverride || record.text || "";
522:     const whisperId = record.id || "";
523:     const payload = {
524:       provider,
525:       whisperId,
526:       message: text,
527:       when: record.when,
528:     };
529:     LogManager.addEvent(
530:       "whisper",
531:       "info",
532:       `Whisper kuyruğa alındı (${provider})`,
533:     );
534:     const exec = async (): Promise<void> => {
535:       const res = await this.sendMessage({ provider, text });
536:       if (!res?.success) {
537:         WhisperManager.markReady(provider, whisperId);
538:         throw new Error(
539:           (res && typeof res === "object" && "message" in res
540:             ? String(res.message)
541:             : undefined) || "Whisper gönderilemedi",
542:         );
543:       }
544:       WhisperManager.WhisperManagerDone(provider, whisperId);
545:     };
546:     const job = CommandManager.CommandManagerEnqueue(
547:       provider,
548:       "WhisperSend",
549:       "whisper",
550:       payload,
551:       exec as unknown as null,
552:       "normal",
553:     );
554:     return { success: true, jobId: job?.id };
555:   }
556: 
557:   async handleCaughtCommand(
558:     commandName: string,
559:     payload: CaughtCommandPayload = {}
560:   ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message?: string; jobId?: string; priority?: string }> {
561:     if (!commandName) return { success: false, message: "Komut adı yok" };
562:     const known = Array.isArray(ServerCommands.list())
563:       ? ServerCommands.list().some(
564:           (c) => (c || "").toLowerCase() === String(commandName).toLowerCase(),
565:         )
566:       : false;
567:     if (!known) {
568:       LogManager.addEvent(
569:         "command",
570:         "error",
571:         `Bilinmeyen komut: ${commandName}`,
572:       );
573:       return { success: false, message: "Bilinmeyen komut" };
574:     }
575:     if (!this.settings) {
576:       await this.init();
577:     }
578:     const priority = "normal";
579:     const stamp = new Date().toLocaleString("tr-TR");
580:     const provider = payload.provider || "AI";
581:     const nickAi1 = AppState.getNickname("ai1");
582:     const nickAi2 = AppState.getNickname("ai2");
583:     const humanName = AppState.getNickname("user");
584:     const who =
585:       provider === "ai1" ? nickAi1 : provider === "ai2" ? nickAi2 : provider;
586:     const argLabel =
587:       typeof payload.args === "string" && payload.args.length
588:         ? payload.args
589:         : "";
590:     const cmdText = `++cmd:${commandName}${argLabel ? `(${argLabel})` : "()"}`;
591:     const sender = payload.source === "manual" ? humanName : who;
592:     const queuePayload = {
593:       provider,
594:       command: commandName,
595:       args: argLabel,
596:       source: payload.source || provider,
597:       sender,
598:       webUrl: payload.webUrl || "",
599:       message: cmdText,
600:     };
601:     LogManager.addEvent(
602:       "command-catch",
603:       "info",
604:       `${sender} - ${commandName}${argLabel ? ` (${argLabel})` : ""} - ${stamp}`,
605:       {
606:         provider,
607:         sender,
608:         command: commandName,
609:         args: argLabel,
610:         timestamp: stamp,
611:         webUrl: payload.webUrl || "",
612:       },
613:     );
614:     const execFn = async (): Promise<void> => {
615:       await ServerCommands.run(commandName, queuePayload);
616:     };
617:     const job = CommandManager.CommandManagerEnqueue(
618:       payload.target || "core",
619:       commandName,
620:       "catch",
621:       queuePayload,
622:       execFn as unknown as null,
623:       priority,
624:     );
625:     LogManager.addEvent(
626:       "core",
627:       "info",
628:       `[${stamp}] ${who} - Komut kuyruğa alındı: ${cmdText}`,
629:       {
630:         provider,
631:         command: commandName,
632:         args: argLabel,
633:         jobId: job?.id,
634:       },
635:     );
636:     return { success: true, jobId: job?.id, priority };
637:   }
638: 
639:   setActiveTargets(targets: string[] = []): void {
640:     AppState.setChatTargets(targets as never[]);
641:   }
642: 
643:   listCommands(): unknown[] {
644:     return CommandManager.list();
645:   }
646: 
647:   /**
648:    * Cleanup method - tüm subscription ve interval'ları temizle
649:    * Uygulama kapanırken çağrılmalı
650:    */
651:   destroy(): void {
652:     // Cleanup interval'ı durdur
653:     if (this._cleanupInterval) {
654:       clearInterval(this._cleanupInterval);
655:       this._cleanupInterval = null;
656:     }
657:     // Settings subscription'ı iptal et
658:     if (this._settingsSub) {
659:       this._settingsSub();
660:       this._settingsSub = null;
661:     }
662:     // Memory leak fix: Cleanup CommandManager event listeners
663:     if (this._commandSentUnsub) {
664:       this._commandSentUnsub();
665:       this._commandSentUnsub = null;
666:     }
667:     if (this._commandFailedUnsub) {
668:       this._commandFailedUnsub();
669:       this._commandFailedUnsub = null;
670:     }
671:     // Memory leak fix: Cleanup SlotController event listeners
672:     if (this._slotTrafficStartedUnsub) {
673:       this._slotTrafficStartedUnsub();
674:       this._slotTrafficStartedUnsub = null;
675:     }
676:     if (this._slotTrafficStoppedUnsub) {
677:       this._slotTrafficStoppedUnsub();
678:       this._slotTrafficStoppedUnsub = null;
679:     }
680:     this.initialized = false;
681:     LogManager.addEvent("core", "info", "CoreEngine destroyed", { visibility: 2 });
682:   }
683: }
684: 
685: export const CoreEngine = new CoreEngineClass();

117: const createSlotState = (slotId: string): SlotStateData => ({
118:   state: SlotState.EMPTY,
119:   stateMachine: createSlotStateMachine(slotId, SlotStates.EMPTY),
120:   accountId: null,
121:   providerId: null,
122:   providerConfig: null,
123:   webview: null,
124:   webviewRegistered: false,
125:   domReady: false,
126:   currentUrl: null,
127:   urlExcluded: false,
128:   trafficStarted: false,
129:   correlationId: null,
130:   error: null,
131:   lastActivity: Date.now(),

136: class SlotControllerClass {
137:   _slots: Record<string, any>;
138:   _listeners: ((...args: any[]) => void)[];
139:   _initialized: boolean;
140:   _boundLog: typeof this._log;
141:   _boundEmit: typeof this._emit;
142:   _boundTransition: typeof this._transition;
143: 
144:   constructor() {
145:     this._slots = {
146:       ai0: createSlotState("ai0"), // Asistan slotu
147:       ai1: createSlotState("ai1"),
148:       ai2: createSlotState("ai2"),
149:     };
150:     this._listeners = [];
151:     this._initialized = false;
152:     
153:     this._boundLog = this._log.bind(this);
154:     this._boundEmit = this._emit.bind(this);
155:     this._boundTransition = this._transition.bind(this);
156:   }
157: 
158:   // ============================================
159:   // ============================================
160:   
161:   async init() {
162:     if (this._initialized) return;
163:     
164:     SettingsManager.subscribe(({ settings, changedPaths }: { settings: unknown; changedPaths: string[] }) => {
165:       handleSettingsChange(this._slots, settings as any, changedPaths, ((slot: string, s: SlotStateData) => {
166:         this._syncSlotWithSettings(slot, s);
167:       }) as any);
168:     });
169:     
170:     const settings = SettingsManager.getSnapshot();
171:     syncWithSettings(this._slots, settings as any, ((slot: string, s: SlotStateData) => {
172:       this._syncSlotWithSettings(slot, s);
173:     }) as any);
174:     
175:     this._initialized = true;
176:     LogManager.addEvent("slot-controller", "info", "SlotController initialized", { visibility: 2 });
177:   }
178: 
179:   // ============================================
180:   // ============================================
181: 
182:   getState(slot: string) {
183:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) return null;
184:     return { ...this._slots[slot] };
185:   }
186: 
187:   isConnected(slot: string) {
188:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) return false;
189:     return this._slots[slot].state === SlotState.CONNECTED;
190:   }
191: 
192:   isAssigned(slot: string) {
193:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) return false;
194:     return this._slots[slot].state !== SlotState.EMPTY;
195:   }
196: 
197:   isTransitioning(slot: string) {
198:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) return false;
199:     const state = this._slots[slot].state;
200:     return state === SlotState.CONNECTING || state === SlotState.DISCONNECTING;
201:   }
202: 
203:   isUrlExcluded(slot: string) {
204:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) return false;
205:     return this._slots[slot].urlExcluded;
206:   }
207: 
208:   getProviderId(slot: string) {
209:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) return null;
210:     return this._slots[slot].providerId;
211:   }
212: 
213:   getWebview(slot: string) {
214:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) return null;
215:     return this._slots[slot].webview;
216:   }
217: 
218:   // ============================================
219:   // ============================================
220: 
221:   registerWebview(slot: string, webview: HTMLElement) {
222:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot) || !webview) return;
223:     
224:     const slotState = this._slots[slot];
225:     
226:     // Zaten aynı webview register edilmişse tekrar log yazma
227:     if (slotState.webviewRegistered && slotState.webview === webview) {
228:       return; // Çift register'u önle
229:     }
230:     
231:     slotState.webview = webview;
232:     slotState.webviewRegistered = true;
233:     slotState.lastActivity = Date.now();
234:     
235:     this._log(slot, "info", "Webview registered");
236:     this._emit(slot, SlotEvent.WEBVIEW_REGISTERED, { webview });
237:   }
238: 
239:   unregisterWebview(slot: string) {
240:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) return;
241:     
242:     const slotState = this._slots[slot];
243:     
244:     if (slotState.state === SlotState.CONNECTED) {
245:       this.disconnect(slot, { force: true });
246:     }
247:     
248:     slotState.webview = null;
249:     slotState.webviewRegistered = false;
250:     slotState.domReady = false;
251:     
252:     this._log(slot, "info", "Webview unregistered");
253:     this._emit(slot, SlotEvent.WEBVIEW_DETACHED, {});
254:   }
255: 
256:   recoverFromError(slot: string) {
257:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) {
258:       return { success: false, message: "invalid-slot" };
259:     }
260: 
261:     const slotState = this._slots[slot];
262:     
263:     if (slotState.state !== SlotState.ERROR) {
264:       return { success: false, message: "not-in-error-state" };
265:     }
266: 
267:     this._log(slot, "info", "Manual recovery from ERROR state");
268:     slotState.error = null;
269:     
270:     if (slotState.accountId) {
271:       this._transition(slot, SlotState.ASSIGNED);
272:     } else {
273:       this._transition(slot, SlotState.EMPTY);
274:     }
275: 
276:     return { success: true, message: "recovered" };
277:   }
278: 
279:   // ============================================
280:   // ============================================
281: 
282:   async connect(slot: string, options: { force?: boolean; url?: string; correlationId?: string } = {}) {
283:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) {
284:       return { success: false, message: "invalid-slot" };
285:     }
286: 
287:     const slotState = this._slots[slot];
288:     const correlationId = this._generateCorrelationId(slot, "connect");
289:     
290:     this._log(slot, "info", `Connect requested`, { correlationId });
291: 
292:     if (slotState.state === SlotState.EMPTY) {
293:       this._log(slot, "warning", "Cannot connect: no account assigned", { correlationId });
294:       return { success: false, message: "no-account-assigned", correlationId };
295:     }
296: 
297:     if (slotState.state === SlotState.CONNECTED && !options.force) {
298:       this._log(slot, "debug", "Already connected", { correlationId });
299:       return { success: true, message: "already-connected", correlationId };
300:     }
301: 
302:     if (slotState.state === SlotState.CONNECTING) {
303:       this._log(slot, "warning", "Connection already in progress", { correlationId });
304:       return { success: false, message: "connection-in-progress", correlationId };
305:     }
306: 
307:     if (slotState.state === SlotState.ERROR) {
308:       this._log(slot, "info", "Recovering from ERROR state", { correlationId });
309:       slotState.error = null;
310:       this._transition(slot, SlotState.ASSIGNED);
311:     }
312: 
313:     if (slotState.state === SlotState.CONNECTED && options.force) {
314:       this._log(slot, "info", "Force reconnect - disconnecting first", { correlationId });
315:       await this.disconnect(slot, { force: true });
316:     }
317: 
318:     if (!slotState.webview) {
319:       this._log(slot, "error", "Cannot connect: webview not registered", { correlationId });
320:       return { success: false, message: "webview-not-registered", correlationId };
321:     }
322: 
323:     // URL override desteği (OpenCode gibi dinamik URL gerektiren provider'lar için)
324:     if (options.url) {
325:       slotState._overrideUrl = options.url;
326:       this._log(slot, "debug", `URL override set: ${options.url}`, { correlationId });
327:     }
328: 
329:     slotState.correlationId = correlationId;
330:     
331:     // State transition - başarısız olursa devam etme
332:     const transitionResult = this._transition(slot, SlotState.CONNECTING);
333:     if (!transitionResult.success) {
334:       this._log(slot, "error", `Invalid state transition blocked: ${slotState.state} → connecting. ${transitionResult.error}`, { correlationId });
335:       return { success: false, message: "invalid-state-transition", correlationId, error: transitionResult.error };
336:     }
337:     this._emit(slot, SlotEvent.CONNECT_START, { correlationId });
338: 
339:     startTimeout(slot, "connect", CONFIG.connectTimeoutMs, () => {
340:       handleConnectTimeout(
341:         slotState, slot, correlationId, SlotState.ERROR,
342:         this._boundLog, this._boundEmit, this._boundTransition,
343:         SlotEvent.CONNECT_FAILED,
344:         (s, cid) => this._cleanupAfterError(s, cid)
345:       );
346:     });
347: 
348:     try {
349:       await attachWebview(slotState, slot, correlationId, this._boundLog, this._boundEmit, SlotEvent.WEBVIEW_ATTACHED);
350: 
351:       await waitForDomReady(slotState, slot, correlationId, this._boundLog);
352:       slotState.domReady = true;
353:       this._emit(slot, SlotEvent.WEBVIEW_DOM_READY, { correlationId });
354: 
355:       await this._delay(CONFIG.urlCheckDelayMs);
356:       const currentUrl = getCurrentUrl(slotState);
357:       slotState.currentUrl = currentUrl;
358:       
359:       const isExcluded = checkUrlExclusion(slotState, currentUrl);
360:       slotState.urlExcluded = isExcluded;
361: 
362:       if (isExcluded) {
363:         this._emit(slot, SlotEvent.URL_EXCLUDED, { url: currentUrl, correlationId });
364:         this._log(slot, "info", `URL excluded: ${currentUrl} - traffic disabled`, { correlationId });
365:       } else {
366:         this._emit(slot, SlotEvent.URL_INCLUDED, { url: currentUrl, correlationId });
367:         await this._startTraffic(slot, correlationId);
368:       }
369: 
370:       setupUrlChangeHandler(slotState, slot, correlationId, (s: string, url: string) => {
371:         this._handleUrlChange(s, url);
372:       });
373: 
374:       clearTimeout(slot, "connect");
375:       this._transition(slot, SlotState.CONNECTED);
376:       this._emit(slot, SlotEvent.CONNECT_COMPLETE, { correlationId, urlExcluded: isExcluded });
377: 
378:       const elapsed = Date.now() - slotState.lastActivity;
379:       this._log(slot, "success", `Connected successfully (${elapsed}ms)${isExcluded ? " [URL excluded]" : ""}`, { correlationId });
380: 
381:       return { success: true, message: "connected", correlationId };
382:     } catch (error) {
383:       clearTimeout(slot, "connect");
384:       return handleConnectError(
385:         slotState, slot, correlationId, error, SlotState.ERROR,
386:         this._boundLog, this._boundEmit, this._boundTransition,
387:         SlotEvent.CONNECT_FAILED,
388:         (s, cid) => this._cleanupAfterError(s, cid)
389:       );
390:     }
391:   }
392: 
393:   async disconnect(slot: string, _options: { force?: boolean } = {}) {
394:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) {
395:       return { success: false, message: "invalid-slot" };
396:     }
397: 
398:     const slotState = this._slots[slot];
399:     const correlationId = this._generateCorrelationId(slot, "disconnect");
400: 
401:     this._log(slot, "info", "Disconnect requested", { correlationId });
402: 
403:     if (slotState.state === SlotState.EMPTY) {
404:       return { success: true, message: "not-assigned", correlationId };
405:     }
406: 
407:     // ASSIGNED durumunda zaten bağlı değil - disconnect gereksiz
408:     // force=true olsa bile ASSIGNED'dan DISCONNECTING'e geçiş geçersiz
409:     if (slotState.state === SlotState.ASSIGNED) {
410:       this._log(slot, "debug", "Already disconnected (ASSIGNED state)", { correlationId });
411:       return { success: true, message: "already-disconnected", correlationId };
412:     }
413: 
414:     if (slotState.state === SlotState.DISCONNECTING) {
415:       return { success: false, message: "disconnect-in-progress", correlationId };
416:     }
417: 
418:     // State transition - başarısız olursa devam etme
419:     const transitionResult = this._transition(slot, SlotState.DISCONNECTING);
420:     if (!transitionResult.success) {
421:       this._log(slot, "error", `Invalid state transition blocked: ${slotState.state} → disconnecting. ${transitionResult.error}`, { correlationId });
422:       return { success: false, message: "invalid-state-transition", correlationId, error: transitionResult.error };
423:     }
424:     this._emit(slot, SlotEvent.DISCONNECT_START, { correlationId });
425: 
426:     try {
427:       clearUrlChangeHandler(slot);
428: 
429:       if (slotState.trafficStarted) {
430:         await this._stopTraffic(slot, correlationId);
431:       }
432: 
433:       await detachWebview(slotState, slot, correlationId, this._boundLog, this._boundEmit, SlotEvent.WEBVIEW_DETACHED);
434: 
435:       slotState.domReady = false;
436:       slotState.currentUrl = null;
437:       slotState.urlExcluded = false;
438:       slotState.trafficStarted = false;
439:       slotState.correlationId = null;
440:       slotState.error = null;
441: 
442:       this._transition(slot, SlotState.ASSIGNED);
443:       this._emit(slot, SlotEvent.DISCONNECT_COMPLETE, { correlationId });
444: 
445:       this._log(slot, "success", "Disconnected successfully", { correlationId });
446:       return { success: true, message: "disconnected", correlationId };
447:     } catch (error) {
448:       slotState.domReady = false;
449:       slotState.trafficStarted = false;
450:       this._transition(slot, SlotState.ASSIGNED);
451:       
452:       this._log(slot, "warning", `Disconnect completed with errors: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`, { correlationId });
453:       return { success: true, message: "disconnected-with-errors", correlationId };
454:     }
455:   }
456: 
457:   // ============================================
458:   // ============================================
459: 
460:   navigate(slot: string, url: string | null = null) {
461:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) return;
462:     
463:     navigateWebview(
464:       this._slots[slot], slot, url, SlotState.CONNECTED,
465:       this._boundLog, this._boundEmit, SlotEvent.WEBVIEW_NAVIGATED
466:     );
467:   }

470:   // ============================================

472:   subscribe(listener: (payload: unknown) => void) {
473:     if (typeof listener === "function") {
474:       this._listeners.push(listener);
475:     }
476:     return () => {
477:       this._listeners = this._listeners.filter((l) => l !== listener);
478:     };
479:   }
480: 
481:   on(eventType: string, listener: (payload: { event?: string; slot?: string }) => void) {
482:     const wrapper = (payload: { event?: string; slot?: string }) => {
483:       if (payload.event === eventType) {
484:         listener(payload);
485:       }
486:     };
487:     wrapper._original = listener;
488:     wrapper._eventType = eventType;
489:     this._listeners.push(wrapper);
490:     return () => {
491:       this._listeners = this._listeners.filter((l) => l !== wrapper);
492:     };
493:   }
494: 
495:   // ============================================
496:   // ============================================

498:   _syncSlotWithSettings(slot: string, settings: SlotStateData) {
499:     syncSlotWithSettings(
500:       this._slots[slot], slot, settings as any,
501:       { EMPTY: SlotState.EMPTY, ASSIGNED: SlotState.ASSIGNED, CONNECTED: SlotState.CONNECTED, CONNECTING: SlotState.CONNECTING },
502:       { ACCOUNT_ASSIGNED: SlotEvent.ACCOUNT_ASSIGNED, ACCOUNT_REMOVED: SlotEvent.ACCOUNT_REMOVED },
503:       this._boundLog, this._boundTransition, this._boundEmit,
504:       (s: string, opts?: { force?: boolean }) => this.disconnect(s, opts),
505:       (s: string) => this.navigate(s)
506:     );
507:   }

513:     handleUrlChange(

515:       this._boundLog, this._boundEmit,
516:       { URL_CHANGED: SlotEvent.URL_CHANGED, URL_EXCLUDED: SlotEvent.URL_EXCLUDED, URL_INCLUDED: SlotEvent.URL_INCLUDED },
517:       (s: SlotId, cid: string) => this._startTraffic(s, cid),
518:       (s: SlotId, cid: string) => this._stopTraffic(s, cid)
519:     );
520:   }

525:   async _startTraffic(slot: string, correlationId: string) {
526:     const slotState = this._slots[slot];
527:     if (!slotState.webview || slotState.trafficStarted) return;
528: 
529:     try {
530:       slotState.trafficStarted = true;
531:       this._emit(slot, SlotEvent.TRAFFIC_STARTED, { correlationId });
532:       this._log(slot, "debug", "Traffic started", { correlationId });
533:     } catch (err) {
534:       this._log(slot, "warning", `Traffic start warning: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, { correlationId });
535:     }
536:   }
537: 
538:   async _stopTraffic(slot: string, correlationId: string) {
539:     const slotState = this._slots[slot];
540:     if (!slotState.trafficStarted) return;
541: 
542:     try {
543:       slotState.trafficStarted = false;
544:       this._emit(slot, SlotEvent.TRAFFIC_STOPPED, { correlationId });
545:       this._log(slot, "debug", "Traffic stopped", { correlationId });
546:     } catch (err) {
547:       this._log(slot, "warning", `Traffic stop warning: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`, { correlationId });
548:     }
549:   }
550: 
551:   // ============================================
552:   // ============================================
553: 
554:   async _cleanupAfterError(slot: string, correlationId: string) {
555:     await cleanupAfterError(
556:       this._slots[slot], slot, correlationId,
557:       this._boundLog,
558:       (s: string) => clearUrlChangeHandler(s as SlotId),
559:       (s: string) => clearDomReadyHandler(s as SlotId),
560:       (s: string, cid: string) => this._stopTraffic(s, cid),
561:       (s: string, cid: string) => detachWebview(this._slots[s], s as SlotId, cid, this._boundLog, this._boundEmit, SlotEvent.WEBVIEW_DETACHED as string)
562:     );
563:   }

565:   // ============================================
566:   // ============================================
567: 
568:   /**
569:    * State transition with validation
570:    * @returns TransitionResult with success status and details
571:    */
572:   _transition(slot: string, newState: string, reason?: string): TransitionResult {
573:     const slotState = this._slots[slot];
574:     const oldState = slotState.state;
575:     
576:     // State machine ile geçerlilik kontrolü ve geçiş
577:     const result = slotState.stateMachine.transition(
578:       newState as SlotStateType,
579:       {
580:         correlationId: slotState.correlationId || undefined,
581:         reason,
582:       }
583:     );
584:     
585:     if (result.success) {
586:       // Legacy state alanını da güncelle (backward compatibility)
587:       slotState.state = newState;
588:       slotState.lastActivity = Date.now();
589:       
590:       if (!result.wasNoOp) {
591:         this._emit(slot, SlotEvent.STATE_CHANGED, { 
592:           oldState, 
593:           newState,
594:           validated: true,
595:         });
596:       }
597:     } else {
598:       // Geçersiz transition - hata logla ama crash etme
599:       this._log(slot, "error", `Invalid state transition blocked: ${oldState} → ${newState}. ${result.error}`);
600:     }
601:     
602:     return result;
603:   }
604: 
605:   /**
606:    * State machine üzerinden mevcut state'i al
607:    */
608:   getStateMachineState(slot: string): SlotStateType | null {
609:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) return null;
610:     return this._slots[slot].stateMachine.state;
611:   }
612: 
613:   /**
614:    * State machine debug bilgisini al
615:    */
616:   getStateMachineDebugInfo(slot: string) {
617:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) return null;
618:     return this._slots[slot].stateMachine.getDebugInfo();
619:   }
620: 
621:   /**
622:    * Belirli bir state'e geçiş yapılabilir mi kontrol et
623:    */
624:   canTransitionTo(slot: string, targetState: string): boolean {
625:     if (!this._isValidSlot(slot)) return false;
626:     return this._slots[slot].stateMachine.canTransitionTo(targetState as SlotStateType);
627:   }
628: 
629:   // ============================================
630:   // ============================================
631: 
632:   _isValidSlot(slot: string) {
633:     return slot === "ai0" || slot === "ai1" || slot === "ai2";
634:   }
635: 
636:   _generateCorrelationId(slot: string, operation: string) {
637:     const timestamp = Date.now();
638:     const random = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
639:     return `${slot}-${operation}-${timestamp}-${random}`;
640:   }
641: 
642:   _emit(slot: string, event: string, data: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
643:     const payload = {
644:       slot,
645:       event,
646:       data,
647:       timestamp: Date.now(),
648:       state: this._slots[slot]?.state,
649:     };
650: 
651:     this._listeners.forEach((listener) => {
652:       try {
653:         listener(payload);
654:       } catch (_err) {
655:       }
656:     });
657:   }
658: 
659:   _log(slot: string, level: string, message: string, context: { correlationId?: string } = {}) {
660:     const prefix = context.correlationId ? `[${context.correlationId}] ` : "";
661:     LogManager.addEvent(`slot-${slot}`, level, `${prefix}${message}`);
662:   }
663: 
664:   _delay(ms: number) {
665:     return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
666:   }
667: }

344:   setupWebviewEvents(type: SlotType, webviewEl: WebviewElement, providerId: string | null = null): void {
345:     if (!webviewEl) return;
346: 
347:     webviewEl.addEventListener("did-start-loading", () => {
348:       try {
349:         if (typeof webviewEl.getWebContentsId !== "function") return;
350:         webviewEl.getWebContentsId();
351:       } catch (_) {
352:         return;
353:       }
354: 
355:       let currentUrl = "";
356:       try {
357:         currentUrl = webviewEl.getURL?.() || "";
358:       } catch (_) {
359:         // getURL başarısız olabilir
360:       }
361:       const isExcluded = WebviewManager?.isUrlExcluded?.(type, currentUrl);
362:       
363:       const state = this.loadLogState[type] || { lastStart: 0, lastStop: 0 };
364:       const now = Date.now();
365: 
366:       if (!isExcluded && now - state.lastStart > 1200) {
367:         this.addLog(type, "info", "Sayfa yükleniyor...", { visibility: 3 });
368:         state.lastStart = now;
369:       }
370:       this.loadLogState[type] = state;
371:     });
372: 
373:     webviewEl.addEventListener("did-stop-loading", async () => {
374:       try {
375:         if (typeof webviewEl.getWebContentsId !== "function") return;
376:         webviewEl.getWebContentsId();
377:       } catch (_) {
378:         return;
379:       }
380: 
381:       const state = this.loadLogState[type] || { lastStart: 0, lastStop: 0 };
382:       const now = Date.now();
383: 
384:       if (now - state.lastStop > 1200) {
385:         this.addLog(type, "info", "Sayfa yükleme tamamlandı", { visibility: 3 });
386:         state.lastStop = now;
387:       }
388:       this.loadLogState[type] = state;
389: 
390:       // Provider config injection - sadece excluded olmayan sayfalarda
391:       let currentUrl = "";
392:       try {
393:         currentUrl = webviewEl.getURL?.() || "";
394:       } catch (_) {
395:         return;
396:       }
397:       
398:       const isExcluded = WebviewManager?.isUrlExcluded?.(type, currentUrl);
399:       if (isExcluded) return;
400: 
401:       const currentProviderId = AppState.getProviderIdForSlot(type) || providerId;
402:       const cfg = currentProviderId ? ProviderRegistry.get(currentProviderId) : null;
403:       if (cfg) {
404:         try {
405:           const configScript = `
406:             (function() {
407:               try {
408:                 window.__hayalet_slot = ${JSON.stringify(type)};
409:                 window.__hayalet_provider_config = ${JSON.stringify(cfg)};
410:                 return true;
411:               } catch (e) {
412:                 console.error('[Hayalet-Config-Inject] Failed:', e);
413:                 return false;
414:               }
415:             })();
416:           `;
417:           await webviewEl.executeJavaScript?.(configScript);
418:         } catch (_err) {
419:           // Config injection başarısız - send() öncesi fallback devreye girecek
420:         }
421:       }
422:     });
423: 
424:     webviewEl.addEventListener("ipc-message", (event: Event & { channel?: string; args?: unknown[] }) => {
425:       try {
426:         if (!event || !event.channel) return;
427:         if (event.channel === "provider-usage") {
428:           const payload = (event.args && event.args[0]) as { tokens?: string | string[] } | null;
429:           if (payload) {
430:             const titleEl = document.getElementById(`${type}-title`);
431:             if (titleEl) {
432:               const base = AppState.getNickname(type);
433:               const tokens = Array.isArray(payload.tokens)
434:                 ? payload.tokens.join(",")
435:                 : String(payload.tokens || "");
436:               titleEl.textContent = tokens
437:                 ? `${base} — tokens: ${tokens}`
438:                 : base;
439:             }
440:           }
441:         }
442:       } catch (err) {
443:         const error = err as Error;
444:         LogManager.addEvent("webview-panel", "warning", `IPC message handler hatası: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`);
445:       }
446:     });
447: 
448:     webviewEl.addEventListener("did-fail-load", (event: Event & { errorCode?: number; errorDescription?: string }) => {
449:       if (event.errorCode !== -3 && event.errorCode !== -102) {
450:         this.addLog(
451:           type,
452:           "error",
453:           `Yükleme hatası (${event.errorCode}): ${event.errorDescription || "Bilinmeyen hata"}`,
454:         );
455:       } else if (event.errorCode === -3) {
456:         this.addLog(type, "info", "Yükleme iptal edildi (normal)");
457:       }
458:     });
459:   }
460: 
461:   openDevTools(type: SlotType): void {
462:     try {
463:       const webview = type === "ai1" ? this.ai1Webview : this.ai2Webview;
464:       if (!webview) {
465:         this.addLog(type, "error", "Webview bulunamadı");
466:         return;
467:       }
468: 
469:       (webview as WebviewElement).openDevTools?.();
470:       this.addLog(type, "info", "DevTools açıldı");
471:     } catch (err) {
472:       const error = err as Error;
473:       LogManager.addEvent("webview-panel", "error", `DevTools açma hatası: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`, { context: { type } });
474:       this.addLog(type, "error", `DevTools açma hatası: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`);
475:     }
476:   }
477: 
478:   addLog(type: SlotType, level: LogLevel, message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void {
479:     LogManager.addEvent(`webview-panel-${type}`, level, message, meta || null);
480:   }
481: 
482:   destroy(): void {
483:     if (this.trafficUnsub) {
484:       this.trafficUnsub();
485:       this.trafficUnsub = null;
486:     }
487:   }
488: }

298:   async deleteEntry(entry: ArchiveEntry | null): Promise<void> {
299:     if (!entry) return;
300:     if (
301:       !confirm(
302:         `'${entry.title || entry.id}' kaydını kalıcı olarak silmek istediğinize emin misiniz?`,
303:       )
304:     ) {
305:       return;
306:     }
307: 
308:     const deleteBtn = document.getElementById("btn-delete") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
309: 
310:     try {
311:       // Loading state
312:       if (deleteBtn) {
313:         ButtonStates.setLoading(deleteBtn, "Siliniyor...");
314:       }
315: 
316:       // Slot'tan hesap bilgisini al
317:       const accountInfo = AppState.getAccountForSlot(entry.provider || "");
318:       if (!accountInfo?.id) {
319:         if (deleteBtn) {
320:           ButtonStates.setError(deleteBtn, "Hata!", 1500);
321:         }
322:         this.setStatus("Hesap bilgisi bulunamadı", "error");
323:         return;
324:       }
325: 
326:       // DB'den sil
327:       const result = await window.electronAPI?.dbDeleteConversation?.({
328:         accountId: accountInfo.id,
329:         conversationId: entry.id,
330:       });
331: 
332:       if (!result?.success) {
333:         if (deleteBtn) {
334:           ButtonStates.setError(deleteBtn, "Hata!", 1500);
335:         }
336:         this.setStatus(result?.error || "Sohbet silinemedi", "error");
337:         return;
338:       }
339: 
340:       // Success state
341:       if (deleteBtn) {
342:         ButtonStates.setSuccess(deleteBtn, "Silindi!", 1500);
343:       }
344: 
345:       LogManager.addEvent("archives", "success", `Sohbet silindi: ${entry.id}`, { showToast: false });
346: 
347:       const isActive = this.selectedId === entry.id;
348:       if (isActive) {
349:         this.selectedId = null;
350:       }
351: 
352:       // Listeyi yenile
353:       await this.loadIndex();
354:       await ConversationListManager.refresh({ silent: true });
355: 
356:       if (isActive) {
357:         this.fillForm(null);
358:         this.setStatus("Sohbet silindi", "success");
359:       } else {
360:         this.setStatus("Sohbet silindi", "success");
361:       }
362:     } catch (e) {
363:       const err = e as Error;
364:       if (deleteBtn) {
365:         ButtonStates.setError(deleteBtn, "Hata!", 1500);
366:       }
367:       LogManager.addEvent("archives", "error", `Silme hatası: ${err.message}`);
368:       this.setStatus("Sohbet silinirken hata oluştu", "error");
369:     }
370:   }
