408:   async performSearch(): Promise<void> {
409:     if (!this.searchQuery || this.searchQuery.length < 2) {
410:       this.clearSearchResults();
411:       return;
412:     }
413: 
414:     try {
415:       let results;
416: 
417:       if (this.searchScope === "all") {
418:         // Tüm hesaplarda ara
419:         results = await window.electronAPI?.dbSearchAllAccounts?.({
420:           query: this.searchQuery,
421:           limit: 50,
422:         });
423:       } else {
424:         // Mevcut hesapta ara
425:         const accountInfo = AppState.getAccountForSlot(this.activeProvider);
426:         if (!accountInfo?.id) {
427:           this.searchResults = { messages: [], attachments: [] };
428:           this.renderSearchResults();
429:           return;
430:         }
431: 
432:         const [messages, attachments] = await Promise.all([
433:           window.electronAPI?.dbSearchMessages?.({
434:             accountId: accountInfo.id,
435:             query: this.searchQuery,
436:             limit: 50,
437:           }),
438:           window.electronAPI?.dbSearchAttachments?.({
439:             accountId: accountInfo.id,
440:             query: this.searchQuery,
441:             limit: 50,
442:           }),
443:         ]) as [Record<string, unknown>[] | undefined, Record<string, unknown>[] | undefined];
444: 
445:         results = {
446:           messages: (messages || []).map(m => ({ ...m, accountId: accountInfo.id })),
447:           attachments: (attachments || []).map(a => ({ ...a, accountId: accountInfo.id })),
448:         };
449:       }
450: 
451:       this.searchResults = (results as { messages: MessageResult[]; attachments: FileResult[] }) || { messages: [], attachments: [] };
452:       this.renderSearchResults();
453:     } catch (e) {
454:       const err = e as Error;
455:       LogManager.addEvent("archives", "error", `Arama hatası: ${err.message}`);
456:       this.searchResults = { messages: [], attachments: [] };
457:       this.renderSearchResults();
458:     }
459:   }
460: 
461:   renderSearchResults(): void {
462:     const { messages, attachments } = this.searchResults;
463:     
464:     // Sayaçları güncelle
465:     if (this.messagesCountEl) this.messagesCountEl.textContent = String(messages.length);
466:     if (this.filesCountEl) this.filesCountEl.textContent = String(attachments.length);
467: 
468:     // Empty state
469:     const hasResults = messages.length > 0 || attachments.length > 0;
470:     this.searchEmptyEl?.classList.toggle("hidden", hasResults || !this.searchQuery);
471: 
472:     // Mesaj sonuçları
473:     if (this.resultsMessagesEl) {
474:       if (messages.length === 0) {
475:         this.resultsMessagesEl.innerHTML = this.searchQuery 
476:           ? '<div class="no-results">Mesaj bulunamadı</div>' 
477:           : '';
478:       } else {
479:         this.resultsMessagesEl.innerHTML = messages.map(m => this.renderMessageResult(m)).join("");
480:       }
481: 
482:       // Event listeners
483:       this.resultsMessagesEl.querySelectorAll(".result-item").forEach((el, i) => {
484:         el.addEventListener("click", () => this.navigateToResult(messages[i], "message"));
485:       });
486:     }
487: 
488:     // Dosya sonuçları
489:     if (this.resultsFilesEl) {
490:       if (attachments.length === 0) {
491:         this.resultsFilesEl.innerHTML = this.searchQuery 
492:           ? '<div class="no-results">Dosya bulunamadı</div>' 
493:           : '';
494:       } else {
495:         this.resultsFilesEl.innerHTML = attachments.map(a => this.renderFileResult(a)).join("");
496:       }
497: 
498:       // Event listeners
499:       this.resultsFilesEl.querySelectorAll(".result-item").forEach((el, i) => {
500:         el.addEventListener("click", () => this.navigateToResult(attachments[i], "file"));
501:       });
502:     }
503:   }

505:   renderMessageResult(msg: MessageResult): string {
506:     const snippet = this.highlightSnippet(msg.snippet || msg.content || "", this.searchQuery);
507:     const accountLabel = this.getAccountLabel(msg.accountId);
508:     
509:     return `
510:       <div class="result-item" data-conversation-id="${msg.conversationId}">
511:         <div class="result-item-header">
512:           <span class="result-item-title">${this.escapeHtml(msg.conversationTitle || "İsimsiz Sohbet")}</span>
513:           ${this.searchScope === "all" ? `<span class="result-item-account">${accountLabel}</span>` : ""}
514:         </div>
515:         <div class="result-item-snippet">${snippet}</div>
516:       </div>
517:     `;
518:   }
519: 
520:   renderFileResult(file: FileResult): string {
521:     const icon = this.getFileIcon(file.mimeType);
522:     const size = this.formatFileSize(file.size);
523:     const accountLabel = this.getAccountLabel(file.accountId || "");
524:     
525:     return `
526:       <div class="result-item" data-stored-path="${this.escapeHtml(file.storedPath || "")}">
527:         <div class="file-result">
528:           <span class="file-icon">${icon}</span>
529:           <div class="file-info">
530:             <div class="file-name">${this.escapeHtml(file.originalName || "")}</div>
531:             <div class="file-meta">
532:               ${this.escapeHtml(file.conversationTitle || "İsimsiz Sohbet")} · ${size}
533:               ${this.searchScope === "all" ? ` · ${accountLabel}` : ""}
534:             </div>
535:           </div>
536:         </div>
537:       </div>
538:     `;
539:   }

541:   async navigateToResult(result: MessageResult | FileResult, type: string): Promise<void> {
542:     if (type === "file") {
543:       // Dosyayı aç
544:       const fileResult = result as FileResult;
545:       if (fileResult.storedPath) {
546:         try {
547:           await window.electronAPI?.openPath?.(fileResult.storedPath);
548:         } catch (err) {
549:           this.setStatus("Dosya açılamadı", "error");
550:         }
551:       }
552:       return;
553:     }
554: 
555:     // Mesaj sonucu - ilgili sohbete git
556:     const { accountId, conversationId } = result;
557:     if (!accountId || !conversationId) return;
558: 
559:     // Provider'ı bul (accountId'den)
560:     const ai1Account = AppState.getAccountForSlot("ai1");
561:     const ai2Account = AppState.getAccountForSlot("ai2");
562:     
563:     let targetProvider = null;
564:     if (ai1Account?.id === accountId) {
565:       targetProvider = "ai1";
566:     } else if (ai2Account?.id === accountId) {
567:       targetProvider = "ai2";
568:     }
569: 
570:     if (!targetProvider) {
571:       this.setStatus("Hesap bulunamadı", "error");
572:       return;
573:     }
574: 
575:     // Provider'ı değiştir
576:     if (this.activeProvider !== targetProvider) {
577:       this.activeProvider = targetProvider;
578:       const radio = document.querySelector(`input[name="archives-provider"][value="${targetProvider}"]`) as HTMLInputElement | null;
579:       if (radio) radio.checked = true;
580:       await this.loadIndex();
581:     }
582: 
583:     // Sohbeti seç
584:     this.selectedId = conversationId;
585:     this.renderList();
586:     
587:     const entry = this.entries.find(e => e.id === conversationId);
588:     if (entry) {
589:       this.fillForm(entry);
590:       
591:       // Liste içinde scroll
592:       const item = this.listEl?.querySelector(`.archive-item.selected`);
593:       item?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
594:     }
595:   }

603:     });

623:   highlightSnippet(text: string, query: string): string {
624:     if (!text || !query) return this.escapeHtml(text || "");
625:     
626:     const escaped = this.escapeHtml(text);
627:     const queryEscaped = query.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
628:     const regex = new RegExp(`(${queryEscaped})`, "gi");
629:     
630:     return escaped.replace(regex, "<mark>$1</mark>");
631:   }
632: 
633:   escapeHtml(text: string): string {
634:     const div = document.createElement("div");
635:     div.textContent = text;
636:     return div.innerHTML;
637:   }

639:   getAccountLabel(accountId: string | undefined): string {
640:     if (!accountId) return "";
641:     // accountId: chatgpt_user_at_gmail_com → ChatGPT
642:     const provider = accountId.split("_")[0];
643:     return provider.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + provider.slice(1);
644:   }

646:   getFileIcon(mimeType: string | undefined): string {
647:     if (!mimeType) return "📄";
648:     if (mimeType.startsWith("image/")) return "🖼️";
649:     if (mimeType.startsWith("video/")) return "🎬";
650:     if (mimeType.startsWith("audio/")) return "🎵";
651:     if (mimeType.includes("pdf")) return "📕";
652:     if (mimeType.includes("zip") || mimeType.includes("rar") || mimeType.includes("tar")) return "📦";
653:     if (mimeType.includes("text") || mimeType.includes("json") || mimeType.includes("xml")) return "📝";
654:     return "📄";
655:   }
656: 
657:   formatFileSize(bytes: number | undefined): string {
658:     if (!bytes) return "0 B";
659:     const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
660:     let i = 0;
661:     let size = bytes;
662:     while (size >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) {
663:       size /= 1024;
664:       i++;
665:     }
666:     return `${size.toFixed(i === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[i]}`;
667:   }
668: 
669:   async saveSelected(): Promise<void> {
670:     const saveBtn = document.getElementById("archive-save") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
671:     
672:     if (!this.selectedId) {
673:       this.setStatus("Sohbet seçilmedi", "warning");
674:       return;
675:     }
676:     const entry = this.entries.find((e) => e.id === this.selectedId);
677:     if (!entry) {
678:       this.setStatus("Kayıt bulunamadı", "error");
679:       return;
680:     }
681: 
682:     // Slot'tan hesap bilgisini al
683:     const accountInfo = AppState.getAccountForSlot(entry.provider || "");
684:     if (!accountInfo?.id) {
685:       this.setStatus("Hesap bilgisi bulunamadı", "error");
686:       return;
687:     }
688: 
689:     // Loading state
690:     if (saveBtn) {
691:       ButtonStates.setLoading(saveBtn, "Kaydediliyor...");
692:     }
693: 
694:     const newTitle = this.titleEl?.value || entry.title;
695:     const newSummary = this.summaryEl?.value || entry.summary;
696: 
697:     try {
698:       // DB'de güncelle
699:       const result = await window.electronAPI?.dbUpdateConversation?.({
700:         accountId: accountInfo.id,
701:         conversationId: entry.id,
702:         title: newTitle,
703:         summary: newSummary,
704:       });
705: 
706:       if (result?.success) {
707:         if (saveBtn) {
708:           ButtonStates.setSuccess(saveBtn, "Kaydedildi!", 1500);
709:         }
710:         this.setStatus("Kaydedildi", "success");
711:         LogManager.addEvent("archives", "success", "Arşiv güncellendi", { showToast: false });
712:         await ConversationListManager.refresh({ silent: true });
713:         await this.loadIndex();
714:       } else {
715:         if (saveBtn) {
716:           ButtonStates.setError(saveBtn, "Hata!", 1500);
717:         }
718:         this.setStatus((result as { error?: string })?.error || "Kaydedilemedi", "error");
719:       }
720:     } catch (e) {
721:       const err = e as Error;
722:       if (saveBtn) {
723:         ButtonStates.setError(saveBtn, "Hata!", 1500);
724:       }
725:       LogManager.addEvent("archives", "error", `Kaydetme hatası: ${err.message}`);
726:       this.setStatus("Kaydedilemedi", "error");
727:     }
728:   }
729: 
730:   setStatus(text: string, type = "info"): void {
731:     if (!this.statusEl) return;
732:     this.statusEl.textContent = text;
733:     this.statusEl.className = `form-hint ${type}`;
734:   }
735: 
736:   clearStatus(): void {
737:     if (!this.statusEl) return;
738:     this.statusEl.textContent = "";
739:     this.statusEl.className = "form-hint";

742:   applyNames(): void {
743:     const settings = SettingsManager.getSnapshot();
744:     const slots = settings?.slots as Record<string, { accountId?: string }> | undefined;
745:     const ai1Assigned = !!slots?.ai1?.accountId;
746:     const ai2Assigned = !!slots?.ai2?.accountId;
747: 
748:     const ai1Name = ai1Assigned ? AppState.getNickname("ai1") : "AI1";
749:     const ai2Name = ai2Assigned ? AppState.getNickname("ai2") : "AI2";
750:     
751:     const labelAi1 = document.getElementById("archives-provider-ai1");
752:     const labelAi2 = document.getElementById("archives-provider-ai2");
753:     const radioAi1 = document.getElementById("archive-filter-ai1");
754:     const radioAi2 = document.getElementById("archive-filter-ai2");
755: 
756:     if (labelAi1) labelAi1.textContent = ai1Name;
757:     if (labelAi2) labelAi2.textContent = ai2Name;
758: 
759:     if (radioAi1) (radioAi1 as HTMLInputElement).disabled = !ai1Assigned;
760:     if (radioAi2) (radioAi2 as HTMLInputElement).disabled = !ai2Assigned;
761:   }
762: 
763:   onShow(): void {
764:     this.loadSettings().then(() => this.applyNames());
765:     this.loadIndex();
766:     this.clearStatus();
767:   }
768: 
769:   onHide(): void {

771:     try {

773:       this._unsubSettings = null;
774:     } catch (_) {
775:       void 0;
776:     }
777:   }

248:   async handleManualSend() {
249:     const text = (this.commandText?.value || "").trim();
250:     if (!text) return;
251:     
252:     const sendBtn = document.getElementById("server-command-send") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
253:     const provider = this.controllerSelect?.value || "ai1";
254:     const regex = /\+\+cmd:([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\((.*?)\)/g;
255:     const matches = [];
256:     let m;
257:     while ((m = regex.exec(text)) !== null) {
258:       matches.push({ name: m[1], args: (m[2] || "").trim() });
259:     }
260:     if (!matches.length) {
261:       if (sendBtn) {
262:         ButtonStates.setError(sendBtn, "Komut Yok!", 1500);
263:       }
264:       LogManager.addEvent("server", "warning", "Komut bulunamadı");
265:       return;
266:     }

269:     if (sendBtn) {
270:       ButtonStates.setLoading(sendBtn, "Gönderiliyor...");
271:     }
272:     
273:     try {
274:       for (const cmd of matches) {
275:         await CoreEngine.handleCaughtCommand(cmd.name, {
276:           provider,
277:           args: cmd.args,
278:           source: "manual",
279:         });
280:       }
281:       
282:       if (sendBtn) {
283:         ButtonStates.setSuccess(sendBtn, "Gönderildi!", 1500);
284:       }
285:       LogManager.addEvent("server", "success", `${matches.length} komut gönderildi`, { showToast: false });
286:     } catch (e) {
287:       if (sendBtn) {
288:         ButtonStates.setError(sendBtn, "Hata!", 1500);
289:       }
290:       LogManager.addEvent("server", "error", "Komut gönderme hatası");
291:     }
292:   }

315:     const recent = LogManager.getRecent ? LogManager.getRecent(200) : [];
316:     const aiList: string[] = [];

318:     recent.forEach((entry: any) => {
319:       if (!entry) return;
320:       const src = entry.source || "";
321:       if (src === "command-catch") {
322:         const provider = entry.meta?.provider || "";
323:         const sender = entry.meta?.sender || this.getProviderLabel(provider);
324:         const cmd = entry.meta?.command || entry.message || "";
325:         const args = entry.meta?.args ? ` (${entry.meta.args})` : "";
326:         const stamp = entry.meta?.timestamp || entry.timestamp || "";
327:         aiList.push(`${sender} - ${cmd}${args ? ` ${args}` : ""} - ${stamp}`);
328:         return;
329:       }
330:       if (src === "command-result") {
331:         const provider = entry.meta?.provider || "";
332:         const sender = entry.meta?.sender || this.getProviderLabel(provider);
333:         const cmd = entry.meta?.command || "";
334:         const args = entry.meta?.args ? ` (${entry.meta.args})` : "";
335:         const stamp = entry.meta?.timestamp || entry.timestamp || "";
336:         const detail = entry.meta?.detail || entry.message || "";
337:         coreList.push(`${sender} - ${cmd}${args} - ${stamp} - ${detail}`);
338:       }
339:     });
340:     this.renderLogColumn(this.aiLog, aiList);
341:     this.renderLogColumn(this.coreLog, coreList);
342:   }

352:         div.className = "log-entry";
353:         div.textContent = msg;
354:         el.appendChild(div);

332: server.setRequestHandler(ListToolsRequestSchema, async () => {
333:   return { tools: [...TOOL_DEFINITIONS, ...FILESYSTEM_TOOL_DEFINITIONS, ...DEV_TOOL_DEFINITIONS, ...PROVIDER_TOOL_DEFINITIONS, ...webToolDefinitions, ...WORKFLOW_TOOL_DEFINITIONS, ...GIT_TOOL_DEFINITIONS] };
334: });
335: 
336: // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
337: server.setRequestHandler(CallToolRequestSchema, async (request): Promise<any> => {
338:   const { name, arguments: args } = request.params;
339:   
340:   // Progress token'ı ayarla (varsa)
341:   const progressToken = (request.params as { _meta?: { progressToken?: string | number } })._meta?.progressToken;
342:   setProgressToken(progressToken || null);
343:   
344:   const { startTime } = logToolCall(name, args);
345: 
346:   try {
347:     switch (name) {
348:       case "hev_test_electron":
349:         return await testElectron(PROJECT_ROOT, args ?? {});
350: 
351:       case "hev_list_plugins":
352:         return await listPlugins(PROJECT_ROOT);
353: 
354:       case "hev_read_electron_logs":
355:         return await readElectronLogs(LOG_DIR, args ?? {});
356: 
357:       case "hev_list_log_sessions":
358:         return await listLogSessions(LOG_DIR, args ?? {});
359: 
360:       case "hev_get_error_hints":
361:         return await getErrorHints(args ?? {});
362: 
363:       case "hev_get_session_summary":
364:         return await getSessionSummary(LOG_DIR, args ?? {});
365: 
366:       // === CDP Tool'ları ===
367:       case "hev_check_electron_connection":
368:         return await checkElectronConnection();
369: 
370:       case "hev_send_command_to_electron":
371:         return await sendCommandToElectron(args ?? {});
372: 
373:       case "hev_take_cdp_screenshot":
374:         return await takeCdpScreenshot(args ?? {});
375: 
376:       case "hev_get_electron_window_info":
377:         return await getElectronWindowInfo();
378: 
379:       case "hev_click_element_by_selector":
380:         return await clickElementBySelector(args ?? {});
381: 
382:       case "hev_click_element_by_text":
383:         return await clickElementByText(args ?? {});
384: 
385:       case "hev_fill_input_field":
386:         return await fillInputField(args ?? {});
387: 
388:       case "hev_get_page_dom_structure":
389:         return await getPageDomStructure(args ?? {});
390: 
391:       case "hev_inspect_element":
392:         return await inspectElement(args ?? {});
393: 
394:       case "hev_query_elements":
395:         return await queryElements(args ?? {});
396: 
397:       case "hev_send_key_press":
398:         return await sendKeyPress(args ?? {});
399: 
400:       case "hev_scroll_page":
401:         return await scrollPage(args ?? {});
402: 
403:       // === Filesystem Tool'ları ===
404:       case "hev_fs_open_files": {
405:         const result = await openFiles((args as { file_paths: string[] }).file_paths);
406:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: JSON.stringify(result, null, 2) }] };
407:       }
408: 
409:       case "hev_fs_create_file": {
410:         const result = await createFile(
411:           (args as { file_path: string }).file_path,
412:           (args as { initial_content?: string }).initial_content ?? "",
413:           (args as { overwrite?: boolean }).overwrite ?? false,
414:           PROJECT_ROOT // Büyük dosyalar için bash heredoc kullanımı
415:         );
416:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.message }] };
417:       }
418: 
419:       case "hev_fs_delete_file": {
420:         const result = await deleteFile(
421:           (args as { file_path: string }).file_path,
422:           PROJECT_ROOT,
423:           (args as { permanent?: boolean }).permanent ?? false
424:         );
425:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.message }] };
426:       }
427: 
428:       case "hev_fs_move_file": {
429:         const result = await moveFile(
430:           (args as { file_path: string }).file_path,
431:           (args as { new_path: string }).new_path
432:         );
433:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.message }] };
434:       }
435: 
436:       case "hev_fs_expand_code_chunks": {
437:         const result = await expandCodeChunks(
438:           (args as { file_path: string }).file_path,
439:           (args as { line_ranges?: [number, number][] }).line_ranges ?? [],
440:           (args as { patterns?: string[] }).patterns ?? []
441:         );
442:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.error || result.content }] };
443:       }
444: 
445:       case "hev_fs_find_and_replace": {
446:         const result = await findAndReplaceCode(
447:           (args as { file_path: string }).file_path,
448:           (args as { find: string }).find,
449:           (args as { replace: string }).replace
450:         );
451:         const msg = result.success 
452:           ? `✅ ${result.replacements} değişiklik yapıldı: ${result.file}`
453:           : `❌ ${result.error}`;
454:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: msg }] };
455:       }
456: 
457:       case "hev_fs_grep": {
458:         const result = await grep(
459:           PROJECT_ROOT,
460:           (args as { content_pattern?: string }).content_pattern ?? null,
461:           (args as { path_glob?: string }).path_glob ?? null
462:         );
463:         const output = result.matches.map(m => `${m.file}:${m.line}: ${m.content}`).join("\n");
464:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: `${result.totalMatches} eşleşme bulundu:\n\n${output}` }] };
465:       }
466: 
467:       case "hev_fs_expand_folder": {
468:         const result = await expandFolder(
469:           (args as { folder_path: string }).folder_path,
470:           (args as { max_depth?: number }).max_depth ?? 3
471:         );
472:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.error || result.structure }] };
473:       }
474: 
475:       case "hev_fs_bash": {
476:         const result = await executeBash(
477:           (args as { command: string }).command,
478:           PROJECT_ROOT,
479:           (args as { timeout?: number }).timeout ?? 30000
480:         );
481:         let output = "";
482:         if (result.stdout) output += result.stdout;
483:         if (result.stderr) output += (output ? "\n" : "") + `STDERR: ${result.stderr}`;
484:         if (result.timedOut) output += "\n⚠️ Timeout!";
485:         output += `\n[exit: ${result.exitCode}]`;
486:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: output }] };
487:       }
488: 
489:       case "hev_fs_create_plan": {
490:         const result = createTechnicalPlan((args as { plan: import("./types/index.js").TechnicalPlan }).plan);
491:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.summary }] };
492:       }
493: 
494:       // === Recycle Bin Tools ===
495:       case "hev_fs_trash_list": {
496:         const result = trashList(PROJECT_ROOT);
497:         if (result.total === 0) {
498:           return { content: [{ type: "text", text: "🗑️ Çöp kutusu boş" }] };
499:         }
500:         let output = `🗑️ Çöp Kutusu (${result.total} dosya)\n\n`;
501:         result.items.forEach((item, i) => {
502:           output += `${i}. ${item.path} (${item.size}) - ${item.deletedAt}\n`;
503:         });
504:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: output }] };
505:       }
506: 
507:       case "hev_fs_restore": {
508:         const result = restoreFile(PROJECT_ROOT, (args as { index?: number }).index);
509:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.message }] };
510:       }
511: 
512:       case "hev_fs_trash_empty": {
513:         const result = trashEmpty(PROJECT_ROOT, (args as { older_than_days?: number }).older_than_days);
514:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.message }] };
515:       }
516: 
517:       case "hev_fs_backup": {
518:         const result = backupFile(PROJECT_ROOT, (args as { file_path: string }).file_path);
519:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.message }] };
520:       }
521: 
522:       case "hev_fs_undo": {
523:         const result = undoOperation(PROJECT_ROOT);
524:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.message }] };
525:       }
526: 
527:       case "hev_fs_history": {
528:         const result = operationHistory(PROJECT_ROOT, (args as { limit?: number }).limit ?? 20);
529:         if (result.operations.length === 0) {
530:           return { content: [{ type: "text", text: "📋 İşlem geçmişi boş" }] };
531:         }
532:         let output = `📋 Son ${result.operations.length} İşlem\n\n`;
533:         result.operations.forEach((op, i) => {
534:           const undoIcon = op.canUndo ? "↩️" : "✓";
535:           output += `${i + 1}. ${undoIcon} ${op.type} - ${op.timestamp}\n`;
536:         });
537:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: output }] };
538:       }
539: 
540:       // === Diff Tools ===
541:       case "hev_fs_diff": {
542:         const result = fileDiff(
543:           (args as { file1: string }).file1,
544:           (args as { file2: string }).file2
545:         );
546:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.summary }] };
547:       }
548: 
549:       case "hev_fs_diff_content": {
550:         const result = contentDiff(
551:           (args as { content1: string }).content1,
552:           (args as { content2: string }).content2,
553:           (args as { label1?: string }).label1,
554:           (args as { label2?: string }).label2
555:         );
556:         if (result.identical) {
557:           return { content: [{ type: "text", text: "✅ İçerikler aynı" }] };
558:         }
559:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: `📊 ${result.additions} ekleme, ${result.deletions} silme\n\n${result.unified}` }] };
560:       }
561: 
562:       case "hev_fs_show": {
563:         const result = showFile(
564:           (args as { file_path: string }).file_path,
565:           (args as { start_line?: number }).start_line,
566:           (args as { end_line?: number }).end_line
567:         );
568:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: `📄 ${result.summary.language} (${result.summary.lines} satır)\n\n${result.content}` }] };
569:       }
570: 
571:       case "hev_fs_create_chunked": {
572:         const result = await createChunkedFile(
573:           (args as { file_path: string }).file_path,
574:           (args as { chunks: string[] }).chunks,
575:           PROJECT_ROOT,
576:           (args as { overwrite?: boolean }).overwrite
577:         );
578:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.message }] };
579:       }
580: 
581:       case "hev_fs_append_chunk": {
582:         const result = await appendChunk(
583:           (args as { file_path: string }).file_path,
584:           (args as { content: string }).content,
585:           (args as { create_if_missing?: boolean }).create_if_missing
586:         );
587:         return { content: [{ type: "text", text: result.message }] };

 133:     this._unsubSlot = SlotController.subscribe((payload: unknown) => {
 134:       const p = payload as { slot?: string; event?: string };
 135:       if (p.slot === "ai0") {

 150:     this._unsubTraffic = TrafficManager.onUpdate((snapshot: { ai0?: unknown; [key: string]: unknown }) => {

 164:   _populateProviderSelect(): void {
 165:     if (!this.providerSelect) return;
 166:     
 167:     this.providerSelect.innerHTML = "";
 168:     
 169:     const asistanProviders = ProviderRegistry.getAllAsistan();
 170:     asistanProviders.forEach((provider) => {
 171:       const opt = document.createElement("option");
 172:       opt.value = provider.id;
 173:       opt.textContent = provider.name;
 174:       this.providerSelect!.appendChild(opt);
 175:     });
 176:     
 177:     // Settings'den seçili provider'ı al
 178:     const settings = SettingsManager.getSnapshot() as AppSettings | null;
 179:     const asistanAccounts = settings?.asistanAccounts as { id: string; provider?: string }[] | undefined;
 180:     const asistanSlot = settings?.asistanSlot as { accountId?: string } | undefined;
 181:     const account = asistanAccounts?.find(
 182:       (acc) => acc.id === asistanSlot?.accountId
 183:     );
 184:     if (account?.provider && this.providerSelect.querySelector(`option[value="${account.provider}"]`)) {
 185:       this.providerSelect.value = account.provider;
 186:     }
 187:   }

 202:     // Relay kaynak seçimi
 203:     this.relaySourceSelect?.addEventListener("change", () => this._onRelaySourceChange());
 204:     
 205:     // UI Mode Toggle - sadece panel visibility değişir, sunucu Bağlan butonuyla başlar
 206:     const nativeModeBtn = document.getElementById("ui-mode-native");
 207:     const webviewModeBtn = document.getElementById("ui-mode-webview");
 208:     const nativePanel = document.getElementById("asistan-native-panel");
 209:     const webviewPanel = document.getElementById("asistan-webview-panel");
 210:     
 211:     nativeModeBtn?.addEventListener("click", () => {
 212:       // Bağlıyken mod değiştirmeye izin verme
 213:       if (this._isConnected()) {
 214:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "warn", "Mod değiştirmek için önce bağlantıyı kesin", { visibility: 1 });
 215:         return;
 216:       }
 217:       
 218:       nativeModeBtn.classList.add("active");
 219:       webviewModeBtn?.classList.remove("active");
 220:       nativePanel?.classList.remove("hidden");
 221:       webviewPanel?.classList.add("hidden");
 222:     });
 223:     
 224:     webviewModeBtn?.addEventListener("click", () => {
 225:       // Bağlıyken mod değiştirmeye izin verme
 226:       if (this._isConnected()) {
 227:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "warn", "Mod değiştirmek için önce bağlantıyı kesin", { visibility: 1 });
 228:         return;
 229:       }
 230:       
 231:       webviewModeBtn.classList.add("active");
 232:       nativeModeBtn?.classList.remove("active");
 233:       webviewPanel?.classList.remove("hidden");
 234:       nativePanel?.classList.add("hidden");
 235:     });
 236:   }
 237: 
 238:   /**
 239:    * Bağlantı durumunu kontrol et
 240:    */
 241:   _isConnected(): boolean {
 242:     const slotState = SlotController.getState("ai0") as SlotStateInfo | null;
 243:     return slotState?.state === SlotState.CONNECTED || 
 244:            this._isServerRunning || 
 245:            this._isSSEServerRunning;
 246:   }
 247: 
 248:   async _toggleConnection(): Promise<void> {
 249:     const slotState = SlotController.getState("ai0") as SlotStateInfo | null;
 250:     
 251:     if (slotState?.state === SlotState.CONNECTED || this._isServerRunning || this._isSSEServerRunning) {
 252:       // Bağlantıyı kes - direkt buton güncelle (ButtonStates kullanma)
 253:       if (this.connectBtn) {
 254:         this.connectBtn.textContent = "Kesiliyor...";
 255:         this.connectBtn.disabled = true;
 256:         this.connectBtn.classList.remove("btn-danger", "btn-primary");
 257:         this.connectBtn.classList.add("btn-primary");
 258:       }
 259:       
 260:       const nativeModeBtn = document.getElementById("ui-mode-native");
 261:       const isNativeMode = nativeModeBtn?.classList.contains("active");
 262:       
 263:       try {
 264:         if (isNativeMode) {
 265:           // Native modda SSE Server'ı durdur
 266:           if (this._isSSEServerRunning) {
 267:             await this._stopSSEServer();
 268:           }
 269:         } else {
 270:           // Webview modda slot'u disconnect et
 271:           LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "debug", "Webview disconnect başlatılıyor", { 
 272:             slotState: slotState?.state,
 273:             visibility: 3
 274:           });
 275:           
 276:           if (slotState?.state === SlotState.CONNECTED) {
 277:             await SlotController.disconnect("ai0");
 278:           }
 279:         }
 280:         
 281:         // OpenCode server'ı durdur (her iki modda da)
 282:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "debug", "OpenCode server durduruluyor", { visibility: 3 });
 283:         await this._stopOpenCodeServer();
 284:         
 285:         // Flag'leri sıfırla
 286:         this._isServerRunning = false;
 287:         
 288:         // Başarılı - kısa süre "Kesildi!" göster
 289:         if (this.connectBtn) {
 290:           this.connectBtn.textContent = "Kesildi!";
 291:           this.connectBtn.disabled = false;
 292:         }
 293:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "success", "Asistan bağlantısı kesildi", { 
 294:           mode: isNativeMode ? "native" : "webview",
 295:           visibility: 1 
 296:         });
 297:       } catch (err) {
 298:         const error = err as Error;
 299:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "error", "Bağlantı kesme hatası", { 
 300:           error: error.message,
 301:           visibility: 1 
 302:         });
 303:         
 304:         // Hata olsa bile flag'leri sıfırla
 305:         this._isServerRunning = false;
 306:         if (this.connectBtn) {
 307:           this.connectBtn.textContent = "Hata!";
 308:           this.connectBtn.disabled = false;
 309:         }
 310:       }
 311:       
 312:       // UI'ı güncelle (1 saniye sonra normal duruma dön)
 313:       setTimeout(() => this._updateConnectionUI(), 1000);
 314:     } else if (slotState?.state === SlotState.ASSIGNED || slotState?.state === SlotState.EMPTY) {
 315:       // Bağlan - direkt buton güncelle (ButtonStates kullanma)
 316:       if (this.connectBtn) {
 317:         this.connectBtn.textContent = "Başlatılıyor...";
 318:         this.connectBtn.disabled = true;
 319:         this.connectBtn.classList.remove("btn-danger");
 320:         this.connectBtn.classList.add("btn-primary");
 321:       }
 322:       
 323:       const result = await this._startOpenCodeServer();
 324:       if (result.success) {
 325:         const nativeModeBtn = document.getElementById("ui-mode-native");
 326:         const isNativeMode = nativeModeBtn?.classList.contains("active");
 327:         
 328:         if (isNativeMode) {
 329:           // Native mode: SSE Server + Native webview kullan, ai0 slot'a bağlanma
 330:           await this._startSSEServer();
 331:         } else {
 332:           // Webview mode: ai0 slot'a bağlan (OpenCode Web UI)
 333:           await SlotController.connect("ai0", { url: result.url });
 334:         }
 335:         
 336:         // Başarılı - kısa süre "Bağlandı!" göster
 337:         if (this.connectBtn) {
 338:           this.connectBtn.textContent = "Bağlandı!";
 339:           this.connectBtn.disabled = false;
 340:         }
 341:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "success", "Asistan bağlantısı başlatıldı", { 
 342:           url: result.url, 
 343:           mode: isNativeMode ? "native" : "webview",
 344:           visibility: 1 
 345:         });
 346:         
 347:         // UI'ı güncelle (1 saniye sonra "Bağlantıyı Kes" moduna geç)
 348:         setTimeout(() => this._updateConnectionUI(), 1000);
 349:       } else {
 350:         // Hata
 351:         if (this.connectBtn) {
 352:           this.connectBtn.textContent = "Hata!";
 353:           this.connectBtn.disabled = false;
 354:         }
 355:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "error", "OpenCode server başlatılamadı", { error: result.error, visibility: 1 });
 356:         this._showError(result.error || "Server başlatılamadı");
 357:         
 358:         // UI'ı güncelle (1 saniye sonra normal duruma dön)
 359:         setTimeout(() => this._updateConnectionUI(), 1000);
 360:       }
 361:     }
 362:   }
 363: 
 364:   /**
 365:    * OpenCode server'ı başlat
 366:    */
 367:   async _startOpenCodeServer(): Promise<ServerResult> {
 368:     try {
 369:       // UI'ı güncelle
 370:       this._updateStatusUI("connecting", "Server başlatılıyor...");
 371:       
 372:       const result = await window.electronAPI?.opencodeStart?.({
 373:         port: OPENCODE_DEFAULTS.port,
 374:         projectPath: null,
 375:       }) as ServerResult | undefined;
 376:       
 377:       if (result?.success) {
 378:         this._isServerRunning = true;
 379:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "info", "OpenCode server başlatıldı", { 
 380:           url: result.url,
 381:           alreadyRunning: result.alreadyRunning,
 382:           existingServer: result.existingServer,
 383:         });
 384:         return result;
 385:       } else {
 386:         this._isServerRunning = false;
 387:         return { success: false, error: result?.error };
 388:       }
 389:     } catch (e) {
 390:       const err = e as Error;
 391:       this._isServerRunning = false;
 392:       LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "error", "OpenCode server başlatma hatası", { error: err.message });
 393:       return { success: false, error: err.message };
 394:     }
 395:   }
 396: 
 397:   /**
 398:    * OpenCode server'ı durdur
 399:    */
 400:   async _stopOpenCodeServer(): Promise<ServerResult> {
 401:     try {
 402:       const result = await window.electronAPI?.opencodeStop?.() as ServerResult | undefined;
 403:       this._isServerRunning = false;
 404:       
 405:       if (result?.success) {
 406:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "info", "OpenCode server durduruldu", { visibility: 2 });
 407:       }
 408:       
 409:       return result || { success: false };
 410:     } catch (e) {
 411:       const err = e as Error;
 412:       this._isServerRunning = false;
 413:       LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "error", "OpenCode server durdurma hatası", { error: err.message });
 414:       return { success: false, error: err.message };
 415:     }
 416:   }
 417: 
 418:   // =========================================================================
 419:   // SSE Server (Native UI için)
 420:   // =========================================================================
 421: 
 422:   /** @type {boolean} */
 423:   private _isSSEServerRunning = false;
 424: 
 425:   /**
 426:    * SSE Server'u başlat
 427:    */
 428:   async _startSSEServer(): Promise<void> {
 429:     if (this._isSSEServerRunning) return;
 430:     
 431:     try {
 432:       // 1. SSE Server'ı başlat
 433:       const result = await window.electronAPI?.opencodeSSEStart?.();
 434:       if (result?.success) {
 435:         this._isSSEServerRunning = true;
 436:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "info", `SSE Server başlatıldı: ${result.url}`, { visibility: 2 });
 437:         
 438:         // 2. OpenCode'a bağlan (SSE bridge)
 439:         const connectResult = await window.electronAPI?.opencodeSSEConnect?.();
 440:         if (connectResult?.success) {
 441:           LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "info", `OpenCode bağlantısı kuruldu: ${connectResult.sessionId}`, { visibility: 2 });
 442:         } else {
 443:           LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "warn", `OpenCode bağlantısı kurulamadı: ${connectResult?.error}`, { visibility: 2 });
 444:         }
 445:         
 446:         // 3. Placeholder'ı gizle, webview'ı göster
 447:         const placeholder = document.getElementById("native-panel-placeholder");
 448:         const nativeWebview = document.getElementById("opencode-native-webview") as WebviewElement | null;
 449:         
 450:         if (placeholder) {
 451:           placeholder.classList.add("hidden");
 452:         }
 453:         
 454:         if (nativeWebview) {
 455:           nativeWebview.classList.remove("hidden");
 456:           
 457:           // Preload path'i Electron API'den al ve webview'a ayarla
 458:           try {
 459:             const preloadPath = await window.electronAPI?.getPreloadPath?.("webview");
 460:             if (preloadPath) {
 461:               // preloadPath zaten file:// ile başlıyorsa tekrar ekleme
 462:               const fullPreloadPath = preloadPath.startsWith("file://") ? preloadPath : `file://${preloadPath}`;
 463:               nativeWebview.setAttribute("preload", fullPreloadPath);
 464:               LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "debug", `Native webview preload: ${fullPreloadPath}`, { visibility: 3 });
 465:             }
 466:           } catch (preloadErr) {
 467:             LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "warn", `Preload path alınamadı: ${(preloadErr as Error).message}`, { visibility: 2 });
 468:           }
 469:           
 470:           // Native UI bridge'i kur (Electron API erişimi için)
 471:           this._setupNativeUIBridge(nativeWebview);
 472:           
 473:           // Server URL'ini query param olarak gönder
 474:           const serverUrl = result.url || "http://127.0.0.1:4097";
 475:           const baseOrigin = window.location.origin;
 476:           // Doğrudan index.html yükle (entrance.html yerine)
 477:           // Workspace parametresi SSE server result'tan alınır
 478:           const workspacePath = result.workspace || '/home';
 479:           const srcUrl = `${baseOrigin}/opencode-ui/index.html?server=${encodeURIComponent(serverUrl)}&workspace=${encodeURIComponent(workspacePath)}`;
 480:           
 481:           LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "debug", `Native webview URL: ${srcUrl}`, { visibility: 3 });
 482:           
 483:           // Webview DOM'a eklendikten sonra URL'i set et
 484:           requestAnimationFrame(() => {
 485:             if (nativeWebview.src !== srcUrl) {
 486:               nativeWebview.src = srcUrl;
 487:             }
 488:           });
 489:         }
 490:       } else {
 491:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "error", `SSE Server başlatılamadı: ${result?.error}`, { visibility: 1 });
 492:       }
 493:     } catch (e) {
 494:       const err = e as Error;
 495:       LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "error", `SSE Server hatası: ${err.message}`, { visibility: 1 });
 496:     }
 497:   }
 498: 
 499:   /**
 500:    * SSE Server'u durdur
 501:    */
 502:   async _stopSSEServer(): Promise<void> {
 503:     if (!this._isSSEServerRunning) return;
 504:     
 505:     try {
 506:       // Önce OpenCode bağlantısını kes
 507:       await window.electronAPI?.opencodeSSEDisconnect?.();
 508:       
 509:       // Sonra SSE Server'ı durdur
 510:       await window.electronAPI?.opencodeSSEStop?.();
 511:       this._isSSEServerRunning = false;
 512:       LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "info", "SSE Server durduruldu", { visibility: 2 });
 513:       
 514:       // Webview'ı gizle, placeholder'ı göster
 515:       const placeholder = document.getElementById("native-panel-placeholder");
 516:       const nativeWebview = document.getElementById("opencode-native-webview") as WebviewElement | null;
 517:       
 518:       if (nativeWebview) {
 519:         nativeWebview.classList.add("hidden");
 520:         nativeWebview.src = "about:blank";
 521:       }
 522:       
 523:       if (placeholder) {
 524:         placeholder.classList.remove("hidden");
 525:       }
 526:       
 527:       // Native bridge flag'ini reset et - sonraki bağlantıda yeniden kurulması için
 528:       this._nativeBridgeSetup = false;
 529:     } catch (e) {
 530:       const err = e as Error;
 531:       LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "error", `SSE Server durdurma hatası: ${err.message}`);
 532:     }
 533:   }
 534: 
 535:   /**
 536:    * Hata mesajı göster
 537:    */
 538:   _showError(message: string): void {
 539:     const overlayEl = document.getElementById("ai0-webview-overlay");
 540:     this._updateOverlay(overlayEl, "error", "❌", "Bağlantı Hatası", message);
 541:   }

 543:   /**
 544:    * Status UI'ını güncelle (loading durumları için)
 545:    */
 546:   _updateStatusUI(state: string, message: string): void {
 547:     if (this.statusDot) {
 548:       this.statusDot.classList.remove("connected", "connecting", "error");
 549:       if (state === "connected") {
 550:         this.statusDot.classList.add("connected");
 551:       } else if (state === "connecting") {
 552:         this.statusDot.classList.add("connecting");
 553:       } else if (state === "error") {
 554:         this.statusDot.classList.add("error");
 555:       }
 556:     }
 557:     if (this.statusText) {
 558:       this.statusText.textContent = message || "Bağlı Değil";
 559:     }
 560:   }
 561: 
 562:   async _onProviderChange(): Promise<void> {
 563:     const providerId = this.providerSelect?.value;
 564:     if (!providerId) return;
 565:     
 566:     const provider = ProviderRegistry.getAsistan(providerId as "opencode");
 567:     if (!provider) return;
 568:     
 569:     // Provider değişikliğini settings'e kaydet
 570:     const settings = SettingsManager.getSnapshot() as AppSettings | null;
 571:     const asistanAccounts = settings?.asistanAccounts as { id: string; provider?: string }[] | undefined;
 572:     const account = asistanAccounts?.find((acc) => acc.provider === providerId);
 573:     
 574:     if (account && settings) {
 575:       const asistanSlot = settings.asistanSlot as { accountId?: string } | undefined;
 576:       await SettingsManager.save({
 577:         ...settings,
 578:         asistanSlot: {
 579:           ...asistanSlot,
 580:           accountId: account.id,
 581:         },
 582:       } as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
 583:     }
 584:     
 585:     // Başlığı güncelle
 586:     if (this.titleEl) {
 587:       this.titleEl.textContent = provider.name;
 588:     }
 589:     
 590:     LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "info", `Provider değiştirildi: ${provider.name}`);
 591:   }
 592: 
 593:   _openDevTools(): void {
 594:     // Mode'a göre doğru webview'i seç
 595:     const nativeModeBtn = document.getElementById("ui-mode-native");
 596:     const isNativeMode = nativeModeBtn?.classList.contains("active");
 597:     
 598:     const webviewId = isNativeMode ? "opencode-native-webview" : "ai0-webview";
 599:     const webview = document.getElementById(webviewId) as WebviewElement | null;
 600:     
 601:     if (webview && typeof webview.openDevTools === "function") {
 602:       webview.openDevTools();
 603:       LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "info", `DevTools açıldı: ${webviewId}`, { visibility: 2 });
 604:     } else {
 605:       LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "warn", `Webview bulunamadı: ${webviewId}`, { visibility: 1 });
 606:     }
 607:   }
 608: 
 609:   async _toggleRelay(): Promise<void> {
 610:     const sourceSlot = this.relaySourceSelect?.value;
 611:     
 612:     if (this._isRelayActive) {
 613:       // Relay'i durdur
 614:       await RelayManager.stopAIAsistanSession();
 615:       this._isRelayActive = false;
 616:       AppState.setAsistanRelay(false, null);
 617:       LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "info", "AI-Asistan relay durduruldu");
 618:     } else {
 619:       // Relay'i başlat
 620:       if (!sourceSlot) {
 621:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "warning", "Relay için kaynak AI seçilmedi");
 622:         return;
 623:       }
 624:       
 625:       // Kaynak AI'ın bağlı olduğunu kontrol et
 626:       if (!SlotController.isConnected(sourceSlot)) {
 627:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "warning", `${sourceSlot} bağlı değil`);
 628:         return;
 629:       }
 630:       
 631:       // Asistan'ın bağlı olduğunu kontrol et
 632:       if (!SlotController.isConnected("ai0")) {
 633:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "warning", "Asistan bağlı değil");
 634:         return;
 635:       }
 636:       
 637:       await RelayManager.startAIAsistanSession(sourceSlot);
 638:       this._isRelayActive = true;
 639:       AppState.setAsistanRelay(true, sourceSlot);
 640:       LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "info", `AI-Asistan relay başlatıldı: ${sourceSlot} ↔ ai0`, { visibility: 2 });
 641:     }
 642:     
 643:     this._updateRelayControls();
 644:   }
 645: 
 646:   async _onRelaySourceChange(): Promise<void> {
 647:     // Kaynak değiştiğinde ve relay aktifse, relay'i yeniden başlat
 648:     if (this._isRelayActive) {
 649:       await this._toggleRelay(); // Önce durdur
 650:       await this._toggleRelay(); // Sonra yeni kaynakla başlat
 651:     }
 652:   }
 653: 
 654:   _updateConnectionUI(): void {
 655:     const slotState = SlotController.getState("ai0") as SlotStateInfo | null;
 656:     const nativeModeBtn = document.getElementById("ui-mode-native");
 657:     const isNativeMode = nativeModeBtn?.classList.contains("active");
 658:     
 659:     // Native modda SSE server durumu, webview modda slot durumu
 660:     const isConnected = isNativeMode 
 661:       ? this._isSSEServerRunning 
 662:       : slotState?.state === SlotState.CONNECTED;
 663:     const isConnecting = slotState?.state === SlotState.CONNECTING;
 664:     const isError = slotState?.state === SlotState.ERROR;
 665:     const hasAccount = !!slotState?.accountId;
 666:     
 667:     // Webview ve overlay elementleri (sadece webview modda kullanılır)
 668:     const webviewEl = document.getElementById("ai0-webview");
 669:     const mountEl = document.getElementById("ai0-webview-mount");
 670:     const overlayEl = document.getElementById("ai0-webview-overlay");
 671:     
 672:     // Webview modda webview mount edilir
 673:     if (!isNativeMode && webviewEl && mountEl && !mountEl.contains(webviewEl)) {
 674:       mountEl.appendChild(webviewEl);
 675:       webviewEl.style.cssText = "position: relative; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;";
 676:     }
 677:     
 678:     // Webview event setup (bir kez)
 679:     if (webviewEl && !webviewEl.dataset.eventsSetup) {
 680:       this._setupWebviewEvents(webviewEl);
 681:       webviewEl.dataset.eventsSetup = "true";
 682:     }
 683:     
 684:     // Webview modda overlay sınıflarını temizle
 685:     if (!isNativeMode && overlayEl) {
 686:       overlayEl.classList.remove("hidden", "empty", "disconnected", "connecting", "error");
 687:       
 688:       // Overlay durumunu güncelle
 689:       if (!hasAccount) {
 690:         this._updateOverlay(overlayEl, "empty", "🤖", "Asistan Seçilmedi", "Provider seçip bağlanın");
 691:       } else if (isConnecting) {
 692:         this._updateOverlay(overlayEl, "connecting", "🔄", "Bağlanıyor...", "Lütfen bekleyin");
 693:       } else if (isError) {
 694:         this._updateOverlay(overlayEl, "error", "❌", "Bağlantı Hatası", slotState?.error || "Tekrar deneyin");
 695:       } else if (!isConnected) {
 696:         this._updateOverlay(overlayEl, "disconnected", "⚡", "Asistan Bağlı Değil", "Bağlan butonuna tıklayın");
 697:       } else {
 698:         // CONNECTED - overlay gizle
 699:         overlayEl.classList.add("hidden");
 700:         if (webviewEl) {
 701:           webviewEl.removeAttribute("data-detached");
 702:         }
 703:       }
 704:     }
 705:     
 706:     // Buton metnini güncelle
 707:     if (this.connectBtn) {
 708:       const isDisconnectMode = isConnected || this._isServerRunning;
 709:       
 710:       // Inline style'ları temizle (ButtonStates'ten kalan olabilir)
 711:       this.connectBtn.style.opacity = "";
 712:       this.connectBtn.style.transform = "";
 713:       this.connectBtn.style.transition = "";
 714:       
 715:       if (isConnecting) {
 716:         this.connectBtn.textContent = "Bağlanıyor...";
 717:         this.connectBtn.disabled = true;
 718:         this.connectBtn.classList.remove("btn-danger", "btn-primary");
 719:         this.connectBtn.classList.add("btn-primary");
 720:       } else if (isDisconnectMode) {
 721:         this.connectBtn.textContent = "Bağlantıyı Kes";
 722:         this.connectBtn.disabled = false;
 723:         this.connectBtn.classList.remove("btn-primary");
 724:         this.connectBtn.classList.add("btn-danger");
 725:       } else {
 726:         this.connectBtn.textContent = "Bağlan";
 727:         this.connectBtn.disabled = false;
 728:         this.connectBtn.classList.remove("btn-danger");
 729:         this.connectBtn.classList.add("btn-primary");
 730:       }
 731:     }
 732:     
 733:     // DevTools butonu durumu
 734:     if (this.devtoolsBtn) {
 735:       this.devtoolsBtn.disabled = !isConnected && !this._isSSEServerRunning;
 736:     }
 737:     
 738:     // Status dot ve text
 739:     if (this.statusDot) {
 740:       this.statusDot.classList.toggle("connected", isConnected);
 741:     }
 742:     if (this.statusText) {
 743:       if (isNativeMode) {
 744:         this.statusText.textContent = this._isSSEServerRunning ? "Native UI Bağlı" : "Bağlı Değil";
 745:       } else {
 746:         this.statusText.textContent = isConnected ? "Bağlı" : (isConnecting ? "Bağlanıyor..." : "Bağlı Değil");

 962:   /**
 963:    * Native UI webview için Electron API bridge kurulumu
 964:    * executeJavaScript ile API fonksiyonlarını inject eder ve console.log ile iletişim kurar
 965:    */
 966:   _nativeBridgeSetup = false; // Flag to prevent duplicate setup
 967: 
 968:   _setupNativeUIBridge(webviewEl: WebviewElement): void {
 969:     if (!webviewEl) return;
 970:     
 971:     // Prevent duplicate setup
 972:     if (this._nativeBridgeSetup) {
 973:       LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "debug", "Native UI bridge already setup, skipping", { visibility: 3 });
 974:       return;
 975:     }
 976:     this._nativeBridgeSetup = true;
 977: 
 978:     // did-finish-load event'inde API bridge'i inject et
 979:     webviewEl.addEventListener("did-finish-load", async () => {
 980:       LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "debug", "Native webview loaded, injecting API bridge", { visibility: 3 });
 981:       
 982:       // Inject API bridge script
 983:       const bridgeScript = `
 984:         (function() {
 985:           if (window.__nativeUIBridgeReady) return;
 986:           window.__nativeUIBridgeReady = true;
 987:           
 988:           // Request ID counter
 989:           let requestId = 0;
 990:           const pendingRequests = new Map();
 991:           
 992:           // Listen for responses
 993:           window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
 994:             if (event.data && event.data.type === 'electron-api-response') {
 995:               const { requestId: respId, result, error } = event.data;
 996:               const pending = pendingRequests.get(respId);
 997:               if (pending) {
 998:                 pendingRequests.delete(respId);
 999:                 if (error) {
1000:                   pending.reject(new Error(error));
1001:                 } else {
1002:                   pending.resolve(result);
1003:                 }
1004:               }
1005:             }
1006:           });
1007:           
1008:           // Create API proxy
1009:           window.__nativeUIRequest = function(method, ...args) {
1010:             return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
1011:               const id = ++requestId;
1012:               pendingRequests.set(id, { resolve, reject });
1013:               
1014:               // Timeout after 15 seconds
1015:               setTimeout(() => {
1016:                 if (pendingRequests.has(id)) {
1017:                   pendingRequests.delete(id);
1018:                   reject(new Error('Request timeout: ' + method));
1019:                 }
1020:               }, 15000);
1021:               
1022:               // Signal to host via console (will be intercepted)
1023:               console.log('__NATIVE_UI_REQUEST__:' + JSON.stringify({ requestId: id, method, args }));
1024:             });
1025:           };
1026:           
1027:           // Expose electronAPI-like interface
1028:           window.electronAPI = {
1029:             loadOpencodeConfig: () => window.__nativeUIRequest('loadOpencodeConfig'),
1030:             saveOpencodeConfig: (config) => window.__nativeUIRequest('saveOpencodeConfig', config),
1031:             opcAddRecentFolder: (path, name) => window.__nativeUIRequest('opcAddRecentFolder', path, name),
1032:             opcRemoveRecentFolder: (path) => window.__nativeUIRequest('opcRemoveRecentFolder', path),
1033:             opcUpdatePreferences: (updates) => window.__nativeUIRequest('opcUpdatePreferences', updates),
1034:             showOpenDialog: (options) => window.__nativeUIRequest('showOpenDialog', options),
1035:             openTerminal: (path) => window.__nativeUIRequest('openTerminal', path),
1036:             shellOpenPath: (path) => window.__nativeUIRequest('shellOpenPath', path),
1037:             // Agent & Model Lists
1038:             opcListModels: () => window.__nativeUIRequest('opcListModels'),
1039:             opcListAgents: () => window.__nativeUIRequest('opcListAgents'),
1040:             // Agent/Model Preference Persistence
1041:             opcGetAgentModelPreference: (folderPath) => window.__nativeUIRequest('opcGetAgentModelPreference', folderPath),
1042:             opcSaveAgentModelPreference: (preference, folderPath) => window.__nativeUIRequest('opcSaveAgentModelPreference', preference, folderPath),
1043:             opcSaveAgentPreference: (agent, folderPath) => window.__nativeUIRequest('opcSaveAgentPreference', agent, folderPath),
1044:             opcSaveModelPreference: (providerId, modelId, folderPath) => window.__nativeUIRequest('opcSaveModelPreference', providerId, modelId, folderPath),
1045:           };
1046:           
1047:           console.log('[NativeUI] API bridge injected');
1048:         })();
1049:       `;
1050:       
1051:       try {
1052:         await webviewEl.executeJavaScript?.(bridgeScript);
1053:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "info", "Native UI API bridge injected", { visibility: 2 });
1054:       } catch (err) {
1055:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "error", `Failed to inject API bridge: ${(err as Error).message}`, { visibility: 2 });
1056:       }
1057:     });
1058: 
1059:     // console-message event'ini dinle (webview'dan gelen API istekleri)
1060:     webviewEl.addEventListener("console-message", async (event: Event) => {
1061:       const consoleEvent = event as Event & { message: string; level: number };
1062:       const { message } = consoleEvent;
1063:       
1064:       // Check if this is an API request
1065:       if (!message?.startsWith('__NATIVE_UI_REQUEST__:')) return;
1066:       
1067:       try {
1068:         const jsonStr = message.substring('__NATIVE_UI_REQUEST__:'.length);
1069:         const { requestId, method, args } = JSON.parse(jsonStr) as { requestId: number; method: string; args: unknown[] };
1070:         
1071:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "debug", `Native UI API request: ${method}`, { requestId, visibility: 3 });
1072:         
1073:         let result: unknown;
1074:         
1075:         // Map method names to Electron API calls
1076:         switch (method) {
1077:           case "loadOpencodeConfig":
1078:             result = await window.electronAPI?.loadOpencodeConfig?.();
1079:             break;
1080:           case "saveOpencodeConfig":
1081:             result = await window.electronAPI?.saveOpencodeConfig?.(args[0] as Parameters<NonNullable<typeof window.electronAPI.saveOpencodeConfig>>[0]);
1082:             break;
1083:           case "opcAddRecentFolder":
1084:             result = await window.electronAPI?.opcAddRecentFolder?.(args[0] as string, args[1] as string | undefined);
1085:             break;
1086:           case "opcRemoveRecentFolder":
1087:             result = await window.electronAPI?.opcRemoveRecentFolder?.(args[0] as string);
1088:             break;
1089:           case "opcUpdatePreferences":
1090:             result = await window.electronAPI?.opcUpdatePreferences?.(args[0] as Parameters<NonNullable<typeof window.electronAPI.opcUpdatePreferences>>[0]);
1091:             break;
1092:           case "showOpenDialog":
1093:             result = await window.electronAPI?.showOpenDialog?.(args[0] as Parameters<NonNullable<typeof window.electronAPI.showOpenDialog>>[0]);
1094:             break;
1095:           case "openTerminal":
1096:             result = await window.electronAPI?.openTerminal?.(args[0] as string);
1097:             break;
1098:           case "shellOpenPath":
1099:             result = await window.electronAPI?.shellOpenPath?.(args[0] as string);
1100:             break;
1101:           case "opcListModels":
1102:             result = await window.electronAPI?.opcListModels?.();
1103:             break;
1104:           case "opcListAgents":
1105:             result = await window.electronAPI?.opcListAgents?.();
1106:             break;
1107:           // Agent/Model Preference Persistence
1108:           case "opcGetAgentModelPreference":
1109:             result = await window.electronAPI?.opcGetAgentModelPreference?.(args[0] as string | undefined);
1110:             break;
1111:           case "opcSaveAgentModelPreference":
1112:             result = await window.electronAPI?.opcSaveAgentModelPreference?.(args[0] as Record<string, unknown>, args[1] as string | undefined);
1113:             break;
1114:           case "opcSaveAgentPreference":
1115:             result = await window.electronAPI?.opcSaveAgentPreference?.(args[0] as string, args[1] as string | undefined);
1116:             break;
1117:           case "opcSaveModelPreference":
1118:             result = await window.electronAPI?.opcSaveModelPreference?.(args[0] as string, args[1] as string, args[2] as string | undefined);
1119:             break;
1120:           default:
1121:             throw new Error(`Unknown API method: ${method}`);
1122:         }
1123:         
1124:         // Send response back to webview
1125:         const responseScript = `
1126:           window.postMessage({
1127:             type: 'electron-api-response',
1128:             requestId: ${requestId},
1129:             result: ${JSON.stringify(result)}
1130:           }, '*');
1131:         `;
1132:         await webviewEl.executeJavaScript?.(responseScript);
1133:         
1134:       } catch (err) {
1135:         const error = err as Error;
1136:         LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "error", `Native UI API error: ${error.message}`, { visibility: 2 });
1137:         
1138:         // Try to extract requestId and send error response
1139:         try {
1140:           const jsonStr = message.substring('__NATIVE_UI_REQUEST__:'.length);
1141:           const { requestId } = JSON.parse(jsonStr) as { requestId: number };
1142:           const errorScript = `
1143:             window.postMessage({
1144:               type: 'electron-api-response',
1145:               requestId: ${requestId},
1146:               error: ${JSON.stringify(error.message)}
1147:             }, '*');
1148:           `;
1149:           await webviewEl.executeJavaScript?.(errorScript);
1150:         } catch (_) {
1151:           // Ignore
1152:         }
1153:       }
1154:     });
1155:     
1156:     LogManager.addEvent("asistan", "debug", "Native UI bridge listeners setup", { visibility: 3 });
1157:   }

 40: function ensureElectronApiFallback() {
 41:   if (window.electronAPI) return;
 42:   const storageKey = "hayalet-settings-v1";
 43:   /**
 44:    * @param {Response} resp
 45:    * @returns {Promise<string|null>}
 46:    */
 47:   const toBase64 = async (resp: Response): Promise<string | null> => {
 48:     try {
 49:       const buf = await resp.arrayBuffer();
 50:       let binary = "";
 51:       const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
 52:       const len = bytes.byteLength;
 53:       for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
 54:       return btoa(binary);
 55:     } catch {
 56:       return null;
 57:     }
 58:   };
 59: 
 60:   (window as any).electronAPI = {
 61:     loadSettings: async () => {
 62:       try {
 63:         const raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
 64:         return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
 65:       } catch {
 66:         return null;
 67:       }
 68:     },
 69:     saveSettings: async (settings: unknown) => {
 70:       try {
 71:         localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(settings));
 72:         return true;
 73:       } catch {
 74:         return false;
 75:       }
 76:     },
 77: 
 78:     readFile: async (path: string): Promise<string | null> => {
 79:       try {
 80:         const resp = await fetch(path);
 81:         if (!resp.ok) return null;
 82:         const b64 = await toBase64(resp);
 83:         return b64;
 84:       } catch {
 85:         return null;
 86:       }
 87:     },
 88:     readFilesMulti: (paths: string[]) => {
 89:       return Promise.all(
 90:         paths.map(async (p) => ({
 91:           path: p,
 92:           data: await window.electronAPI!.readFile(p),
 93:         })),
 94:       );
 95:     },
 96: 
 97:     openPath: async (_path: string) => ({ success: true }),
 98: 
 99:     appendLog: async (payload: unknown) => {
100:       console.debug("[appendLog]", payload);
101:     },
102: 
103:     fmEnsureDirs: async () => ({
104:       success: true,
105:       paths: { commands: "commands" },
106:     }),
107:     fmTempPath: async (prefix: string, ext: string) => ({

262: export async function waitForDomReady(webview: HTMLElement & { isLoading?: () => boolean }) {
263:   if (!webview) return;
264:   try {
265:     if (typeof webview.isLoading === "function" && !webview.isLoading()) return;
266:     await new Promise((resolve) => {
267:       webview.addEventListener("dom-ready", resolve, { once: true });
268:     });
269:   } catch (e) {
270:   }
271: }

273: function setupNavigation() {
274:   try {
275:     // Listen for custom navigation events (from other parts of the app)
276:     document.addEventListener("navigate-page", ((e: CustomEvent<{ page: string }>) => {
277:       if (e.detail?.page) {
278:         showPage(e.detail.page);
279:       }
280:     }) as EventListener);
281:   } catch (error) {
282:     LogManager.addEvent("system", "error", `Navigation setup error: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`);
283:   }
284: }

286: /**
287:  * @param {string} pageName
288:  */
289: function showPage(pageName: string) {
290:   const previousPage = currentPage;
291:   if (
292:     previousPage &&
293:     previousPage !== pageName &&
294:     controllers[previousPage]?.onHide
295:   ) {
296:     controllers[previousPage].onHide();
297:   }
298:   document.querySelectorAll(".page").forEach((page) => {
299:     page.classList.add("hidden");
300:   });
301: 
302:   const pageElement = document.getElementById(`page-${pageName}`);
303:   if (pageElement) {
304:     pageElement.classList.remove("hidden");
305:     currentPage = pageName;
306: 
307:     if (controllers[pageName]?.onShow) {
308:       controllers[pageName].onShow();
309:     }
310: 
311:     setActiveNavigation(pageName);
312:   }
313: }

335: function setupTopBarButtons() {
336:   try {
337:     const asistanBtn = document.getElementById("asistan-btn");
338:     const themeToggle = document.getElementById("theme-toggle");
339: 
340:     if (asistanBtn) {
341:       asistanBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
342:         showPage("asistan");
343:       });
344:     }
345: 
346:     // Theme toggle in topbar
347:     if (themeToggle) {
348:       // Set initial icon
349:       themeToggle.textContent = ThemeManager.getIcon();
350:       
351:       themeToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
352:         // Doğrudan DOM'u güncelle - Vite HMR sorunlarını bypass et
353:         const root = document.documentElement;
354:         const currentTheme = root.getAttribute("data-theme") || "dark";
355:         const newTheme = currentTheme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
356:         
357:         root.setAttribute("data-theme", newTheme);
358:         localStorage.setItem("hayalet-ev-theme", newTheme);
359:         themeToggle.textContent = newTheme === "dark" ? "🌙" : "☀️";
360:         
361:         LogManager.addEvent("theme", "info", `Tema değiştirildi: ${newTheme}`, { visibility: 3 });
362:       });
363: 
364:       // Listen for theme changes from other sources (system preference etc.)
365:       ThemeManager.onChange(() => {
366:         themeToggle.textContent = ThemeManager.getIcon();
367:       });
368:     }
369: 
370:     // Side navigation overlay hover handling
371:     const sideNavOverlay = document.getElementById("side-nav-overlay");
372:     const sideNavTrigger = document.querySelector(".side-nav-trigger");
373:     const sideNavMenu = document.querySelector(".side-nav-menu");
374:     
375:     if (sideNavOverlay && sideNavTrigger && sideNavMenu) {
376:       // Trigger zone'a girildiğinde menüyü aç
377:       sideNavTrigger.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
378:         sideNavOverlay.classList.add("is-open");
379:       });
380:       
381:       // Menüden çıkıldığında kapat
382:       sideNavMenu.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
383:         sideNavOverlay.classList.remove("is-open");
384:       });
385:       
386:       // Trigger'dan direkt dışarı çıkıldığında (menüye girmeden)
387:       sideNavTrigger.addEventListener("mouseleave", (e) => {
388:         const relatedTarget = (e as MouseEvent).relatedTarget as Element | null;
389:         if (!relatedTarget || !sideNavMenu.contains(relatedTarget)) {
390:           // Kısa gecikme ile kapat (menüye geçiş için zaman tanı)
391:           setTimeout(() => {
392:             if (!sideNavOverlay.matches(":hover")) {
393:               sideNavOverlay.classList.remove("is-open");
394:             }
395:           }, 100);
396:         }
397:       });
398:     }
399: 
400:     // Page navigation buttons in side overlay
401:     const navButtons = document.querySelectorAll(".side-nav-btn") as NodeListOf<HTMLElement>;
402:     navButtons.forEach((btn) => {
403:       btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
404:         const page = btn.dataset.page;
405:         if (page) {
406:           showPage(page);
407:           // Update active state
408:           navButtons.forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
409:           btn.classList.add("active");
410:         }
411:       });
412:     });
413:   } catch (error) {
414:     LogManager.addEvent("system", "error", `Top bar setup error: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`);
415:   }
416: }

418: /**
419:  * @param {string} pageName
420:  */
421: function setActiveNavigation(pageName: string) {
422:   const menuItems = document.querySelectorAll(".menu-item") as NodeListOf<HTMLElement>;
423:   menuItems.forEach((mi) => mi.classList.remove("active"));
424:   if (!SPECIAL_PAGES.includes(pageName)) {
425:     menuItems.forEach((mi) => {
426:       if (mi.dataset.page === pageName) {
427:         mi.classList.add("active");
428:       }
429:     });
430:   }
431: 
432:   /** @type {Record<string, HTMLElement | null>} */
433:   const iconMap = {
434:     asistan: document.getElementById("asistan-btn"),
435:   };
436:   Object.values(iconMap).forEach((btn) => btn?.classList.remove("active"));
437:   const activeIcon = iconMap[pageName as keyof typeof iconMap];
438:   if (activeIcon) {
439:     activeIcon.classList.add("active");
440:   }
441: }

443: async function updateIndicatorAvatars() {
444:   const getAvatar = (provider: string) => AppState.getAvatar(provider);
445: 
446:   const map = {
447:     ai0: {
448:       el: document.getElementById("indicator-avatar-ai0"),
449:       path: getAvatar("ai0"),
450:       connected: SlotController.isConnected("ai0"),
451:       nickname: AppState.getNickname("ai0"),
452:       isAsistan: true,
453:     },
454:     ai1: {
455:       el: document.getElementById("indicator-avatar-ai1"),
456:       path: getAvatar("ai1"),
457:       connected: SlotController.isConnected("ai1"),
458:       nickname: AppState.getNickname("ai1"),
459:       isAsistan: false,
460:     },
461:     ai2: {
462:       el: document.getElementById("indicator-avatar-ai2"),
463:       path: getAvatar("ai2"),
464:       connected: SlotController.isConnected("ai2"),
465:       nickname: AppState.getNickname("ai2"),
466:       isAsistan: false,
467:     },
468:   };
469: 
470:   /**
471:    * @param {string | undefined} filePath
472:    * @returns {Promise<string | null>}
473:    */
474:   const buildDataUrl = async (filePath: string | undefined): Promise<string | null> => {
475:     if (!filePath || !window.electronAPI?.readFile) return null;
476:     try {
477:       const data = await window.electronAPI.readFile(filePath);
478:       if (!data) return null;
479:       const mime = getMimeTypeFromPath(filePath);
480:       return `data:${mime};base64,${data}`;
481:     } catch (err) {
482:       // Avatar okuma hatası - sessiz geç (kritik değil)
483:       return null;
484:     }
485:   };
486: 
487:   /**
488:    * @param {HTMLElement | null} el
489:    * @param {string | null} src
490:    * @param {boolean} connected
491:    */
492:   const applyAvatar = (el: HTMLElement | null, src: string | null, slotState: "empty" | "disconnected" | "connected") => {
493:     if (!el) return;
494:     if (src) {
495:       el.style.backgroundImage = `url('${src}')`;
496:       el.classList.remove("avatar-placeholder");
497:       el.textContent = "";
498:     } else {
499:       el.style.backgroundImage = "";
500:       el.classList.add("avatar-placeholder");
501:       el.textContent = "";
502:     }
503: 
504:     const cluster = el.closest(".indicator-cluster") as HTMLElement | null;
505:     if (!cluster) return;
506: 
507:     if (slotState === "empty") {
508:       el.style.opacity = "0.3";
509:       cluster.style.opacity = "0.5";
510:       cluster.style.pointerEvents = "none";
511:     } else if (slotState === "disconnected") {
512:       el.style.opacity = "0.6";
513:       cluster.style.opacity = "0.7";
514:       cluster.style.pointerEvents = "none";
515:     } else if (slotState === "connected") {
516:       el.style.opacity = "1";
517:       cluster.style.opacity = "1";
518:       cluster.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
519:     }
520:   };
521: 
522:   Object.entries(map).forEach(([provider, { el, path, isAsistan }]) => {
523:     if (!el) return;
524: 
525:     let slotState: "empty" | "disconnected" | "connected" = "empty";
526: 
527:     const settings = SettingsManager.getSnapshot();
528:     
529:     // Asistan için asistanSlot, diğerleri için slots kullan
530:     const hasAccount = isAsistan 
531:       ? !!settings?.asistanSlot?.accountId
532:       : !!settings?.slots?.[provider]?.accountId;
533:     const connected = SlotController.isConnected(provider);
534:     
535:     if (!hasAccount) {
536:       slotState = "empty";
537:     } else if (connected) {
538:       slotState = "connected";
539:     } else {
540:       slotState = "disconnected";
541:     }
542: 
543:     applyAvatar(el, null, slotState);
544:     if (path) {
545:       buildDataUrl(path).then((uri) => {
546:         if (uri) applyAvatar(el, uri, slotState);
547:       });
548:     }
549: 
550:     // Asistan için conversation select yok
551:     if (isAsistan) return;
552: 
553:     try {
554:       const conv = document.getElementById(`conversation-${provider}`) as HTMLSelectElement | null;
555:       if (conv) {
556:         conv.disabled = slotState !== "connected";
557:         try {
558:           const btn = document.getElementById(
559:             `conversation-refresh-${provider}`,
560:           ) as (HTMLButtonElement & { __convRefreshHandler?: EventListener }) | null;
561:           if (btn) {
562:             btn.disabled = slotState !== "connected";
563:             if (btn.__convRefreshHandler) {
564:               btn.removeEventListener("click", btn.__convRefreshHandler);
565:             }
566:             const handler: EventListener = async (ev: Event) => {
567:               ev?.preventDefault();
568:               try {
569:                 await WebviewManager.syncProvider(provider, { from: "manual" });
570:               } catch (err) {
571:                 LogManager.addEvent("sync", "warning", `Manual sync failed: ${getErrorMessage(err)}`);
572:               }
573:             };
574:             btn.__convRefreshHandler = handler;
575:             btn.addEventListener("click", handler);
576:           }
577:         } catch (e) {
578:           /* noop */
579:         }
580:       }
581:     } catch (e) {
582:     }
583:   });
584: }

586: /**
587:  * Relay göstergesini güncelle - Flow line animasyonları
588:  * AI-AI: Alt çizgi sarı/turuncu, AI1-Asistan: Sol çizgi yeşil, AI2-Asistan: Sağ çizgi mavi
589:  */
590: function updateRelayIndicator() {
591:   const flowAi1Ai0 = document.getElementById("relay-flow-ai1-ai0");
592:   const flowAi0Ai2 = document.getElementById("relay-flow-ai0-ai2");
593:   const flowAi1Ai2 = document.getElementById("relay-flow-ai1-ai2");
594:   
595:   if (!flowAi1Ai0 || !flowAi0Ai2 || !flowAi1Ai2) return;
596: 
597:   // Tüm relay class'ları temizle (thinking-active hariç - o TrafficManager tarafından yönetilir)
598:   flowAi1Ai0.classList.remove("active", "thinking");
599:   flowAi0Ai2.classList.remove("active", "thinking");
600:   flowAi1Ai2.classList.remove("active", "thinking");
601: 
602:   // Relay durumunu kontrol et
603:   const isAIAIActive = RelayManager.isAIAIActive();
604:   const isAIAsistanActive = RelayManager.isAIAsistanActive();
605:   const asistanSourceSlot = RelayManager.getAIAsistanSourceSlot();
606: 
607:   if (isAIAIActive) {
608:     // AI-AI Relay: Alt çizgi (AI1-AI2) sarı/turuncu animasyonlu
609:     flowAi1Ai2.classList.add("active");
610:     flowAi1Ai2.title = "AI1 ↔ AI2 Relay Aktif";
611:   } else if (isAIAsistanActive && asistanSourceSlot === "ai1") {
612:     // AI1-Asistan Relay: Sol çizgi yeşil animasyonlu
613:     flowAi1Ai0.classList.add("active");
614:     flowAi1Ai0.title = "AI1 ↔ Asistan Relay Aktif";
615:   } else if (isAIAsistanActive && asistanSourceSlot === "ai2") {
616:     // AI2-Asistan Relay: Sağ çizgi mavi animasyonlu
617:     flowAi0Ai2.classList.add("active");
618:     flowAi0Ai2.title = "Asistan ↔ AI2 Relay Aktif";
619:   } else {
620:     flowAi1Ai0.title = "";
621:     flowAi0Ai2.title = "";
622:     flowAi1Ai2.title = "";
623:   }
624: }
